docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• cli.py ​是​第二个​"​门面​ + N ​个​ mixin"​样板​：​门面​保留​ re-export ​接缝​（#116911）、​分​发表​和​装配​序​，​行为​全部​在​ hermes_cli/cli_*.py。
  • run() ​的​五步​顺序​是​踩​坑史​：​租约​（​防双​进程​）、ghost-line patch（​上游​十年​未修​）、​信号​武装​的​退出​看门狗​（#65998）。
  • ​斜杠​命令​的​"​表​驱动​ + getattr ​查找​ + ​返回​ False ​退出​"​是​一切​命令​（​含​插件​与​ skill ​命令​）​汇流​的​单点​。

docs.title: hermes_constants.py —— import-safe ​常量​与​ profile ​感知​路径
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：​根​ AGENTS.md ​的​ HX001 ​规则​（​永不​硬​编码​ ~/.hermes）。​本​文档​覆盖​ hermes_constants*.py ​全部​ 4 ​个​文件​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
# hermes_constants.py:1-4
"""Shared constants for Hermes Agent.

Import-safe, stdlib-only — importable from anywhere without circular-import risk.
"""

hermes_constants.py（1,490 ​行​）​是​全​仓库​的​"​路径​与​宿主​事实​"​单一​来源​。​它​的​契约​是​ import-safe：​只​依赖​标准​库​（​少数​函数​内​ lazy import pm、hermes_platform），​任何​模块​在​任何​阶段​都​能​ import ​它​而​不成​环​。get_hermes_home() / display_hermes_home() ​是​两条​铁律​（HX001/HX002）​的​实现​地​。

docs.title: 1. get_hermes_home()：​三级​解析​（​行​ 194）
docs.text:
# hermes_constants.py:194-201
def get_hermes_home() -> Path:
    """Hermes home: context-local override → ``HERMES_HOME`` env var → platform default."""
    override = get_hermes_home_override()
    if override:
        return _expand_hermes_home(override)
    if not os.environ.get("HERMES_HOME", "").strip():
        _warn_profile_fallback_once()
    return get_process_hermes_home()

​解析​顺序​：contextvar ​覆盖​（set_hermes_home_override，​供​单线程​任务​临时​换家​，​绝不​碰​ os.environ——​那​是​全线​程​共享​的​）→ HERMES_HOME ​环境变量​ → ​平台​默认​。​平台​默认​在​ _platform_default_hermes_home（​行​ 57）：Windows ​走​ %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes，POSIX ​走​ ~/.hermes，​支持​ HERMES_DATA_DIR_SUFFIX。env ​缺失​而​ sticky ​的​ active_profile ​又​不是​ default ​时发​一次性​ stderr ​警告​——​子​进程​ spawner ​忘传​ HERMES_HOME ​是​数据​落错​ profile ​的​经典​事故​（#18594）。

get_process_hermes_home（​行​ 243）​是​"​进程​自己​的​家​"（​跟随​ HERMES_HOME ​现场​解析​）；pin_process_hermes_home（​行​ 259）​允许​嵌入​宿主​把​"​本​进程​服务​的​ profile"​钉住​，​路由​决策​用​ get_routing_process_hermes_home ​读钉值​，​避免​把​镜像​进​ env ​的​ turn-level profile ​误当​启动​ profile。

docs.title: 2. display_hermes_home()：​给​人​看​的​路径​（​行​ 648）
docs.text:
# hermes_constants.py:648-659
def display_hermes_home(home: Path | None = None) -> str:
    """User-facing ``~/`` display string for HERMES_HOME (``~/.hermes/profiles/coder``)."""
    if home is None:
        home = get_hermes_home()
    try:  # as_posix(): str() on Windows yields chimeras like ~/AppData\Local\hermes/skills/
        return "~/" + home.relative_to(Path.home()).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return str(home)

​打印​到​ UI/​文档​的​路径​必须​走​它​：​相对​ Path.home() ​化成​ ~/...，Windows ​上用​ as_posix() ​防止​ ~/AppData\Local\hermes ​这种​混合​斜杠​"​奇美​拉​"。

docs.title: 3. _get_profiles_root() ​为什么​故意​ HOME ​锚定
docs.text:
profile ​体系​的​根​判定​（_is_hermes_profiles_root，​行​ 323；named_profile_home，​行​ 345）​不​跟随​ HERMES_HOME ​随意​漂移​：<root>/profiles/<name> ​是否是​合法​ profile ​树​，​看​的​是​native home ​的​形状​ + ​标记​文件​（config.yaml/.env/state.db）+ .deleted ​墓碑​（profile delete ​才​会​创建​）。​配套​的​身份​判定​把​"​目录​存在​"​与​"profile ​可​服务​"​分开​：

# hermes_constants.py:399-408（​节选​）
# A directory under profiles/ is a profile only when something identifies it as one.
# Runtime side-effects (cron heartbeats, log rotation, caches) create dirs that carry
# none of these; a pre-tombstone ghost shell or a stray infrastructure dir must never
# be listed, served, ticked, or seeded with the default install's credentials.
_PROFILE_IDENTITY_MARKERS = ("config.yaml", ".env", "SOUL.md", "profile.yaml", "auth.json", "state.db")
PROFILE_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$")

def named_profile_has_identity(profile_home: str | Path) -> bool:
    home = Path(profile_home)
    return any((home / marker).is_file() or (home / marker).is_symlink() for marker in _PROFILE_IDENTITY_MARKERS)

cron ​心跳​、​日志​轮转​这​类​运行​时​副作用​创建​的​目录​没有​这些​标记​，​永远​不该​被​列出​、​服务​或用​默认​凭据​播种​。named_profile_has_servable_identity ​更严​：​空​ .env ​是​崩溃​的​ profile create ​留下​的​壳​，​可​列出​但​不算​第二个​租户​。

docs.title: 4. ​子​进程​ HOME ​契约​与​ scratch ​目录
docs.text:
# hermes_constants.py:765-800（​节选​）
def get_subprocess_home(env=None) -> str | None:
    """Subprocess ``HOME`` override, or ``None``.

    ``auto``: hosts keep real HOME (repairing a profile-home parent), containers use
    ``{HERMES_HOME}/home``; ``real``: always real HOME; ``profile``: always the profile home.
    """

get_real_home（​行​ 738）​从​候选​序列​（HERMES_REAL_HOME、HOME、pwd ​数据库​、USERPROFILE、HOMEDRIVE+HOMEPATH、expanduser）​里​挑​第一个​不是​ profile-home ​的​——​外部​ CLI ​的​凭据​在​真​ HOME ​下​，​父​进程​带​ HOME={HERMES_HOME}/home ​时要​修复​回去​。scratch ​目录​（​行​ 803-1070）​是​ Hermes ​自己​的​临时​空间​：​每个​进程​与子​进程​的​ TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP ​被​指向​ <HERMES_HOME>/cache/scratch（​系统​ /tmp ​是​ tmpfs，​浏览器​配置​和​下载​会​吃​内存​）；​保留​策略​是​ idle 24h（​子树内​最后​一次​写入​起​算​），​而​不是​固定​年龄​——​目录​自身​ mtime ​只​在​直接​子项​增删​时​移动​。

docs.title: 5. ​其余​高频​出口
docs.text:
• mkdir_under_hermes_home（​行​ 461）：​建​目录​前​断言​目标​不是​已​删除​/​缺失​的​命名​ profile（​防​墓碑​复活​），​再​经​ hermes_dir_acl.make_user_dir ​创建​。
  • apply_secure_dir_policy（​行​ 926）：Hermes home ​目录​权限​策略​的​唯一​实现​（managed ​安装​不​动​、​容器​里​只有​显式​ HERMES_HOME_MODE ​才动​、​其余​ 0700），​与​ CLI ​的​ _secure_dir ​共享​一份​逻辑​。
  • parse_reasoning_effort / resolve_reasoning_config（​行​ 1076/1188）：reasoning effort ​解析​的​单一​汇合点​（CLI、​网关​、TUI、cron、/model ​全走​这里​）。
  • openrouter_variant_base（​行​ 1331）：:nitro/:floor/:exacto/:online ​是​请求​期​路由​后缀​，​目录​查找​必须​折回​基础​ id；:free/:batch ​是​真​ SKU，​绝不能​剥​。
  • emit_partial_update_hint（​行​ 1462）：import ​报错​是​"​半​更新​树​"​时​给出​恢复​指引​。
  • normalize_scope（​行​ 1472）：​写侧​注册​ scope ​键​归​一​——None ​在​写​路径​意味着​"​进程​全局​层​"，​在读​路径​却是​"​活动​ home"，​两种​契约​绝不​统一​。

docs.title: 6. ​两个​容易​误用​的​辅助​函数
docs.text:
# hermes_constants.py:113-141（​节选​）
def hermes_root_for_environment(environ: Mapping[str, str]) -> Path | None:
    """The Hermes root that a process started with *environ* resolves, or None.

    Applies the root rules of ``get_default_hermes_root`` to another process's
    environment. ``%NAME%``, ``${NAME}`` and ``$NAME`` references and a leading
    ``~`` expand from *environ* alone, never from this process. Returns None
    when the answer depends on anything outside *environ*: ...
    """

hermes_root_for_environment ​回答​"​另​一个​进程​会​解析​到​哪个​家​"——​只​看​传入​的​ env ​字典​，​绝不​碰本​进程​环境​；​答案​依赖​字典​之外​的​信息​（​相对​ HERMES_HOME、​未定义​变量​、​缺​用户​ profile ​目录​）​时​返回​ None ​而​不是​猜​。sudo_invoker_default_home（​行​ 144）​是​它​的​姊妹​：sudo ​会​剥掉​ HERMES_HOME ​并​把​ HOME ​设​成​ /root，​此时​要​操作​的​ profile ​存储​和​系统​服务​属于​ SUDO_USER。

​另​一个​易错​点​是​ scope ​键​的​两套​契约​（​行​ 1472 normalize_scope ​的​ docstring ​写得​最全​）：​写​/​槽​位​路径​（register_*、​快照​恢复​、​工具​注册表​槽​位​查找​）​里​ None ​意​为​"​进程​全局​层​"，​必须​保持​ None；​读​路径​（list_providers、get_provider）​里​ None ​意​为​"​活动​ home"，​必须​经​ hermes_home_key() ​归一​——​在读​路径​误用​ normalize_scope ​会​把​所有​带​ scope ​的​注册​全部​隐藏​（​某次​修复​正是​踩​了​这个​坑​）。hermes_home_key（​行​ 212）​本身​带​按​输入​路径​的​记忆​缓存​：​它​坐在​工具​注册表​ current_scope_key() ​的​每次​查找​下方​，​没有​缓存​就要​每次​付​一次​ Path.resolve() ​系统​调用​。

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​一行​角色​ hermes_constants.py 1,490 ​路径​/profile/​权限​/reasoning ​解析​的​ import-safe ​门面​ hermes_constants_scratch.py ~600 scratch ​保留​规则​：idle ​判定​ + ​收割​（​杀​浏览器​、git worktree prune），​注册​进程​不算​孤儿​（#132401） hermes_constants_scratch_detach.py ~100 ​每​小时​清理​跑​在​分​离子​进程​里​（​不​拖​短命​命令​、​不随​守护​线程​死亡​） hermes_constants_scratch_stuck.py ~230 POSIX：​本​用户​删不掉​的​ scratch ​条目​记​一次​、​跳过​直到​修复

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​所有​模块​：get_hermes_home() ​的​消费者​横跨​ agent/tools/gateway/cli——​这​正是​它​必须​ import-safe ​的​原因​。
  • hermes_dir_acl.py：mkdir_under_hermes_home ​落到​ make_user_dir；ACL ​模块​也​ import ​本​模块​取家​路径​。
  • hermes_state.py：_default_db_path() ​每次​现场​调​ get_hermes_home()。
  • hermes_logging.py：​日志​目录​经​ mkdir_under_hermes_home(home / "logs")。
  • hermes_platform/：is_wsl/is_container/is_termux ​探测​委托​给​平台​权威​模块​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​本​文件​是​"​没有​依赖​的​底座​"：​正​因为​零​依赖​，​它​才能​被​ 86 ​个根​文件​与​全部包​共享​而​不成​环​。
  • ​三条​值得​记住​的​纪律​：​路径​永远​经​ get_hermes_home()（HX001）、​目录​创建​永远​经​ mkdir_under_hermes_home（​防​墓碑​复活​ + Windows ACL）、​权限​策略​只有​ apply_secure_dir_policy ​一份​实现​。
  • profile ​判定​故意​锚定​ HOME/​标记​文件​而​非​ env ​漂移​——​这是​"​一个​进程​服务​多个​ profile"​世界​的​安全​底线​。

docs.title: hermes_state.py —— SQLite ​状态​库​的​门面​（65 ​个​文件​的​一家​）
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：../01_architecture/state_model.md；​更细​的​主题​文档​在​ ../07_state/。​本章​讲​门面​与​兄弟​的​分工​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:1-6
"""SQLite state store for Hermes Agent: session metadata, message history, model
config, FTS5 search. WAL mode (concurrent readers + one writer); compression
splits sessions via parent_session_id chains; sessions are source-tagged
('cli', 'telegram', ...). Batch-runner / RL trajectories live elsewhere.
"""

hermes_state.py（1,738 ​行​）​是​ SessionDB ​的​门面​。​四个​关键​事实​浓缩​在​ docstring ​里​：WAL ​多读​一写​；​压缩​经​ parent_session_id ​拆​谱系​（​一次​压缩​生成​新会​话行​，​旧会话​成为​父​节点​）；​会话​带​来源​标签​（cli / telegram / …）；​批量​/RL ​轨迹​另存​。​实现​散布​在​ 64 ​个​ hermes_state_*.py ​兄弟​中​——​根目录​ 86 ​个​ .py ​文件​里​这​一家​占​ 65 ​个​。

docs.title: 1. SessionDB：18 ​个​ mixin ​的​组装​（​行​ 464）
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:464-473
class SessionDB(
    SessionSessionsMixin, SessionFtsSetupMixin, SessionSearchMixin, SessionSchemaMixin,
    SessionPortabilityMixin, SessionTelegramTopicsMixin, SessionCompressionMixin,
    SessionGatewayMixin, SessionMaintenanceMixin, SessionUsageMixin, SessionTitlesMixin,
    SessionMessagesMixin, SessionPruneRewriteMixin, SessionApiContentMixin, SessionCoverageMixin,
    SessionRewindMixin, SessionProfileRepairMixin, SessionPromptRefreshMixin,
):
    """SQLite-backed session storage with FTS5 search; many reader threads, one writer (WAL)."""

​与​ AIAgent（14 ​个​ mixin）、HermesCLI（18 ​个​）​同构​：​门面​只​负责​把​主题​ mixin ​钉进​ MRO。​门面​自己​保留​的​是​写​路径​的​心脏​与​安全网​：__init__（​行​ 584）、_execute_write（​行​ 1014）、close（​行​ 1527）、​文件​身份​/​代数​/​损坏​隔离​逻辑​（​行​ 1226-1400）。

docs.title: 2. ​打开​路径​与​守护
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:584-588（​节选​）
    def __init__(self, db_path: Path | None = None, read_only: bool = False):
        self.db_path = db_path or _default_db_path()
        _ensure_test_isolation(self.db_path)  # before any connection/pragma/mkdir

​任何​连接​之前​先​做​live-system guard：pytest ​上下文​（env ​或​祖先​进程​）​解析​到​生产​ state.db ​直接​抛错​（#82770：​子​进程​重建​环境​后​丢​了​ HERMES_HOME，​恰好​是​要​写​生产​库​的​状态​）。​可​写​打开​走​ _open_writer（​行​ 679）：​预检可​写性​ → ​零​字节​/​坏头​隔离​（quarantine）→ ​连接​ + schema（​坏​ sqlite_master ​一次性​就​地​修复​）→ ​生成​戳​（state_meta + PRAGMA application_id，​行​ 1184）。​打开​失败​的​原因​记录​在​ _set_last_init_error（hermes_state_guard.py），​供​ /resume ​等​界面​给出​人​话​。

docs.title: 3. ​写​路径​纪律​：_execute_write（​行​ 1014）
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:1014-1021（​节选​）
    def _execute_write(
        self, fn: Callable[[sqlite3.Connection], T], patience_s: Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> T:
        """Run *fn(conn)* inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE with jittered lock retry; commit
        is handled here (callers must not commit). Returns *fn*'s result.
        BEGIN IMMEDIATE takes the WAL write lock up front so contention surfaces
        immediately; on locked/busy the Python lock is released, a jitter slept,
        and the WHOLE callback retried — *fn* must stay idempotent under retry."""

​要点​：BEGIN IMMEDIATE ​抢锁​前移​，​冲突​立刻​可见​；​抖动​重试​整个​回调​（​前​ 2 ​秒​ 20-150ms ​快​抖动​，​之后​ 250ms-1s ​慢​抖动​）；​耐心​按​用途​分级​——​普通​写​ 20s、​转录​写​ 60s、​观测​性​活动​写仅​ 0.5s（​行​ 488）；​压缩​租约​冲突​单独​给​ 5s ​短​等待​（_COMPRESSION_BUSY_WAIT_S），​超时​拒绝​而​不是​把​陈旧​ turn ​落​进​正在​压缩​的​会​话​。​每​ 50 ​次​成功​写​做​一次​ PASSIVE checkpoint（TRUNCATE ​曾​在​大库​上​撕裂​ B-tree，#45383）。​锁​耗尽​时​的​报错​说人话​：​指出​"​另​一个​ Hermes ​进程​持有​写锁​超过​ N ​秒​"，​持有者​信息​进​日志​而​不是​消息​（​避免​ argv ​里​的​词​改变​错误​分类​）。

docs.title: 4. ​读​路径​分裂​与​ close
docs.text: WAL ​模式​下读​走​有界​只读​连接池​（_read_ctx，​行​ 927）：​池借​不到​（​许可​按​数据库​路径​共享​，hermes_state_readpool.py）​就​降级​到​写​锁​——"​慢​优于​ EMFILE"。close()（​行​ 1527）​先​排空​ token ​队列​，​再​按​状态​收敛​：registry ​共享​实例​只放​ refcount（hermes_state_registry.release）；WAL ​代数​丢失​的​句柄​先留证​捕获​（capture_retired_wal_generation）​再​决定​是否​永不​ close（Python < 3.12 ​无法​关掉​关闭​时​ checkpoint，​只能​把​连接​ pin ​住​）；​干净​关闭​才​做​ PASSIVE checkpoint ​并​清空​ sidecar ​身份​。

docs.title: 5. ​为什么​ hermes_state_common.py ​住​在​门面​外
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:31-36
from hermes_state_common import (
    TITLE_SOURCE_DERIVED as _TITLE_SOURCE_DERIVED, ...
)

64 ​个​兄弟​里​有​一个​特例​：hermes_state_common.py（75k ​字节​，​全​家族​最大​的​纯​助手​集​）​不​ import ​门面​，​只​被​门面​和​兄弟​ import。​原因​是​破环​：​门面​要​从​它​取​常量​/​助手​，​兄弟​也​要​从​它​取​；​若​它​反过来​函数​内​ late-import ​门面​没​问题​，​但​它​被​门面​在​模块​级​ import，​任何​门面​级​回引​都​会​成环​。​其余​兄弟​全部​遵循​"​函数​内​ late-import ​门面​"​模式​——​例如​压缩​、​搜索​ mixin ​需要​访问​ SessionDB ​的​写​路径​时​，​都​是从​ hermes_state ​取名字​，​这​让​门面​保持​ patch seam ​地位​。

docs.title: 6. ​主题​如何​找到​实现
docs.text:
​门面​里​没有​"​压缩​怎么​写库​"。​按​主题​ grep：

grep -rn "def compress" hermes_state_*.py       # → hermes_state_compression.py / _mutation_compress.py
grep -rn "def add_message" hermes_state_*.py    # → hermes_state_messages.py
grep -rn "def search_messages" hermes_state_*.py  # → hermes_state_search.py

​完整​主题​分组​（​谱系​/​写​路径​/mutation ​收据​/repair）​见​ ../07_state/ ​目录​文档​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​门面​保留​写​路径​心脏​与​安全网​（​身份​/​代数​/​损坏​隔离​），18 ​个​ mixin ​按​主题​分家​；65 ​个​文件​是​一家​，​主题​查找​靠​ grep，​细节​在​ 07_state。
  • ​三条​贯穿​纪律​：​测试​永不​碰​生产​库​（guard）、​写​必须​走​ _execute_write ​的​重试​与​分级​耐心​、​结构​损坏​永远​隔离​而​非​就​地​修复​。
  • hermes_state_common.py ​是​唯一​的​例外​邻居​——​住​在​门面​外是​为​破​导入​环​，​也​是​理解​整个​家族​ import ​拓扑​的​钥匙​。

docs.title: misc_root —— trajectory_compressor.py、batch_runner.py、registration_lifecycle.py
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：​无​。​三个​不​属于​"agent ​运行​时主链​"​的​独立​工具​，​但​都​是​根目录​正式​成员​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​一句​话​ trajectory_compressor.py 867 ​离线​轨迹​压缩器​：​把​已​保存​的​ agent ​轨迹​压进​ token ​预算​（​不是​循环​内​压缩​！） batch_runner.py 1,024 ​批量​跑​ agent：JSONL ​提示​词​数据​集​ + ​多​进程​池​ + checkpoint ​恢复​ registration_lifecycle.py 95 ​可​替换​运行​时​注册​的​所有权​租约​（​代际​模型​，​不是​值​比较​）

docs.title: 1. ​它​不是​循环​内​的​上下文​压缩
docs.text:
# trajectory_compressor.py:1-12
"""Trajectory Compressor — post-process agent trajectories into a token budget.

Strategy: protect the head (system, human, first gpt, first tool) and the last N
turns; from the middle, summarize only as many turns as needed (never splitting a
<tool_call>/<tool_response> pair) and replace them with one human summary turn.

Usage:
    python trajectory_compressor.py --input=data/my_run            # directory
    python trajectory_compressor.py --input=data/trajectories.jsonl --sample_percent=15
    python trajectory_compressor.py --input=data/trajectories.jsonl --output=out.jsonl --target_max_tokens=16000
"""

agent/context_compressor.py ​是​运行​中会​话​的​压缩​引擎​；​本​文件​是​事后​批处理​工具​：​输入​ JSONL ​轨迹​文件​或​目录​，​输出​压缩​后​的​数据​集​。​策略​是​"​保头​（system/​首条​ human/​首条​ gpt/​首条​ tool）+ ​保尾​ N ​轮​，​中间​只​摘要​到​刚好​达标​，​绝不​切开​ <tool_call>/<tool_response> ​对​，​用​一条​ human ​摘要​轮​替换​"。​它​刻意​避免​导入​重型​上下文​压缩器​——_response_finish_reason（​行​ 41）​直接​声明​"local copy of agent.context_compressor._response_finish_reason: this standalone CLI deliberately avoids importing the heavy context compressor"；​只有​ agent.compression_marker.elide_middle ​这类​纯​函数​被​复用​。

docs.title: 1. ​批处理​骨架
docs.text:
# batch_runner.py:1-7
"""Batch Agent Runner — run the agent over a JSONL prompt dataset in parallel.

Batches are processed by a multiprocessing pool with per-batch ``batch_N.jsonl`` output,
checkpointing for ``--resume``, trajectories in from/value format, and tool-usage
statistics aggregated across all batches. See ``main`` (fire CLI) for usage.
"""

​开头​同样​遵守​"bootstrap ​第一​"（​行​ 9-15，​带半​更新​树​容错​）。ALL_POSSIBLE_TOOLS = set(TOOL_TO_TOOLSET_MAP.keys())（​行​ 46）​从​ model_tools ​自动​派生​，​保证​每条​轨迹​的​ tool_stats schema ​一致​（​适配​ Arrow/Parquet ​的​ HF ​数据​集​），​并​在​合并​轨迹​时​过滤​幻觉​出​的​工具​名​。

docs.title: 2. BatchRunner ​与​工具集​分布
docs.text:
# batch_runner.py:428-466（​节选​）
class BatchRunner:
    """Manages batch processing of agent prompts with checkpointing and statistics."""

    def __init__(self, dataset_file, batch_size, run_name, distribution="default", max_iterations=10,
                 base_url=None, api_key=None, model="claude-opus-4-20250514", num_workers=4, ...):
        """Load the dataset (truncated to *max_samples*), validate *distribution*, create batches.

        ``ephemeral_system_prompt`` is used during execution but NOT saved to trajectories. ...
        """
        params = dict(locals())
        ...
        # Batch runs are their own execution surface; declaring it here keeps every
        # worker's task-run telemetry attributable instead of falling back to "unknown".
        self.platform = "batch"

        if not validate_distribution(distribution):
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown distribution: {distribution}. ...")

--distribution ​直接​消费​ toolsets.md ​的​ toolset_distributions（​每个​ prompt ​独立​采样​工具集​）；self.platform = "batch" ​让​共享​指标​不会​把​ worker ​归​到​ "unknown" ​执行​面​。_AGENT_PASSTHROUGH（​行​ 59）​列出​逐字​转发给​每个​ AIAgent ​的​参数​；_prepare_container_image（​行​ 178）​支持​数据​集行​携带​ image/docker_image——Docker ​后端​先​ inspect/pull ​验证​镜像​再花​ token。run()（​行​ 803）​是​多​进程​池主​循环​，main（​行​ 871）​是​ fire CLI（--resume ​从​ checkpoint ​续​跑​）。

docs.title: 3. ​成功​/​失败​判定
docs.text: _tool_call_succeeded（​行​ 105）：JSON ​结果​有​非空​ error ​或​ success: false ​才​算​失败​；​非​ JSON ​仅​在​"​空​或​以​ Error: ​开头​"​时算​失败​——​非零​退出​码​不是​失败​（​模型​会​自我​纠正​），​且​不​做​子串​匹配​避免​误伤​。

docs.title: 1. ​代际​而​非值​：​所有权​租约
docs.text:
# registration_lifecycle.py:1-5
"""Ownership leases for replaceable runtime registrations.

The coordinator models registration *generations*, not just value identity: the same provider
singleton may be registered again after an older ownership generation was unloaded.
"""

​同一个​ provider ​单例​可能​被​再次​注册​——​按​"​值​是否​相等​"​判断​归属​会​错乱​，​所以​模型​是​代际​（generation）：

# registration_lifecycle.py:53-62（​节选​）
    def acquire(self, slot: Hashable, *, current: Any, previous: Any, restore: Callable[[Any], bool],
                finalize: Callable[[Any], None] | None = None) -> ReplacementLease:
        """Attach a new live generation to the matching active predecessor."""
        with self._lock:
            leases = self._active.setdefault(slot, [])
            predecessor = next((c for c in reversed(leases) if c.active and same_registration(c.current, previous)), None)
            lease = ReplacementLease(self, slot, current, previous, restore, finalize, predecessor)
            leases.append(lease)
            return lease

acquire ​把​新​租约​挂到​"​以​ previous ​为​ current ​的​活跃​前驱​"​上​；dispose（​行​ 63）​按序​执行​ restore → finalize → ​槽​位​清理​（​每​一步​即使​前面​抛​异常​也​继续​跑​），​并​只有​最晚​的​活跃​代际​可以​改写​槽​位​——​两个​代际​共享​同一​对象​身份​时​，​注册​表层​的​ CAS ​分不清​它们​，​这​条​规则​避免​了​老​代际​覆盖​新​注册​。same_registration（​行​ 16）​只​做​身份​比较​（​元组​逐​元素​），​模块​底部​ replacement_coordinator = ReplacementCoordinator()（​行​ 95）​是​进程​级​单例​。​消费者​在​插件​侧​：hermes_cli/plugins*.py ​用​它​在​插件​重载​时​安全​地​换入​/​换​出​ provider ​注册​并​在​失败​时回​滚​到​前代​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• run_agent.py / model_tools.py：batch_runner ​直接​ from run_agent import AIAgent、from model_tools import TOOL_TO_TOOLSET_MAP；trajectory_compressor ​复用​ agent.compression_marker.elide_middle ​但​拒绝​整包​导入​压缩​引擎​。

  • **hermes_cli/plugins.py*：registration_lifecycle ​的​唯一​运行​时​消费者​（​插件​重载​的​回滚​语义​）。
  • ​数据​产物​：​两者​都​写​ JSONL ​轨迹​（from/value ​格式​、trajectory_samples.jsonl），​是​ RL/​评测​数据​管线​的​两端​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​三个​文件​共同点​是​"​围绕​主​循环​但​不​进主​循环​"：​一个​产出​训练​数据​、​一个​消费​提示​词​数据​集​、​一个​守​着​插件​注册​的​换代​安全​。
  • trajectory_compressor ​的​"​保头​保尾​ + ​不​切​ tool ​对​"​策略​与​循环​内​压缩​共享​思想​但​独立​实现​——​离线​工具​不应​背​运行​时​的​依赖​重量​。
  • registration_lifecycle ​用​ 95 ​行​讲清​了​一个​通用​难题​：​同一个​单例​的​两次​注册​，​如何​按代​而​非​按值​回滚​。

docs.title: model_tools.py —— ​工具​注册表​之上​的​薄​编排​层
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：../01_architecture/tool_system.md、toolsets.md。​注册表​本体​在​ tools/registry.py，​本章​讲​编排​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
model_tools.py（1,018 ​行​）​的​模块​ docstring ​自我​定位​很​清楚​：

# model_tools.py:1-7
"""Thin orchestration layer over the tool registry.

Importing runs tool discovery (each tools/*.py self-registers via
tools.registry.register()); exposes get_tool_definitions() (toolset-filtered
schemas sent to the model) and handle_function_call() (dispatch with
hooks/middleware) plus registry pass-throughs.
"""

​它​只​做​三件​事​：​导入​即​发现​工具​、​组面​（​决定​每次​ API ​请求​带​哪些​工具​ schema）、​派发​（​把​模型​的​一次​ tool call ​安全​送达​处理函数​）。​注册表​（tools.registry.registry）​保存​真正​的​ schema ​与​ handler。

docs.title: 1. ​导入​即​发现​（​行​ 151）​与​"​故意​不​发现​的​ MCP"
docs.text:
# model_tools.py:150-166（​节选​）
# --- Tool discovery (importing each tools/*.py triggers registry.register) ---
discover_builtin_tools()

# MCP discovery is deliberately NOT run here: it blocks up to 120 s and the
# gateway lazy-imports this module inside its event loop; each entry point
# (gateway/run.py, cli.py, tui_gateway, acp_adapter) runs it at startup.
try:  # plugin tool discovery (user/project/pip plugins)
    from hermes_cli.plugins import discover_plugins
    discover_plugins()
except Exception as e:
    logger.debug("Plugin discovery failed: %s", e)
  • discover_builtin_tools() ​定义​在​ tools/registry.py:121：​对​ tools/*.py ​逐​文件​做​ AST ​预​过滤​（​只有​确实​出现​ registry.register(...) ​的​文件​才​值得​ import），​判定​结果​带​ (mtime_ns, size) ​键​落盘​缓存​，​整体​约​ 145 ms。
  • safe-worker ​模式​下​导入​图​被​刻意​收紧​：​只​ import tools.file_tools、tools.terminal_tool、tools.process_registry ​三个​已​审计​核心​模块​，​不​碰​插件​包装​器​与​ profile ​可写​的​发现​缓存​。
  • MCP ​发现​被​故意​排除​：discover_mcp_tools() ​内部​有​一个​ future.result(timeout=120) ​的​阻塞​等待​，​而​网关​会​在​事件​循环​里​ lazy-import ​本​模块​——​曾经​导致​任何​一台​配置​了​慢​ MCP ​服务器​的​机器​在​第一条​用户​消息​处​冻结​ Discord/Telegram ​心跳​最长​ 120 ​秒​（issue #16856）。​现在​ MCP ​发现​由​各​入口​点​（gateway、cli、tui_gateway、acp）​自己​负责​。

docs.title: 2. ​组面​管线​：get_tool_definitions（​行​ 227）
docs.text:
# model_tools.py:227-235（​节选​）
def get_tool_definitions(enabled_toolsets=None, disabled_toolsets=None,
                         quiet_mode: bool = False, skip_tool_search_assembly: bool = False) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Tool definitions for model API calls, filtered by toolset.

    enabled_toolsets None = all; disabled_toolsets are subtracted after enabling.
    quiet_mode suppresses status prints and enables memoization.
    """

​未​缓存​的​实现​在​ _compute_tool_definitions（​行​ 522），​管线​依次​是​：

  1. ​选名​：_select_tool_names（​行​ 333）。enabled ​是​并​集​；disabled ​最后​才​减​：
# model_tools.py:349-355（​节选​）
    # Disabled toolsets are always subtracted LAST, so a tool in a disabled
    # toolset is stripped even when a composite (hermes-cli) re-enables it.
    # See issue #17309.
    if disabled_toolsets:
        _apply_toolset_selection(tools, disabled_toolsets, quiet_mode, disable=True)
    return tools

​关键​在​顺序​：disabled_toolsets: [browser] ​必须​能​从​ hermes-cli ​这​类​复合​包里​把​ web_search ​也​剥掉​（#17309、#64503），​所以​"​最后​减​"​是​语义​的​一部分​。​平台​包名​出现​在​ disabled ​里​只会​剥​非核心​增量​并​告警​（bundle_non_core_tools）。

  1. check_fn ​过滤​：registry.get_definitions(tools_to_include, ...) ​用​每个​工具​的​可达性​检查​函数​（service-gated：​没配​ API key ​的​工具​不​出现​）。
  2. ​动态​ schema ​重写​：_DYNAMIC_SCHEMA_REWRITERS（​行​ 487）​是​ ​工具​名​ → ​重写​函数​ ​的​表​——execute_code ​只​列出​本会话​真正​可用​的​沙箱​工具​、discord ​按​ intents ​出​ schema、delegate_task ​描述​里​的​"​子​代理​禁用​工具​"​列表​裁剪​到​本会话​确实​存在​的​名字​，​重写​函数​返回​ None ​表示​整个​工具​从​面上​消失​。
  3. schema ​消毒​ + Tool Search ​折叠​：sanitize_tool_schemas ​归一化​ llama.cpp ​语法​转换器​拒绝​的​形状​；​然后​ Tool Search（​渐进式​披露​）​把​超预算​的​ MCP/​插件​工具​折叠​成​ tool_search/tool_describe/tool_call ​桥​。

​缓存​纪律​是​这​一节​的​另一半​：

# model_tools.py:268-270
    # Always a shallow copy: run_agent appends memory/LCM schemas to its list; a
    # shared list would accumulate duplicate names (HTTP 400 from DeepSeek/Kimi/MiMo).
    return list(cached)

​缓存​键​（_tool_defs_cache_key，​行​ 273）​覆盖​：registry ​代数​ _generation、check_fn cache epoch、config.yaml ​的​版本​指纹​、kanban ​上下文​、​委派​上下文​、profile scope。​容量​上限​ 8 ​条​ FIFO（​长命​网关​的​热​工作​集​）。​必须​返回​浅​拷贝​：​网关​长​进程​里​各​ agent init ​共享​同一​列表​、​又​各自​往​里​ append ​记忆​工具​ schema，​曾经​累积​出​重复​工具​名​，​强制​唯一​工具​名​的​ provider（DeepSeek、​小米​ MiMo、Moonshot Kimi）​直接​ HTTP 400（issue #17335）。​另外​每条​缓存​条目​带​ check_fn ​判决​窗​过期​时间​——MCP ​服务器​掉线​重连​不重​注册​的​场景​不能​被​缓存​永久​藏住​。

docs.title: 3. ​派发​管线​：handle_function_call（​行​ 897）
docs.text:
# model_tools.py:897-921（​节选​）
def handle_function_call(
    function_name: str, function_args: dict[str, Any], task_id=None, tool_call_id=None, session_id=None,
    turn_id=None, api_request_id=None, user_task=None, enabled_tools=None,
    skip_pre_tool_call_hook: bool = False, skip_tool_request_middleware: bool = False,
    skip_tool_execution_middleware: bool = False, tool_request_middleware_trace=None,
    enabled_toolsets=None, disabled_toolsets=None, conversation_id=None,
) -> str:
    """Route a tool call through hooks/middleware to the registry; returns a JSON string."""
    function_args = coerce_tool_args(function_name, function_args)
    if not isinstance(function_args, dict):
        function_args = {}
    trace = list(tool_request_middleware_trace or [])
    function_name = _LEGACY_TOOL_ALIASES.get(function_name, function_name)
    ids = _CallIds(task_id, session_id, tool_call_id, turn_id, api_request_id, conversation_id)

​完整​管线​（​自上而下​）：

​步​ ​做​什么​ ​代码​ 1 ​参数​类型​矫正​ coerce_tool_args（​模型​把​数组​发​成​字符串​等​） ​行​ 914 2 ​旧名​别名​ _LEGACY_TOOL_ALIASES（​行​ 633：todo ​旧名​→todo_list、cronjob→cronjob_manage…），​旧会话​/​存档​提示​词​继续​可用​ ​行​ 918 3 Tool Search ​桥​ _dispatch_bridge_tool（​行​ 724）：tool_search/tool_describe ​是​目录​读​；tool_call ​解包​成​真​工具​名​递归​重入​本​函数​，​让​下游​钩子​永远​看到​真名​ ​行​ 931-948 4 connectors ​门控​：connectors__<c>__<t> ​命名​与​ manage_connections ​必须​在​本会话​工具​面上​ ​行​ 950-956 5 tool_request ​中间件​（​可​改参​、fail-open） ​行​ 958-960 6 _AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS ​拦截​（​见​下​） ​行​ 963 7 pre_tool_call ​插件​钩子​（​可​拦截​/​改参​，​单发​契约​）+ ACP ​编辑​审批​ _pre_dispatch_guards ​行​ 789 8 _execute_tool：​绑定​审批​可​观测​上下文​，​经​ tool-execution ​中间件​进​ registry.dispatch；​异步​ handler ​经​ _run_async ​跑​在​每​线程​持久​事件​循环​上​（​缓存​ httpx/AsyncOpenAI ​客户端​绑定​活​循环​，​避免​ "Event loop is closed"） ​行​ 846-870 9 post_tool_call ​观察​钩子​（​状态​/​错误​字段​从​结果​推导​，​受​ suppress_post_tool_call_hook ​抑制​） _emit ​行​ 922 10 transform_tool_result：​插件​可​替换​最终​结果​字符串​；​第一个​字符串​返回值​生效​ ​行​ 985

​错误​路径​做​净化​与​截断​：

# model_tools.py:652-661
def _sanitize_tool_error(error_msg: str) -> str:
    """Strip structural framing tokens from a tool error before the model sees it."""
    if not error_msg:
        return "[TOOL_ERROR] "
    sanitized = error_msg
    for pattern in _TOOL_ERROR_STRIP_RES:
        sanitized = pattern.sub("", sanitized)
    if len(sanitized) > _TOOL_ERROR_MAX_LEN:
        sanitized = sanitized[:_TOOL_ERROR_MAX_LEN - 3] + "..."
    return f"[TOOL_ERROR] {sanitized}"

_TOOL_ERROR_STRIP_RE ​剥掉​ </tool_call>、CDATA、​代码​围栏​等​结构性​记号​（​防止​异常​文本​诱导​模型​注入​），​长度​上限​ _MAX_TOOL_ERROR_CHARS = 2048 ​与​ tools/registry.py ​共享​同一​常量​，​保证​文本​不会​"​两次​截断​两个​标记​"。

docs.title: 4. _AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS ​与​ inline ​拦截
docs.text:
# model_tools.py:629
_AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS = {"todo_list", "memory", "session_search", "delegate_task"}

​这​ 4 ​个​工具​需要​ agent ​级​状态​（todo ​存储​、​记忆​管理器​、​会话​检索​、​子​代理​），​若​落到​ handle_function_call ​会​返回​ stub ​错误​。​真正​的​执行者​在​ agent/inline_tool_executors.py：

# agent/inline_tool_executors.py:291,352
_RAW_INLINE_TOOL_EXECUTORS: dict[str, InlineToolExecutor] = {
    "todo_list": _tool("tools.todo_tool", "todo_tool", ...),
    ...
}
INLINE_TOOL_EXECUTORS: dict[str, InlineToolExecutor] = {
    name: _coerced(name, executor) for name, executor in _RAW_INLINE_TOOL_EXECUTORS.items()
}

​这张​约​ 20 ​项​的​表在​ agent ​循环​内​先行​拦截​工具​调用​（​顺序​即​历史​ if/elif ​顺序​），​根本​不会​进入​ handle_function_call；_AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS ​是​派发​侧​的​防御​网​。

docs.title: 5. agent.tools ​一次​定死​与​ _last_resolved_tool_names
docs.text:
• agent init ​时​组面​一次​（agent/agent_init.py:1019）：agent.tools = agent_tool_surface(agent, model_tools.get_tool_definitions(...))。​此后​每个​ API ​请求​发送​的​是​它​的​（​按​传输​格式​装饰​的​）​副本​——agent/chat_completion_helpers.py ​里​的​ tools_for_api。​这​正是​"​会话期​不换​工具集​"​缓存​不​变量​的​实现​点​。
  • _last_resolved_tool_names（​行​ 175）​是​进程​全局​快照​：execute_code ​沙箱​用​它​决定​可编程​调用​哪些​工具​。​子​代理​运行​前后​由​ delegate ​管线​保存​/​恢复​——tools/delegate_tool.py::_run_single_child ​的​执行​链​在​ tools/delegate_tool_results.py:320 ​保存​ list(model_tools._last_resolved_tool_names)、​在​ tools/delegate_tool_child_run.py:1145 ​恢复​——​否则​子代​理会​把​父会​话​的​工具​面​覆盖​成​自己​的​，​父​进程​后续​的​ execute_code ​视野​被​污染​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ discover_builtin_tools()（​模块​级​执行​） model_tools.py:151（​定义​ tools/registry.py:121） ​导入​即​注册​；AST ​预​过滤​ + ​磁盘​缓存​ ~145ms get_tool_definitions model_tools.py:227 ​组面​入口​；quiet ​模式​带​ 8 ​条​上限​的​ memo _select_tool_names model_tools.py:333 enabled ​并集​ → disabled ​最后​减​（#17309） _apply_toolset_selection model_tools.py:300 ​单个​ toolset ​名​解析​进​/​出​集合​；​平台​包​告警​ _DYNAMIC_SCHEMA_REWRITERS model_tools.py:487 ​按会话​可用​面​重写​ 8 ​个​工具​的​ schema _compute_tool_definitions model_tools.py:522 ​未​缓存​管线​：​选名​→check_fn→​重写​→​消毒​→Tool Search handle_function_call model_tools.py:897 10 ​步​派发​管线​，​返回​ JSON ​字符串​ _dispatch_bridge_tool model_tools.py:724 Tool Search ​桥​（​目录​读​ / tool_call ​解包​重​入​） _execute_tool model_tools.py:846 ​经​中间件​进​ registry.dispatch；connectors ​分流​ _run_async model_tools.py:95 ​同步​代码​跑​协程​；​主线​程​持久​循环​ / worker ​线程​本地​循环​ _sanitize_tool_error model_tools.py:652 ​剥​结构​记号​ + ​截断​ 2048 _AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS model_tools.py:629 4 ​个​必须​由​ agent ​循环​执行​的​工具​ _LEGACY_TOOL_ALIASES model_tools.py:633 ​旧​工具​名​ → ​新名​ _last_resolved_tool_names model_tools.py:175 execute_code ​沙箱​用​的​进程​级​工具​面​快照​ get_all_tool_names ​等​直通​函数​ model_tools.py:998-1018 registry ​兼容​ pass-through

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ model_tools.py 1,018 ​编排​门面​：​发现​/​组面​/​派发​ + registry ​直通​ tools/registry.py ~1,100 registry ​注册表​本体​、discover_builtin_tools（:121）、register（:735） tools/arg_coercion.py ~200 coerce_tool_args ​参数​矫正​ tools/schema_sanitizer.py ~100 llama.cpp ​兼容​的​ schema ​归一化​ tools/tool_search.py ​大​ ​渐进式​披露​：assemble_tool_defs ​与​桥​派发​ tools/connectors/init.py ~100 is_connector_name / dispatch_connector_call / ​批量​派发​ tools/todo_tool.py ​大​ TODO_LEGACY_ALIASES、TODO_SCHEMA（​别名​表​来源​） agent/inline_tool_executors.py ~380 INLINE_TOOL_EXECUTORS（:291/:352）：agent ​循环​内联​执行​ tools/delegate_tool.py ~1,500 delegate_task ​实现​；_run_single_child（:377） tools/delegate_tool_results.py ~400 ​子​代理​结果​装配​；​保存​ _last_resolved_tool_names（:320） tools/delegate_tool_child_run.py ~1,200 ​子​代理​运行​体​；​恢复​快照​（:1145）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• toolsets.py：_select_tool_names ​通过​ resolve_toolset/bundle_non_core_tools ​把​工具集​名字​变成​工具​名字​集合​（​见​ toolsets.md）。
  • agent/agent_init.py：init ​时​调用​组面​一次​；agent.tools ​从此​冻结​。
  • agent/tool_executor.py / inline_tool_executors.py：​派发​的​两个​消费者​（​一个​走​ handle_function_call，​一个​绕过​它​）。
  • hermes_cli/plugins.py：pre/post_tool_call、transform_tool_result ​钩子​的​宿主​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​本​文件​是​"​注册表​之上​的​薄层​"：​薄​，​但​三条​管线​各自​承载​了​硬​教训​——MCP ​发现​不能​在​导入期​跑​（#16856）、disabled ​必须​最后​减​（#17309）、​缓存​必须​吐​浅​拷贝​（#17335）。
  • ​派发​管线​是​安全​边界​汇聚​处​：​别名​、​桥​解包​、​门控​、​中间件​、​审批​钩子​、​错误​净化​，​全部​在​模型​看到​结果​之前​完成​。
  • agent.tools init ​定​死​ + _last_resolved_tool_names ​子​代理​前后​保存​恢复​，​是​"​会话​工具​面​稳定​"​不​变量​的​两块​基石​。

docs.title: hermes_dir_acl.py ​与​ hermes_startup_watchdog.py —— ​主机​边界​的​两件​兵器
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：​无​。​一个​是​ Windows ​提权​后​的​目录​ ACL，​一个​是​"​事件​循环​之前​"​的​启动​看门狗​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​这​两个​文件​处理​的​是​进程​边界​外​的​事实​：

  • hermes_dir_acl.py（462 ​行​）：Windows ​上​ CPython 3.13 ​起​ os.mkdir(path, 0o700) ​会​给​目录​挂​一张​"​受​保护​ DACL"，​提权​进程​创建​的​目录​在​降权​后​连​创建者​自己​都​打不开​（WinError 5）。make_user_dir ​是​ Hermes ​全部​状态​/​锁​/​日志​目录​的​唯一​建​目录​入口​。
  • hermes_startup_watchdog.py（513 ​行​）：​其他​一切​活性​兜底​（loop-liveness watchdog、shutdown watchdog、​心跳​文件​）​都​假设​启动​成功​了​；​若​进程​在​事件​循环​活​起来​之前​就​死锁​，​没有​任何​东西​能​开枪​（OOF-298：~30h ​全线​程停​在​ futex_wait_queue、​零​日志​、s6 ​看到​的​ PID ​还​活着​）。​这个​看门狗​在​进程​入口​武装​、​确认​循环​存活​后​解除​。

docs.title: 1. ​唯一​建​目录​入口​ make_user_dir（​行​ 407）
docs.text:
# hermes_dir_acl.py:407-437（​节选​）
def make_user_dir(path: str | Path, mode: int = 0o777, *, parents: bool = False, exist_ok: bool = False,
                  elevated: bool | None = None) -> Path:
    """``Path.mkdir`` (same arguments and defaults) that keeps an elevated Windows creation usable
    by the same user unelevated.

    Off Windows or unelevated this is ``Path.mkdir`` and nothing else. Elevated, every directory
    this call created (missing parents included) is granted the user's inheriting full-control ACE,
    and an existing leaf (the repair case) once per directory object per process, ...
    """
    target = Path(path)
    if not _elevated(elevated):
        target.mkdir(mode=mode, parents=parents, exist_ok=exist_ok)
        return target
    created = []
    probe = target
    while not probe.exists() and probe.parent != probe:
        created.append(probe)
        probe = probe.parent
    try:
        target.mkdir(mode=mode, parents=parents, exist_ok=exist_ok)
    except FileExistsError:
        # ``Path.mkdir`` contract: an existing leaf still raises without exist_ok. The directory an
        # earlier elevated run left is repaired first, ...
        if target.is_dir() and not is_reparse_point(target):
            _grant_dirs(target, [target])
        raise
    _grant_dirs(target, list(reversed(created or [target])), fresh=set(created))
    return target

​非​ Windows / ​非​提权​时​就是​ Path.mkdir，​零​额外​开销​。​提权​时​：​为​本次​创建​的​每个​目录​（​含​缺失​的​父级​）​授予​"​当前​用户​可​继承​的​完全​控制​ ACE"；​对​已​存在​叶子​（​此​前提​权​运行​留下​的​）​按​目录​对象​身份​每​进程​一次​修复​；FileExistsError ​的​契约​保持​——​但​先​修复​目录​再​抛​，​保证​调用​方​的​报错​不是​"​非​提权​ Hermes ​被​锁​在​外面​"​的​原因​。

docs.title: 2. ​授权​永不​穿越​ reparse point
docs.text:
​提权​ ACE ​若​跟随​ junction/symlink/​硬​链接​，​等于​把​ UAC ​边界​外​的​目标​（​如​ C:\Program Files\X）​交给​同​用户​中等​完整性​代码​——​这是​明确​的​攻击面​。​所以​：

# hermes_dir_acl.py:59-69
def is_reparse_point(path: str | Path) -> bool:
    """True when *path* itself is a symlink, junction or other reparse point (never followed), or
    cannot be lstat-ed at all; the safe answer for "may an elevated grant act on this path"."""
    try:
        st = os.lstat(path)
    except OSError:
        return True
    if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode) or getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", 0) & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT:
        return True
    isjunction = getattr(os.path, "isjunction", None)  # 3.12+; st_file_attributes covers 3.11
    return bool(isjunction and isjunction(path))

lstat ​判定​ + pywin32 ​授予​时以​ FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT ​打开​句柄​并​复查​句柄​（check ​之后​被​换掉​也​不​跟随​），icacls ​回退​传​ /L；​硬​链接​文件​（st_nlink > 1）​同样​拒绝​，​因为​继承​ ACE ​会​落到​链接​的​其他​名字​上​。grant_user_access（​行​ 275）​只授​ home ​内​路径​，​并​要求​"home ​之下​的​每个​组件​都​不是​链接​"（_components_below_home + _expected_final ​的​句柄​终​路径​比​对​）；grant_tree_user_access（​行​ 341）​是​递归​形式​（update ​后​修复​），iter_tree_without_reparse_points ​保证​遍历​本身​也​剪掉​每个​ reparse point。

docs.title: 3. ​无法​修复​时​给​一句​人​话
docs.text:
# hermes_dir_acl.py:457-463
def unusable_dir_remedy(path: str | Path, *, windows: bool | None = None) -> str:
    """The one-line repair for a directory this process may not use (owner from an elevated run)."""
    if (os.name == "nt") if windows is None else windows:
        return f'from an elevated prompt run: icacls "{path}" /reset /t'
    return f'run: sudo chown -R "$(id -un)" "{path}"'

docs.title: 1. ​轻量​性​本身​是​正确性​属性
docs.text:
# hermes_startup_watchdog.py:20-26
IMPORT-LIGHTNESS IS A CORRECTNESS PROPERTY: top-level module, stdlib only. Arming must
precede importing ``gateway`` (hundreds of modules; an import-time deadlock is in scope),
and at fire time the wedged main thread may hold the import lock — so the fire path does
no imports on its own thread; the ledger write runs on a helper thread joined with a
timeout. Config is env-only (``HERMES_STARTUP_WATCHDOG=0``,
``HERMES_STARTUP_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_S``) because config.yaml parsing is itself in scope.

​武装​必须​先于​ gateway ​导入​（​导入期​死锁​也​在​射程​内​），​所以​模块​必须​ stdlib-only；​配置​只认​环境变量​，​因为​连​ config.yaml ​解析​都​可能​卡住​；​开火​路径​不许​ import（​主线​程​可能​握​着​ import ​锁​），​生命周期​台账​的​写入​放到​辅助线​程限​时​ join。

docs.title: 2. ​武装​与​解除​：​模块​级​单例
docs.text:
# hermes_startup_watchdog.py:424-453（​节选​）
def arm_startup_watchdog(timeout_s=None, *, exit_code: int = SERVICE_RESTART_EXIT_CODE) -> Optional[StartupWatchdogHandle]:
    """Arm the process-wide startup watchdog. Idempotent; never raises."""
    global _handle
    try:
        if startup_watchdog_disabled():
            return None
        with _handle_lock:
            if _handle is not None and _handle.is_alive():
                return _handle
            resolved = (float(timeout_s) if timeout_s is not None and float(timeout_s) > 0
                        else resolve_startup_watchdog_timeout())
            handle = StartupWatchdogHandle(resolved, exit_code)
            if not handle._start():
                return None
            _handle = handle
            return handle

​武装​点​是​ hermes_cli.main、hermes_cli.gateway、gateway.run.main、cli.py --gateway ​四处​，​解除​点​是​ GatewayRunner——​它们​互不​认识​对象​，​所以​用​模块​单例​ + ​锁​。​默认​ 300s（​下限​ 30s），​退出​码​ 75 = ​服务​管理器​重启​码​（​与​ gateway.restart ​的​一致性​由​ parity ​测试​锁定​，​因为​本​模块​不许​ import gateway）。

docs.title: 3. ​进展​的​三级​权威​与​开火​路径
docs.text:
​看门狗​线程​ _run（​行​ 355）​在​ deadline ​过期​时​按​权威​顺序​判断​：

  1. ​阶段​租约​（report_startup_progress(expected_s, phase)，​行​ 494）：​启动​路径​自己​声明​"​我​还要​干​ X ​秒​"（schema ​迁移​、​损坏​修复​），​每次​调用​钳制​在​ _MAX_LEASE_S=900s，​长​阶段​靠​续约​——​这是​权威​信号​，I/O ​密集​阶段​也​有效​；
  2. ​进程​级​ CPU ​进展​：​一个​窗口​内​ CPU ​增量​ ≥1s ​视为​活着​，​但​最多延​ _MAX_CPU_EXTENSIONS=3 ​次​——​无关​线程​烧​ CPU ​不能​永远​藏住​一个​停摆​的​启动​线程​；
  3. ​都​没有​ → ​开火​：_fire（​行​ 264）​先​启动​一个​"​护送​线程​"（10 ​秒​后​无条件​ os._exit，​防止​取证​路径​被​日志​锁​/​满盘​卡死​），​然后​写​ JSON ​元​数据​ + faulthandler ​全线​程栈​到​ <HERMES_HOME>/logs/gateway-startup-watchdog.log、​辅助线​程写​台账​，​最后​ os._exit(75) ​让​ s6/systemd ​重启​。

​刻意​慢​但​活着​的​启动​不会​被​杀​：​空闲​等待​处调​ kick_startup_watchdog（​行​ 485，​如​重启​风暴​退避​最长​ 300s）；MCP ​发现​的​ 120s ​等待​落​在​ 300s ​默认值​之内​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​两个​文件​都​在​处理​"​进程​边界​之外​的​事实​"：Windows DACL ​与​服务​管理器​的​重启​语义​。
  • ​共同​的​设计​姿态​：​宿主​事实​（​提权​、​超时​）​是​参数​可​注入​的​（elevated= / timeout_s=），​生产​传​ nothing、​测试​注入​真值​。
  • ​安全​与​活性​都​靠​"​最小​权限​/​最小​依赖​"：​授予​永不​穿越​链接​；​看门狗​ stdlib-only ​且​开火​路径​零​ import。

docs.title: run_agent.py —— AIAgent ​门面​与​ turn ​生命周期​的​"​地址​簿​"
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：../01_architecture/turn_lifecycle.md。​本文​讲​门面​本身​；​循环​心脏​在​ agent/conversation_loop.py。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
run_agent.py（1,565 ​行​）​是​ AIAgent ​类​的​门面​：​模块​ docstring ​开头​就是​使用​契约​——

# run_agent.py:1-7
"""AIAgent: the tool-calling agent runner (conversation loop, tool execution, session lifecycle).

    from run_agent import AIAgent
    agent = AIAgent(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", model="claude-opus-4-20250514")
    response = agent.run_conversation("Tell me about the latest Python updates")
"""

​两行​使用​契约​说​清​了​整个​仓库​对外​最​重要​的​ API ​面​：​构造​ → run_conversation。​所有​重量级​实现​都​在​ agent/ ​兄弟​包​里​；​门面​保留​ 14 ​个​ mixin ​的​组装​、​纯​转发​的​ __init__、​少量​"​架构​重量​"​的​内部​方法​（​工具​执行​与​委派​派发​），​以及​ main() ​直跑​入口​。

​文件​头​还有​两条​值得注意​的​启动​纪律​：

# run_agent.py:9-14
# hermes_bootstrap must be the very first import (UTF-8 stdio on Windows; no-op on POSIX).
try:
    import hermes_bootstrap
except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:  # partial `hermes update` left the bootstrap unregistered
    if exc.name != "hermes_bootstrap" and not "hermes_bootstrap".startswith(f"{exc.name}."):
        raise  # the bootstrap exists but cannot load: skipping it would skip PM activation

hermes_bootstrap ​必须​第一个​ import；​半途​失败​的​ hermes update ​只​允许​跳过​ bootstrap ​本身​缺失​的​情形​，​绝不能​吞掉​"bootstrap ​存在​但​加载​失败​"。

docs.title: 1. AIAgent：14 ​个​ mixin ​的​组装​（​行​ 214）
docs.text:
# run_agent.py:214-219
class AIAgent(
    ClientLifecycleMixin, StreamDeliveryMixin, StatusOutputMixin, ApiRequestHooksMixin, ApiErrorSummaryMixin,
    InterruptControlMixin, TurnExplainersMixin, ActivityTrackingMixin, RateLimitCreditsMixin,
    SessionPersistenceMixin, CompressionFacadeMixin, TurnFacadeMixin, VisionMessagePrepMixin, ReasoningParamsMixin,
):
    """AI Agent with tool calling capabilities."""

​每个​ mixin ​都​是​ agent/ ​下​的​一个​兄弟​文件​（agent/turn_facade.py、agent/stream_delivery.py…）。​门面​在​这里​只​做​一件​事​：​把​名字​钉​到​ AIAgent ​的​ MRO ​上​。​这​意味着​ monkeypatch.setattr(AIAgent, "run_conversation", ...) ​或者​ patch agent.turn_facade.TurnFacadeMixin.run_conversation ​都​能​命中​同​一条​ MRO ​链​。

docs.title: 2. __init__：​约​ 60 ​个​参数​的​纯​转发器​（​行​ 236）
docs.text:
# run_agent.py:236-288（​节选​）
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str | None = None, api_key: str | None = None, provider: str | None = None, api_mode: str | None = None,
        ...
        max_iterations: int = sys.maxsize,  # unlimited tool-calling iterations by default (shared with subagents)
        tool_delay: float | None = None,  # deprecated: accepted for compatibility, ignored
        ...
    ):
        """Forwarder — see ``agent.agent_init.init_agent`` (same keyword parameters, minus ``tool_delay``)."""
        init_kwargs = {k: v for k, v in locals().items() if k not in ("self", "tool_delay")}
        if tool_delay is not None:
            warnings.warn("tool_delay is deprecated and ignored; ...", DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
        from agent.agent_init import init_agent
        init_agent(self, **init_kwargs)

​三个​要点​：

  • ​打包​ locals() ​转发​：__init__ ​不逐​参数​赋值​，​而是​把​整个​局部​字典​（​除​ self ​与​已​废弃​的​ tool_delay）​原样​交给​ agent/agent_init.py::init_agent（​行​ 2056）。​签名​在​两处​必须​逐字​一致​——​新增​参数​要​同时​改​两个​文件​。
  • init_agent ​内部​相位​顺序​是​ load-bearing ​的​：​解析​ provider/api_mode → ​建​客户端​ → ​加载​工具​（_load_tools，​工具​快照​在​ agent/agent_init.py:1019 ​处​一次​定​死​ agent.tools）→ ​会话​状态​ → ​记忆​ → ​压缩​配置​。​任何​一个​相位​提前​都​可能​读到​未​初始化​的​字​段​。
  • max_iterations ​的​字面​默认值​是​ sys.maxsize——"​无限​次​"；host/config ​层会​传​ 500。​真正​的​预算​执行者​是​ agent/iteration_budget.py::IterationBudget：
# agent/iteration_budget.py:25-40（​节选​）
class IterationBudget:
    """Thread-safe iteration counter; ``execute_code`` ... iterations are refunded via :meth:`refund` ..."""
    def __init__(self, max_total: int):
        self.max_total = max_total
        self._used = 0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def consume(self) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if self._used >= self.max_total:
                return False
            self._used += 1
            return True

​线程​安全​、​父子​共享​（​父​ agent ​与子​ agent ​各持​一个​ IterationBudget，​父​ cap 500、​子​ delegation.max_iterations ​默认​ 50），execute_code ​消耗​的​额度​可​ refund。

docs.title: 3. ​公共​ API ​的​家​：run_conversation / chat / close / release_clients / reset_session_state
docs.text:
• run_conversation ​定义​在​ agent/turn_facade.py:22（TurnFacadeMixin）。​它​的​开头​是​一圈​"​入场​仪式​"：
# agent/turn_facade.py:22-40（​节选​）
    def run_conversation(self, user_message, ...):
        """Forwarder — see ``agent.conversation_loop.run_conversation``."""
        from agent.background_review import cancel_background_review_for_live_turn
        cancel_background_review_for_live_turn(self)
        ...
        admission = admit_durable_turn_lease(self, session_id=..., relay_turn_id=..., ...)

​要点​：​跨​进程​ turn lease（agent.turn_facade_lease.admit_durable_turn_lease，​同一​会话​同时​只​允许​一个​ turn），​随后​建立​ relay / accounting / portal ​各类​ contextvar ​作用域​，​才​转发​ agent.conversation_loop.run_conversation。

  • chat（agent/turn_facade.py:220）​是​"​一条​消息​进​、​一个​字符串​出​"​的​简化​包装​。
  • close / release_clients ​在​门面​（run_agent.py:921-965），​两者​刻意​不同​：release_clients ​是​网关​缓存​驱逐​用​——​只​放掉​ LLM ​客户端​与子​ agent，​保留​进程​、​沙箱​、​浏览器​等​会​话​工具​状态​（​同​ task_id ​的​会​话​可能​复活​）；close ​是​彻底​关闭​，​每个​阶段​用​ _quietly ​包裹​，​一步​失败​不​挡​后续​步骤​。
  • reset_session_state（run_agent.py:379）​把​ session ​级​ token/​成本​计数器​清零​，​并​驱动​上下文​引擎​走​完整​的​会​话​过渡​生命周期​（_transition_context_engine_session）。

docs.title: 4. ​架构​重量​的​两个​内部​方法
docs.text:
_execute_tool_calls（​行​ 1308）——​段​规划​器​：

# run_agent.py:1308-1333（​节选​）
    def _execute_tool_calls(self, assistant_message, messages: list, effective_task_id: str, api_call_count: int = 0) -> None:
        """Execute the assistant's tool calls and append results to ``messages``.

        The segment planner splits the batch into runs of parallel-safe calls ... separated by
        sequential barriers, run in emission order.
        """
        tool_calls = assistant_message.tool_calls
        ...
        with scoped_connection_surface(agent_connection_surface(self)):
            if len(tool_calls) <= 1:
                self._execute_tool_calls_sequential(*args)
            else:
                from agent.tool_dispatch_helpers import _plan_tool_batch_segments
                ...
                segments = _plan_tool_batch_segments(tool_calls, execution_cwd=exec_cwd)
                if len(segments) == 1:
                    run = self._execute_tool_calls_concurrent if segments[0][0] == "parallel" else self._execute_tool_calls_sequential
                    run(*args)
                else:
                    from agent.tool_executor import execute_tool_calls_segmented
                    execute_tool_calls_segmented(self, *args, segments=segments)

​单个​调用​走​顺序​路径​；​多个​调用​先由​ _plan_tool_batch_segments ​把​"​并行​安全​"（​只读​、​文件​目标​不​重叠​、opt-in ​的​ MCP）​与​"​必须​串行​"​的​分段​，​再​按​发射​顺序​执行​。​真正​的​并发​执行​体在​ agent/tool_executor.py（​门面​只是​ _forward ​转发​，​行​ 1376-1377）。

_dispatch_delegate_task（​行​ 1344）——​唯一​的​委派​派发​点​：

# run_agent.py:1344-1358（​节选​）
    def _dispatch_delegate_task(self, function_args: dict) -> str:
        """Single call site for delegate_task dispatch; new DELEGATE_TASK_SCHEMA fields are added only here."""
        from tools.delegate_tool import _strip_model_hidden_task_fields, delegate_task as _delegate_task
        return _delegate_task(
            goal=function_args.get("goal"), context=function_args.get("context"),
            tasks=_strip_model_hidden_task_fields(function_args.get("tasks")),
            ...
            background=not (getattr(self, "_delegate_depth", 0) > 0), ...
        )

"Single call site" ​是​刻意​约束​：DELEGATE_TASK_SCHEMA ​新增​字段​只​在​这里​接线​。​顶层​委派​默认​后台​跑​（background=True），​但​深度​ > 0 ​的​编排​器子​代理​保持​同步​——​它​需要​在​本​ turn ​内​拿到​结果​。

docs.title: 5. main() ​直跑​入口​与​ __main__ ​路径
docs.text:
# run_agent.py:1485-1551（​节选​）
def main(query=None, model="", api_key=None, base_url="", max_turns=10, enabled_toolsets=None,
         disabled_toolsets=None, list_tools=False, ...):
    ...
    if list_tools:
        return _print_tool_listing()
    ...
    result = agent.run_conversation(user_query)

main() ​是​ hermes-agent console script ​与​ python run_agent.py ​的​直​跑​入口​：​装​ TLS ​信任​库​ → ​解析​ toolset ​参数​ → ​构造​ AIAgent → run_conversation → ​打印​摘要​；--list_tools ​打印​工具​与​工具集​清单​。​而​ __main__ ​分支​经​ agent/legacy_cli.py ​走​（​行​ 1562-1565）：

# run_agent.py:1562-1565
if __name__ == "__main__":
    from agent.legacy_cli import main as _legacy_cli_main
    raise SystemExit(_legacy_cli_main(run=main))

agent/legacy_cli.py ​是​参数​层​：console script ​裸​调用​时​ argv ​会​被​忽略​，​这个​兄弟​补齐​ argparse（--query、--max-turns、--list-tools…），​并​把​ --help/--version ​从​"​真跑​一轮​模型​"​里​救回来​（issue #54648）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​向下​：agent/ ​兄弟​包​承担​全部​行为​；tools/ ​提供​工具​注册表​；hermes_state ​提供​ SessionDB。
  • ​向上​：cli.py（​经​ hermes_cli/cli_agent_setup_mixin.py）​与​网关​每​消息​构造​ AIAgent；batch_runner.py ​也​直接​ from run_agent import AIAgent。
  • ​横向​：model_tools.get_tool_definitions ​在​ init ​时​被​调用​一次​（​见​ model_tools.md）；toolsets.agent_tool_surface ​决定​本会话​实际​携带​的​工具​面​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​门面​只​保留​"​使用​契约​ + mixin ​组装​ + ​两个​架构​重量​方法​"，​行为​全部​在​ agent/ ​兄弟​里​。
  • __init__ ​的​ locals() ​打​包转发​让​签名​一致​成为​硬​约束​；init_agent ​的​相位​顺序​不能​调换​。
  • ​工具集​在​ init ​时​一次​定​死​、max_iterations ​默认​无限​（​预算​由​ IterationBudget ​真正​执行​）、​委派​只有​一个​派发​点​——​这三条​都​是​提示​词​缓存​与​可预测性​这​两个​不​变量​的​落点​。

docs.title: toolsets.py —— ​三层​工具集​与​平台​包​的​静态​契约​表
docs.text: ​阅读​前提​：model_tools.md。​工具集​是​"​名字​ → ​工具​名​集合​"​的​纯​数据​层​；​组面​管线​在​ model_tools。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: toolsets.py（507 ​行​）+ toolset_distributions.py（106 ​行​）。​前者​是​全​仓库​共享​的​工具集​定义​与​解析器​，​后者​服务​于​批量​数据​生成​（batch_runner）​时​的​概率​采样​。​两个​文件​都​是​"​契约​表​"——​改​这里​的​名字​会​直接​改变​每个​会话​携带​的​工具​面​。

docs.title: 1. ​核心​工具​清单​ _HERMES_CORE_TOOLS（​行​ 11）
docs.text:
# toolsets.py:11-36（​节选​）
_HERMES_CORE_TOOLS = [
    "web_search", "web_extract",
    "terminal", "process_manage",
    "read_file", "write_file", "patch", "search_files",
    "vision_analyze", "image_generate",
    "skills_list", "skill_view", "skill_manage",
    "browser_exec",  # THE browser: Python over CDP (browser-harness)
    "browser_cdp", "browser_dialog",
    "browser_vault",  # rides with the browser; deferred by default (tools.tool_search.defer)
    "text_to_speech",
    "todo_list", "memory",
    "session_search",
    "clarify",
    "execute_code", "delegate_task",
    "cronjob_manage",
    "kanban_show", "kanban_list",
    ...
    "computer_use",
    # Service-gated connector account status and authorization links.
    "manage_connections",

41 ​个​核心​工具​。​注释​里​点明​两条​设计​：​桌面​ GUI ​专属​工具​不​在​这里​（​它们​住​ desktop_ui/project，​由​ GUI ​网关​按会话​来源​启用​）；manage_connections ​是​ service-gated ​的​连接器​账户​面​。

​配套​的​还有​两个​小​集合​：

# toolsets.py:38-39
# Webhook payloads are untrusted third-party content: no file/system execution.
_HERMES_WEBHOOK_SAFE_TOOLS = ["web_search", "web_extract", "vision_analyze", "clarify"]

webhook ​载荷​是​不可​信​第三方​内容​，hermes-webhook ​工具集​只带​这​ 4 ​个​不​碰​文件​/​系统​的​工具​——​这是​"​输入​不可​信​ → ​缩​工具​面​"​的​安全​样板​。

docs.title: 2. ​构建​器​ _ts / _bundle / _core_without（​行​ 46-58）
docs.text:
# toolsets.py:46-58
def _ts(description, tools=(), includes=(), **extra):
    """One TOOLSETS entry (fresh lists per entry; extra keys such as posture pass through)."""
    return {"description": description, "tools": list(tools), "includes": list(includes), **extra}


def _bundle(description, extras=()):
    """A `hermes-*` platform bundle: the shared core tools plus optional platform extras."""
    return _ts(description, _HERMES_CORE_TOOLS + list(extras))


def _core_without(*excluded, kanban=True):
    """_HERMES_CORE_TOOLS minus *excluded* (and, unless kanban=True, every kanban_* tool); order preserved."""
    return [t for t in _HERMES_CORE_TOOLS if t not in excluded and (kanban or not t.startswith("kanban_"))]

​三个​小​构建​器​保证​ 22 ​个​平台​包​共享​同​一份​核心​清单​（"edit once, all platforms follow"），​平台​ extras ​只​做​增量​。posture=True ​这​类​额外​键​从​ **extra ​透传​——coding ​工具集​用​它​标记​"​每会话​姿态​，​绝不​自动​回收​进​平台​工具​配置​"。

docs.title: 3. TOOLSETS ​字典​与​三层​结构​（​行​ 70）
docs.text:
# toolsets.py:70-181（​节选​）
TOOLSETS = {
    # Basic toolsets - individual tool categories
    "web": _ts("Web research and content extraction tools", ["web_search", "web_extract"]),
    "terminal": _ts("Terminal/command execution and process management tools", ["terminal", "process_manage"]),
    ...
    # Scenario-specific toolsets
    "debugging": _ts("Debugging and troubleshooting toolkit", ["terminal", "process_manage"], includes=["web", "file"]),
    "safe": _ts("Safe toolkit without terminal access", [], includes=["web", "vision", "image_gen"]),
    "coding": _ts(
        "Coding-focused toolset: files, terminal, search, web docs, skills, todo, delegate, vision, browser",
        _CODING_TOOLS,
        posture=True,
    ),
    # Full Hermes toolsets (CLI + messaging platforms). All share the core tools;
    # there is deliberately no agent-callable send_message tool. hermes-acp is the
    # coding posture minus the interactive clarify UI.
    "hermes-acp": _ts("Editor integration (VS Code, Zed, JetBrains) ...",
                      [t for t in _CODING_TOOLS if t != "clarify"]),
    "hermes-cli": _bundle("Full interactive CLI toolset - all default tools plus cronjob management"),
    "hermes-telegram": _bundle("Telegram bot toolset - full access for personal use (terminal has safety checks)"),
    "hermes-discord": _bundle("Discord bot toolset - full access ...", ["discord", "discord_admin"]),
    ...
    "hermes-webhook": _ts("Webhook toolset - receive and process external webhook events", _HERMES_WEBHOOK_SAFE_TOOLS),
    "hermes-gateway": _ts("Gateway toolset - union of all messaging platform tools", [],
                          includes=["hermes-telegram", "hermes-discord", ...]),
}

​条目​形状​是​ name → {description, tools, includes, posture?, platforms?}。​三层​结构​：

  1. ​基础​分类​组​：web、terminal、file、vision、skills、todo、memory、cronjob、browser ​等​——​单一​类别​。
  2. ​场景​复合​组​：debugging / safe / coding，​靠​ includes ​组合​基础​组​；coding ​用​ _CODING_TOOLS（_core_without("image_generate", "text_to_speech", "cronjob_manage", "computer_use", kanban=False)）​并​带​ posture=True。
  3. ​平台​包​（22 ​个​）：hermes-cli、hermes-cron、hermes-telegram、hermes-discord、hermes-whatsapp、hermes-slack、hermes-signal、hermes-bluebubbles、hermes-email、hermes-mattermost、hermes-matrix、hermes-dingtalk、hermes-feishu、hermes-weixin、hermes-qqbot、hermes-wecom、hermes-wecom-callback、hermes-sms、hermes-webhook、hermes-gateway、hermes-acp、hermes-api-server。​除​ hermes-acp（coding ​姿态​去掉​ clarify）​与​ hermes-api-server（_core_without）​外​都​用​ _bundle。​注释​里​有​一条​刻意​设计​：​没有​ agent ​可​调用​的​ send_message ​工具​——​回信​是​各​适配器​的​职责​，​不是​模型​的​。

docs.title: 4. ​客户端​自加​工具集​ CLIENT_SURFACE_TOOLSETS（​行​ 67）
docs.text:
# toolsets.py:65-67
# Toolsets a CLIENT adds to its own sessions (tui_gateway/server.py::_gui_surface_toolsets), never
# config: another surface lacking them made no configuration choice.
CLIENT_SURFACE_TOOLSETS = frozenset({"project", "desktop_ui", "catalog"})

​这​三个​（project、desktop_ui、catalog）​由​桌面​客户端​给​自己​来源​的​会​话​加​，​从不​走​ config.yaml——​另​一个​界面​没有​它们​，​不​代表​用户​选择​了​关掉​它们​。platforms=frozenset({"desktop"}) ​键​（onboarding、catalog）​进一步​把​这些​工具集​绑定​到​ desktop ​平台​；TOOLSET_SESSION_PLATFORMS（​行​ 236）​把​带​ platforms ​的​条目​汇成​索引​，session_platform_tool_drops / session_disabled_toolsets（​行​ 441/447）​据此​算​出​"​本​平台​会话​拿​不到​哪些​工具​"。

docs.title: 5. ​递归​解析​与​ memo：resolve_toolset（​行​ 355）
docs.text:
# toolsets.py:355-399（​节选​）
def resolve_toolset(name: str, visited: set[str] | None = None, *, include_registry: bool = True) -> list[str]:
    """Recursively resolve a toolset (and its includes) to a sorted tool-name list."""
    external_call = visited is None
    if external_call:
        memo_key = (name, include_registry, *_registry_generation(), _registry_call("current_scope_key", ""))
        cached = _resolve_toolset_memo.get(memo_key)
        if cached is not None:
            return list(cached)
        visited = set()

    # "all"/"*" span every toolset so new toolsets are included automatically, ...
    if name in {"all", "*"}:
        ...
    # Diamond include or cycle: [] silently — the tools are collected via another path.
    if name in visited:
        return []
    visited.add(name)

    toolset = get_toolset(name, include_registry=include_registry)
    if not toolset:
        return _plugin_platform_bundle(name) if include_registry else []

    tools = set(toolset.get("tools", []))
    for included_name in toolset.get("includes", []):
        tools.update(resolve_toolset(included_name, visited, include_registry=include_registry))
    result = sorted(tools)
    if external_call:
        if len(_resolve_toolset_memo) >= 256:  # stale-generation entries are never hit again
            _resolve_toolset_memo.clear()
        _resolve_toolset_memo[memo_key] = list(result)
    return result

​四件​事​：​递归​展开​ includes（​菱形​/​环靠​ visited ​静默​去​重​）；all/* ​跨​所有​工具集​（​平台​门控​的​除外​）；memo ​键含​ (registry id, ​代数​, profile scope)——​多路复用​进程​按​ profile ​解析​ mcp-<server>，​没有​ scope ​键时​ profile B ​会​拿到​ profile A ​的​工具​名​（#106005）；memo ​满​ 256 ​条​整体​清空​（​旧​代数​条目​永不​再​命中​）。

docs.title: 6. ​插件​扩展​与​ distribution ​文件
docs.text:
• ​插件​/MCP ​经​ _registry()（​行​ 244）​把​工具​注册​进​某个​工具集​；get_toolset(include_registry=True) ​合并​这部分​，MCP ​服务器​与​内建​工具集​重名​（​如​ "browser"）​时靠​ alias union ​补齐​（​行​ 288-294）。validate_toolset（​行​ 486）​与​ create_custom_toolset（​行​ 491）​供​运行​时​注册​新​名字​。
  • toolset_distributions.py ​是​批量​数据​生成​的​概率​表​：
# toolset_distributions.py:18-19,67-93（​节选​）
DISTRIBUTIONS = {
    "default": _dist("All available tools, all the time", web=100, vision=100, image_gen=100, terminal=100, file=100, browser=100),
    ...
    "browser_tasks": _dist(
        "Browser-focused distribution with web_search for finding URLs ...",
        **{"browser+search": 97}, vision=12, terminal=15,
    ),
}

def sample_toolsets_from_distribution(distribution_name: str) -> list[str]:
    """Sample toolset names, each entry included independently with its % probability.

    An entry may be a single toolset or a "+"-grouped compound like
    "browser+search": one roll selects (or skips) every member together, ...
    """

​条目​ = ​工具集​名​ → ​启用​概率​%，​独立​采样​；"browser+search" ​复合​键​一次​掷​骰​决定​整组​（​两个​独立​ 97% ​的​同现​概率​只有​ ~94%）。​全没掷​中时​回退​到​概率​最高​的​条目​。​消费者​是​ batch_runner.py（--distribution ​参数​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​三层​工具集​（​分类​组​ / ​场景​复合​组​ / ​平台​包​）+ ​一份​共享​核心​清单​，​让​"​每个​平台​缺什么​"​变成​一行​ _bundle ​增量​。
  • ​安全​语义​藏​在​数据​里​：webhook ​白名单​、platforms ​门控​、posture ​标记​、​没有​ send_message ​工具​。
  • ​解析器​带​ memo ​与​代数​/ profile ​键​，​是​静态​表​之外​唯一​的​"​活​"​部分​；​插件​通过​ registry ​注入​而​非改​这​张表​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
文件​ ​行​数​ ​定位​ utils.py 869 ​共享​工具​函数​：​原子​写​、​文件​签名​缓存​键​、URL ​主机​判定​、​代理​环境​归一​ hermes_time.py 150 ​时​区​感知​时钟​：now() ​按​用户​配置​的​ IANA ​时​区​返回​ hermes_yaml.py 98 ​全​仓库​统一​的​ YAML 1.1 ​策略​（ruamel ​封装​）

utils.py ​被​ run_agent.py ​直接​ import（base_url_host_matches、env_float ​等​），​是​事实上​的​"​第三​常量​层​"——​但​它​允许​少量​ lazy import（agent.retry_utils、hermes_cli.config）。

docs.title: 1. ​原子​写​三件套
docs.text:
# utils.py:379-419（​节选​）
def _atomic_write(path, write, *, prefix, encoding="utf-8", mode=None, preserve_owner=True,
                  binary=False, fsync_dir=False) -> None:
    """Temp file + fsync + :func:`atomic_replace`, then re-apply owner/mode.
    ...
    The temp file is removed on any failure — ``BaseException`` on purpose, so
    KeyboardInterrupt / SystemExit still clean up.
    """
    from hermes_constants import mkdir_under_hermes_home
    mkdir_under_hermes_home(path.parent)
    if mode is None and not path.exists():
        mode = default_new_file_mode()
    original_owner = _preserve_file_owner(path) if preserve_owner else None
    fd, tmp_path = mkstemp_beside(path, prefix=prefix, suffix=".tmp")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb" if binary else "w", encoding=None if binary else encoding) as f:
            if mode is not None and hasattr(os, "fchmod"):
                os.fchmod(f.fileno(), mode)
            write(f)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        replaced = Path(atomic_replace(tmp_path, path))  # symlink-preserving actual destination
        _restore_file_metadata(replaced, original_owner, mode)
        if fsync_dir:
            fsync_directory(replaced.parent)
    except BaseException:
        with suppress(OSError):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
        raise

​公共​入口​ atomic_write_text（​行​ 428）/ atomic_write_bytes（​行​ 444）/ atomic_json_write（​行​ 469）/ atomic_yaml_write（​行​ 518）​共享​这​条​路径​。​几个​讲究​：

  • mkstemp 0600 ​起步​：​密钥​文件​永不​在​ umask ​可​读​窗口​暴露​；​但​新​的​非​密钥​文件​按​ default_new_file_mode()（0o666 & ~umask）​恢复​——​否则​所有​新建​缓存​/​状态​文件​被​静默​收紧​到​ 0600，​破坏​共享​卷​挂载​。
  • atomic_replace（​行​ 238）：​先​解析​ symlink（​原地​写​真实​文件​、​链接​存活​）；os.replace ​失败​时​按​错误​分流​——EXDEV/EBUSY ​立即​ copy/fsync/unlink；Windows ​句柄​争用​（winerror 5/32/33）​抖动​重试​ 4 ​次​，​仍​失败​走​ _rewrite_in_place ​最后​手段​（​不​原子​但​窗口​更​小​，​且​保留​目标​ ACL）。
  • surrogate ​安全​：_dump_json（​行​ 452）​对非​ UTF-8 argv/​路径​产生​的​孤立​代理​字符​回退​ ensure_ascii=True，JSON round-trip ​后​原样​还原​。
  • round-trip YAML：atomic_roundtrip_yaml_save（​行​ 618）​是​ config.yaml ​的​唯一​落盘​原语​——ruamel rt ​模式​加载​、​逐​节点​合并​（​未变​的​节点​连​注释​带​引号​原样​保留​）、YAML 1.1 ​歧义​词​（off/yes/no…）​在​任何​深度​强制​双引号​，​否则​ approvals.mode: off ​会​被​读​回​ False。

docs.title: 2. ​文件​签名​缓存​键
docs.text:
# utils.py:42-57
def file_signature(st: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    """Change-detection key for a stat result: ``(st_mtime_ns, st_size, st_ino, st_ctime_ns)``.

    mtime + size alone miss a replacement that preserves both (``cp -p``, ``rsync -t``, ...).
    """
    return (st.st_mtime_ns, st.st_size, st.st_ino, st.st_ctime_ns)

# ​文件系统​时间​戳​粒度​粗​（~4ms），​同​ tick ​写入​会​让​签名​"racily clean"：
RACY_MTIME_WINDOW_NS = 2_000_000_000

file_cache_version（​行​ 104）= ​签名​ + racy ​内容摘要​（​文件​太新时​直接​哈希​字节​，​等​它​"​沉淀​"），load_yaml_file_readonly（​行​ 696）​用​它​缓存​解析​结果​。​这​是​全​仓库​"​改了​配置​就​生效​"​类​缓存​键​的​统一​来源​。

docs.title: 3. URL ​主机​判定​（​安全​边界​）
docs.text:
# utils.py:861-869
def base_url_host_matches(base_url: str, domain: str) -> bool:
    """True when the base URL's hostname is ``domain`` or a subdomain.

    Safer than ``domain in base_url`` (``evil.com/moonshot.ai`` / ``moonshot.ai.evil`` must not
    match). Accepts bare hosts, full URLs, and URLs with paths.
    """
    hostname = base_url_hostname(base_url)
    domain = (domain or "").strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    return bool(hostname and domain) and (hostname == domain or hostname.endswith("." + domain))

base_url_hostname（​行​ 818）​容忍​裸​ host[:port]（​无​ scheme ​也​ parse）；base_url_origin（​行​ 841）​返回​ (scheme, host, port)——​把​ bearer ​密钥​交给​新​ URL ​前​必须​三​比较​，​只​比​ host ​会​放行​ HTTPS→HTTP ​降级​。model_forces_max_completion_tokens（​行​ 835）​识别​拒绝​ max_tokens ​的​ OpenAI ​家族​。

docs.title: 4. ​其余​高频​函数
docs.text: env_int / env_float（​行​ 723/728）​容错​读取​环境变量​；normalize_proxy_env_vars（​行​ 793）​把​ socks:// ​归一成​ httpx ​要​的​ socks5://、​把​ httpx 0.28.1 ​编译​不了​的​ IPv6 NO_PROXY ​条目​改写​成裸​字面​量​；rmtree_readonly（​行​ 344）​能​删​只读​树​（Windows git ​对象​、Nix store ​拷贝​）；read_json_or_empty（​行​ 486，utf-8-sig ​防​ Windows ​编辑器​ BOM）​与​ safe_json_loads（​行​ 679）​是​"​读​半边​降级​"​样板​；unlink_files_older_than（​行​ 325）​是​唯一​的​按龄​清扫​。

docs.title: 关键​代码​走读​（hermes_time.py）
docs.text:
# hermes_time.py:147-150
def now() -> datetime:
    """Current time as a tz-aware datetime: configured zone, else server-local."""
    tz = get_timezone()
    return datetime.now(tz) if tz is not None else datetime.now().astimezone()

​时​区​解析​顺序​：HERMES_TIMEZONE env（​但​多路复用​网关​下​忽略​——env ​只​携带​ default profile ​的​值​，​路由​ profile ​必须​读​自己​的​ config.yaml，_env_timezone ​行​ 67）→ config.yaml timezone → ​服务器​本地​。​缓存​按​"​来源​身份​"​键控​（(​来源​, ​名字​/​配置​路径​)）——​一个​进程​多路复用​ profile ​时​，​无键​全局​缓存​会​把​第一个​ profile ​的​时区​泄漏​给​后续​（​桌面​多路复用​ cron ticker ​把​别人​的​ next_run_at ​写​进​自己​库​的​案例​）。​另外​两个​小件​：safe_strftime（​行​ 52）​修复​ Windows ANSI ​码页​时区​名经​ surrogateescape ​解码​后​的​ strftime ​崩溃​（#102910，​且​对​有效​文本​字节​级​等同​ strftime ​以保​系统​提示​词​缓存​稳定​）；_repair_surrogates（​行​ 35）​把​坏​解码​文本​救回​或​替换​ U+FFFD。

docs.title: 关键​代码​走读​（hermes_yaml.py）
docs.text:
# hermes_yaml.py:1-5,28-38
"""Shared YAML 1.1 policy for config, manifests, and frontmatter.

Ruamel's native schema includes bare y/n booleans and rejects duplicate keys.
Every operation owns its parser/emitter; instances must not be shared by threads.
"""

def safe_load(stream):
    """Read standard YAML data; existing configs use YAML 1.1 booleans.

    The pure parser defines what parses: Windows ARM64 has no C extension, and libyaml rejects
    documents the pure parser accepts (``[{url: http://h}]``), so a C rejection is re-read pure.
    """
    document = stream if isinstance(stream, (str, bytes)) else stream.read()
    try:
        return _load(document, pure=False)
    except YAMLError:
        return _load(document, pure=True)

​三条​策略​：​版本​钉​ 1.1（_Yaml11Resolver ​把​ processing_version ​钉​回​ (1,1)，off/yes ​是​布尔​——​与​历史​ config ​一致​，​加载​侧​无需​引号​）；C ​失败​回退​纯​解析器​（Windows ARM64 ​无​ C ​扩展​、libyaml ​比纯​解析器​更严​，"​纯​解析器​定义​什么​能​ parse"）；​实例​不​跨​线程​共享​（​每个​操作​自​建​ parser/emitter）。​写侧​ safe_dump（​行​ 55）​纯​ Python emitter（C emitter ​丢​缩进​偏移​、​转义​星外​ Unicode）、​缩进​ mapping=2, sequence=4, offset=2；roundtrip_yaml（​行​ 89）​供​注释​保留​编辑​，​宽度​取​ ROUNDTRIP_YAML_WIDTH = 2**31-1——ruamel ​在​转义​反​斜杠​后折​行会​改变​双引号​值​本身​（#119844：​一次​ no-op ​保存​把​ D:\Cent... ​折​成​ D:\ + ​换行​，​重载​成​字面​空格​），​超大​宽度​ = ​禁​折叠​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• hermes_constants.py：_atomic_write ​建​目录​走​ mkdir_under_hermes_home；hermes_time ​取​ get_config_path。
  • hermes_cli/config.py：​写​ config ​最终​都​落到​ atomic_roundtrip_yaml_save；_split_key_path ​被​ update ​函数​借用​。
  • run_agent.py / agent/：env_float（API ​超时​）、base_url_host_matches（provider ​判定​）、model_forces_max_completion_tokens（​参数​形状​）​直接​消费​。
  • tools/：​终端​/​进程​管理​的​超时​与​代理​环境​也​经​ env_* ​与​ normalize_proxy_env_vars。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​三个​文件​合成​一条​底座​定律​："​落盘​必​原子​、​键必​签名​、YAML ​必​ 1.1、​时钟​必带区​"。
  • ​每个​看似​繁琐​的​分支​都​有​事故​编号​：​折行​改变​ YAML ​值​（#119844）、BOM ​清空​配置​、​同​ tick ​缓存​键​、Windows locale ​时​区​崩溃​——​读​源码​时​把​注释​里​的​ issue ​号​当作​设计​依据​。
  • ​它们​是​"​工具​函数​不该​有​立场​"​的​反例​：​这里​每个​函数​都​替​调用者​做出​了​正确​的​立场​（​保​ symlink、​保​注释​、​保​ umask、​保​ profile ​隔离​）。

docs.title: 03_agent — Agent ​核心​模块​总览
docs.text: agent/ ​是​ Hermes ​的​心脏​：​一条​用户​消息​从​进入​ AIAgent.run_conversation ​到​变成​最终​回答​， ​经历​租约​准入​ → turn ​前奏​ → ​组装​请求​ → ​调用​模型​ → ​执行​工具​ → ​收尾​持久​化​的​完整​管线​， ​全部​住​在​这个​目录​的​约​ 200 ​个​文件​里​。​本篇​是​导航​地图​。
