docs.title: 文档​导航
docs.text:
文档​ ​主题​ ​内容​ conversation_loop.md ​主​循环​心脏​ run_conversation/_run_conversation_turn、_LoopState ​数据​类​、_run_phase ​按名​传参​/​回​拷​、verdict ​四​ action、_run_api_retry_loop ​内层​重试​循环​ turn_pipeline.md 33 ​个​ turn_*.py ​分阶段​走读​ ​五幕​：​上下文​构建​ → ​请求​组装​ → API ​调用​与​错误​ → ​恢复​分支​ → ​工具​轮​与​收尾​；​每​文件​一行​清单​ turn_facade.md ​准入​门面​ TurnFacadeMixin、​跨​进程​ turn ​租约​与​看门狗​、AIAgent ​的​ 14 ​个​ Mixin、init_agent ​相位​、IterationBudget system_prompt.md ​系统​提示​词​ ​三层​结构​ stable/context/volatile、​字节​稳定​不​变量​、​技能​索引​与​上下文​文件​、​时间​戳​的​缓存​经济学​ ​本篇​ index.md ​总览​ ​全景图​、​导航​、​大​文件​排行​、facade+siblings ​模式​

​其余​主题​文档​（​已​随本​模块​成文​）：

​文档​ ​主题​ compression.md ​上下文​压缩​：context_compressor.py（5,725 ​行​）、conversation_compression.py（4,410 ​行​）、​三遍​压缩​、​溢出​恢复​ model_providers.md ​模型​与​ provider ​解析​：auxiliary_client.py（8,281 ​行​）、model_metadata.py（2,627 ​行​）、fallback ​链​与​凭据​池​；wire ​适配​层​ agent/transports/（chat_completions / anthropic / bedrock）​也​在​这篇​讲​ ../02_core/model_tools.md ​与​ tool_execution.md ​工具​体系​：model_tools.py、toolsets、tool_executor.py ​深读​；MCP ​见​ ../04_tools/mcp.md codex_runtime.md codex wire ​适配​：agent/transports/codex*.py ​系列​ memory_learning.md ​与​ skills_runtime.md ​记忆​与​技能​：memory_manager.py、curator、skills frontmatter

docs.title: 模块​内大​文件​排行
docs.text:
​理解​ agent/ ​的​第一课​：​行​数​ = ​主题​的​复杂度​。​下面​是​ top 12（​行数​为​当前​源码​实测​）：

​排名​ ​文件​ ​行​数​ ​一句​话​ 1 agent/auxiliary_client.py 8,281 ​辅助​（side-LLM）​调用​总管​：​压缩​/​视觉​/​标题​/​嵌入​等​非主​循环​模型​调用​的​路由​与​降级​ 2 agent/context_compressor.py 5,725 ​内​建​压缩器​：​阈值​、​剪枝​、​摘要​生成​、​失败​冷却​ 3 agent/conversation_compression.py 4,410 ​压缩​事务​：​边界​选择​、​原地​/​轮转​、feasibility、checkpoint 4 agent/chat_completion_helpers.py 4,001 ​每次​模型​调用​的​落地​：build_api_kwargs(:1503)、interruptible_api_call(:1260)、interruptible_streaming_api_call(:3977) 5 agent/agent_runtime_helpers.py 3,765 ​运行​时​杂项​助手​：switch_model、invoke_tool、​活动​时钟​、​缓存​同步​ 6 agent/model_metadata.py 2,627 ​模型​元​数据​：​上下文​长度​、​能力​、token ​估算​ 7 agent/agent_init.py 2,211 init_agent：​构造​的​真正​实现​（​相位​顺序​ load-bearing） 8 agent/turn_recovery.py 1,999 ​内层​重试​的​就​地​修复​链​（OAuth/​签名​/​图片​/​语法​……） 9 agent/conversation_loop.py 1,967 ​主​循环​心脏​：run_conversation + _run_conversation_turn + _LoopState 10 agent/tool_executor.py 1,960 ​工具​执行器​：​顺序​/​并发​/​分段​三​执行器​，_MAX_TOOL_WORKERS = 8 11 agent/prompt_builder.py 1,750 ​提示​词​原料​：​技能​索引​、​上下文​文件​、​环境​锚​ 12 agent/system_prompt.py 889 ​系统​提示​词​三层​结构​与​缓存​不​变量​

​规则​提醒​（​根​ AGENTS.md）：​文件​ ≤ 2,000 ​行​、​新​函数​ CC ≤ 20——​已​超限​的​单元​"​只许​变小​"。 ​所以​ top 8 ​里​的​大​文件​都​是​历史​上​已​定型​的​候选​拆分​对象​，​阅读​时​优先​找​它​的​ facade（​公开​入口​）​和​ siblings（​同​前缀​兄弟​文件​）。

docs.title: facade + siblings ​设计模式
docs.text:
agent/ ​是​这个​模式​的​范本​（​根​ AGENTS.md § Project Structure）：

run_agent.py（facade，1,565 ​行​）            agent/conversation_loop.py（​实现​，1,967 ​行​）
  class AIAgent(14 ​个​ Mixin)                 def run_conversation(agent, ...)
      __init__ ──​打包​ locals()──►  agent/agent_init.py::init_agent
      run_conversation ──​转发​──►   ── lease ​准入​后​ ──►
      _execute_tool_calls ──►      agent/tool_executor.py（siblings ​之一​）
      switch_model ──_forward──►   agent/agent_runtime_helpers.py

​四条​规则​（​读​代码​时​随时​用得上​）：

  1. ​门面​保留​：​公共​入口​ + ​其他​包​ import ​的​名字​；​行为​住​在​兄弟​文件​ <stem>_<topic>.py，​每个​文件​管​一个​主题​（turn_tool_round.py ​只管​一轮​工具​调用​）。
  2. ​按​主题​找​代码​：grep -rn "def run_tool_round" agent/turn_*.py， ​不要​通读​门面​。
  3. ​兄弟​文件​在​函数​体内​ late-import ​门面​（from agent.conversation_loop import X）， ​绝不​模块​级​循环​。​这​同时​定义​了​测试​缝​：patch ​生产​代码​真正​读取​的​位置​ （patch("agent.conversation_loop.X")）。
  4. super god-file ​的​拆分​方式​：turn ​循环​拆成​了​ 33 ​个​ turn_*.py，​每个​阶段​一个​文件​； ​主​循环​只​剩​"​串​阶段​"​的​ _run_phase ​机制​。

docs.title: 一条​不​变量​贯穿​所有​文档
docs.text:
Per-conversation prompt caching is sacred（​会话级​提示​词​缓存​神圣不可​侵犯​）。

  • ​系统​提示​词​每会话​构建​一次​、​字节​冻结​，​唯一​合法​的​变异​是​压缩​ （system_prompt.md）；
  • ​请求​历史​通过​ api_content sidecar ​重​放​"​当初​发送​的​精确​字节​"，​请求​组装​时​ cache plan ​永远​最后​构建​（turn_pipeline.md）；
  • ​中途​注入​的​一切​（steer、​内存​预取​、​预算​警告​）​都​骑​在​最新​的​工具​结果​行上​， ​已​持久​化​的​行​绝不​改写​（conversation_loop.py:139-158 ​的​注释​是​范本​）；
  • ​主​循环​是​同步​的​：​任何​"​换个​上下文​就​想​重建​提示​词​"​的​冲动​，​都​请回到​这条​不​变量​上​自问​。

docs.title: 阅读​路径​建议
docs.text:
​零​基础​读者​推荐​顺序​：

  1. ​本篇​（​全景图​）→ 2. turn_facade.md（​消息​如何​进门​） → 3. conversation_loop.md（​循环​如何​转​） → 4. turn_pipeline.md（​每个​阶段​做​什么​） → 5. system_prompt.md（​为什么​提示​词动​不得​） → 6. compression / model_providers ​等​后续​文档​（​边缘系统​）。

​动手​改​代码​前​的​三件套​：​读​ agent/AGENTS.md（​模块​规则​）、​跑​ grep -rn "def <​符号​>" agent/turn_*.py ​定位​实现​、​用​ scripts/run_tests.sh ​的​ tests/agent/ ​套件​验证​消息​形状​不​变量​（​角色​交替​、​字节​稳定​系统​提示​词​）。

docs.title: auxiliary_clients.md — ​辅助​ LLM ​客户端​：​副​任务​宇宙
文件​概览
docs.text:
​主​循环​之外​的​一切​ LLM ​调用​——​压缩​、​标题​、​视觉​、embedding、​会话​搜索​、curator、MoA ​顾问​——​都​叫​辅助​调用​（auxiliary）。​它们​没有​自己​的​ turn，​却​要​凭据​、​要​路由​、​要​重试​、 ​要​可​观测​。agent/auxiliary_client.py（8,281 ​行​，​全仓​最大​）​是​这片​宇宙​的​中心​路由器​， 19 ​个​ auxiliary_* ​兄弟​模块​各管​一摊​。

​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/auxiliary_client.py 8,281 ​中心​路由器​：call_llm ​入口​、_resolve_auto_route ​三级​阶梯​、resolve_provider_client agent/auxiliary_task_config.py 117 auxiliary.<task> ​配置​块​的​读时​解析​（​每​任务​ pin、​插件​任务​、inherit_from） agent/auxiliary_hooks.py 266 pre_auxiliary_call/post_auxiliary_call ​插件​事件​（​每次​物理​尝试​一对​） agent/auxiliary_unavailable.py 275 "​为什么​建不出​客户端​"： Nous ​凭据​失败​的​记忆​与​一次性​告警​ agent/auxiliary_error_shapes.py 54 ​错误​形态​读取​：HTTP ​状态​在​哪​、​无​状态​失败​如何​终结​一条​路由​ agent/auxiliary_rate_limit_backoff.py 71 ​同​凭据​ 429/​限流​退避​（​阶梯​产出​ wait，sync/async ​共享​一张​表​） agent/auxiliary_fallback_recovery.py 50 ​回退​候选​的​参数​拒绝​恢复​（​剥掉​被​拒字段​再试​） agent/auxiliary_reasoning_floor.py 126 ​推理​下限​：​路由​拒绝​关​推理​时​改为​升档​ agent/auxiliary_structured_output.py 127 ​结构化​输出​能力​记忆​（​某​路由​拒​ response_format ​就​记下来​） agent/auxiliary_stream_watchdog.py 182 ​流式​无​进展​看门狗​（​只​ shutdown ​本​尝试​的​ socket） agent/auxiliary_health.py 73 ​自定义​ provider ​健康检查​的​端点​身份​ agent/auxiliary_client_registry.py 134 auth_type ​分派​表​（auxiliary registry ​分支​） agent/auxiliary_plugin_oauth.py 45 OAuth ​型​ model-provider ​插件​的​ aux ​客户端​ agent/auxiliary_key_rotation.py 21 ​凭据​刷新​后​轮转​已​发布​的​ main-runtime key agent/auxiliary_local_runtime.py 35 ​托管​ llama.cpp ​端点​（aux/​回退​解析​） agent/auxiliary_managed_local.py 44 ​判定​"​哪个​端点​是​本​ Hermes ​管​的​ llama-server" agent/auxiliary_wire.py 33 ​解析​出​的​客户端​边界​上​的​消息​卫生​ agent/auxiliary_async_rebuild.py 42 sync → async ​客户端​重建​时​携带​凭据​与​配置​头​ agent/auxiliary_codex_response.py 55 Codex Responses → chat.completions ​的​ aux ​侧​归一化​ agent/auxiliary_call_outcome.py 60 ​一次​逻辑​调用​的​结局​（Relay hermes.logical_llm_call ​作用域​）

​模块​头​（auxiliary_client.py:1-7）​把​自动​链背​得​滚瓜烂熟​：

Text auto chain: main provider+model → OpenRouter → Nous Portal → custom endpoint → native Anthropic → direct API-key providers → None. Vision auto chain: main provider (if a supported vision backend) → OpenRouter → Nous → Anthropic → custom. auxiliary.free_only restricts the OpenRouter lane to :free SKUs. Codex OAuth is in neither chain (undocumented, shifting allow-list): main provider or explicit auxiliary.<task>.provider only. HTTP 402 in call_llm() falls through the chain.

docs.title: 1. _resolve_auto_route —— ​三级​自动​路由​阶梯​（auxiliary_client.py:4568）
docs.text:
(1) ​主​ provider + ​主模型​
    "auto" = ​副​任务​也​用​我​的​主模型​（​每​任务​显式​覆盖​仍然​赢​）
        │ ​失败​/​不可​用​
        ▼
(2) ​配置​的​回退​策略​
    auxiliary.<task>.fallback_chain → ​主​ agent ​顶层​ fallback_chain
        │ ​没​配置​或​不可​用​
        ▼
(3) ​发现​链​（​仅​当​无​策略​且主​客户端​不​工作​）
    OpenRouter → Nous → custom → Codex → API-key providers
        │ ​全灭​
        ▼
    (None, None, "") —— ​压缩​/​标题​/​记忆​全部​停摆​，​日志​点名​怎么​配​

# agent/auxiliary_client.py:4568-4593
def _resolve_auto_route(
    main_runtime: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, task: Optional[str] = None
) -> tuple[Optional[OpenAI], Optional[str], str]:
    """Full auto-detection chain, including the selected provider identity. Priority: (1) main provider +
    main model, regardless of provider type ("auto" means "my main model for side tasks too"; explicit
    per-task overrides still win); (2) configured fallback policy — task chain, then the main agent's
    top-level chain; (3) OpenRouter → Nous → custom → Codex → API-key providers, only with no policy
    and no working main client."""
    runtime = _normalize_main_runtime(main_runtime)
    _warn_stale_openai_base_url(runtime.get("provider", ""))
    main_provider, main_model, base_url, api_key, api_mode = _main_route_target(runtime, task)
    routed = _try_main_provider_route(main_provider, main_model, base_url, api_key, api_mode)
    if routed is not None:
        return routed
    if task:
        fb_client, fb_model, fb_label = _try_configured_fallback_chain(
            task, main_provider or "auto", reason="main provider unavailable")
        if fb_client is not None:
            return fb_client, fb_model, _fallback_provider_from_label(fb_label)
    fb_client, fb_model, fb_label = _try_main_fallback_chain(
        task, main_provider or "auto", reason="main provider unavailable")
    if fb_client is not None:
        return fb_client, fb_model, fb_label
    if not _discovery_chain_allowed(main_provider, task):
        return None, None, ""
    return _try_discovery_chain()

​第三级​ _try_discovery_chain（:4544-4565）​自带​健康​过滤​：​跳过​被​标记​不​健康​的​ provider， ​并​把​试过​的​每个​候选​记进​日志​；​全灭​时​给​一句​可​操作​的​告警​——"Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY or configure a local model in config.yaml"，​且​明说​后果​（​压缩​/​摘要​/​记忆​刷新​不会​工作​）。

docs.title: 2. resolve_provider_client —— ​唯一​入口​（auxiliary_client.py:5311）
docs.text:
# agent/auxiliary_client.py:5300-5305 + 5311-5317（​节选​）
# Centralized Provider Router: resolve_provider_client() is the single entry point for building a configured
# client (auth, base URL, headers, API format) from (provider, model). Never read auth env vars ad-hoc.


def resolve_provider_client(
    provider: str, model: str | None = None, async_mode: bool = False, raw_codex: bool = False,
    explicit_base_url: str | None = None, explicit_api_key: Optional[str | Callable[[], str]] = None,
    api_mode: str | None = None, main_runtime: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, is_vision: bool = False,
    task: Optional[str] = None,
) -> tuple[Optional[Any], Optional[str]]:

​注释​里​那句​大写​是​铁律​：Never read auth env vars ad-hoc——auth、base URL、headers、 API ​格式​全部​从​这里​出​。provider ​可以​是​内置​名​、custom:<name>、"custom"（OPENAI_BASE_URL + OPENAI_API_KEY）​或​ "auto"（​完整​自动​链​）。​返回​的​客户端​永远​暴露​ .chat.completions.create()——Codex/Responses/Anthropic/Bedrock/Gemini provider ​得到​ ​的​是​适配器​客户端​（CodexAuxiliaryClient、AnthropicAuxiliaryClient…），​副​任务​世界​ ​内部​只有​一种​方言​。

​模型​解析​的​优先级​写​在​ :5335-5353 ​的​长​注释​里​：caller ​的​ model → provider ​目录​默认​ （ProviderProfile.default_aux_model）→ config.yaml ​的​主模型​。​注释​特别​点​出​ auto ​故意​不​预填​——​预填​一个​过期​主模型​ slug ​会​把​ Claude ​模型​发到​ Codex OAuth ​上​ （#31845 ​的​教训​）；OAuth provider ​用户​配置​的​主模型​必须​胜过​ Step-2 ​回退​，​否则​ xai-oauth ​用户​的​标题​生成​会​静默​掉​到​随便​什么​便宜​模型​。

docs.title: 3. _relay_* —— ​每次​物理​尝试​的​漏斗​（auxiliary_client.py:2612）
docs.text:
​每个​ aux ​物理​尝试​（​重试​、​恢复​档​、​回退​在内​）​都​要​过​三个​ relay ​之一​：

# agent/auxiliary_client.py:2612-2648（​节选​）
def _relay_sync_completion(
    client: Any, kwargs: dict[str, Any], *, provider: str | None = None,
    api_mode: str | None = None, create: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
) -> Any:
    from agent.auxiliary_wire import prepare_chat_messages, relay_chat_metadata

    kwargs = prepare_chat_messages(client, kwargs)
    # The progress hook is installed per TASK, so every attempt (retries, recovery rungs, fallbacks)
    # must stream through _create_with_progress or the compression watchdog sees silence (#98466).
    relay_context = _RELAY_AUX_CALL_CONTEXT.get() or {}
    task = relay_context.get("task")
    relay_context["stream_provider"] = provider or relay_context.get("provider")
    callback = create or (lambda request: _create_with_progress(client, request, task))
    route = _relay_auxiliary_metadata(provider=provider, api_mode=api_mode)
    ...
    try:
        return run_with_aux_hooks(
            lambda: relay_llm.execute_current(
                kwargs, lambda request: _run_protected_sync_provider_call(callback, request),
                name=provider_name, model_name=model_name, metadata=relay_chat_metadata(metadata),
                defer_logical_completion=True,
            ),
            aux_task=..., metadata=..., client=client, kwargs=kwargs,
            provider=provider_name, model=model_name, api_mode=...,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        _note_relay_auxiliary_error(exc)
        raise

​三件套​ _relay_sync_completion（:2612）/_relay_async_completion（:2651）/ _relay_sync_stream（:2681）​是​同一​漏斗​的​同步​/​异步​/​流式​变体​：​先​ prepare_chat_messages （auxiliary_wire ​的​边界​卫生​），​再​包进​ run_with_aux_hooks（​插件​事件​对​）​与​ relay_llm.execute_current（Relay ​逻辑​调用​作用域​）。​两条​注释​值得​记​：progress hook ​按​ task ​安装​，​所以​任何​重试​/​回退​路径​都​必须​从​ _create_with_progress ​走​，​否则​压缩​ ​看门狗​把​正常​工作​误判​为​静默​（#98466）；_run_protected_sync_provider_call ​只​隔离​ provider ​回调​——​硬​取消​时​拥有​线程​能​正常​解卷​租约​/DB ​事务​，​共享​客户端​不​受​影响​。

docs.title: 4. hooks ​对​ —— ​为什么​主​循环​钩子​不得​对​ aux ​触发​（auxiliary_hooks.py:1-12）
docs.text:
# agent/auxiliary_hooks.py:1-12（​模块​ docstring）
"""Plugin events for auxiliary LLM calls (#79733).

``pre_auxiliary_call`` / ``post_auxiliary_call`` fire once per physical provider attempt at the
relay boundary of ``agent.auxiliary_client`` — the funnel every auxiliary task (titling,
compression, MoA advisors/aggregator, vision, approval, ...) shares, retries and fallbacks
included — carrying the ``pre_api_request`` / ``post_api_request`` payload shape plus
``aux_task``. They are deliberately DISTINCT events: the main-loop ``*_api_request`` events stay
turn-scoped, so observability plugins keyed on turn identity never see auxiliary traffic unless
they subscribe to these. Observer-only (returns ignored) and fail-open: a raising or hung
callback is logged and the auxiliary call proceeds untouched.
"""

​这是​刻意​的​双​事件​体系​：​主​循环​的​ pre_api_request/post_api_request ​事件​是​ turn-scoped ​的​——​按​ turn ​身份​键控​的​可​观测​插件​绝不​该​看到​副​任务​流量​，​除非​它​明确​订阅​ *_auxiliary_call。aux ​对​携带​与​主​事件​相同​的​载荷​形状​外加​ aux_task，​每次​物理​尝试​ ​发​一对​（​重试​和​回退​各有​各​的​对​）。​两条​安全阀​：observer-only（​返回值​被​忽略​，​调用​结果​ ​不许​依赖​观察者​），fail-open（​抛​异常​/​挂​起​的​回调​只记​日志​，aux ​调用​照常进行​）。

_fire（:197-206）​与​ run_with_aux_hooks（:236-249）​落实​这​两条​；_parent_turn_identity （:13-30）​把​主​ turn ​的​ session/task/turn/platform ​带上​（​无​ turn ​的​调用者​——cron、​网关​ ​空闲​工作​——​得到​空串​）。​流式​响应​未​消费​就​交还​（MoA ​门面​负责​重组​），post ​载荷​里​没有​ usage/finish_reason，​由​ streaming=True ​解释​（:159-163）。

docs.title: 5. ​每​任务​ pin —— config.yaml ​的​ auxiliary: ​段​（auxiliary_task_config.py:45）
docs.text:
# config.yaml（​示意​）
auxiliary:
  titles:
    provider: openrouter
    model: openai/gpt-4.1-mini
  compression:
    provider: auto            # ​跟​主模型​
  vision:
    provider: nous            # Portal ​的​ tier ​感知​视觉​推荐​
  embedding:
    provider: custom:local-embed
  session_search:
    model: gpt-4.1-mini
  curator:
    fallback_chain: [nous, openrouter]

# agent/auxiliary_task_config.py:45-56 + 94-95（​节选​）
def _get_auxiliary_task_config(task: str, _seen: frozenset = frozenset()) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Config dict for auxiliary.<task>, or {} when unavailable. Plugin-registered tasks get their
    declared defaults layered under user config (user wins); built-in defaults live in DEFAULT_CONFIG.
    A task registered with ``inherit_from`` is resolved here, at read time, over the base task's
    effective config, so it follows the base's current settings (and the active profile's config)
    until the user pins a route on the task itself. ``_seen`` guards re-registration cycles."""
    if not task:
        return {}
    config = _task_config(str(task), _seen)
    if getattr(task, "route_authoritative", False):
        return {key: value for key, value in config.items() if key not in _AUX_ROUTE_KEYS}
    return config

# The fields that together pick WHERE a call goes. They travel as one unit: a provider pinned on an
# inheriting task must never pick up the base's base_url/api_key (that would send one vendor's key
# to another's endpoint).
_AUX_ROUTE_KEYS = frozenset({"provider", "model", "base_url", "api_key", "api_mode", "key_env",
                             "api_key_env", "reasoning_effort"})

​三个​设计​点​：

  1. ​读时​解析​：inherit_from ​在​读取​时​解析​到​基础​任务​的​当前​生效​配置​——​基础​任务​ ​改了​路由​，​继承​任务​跟着​走​，​直到​用户​给​自己​ pin ​了​路由​。_seen ​防​注册​环​。
  2. ​路由​键​是​原子​单位​（:91-95）：provider/model/base_url/api_key/api_mode/key_env/ api_key_env/reasoning_effort ​一起​旅行​——​继承​任务​ pin ​了​ provider ​却​继承​ base ​的​ base_url/api_key，​等于​把​一家​的​ key ​发到​另一家​的​端点​。
  3. route_authoritative（:32-42）：​一次性​回退​若​点名​了​完整​路由​，​则​剥离​路由​键​—— ​绝不​继承​刚​失败​那条​路由​的​未​清空​ endpoint/key（#113322、#130895）。

_layer_over_inherited（:98-110）​再​补​一层​语义​：picker/​重置​/​面板​持久​化​的​ provider: auto + ​空串​是​"​跟随​基础​"​而​不是​"​覆盖​为​无​"；​一旦​ pin ​了​路由​（​非​ auto provider、​非空​ model ​或​ base_url），​整条路​由​都​来自​任务​自己​的​块​。

docs.title: 6. ​恢复​体系​ —— ​限流​退避​、​流​看门狗​、​参数​恢复
docs.text:
aux ​调用​每​ provider ​只试​一次​（OpenAI SDK max_retries=0、botocore total_max_attempts: 1），​恢复​阶梯​自己​掌握​等待​：

# agent/auxiliary_rate_limit_backoff.py:1-8 + 16-24（​节选​）
"""Same-credential backoff for an auxiliary call refused by a rate limit (429, Bedrock throttle).

Auxiliary clients make one attempt per call (OpenAI SDK ``max_retries=0``, botocore
``total_max_attempts: 1``), so the recovery ladder owns the wait. An immediate re-send lands in the
same throttle window and spends the retry, then credential rotation and the provider fallback chain
see a provider that would have answered a moment later. The ladder yields a ``wait`` step; the sync
and async ladder drivers sleep it, so both caller kinds share one schedule."""

RATE_LIMIT_RETRIES = 1
RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF_BASE = 1.0
RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF_CAP = 4.0
# A provider-declared cooldown longer than this is not worth sitting through inside an auxiliary
# call (compression, titles, summaries): rotate or fall back instead.
RATE_LIMIT_RETRY_AFTER_CAP = 5.0

​流式​这边​，​消费者​阻塞​在​ SDK ​的​ chunk ​迭代​器里​，​静默​流要​等​ httpx ​读​超时​（​压缩​的​完整​ ​预算​ ≥300s）​才​被​发觉​——​宿主​的​压缩​等待​先​放弃​，​这次​尝试​死于​无​回退​。​看门狗​的​窗口​由​一个​ Timer ​执行​，​且​只​ shutdown ​本次​尝试​的​ socket（FD ​安全​， stranger ​线程​可​执行​， :1-8 docstring）：​唤醒​拥有者​的​阻塞​读​，​拥有者​仍​在​自己​的​ finally ​里​关流​，​让​连接池​丢弃​ ​而​不是​回收​死​连接​（#100501、#70773）。ChatStreamWatchdog（:45）​只​被​实质性​ chunk ​重置​；​首个​ token ​前​的​静默​由​ first_token_window ​界定​（​推理模型​会​静默​思考​数分钟​），​窗口​ ​跑​在​ awake ​时钟​上​——​电脑​睡眠​的​时间​不计​。

​其余​恢复​件​各就各位​：auxiliary_fallback_recovery.py ​把​回退​候选​请求​里​被​拒绝​的​参数​ ​剥掉​再试​；auxiliary_reasoning_floor.py ​处理​"​路由​拒绝​关​推理​"——​改为​升档​而​不是​ ​硬来​；auxiliary_structured_output.py ​记住​哪个​路由​拒​ response_format，​下次​按​ _route_key ​直接​省略​；auxiliary_error_shapes.py ​是​这些​机制​共用​的​错误​形态​读取器​ （SDK ​错误​的​ HTTP ​状态​在​哪​、HTTP-200 ​畸形​响应​/SSE error ​事件​这类​无​状态​失败​如何​终结​ ​一条​路由​）；auxiliary_unavailable.py ​记住​最近​一次​ Nous ​凭据​失败​的​细节​（_quarantined_nous_error ​优先​用​池里​持久​化​的​终态​隔离​标记​——​池​清理​死​ token ​后​，resolver ​只能​说​"No access token found"，​真正​死因​ invalid_grant ​只​在​标记​里​，#42177），​并​对​每条​不同​消息​只​告警​一次​。

docs.title: 7. ​客户端​家族​与​异步​重建
docs.text:
resolve_provider_client ​返回​的​客户端​是​多态​家族​：_to_async_client（:4608-4652）​展示​ ​了​完整​清单​——CodexAuxiliaryClient→Async ​版​、AnthropicAuxiliaryClient、 BedrockAuxiliaryClient、GeminiNativeClient、ACP shim（​子​进程​，​天然​ async ​安全​， HERMES_SKIP_ASYNC_WRAP ​跳过​包装​）、​其余​重建​为​ AsyncOpenAI。​重建​时​最​容易​踩​的​坑​在​ auxiliary_async_rebuild.py：key_cmd/Entra ​客户端​的​凭据​在​ SDK ​的​ per-request provider ​槽​里​而​非​ .api_key（​保持​空串​），​只​从​快照​重建​会​一个​ Authorization ​头​都​不带​ （#109595）；​配置​的​ default_headers ​也​要​按​ SDK ​的​合并​顺序​带​过去​。

call_llm（:7905-7946）​是​最​外层​入口​：​先​拿​任务​的​并发​信号量​（​排队​时间​记进​ latency_info），​包​上​ scoped_runtime_main（​一次​不可​变​运行​时​快照​——​并发​ /model ​切换​ ​不​可能​把​不同​ runtime ​的​ key ​和​ client ​混进​一次​调用​），​流式​时​信号量​延迟​到​流​被​消费​或​ ​关闭​才​释放​（_release_sync_semaphore_after_stream，:7949-7961）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
​副​任务​调用​方​（​压缩​ / ​标题​ / ​视觉​ / embedding / ​会话​搜索​ / curator / MoA / ​审批​）
        │  call_llm(task=..., messages=...)
        ▼
auxiliary_client.call_llm ──► auxiliary_task_config（auxiliary.<task> pin / ​回退​链​ / ​超时​）
        │
        ▼
_resolve_auto_route ──► resolve_provider_client（​唯一​入口​）
        │                    ├──► providers/ get_provider_profile（default_aux_model）
        │                    └──► credential_pool / anthropic_credentials（​凭据​）
        ▼
_relay_sync/_async/_stream ──► auxiliary_wire（​边界​卫生​）+ relay_llm（​逻辑​调用​作用域​）
        │                  └──► auxiliary_hooks（pre/post_auxiliary_call ​插件​事件​）
        ▼
​恢复​阶梯​：rate_limit_backoff → fallback_recovery → fallback_chain → aux_unavailable ​上​抛​
  • ​消费​方​：context_compressor*.py（​压缩​摘要​）、title_generator.py、 vision_message_prep.py、side_question.py、curator/skills_index_delta.py、 MoA（agent_init.py::_init_moa_client）、​审批​与​ goal judge。
  • ​凭据​层​：​池​轮转​/​冷却​在​ credential_pool.py、Nous ​密钥​在​ anthropic_credentials.py ——​见​ credentials_rate.md；auxiliary_key_rotation.py ​在​刷新​后​把​新​ key ​发布​回​ main-runtime。
  • ​观测​：api_request_hooks.py ​的​主​循环​事件​与​这里​的​事件​对​互不​越界​——turn-scoped ​插件​看不到​ aux ​流量​，​除非​订阅​ *_auxiliary_call。
  • ​传输层​复用​：Codex ​头部​/​端点​判定​ import ​自​ codex_headers.py（​叶子​模块​，​见​ codex_runtime.md）；auxiliary_codex_response.py ​与​主​传输​共享​ _cache_scope_from_session_id。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​副​任务​宇宙​只有​一个​漏斗​：call_llm → ​任务​配置​ → _resolve_auto_route ​三级​阶梯​ → resolve_provider_client（​唯一​入口​，"Never read auth env vars ad-hoc"）→ relay ​漏斗​。 ​返回​的​客户端​对外​统一​ chat.completions.create()，​协议​差异​被​家族​适配器​吃掉​。
  • ​路由​三级​语义​分明​：​主模型​优先​（"auto = ​副​任务​也​用​主模型​"）、​配置​回退​其次​、​发现​链​ ​兜底​（​健康​过滤​ + ​可​操作​告警​）；Codex OAuth ​因​允许​列表​漂移​永远​不进​自动​链​。
  • ​每​任务​ pin ​是​原子​的​：​路由​键​（provider/model/base_url/api_key/api_mode/key_env/ reasoning_effort）​作为​一个​单位​旅行​，​继承​任务​的​ provider ​绝不​配​别家​的​ endpoint； route_authoritative ​让​一次性​回退​不​继承​失败​路由​的​残骸​。
  • ​事件​双​体系​是​刻意​的​：pre/post_auxiliary_call ​与​主​循环​ *_api_request ​形状​相同​ ​但​ distinct——turn-scoped ​可​观测​插件​看不到​副​任务​流量​；observer-only + fail-open， aux ​结果​不​依赖​任何​观察者​。
  • ​恢复​阶梯​替​ SDK ​重试​：​每​ provider ​一次​尝试​（SDK max_retries=0），​限流​退避​一次​ ​重试​后​转​凭据​轮转​/​回退​链​；​流​看门狗​只关​本次​ socket、awake ​时钟​、​实质性​ chunk ​才​重置​。
  • ​错误​也​是​要​记住​的​：Nous ​凭据​死因​、​结构化​输出​拒绝​、​推理​下限​、​回退​参数​拒绝​—— ​按​路由​/​消息​记忆​，​宁可​升档​与​绕行​，​不硬​撞墙​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
codex_responses（HTTP Responses API）​与​ codex_app_server（​子​进程​ codex CLI）​是​ Hermes ​里​最重​的​两种​ wire。​前者​由​ agent/transports/codex.py + ​无​状态​适配器​支撑​；​后者​干脆​把​整个​ turn ​交给​ codex ​子​进程​跑​——codex ​拥有​ loop、​工具​列表​和​模型​侧线​程​（thread），Hermes ​只​ ​负责​投影​事件​、​审批​桥接​与​转录​拼接​。

​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/codex_responses_adapter.py 1,359 ​无​状态​转换​/normalize：Responses ​输入​项​、​加密​ reasoning blob、endpoint quirks agent/codex_runtime.py 1,481 ​两条​运行​时​路径​的​入口​：run_codex_app_server_turn / run_codex_stream agent/codex_runtime_history_seed.py 65 ​全新​线程​的​"​历史​种子​"：​把​ Hermes ​前​文​渲染​成​一次性​ developerInstructions agent/codex_service_tiers.py 212 ​速度​档位​（ultrafast/priority）​与​ Daybreak：​只​按​账户​目录​协商​，​绝不​盲目​降级​ agent/codex_headers.py 128 ​请求​身份​头​：originator/UA、JWT ​派生​的​账户​头​、zstd ​压缩​钩子​ agent/transports/codex.py 977 Responses ​传输层​（​四步​数据​路径​，​见​ model_providers.md） agent/transports/codex_app_server.py 381 stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 ​客户端​（​握手​、thread/start、turn/start） agent/transports/codex_app_server_session.py 849 ​会话​适配器​：​一线​程​一会​话​，​审批​桥接​、​取消​翻译​、TurnResult agent/transports/codex_event_projector.py 171 item/* ​通知​ → OpenAI ​形态​消息​的​投影​器​

​两条​路径​的​关系​：

codex_responses（HTTP）                    codex_app_server（​子​进程​）
  turn_api_call                             run_codex_app_server_turn
      │                                         │
      ▼                                         ▼
transports/codex.py  ──​适配​──►            _ensure_codex_session
codex_responses_adapter                        │ ​惰性​ spawn
      │                                        ▼
      ▼                              CodexAppServerSession（​一线​程一​ Hermes ​会话​）
run_codex_stream                          │  turn/start + ​流式​ item/*
  _CodexResponseAssembler ──┐              ▼
      │                    │        CodexEventProjector（item/* → OpenAI ​消息​）
      ▼                    ▼              │
  NormalizedResponse    ​流式​ delta ◄──────┘ ​事件​桥​ make_codex_app_server_event_bridge

docs.title: 1. run_codex_app_server_turn —— ​一个​ turn ​的​完整​移交​（codex_runtime.py:748）
docs.text:
# agent/codex_runtime.py:748-793（​节选​）
def run_codex_app_server_turn(agent, *, user_message: str, original_user_message: Any, messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
                              effective_task_id: str, should_review_memory: bool = False,
                              turn_id: Any = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Hand the turn to a ``codex app-server`` subprocess and project its events into ``messages``.
    Returns the chat_completions result shape. The user message is ALREADY in ``messages`` — never append it again."""
    # Defense in depth for compression.checkpoint_required: agent init refuses the combination, but
    # api_mode is mutable. Explicit-True check matches compress_context().
    if getattr(agent, "compression_checkpoint_required", False) is True:
        from agent.conversation_compression_checkpoint import _checkpoint_blocked
        raise _checkpoint_blocked("codex_app_server owns the authoritative thread and compacts it "
                                  "without a truthful pre-compaction transcript boundary")
    _ensure_codex_session(agent, messages)
    try:
        _start_codex_thread(agent)
        wire_model = _codex_wire_model(agent, getattr(agent, "_codex_session_model_provider", None))
        turn = agent._codex_session.run_turn(
            user_input=user_message,
            model=wire_model, reasoning_effort=_codex_turn_effort(agent, wire_model),
            service_tier=_codex_turn_service_tier(agent))
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("codex app-server turn failed")
        _close_codex_session(agent)
        return _turn_result(..., final_response=f"Codex app-server turn failed: {exc}. "
                           f"Fall back to default runtime with `/codex-runtime auto`.")
    interrupt = _consume_user_interrupt(agent, turn.interrupted)
    # Wedged client (turn deadline blown, OAuth refresh died, subprocess exited): retire it. Post-tool
    # silence alone no longer retires — it only logs a warning (#112928).
    if getattr(turn, "should_retire", False):
        logger.warning("codex app-server session retired (turn error: %s)", turn.error)
        _close_codex_session(agent)
    reply = _transform_codex_reply(agent, turn, turn_id)
    # The binding is published only once the transcript it belongs to is durable, and never for a
    # retired thread (the next agent would only resume into the same wedge).
    if _persist_projected_messages(agent, turn, messages) and not getattr(turn, "should_retire", False):
        _store_codex_thread_id(agent, turn.thread_id)

​这里​的​顺序​每一环​都​ load-bearing：

  1. checkpoint ​双保险​：codex_app_server ​自己​拥有​权威​线程​并​自行​压缩​，​压缩​检查点​ ​模式​与​它​不可​共存​——agent init ​已​拒绝​该​组合​，​这里​再拦​一次​（api_mode ​是​可变​的​）。
  2. ​会话​退役​（retire）​语义​：turn ​超时​、OAuth ​刷新​死​、​子​进程​退出​ → should_retire → ​关闭​会话​，​下个​ turn ​重生​；​仅​"​工具​后​沉默​"​不再​触发​退役​（#112928 ​修复​）。
  3. thread ​绑定​的​发布​门​：​只有​投影​消息​先落库​（_persist_projected_messages ​返回​ True）​才​把​ codex thread_id ​存进会​话​——​绑定​指向​的​转录​必须​已​持久​；​退役​线程​ ​永不​发布​绑定​（​下​一个​ agent ​会​ resume ​进​同一个​卡死​的​线程​）。
  4. ​结果​形状​对齐​：_turn_result（:796）​返回​与​ chat_completions ​路径​完全相同​的​ dict ​形状​，​外加​ agent_persisted=True（​网关​跳过​自己​的​ DB ​写​）​与​ codex ​线程​/turn id。

docs.title: 2. _ensure_codex_session —— ​懒​ spawn、​合成​感知​退役​、​失败​种子​（codex_runtime.py:599）
docs.text:
# agent/codex_runtime.py:599-617 + 649-663（​节选​）
def _ensure_codex_session(agent, messages=None) -> None:
    """Lazily spawn one CodexAppServerSession per AIAgent (reused across turns, closed by the _cleanup hook).
    A live session whose thread was started with a different prompt composition (TUI/Desktop ``/personality``
    or a prompt mirror mutate the agent in place) is retired first so the new thread carries the current one.
    Only the FIRST session of an AIAgent resumes the stored codex thread: a retired/recreated one keeps
    today's fresh-thread behaviour and overwrites the binding once its turn is committed."""
    developer_instructions = _codex_developer_instructions(agent)
    model_provider = _codex_model_provider(agent)
    if getattr(agent, "_codex_session", None) is not None:
        recorded = getattr(agent, "_codex_session_prompt", None)
        if recorded is None or (recorded == developer_instructions
                                and getattr(agent, "_codex_session_model_provider", None) == model_provider):
            return
        _close_codex_session(agent)
    ...
    agent._codex_session_prompt = developer_instructions
    agent._codex_session_model_provider = model_provider
    from agent.codex_runtime_history_seed import render_history_seed
    history_seed = render_history_seed(messages) or None
    agent._codex_session = CodexAppServerSession(
        cwd=..., approval_callback=approval_callback,
        codex_bin=get_configured_codex_binary(load_config()),
        request_routing=_ServerRequestRouting(auto_approve_exec=..., auto_approve_apply_patch=...),
        on_event=make_codex_app_server_event_bridge(agent),
        developer_instructions=developer_instructions or None,
        model=_codex_wire_model(agent, model_provider), model_provider=model_provider,
        resume_thread_id=resume_thread_id, history_seed=history_seed,
    )

​要点​：

  • prompt ​合成​变​了​就​退役​：TUI/Desktop ​的​ /personality ​会​原地​改​ agent；codex ​线程​ ​的​ developerInstructions ​是​每​请求​都​会​带上​的​首条​ developer ​消息​，​合成​漂移​的​线程​ ​必须​重开​。​记录​的​是​裸​ prompt——history seed ​不能​算​进​合成​，​否则​下​一​ turn ​白​退役​。
  • ​只有​第一个​会话​ resume ​存储​线程​：​退役​重建​的​会​话​走​ fresh-thread ​行为​，turn ​提交​后​ ​覆写​绑定​。
  • ​审批​ fail-closed：CLI ​线程​装​了​审批​回调​才​桥接​；​网关​/cron ​没人能​答​审批​，​默认​拒绝​ exec/apply_patch，​只有​显式​ bypass（approvals.mode: off、/yolo）​才​放行​给​ codex ​沙箱​。
  • ​模型​总是​随行​（:653-654 ​注释​）：codex home ​是​共享​的​，​而​ Hermes ​模型​是​ per profile/session ​的​——​省略​ model ​会​跑​成​ codex ​自己​的​默认​选择​。

docs.title: 3. ​历史​种子​ —— fresh thread ​不许​失忆​（codex_runtime_history_seed.py:53）
docs.text:
​一个​ Hermes ​会话​可能​因为​ /model ​切​到​ openai-codex、​存储​线程​ resume ​失败​或​线程​中途​ ​退役​而​从零开始​一个​ codex ​线程​。​线程​是​模型​侧​的​连续性​存储​，codex ​不​认识​ Hermes ​的​ ​转录​，​除非​有人​告诉​它​。render_history_seed ​把​前文​渲染​成​一段​文本​，​搭乘​ thread/start.developerInstructions ​一次性​注入​（codex ​会​把​它​作为​线程​内​每个​请求​的​首条​ developer ​消息​，​所以​上限​很​重要​）：

# agent/codex_runtime_history_seed.py:19-23 + 53-65
# Tail cap on the rendered history; ~8k tokens, resent by codex on every request of the thread.
MAX_HISTORY_SEED_CHARS = 32_000
_TOOL_RESULT_PREVIEW_CHARS = 400

_HEADER = ("Prior conversation from this Hermes session (the thread you are continuing was started fresh; "
           "treat these turns as already having happened):")

def render_history_seed(messages: list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> str:
    """Prior turns as one text block, newest last; empty when there is nothing before the current
    user message. The trailing user row is the turn being submitted and is never included."""
    rows = list(messages or [])
    if rows and rows[-1].get("role") == "user":
        rows = rows[:-1]
    rendered = [r for r in (_render_row(m) for m in rows if isinstance(m, dict)) if r]
    if not rendered:
        return ""
    body = "\n\n".join(rendered)
    if len(body) > MAX_HISTORY_SEED_CHARS:
        body = "[… earlier turns omitted …]\n\n" + body[-MAX_HISTORY_SEED_CHARS:]
    return f"{_HEADER}\n\n{body}"

​渲染​规则​（_render_row，:35-50）：user/assistant ​原文​（assistant ​附带​ called tools ​清单​）、tool ​结果​只留​ 400 ​字符​预览​、system ​行​直接​跳过​（prompt ​合成​本来​就​以​ developerInstructions ​单独​发送​）。​超长​时保尾​不​保头​——​最近​的​ turn ​才​是​下​一​答案​ ​依赖​的​东西​。

docs.title: 4. CodexEventProjector —— item/* ​到​ OpenAI ​消息​的​投影​（codex_event_projector.py:42）
docs.text:
# agent/transports/codex_event_projector.py:1-8 + 42-67（​节选​）
"""Projects codex app-server ``item/*`` notifications into OpenAI-shaped messages.

userMessage → user; agentMessage → assistant; reasoning → stashed onto the next
assistant entry; commandExecution / fileChange / mcpToolCall / dynamicToolCall /
webSearch → assistant tool_call + tool result; anything else → opaque assistant note.
Each item yields AT MOST one assistant + one tool entry (message-alternation
invariant). ``is_tool_iteration`` ticks once per completed tool-shaped item.
"""
class CodexEventProjector:
    """Stateful projector; stashes codex's separate reasoning items onto the next assistant message."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._pending_reasoning: list[str] = []

    def project(self, notification: dict) -> ProjectionResult:
        """Project one notification; only ``item/completed`` materializes messages (deltas are display-only)."""
        if notification.get("method", "") != "item/completed":
            return ProjectionResult()
        item = (notification.get("params", {}) or {}).get("item") or {}
        ...
        if item_type == "reasoning":
            self._pending_reasoning.extend(item.get("summary") or [])
            self._pending_reasoning.extend(item.get("content") or [])
            return ProjectionResult()

​投影​器​的​纪律​：​只有​ item/completed ​物化​消息​，​流式​ delta ​只​做​展示​；reasoning ​是​ ​独立​ item，​先​暂存​（stash）​再​挂到​下​一条​ assistant ​消息​上​，​维持​ Hermes ​的​消息​交替​不变​ ​量​（​每个​ item ​至多​产生​一条​ assistant + ​一条​ tool）。​未知​ item ​类型​（plan、hookPrompt…） ​投影​成​不​透明​备注​，​绝不​伪造​ tool_call ​结构​。tool_call id ​用​确定性​哈希​ （_deterministic_call_id，:18），​保证​重放时​前缀​缓存​仍然​命中​。

​会话​适配器​还​做​一层​多路复用​防护​（_notification_belongs_to_turn， codex_app_server_session.py:89）：​一条​连接​可能​同时​承载​父子​ subagent ​的​线程​，​显式​属于​ ​别的​ thread/turn ​的​通知​不许​改动​本​转录​。

docs.title: 5. run_codex_stream ​与​ _CodexResponseAssembler —— HTTP ​流式​路径​（codex_runtime.py:1192）
docs.text:
# agent/codex_runtime.py:1192-1199 + 1211-1214（​节选​）
def run_codex_stream(agent, api_kwargs: dict, client: Any = None, on_first_delta=None):
    """One streaming Responses API request over raw ``responses.create(stream=True)`` events."""
    ...
    active_client = client or agent._ensure_primary_openai_client(reason="codex_stream_direct")
    max_stream_retries, model = 1, api_kwargs.get("model")
    ...
    # Delta-sink claim for the CURRENT physical attempt (None until the stream opens). A newer attempt that
    # claims the sink supersedes this token; that only silences OUR live callbacks — consumption continues,
    # because stopping here handed the gateway a "completed" response missing its tail (#69486).
    writer_token = {"value": None, "raw_stream": None, "superseded_logged": False}

​为什么​不用​ SDK ​的​ responses.stream() ​助手​？:808-811 ​的​注释​给出​了​原因​：SDK ​会​从​ response.completed.response.output ​重建​类型化​ Response，​而​该​字​段​为​ null ​时​直接​崩溃​。 ​所以​ Hermes ​消费​原始​ SSE ​事件​，​从​ output_item.done ​组装​最终​响应​——​终帧​的​ output ​可以​是​ null/[]/​字符串​/​缺席​。_CodexResponseAssembler（:873）​是​有​状态​组装​器​： ​只​从​终帧​读​ usage/status/id/service_tier；​被​ output_item.added ​宣告​但​从未​确认​的​ function call ​从​ delta ​结算​出来​；message_phases ​保证​ commentary ​永远​不​混进​答案​文本​。

​两套​"_current"​令牌​值得​细读​：_request_is_current ​挡​已​退役​请求​的​迟到​帧​； _writer_is_current ​挡​被​更新​尝试​顶替​的​ writer——​注意​后者​只是​让​旧​尝试​闭嘴​， ​消费​照常进行​到底​，​否则​网关​会​拿到​一条​丢​了​尾巴​的​"completed"​响应​（#69486）。

docs.title: 6. codex_headers —— ​身份​、​账户​头​与​压缩​（codex_headers.py:34）
docs.text:
# agent/codex_headers.py:34-51 + 54-63（​节选​）
def codex_cloudflare_headers(access_token: str, *, base_url: str = CODEX_AUX_BASE_URL) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Identity and account headers for chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex.

    OpenAI requires third-party harnesses to identify themselves: the official
    endpoint gets Hermes' originator and version, custom endpoints keep the
    codex_cli_rs compatibility identity. The account headers come from the
    OAuth JWT (see :func:`codex_account_headers`).
    """
    if is_official_codex_base_url(base_url):
        headers = {
            "User-Agent": f"HermesAgent/{get_version_info().base_version}",
            "originator": "hermes-agent",
        }
    else:
        headers = {"User-Agent": "codex_cli_rs/0.0.0 (Hermes Agent)", "originator": "codex_cli_rs"}
    headers.update(codex_account_headers(access_token))
    return headers

​官方​端​点亮​明​ Hermes ​身份​；​自定义​端点​保持​ codex_cli_rs ​兼容​身份​（​第三方​代理​按​ codex ​客户端​白名单​放行​）。codex_account_headers（:54-81）​从​ OAuth JWT ​的​ https://api.openai.com/auth ​声明​里​挖出​ ChatGPT-Account-ID ​与​数据​驻留​头​——​缺​驻留​头​ ​的​驻留​强制​工作​区​直接​ 401 "Workspace is not authorized in this region"。​畸形​ token ​丢弃​ ​头部​而​不​抛​异常​，​让​问题​以​ 401 ​面目​出现​而​不是​构造​期​崩溃​。​另有​ codex_request_compression_hooks（:84-103）：​官方​后端​上​的​ POST /responses ​请求​体做​ zstd ​压缩​（​与​官方​ codex ​客户端​对齐​，​无损​传输​编码​，token ​与​提示​词​缓存​不​受​影响​）。

​模块​定位​也​要​注意​：​它​是​叶子​模块​，​故意​不​依赖​庞大​的​ auxiliary-client ​路由器​——​长寿命​ ​进程​可以​ import ​新增​的​ client builder ​而​不必​从​旧​缓存​的​ auxiliary_client ​模块​解析​新​符号​ （:1-4 docstring）。

docs.title: 7. codex_service_tiers —— ​目录​驱动​的​档位​协商​（codex_service_tiers.py:188）
docs.text:
# agent/codex_service_tiers.py:188-212
def negotiate_request_tier(agent: Any, overrides: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Resolve the current credential on each build without mutating user preference."""
    from agent.codex_headers import is_official_codex_base_url
    requested = overrides.get("service_tier")
    base_url = str(getattr(agent, "base_url", "") or "")
    if (requested not in {"ultrafast", "priority"}
            or getattr(agent, "api_mode", None) != "codex_responses"
            or getattr(agent, "provider", None) != "openai-codex"
            or not is_official_codex_base_url(base_url)):
        return
    token = getattr(agent, "api_key", None)
    if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
        return
    model = overrides.get("model", getattr(agent, "model", ""))
    supported = _tiers_for_model(token, base_url, model)
    if supported is None:
        return
    candidates = ("ultrafast", "priority") if requested == "ultrafast" else ("priority",)
    effective = next((tier for tier in candidates if tier in supported), "default")
    if effective == "default":
        overrides.pop("service_tier", None)  # Codex represents Standard by omission.
    else:
        overrides["service_tier"] = effective

​模块​ docstring（:1-5）​定​了​调​：​未知​的​发现​保留​请求​档位​；​只有​显式​公告​的​档位​清单​才​允许​ ​降级​；​响应​回显​永不​驱动​选择​或​重试​。Daybreak ​反其道​而行​——​只​在​目录​显式​列出​ daybreak_blue ​时才​请求​（apply_daybreak，:143-162，​每​请求​检查​，​模型​切换​/​凭据​轮转​/ ​目录​过期​都​不会​把​ program ​带到​不该​带​的​模型​或​账户​上​）。ULTRAFAST ​则​必须​协商​：​后端会​ ​对​没有​授权​的​计划​静默​按​默认​档​服务​，​所以​官方​客户端​读​的​那个​账户​目录​才​是​权威​ （ultrafast_offered，:165-179）。​三条​规则​同一​动机​：​宁可​保守​，​不可​假装​。

docs.title: 8. codex_responses_adapter —— endpoint quirks ​与​ blob ​签发​者​（codex_responses_adapter.py:23）
docs.text:
# agent/codex_responses_adapter.py:23-48 + 56-62（​节选​）
class ResponsesEndpointQuirks(NamedTuple):
    """Responses wire quirks of the endpoint, from the ``responses_*`` fields of the profile claiming it
    (``providers.profile_for_host``). Defaults are the generic wire."""
    replay_item_ids: bool = True
    prompt_cache_key: bool = True
    issuer_kind: str = ""
    native_compaction: bool = True
    profile_reasoning: bool = False


def responses_endpoint_quirks(base_url: Any) -> ResponsesEndpointQuirks:
    """Quirks for *base_url*; the generic wire when no registered profile claims it (or none is installed).
    Pure function of the URL and the registry, so every turn replays the same bytes for the same history."""
    from providers import profile_for_host
    profile = profile_for_host(str(base_url or ""))
    if profile is None:
        return _GENERIC_ENDPOINT
    return ResponsesEndpointQuirks(
        replay_item_ids=profile.responses_replay_item_ids, prompt_cache_key=profile.responses_prompt_cache_key,
        issuer_kind=profile.responses_issuer_kind, native_compaction=profile.responses_native_compaction,
        profile_reasoning=profile.responses_profile_reasoning,
    )

quirks ​是​ URL ​与​注册表​的​纯​函数​（​同样​的​历史​每​ turn ​重​放出​同样​的​字节​，​缓存​才​不​冷​）。 ​另​一个​关键​概念​是​"​签发​者​"（issuer）：reasoning ​的​ encrypted_content blob ​被​密封​到​签发​ ​它​的​端点​（HTTP 400 invalid_encrypted_content），_classify_responses_issuer（:56-72） ​给​每个​端点​盖​稳定​戳​——​模型​切换​后​重放​才能​把​外来​ blob ​丢掉​。​注释​还​特别​叮嘱​：openai SDK ​会​给​ client.base_url ​加尾​斜杠​、host ​大小写​不​敏感​，​主​传输​与​ aux ​适配器​必须​把​端点​规范化​ ​成同​一种​ kind，​否则​ aux ​调用​会​丢掉​主​循环​铸造​的​每​一个​ blob。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
agent_init._resolve_api_mode ── codex_responses / codex_app_server
        │
        ▼
turn_api_call ─┬─ api_mode=codex_responses ─► transports/codex.py ─► codex_responses_adapter
               │        └─ ​流式​ ─► codex_runtime.run_codex_stream ─► _CodexResponseAssembler
               └─ api_mode=codex_app_server ─► codex_runtime.run_codex_app_server_turn
                        └─► transports/codex_app_server(_session) ─► codex_event_projector
  • ​凭据​：Codex OAuth token ​的​解析​/​轮转​住​在​ credential_pool.py ​与​ anthropic_credentials.py ​平行​的​凭据​层​（​见​ credentials_rate.md）；_finalize_routing ​里​ GPT-5.x ​自动​升​ Responses ​的​判定​在​ agent_init.py:379-401。
  • ​回退​：​子​进程​路径​失败​时​ turn_recovery.activate_codex_app_server_fallback （turn_recovery.py ​家族​）​激活​回退​；​错误​分类​走​ agent/error_classifier。
  • ​审批​：tools.terminal_tool ​的​审批​回调​与​ tools.approval ​的​ bypass ​判定​在​此​桥接​； codex ​自带​工具​（terminal/file/search）​不进​ Hermes ​的​工具​面​。
  • MCP：hermes_tools_mcp_server.py ​把​ Hermes ​侧​工具​暴露​给​ codex ​子​进程​ （​见​ model_providers.md §6）。
  • ​辅助​调用​：aux ​侧​的​ Responses ​适配​在​ auxiliary_codex_response.py；prompt_cache_key ​的​共享​哈希​让​ aux ​与​主​传输​命中​同一​缓存​桶​（transports/chat_completions.py:101）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​两种​ codex ​形态​：HTTP Responses（Hermes ​拥有​ loop）​与​ codex_app_server （codex ​拥有​ loop，Hermes ​投影​事件​、​管​审批​、​拼接​转录​）。​后者​返回值​刻意​对齐​ chat_completions ​的​结果​形状​，​上游​无感​。
  • ​线程​是​模型​侧​资产​：​合成​漂移​退役​、​只有​首个​会话​ resume、​绑定​只​在​转录​落库​后​发布​、 ​退役​线程​永不​发布​；fresh ​线程​用​ 32k ​保尾​的​历史​种子​补课​，​不许​失忆​。
  • ​投影​有​纪律​：​只​物化​ item/completed、reasoning stash ​到​下​一条​ assistant、 ​每个​至多​一条​ assistant+​一条​ tool、​未知​类型​不​伪造​结构​、​确定性​ call id ​保​缓存​。
  • ​流式​防御​成​对​出现​：​退役​请求​的​迟到​帧​（fenced）​与​被​顶替​ writer ​的​帧​（superseded） ​分别​隔离​；superseded ​只​静音​不​中断​——​消费​到​完成​，​尾巴​不能​丢​（#69486）。
  • ​身份​与​档位​都​向​"​权威​目录​"​看齐​：​官方​端​点亮​ Hermes ​身份​、​自定义​端点​保持​ codex ​兼容​； service_tier ​只有​显式​公告​才​降级​、Daybreak ​只​在​目录​列出​才​请求​、​响应​回显​永不​驱动​决策​。
  • endpoint quirks ​是​纯​函数​：URL+​注册表​决定​线形​怪癖​与​ blob ​签发​者​，​保证​同样​历史​ ​每次​重​放出​同样​字节​。

docs.title: 上下文​压缩​引擎​（agent/ ​压缩​子系统​）
文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​的​上下文​压缩​是​一个​横跨​约​ 40 ​个​文件​的​子系统​，​但​职责​划分​非常​清晰​：

  • ​引擎​本体​ context_compressor.py（5,725 ​行​）：ContextCompressor —— ​默认​的​ ContextEngine ​实现​。​五步​算法​：​无​ LLM ​剪枝​旧​工具​结果​ → ​选​边界​ → ​保护​头尾​ → ​用​辅助​压缩​模型​迭代​摘要​中段​ → ​组装​回写​。​文件​本体​只是​一个​ mixin ​装配​点​，​每个​阶段​ ​拆​在​ context_compressor_*.py ​兄弟​模块​里​。
  • ​编排​层​ conversation_compression.py（4,410 ​行​）：​可行性​探针​、​警告​回放​、 commit-fence ​发布​（​超过​ host timeout ​的​工作​被​丢弃​，​绝不​租约​外​提交​）、​在​池化​ daemon ​线程​上​对​私有​深​快照​运行​。​宿主​侧​包装​在​ compression_facade.py:: CompressionFacadeMixin._compress_context；​手动​入口​ conversation_compression_manual.py:: compress_now（CLI / ​网关​ / TUI / ACP ​所有​表面​的​ /compress ​共用​）。
  • ​触发​层​ turn_context_compaction.py / turn_preflight.py / turn_overflow.py： ​把​压缩​挂进​ turn ​循环​的​五个​时机​。
  • ​特殊​路径​ native_compaction.py、conversation_compression_codex.py（provider ​原生​ Responses/Codex ​压缩​）、micro_compaction.py（​滚动​逐轮​摘要​，​默认​关闭​）、 prepared_compaction.py（​后台​预备​摘要​）。

docs.title: 1. ​引擎​ = ​七个​ mixin ​的​装配
docs.text:
ContextCompressor ​本体​不​含​算法​细节​，​只​做​装配​和​会​话​状态​管理​。MRO ​顺序​即​阶段​顺序​：

# agent/context_compressor.py:2138
class ContextCompressor(
    SummaryDispatchMixin, PreLlmSkipMixin, CompressionTelemetryMixin, MicroCompactionMixin,
    ProactivePruneMixin, CompactionWindowMixin, ContextEngine,
):
    """Default context engine: prune tool results, protect head/tail, summarize the middle
    with an LLM, and iteratively update the previous summary on later compactions."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "compressor"

mixin ​到​文件​的​映射​：

ContextCompressor (context_compressor.py, ​装配​ + compress ​主流程​)
├── SummaryDispatchMixin        ← context_compressor_summary.py   ​摘要​ LLM ​调度​/​重试​/​回退​
├── PreLlmSkipMixin             ← context_compressor_prellm.py    ​摘要​前​的​可行性​跳过​
├── CompressionTelemetryMixin   ← context_compressor_telemetry.py ​遥测​/​结构化​ no-op
├── MicroCompactionMixin        ← micro_compaction.py             ​滚动​逐轮​摘要​（​默认​关​）
├── ProactivePruneMixin         ← context_compressor_prune.py     ​无​ LLM ​剪枝​旧​工具​结果​
├── CompactionWindowMixin       ← context_compressor_window.py    ​边界​选择​ + ​头尾​保护​
└── ContextEngine               ← context_engine.py               ​引擎​基类​/​接口​

ContextEngine ​基类​（context_engine.py）​定义​ threshold_percent: float = 0.75 ​这样​的​接口​默认值​，​真正​的​默认​来自​配置​ compression.threshold（​见下文​）。

docs.title: 2. ​五步​算法​：compress()
docs.text:
​主流程​只有​一个​入口​。​注意​它​是​「​先​剪枝​、​再选​窗​、​后​摘要​」​的​流水线​，​任何​一步​失败​都​ ​返回​未​裁剪​的​ canonical_messages —— ​历史​永不​因​压缩​失败​而​丢失​：

# agent/context_compressor.py:5422（​节选​）
def compress(
    self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], current_tokens: Optional[int] = None, focus_topic: Optional[str] = None,
    force: bool = False, memory_context: str = "", bypass_cooldown: bool = False,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Summarize the middle turns: prune tool-result bodies (tool-call args untouched), protect head and a
    token-budget tail from the pruned copy, summarize, then clean orphaned tool pairs."""
    from agent.conversation_compression import _raise_if_stale_attempt

    _raise_if_stale_attempt(self)                       # ​过期​尝试​连​状态​都​不许​重置​
    telemetry = self._begin_compress_attempt(current_tokens, force)
    n_messages = len(messages)
    _min_for_compress = self._protect_head_size(messages) + 3 + 1
    if n_messages <= _min_for_compress:                 # ​消息​太​少​ → ​结构性​ no-op
        self._structural_no_op_result(telemetry, "insufficient_messages", ...)
        return messages
    ...
    canonical_messages = self._drop_blank_echoes(messages)      # ​无损​副本​：no-op/​中止​时​返回​它​
    # ​阶段​ 1-2：​剪枝​（​无​ LLM）+ ​选​边界​
    messages, pruned_count, compress_start, compress_end = self._plan_compaction_window(messages)
    ...
    # ​阶段​ 3：​结构化​摘要​（​可行​才​调​ LLM）
    feasibility_skip = not (force or prepared) and (...)
    summary = self._summarize_window(messages, turns_to_summarize, scan, focus_topic, memory_context, bypass_cooldown)
    if not summary:
        summary = self._fallback_summary_for_window(...)        # ​确定性​回退​摘要​
    # ​阶段​ 4：​组装​；​之后​ _finalize_compressed ​清理​孤儿​工具​对​
    compressed = self._assemble_compressed(messages, compress_start, compress_end, scan, summary)
    return self._finalize_compressed(compressed, canonical_messages, n_messages, spare_pending_images, pruned_count)

​三处​「​失败​即​无损​」​的​设计​值得注意​：canonical_messages ​是​未​剪枝​副本​； _structural_no_op_result ​把​「​没有​可压缩​窗口​」「​消息​太​少​」​这​类​结构性​跳过​记入​ ​遥测​而​非​报错​；​摘要​失败​时​走​ _fallback_summary_for_window ​生成​确定性​骨架​摘要​， ​而​不是​把​对话​砍掉​。

docs.title: 3. ​阈值​：50% ​解析​窗口​ + ​小​窗口​只升​不降​地板
docs.text:
​默认​阈值​是​配置​ compression.threshold: 0.50（​相对​解析​后​的​上下文​窗口​； hermes_cli/config_defaults.py:575）。​每个​模型​可用​ model_thresholds ​子串​覆盖​， ​最长​匹配​（provider ​作用域​优先​）​获胜​：

# agent/context_compressor.py:2039
def resolve_model_threshold(
    model: str, model_thresholds: dict[str, float] | None, default: float, provider: str = "",
) -> float:
    """Per-model threshold: longest matching ``model_thresholds`` key wins, else ``default``."""
    if not model_thresholds or not model:
        return default
    provider = (provider or "").strip().lower()
    ranked = ((_model_threshold_key_rank(key, model, provider), key) for key in model_thresholds)
    best = max(((rank, key) for rank, key in ranked if rank is not None), default=None)
    return float(model_thresholds[best[1]]) if best else default

​小​窗口​模型​（< 512K）​有​一个​只升​不降​的​地板​ —— 50% ​对​小​窗口​意味着​几乎​从不​触发​ （provider ​会先​拒绝请求​），​所以​地板​抬到​ 75%：

# agent/context_compressor.py:2752
@staticmethod
def _effective_threshold_percent(context_length: int, threshold_percent: float) -> float:
    """Raise-only small-context threshold floor: models under 512K trigger at >= 75%."""
    if context_length and context_length < _SMALL_CTX_WINDOW_LIMIT:      # 512_000 (​行​ 1151)
        return max(threshold_percent, _SMALL_CTX_THRESHOLD_PERCENT)      # 0.75   (​行​ 1152)
    return threshold_percent

docs.title: 4. ​触发​点​全图​（5 ​处​ + 1 ​处​网关​兜底​）
docs.text:
turn ​循环​内​的​ 5 ​个​压缩​时机​                          ​宿主​/​网关​侧​
────────────────────────────────────────────      ──────────────────────────────
① turn ​开始​    run_turn_start_compaction          ⑥ ​宿主​侧​包装​
   (turn_context_compaction.py:129)                CompressionFacadeMixin
   ​空闲​触发​ → ​预检​ token ​阈值​ →                       ._compress_context
   ​未​压缩​会话​溢出​警告​重​整备​                           (compression_facade.py)
        │
② ​预​ API ​门​    turn_preflight.py +                ⑦ ​手动​入口​（​所有​表面​）
   turn_preflight_gate.py                          /compress → compress_now
   ​请求​发出​前量​压​，​超​阈值​则​压缩​；                      (conversation_compression_
   ​工具​轮后​的​压缩​也​在​这里​                               manual.py:69)
        │
③ ​响应​式​恢复​   turn_overflow.py::recover_from_overflow
   provider ​溢出​/413 ​分类​命中​后​压缩​重试​
        │
④ ​手动​ /compress（​同​⑦）
⑤ ​网关​会话​卫生​兜底​  gateway/run_turn_hygiene.py —— 85% ​阈值​

​预​ API ​门​的​尝试​预算​来自​ max_compression_attempts（​默认​ 3）：

# agent/turn_context_compaction.py:382
_max_preflight_passes = max(1, int(getattr(agent, "max_compression_attempts", 3) or 3))

​网关​卫生​兜底​刻意​高于​ agent ​压缩​阈值​（85% vs 50%），​注释​写明​它​是​安全网​：

# gateway/run_turn_hygiene.py:97（​节选​）
# The 0.85 threshold is deliberately HIGHER than the agent's compressor (0.50): a safety net

docs.title: 5. ​编排​契约​：​快照​ + commit fence
docs.text:
conversation_compression.py ​的​模块​ docstring ​就是​整个​并发​模型​的​契约​：

# agent/conversation_compression.py:1
"""Context compression: feasibility probe, warning replay, compress, image fix.

Thread-safety contract for extension points: with ``compression.context_timeout_seconds > 0`` (default) the
whole pass, context engines and memory providers included, runs on a pooled daemon thread. Calls may arrive
on any pooled thread (never rely on thread-affinity/locals); the message list is a private deep snapshot
(in-place mutation is invisible to the live conversation unless the pass commits); state is published ONLY
on an admitted :class:`CompressionCommitFence` commit (work still running after a host timeout is discarded);
one pass per session at a time (durable lock) but sessions run concurrently, so shared engines must be thread-safe.
"""

commit fence ​让​「​超时​的​ worker ​线程​无法​被​杀死​」​这一​事实​变得​确定性​可控​：

# agent/conversation_compression.py:458
class CompressionCommitFence:
    """Fence timeout cancellation against post-summary session mutation.
    The sync worker thread cannot be killed; the fence makes the commit boundary deterministic: cancellation
    wins before mutation starts, or waits for an already-started commit to finish completely."""

​也就是说​：host ​放弃​等待​后​，​工作​线程​若​还​没​开始​提交​ → ​取消​生效​，​结果​丢弃​； ​若​提交​已​开始​ → host ​等​它​完整​落盘​。​绝不​存在​「​半个​压缩​结果​写​进会话​」​的​中间​态​。 ​这​是​把​「​压缩​是​对​历史​的​唯一​合法​变更​」​这条​不​变量​在​并发​下​兜住​的​关键​。

docs.title: 6. ​为什么​ micro_compaction ​默认​关闭
docs.text:
​滚动​逐轮​摘要​每​走​一轮​都​会​改写​ prompt ​前缀​ —— ​这​直接​违反​「​每会话​ prompt ​缓存​神圣​」 ​不​变量​，​所以​默认​关​、​只​在​用户​显式​开启​时​工作​：

# agent/micro_compaction.py:1
"""Micro-compaction mixin for ContextCompressor.

Rolling per-exchange summarization that folds old user/assistant exchanges into a single
summary marker between turns. OFF by default: every pass rewrites the prompt prefix and
breaks the provider prompt cache.
"""

​对比​之下​，​主​压缩​路径​（​批量​摘要​）​一次性​替换​历史​，​前缀​只​破坏​一次​，​且​立即​用​ register_stable_prefix / ​重建​系统​提示​把​缓存​重新​热​起来​。

docs.title: 7. ​手动​入口​是​唯一​被​认可​的​历史​变更
docs.text:
​四个​表面​（CLI/​网关​/TUI/ACP）​共用​同一个​核心​，​避免​各写​一份​ flag ​解析​和​措辞​：

# agent/conversation_compression_manual.py:1（​节选​）
"""Manual ``/compress`` core shared by the CLI, gateway, TUI and ACP surfaces.

Manual compression is the ONE sanctioned history mutation (prompt-cache invariant): each surface parses
its own flags and renders its own text, but the sequence — split for ``here [N]``, estimate, run
``agent._compress_context(force=True)``, detect a lock-skip, rejoin the verbatim tail, summarize — lives
here so ``--preview`` / ``--aggressive`` and the lock-skip wording cannot drift per surface again.
"""

force=True ​会​清掉​摘要​失败​冷却​并​绕过​可行性​跳过​ —— ​用户​显式​请求​总是​走​完整​路径​； ​自动​压缩​调用​方​永远​传​ False。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/turn_pipeline / conversation_loop：​五处​触发​点​全部​挂​在​ turn ​循环​上​， ​细节​见​ 02_core/turn_pipeline.md；​错误​恢复​分支​（turn_recovery.py）​在​ FailoverReason.context_overflow ​命中​后​把​控制权​交给​ turn_overflow.py。
  • agent/prompt_caching：​压缩​改写​历史​ = ​缓存​前缀​失效​，​所以​压缩​谱系​根​ （prompt_cache_scope.py::conversation_id）​与​ prompt_refresh.py ​的​ epoch ​机制​ ​都​围绕​压缩​设计​；​见​本组​ prompt_caching.md。
  • gateway/run_turn_hygiene.py：85% ​会话​卫生​兜底​，​复用​同一​压缩​编排​但​独立​于​ agent ​阈值​（​安全网​定位​）。
  • hermes_state（SessionDB）：​压缩​谱系​、​归档​水位​、checkpoint ​都​落​在​状态​库​； session_db.get_compression_lineage ​同时​是​缓存​作用域​的​数据源​。
  • ​配置​：compression.threshold / threshold_tokens / target_ratio / context_timeout_seconds / model_thresholds / max_compression_attempts， ​默认值​在​ hermes_cli/config_defaults.py ​的​ compression ​段​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​压缩​子系统​的​设计​可以​压缩成​三句话​：​算法​上​先​做​无​ LLM ​的​便宜​事​（​剪枝​、​选窗​、 ​保护​头尾​），​最后​才​花钱​调​辅助​模型​摘要​中段​，​且​摘要​失败​时​历史​保持​无损​； ​并发​上​一切​在​私有​深​快照​上​运行​，​只有​通过​ commit fence ​的​提交​才​对​活会话​可见​， ​超时​的​工作​被​整体​丢弃​；​生态​上​默认​阈值​ 50%（​小​窗口​抬到​ 75%），​网关​ 85% ​兜底​， ​每​ turn ​最​多​尝试​ max_compression_attempts（3）​次​，micro-compaction ​因​破坏​缓存​ ​前缀​而​默认​关闭​。​阅读​顺序​建议​：​先​ compress() ​主流程​，​再​按​ mixin ​进入​各​阶段​， ​最后​读​ conversation_compression.py ​顶部​的​并发​契约​ —— ​它​是​理解​其余​ 30 ​个​文件​的​钥匙​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
agent/conversation_loop.py（1,967 ​行​）​是​ Hermes ​整个​ Agent ​的​心脏​：​一个​用户​消息​进来​之后​， "​调​模型​ → ​解析​响应​ → ​执行​工具​ → ​把​工具​结果​喂​回去​ → ​再调​模型​……"​直到​模型​给出​最终​文字​回答​， ​这​整台​发动机​就​装​在​这个​文件​里​。​它​原本​是​ run_agent.py ​里​ AIAgent ​的​几千​行​内联​ while ​循环​， ​后来​被​抽成​独立​模块​；​函数​签名​都​带​一个​ agent ​参数​——​不是​类​方法​，​而是​"​把​ AIAgent ​实例​当​ ​上下文​对象​传​进来​"​的​普通​函数​（​模块​ docstring，agent/conversation_loop.py:1-6）。

​文件​顶部​有​一句​关键​设计说明​（:43-44）：Phase helpers of the turn loop, bound at import so a source-tree swap cannot load a skewed phase mid-turn——turn ​循环​的​各​阶段​助手​在​ import ​时​就​ ​绑定​好​，​源码​树热​替换​不​可能​让​一轮​ turn ​中途​换​实现​。

​一个​ turn（​一轮​用户​对话​）​分​两层​：run_conversation（​外层​信封​）​套​着​ _run_conversation_turn （​真正​的​循环体​）。​整条​链路​完全​同步​（​没有​ async/await），​只​在​真正​发起​ HTTP ​请求​时借​一个​ worker ​线程​，​以便​用户​随时​可以​打断​（interrupt）。
