docs.title: 2. run_conversation：turn ​的​外层​信封​（:1808）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1825-1831（docstring）
    """Run one turn (see ``_run_conversation_turn``) and export the current-turn boundary.

    Every envelope that leaves the loop — success, partial/error, interrupt, retry-exhausted,
    tool-limit, preflight timeout, codex runtime — passes through here, so the
    ``{turn_id, current_turn_user_idx}`` pair is stamped beside the exact ``messages`` it
    addresses, after every history rewrite including post-turn micro-compaction."""

docstring ​说​得​直白​：​所有​离开​循环​的​信封​（​成功​、​部分​失败​、​中断​、​重试​耗尽​、​工具​上限​、 preflight ​超时​、codex ​运行​时​）​都​要​路过​这里​——​因为​要​在​"​最后​一刻​"（​所有​历史​改写​都​完成​后​） ​给​结果​盖​ {turn_id, current_turn_user_idx} ​印章​。​主体​三步​（:1838-1866）：

# agent/conversation_loop.py:1838-1866（​节选​）
    agent._turn_user_intervened = False          # steer/​重定向​/​中断​会置位​，​结果​里​上报​
    with native_turn_images(user_message):
        try:
            result = _run_conversation_turn(...)  # ← ​真正​的​循环​
        finally:
            end_voice_turn_route(agent)           # ​语音​路由​必​回退​，​即使​抛​异常​
    settle_held_final(agent, result)              # hold_stream ​持扣​的​最终​回答​落地​
    result = export_current_turn_boundary(agent, result, user_message)
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result["user_intervened"] = bool(getattr(agent, "_turn_user_intervened", False))
    _close_durable_failed_turn(agent, result)     # ​失败​ turn ​的​持久​化​收口​
    return result

_close_durable_failed_turn（:1914）​值得​单独​一提​：​失败​的​ turn ​若​什么​都​没​留下​， ​持久​化​尾巴​会​停​在​裸​ user ​行​或​裸​ tool ​行上​，​下​一个​ prompt ​追加​第二条​ user ​行​就​违反​ ​角色​交替​。​它​在​ SessionDB ​尾部​补​一条​ Hermes ​署名​的​ assistant ​边界​行​，​并​刻意​排除​ ​上下文​压力​类​失败​（compression_exhausted ​等​）——​往​已经​超限​的​会​话​里​继续​追加​，​正是​ ​历史​ issue #1630 ​那个​"​越压​越大​"​的​死循环​。

docs.title: 3. _run_conversation_turn ​的​前半段​：​赛前​准备​（:1646-1748）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1673-1682（​节选​）
    if moa_config is None:
        user_message, moa_config, persist_user_message = _decode_inline_moa_turn(
            user_message, persist_user_message)
    # The gateway caches agents across turns; compression state is per-turn, or a stale
    # in-place boundary would make a later uncompressed result look compacted.
    agent._last_compaction_in_place = agent._last_compression_attempt_recorded = False

​第一​，​用户​消息​里​若​编码​了​ MoA（​多​模型​混合​）​预设​先​解码​；​第二​，​压缩​状态​是​ per-turn ​的​—— ​网关​会​缓存​ AIAgent ​跨​ turn ​复用​，​不​重置​的话​上​一轮​的​"​原地​压缩​边界​"​会​污染​下​一轮​的​判断​。 ​这​正是​根​ AGENTS.md"​一个​进程​服务​多个​ turn，​任何​跨​ turn ​状态​泄漏​都​是​ bug"​的​具体​体现​。

​接着​是​重头戏​ build_turn_context（:1699-1717）：​一次性​赛前​准备​（​系统​提示​词​恢复​或​重建​、 ​用户​消息​入列​、​三遍​ turn ​起始​压缩​、​插件​ pre_llm_call ​钩子​、​内存​预取​……），​返回​ TurnContext ​数据​类​。​它​传入​了​一堆​函数​引用​（restore_or_build_system_prompt=...、 ra=_ra ​等​，:1706-1712）——​为了​避免​循环​ import：turn_context ​不能​模块​级​ import conversation_loop，​回调​从​调用​方传​进去​。PreflightCompressionTimedOut（:1718-1719）​是​ ​唯一​专门​异常​出口​：turn ​起始​ preflight ​压缩​超时​就​直接​返回​类型化​失败​结果​，​循环​都​不进​。

docs.title: 4. _LoopState：​把​循环​局部变量​装进​一个​数据​类​（:1460）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1460-1468
@dataclass
class _LoopState:
    """Every local the turn loop threads through the phase helpers in ``agent/turn_*.py``.

    Helpers take the loop locals they need as keyword arguments named like these fields and
    return a verdict whose non-``action``/``result`` fields carry the same names;
    :func:`_run_phase` passes and copies them back by name, so a new helper input/output
    needs a field here and nothing else. Per-iteration slots are rebound by the phases
    before any later phase reads them, exactly as the former inline locals were."""

docstring ​就是​设计​文档​，​翻译成​三句话​：

  1. turn ​循环​里​每​一个​要​穿过​阶段​助手​的​局部变量​，​都​是​ _LoopState ​的​一个​字​段​（:1470-1540）；
  2. ​阶段​助手​用​与​字​段​同名​的​关键字​参数​接收​它们​，​返回​ verdict，verdict ​上除​ action/result ​外​的​字​段​也​叫​同样​的​名字​；
  3. _run_phase ​按​名字​传参​、​按​名字​回​拷​——​给​某个​阶段​加​输入​/​输出​ = ​只加​一个​字​段​， ​别的​什么​都​不用​改​。

​字段​按​生命周期​分​三组​：

​组​ ​代表​字​段​ ​含义​ ​整个​ turn ​固定​ user_message、system_message、conversation_history、turn_id ​进​ turn ​时​确定​，​之后​只读​ turn ​级​可变​ messages、active_system_prompt、api_call_count、final_response、compression_attempts、restart_count ​循环​过程​中​被​各​阶段​改写​ ​单次​迭代​槽​位​ api_messages、tools_for_api、response、api_kwargs、retry_count、finish_reason、assistant_message ​每次​迭代​开始​前​重新​赋值​

restart_count（:1496-1502）​的​注释​解释​了​一个​坑​：retry_count ​每次​迭代​清零​，​但​ "​重定向​重启​"​和​"fallback ​重建​"​这类​会​退还​迭代​预算​的​重启​不能​无限​刷​——​需要​一个​跨​迭代​ ​存活​的​计数器​兜底​，​防止​失控​的​重启​循环​一直​白​嫖​预算​、​一直​占​着​ turn ​租约​。

docs.title: 5. _run_phase：​按​参数​名传参​、​回​拷​的​魔法​胶水​（:1556）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1549-1574
# Keyword names each phase helper takes (minus ``agent``), cached per function object.
_PHASE_PARAMS: dict[Any, tuple] = {}
# Verdict fields the loop latches (only ever sets True) instead of copying back:
# ``handle_api_error`` reports overflow recovery per call and must not clear an earlier arm.
_LATCHED_VERDICT_FIELDS = {"handle_api_error": frozenset({"_provider_overflow_recovery_pending"})}


def _run_phase(fn, agent, state: _LoopState, **extra):
    """Call phase helper ``fn`` with the loop locals it names, copy its verdict fields back.

    ``extra`` supplies non-state arguments (the caught exception). Returns the verdict so
    the caller can act on ``.action`` / ``.result``."""
    params = _PHASE_PARAMS.get(fn)
    if params is None:
        params = _PHASE_PARAMS[fn] = tuple(p for p in inspect.signature(fn).parameters if p != "agent")
    verdict = fn(agent, **{n: extra[n] if n in extra else getattr(state, n) for n in params})
    latched = _LATCHED_VERDICT_FIELDS.get(getattr(fn, "__name__", ""), ())
    for f in fields(verdict):
        if f.name in ("action", "result"):
            continue
        value = getattr(verdict, f.name)
        if f.name not in latched:
            setattr(state, f.name, value)
        elif value:
            setattr(state, f.name, True)
    return verdict

​逐行​拆解​：

  • ​第一次​调用​时用​ inspect.signature ​缓存​形参名​（_PHASE_PARAMS）；
  • ​调用​时​从​ state ​按名​取值​：extra ​传​ state ​之外​的​东西​——​最​典型​是​ except ​捕到​的​ ​异常​（_run_phase(handle_api_error, agent, s, api_error=api_error)）；
  • ​调完​把​ verdict ​上除​ action/result ​外​的​所有​字段​按名​拷回​ state——​阶段​函数​改了​ retry_count，​主​循环​的​ s.retry_count ​立刻​同步​；
  • _LATCHED_VERDICT_FIELDS ​是​特例​：handle_api_error ​每次​都​报告​"​是否​进入​ overflow ​恢复​"，​直接​回​拷​的话​一次​ False ​会​熄掉​之前​点亮​灯​。​所以​这类​字​段​只许​置​ True（​闩​锁​）， ​不许​被​ False ​回​拷​清零​。
        _LoopState (s)
             │ ​按名​取值​
             ▼
  _run_phase(fn, agent, s) ──► fn(agent, retry_count=s.retry_count, messages=s.messages, ...)
             ▲                          │
             │ verdict ​字段​按名​回​拷​       ▼
        _LoopState (s) ​已​更新​ ◄────── verdict（​含​ action/result）

docs.title: 6. verdict ​的​四种​ action
docs.text:
​每个​阶段​函数​返回​带​ action ​字段​的​ verdict，​语义​全​项目​统一​：

action ​含义​ ​主​循环​的​对应​动作​ fallthrough ​正常​走​完​，​继续​下一阶段​ ​顺序​往​下​ return turn ​结束​，result ​是​最终​结果​ dict return _xx.result break ​跳出​当前​循环​（​内层​ break ​交给​外层​；​主​循环​ break ​去​ finalize） break continue ​本​迭代​结束​，​重开​下​一​迭代​ continue

​主​循环​里​这种​模式​反复​出现​：

# agent/conversation_loop.py:1754-1764
        if _run_phase(begin_iteration, agent, s).action == "break":
            break
        _run_phase(prepare_iteration, agent, s)
        _run_phase(assemble_api_request, agent, s)
        _pg = _run_phase(run_preflight_gate, agent, s)
        if _pg.action == "return":
            return _pg.result
        if _pg.action == "break":
            break
        if _pg.action == "continue":
            continue

prepare_iteration ​和​ assemble_api_request ​连​ verdict ​都​不接​——AssembledRequest ​的​ action ​恒为​ "fallthrough"（agent/turn_request_assembly.py:24-28 docstring）。

docs.title: 7. ​主​ WHILE ​循环​本体​（:1748-1798）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1751-1753
    while _prelude_action != "break" and (
        (s.api_call_count < agent.max_iterations and agent.iteration_budget.remaining > 0) or agent._budget_grace_call
    ):

​循环​条件​两半​：api_call_count < max_iterations（​上限​默认​ sys.maxsize ​即不限​， run_agent.py:241）+ iteration_budget.remaining > 0（​线程​安全​预算​，​父子​ Agent ​共享​ ​同一​实例​，agent/iteration_budget.py:25）；or agent._budget_grace_call ​是​宽限​调用​—— ​预算​耗尽​后​允许​模型​多调​一次​产出​体面​总结​，flag ​在​ begin_iteration ​里​被​消费​ （agent/turn_iteration_prep.py:408-416），​用​完即​清​，​循环​随即​退出​。

​循环体​最后​是​"​分流​到​工具​轮​还是​文本​收尾​"：

# agent/conversation_loop.py:1781-1798
        try:
            _ri = _run_phase(normalize_model_response, agent, s)
            if _ri.action == "return":
                return _ri.result
            if _ri.action == "continue":
                continue
            _v = _run_phase(
                run_tool_round if s.assistant_message.tool_calls else finish_text_response, agent, s
            )
            if _v.action == "return":
                return _v.result
            if _v.action == "break":
                break
            if _v.action == "continue":
                continue
        except Exception as e:
            if _run_phase(handle_outer_loop_error, agent, s, e=e).action == "break":
                break

_run_phase ​的​第一个​参数​是​条件​选出​的​函数​：​有​ tool_calls ​进​工具​轮​，​否则​文本​收尾​； ​两个​阶段​的​ verdict ​接口​一致​，​主​循环​不​关心​里面​是​哪种​。​最​外层​ except ​兜住​漏出​的​异常​交给​ handle_outer_loop_error（agent/turn_loop_errors.py:35）：​区分​"​解释器​关闭​"（​立即​放弃​）、 "​确定性​本地​ bug"（traceback ​只有​本地​模块​、​无​ API ​模块​，​不​值得​重试​， agent/conversation_loop.py:229-235），​以及​每​ turn ​最​多​ 8 ​次​外层​异常​ （_MAX_OUTER_LOOP_ERRORS = 8，:239——​只有​逃出​内层​重试​机制​的​异常​才​计数​，8 ​次​够用​）。

docs.title: 8. _run_api_retry_loop：​内层​重试​循环​（:1577）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1577-1606
def _run_api_retry_loop(agent, s: _LoopState) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
    """One API call with its retry/recovery loop (guard → build → call → check, error handlers).

    Returns a turn result dict when a phase ends the turn, else None once the loop is left
    (success, a restart armed on ``s._retry``, interrupt, or retries exhausted)."""
    while s.retry_count < s.max_retries:
        _ng = _run_phase(nous_rate_limit_guard, agent, s)
        if _ng.action == "return":
            return _ng.result
        if _ng.action == "break":
            return None
        try:
            _run_phase(build_api_request, agent, s)
            if _run_phase(perform_api_call, agent, s).action == "break":
                return None
            _rc = _run_phase(check_api_response, agent, s)
            if _rc.action == "return":
                return _rc.result
            if _rc.action == "break":
                return None
        except InterruptedError:
            if _run_phase(handle_api_interrupt, agent, s).action == "break":
                return None
        except Exception as api_error:
            _ae = _run_phase(handle_api_error, agent, s, api_error=api_error)
            if _ae.action == "return":
                return _ae.result
            if _ae.action == "break":
                return None
    return None

​这是​"​一次​成功​的​模型​调用​"​的​完整​生命周期​：​限流​守卫​ → ​请求​构建​ → ​真​调用​ → ​响应​校验​ ​加​两个​异常​分支​。​内层​怎么​"​重试​"？​关键​在​ handle_api_error ​的​就​地​修复​语义​：​它​跑​一轮​ ​一次性​恢复​链​（OAuth ​刷新​、thinking ​签名​重试​、429 ​退避​、​凭据​轮换​、​激活​ fallback ​链​……）， ​守卫​记录​在​ TurnRetryState（agent/turn_retry_state.py:9，​每​守卫​只​触发​一次​）， restart_with_* ​信号​让​外层​重建​再试​；​修复​成功​则​ retry_count ​不涨​重跑​ build → call → check，​手段​用尽​时​ settle_unrecovered_error （agent/turn_api_error.py:266）​给​终局​。

perform_api_call（agent/turn_api_call.py:154-163）​处理​一个​精妙​的​并发​场景​：

# agent/turn_api_call.py:154-162（​节选​）
    if _redirect_crossed_response:
        # Response and redirect can cross threads: discard the now-stale
        # response and rebuild from the correction rather than lose it.
        thinking_spinner = stop_thinking_spinner(agent, thinking_spinner)
        if agent.clear_interrupt(preserve_redirect=True):
            _retry.restart_with_redirected_messages = True
        else:
            interrupted = True
        return _verdict("break")

​用户​在​模型​响应​返回​的​同​一瞬间​发起​重定向​：​响应​与​重定向​跨​线程​竞争​。​代码​选择​丢弃​过时​ ​响应​、​从​用户​纠正​出发​重建​——​宁可​重算​，​不​丢​用户​输入​。

docs.title: 9. ​循环​之后​：finalize ​与​压缩​超时​特判​（:1800-1805）
docs.text:
# agent/conversation_loop.py:1800-1805
    result = _finalize_from_state(agent, s)
    if s._compression_timeout_exhausted:
        # Reuse the gateway's context-recovery contract: transcript stays intact while
        # future input can move to a clean session (#98722).
        result.update(error=_COMPRESSION_TIMEOUT_FINAL_RESPONSE, partial=True, compression_exhausted=True)
    return result

_finalize_from_state（:1609-1614）​把​ state ​字段​按​ finalize_turn ​形参名​一把​喂​进去​ （​又​是​按名​传参​模式​）。​若​压缩​耗尽​主机​超时​（#98722），​复用​网关​的​上下文​恢复​契约​： transcript ​原样​保留​、​结果​标​ compression_exhausted，​让​用户​知道​该​开新会​话​或​修​ auxiliary.compression ​配置​，​而​不是​对​着​永远​发​不​出去​的​请求​干瞪眼​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 符号​ ​职责​ ​位置​ run_conversation turn ​外层​信封​：​导出​边界​、​关闭​失败​ turn agent/conversation_loop.py:1808 _run_conversation_turn ​真正​的​循环体​：​赛前​准备​ → ​主​ WHILE → finalize agent/conversation_loop.py:1646 _LoopState ​循环​全部​贯穿​局部变量​（​新增​阶段​ IO = ​加​一个​字​段​） agent/conversation_loop.py:1460 _run_phase ​按​参数​名​取值​调用​阶段​函数​、verdict ​字段​按名​回​拷​ agent/conversation_loop.py:1556 _run_api_retry_loop ​内层​重试​循环​：guard→build→call→check+​异常​处理​ agent/conversation_loop.py:1577 _finalize_from_state ​把​ state ​喂给​ finalize_turn（​按形​参名​） agent/conversation_loop.py:1609 _turn_without_loop pre_llm_call ​否决​ / codex_app_server ​的​旁路​出口​ agent/conversation_loop.py:1617 _apply_active_turn_redirect ​重定向​：​追加​ role ​安全​的​检查点​+​用户​纠正​行​ agent/conversation_loop.py:324 _close_durable_failed_turn ​失败​ turn ​收口​（​补​ assistant ​边界​行​） agent/conversation_loop.py:1914 _maybe_inject_run_budget_wrapup ​运行​预算​过​ 80% ​注入​一次性​收尾​通知​（​缓存​安全​） agent/conversation_loop.py:126 _join_truncated_parts / _continuation_overlap_length length ​续写​片段​去​重​拼接​（KMP ​重叠​） agent/conversation_loop.py:296/268 _LATCHED_VERDICT_FIELDS ​闩​锁​字​段表​：​只置​ True ​不​被​清零​ agent/conversation_loop.py:1553 _MAX_OUTER_LOOP_ERRORS ​每​ turn ​外层​异常​上限​（=8） agent/conversation_loop.py:239

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​角色​ agent/conversation_loop.py turn ​主​循环​心脏​：​外层​信封​ + ​主​ WHILE + ​内层​重试​循环​ + _LoopState/_run_phase ​机制

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
AIAgent.run_conversation（turn_facade.py:22，​先取​租约​）
        │ ​转发​
        ▼
conversation_loop.run_conversation ──import ​时​绑定​──► 33 ​个​ turn_*.py ​阶段​助手​
        │                                              ├─ turn_context.py        ​赛前​准备​
        │                                              ├─ turn_request_assembly  ​请求​组装​
        │                                              ├─ turn_api_call          ​真正​的​调用​
        │                                              ├─ turn_api_error         ​错误​恢复​
        │                                              ├─ turn_tool_round        ​工具​轮​
        │                                              ├─ turn_final_response    ​文本​收尾​
        │                                              └─ turn_finalizer         ​收尾​
        └─ ​工具​轮​内部​ → AIAgent._execute_tool_calls（run_agent.py:1308）
                        → tool_dispatch_helpers ​分段​ → tool_executor ​执行​

turn_*.py ​不​在​模块​级​ import conversation_loop（​防​循环​），​需要​的​循环​常量​在​函数​体内​ ​延迟​ import——​同时​让​ patch("agent.conversation_loop.X") ​的​测试​桩​继续​生效​ （​根​ AGENTS.md："Patch where production reads"）。​上层​入口​见​ turn_facade.md； ​工具​执行​细节​见​ turn_pipeline.md。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​一个​ turn = ​一次​ run_conversation：​外层​信封​（​边界​导出​、​失败​收口​）​套​着​ _run_conversation_turn ​的​主​ WHILE ​循环​。
  • ​每个​阶段​都​是​ agent/turn_*.py ​的​独立​文件​，​由​ _run_phase ​按​参数​名​从​ _LoopState ​取值​调用​、verdict ​字段​按名​回​拷​——​新增​阶段​输入输出​只​需加​一个​字​段​。
  • verdict action ​全​项目​统一​：fallthrough/return/break/continue； ​闩​锁​字​段​只​置​ True ​不​清零​。
  • ​内层​ _run_api_retry_loop = ​一次​模型​调用​ + ​重试​恢复​的​完整​生命周期​；​错误处理​走​ ​就​地​修复​链​（TurnRetryState ​一次性​守卫​），​重定向​与​响应​的​线程​竞争​以​ "​宁可​重算​不​丢​用户​输入​"​裁决​。
  • ​预算​三​保险​：api_call_count ​上限​（​默认​ sys.maxsize）、​线程​安全​的​ IterationBudget、_budget_grace_call ​一次​宽限​；​再加​每​ turn 8 ​次​外层​异常​上限​和​ restart_count ​防​退款​失控​兜底​。
  • ​同步​、​可​打断​：​整条​链路​没有​ async；HTTP ​在​ worker ​线程​上​进行​，​用户​随时​可​ interrupt。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​一个​长寿命​ Hermes ​进程​（​网关​同时​跑​几十个​会话​）​要​回答​四类​问题​：​这个​ provider ​现在​用​哪​把​ ​凭据​（​池​与​轮转​）、​凭据​坏​了​怎么办​（​冷却​、​隔离​、​刷新​、​恢复​）、​我离​限流​还有​多远​ （​头部​捕获​、​跨会话​熔断​、credits）、​这些​ token ​花​了​多少​钱​（​锚点​记账​、​计价​、​用量​/​账单​ ​视图​）。27 ​个​文件​分担​这些​职责​，​没有​一个​是​"​顺手​的​散装​代码​"——​凭据​边界​和​钱​都​是​审计​对象​。

​组​ ​文件​ ​职责​ ​池​核心​ credential_pool.py + 4 ​兄弟​ ​多​凭据​池​：​选择​、​轮转​、​冷却​、​刷新​、​管理​端​ ​多源​凭据​ credential_sources.py / credential_source.py / anthropic_credentials.py / command_token_source.py / credential_persistence.py / credential_auth_recovery.py / custom_entry_pool.py ​来源​读取​、​借用​、key_cmd、​磁盘​边界​ ​限速​ rate_limit_tracker.py / rate_limit_credits.py / nous_rate_guard.py / credits_tracker.py ​头部​捕获​、​低​额度​通知​、​跨会话​熔断​ ​记账​ usage_anchor.py / usage_pricing.py / usage_gauges.py / aux_accounting.py ​锚点​计数​、​美元​计价​、​窗口​余量​、aux ​归账​ ​视图​ account_usage.py / account_usage_cache.py / subscription_view.py / plan_limits.py / billing_usage.py / billing_view.py / billing_links.py /usage ​与​ /subscription ​的​数据​与​渲染

docs.title: 1. PooledCredential —— ​池行​的​全部​状态​（credential_pool.py:209）
docs.text:
# agent/credential_pool.py:209-239（​节选​）
class PooledCredential:
    provider: str
    id: str
    label: str
    auth_type: str
    priority: int
    source: str
    access_token: str
    refresh_token: Optional[str] = None
    last_status: Optional[str] = None          # OK / EXHAUSTED / DEAD / ...
    last_status_at: Optional[float] = None
    last_error_code: Optional[int] = None
    last_error_reason: Optional[str] = None
    last_error_message: Optional[str] = None
    last_error_reset_at: Optional[float] = None
    # Epoch of the last deliberate ``hermes auth reset`` of this entry. Sticky: a later exhaustion
    # stamps a newer ``last_status_at``, so "reset postdates status" stays decidable across processes.
    status_cleared_at: Optional[float] = None
    base_url: Optional[str] = None
    expires_at: Optional[str] = None
    expires_at_ms: Optional[int] = None
    ...
    request_count: int = 0
    # A provider may rate-limit one model while the same credential remains
    # usable for its sibling models.  Keep that observation separate from the
    # credential-wide status used for auth and billing failures.
    model_cooldowns: Optional[dict[str, float]] = None
    extra: dict[str, Any] = None  # type: ignore[assignment]

​三处​设计​值得​记住​：

  • status_cleared_at ​是​粘性​的​（:224-226）：​后续​的​ exhaustion ​会盖​新​的​时间​戳​， ​所以​"reset ​晚于​ status"​这​条​判定​跨​进程​永远​可决​。
  • ​模型​冷却​与​凭据​级​状态​分离​（:235-238）：provider ​可以​只限​流​一个​模型​，​同一​凭据​的​ ​兄弟​模型​照常​可用​——​这个​观察​放在​ model_cooldowns，​不​污染​ auth/billing ​失败​用​的​ last_status。
  • extra ​是​插件​的​载荷​（from_dict，:252-272）：​非字​段键​全部​进​ extra ​往返​， ​插件​存在​自己​行上​的​元​数据​在​ load→save→load ​之后​幸存​；provider ​永远​是​行​的​所有者​， ​不许​被​扫进​元​数据​。

runtime_api_key / runtime_base_url（:287-316）​是​运行​时​读取​面​：Nous ​的​推理​凭据​ ​是​ agent_key（​必须​是​可用​的​ NAS invoke JWT）；openai-codex ​的​行​保存​规范​ ChatGPT URL， ​但​ profile ​级​代理​覆盖​必须​赢​——​否则​一次​ 401/429 ​轮转​会​静默​离开​代理​。

docs.title: 2. _available_entries ​与​ mark_exhausted_and_rotate —— ​选择​的​纪律​（credential_pool.py:2030, 2255）
docs.text:
# agent/credential_pool.py:2030-2056 + 2090-2105（​节选​）
    def _available_entries(
        self, *, clear_expired: bool = False, refresh: bool = False, model: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> tuple[list[PooledCredential], list[PooledCredential]]:
        """Return (available, pending_refresh) for entries not in cooldown.

        *clear_expired* resets elapsed cooldowns to STATUS_OK and persists.
        *refresh* refreshes entries needing a token refresh (skipped on
        failure) — except single-use-token providers (openai-codex,
        xai-oauth), which are returned as *pending_refresh* so the caller
        refreshes them outside the lock instead of stalling every pool
        consumer during cross-process flock acquisition + OAuth network I/O.
        """
        ...
            if entry.last_status == STATUS_DEAD:
                # Manual DEAD credentials are pruned after a 24h quiet window;
                # singleton-seeded ones stay (audit trail, and the seeder would
                # re-create them anyway). DEAD never re-enters via TTL — only a
                # write-side re-auth sync clears it.

​可​选​用途​过滤​的​完整​链条​：​借用​凭据​未​水合​的​不租​（​防发空​ key）、DEAD ​行​手动​来源​ 24h ​后​ ​修剪​（singleton ​播种​的​留​着​——​审计​线索​，​反正​播种​器会​重建​）、DEAD ​永不​经​ TTL ​复活​ （​只有​写侧​的​ re-auth ​同步​能清​）、​单​ use token provider ​的​刷新​推迟​到​锁​外​（​不​在​跨​进程​ flock + OAuth ​网络​往返​中​卡死​所有​池​消费者​）。

# agent/credential_pool.py:2255-2275 + 2281-2300（​节选​）
    def mark_exhausted_and_rotate(self, *, status_code, error_context=None, api_key_hint=None,
                                  credential_id=None, failure_reason=None, model=None):
        with self._lock:
            identity_supplied = bool(credential_id or api_key_hint)
            entry = self._identify_failed_entry(credential_id, api_key_hint)
            ...
            if self._is_model_scoped_failure(status_code, model, failure_reason):
                # A generic Anthropic 429 (per-model rate limit) or a Codex account model
                # entitlement rejection: bench this model only, the credential stays
                # available for its siblings.
                self._cool_down_model(entry, model, error_context, failure_reason=failure_reason)
                ...
            self._mark_exhausted(entry, status_code, error_context, failure_reason=failure_reason)
            # A 402/429/401 is a key-level failure, and the same key can back
            # several entries (an explicit entry plus a ``model_config`` row
            # auto-seeded from ``model.api_key``). Marking only the first
            # leaves siblings OK, ``_select_unlocked()`` keeps handing back
            # the depleted key, and rotation never converges (~2.5 min hang).
            # Mark every entry sharing the failed key.
            failed_runtime_key = entry.runtime_api_key
            if identity_supplied and failed_runtime_key:
                siblings = [
                    s for s in self._entries if s.id != entry.id and s.runtime_api_key == failed_runtime_key
                ]
                for sibling in siblings:
                    self._mark_exhausted(sibling, ..., persist=False, ...)

​轮转​的​两条​硬​规则​：​模型​级​失败​只​冷却​模型​（Anthropic ​泛​ 429、Codex ​模型​权益​拒绝​—— ​凭据​留给​兄弟​模型​）；key ​级​失败​连坐​所有​同​ key ​条目​（​同一个​ key ​可以​支撑​多条​ pool ​行​，​只​标记​第一条​的话​ _select_unlocked ​会​一直​把​耗尽​的​ key ​发​回来​，​轮转​永不​ ​收敛​，​症状​是​ ~2.5 ​分钟​挂​起​）。

docs.title: 3. ​播种​器​与​借用​凭据​（credential_pool.py:2521 + credential_persistence.py）
docs.text:
​池​不是​凭空​来​的​：_Seeder（:2521）​从​单例​播种​——_seed_anthropic_singletons（: 2545）、_seed_nous_singleton、_seed_profile_singleton、_seed_qwen_singleton、 _seed_minimax_singleton。anthropic_credentials.py ​的​头​注释​点​出​契约​：

~/.hermes/.anthropic_oauth.json (Hermes PKCE) and the Claude Code file are singletons: credential_pool._seed_from_singletons() re-reads them on every load_pool(), so a failed write here is a failed refresh.

"​借用​"​凭据​（Codex CLI ​的​ ~/.codex/auth.json、Claude Code ​的​ ~/.claude/.credentials.json）​有​专门​的​政策​文件​。credential_persistence.py ​管​磁盘​ ​边界​：​借用​的​池行​持久​化为​仅元​数据​引用​，​原始​秘密​在​到达​ auth.json ​前​剥掉​（ sanitize_borrowed_credential_payload），​并且​刻意​不​ import hermes_cli.auth——​池​模型​ ​与​ auth-store ​写​边界​共享​一套​策略​而​不​产生​环​。​还有​"​已花​轮转​"​侧车​（_spent_rotation_sidecar_path， :151）：single-use refresh token ​是​一次性​的​，​指纹​记下来​防止​把​已​消费​的​轮转​当成​新鲜​对​。

credential_sources.py ​统一​的​是​移除​契约​（:1-13）：

Readers live in agent.credential_pool; what is unified here is removal: hermes auth remove <provider> <N> must make the entry stay gone across load_pool() calls. Each source registers a RemovalStep ... and the dispatcher suppresses (provider, source_id) in auth.json so the seeding branch skips the upsert.

​不​加​这个​，hermes auth remove ​会​在​下​一次​ load_pool() ​时​被​播种​器​原样​复活​。 ​借用​ CLI ​登录​的​政策​开关​ auth.adopt_external_logins（​默认​ True）​也​在​这里​：Codex ​和​ Claude ​的​ OAuth refresh token ​是​单次​使用​且​轮转​的​——Hermes ​一旦​借​走​ CLI ​的​ token ​对​， ​两个​程序​就​共享​一个​ token ​族​，​谁​先​刷新​谁​把​对方​登出​（:24-33）；opt-out ​后​ Hermes ​永不​ ​读​/​刷新​那些​文件​，​并​每​进程​ INFO ​一次​。

docs.title: 4. ​刷新​与​恢复​（credential_pool.py:1490 + credential_auth_recovery.py）
docs.text:
_refresh_entry（:1490）​是​刷新​总​入口​，​按​ provider ​分派​到​ _refresh_anthropic（Claude OAuth PKCE）、Codex（single-use、​带​ CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN_REFRESH_SKEW_SECONDS ​提前量​）、 ​插件​ refresh hook（credential_pool_plugin.py，#116408）​等​；​失败​走​ _recover_failed_refresh / _mark_dead_refresh_grant——​终态​（invalid_grant）​会​清理​ token ​并​写​隔离​标记​。_fail_closed_unpersisted_rotation（:1547）​处理​最​危险​的​窗口​： ​轮转​已​消费​但​尚未​持久​时​绝不​放行​（fail-closed），​宁可​拒绝​也​不​把​不可​复现​的​ token ​族​留在​内存​里​。

credential_auth_recovery.py ​是​ 401/403 ​的​恢复​路径​：​调度​到​的​凭据​认证​失败​时​，​先​同步​ ​外部​来源​（auth store / ​凭据​文件​可能​已​被​别的​进程​刷新​），​同步​失败​才​标记​并​轮转​—— ​多​进程​共享​ auth.json ​时​，"​过期​"​经常​只是​"​别的​进程​刚​刷新​、​我​拿到​旧值​"。

docs.title: 5. ​限速​捕获​与​跨会话​熔断
docs.text:
# agent/rate_limit_tracker.py:1-19（​节选​）
"""Rate limit tracking for inference API responses.

Captures ``x-ratelimit-{limit,remaining,reset}-{requests,tokens}[-1h]``
headers (Nous Portal format, also used by OpenRouter / OpenAI-compatible APIs)
and formats them for the /usage slash command. Reset values are seconds."""
_BUCKET_TAGS = (
    ("requests_min", "requests"),
    ("requests_hour", "requests-1h"),
    ("tokens_min", "tokens"),
    ("tokens_hour", "tokens-1h"),
)

​四个​窗口​（​分钟​/​小时​的​请求​数​与​ token ​数​）​一次​捕获​成​ RateLimitBucket。 rate_limit_credits.py ​是​ AIAgent Mixin ​侧​的​粘合​层​：​解析​响应​头进​ _rate_limit_state/_credits_state ​并发​粘性​通知​——​解析​面在​ Mixin（​保持​ run_agent ​同名​的​ logger），​策略​面在​ tracker。

nous_rate_guard.py ​解决​一个​具体​的​放大​问题​：

# agent/nous_rate_guard.py:1-6
"""Cross-session rate limit guard for Nous Portal.

Writes rate limit state to a shared file so all sessions (CLI, gateway, cron,
auxiliary) can check whether Nous Portal is currently rate-limited before making
requests. Without it each 429 fans out into up to 9 calls per turn (3 SDK
retries x 3 Hermes retries), all counted against RPH."""

​共享​文件​是​跨会话​熔断器​：​所有​会话​（CLI/​网关​/cron/auxiliary）​请求​前先​看​一眼​，​一个​ 429 ​不再​引发​每​ turn ​最​多​ 9 ​次​的​连锁​。​两个​阈值​讲究​：reset < 60s ​是​上游​抖动​，​不​值得​跳闸​； welcome tier ​的​结构化​ rate_limited ​拒绝​里​，reset ≥ ​阈值​是​配额​耗尽​（​停下​、​告诉​用户​ ​何时​刷新​、​登录​可​解除​），​低于​阈值​则​等一等​就​好​。

credits_tracker.py（940 ​行​）​管​ Nous credits：​把​ x-nous-credits-* / x-nous-tool-pool-* ​头​解析​成​校验​过​的​ CreditsState——​钱​是​ micros ​整数​， *_usd ​字符串​原样​保留​（​绝不​重新​解析​成​ float），schema ​版本​不​认识​就​ warn-once ​放行​。

docs.title: 6. ​用量​锚点​ —— ​本地​估算​只算​增量​（usage_anchor.py:1-11）
docs.text:
# agent/usage_anchor.py:1-11
"""Usage-anchored token accounting: the provider's real ``usage.prompt_tokens`` is the only
authoritative context size; the local ``bytes/4`` estimate covers ONLY messages appended since.

An anchor = provider usage at capture + a snapshot of the transcript position it priced:
``base_count`` (len(messages) at capture; the reply is not yet appended and is covered by
``completion_tokens``, so the delta walk skips an assistant row at that index), ``base_last_role``
and ``base_last_fp`` (content fingerprint of the last priced message; compaction, splices and
rewinds replace it → anchor fails closed → full estimation until the next real reading).

The fingerprint (not ``id()``) is the identity: the gateway re-reads the transcript from the DB
every turn and a resumed session runs in a fresh process, so object identity is never stable
across the surfaces where the estimate mattered most (#99421, #104462). The anchor also persists
on the session row (``model_config._usage_anchor``) so a restarted process can restore it; a
restored anchor is honored only while the durable transcript still matches its fingerprint."""

​计数​的​信用等级​很​明确​：provider ​的​真实​ usage.prompt_tokens ​是​唯一​权威​，​本地​ bytes/4 ​粗估​（model_metadata.md §2）​只​覆盖​锚点​之后​追加​的​消息​。​锚点​身份​用​内容​指纹​ （_FINGERPRINT_KEYS = ("role", "content", "api_content", "tool_call_id", "tool_calls")， :23）​而​不是​ id()——​网关​每​ turn ​从​ DB ​重读​转录​、​恢复​的​会​话​跑​在​新​进程​里​，​对象​身份​ ​在​最​需要​它​的​地方​恰恰​不​稳定​。​锚点​对不上​（​压缩​/​拼接​/​回退​改了​转录​）​就​失败​关闭​： ​退回​全量​估算​，​直到​下​一次​真实​读数​。​锚点​随会​话行​持久​化​，​重启​的​进程​可​恢复​，​恢复​的​锚点​ ​只​在​持久​转录​仍​匹配​指纹​时​被​采纳​。

docs.title: 7. ​计价​与​视图
docs.text:
usage_pricing.py（799 ​行​）​把​ token ​变成​美元​：​价格​优先​从​ OpenRouter ​元​数据​的​ pricing ​字​段​（model_metadata.md §4 ​预热​的​缓存​）​与​端点​ /models ​定​；_MODELS_DEV_DIRECT_HOSTS （:23-27）​列明​哪些​一方​按量​计费​ API ​可以​直接​用​ models.dev ​牌价​——​且​只​在​直连该​域名​ （HTTPS:443）​时​：​代理​/​中继​/​自定义​端点​卖​同一个​模型​ id ​可以​不同​价​，​订阅​路由​ （openai-codex、xai-oauth）​有​自己​的​政策​。​显示​层为​ sub-cent ​成本​渲染​ 4 ​位​小数​ （"\(0.0046" ​而​不是​ "\)0.00"）。

aux_accounting.py ​把​ aux ​调用​的​用量​归回​会话​：aux ​客户端​没有​会话​句柄​，​历史​上​用量​ ​直接​丢弃​——agent ​循环​把​ (session_db, session_id) ​发布​进​ ContextVar（​镜像​ portal_tags ​的​作用域​纪律​，HX002 ​家族​），aux ​客户端​在​它​唯一​的​响应​校验​咽喉​点​记账​。 _EXCLUDED_TASKS ​排除​ moa_reference/moa_aggregator——​它们​已​折进​ conversation_loop ​的​ delta，​再记​一次​就​双算​。

​视图​四件套​共享​同一​数据​面​：billing_usage.py ​是​ /usage ​与​ /subscription ​通用​条​的​ ​美元​用量​模型​；usage_gauges.py ​按​服务器​发来​的​显示​顺序​维护​用量​窗口​余量​； plan_limits.py ​回答​"​一个​限额​挡住​了​什么​、​改​提供​什么​"；account_usage.py（975 ​行​） ​是​各​ provider ​账户​用量​的​取数​引擎​（Anthropic OAuth、Codex、OpenRouter、Portal… ​各有​一套​窗口​），account_usage_cache.py ​让​ model.options ​在​不​打​网络​的​情况​下​知道​ ​订阅​用量​；billing_view.py ​是​ Remote Spending ​屏幕​的​ surface ​无关​核心​（CLI ​与​ TUI JSON-RPC ​共用​）；billing_links.py ​给​账单​类​失败​配​ provider ​无关​的​"​恢复​链接​"。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
turn ​主​循环​（turn_api_call / client_lifecycle._swap_credential）
        │ mark_exhausted_and_rotate / credential_auth_recovery
        ▼
credential_pool.CredentialPool ──► hermes_cli/auth（auth.json ​读写​、OAuth ​刷新​）
        │  select()                        ▲ ​播种​：_seed_from_singletons
        │                                  └── anthropic_credentials / ~/.codex / ~/.claude
        ▼
resolve_provider_client（auxiliary_client.md）── 402/429 ──► ​回退​链​ + pool ​轮转​
        │
        ▼
​每次​响应​ ──► rate_limit_tracker / credits_tracker / nous_rate_guard（​限速​面​）
        └──► usage_anchor / usage_pricing / aux_accounting（​记账​面​）
                 ▼
        /usage ​与​ /subscription ​视图​（billing_usage/view、usage_gauges、plan_limits）
  • ​主​循环​消费​：_finalize_routing ​用​ credential_pool_matches_provider ​校验​池​ （agent_init.md §2）；client_lifecycle._swap_credential ​在​ 401/429 ​时换​凭据​并重​套​ pin_model_for_route；rate_limit_credits.py ​本身​是​ AIAgent ​的​一个​ Mixin （RateLimitCreditsMixin）。
  • aux ​消费​：aux ​漏斗​的​回退​阶梯​调用​池​轮转​与​冷却​；aux_accounting ​的​ ContextVar ​由​ turn_facade ​挂载​（acct_token = set_accounting_context(...)）。
  • model_metadata：OpenRouter ​预热​缓存​同时​喂​计价​；estimate_messages_tokens_rough ​是​锚点​增量​的​估算​器​。
  • hermes_cli：hermes auth add/remove/status ​的​读者​与​移除​器​在​这里​； hermes_cli.nous_auth_keepalive（_finalize_routing ​启动​）​靠池​的​ Nous ​行​提前​续期​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​池是​一条​状态机​：​每行​凭据​带​状态​（OK/EXHAUSTED/DEAD）、​模型​级​冷却​、​刷新​计划​与​ extra ​载荷​；​选择​过滤​ DEAD ​与​冷却​（​单​ use provider ​的​刷新​推迟​到​锁​外​）；DEAD ​永不​经​ TTL ​复活​。
  • ​轮转​的​粒度​即​失败​粒度​：​模型​级​失败​（429/​权益​拒绝​）​只​冷却​模型​；key ​级​失败​ （402/429/401）​连坐​所有​共享​该​ key ​的​条目​——​否则​轮转​永不​收敛​。
  • ​凭据​有​来源​也​有​去处​：​单例​播种​（Hermes OAuth、Claude Code、~/.codex）、key_cmd、 custom providers；​移除​必须​登记​ RemovalStep，​否则​ hermes auth remove ​被​播种​器​复活​。 ​借用​凭据​在​磁盘​边界​消毒​、​已花​轮转​记​指纹​侧车​。
  • ​限速​有​三层​：​响应​头​捕获​（​四​窗口​）、​跨会话​熔断​（​共享​文件​防​一个​ 429 ​放大​ 9 ​次​）、 credits ​状态机​（micros ​整数​，​字符串​保留​，warn-once ​版本​门​）。
  • ​记账​以​ provider ​为​权威​：​真实​ usage.prompt_tokens ​是​锚点​，​本地​粗估​只算​增量​； ​锚点​用​内容​指纹​定​身份​（​跨​进程​/​跨​ DB ​重读​都​稳定​），​对不上​就​失败​关闭​退回​全量​估算​。 aux ​调用​经​ ContextVar ​归账​，MoA ​双算​被​显式​排除​。
  • ​计价​认直​连​：models.dev ​牌价​只​对​一方​ API ​的​直连​域名​成立​，​代理​与​订阅​路由​各有​ ​各​的​账​；sub-cent ​成本​渲染​到​ 4 ​位​小数​，​绝不​显示​ $0.00。

docs.title: delegation_subagents.md — ​委派​与子​代理​：DelegationProvider ​路由​、​子会话​运行​时​与​辅助​侧问
文件​概览
docs.text:
delegate_task ​把​一个​目标​拆成​若干​ task，​交给​子​ AIAgent ​并发​执行​。core ​保留​整个​生命周期​ （spawn、​隔离​、roles、depth、​并发​、​后台​单元​、stop ​扇出​、​结果​、output_schema、progress）—— ​都​在​ tools/delegate_tool.py（04_tools/delegation_tools.md，​含​ _run_single_child ​的​ _last_resolved_tool_names ​保存​/​恢复​）；​本篇​讲​ agent/ ​侧​的​配套​机器​：

​父​ turn（AIAgent）
   │ delegate_task（INLINE_TOOL_EXECUTORS ​拦截​ → run_agent.py:1344 _dispatch_delegate_task）
   ▼
DelegationProvider.route_task(task, config)     —— "​这个​ task ​走​哪条​路​"
   │  ​默认​ backend = ​内置​插件​ plugins/delegation/default；route: model/provider/base_url/
   │  reasoning_effort/service_tier/profile/label
   ▼
​每个​ task ​一个​子​ AIAgent（platform="subagent"）
   │  ​路由​随本会​话​ schema ​钉死​（delegation_backends）；​子​上下文​标记​ delegated_child_context
   │  / DELEGATED_CHILD_ENV_MARKER；​托管​ worker：owner ​预留​子会​话行​（runtime_session_child），
   │  ​私有​ exec ​入口​ managed_worker + safe_worker_policy ​冻结​配置​
   ▼
​结果​ JSON ​回填​父​ turn（on_delegation ​钩子​ → ​父​的​记忆​ provider ​观察​）
​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/delegation_provider.py 117 DelegationProvider ABC：​路由​词汇表​ agent/delegation_registry.py 134 backend ​注册表​；​默认​ backend ​即​内置​插件​ agent/delegation_backends.py 157 /delegation ​命令​；backend ​按会话​钉死​ agent/delegation_context.py 187 ​子​上下文​标记​与​ kanban ​环境​作用域​ agent/subagent_lifecycle.py 472 ​插件​安全​的​公共​生命周期​ API（​不可​变​契约​） agent/runtime_session_store.py 497 ​托管​ worker ​的​显式​持久​化​门面​ agent/runtime_session_child.py 57 ​子会话​ store：owner ​预留​，​绝不​自​注册​ agent/runtime_session_lifecycle.py 93 worker store ​的​显式​生命周期​方法​（​含​压缩​ API：runtime_session_compression.py 162 ​行​） agent/managed_worker.py 477 ​私有​ exec ​入口​（​有​界​ stdin ​控制​管道​） agent/safe_worker_policy.py 80 ​一次性​绑定​的​冻结​会话​配置​ agent/oneshot.py 122 ​一次性​ LLM ​请求​（commit ​信息​、​改名​建议​…）；​有限​会话​削减​见​ oneshot_footprint.py（78 ​行​） agent/side_question.py 175 /btw ​侧问​：​缓存​对齐​ fork agent/side_question_lease.py 151 ​插件​侧问​的​ turn ​租约​ agent/side_question_request.py 288 ​单次​纯​文本​请求​（​分离​缓存​对齐​ fork） agent/review_engine.py 195 /review ​共享​引擎​（​后台​全权​子​代理​） agent/review_idle_queue.py 218 ​本地​托管​ runtime ​的​评审​空闲​排队​ agent/process_bootstrap.py 358 ​进程​级​引导​（​共享​ httpx ​传输​池​、Happy Eyeballs） agent/primary_runtime_snapshot.py 84 ​回​退后​下​ turn ​恢复​的​主​路由​快照

docs.title: 1. DelegationProvider ABC：core ​只​问​"​这条​路​怎么​走​"
docs.text:
provider ​决定​一个​ task ​如何​变成​一次​子​运行​：​用​什么​ model/provider/endpoint/reasoning effort， ​或者​以​哪个​ Hermes profile ​身份​跑​。​跨​接口​全是​纯​ JSON ​数据​（​无活​ agent ​对象​），​所以​同一​ provider ​在​进程​内​与​ plugins.isolation: host ​下​都​能​跑​：

# agent/delegation_provider.py:110-117
    @abc.abstractmethod
    def route_task(self, task: Mapping[str, Any], config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the route for one task (vocabulary in the module docstring).

        ``task`` carries ``goal``, ``context``, ``index`` and the values the model supplied for
        this provider's :meth:`task_parameters` (absent when omitted). Raise
        :class:`DelegationRouteError` to refuse the task."""

​路由​词汇表​（​模块​ docstring，:15-31）：model/provider/base_url/api_key/api_mode/request_overrides/ reasoning_effort/fallback_providers（​空​ route = ​子​代理​继承​父​路由​）；service_tier（normal/fast/ ultrafast，​按​ /fast ​规则​核对​）；profile（​子​代理​以该​ profile ​的​ config/​凭据​/​技能​/SOUL.md/ ​终端​策略​运行​，scope helper ​与​多路​网关​同​一套​）；label（​进度​/​结果​旁​显示​的​短文​本​）。 task_parameters（:93）​允许​ provider ​给​ delegate_task ​的​ tasks.items.properties ​追加​ per-task JSON-schema ​字​段​（profile ​名​枚举​、​标题​化​模型​选项​……），​但​它​只​在​会​话​构建​工具​时​调用​、 ​且​必须​对​同一​ config ​产出​逐字​节​相同​的​结果​——schema ​是​缓存​前缀​的​一部分​。​保留​名​ RESERVED_TASK_PARAMETERS（:45，goal/context/index/output_schema/provider/model/...）​在​ schema ​构建​期​拒收​：​插件​加​参数​，​永不​重​定义​ core ​的​。DelegationRouteError ​的​消息​会​原样​变成​ delegate_task ​的​工具​错误​给​模型​读​，​所以​措辞​是​"​指令​式​"​的​。

docs.title: 2. ​注册表​：​默认​ backend ​本身​就是​一个​插件
docs.text:
delegation.backend ​未​配置​即​ default——​而​"​今天​的​行为​"（​每个​子​代理​跟随​ delegation ​段​， ​否则​继承​父​路由​）​由​内置​插件​ plugins/delegation/default ​通过​同一​接缝​提供​：

# agent/delegation_registry.py:128-134
def get_active_provider(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> DelegationProvider:
    """The provider ``config`` (the ``delegation`` section) selects; ``default`` when unset. Raises
    :class:`DelegationRouteError` naming the backend and the fix when it is not registered or unavailable."""
    provider, reason = backend_status(configured_backend(config))
    if reason or provider is None:
        raise DelegationRouteError(f"{reason} No subagent was started.")
    return provider

_usable（:88）​的​解析​顺序​：​已​注册​且​ available → bundled ​首用​加载​（plugins/delegation/<name>/， ​不​经​插件​ sweep——delegation ​是​ core ​工具​，​不能​依赖​ sweep ​跑​过​；plugins.disabled ​每次​调用​都​ ​生效​）→ ​补​一次​ discovery。fail-closed：backend ​未​安装​/​不可​用​不是​悄悄​换​路由​，​而是​工具​错误​ ​指名​ backend ​与​修法​；​该会​话​的​ schema ​里​也​不会​出现​它​的​参数​（schema ​由​同一​解析​构建​）。

docs.title: 3. delegation_backends：​路由​按会话​钉死​保护​缓存
docs.text:
# agent/delegation_backends.py:1-8（​模块​ docstring ​节选​）
"""Which delegation backend Hermes uses: the public API behind a ``/delegation`` command.

``delegation.backend`` in config.yaml is the saved choice. A session routes on the backend its
``delegate_task`` schema was built from (``agent._delegation_backend``, captured with its tools and
pinned with them to the session row), because that schema (a backend's per-task parameters) is cached
prompt: a save, or a config.yaml edit, changes nothing in a running chat and applies from its next
session (``/new``). ``apply_now`` opts into rebuilding the calling session's tools at its next turn
instead ... one prompt-cache break, the rule every slash command that changes prompt state follows."""

​这​正是​根​ AGENTS.md"slash ​命令​改​系统​提示​词​状态​推迟​到​下​一会​话​、opt-in --now"​规则​的​一个​实例​。 ​附带​防御​：​带​着​本会话​ backend ​未声明​参数​的​ task ​仍会​被​拒​（tools/delegate_tool_routes.py）。

docs.title: 4. bind_subagent_parent：TurnFacadeMixin ​每​回合​绑定​属主
docs.text:
subagent_lifecycle.py ​是​插件​可​拿到​的​不可​变​契约​层​（SubagentHandle/Status/TerminalState/ CancelResult/Result，frozen dataclass + HMAC capability ​字​段​），​唯一​暴露​活​ agent ​的​地方​是​ contextvar ​绑定​：

# agent/subagent_lifecycle.py:165-189（​节选​）
_ACTIVE_PARENT_AGENT: contextvars.ContextVar[Any] = contextvars.ContextVar("hermes_subagent_lifecycle_parent", default=None)

@contextmanager
def bind_subagent_parent(parent_agent: Any):
    """Bind the host-owned parent for the current agent turn.

    Stored as a weakref: every asyncio Handle/Future scheduled from the turn
    (LSP reader loops, kernel pipes, ...) snapshots the Context, and those
    snapshots outlive the turn. A strong ref there pinned finished delegate
    children — each of which binds itself here for its own turn — in the
    parent process heap for the life of the background loop."""
    try:
        ref = weakref.ref(parent_agent)
    except TypeError:
        ref = lambda: parent_agent
    token = _ACTIVE_PARENT_AGENT.set(ref)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        _ACTIVE_PARENT_AGENT.reset(token)

TurnFacadeMixin ​在​ turn ​外围​ with bind_subagent_parent(self)；_record（:399）​校验​ handle ​的​ HMAC capability ​与​属​主会​话​后​才​放行​ status/result/cancel/steer。​终态​记录​保留​ 1 ​小时​ （_TERMINAL_RETENTION_SECONDS）​供重​连​查询​，live ​记录​永不​外露​；​取消​走​ request_hard_interrupt （CANCEL_REQUESTED → CANCELLED）。fork ​的​实际​执行​体​ _run（:421）​回调​ tools/delegate_tool._run_child_lifecycle。

docs.title: 5. delegation_context：​身份​门​ fail-closed ​而​不​改​进程​环境
docs.text:
​一个​ Hermes ​进程​可能​本身​就是​ Kanban dispatcher worker（HERMES_KANBAN_* ​在​ os.environ）。 ​进程​内​的​ delegate ​子​代理​与​ cron ​作业​不是​ dispatcher ​所有​——​身份​门​必须​对​它们​关闭​，​但​不能​ ​去​改​进程​全局​环境​（claim ​心跳​与​并发​读者​都​在​用​）：

# agent/delegation_context.py:28-40（​节选​）
@contextmanager
def delegated_child_context(session_id=None) -> Iterator[None]:
    """Mark child execution and isolate its task-local session identity..."""
    token = _DELEGATED_CHILD_CONTEXT.set(True)
    try:
        from gateway.session_context import scoped_current_session_id
        with scoped_current_session_id(session_id):
            yield
    finally:
        _DELEGATED_CHILD_CONTEXT.reset(token)

​跨​真实​进程​ spawn ​时​，delegated_child_subprocess_env()（:176）→ scrub_kanban_env()（:122）： ​剥掉​ worker ​身份​（HERMES_KANBAN_TASK ​等​），​保留​ board/​位置​，​并​写入​/​继承​ DELEGATED_CHILD_ENV_MARKER——​标记​的​值​是​围栏​板根​，​后代​对板​外​ Kanban DB ​的​写​被​ kanban_path_is_fenced（:144）​拒绝​；"TASK ​缺席​"​单独​不足以​提升​为​ orchestrator。​内联​ shell （skill_preprocessing）​与​终端​工具​都​经​它​清洗​子​进程​环境​。

docs.title: 6. ​子会话​运行​时​（runtime_session_*）：​托管​ worker ​持久​化
docs.text:
gateway ​托管​模式​下​，​持久​化走​"worker ​发​ RPC、owner ​持​ SQLite"​的​显式​通道​：

# agent/runtime_session_child.py:19-57（​节选​）
class ChildSessionStore(RuntimeSessionStore):
    binds_delegation_ledger = False

    def create_session(self, session_id, source, **fields):
        # The owner created this row at reservation with its source, lineage and profile; only
        # the constructor facts are the child's to add.
        ...
        return super().create_session(session_id, 'subagent', model=..., ...)


def reserve_child_store(parent):
    """A ``ChildSessionStore`` the owner reserved under ``parent``'s verified execution."""
    ...
    result = call_off_event_loop(parent._apply, 'child.reserve', {'secret': secret})
    if 'refused' in result:
        raise ValueError(_REFUSALS.get(result['refused'], ...))   # ​容量​/​深度​超限​ → ​工具​错误​
    ...

​子会​话行​由​ owner ​在​预留​时​创建​（source='subagent'、lineage、profile ​都​定​好​），​子​代理​只补​ ​构造​事实​；​拒绝​（delegation_capacity、delegation_depth_exceeded）​以​ ValueError ​上浮​成​ delegate_task ​工具​错误​。runtime_session_store.py ​定义​显式​持久​化​门面​（​永不​打开​规范​ SQLite ​库​；is_worker_process() ​一旦​自​注册​即​进程​级​、​不​可逆​）；runtime_session_lifecycle.py ​补显式​ ​生命周期​方法​；runtime_session_compression.py ​把​微​压缩​ handoff ​行​投影​到​ owner ​的​封闭​字段​集​ （worker ​本地​簿记​键​发给​ owner ​会​打​不进​收据​、​卡死​ journal）。

docs.title: 7. ​私有​ exec：managed_worker + safe_worker_policy
docs.text: ​托管​ worker ​是​ python -m ​裸​进程​：​先​ import hermes_bootstrap ​选定​已​提交​的​环境​，​再谈​别的​。 stdin ​是​ owner ​的​有界​ bootstrap/​控制​管道​（MAX_FRAME = 4MB），stdout ​的​复制品​被​预留​给​ ​帧化​事件​——​运行​时​导入​重定向​普通​输出​前​就位​；​指派​机密​与​启动​凭据​不​出现​在​ argv ​或​日志​里​。 safe_worker_policy.py ​在​新鲜​ exec ​里​一次性​绑定​冻结​的​会​话​配置​（frozen dataclass、​无​重置​、 ​无​环境​开关​），​此后​每个​ config ​读取​者​返回​同一​快照​；​排障​ worker ​额外​允许​ safe/ignore-user-config ​旁路​（stdlib-only，hermes_cli ​的​ config ​层要​导入​它​）。process_bootstrap.py ​管​进程​级​传输​经济性​： ​共享​ httpx ​传输​池​（_SHARED_TRANSPORTS，​同​ (verify, proxy, happy-eyeballs) ​身份​复用​，​上限​ 32）——​否则​ N ​个​委托​子​代理​各持​一套​ TLS ​池​指向​同一​ provider；​外加​ Happy Eyeballs ​后端​与​防崩​ stdio。

docs.title: 8. ​辅助​路径​：side_question、oneshot、review
docs.text:
# agent/side_question.py:1-6（​模块​ docstring ​节选​）
"""Context-aware side questions (``/btw``): answer a question ABOUT the conversation without
touching it (no synthetic turns, no role-alternation risk, no prompt-cache invalidation).

Preferred path: a detached cache-parity fork of the live parent ``AIAgent`` replays its
snapshot verbatim against the warm prefix cache (tools denied at dispatch, persistence
detached, usage attributed to the parent)."""
  • side_question.py：​首选​缓存​对齐​ fork（​回放​父​快照​，​工具​在​ dispatch ​侧​拒绝​、​持久​化​分离​、 ​用量​记给父​）；​无活​ agent（​网关​已​逐出​）​则​回退​到​渲染​转录​走​ oneshot.run_oneshot（​每​消息​ 2000 ​字符​、​总量​ 24000 ​字符​预算​）。trim_snapshot_for_fork ​截到​"​完整​ assistant ​文本​"​结尾​， ​半截​ turn ​会破​前缀​缓存​。
  • side_question_lease.py：​插件​侧问​（ctx.side_question，​能力​ llm.side_question）​在​ turn ​收尾​时​把​请求​输入​拍​成​ SideQuestionCapture（​弱​引用​父​）​并发​ post_llm_call ​一个​不​透明​ token； ​一个​ token ​只​买​一次​请求​（​共享​给​所有​收到​该​钩子​的​插件​），TTL 60s ​或父​开下​一​ turn ​即​失效​； ​未​托管​ turn（cron、​委托​子​代理​）​不发​ token——"​没​人​在场​读​一个​用​主模型​ token ​买​的​答案​"。
  • side_question_request.py：​执行层​——fork ​走​ turn ​循环​自己​的​请求​相位​（​组装​、​带​ LLM ​中间件​的​ payload ​构建​、perform_api_call）​恰好​一次​：​无​工具​派发​、​无​重试​、​无​回退​模型​、​无​压缩​、​无​ ​持久​化​；​用量​以​ plugin_side_question:<plugin_id> ​记账​。
  • oneshot.py：​非会​话​型​单发​调用​（commit ​信息​、​改名​建议​、​摘要​），​显式​ instructions ​或​注册​ template；oneshot_footprint.py ​用​数据​说明​为什么​ -q ​会话​砍掉​自​改进​循环​（21 ​条​轨迹​里​ skill ​文本​占​工具​结果​字节​的​ 34%）：ONESHOT_DISABLED_TOOLSETS = ("clarify",)、 delegation.oneshot_max_children ​封顶​子​代理​。
  • review_engine.py：/review ​各​表面​共享​——​快照​近​ 10 ​条​消息​（​每条​ 12k ​字符​帽​）​拼​ _REVIEW_GOAL，​走​ delegate_task(background=true) ​同一​异步​轨​；​模型​路由​ auxiliary.review ​优先​，​否则​父​凭据​以​ credentials_cfg ​下​传​。review_idle_queue.py： ​本地​托管​ llama-server ​上​评审​ fork ​会​霸占​ GPU、​被​下​一​ turn ​取消​（​解码​成本​照付​、​学习​成果​丢失​）， ​于是​改​排队​、​等​ supervisor /slots ​安静​ 15s ​才​发​；​每会话​一槽​、​最新​快照​胜出​、​超​ 30 ​分钟​照发​。
  • primary_runtime_snapshot.py：_snapshot_primary_runtime ​在​ agent ​构建​与​主动​切换​模型​时​ ​记录​拥有​该​凭据​的​ custom entry；​回​退后​的​下​ turn ​恢复​按​这份​快照​圈定​凭据​池​，​而​绝不​按​ ​活​的​ config.yaml ​重新​查​——​被​编辑​/​删除​的​条目​不能​把​别的​账号​的​ key ​塞​给​这个​会话​。

docs.title: 9. ​回到​ delegate_tool：​几个​承重​常量​（​供​交叉​阅读​）
docs.text:
# tools/delegate_tool.py:106 / :302 / :608-609
DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS = 250
        ephemeral_system_prompt=child_prompt, log_prefix=f"[subagent-{task_index}]", platform="subagent",
    default_max_iter = cfg.get("max_iterations", DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS)  # ​调用​方​传入​被​忽略​：​配置​为​权威​

​子​代理​ turn ​以​ platform="subagent" ​起​，​经​ relay ​元​数据​携带​；​迭代​帽​默认​ 250——config migration 36 ​从​ 50 ​升上来​的​（hermes_cli/config_migrations.py:779："50 truncated substantial delegated work"）。​记忆​侧​的​父​观察​钩子​在​ MemoryManager.on_delegation（memory_learning.md）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/delegate_tool.py（04_tools/delegation_tools.md）：​生命周期​本体​——task ​拆分​、​子​代理​ spawn/join、_run_single_child ​的​工具​面​保存​/​恢复​、​后台​单元​结果​回流​；​本组​的​ provider/registry/ context ​是​它​的​决策​与​作用域​供给方​。
  • plugins/：PluginContext.register_delegation_provider ​注册​ backend；​默认​ backend ​就是​ plugins/delegation/default（​核心​工具​不​依赖​插件​ sweep，​注册表​可首用​自​加载​）； subagent_lifecycle ​经​ PluginContext.subagent_lifecycle ​发布​。
  • agent/ ​内​：inline_tool_executors.py ​的​ delegate_task ​拦截​ → run_agent._dispatch_delegate_task （tool_execution.md）；bind_subagent_parent ​由​ TurnFacadeMixin ​调用​；​子​代理​的​ platform="subagent" ​使​ agent_context="subagent"（fork ​写​/​召回​被​ manager ​抑制​， ​见​ memory_learning.md）；delegation_context ​被​ skill_preprocessing ​的​内联​ shell ​复用​。
  • gateway/：​多​ profile ​作用域​ helper（set_hermes_home_override、secret scope）​同时​服务​ profile ​路由​的​子​代理​与​ profile_scoped_chore；​托管​模式​下​的​ worker RPC/​收据​协议​由​ hermes_state_worker_* ​与​ gateway/session_worker_child.py ​配合​。
  • cron/：side_question_lease ​不​给​ cron ​发​ token；delegation_context.non_dispatcher_owned_context ​防止​ worker ​里​的​ cron ​运行​被​误读​为​ dispatcher ​所有​。
  • config：delegation.max_iterations ​默认​ 250（migration 36）、max_concurrent_children（migration 37 ​提到​ 10）、oneshot_max_children；auxiliary.{curator,side_question,review,background_review}.* ​是​各​辅助​ fork ​的​模型​槽​位​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​委派​子系统​把​"​拆分​策略​"​与​"​执行​机制​"​切得​很​干净​：core ​拥有​全部​机制​（​隔离​、​深度​、​并发​、​后台​、 ​停止​扇出​、​结果​回填​），​插件​只​回答​"​这个​ task ​走​哪条​路​"，​且​答案​是​纯​数据​。​三个​安全​母题​反复​出现​： fail-closed（backend ​不可​用​是​工具​错误​而​非​静默​换路​；​子​上下文​的​身份​门​默认​拒绝​）、​作用域​显式​ （contextvar ​标记​ + ​子​进程​环境​清洗​ + ​板​围栏​，​绝不​改​进程​全局​）、​缓存​钉死​（backend/schema ​按​ ​会话​冻结​，/delegation ​默认​等​下​一会​话​、apply_now ​才​破​一次​缓存​）。​辅助​路径​（/btw、/review、 curator fork）​共享​同一​形态​——​缓存​对齐​ fork、dispatch ​侧​工具​削减​、​用量​记账​回父​会​话​——​学会​一个​ ​就读​懂​了​全部​。

docs.title: 错误​分类​与​韧性​（agent/ ​错误​子系统​）
文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​的​错误处理​是​一条​「​分类​ → ​路由​ → ​韧性​原语​」​的​流水线​：

  • ​分类器​ error_classifier.py（1,637 ​行​）：​把​任意​ API ​异常​压成​带​恢复​提示​的​ ClassifiedError（FailoverReason ​枚举​ + 4 ​个​布尔​提示​）。​这是​错误​域​的​单一​ ​真相​源​。
  • ​恢复​路由​ turn_recovery.py（1,999 ​行​）+ turn_recovery_autorecover.py （​耗尽​后​的​等待​-​重试​阶梯​）+ turn_recovery_codex.py（​陈旧​ reasoning ​阶​）—— ​在​ 02_core/turn_pipeline.md ​已​从​循环​视角​讲过​，​本篇​从​分类器​视角​收束​。
  • ​失败​面​ error_surface.py：​把​内部​分类​映射​成​ UI ​稳定​描述符​ {"layer", "code", "retryable"}。
  • ​中断​族​ interrupt_compat.py / interrupt_control.py / interrupt_scope.py / estop.py：​用户​取消​、​范围​取消​、​全局​急停​。
  • ​边界​原语​ deadline.py / iteration_budget.py / turn_liveness.py / retry_utils.py / fallback_cooldown.py：​超时​、​预算​、​看门狗​、​退避​、​冷却​。

docs.title: 1. ​错误​分类学​：FailoverReason + ClassifiedError
docs.text:
​分类​的​结果​不是​字符串​而是​结构化​恢复​建议​。FailoverReason ​有​ 30+ ​个值​，​每个​值​ ​注释​里​直接​写​恢复​策略​：

# agent/error_classifier.py:34（​节选​）
class FailoverReason(enum.Enum):
    """Why an API call failed — determines recovery strategy."""
    auth = "auth"                        # Transient auth (401/403) — refresh/rotate
    auth_permanent = "auth_permanent"    # Auth failed after refresh — abort
    billing = "billing"                  # 402 or confirmed credit exhaustion — rotate immediately
    rate_limit = "rate_limit"            # 429 or quota-based throttling — backoff then rotate
    upstream_rate_limit = "upstream_rate_limit"  # Aggregator's upstream model 429 — fallback model, key is healthy
    overloaded = "overloaded"            # 503/529 — provider overloaded, backoff
    timeout = "timeout"                  # Connection/read timeout — rebuild client + retry
    context_overflow = "context_overflow"  # Context too large — compress, not failover
    payload_too_large = "payload_too_large"  # 413 — compress payload
    model_not_found = "model_not_found"  # 404 or invalid model — fallback to different model
    content_policy_blocked = "content_policy_blocked"  # Provider safety filter rejected this prompt — deterministic per-request, don't retry unchanged
    reasoning_mandatory = "reasoning_mandatory"  # Route rejects reasoning: {enabled: false} — send the disable no more this session and retry
    unknown = "unknown"                  # Unclassifiable — retry with backoff

ClassifiedError ​携带​四个​恢复​提示​，​重试​循环​读​提示​而​不是​重新​分类​：

# agent/error_classifier.py:70（​节选​）
@dataclass
class ClassifiedError:
    """Structured classification of an API error with recovery hints."""

    reason: FailoverReason
    status_code: Optional[int] = None
    provider: Optional[str] = None
    model: Optional[str] = None
    message: str = ""
    error_context: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    # Recovery hints — the retry loop checks these instead of re-classifying.
    retryable: bool = True
    should_compress: bool = False
    should_rotate_credential: bool = False
    should_fallback: bool = False

    @property
    def billing_unverified(self) -> bool:
        """True when a ``billing`` verdict rests on an ambiguous body (#82154)."""
        return bool(self.error_context.get("billing_unverified"))

billing_unverified ​是​个​好​例子​：Anthropic ​对​内容​过滤​拒绝​也​会​返回​「out of extra usage」​的​ body（#82154），​所以​裁决​保持​ billing ​但​打​上​「​未​证实​」​标记​，​让​面层​ ​措辞​谨慎​、​密钥​池用​短​冷却​。

docs.title: 2. ​分类​流水线​：​阶段​表​ + ​首个​裁决​获胜
docs.text:
classify_api_error ​按​ _STAGES ​顺序​跑​插件​裁决​ → provider ​特例​ → ​错误码​ → ​消息​模式​ → ​传输层​ → HTTP ​状态​，​首个​非​ None ​胜出​，​否则​ unknown：

# agent/error_classifier.py:1068（​节选​）
def classify_api_error(
    error: Exception, *, provider: str = "", model: str = "",
    approx_tokens: int = 0, context_length: int = 200000, num_messages: int = 0,
    base_url: str = "",
    api_key: Any = None,
) -> ClassifiedError:
    """Classify an API error into a structured recovery recommendation (see ``_STAGES``)."""
    from hermes_cli.anon_auth import is_anonymous_request
    status_code = _extract_status_code(error)
    # Some SDK RateLimitErrors (OpenAI-compatible relays) may not set .status_code; force 429.
    if status_code is None and type(error).__name__ == "RateLimitError":
        status_code = 429
    body = _extract_error_body(error)
    c = _Ctx(error, status_code, body, _build_error_msg(error, body), provider, model,
             approx_tokens, context_length, num_messages, str(base_url or ""),
             anonymous=is_anonymous_request(provider, api_key))
    verdict = next((v for v in (stage(c) for stage in _STAGES) if v is not None), _V_UNKNOWN)
    ...
    base = {"status_code": status_code, "provider": provider, "model": model, "message": message}
    return ClassifiedError(**{**base, **verdict})

​阶段​顺序​本身​就是​设计​：​插件​/profile ​的​针对性​裁决​先于​通用​模式​，​结构化​错误码​ ​先于​易碎​的​文本​子串​。base_url ​让​「​请求​发到​了​错误​的​ host」（​陈旧​的​ model.base_url）​能​被​识别​为​离​线路​由​而​非坏​密钥​（#113719）。

docs.title: 3. ​恢复​阶梯​全景
docs.text:
​分类​之后​控制权​流经​的​阶梯​（​细节​在​ turn_pipeline.md，​此处​是​分类器​视角​的​地图​）：

  API ​调用​抛​异常​
        │
        ▼
 classify_api_error ──► ClassifiedError(reason, hints)
        │
        ├─ context_overflow / payload_too_large ──► agent/turn_overflow.py
        │        ​压缩​ + ​重启​调用​（OverflowVerdict: return/break/continue/fallthrough）
        │
        ├─ retryable (timeout/overloaded/server_error/unknown)
        │        │
        │        ▼
        │   turn_recovery.py ​恢复​链​ → retry_utils.jittered_backoff ​重试​
        │        │ ​耗尽​
        │        ▼
        │   turn_recovery_autorecover.py ​等待​-​重试​阶梯​（​分钟​级​退避​）
        │
        ├─ should_rotate_credential (auth/billing/rate_limit)
        │        → fallback_cooldown ​冷却​主​路由​ → ​密钥​池​轮换​
        │
        ├─ should_fallback (upstream_rate_limit/model_not_found/...)
        │        → ​走​ fallback ​链换​模型​/​供应商​
        │
        └─ ​不可​重试​ (auth_permanent/content_policy_blocked/format_error)
                 → turn ​以​ failure_reason=FailoverReason ​值​结束​
                        → error_surface.py ​映射​成​ {"layer","code","retryable"}
                        → TUI/Desktop ​展示​

docs.title: 4. ​退避​与​冷却
docs.text:
retry_utils.py ​的​核心​是​去​相关​抖动​退避​ —— ​多会话​同时​撞​上​同一个​限流​供应商​ ​时​，​固定​指数​退避​会​形成​重试​尖峰​：

# agent/retry_utils.py:121
def jittered_backoff(attempt: int, *, base_delay: float = 5.0, max_delay: float = 120.0, jitter_ratio: float = 0.5) -> float:

​配套​的​ parse_retry_after_seconds（​行​ 30）​解析​ Retry-After ​头​与​多种​「quota resets in/at」​消息​格式​，adaptive_rate_limit_backoff（​行​ 155）​把​两者​结合​。​主​ ​路由​的​限流​冷却​由​ fallback_cooldown.py ​统一​武装​，​回退​行走​与​ restore_primary_runtime ​共享​同​一份​状态​：

# agent/fallback_cooldown.py:1
"""Primary rate-limit cooldown arming and per-session model rejection markers, shared by the
fallback walk (chat_completion_helpers) and restore_primary_runtime (agent_runtime_helpers)."""

docs.title: 5. ​中断​族​：​三层​取消
docs.text:
compat → control → scope ​是从​「​怎么​调​」​到​「​谁​能​取消​谁​」​的​三层​：

  • interrupt_compat.py（55 ​行​）：​探测​可​调用​对象​是否​支持​某​关键字​参数​ —— ​让​硬​ ​中断请求​兼容​新旧​生产者​签名​。
  • interrupt_control.py：InterruptControlMixin ​拥有​软​/​硬​中断请求​、​工具​线程​ ​中断​传播​、pending steer/redirect ​队列​。
  • interrupt_scope.py ​解决​一个​真实​痛点​：host ​在​ worker ​线程​上​跑​阻塞​命令​时​， ​看不见​ CLI ​子​命令​内部​ fork ​出​的​ AIAgent，​没法​调​ interrupt()：
# agent/interrupt_scope.py:1（​模块​ docstring，​节选​）
"""Host-owned cancellation for agents created deep inside synchronous work.

A host that runs a blocking command on a worker thread (Hermes Console) never sees
the ``AIAgent`` a CLI subcommand forks inside it, so it cannot call ``interrupt()``
when the user cancels. The host binds an :class:`InterruptScope` around the work;
every ``run_conversation()`` under that scope registers its agent, and
``scope.cancel()`` hard-interrupts them from any thread. Agents registering after
the cancel are interrupted immediately, so a cancel never loses the race with a
turn that has not started yet (#106179).
"""

「cancel ​之后​注册​的​ agent ​立即​被​中断​」​堵住​了​取消​与​未​开始​ turn ​的​竞态​。

docs.title: 6. ​边界​原语​：deadline / iteration_budget / turn_liveness / estop
docs.text: deadline.py ​是​统一​的​有限​执行​原语​（#85125）：resolve_timeout（config > legacy env > default）、clamp_timeout（​超大​超时​在​ macOS ​上​会​溢出​ time_t，

docs.title: 83220）、run_bounded_async/run_bounded_sync（daemon Timer ​驱动​ —— ​事件​循环
docs.text:
​卡死​时​超时​依然​触发​）、poll_until（​唯一​合法​的​轮询​循环​写法​）。

iteration_budget.py ​是​线程​安全​的​迭代​预算​，​父​/​子​代理​各自​持有​：

# agent/iteration_budget.py:25（​节选​）
class IterationBudget:
    """Thread-safe iteration counter; ``execute_code`` (programmatic tool calling)
    iterations are refunded via :meth:`refund` so they don't eat into the budget."""

    def __init__(self, max_total: int):
        self.max_total = max_total
        self._used = 0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def consume(self) -> bool:
        """Try to consume one iteration.  Returns True if allowed."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._used >= self.max_total:
                return False
            self._used += 1
            return True

​父代​默认​ 500（max_iterations），​子​代理​默认​ 50（delegation.max_iterations）， ​所以​父​+​子​的​总​迭代​可以​超过​父代​上限​ —— ​这是​刻意​的​设计​而​非​漏洞​。​预检​压缩​没有​真正​ ​到达​ provider ​的​调用​会​被​ refund() ​退回​（​见​ turn_context_compaction.py:103）。

turn_liveness.py ​处理​「turn ​卡死​但​租约​还​在​续期​」​的​最坏​情况​：​无声​停滞​的​ turn ​会​被​看门狗​强制​中止​。​中止​决定​绑定​观测​到​的​ (generation, timestamp)，​提交​回调​在​ _touch_activity ​加锁​的​同一​把​锁​下​复核​ —— ​恢复​了​的​ turn ​永不​被​误杀​。

estop.py ​是​全局​急停​：hermes pause ​写​哨兵​文件​ $HERMES_HOME/ESTOP，cron ​调度​器​、kanban ​分发​器​、​新​网关​ turn ​看到​它​就​跳​过​工作​；​在​飞​的​工作​永不​杀死​。 ​检查​是​一两次​未​缓存​的​ os.stat；​损坏​/​空​文件​也​算​已​启用​（fail safe， touch ~/.hermes/ESTOP ​即可​用​）。

docs.title: 7. ​错误​面​：​给​ UI ​的​稳定​描述符
docs.text:
error_surface.py ​把​ FailoverReason（​或​原始​异常​）​映射​成小而​稳定​的​线​上​描述符​， ​且​永不​抛​异常​ —— ​诊断​机制​不能​弄坏​它​所​描述​的​错误​路径​：

# agent/error_surface.py:1（​节选​）
"""Structured error-surface descriptors for UI clients (Desktop/TUI).

Maps the internal failure taxonomy (``FailoverReason`` values carried in turn
results as ``failure_reason``, or raw exceptions from the turn dispatcher)
onto a small, stable wire descriptor ``{"layer", "code", "retryable"}``.
Layers: provider (model API rejected/failed), endpoint (user-configured
custom/local endpoint transport failure), streaming (SSE dropped mid-turn),
auth, billing (fallback signal; clients usually have a richer
``billing_block``), gateway (local runtime errored), disk (disk full).
Dependency-light and NEVER raises: surfacing diagnostics must not break the
error path it describes. Descriptors are advisory — clients fall back to
string sniffing when absent or partial.
"""

​配套​的​ timeout_error_summary.py ​把​「Request timed out.」​这种​ SDK ​裸​文本​升级成​ ​带​阶段​（​连接​/​读取​/​流中​）​和​「​该调​哪个​配置​」​的​一句​话​；api_error_summary.py ​负责​ API ​错误​的​脱敏​摘要​（​密钥​掩码​、​结构化​细节​收敛​）。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​文件​:​行号​ ​职责​ FailoverReason error_classifier.py:34 30+ ​失败​原因​枚举​，​注释​即​恢复​策略​ ClassifiedError error_classifier.py:70 ​分类​结果​ + 4 ​恢复​提示​ + billing_unverified classify_api_error() error_classifier.py:1068 ​阶段​表​分类​流水线​，​首个​裁决​获胜​ recover_from_overflow() turn_overflow.py:44 ​溢出​/413 ​恢复​，​产出​ OverflowVerdict jittered_backoff() retry_utils.py:121 ​去​相关​抖动​退避​（​防​重试​尖峰​） parse_retry_after_seconds() retry_utils.py:30 Retry-After ​头​ / quota ​消息​解析​ arm_primary_rate_limit_cooldown ​等​ fallback_cooldown.py ​主​路由​限流​冷却​ + ​模型​拒绝​标记​ InterruptControlMixin interrupt_control.py:9 ​软​/​硬​中断​、​工具​线程​传播​、steer/redirect ​队列​ InterruptScope interrupt_scope.py host ​对​深层​同步​工作​中​的​ agent ​的​取消​ engage() / is_engaged() estop.py ​全局​急停​哨兵​（​在​飞​工作​不杀​） resolve_timeout() / run_bounded_async() deadline.py ​统一​超时​解析​ + daemon Timer ​有限​执行​ IterationBudget iteration_budget.py:25 ​线程​安全​消费​/​退还​预算​（​父​ 500 / ​子​ 50） TurnLivenessWatchdog turn_liveness.py:90 ​无声​停滞​ turn ​的​看门狗​强制​中止​ describe_error（surface） error_surface.py FailoverReason → {"layer","code","retryable"} ApiRequestHooksMixin api_request_hooks.py api_request_error ​生命周期​ hook ​派发​ ClientLifecycleMixin client_lifecycle.py:8 ​客户端​生命周期​：owner ​线程​ close vs ​陌生​线程​ abort、​凭据​轮换

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ error_classifier.py ​错误​分类器​：FailoverReason/ClassifiedError/​阶段​表​流水线​ error_surface.py UI ​稳定​错误​描述符​（​永不​抛​异常​） errors.py ​两个​领域​异常​：EmptyStreamError、MoAPresetNotFoundError api_error_summary.py API ​错误​摘要​：​权益​检测​、​脱敏​、​结构化​细节​ timeout_error_summary.py ​传输​超时​的​分阶段​一句​话​摘要​ api_request_hooks.py api_request_error hook ​载荷​与​派发​ turn_recovery.py ​分类​后​的​恢复​分支​（1,999 ​行​，​见​ turn_pipeline.md） turn_recovery_autorecover.py ​重试​耗尽​后​的​等待​-​重试​阶梯​ turn_recovery_codex.py Codex ​陈旧​ reasoning ​阶​恢复​ turn_overflow.py ​溢出​/413 → ​压缩​恢复​（OverflowVerdict） retry_utils.py ​抖动​退避​、Retry-After ​解析​、​自​适应​限流​退避​ fallback_cooldown.py ​主​路由​限流​冷却​ + ​每会话​模型​拒绝​标记​ interrupt_compat.py ​显式​停止​生产者​的​签名​兼容​探测​ interrupt_control.py ​软​/​硬​中断​ + steer/redirect ​控制​面​（InterruptControlMixin） interrupt_scope.py host ​拥有​的​范围​取消​（​注册​后​即​取消​，#106179） estop.py ​全局​急停​哨兵​（$HERMES_HOME/ESTOP，​在​飞​不​杀​） deadline.py ​统一​ deadline ​层​：​解析​/​钳制​/​有限​执行​/​进程​树​击杀​ iteration_budget.py ​线程​安全​迭代​预算​（​消费​/​退还​） turn_liveness.py turn ​停滞​看门狗​（​采样​状态机​ + watcher ​线程​） async_utils.py ​异步​辅助​ client_lifecycle.py ​工具​资源​回收​ + wire ​客户端​生命周期​ + ​凭据​轮换​ jiter_preload.py jiter ​预​加载​（​加速​ json ​解析​，​可​选​） ssl_verify.py TLS ​校验​处理​（​确定性​失败​快速​给出​指引​） proxy_bypass.py ​代理​绕过​判定​ （​关联​）interrupt ​相关​ exit ​处理​ ​见​ turn_pipeline.md ​的​ turn ​退出​路径

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/chat_completion_helpers：try_activate_fallback ​消费​ should_fallback ​提示​并​与​ fallback_cooldown ​协作​；​陈旧​连击​熔断​抛出​的​ RuntimeError ​也​会​回到​ classify_api_error ​走​通用​分类​。
  • agent/turn_context_compaction / turn_preflight / turn_overflow： context_overflow/payload_too_large ​的​消费者​；_refund_api_call ​退回​ IterationBudget。
  • agent/streaming：​流​中段​断​（SSE ​掉线​）​是​ error_surface ​的​ streaming ​层​；errors.EmptyStreamError ​由流​路径​抛出​。
  • gateway / cron / kanban：estop.is_engaged ​是​新​工作​的​统一​闸门​； interrupt_scope ​服务​ Hermes Console ​这​类​ host。
  • TUI / desktop：error_surface.py ​描述符​ + billing_block ​富化​是​ UI ​显示​错误​的​合同​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​错误​子系统​的​架构​是​一台​编译器​：classify_api_error ​把​不​可控​的​原始​异常​「​词法​ ​解析​」​成​结构化​ ClassifiedError，​重试​循环​是​它​的​「​调度​器​」，​只​消费​四个​布尔​提示​ ​而​不​重复​解析​。​三条​韧性​支柱​各自​补​一个​盲区​：​退避​+​冷却管​速率​（​抖动​防​尖峰​、 ​冷却​防​反复​撞墙​），deadline+​预算​+​看门狗​管​卡死​（​事件​循环​阻塞​也​有​ daemon Timer ​兜底​、​无声​停滞​ turn ​有​强制​中止​），​中断​族​管人​（​软​/​硬​中断​、​范围​取消​、​急停​， ​且​急​停​永不​杀​在​飞​工作​）。​贯穿​其中​的​是​同一​价值观​：​分类​宁可​打​上​「​未​证实​」​标记​也​ ​不硬​下结论​（billing_unverified）、​诊断​层​永不​抛​异常​（error_surface）、​降级​ ​路径​宁可​ fail-safe（ESTOP ​空​文件​也​算​启用​）。​下​一篇​读​ turn_recovery.py ​时​， ​把​每个​分支​对​回​ FailoverReason ​的​一个​值​，​整张​恢复​网络​就​清晰​了​。

docs.title: memory_learning.md — ​记忆系统​与​学习​图​：MemoryProvider ABC、MemoryManager ​扇出​与​"​学习​可见​化​"
文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​的​记忆​是​双层​的​：​内​建​文件​存储​（MEMORY.md / USER.md，​由​ tools/memory_tool.py ​承担​， ​在​ 04_tools ​讲​）​永远​可用​；​外部​记忆​后​端​（Honcho、Hindsight……）​以​插件​形式​接入​ plugins/memory/<name>/， ​一次​最​多​启用​一个​。​本篇​讲​ agent ​侧​的​四个​问题​：

  1. ​外部​ provider ​如何​被​抽象​（MemoryProvider ABC）；
  2. MemoryManager ​如何​把​一次​ turn ​的​钩子​扇出​给​"​内​建恒​可用​ + ​至多​一个​外部​"​的​ provider ​列表​， ​且​一个​ provider ​卡死​不​拖垮​另​一个​；
  3. ​召回​内容​如何​安全​进出​上下文​（​围栏​防​注入​）；
  4. ​一个​进程​服务​多个​ profile ​时​，​凭​什么​不​把​ A profile ​的​记忆​写​进​ B profile ​的​库​（​调用者​作用域​ fail-closed）。

​最后​带​一​小组​"​学习​可见​化​"​文件​：​把​ agent ​学到​的​技能​与​记忆​装配成​图​（learning_graph），​供​桌面​星图​、 hermes journey、TUI /journey ​展示​与​编辑​，​外加​ /learn ​技能​创作​提示​词​与会​话​洞察​引擎​。

docs.title: 1. ctx_bound ​与​ spawn_context_thread —— ​为什么​是​"​强制​模式​"
docs.text:
Profile ​隔离​是​ ContextVar ​作用域​的​ HERMES_HOME ​覆盖​加​每​ turn ​的​ secret scope。​裸​ threading.Thread ​启动​的​ worker ​拿到​的​是​空​ context——​它​就​悄悄​落​在​默认​ profile ​上​，​或者​在​机密​读取​上​直接​失败​。 ​所以​每个​记忆​后台任务​都​必须​携带​派生​者​的​ contextvars：

# agent/memory_provider.py:21-33
def ctx_bound(fn: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]:
    """Bind ``fn`` to the CALLER's contextvars for another thread/executor. Profile isolation
    is a ContextVar-scoped HERMES_HOME override plus the per-turn secret scope; a worker started
    with an empty context silently lands on the default profile (or fails closed on secrets)."""
    ctx = contextvars.copy_context()
    return lambda *args, **kwargs: ctx.run(fn, *args, **kwargs)


def spawn_context_thread(target, *, name, daemon=True, args=(), kwargs=None) -> threading.Thread:
    """Unstarted thread running *target* under the spawner's contextvars (see ctx_bound).
    Every memory-provider background job (prefetch, sync, writer loops) must go through this."""
    return threading.Thread(target=ctx_bound(target), args=args, kwargs=kwargs, name=name, daemon=daemon)

​为什么​"​强制​"：MemoryManager ​的​所有​后台​提交​（_submit_background、​外部​ prefetch ​线程​、 MemoryManagerTools ​的​ provider ​工具​调用​）​都​经​这​两个​入口​。​绕开​它们​ = ​跨​ profile ​静默​串库​， ​这是​ HX002/HX012 ​类​缺陷​在​记忆​域​的​具名​形态​。​注意​ spawn_context_thread ​返回​未​启动​的​线程​—— ​门控​（_StuckCallGate.enter）​要​先​登记​、​再启动​，​避免​"​启动​了​却​没​登记​"​的​孤儿​。

docs.title: 2. MemoryProvider ABC —— ​多路复用​契约
docs.text:
ABC ​分​三层​：​必须​实现​的​核心​生命周期​（is_available/initialize/get_tool_schemas）、​有​默认​实现​的​ ​每​ turn ​钩子​（system_prompt_block/prefetch/queue_prefetch/recall_status/sync_turn/handle_tool_call/ shutdown）、​以及​ opt-in ​钩子​（on_turn_start/on_session_end/on_session_switch/on_pre_compress/ on_delegation/identity_signature/get_config_schema/save_config/on_memory_write/on_profile_created...）。 docstring ​里​的​多路复用​契约​（#140058）​是​本​文件​的​重心​：

# agent/memory_provider.py:87-103（​节选​）
class MemoryProvider(ABC):
    """Multiplexing contract (#140058). One gateway process can serve several profiles, and each agent's
    ``MemoryManager`` owns its own provider instance, initialized for one profile. A provider must:

    - hand every load a NEW instance (``register(ctx)`` / the loader constructs one per agent). The
      manager refuses an instance another profile's manager already bound, rather than rebinding it;
    - bind every store, path, client, bank or tenant from ``initialize()``'s ``hermes_home`` ...;
    - keep no profile-specific mutable state at module or class level, and never "rebind" a shared
      binding per call: two profiles' calls interleave on different threads."""

​要点​：​一个​实例​服务​一个​ profile。​插件​在​ loader ​处​给​每个​ agent ​发新​实例​；​管理器​用​ claim_instance()（memory_caller_scope.py:111）​拒绝​"​第二个​ profile ​复用​同一​实例​"，​而​不是​重新​绑定​它​。

docs.title: 3. MemoryManager ​扇出​ —— ​单工​后台​线程​ + ​停滞​门
docs.text:
​所有​钩子​扇出​共用​ _each_provider：​逐​ provider ​调用​、​记录​并吞​掉​异常​，"​一个​ provider ​挂​了​不​拖累​另​一个​"。

# agent/memory_manager.py:244-254
def _each_provider(self, label, call, *, level=logging.DEBUG, providers=None, exc_info=False):
    """Call ``call(provider)`` per provider, logging+swallowing failures; returns successes in order."""
    results: list[Any] = []
    for provider in self._providers if providers is None else providers:
        try:
            results.append(call(provider))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.log(level, "Memory provider '%s' %s: %s", provider.name, label, e, exc_info=exc_info)
    return results

turn ​结束​后​的​写​（sync_all）​与​预取​排队​（queue_prefetch_all）​绝不​内联​——provider ​的​ sync_turn ​可能​阻塞​数分钟​，​曾​把​ run_conversation ​在​用户​已​看到​回复​后​继续​吊住​。​它们​被​ _submit_background ​压到​单​ worker ​的​ DaemonThreadPoolExecutor：​序列化​保证​ turn N ​的​写​先于​ N+1，​并​按​ "write"/"prefetch" ​两个​耐久​级​追踪​ future，​供​关停​时​有限​排水​：

# agent/memory_manager.py:494-531（​节选​）
def _submit_background(self, fn, *, kind: str = "write") -> None:
    """Queue ``fn`` on the serialized worker (created lazily; None once shutting down)..."""
    fn = ctx_bound(in_owner_home(self._bound_scope, fn))     # ← ​作用域​强制​：ctx_bound + ​显式​ home
    executor = None if self._shutting_down else self._sync_executor
    ...
    with self._sync_executor_lock:
        if self._shutting_down:
            logger.warning("Memory manager is shutting down; rejecting late %s task", kind)
            return
        if executor is not None:
            future = executor.submit(fn)
            self._background_futures[future] = kind
    ...

​这里​叠​了​三层​防线​：ctx_bound（​携带​ contextvars）→ in_owner_home（​显式​设置​属主​ profile ​的​ HERMES_HOME ​覆盖​，​不​依赖​提交者​上下文​恰好​带​着​它​，memory_caller_scope.py:140）→ ​单工​执行器​。 ​外部​ provider ​的​调用​还有​ _StuckCallGate（​进程​级​准入​，​按​ (home, provider) ​计​ stuck ​数​， ​超过​ _MAX_STUCK_CALLS=4 ​就​关门​、​每​ _PROBE_INTERVAL_S=60s ​放​一个​探针​），​以及​ _BACKGROUND_CALL_STALL_S=30s ​的​停滞​判定​——​卡死​的​后​端​最​多​钉住​有限​个​线程​，​而​不是​每个​新​ manager ​再添​一个​。shutdown_all() ​先​ executor.shutdown(wait=False) + ​限时​ 5 ​秒​ wait() ​排水​， ​再​逆序​关停​ provider，​并​把​放弃​的​写​/​预取​数量​记进​ shutdown_drain_state。

docs.title: 4. ​会话​边界​：end → switch ​必须​串行
docs.text:
/new、​压缩​轮换​等​场景​要求​"​旧会话​提取​"（LLM ​绑定​、​秒级​）​严格​先于​ on_session_switch ​重绑​。 ​内联​跑​会​卡住​命令​（#16454），ad-hoc ​线程​会​竞态​错记​转录​（transcript misattributed）。​解法​是​把​两个​钩子​ ​打包​成​一个​任务​，​丢进​与​其它​写​共享​的​那个​单工​ worker，​靠​ FIFO ​天然​串行​：

# agent/memory_manager.py:659-690（​节选​）
def commit_session_boundary_async(self, messages, *, new_session_id, parent_session_id="", reason="new_session"):
    """Queue old-session extraction + provider rebinding as ONE serialized task.
    ...
    Submitting BOTH hooks as one task on the manager's single background worker gives both properties at
    a single chokepoint: the caller returns immediately, and the worker's FIFO order serializes
    end→switch against every other provider write ..."""
    if not self._providers or not self._owner_allows("session_boundary"):
        return
    snapshot = list(messages or [])

    def _run():
        try:
            self.on_session_end(snapshot)
        ...
        try:
            self.on_session_switch(new_session_id, parent_session_id=parent_session_id, reset=True, ...)
        ...

    self._submit_background(_run)

docs.title: 5. ​围栏​防​注入​：​进​得来​、​出不去
docs.text:
​召回​内容​进​上下文​前​包上​围栏​ + ​系统​注记​；provider ​输出​（​会​被​回显​/​流式​）​离开​ agent ​前​剥掉​同样​形状​的​ ​围栏​——​防止​"​记忆​内容​伪装成​新​输入​"​的​注入​回流​：

# agent/memory_context.py:169-185
def build_memory_context_block(raw_context: str) -> str:
    """Wrap prefetched memory in a fenced block with system note."""
    if not raw_context or not raw_context.strip():
        return ""
    sanitized = sanitize_context(raw_context)
    if sanitized != raw_context:
        logger.warning("memory provider returned pre-wrapped context; stripped")
    clean = _drop_repeated_recall_lines(sanitized)
    return (
        "<memory-context>\n"
        "[System note: The following is recalled memory context, "
        "NOT new user input. Treat as authoritative reference data — "
        "this is the agent's persistent memory and should inform all responses.]\n\n"
        f"{clean}\n"
        "</memory-context>"
    )

​流式​输出​里​围栏​可能​跨​ delta ​断裂​，sanitize_context ​的​一次性​正则​罩不住​：StreamingContextScrubber ​在​ feed() ​之间​扣住​可能​是​半截​标签​的​尾巴​、​丢弃​ span ​内部​，flush() ​时未​闭合​的​ span ​直接​丢弃​ （"​泄露​半截​记忆​上下文​比​截断​回答​更糟​"）。​装配​处​ _drop_repeated_recall_lines ​还​按​小节​做​自​包含​ bullet ​去​重​——​组合​块​会​被​盖​进​ user ​行​的​ api_content sidecar，​此后​每个​ turn ​重​放​，​重复​行是​永久​开销​。

docs.title: 6. ​调用者​作用域​：fail-closed ​的​ profile ​强制
docs.text:
​多路​网关​一个​进程​跑​多个​ profile。​工具​调用​与​生命周期​钩子​只​在​调用​方显​式​点名​ provider ​初始化​所用​的​ ​那个​ profile ​时​放行​：

# agent/memory_caller_scope.py:71-100（​节选​）
def caller_scope(bound, label) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Provider kwargs naming the calling profile, or None when the call/hook must be refused."""
    bound = bound or {}
    bound_home = bound.get("hermes_home")
    multiplexed = is_multiplex_active()
    caller_home = _explicit_caller_home()
    if caller_home is None:
        if multiplexed:
            _refuse(label, "the caller names no profile on a process serving several", ...)
            return None                       # ← fail-closed：​不​解析​到​进程​自身​的​ profile
        caller_home = str(get_hermes_home())  # ​单​ profile ​进程​才​允许​回落​
    ...
    if caller_key is None or caller_key != (bound.get("home_key") or _home_key(bound_home)):
        _refuse(label, "the caller's profile is not the one its provider was initialized for", ...)
        return None
    return {"hermes_home": str(bound_home), ...}

refusal ​细节​（​两个​ home、​检查​码​）​只进​ errors.log；​模型​/​聊天​侧​只见​ refused_tool_message() ​的​通用​话术​（memory_caller_scope.py:36）。

docs.title: 7. ​接线​：_init_memory ​与​ volatile ​层
docs.text:
agent_init.py:1155 _init_memory ​先装​内建​ MemoryStore（enabled_toolsets=["memory"] ​仍会​拿到​， memory ​工具​不至​ store=None），​再​解析​外部​ provider：

# agent/agent_init.py:1204-1231（​节选​）
    agent._memory_manager = None
    if memory_manager is not None and not skip_memory:
        # ​网关​每​ turn ​重建​ agent ​时​交还​已​初始化​的​ manager：provider ​的​预取​/​留存​状态​跨​ turn ​保留​
        agent._memory_manager = memory_manager
    elif not skip_memory:
        ...
        if not is_core_memory_provider(_mem_provider_name):
            agent._memory_manager = _MemoryManager()
            _mp = resolve_memory_provider(_mem_provider_name, say=agent._emit_startup_warning)
            if _mp is not None:
                agent._memory_manager.add_provider(_mp)
            if agent._memory_manager.providers and agent._memory_manager.initialize_for_agent(...):
                _ra().logger.info("Memory provider '%s' activated", _mem_provider_name)
    ...
    inject_memory_provider_tools(agent)

​两条​缓存​安全线​：provider ​的​ system_prompt_block() ​属​静态​系统​提示​词​、​会话​开始​时​定格​（​改了​配置​ ​也​不​中途​换​ prompt）；​每​ turn ​的​召回​块​则​经​ turn_context.compose_multimodal_context_part （turn_context.py:114-122）​骑​在​ user ​消息​的​ api_content sidecar ​上​——​每​ turn ​一个​新​尾部​，​不​碰​前缀​。 ​另外​ agent_context="subagent" ​的​ fork ​只​为​压缩​检查点​持有​ provider，​其​ turn ​写​与​召回​在​ manager ​内​ ​被​ _fork_turn_hooks_suppressed() ​全量​关掉​；cron ​会话​如今​走​正常​路径​（cron/scheduler.py:2510 skip_memory=False），​靠​ agent_context="cron" ​让​ provider ​跳过​写​。

docs.title: 8. ​学习​图一族
docs.text:
• learning_graph.py：build_learning_graph() ​把​非​内建​、​已​学习​/​已​使用​的​技能​ + MEMORY.md/USER.md ​卡片​装​成​节点​；​技能​间边​来自​ frontmatter related_skills，​记忆​→​技能​边​由​词法​重叠​推导​； ​记忆​节点​ id ​形​如​ memory:<source>:<index>:<fingerprint>（​指纹​保证​列表​移位​后​仍​可​指认​）。
  • learning_graph_render.py：​同​一份​数据​的​纯​终端​时间​线​渲染​，​年龄​梯度​/​墨色​常量​逐字​移植​自​桌面​ constants.ts（AGE_OLD_INK=0.42...），stdlib-only。
  • learning_mutations.py：delete_node/edit_node ​共用​入口​——​删​技能​=​归档​（curator ​可​恢复​）， ​删​记忆​=​持锁​重写​文件​。
  • learn_prompt.py：/learn ​只​产出​一条​提示​词​，​由活​ agent ​用​既有​工具​收集​素材​、​按​ HARDLINE ​作者​规范​经​ skill_manage ​落盘​（description ≤60 ​字符​因为​系统​提示​词​索引​只截​ 60 ​字符​）。
  • insights.py：InsightsEngine(db).generate(days=30) ​聚合​ token/​成本​/​工具​/​技能​/​活跃​细分​， format_terminal(report) ​渲染​。
