docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/：​内​建​存储​与​ memory ​工具​本体​在​ tools/memory_tool.py（04_tools/skills_memory.md）； ​遥测​ tools/skill_usage.py（.usage.json）​是​学习​图​节点​ use_count/state ​的​数据源​； tools/hook_output_spill.spill_if_oversized ​限制​外部​预​取回​放​体积​。
  • plugins/：​外部​ provider ​住​在​ plugins/memory/<name>/，bundled-first——dropped-in ​目录​不得​遮蔽​ ​内置​；plugins/memory/__init__.py ​提供​ load_memory_provider。
  • agent/​其余​：agent/redact.redact_for_egress ​是​所有​出站​脱敏​的​底座​（​即使​ security.redact_secrets ​关闭​也​强制​，​因为​那​是​"​离开​ agent ​的​数据​"）；agent/secret_scope ​与​ hermes_constants.get_hermes_home_override ​是​作用域​判定​的​两个​事实​源​；​压缩​侧​ agent/conversation_compression_* ​通过​ on_pre_compress ​拿​检查点​（v2 fail-closed）。
  • gateway/：identity_signature() ​让​ provider ​侧​身份​变化​能​ bust ​网关​的​缓存​ agent； on_profile_created/renamed/read_config_fields/write_config_fields ​服务​ Dashboard/Desktop ​的​ ​配置​面板​。
  • skills/curator：​学习​图​与​ curator ​共享​ tools.skill_usage ​生命周期​状态​（active/stale/archived）， ​见​本组​ skills_runtime.md。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​记忆​子系统​的​每个​设计​都​在​兑现​两条​项目​不​变量​：​提示​词​缓存​神圣​（​静态​块​进​系统​提示​词会​话​初​定格​， ​动态​召回​骑​ user ​消息​ sidecar，​绝不​中途​改​前缀​）​与​窄​腰​内核​（​外部​后端​全是​插件​，core ​只认​ ABC）。 ​工程​上​最​值得​学​的​是​防御​的​组合拳​：ctx_bound+in_owner_home+claim_instance+caller_scope ​四层​一起​才​构成​ profile ​隔离​，​且​每​一层​都​ fail-closed；_StuckCallGate ​用​准入​而​非​取消​来​对付​ "Python ​无法​杀死​线程​"​的​现实​。​学习​图一族​则​是​纯​展示​层​——​从同​一份​遥测​出发​生成​图​、​渲染​、​变更​， ​零​模型​调用​。

docs.title: model_metadata.md — ​模型​元​数据​与​ token ​粗估
文件​概览
docs.text:
"​这个​模型​的​上下文​窗口​多大​？​这个​消息​列表​大约​多少​ token？"——​压缩​触发​、preflight ​检查​、 ​工具​输出​预算​都​靠​这​两个​答案​。​回答​它们​的​代码​集中​在​ agent/model_metadata.py（2,627 ​行​） ​及其​五个​兄弟​模块​，​加上​ models_dev.py ​这个​外部​目录​源​。

​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/model_metadata.py 2,627 ​主​模块​：​上下文​长度​九级​解析​、​能力​门控​、token ​粗估​、​错误信息​反推​窗口​ agent/model_metadata_cache.py 72 ​持久​上下文​缓存​文件​（@<host> ​键​）​的​加锁​写入​ agent/model_metadata_http.py 72 ​所有​元​数据​ HTTP ​的​统一​出口​：​凭据​作用域​、TLS verify、​流式​下载​ agent/model_metadata_llamacpp.py 64 llama.cpp /props ​的​已​分配​ n_ctx ​读取​ agent/model_metadata_memo_bounds.py 36 ​端点​ memo ​的​有界​记忆​（endpoint models、codex ​缓存​封顶​） agent/model_metadata_token_memo.py 129 ​每​消息​ token ​估算​ memo：​指纹​键​ + LRU + ​双界​（​条数​/​字节​） agent/models_dev.py 1,032 models.dev ​目录​（models.dev/api.json）：​内存​/​磁盘​/​网络​三级​缓存​ + ​覆盖层​

​模块​头​一句​话定​了​性​（model_metadata.py:1-3）："Pure utility functions with no AIAgent dependency"——​全​模块​不​ import AIAgent，​供​ ContextCompressor ​与​ run_agent ​在​ preflight ​时​调用​。

docs.title: 1. get_model_context_length —— ​九级​解析​阶梯​（model_metadata.py:2211）
docs.text:
​这​是​全​模块​的​招牌​函数​，docstring ​直接​把​阶梯​写​在​第一段​（:2215-2220）：

# agent/model_metadata.py:2211-2220 + 2221-2230（​节选​）
def get_model_context_length(
    model: str, base_url: str = "", api_key: str = "", config_context_length: int | None = None,
    provider: str = "", custom_providers: list | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Context length for a model. Resolution order: 0 config override / MoA aggregator /
    model_overrides / custom_providers / endpoint-scoped; 1 persistent cache (Nous, LM
    Studio, Codex OAuth bypass it) and Bedrock; 2-3 custom endpoints (/models, local
    probe, Ollama); 4 Anthropic /v1/models (API keys only); 5 provider-aware (profile live
    catalog, Nous, Codex OAuth, GMI, Ollama, OpenRouter live, models.dev); 6 OpenRouter for
    unknown providers; 7 local server; 8 hardcoded defaults; 9 256K fallback."""
    # 0. Explicit config override — user knows best
    if isinstance(config_context_length, int) and config_context_length > 0:
        return config_context_length

​阶梯​中段​有​两处​"​排位​即​语义​"​的​注释​（:2252-2263）：

# agent/model_metadata.py:2243-2256 + 2258-2263（​节选​）
    model = _strip_provider_prefix(model)  # "local:x" -> "x"; Ollama "model:tag" colons preserved
    # OpenRouter routing variants (":nitro", ":floor", ...) are request-time
    # modifiers, not catalog entries — resolve the window from the BASE id.
    # Deliberately placed AFTER the explicit config overrides above (0b/0c) so
    # a user who pinned the fully-suffixed id keeps winning, and BEFORE every
    # cache/catalog lookup below so the base's real window is found instead of
    # a generic family default. Mirrors the validation path's base/suffix split
    # in hermes_cli.models.validate_requested_model.
    model = _strip_openrouter_routing_variant(model, base_url=base_url, provider=provider)
    # Endpoint-scoped metadata goes AHEAD of the persistent cache so a value learned on a
    # multiplexed provider's other endpoint cannot override it.
    endpoint_context = _endpoint_scoped_context_length(model, base_url)
    if endpoint_context is not None:
        return endpoint_context
    # A profile that qualifies its own bound (external processes have no /models probe) wins
    # over the generic caches below; explicit user/endpoint overrides above still take precedence.
    from providers import get_provider_profile
    profile = get_provider_profile(provider)
    context = profile.get_model_context_length(model) if profile else None

​阶梯​尾部​的​两条​防线​（:2319-2325）：

# agent/model_metadata.py:2319-2325
    # 7. Local server before hardcoded defaults — ``Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-70B`` matches ``llama``
    # (131072) even when vLLM runs at a lower ``--max-model-len``.
    local_ctx = _probe_local_context_length(model, base_url, api_key, provider) if base_url and is_local_endpoint(base_url) else None
    if local_ctx:
        return local_ctx
    # 8. Hardcoded defaults: `key in model` only — the reverse would let "claude-sonnet-4" match "claude-sonnet-4-6" and return 1M.
    hit = _longest_key_match(DEFAULT_CONTEXT_LENGTHS, model.lower())
    if hit:
        return hit[1]
    # 9. Default fallback — warn (deduped) so small-context models don't silently get 256K.
    _warn_context_length_fallback(model, base_url)
    return DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CONTEXT

​值得​咀嚼​的​细节​：

  • OpenRouter ​路由​变体​（:nitro/:floor）​是​请求​期​修饰符​，​不是​目录​条目​——​窗口​要查​ base id。​剥除​位置​刻意​夹​在​中间​：​显式​覆盖​（0 ​级​）​之后​、​一切​缓存​/​目录​查找​之前​。 ​用户​钉死​全​后缀​ id ​依然​赢​。
  • ​端点​级元​数据​排​在​持久​缓存​之前​：​多路复用​网关​下​，​一个​端点​上学​到​的​值​不能​压过​另​一​ ​端点​的​真实​窗口​。
  • ​空白​模型​ id ​直接​落​ 256K（:2239-2242）：​空串​对​目录​是​万能​模糊​匹配​（"" in key ​恒真​），​还会​以​垃圾​键​ @<base_url> ​持久​化​——​宁可​默认​也​不查​。
  • ​第​ 8 ​级​只许​ key in model ​单向​匹配​：​反过来​ claude-sonnet-4 ​会​命中​ claude-sonnet-4-6 ​的​ 1M——​方向​错​了​就是​ 256K ​报错​。
  • ​第​ 9 ​级落​ 256K ​前先​去​重​告警​：​小​窗口​模型​静默​拿到​ 256K ​是​最​阴险​的​故障​形态​。

​还有​ Codex ​路由​的​特殊性​（:2265-2268 ​注释​）：Codex Responses ​路由​按​传输​而​不是​ host ​判定​——​代理​（HERMES_CODEX_BASE_URL、custom api_mode）​后面​ URL ​看着​普通​，​窗口​仍​是​ Codex OAuth ​那套​（#116191），​所以​持久​缓存​对​它​直接​跳过​。

docs.title: 2. token ​粗估​ —— CJK ​密度​与​字节​计数​（model_metadata.py:2340）
docs.text:
# agent/model_metadata.py:2336-2366
# CJK/Hangul/Kana codepoints (~1 token each), counted in one C-level regex pass: Hangul
# Jamo (+Ext-A), CJK radicals/ideographs (+compat), Hangul syllables, fullwidth/halfwidth.
# Rough chars-per-token ratio for ASCII text; the single source for every "N tokens ≈ N*4 chars"
# budget conversion (context files, tool-output budgets, whisper prompt cap, compressor metadata).
CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4

_CJK_DENSE_RE = re.compile("[\u1100-\u11ff\u2e80-\u9fff\ua960-\ua97f\uac00-\ud7af\uf900-\ufaff\uff00-\uffef]")

def _is_cjk_token_dense_char(ch: str) -> bool:
    return _CJK_DENSE_RE.fullmatch(ch) is not None


def estimate_tokens_rough(text: str) -> int:
    """Rough token estimate: CJK/Hangul/Kana codepoints ~1 token each; everything else ceil(UTF-8 bytes/4).
    Ceiling keeps short texts from estimating 0. Runs on every preflight walk, so all-ASCII stays O(1).

    Byte-counting (not chars) is the corrective for non-CJK, non-ASCII text: Cyrillic/Greek/Arabic are 2
    bytes/char so count ~chars/2, matching real BPE cost (~2-3 chars/token) where chars/4 under-counted
    ~2x and let sessions ride the provider ceiling below the compaction threshold. Calibrated vs
    cl100k/o200k/Qwen2.5 (estimate/real): Russian 0.67->1.24, Arabic 0.53->0.96, Hindi 0.34->0.90,
    Greek 0.37->0.68; accented Latin barely moves (French 1.02->1.03). errors="replace": lone surrogates
    (routine in tool output; see message_sanitization) must not turn an estimate into a raise."""
    if not text:
        return 0
    text = str(text)
    if text.isascii():  # flag check on CPython; ASCII cannot contain token-dense CJK
        return (len(text) + 3) // CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    stripped = _CJK_DENSE_RE.sub("", text)
    dense = len(text) - len(stripped)
    return dense + ((len(stripped.encode("utf-8", "replace")) + 3) // CHARS_PER_TOKEN)

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4 ​是​唯一​事实​源​——​上下文​文件​、​工具​输出​预算​、whisper ​上限​、 ​压缩器​元​数据​里​所有​ "N tokens ≈ N*4 chars" ​换算​都​ import ​它​。​估算​公式​的​演进​史写​在​ docstring ​里​：​字符​/4 ​对​西里尔​/​阿拉伯语​低估​约​ 2 ​倍​，​会​让​会​话​贴着​ provider ​上限​运行​而​ ​压缩​永不​触发​；​改​按​ UTF-8 ​字节​/4 ​后​按​ cl100k/o200k/Qwen2.5 ​校准​，​俄语​ 0.67→1.24、 ​阿拉伯语​ 0.53→0.96。CJK ​密集​码点​（​约​一字​一​ token）​用​一条​ C ​级​正则​一次​剥出​。

estimate_messages_tokens_rough（:2369-2381）​再​上​一层​：​图片​按​从​ provider ​用量​学到​的​ ​每图​价格​计​（agent.image_token_cost），​而​非​ base64 ​长度​；charge_stale_thinking=False ​时​剥掉​旧​ turn ​的​ reasoning ​键​（​只​保留​最新​ assistant）——​非​ echo ​路由​上​过期​推理​只有​最新​ ​一轮​真正​上线​，​不​剥离​的话​推理​重​的​会​话​会​让​ preflight ​永远​开火​，​与​压缩器​的​尾​预算​游走​ （context_compressor._estimate_msg_budget_tokens）​必须​同​尺寸​类​。

docs.title: 3. ​每​消息​ memo —— ​指纹​键​与​双界​缓存​（model_metadata.py:2425 + token_memo.py:29）
docs.text:
​估算​函数​每次​循环​迭代​都​对​全​历史​跑​一遍​（conversation_loop preflight）、​压缩​遥测​反复​调​、 MoA ​的​ O(n²) ​收缩​循环​里​更​要命​。​于是​有​了​一个​按值​指纹​的​ memo（:2425-2438 ​的​长​注释​ ​给出​完整​健全性​论证​）：

# agent/model_metadata.py:2425-2438（​节选​）
# Per-message token-estimate memo keyed by an exact value fingerprint: strings by ``id()`` AND
# pinned (strong ref in the entry, so the id can't be reused and immutability makes id-equality
# value-equality); numbers/bools/None by value; dicts/lists structurally in key order (``str(shadow)``
# depends on it); any other type aborts the memo. api_messages shallow-copies dicts but shares the strings.
# ...
# Fingerprint design (soundness argument): While the entry lives, that id cannot be reused by another
# object, so id-equality implies object-equality — strings are immutable, so value-equality too ...

​字符串​按​ id() ​键入​，​但​ entry ​里​强​引用​钉住​（MemoPins，token_memo.py:43）——id ​不可​被​复用​，​不可​变​对象​相等​即值​相等​。​历史​ dict ​每​ turn ​浅​拷贝​但​共享​同​一批​字符串​，​所以​ ​未变​的​历史​消息​照样​命中​。​缓存​本体​在​ token_memo.py：

# agent/model_metadata_token_memo.py:29-38 + 68-75（​节选​）
# fingerprint -> (pins, text tokens, image count). Order is recency: a hit moves its entry to the end, and an
# OrderedDict evicts from the front in O(1) where a plain dict rescans its deleted slots on every eviction.
_MSG_TOKENS_CACHE: OrderedDict[Any, tuple[list, int, int]] = OrderedDict()
_MSG_TOKENS_CACHE_MAX = 4096
_MSG_TOKENS_CACHE_MAX_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
# Measured on real histories: the fingerprint tuple, its id int and the pin slot cost ~120 B per string leaf.
_LEAF_OVERHEAD_BYTES = 120
# An entry looked up this recently is never evicted (see module docstring).
_ACTIVE_WINDOW_S = 60.0

def remember_message_tokens(key: Any, entry: tuple[MemoPins, int, int]) -> None:
    """Insert ``entry`` as most recent, then evict least-recently-used entries past either bound, stopping at
    the first one looked up inside the active window (everything after it is more recent)."""
    ...
    if size > _MSG_TOKENS_CACHE_MAX_BYTES:
        return  # one message larger than the whole budget is recomputed, never allowed to flush the memo

​三条​驱逐​规则​：LRU 4096 ​条​上限​、16 MB ​字节​预算​（​按​每​字符串​叶子​ ~120 B ​估​）、​以及​ 60 ​秒​活动​窗​——​刚​被​查过​的​条目​永不​被​逐​（​驱逐​停​在​第一个​活动​窗内​的​条目​）。​单条​消息​ ​超过​整个​预算​则​直接​重算​，​绝​不许​它​冲刷​整个​ memo。forget_message_token_memo（:112）​在​ ​消息​内容​被​压缩​修改​时​按​字符串​ id ​定点​遗忘​。

docs.title: 4. fetch_model_metadata —— OpenRouter ​元​数据​与​三级​降级​（model_metadata.py:898）
docs.text:
# agent/model_metadata.py:898-910 + 932-943（​节选​）
def fetch_model_metadata(force_refresh: bool = False) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Fetch model metadata from OpenRouter (cached for 1 hour)."""
    global _model_metadata_cache, _model_metadata_cache_time
    if not force_refresh:
        if _model_metadata_cache and (time.time() - _model_metadata_cache_time) < _MODEL_CACHE_TTL:
            return _model_metadata_cache
        disk_age = _model_metadata_disk_cache_age_seconds()
        if disk_age is not None and disk_age < _MODEL_CACHE_TTL:
            disk_cache = _load_model_metadata_disk_cache()
            if disk_cache:
                _model_metadata_cache = disk_cache
                _model_metadata_cache_time = time.time() - disk_age
                return _model_metadata_cache
    ...
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("Failed to fetch model metadata from OpenRouter: %s", e)
        if _model_metadata_cache:
            return _model_metadata_cache
        disk_cache = _load_model_metadata_disk_cache()
        if disk_cache:
            _model_metadata_cache = disk_cache
            disk_age = _model_metadata_disk_cache_age_seconds()
            stale_by = min(disk_age, _MODEL_CACHE_TTL) if disk_age is not None else _MODEL_CACHE_TTL - 1
            _model_metadata_cache_time = time.time() - stale_by
            return _model_metadata_cache
        return {}

​内存​（1h TTL）→ ​磁盘​（_model_metadata_disk_cache_age_seconds ​只认​新鲜度​）→ ​网络​， ​网络​失败​再​回退​内存​/​陈旧​磁盘​。agent_init ​的​ _finalize_routing（agent_init.py:403-410） ​在​ OpenRouter ​路由​上开​后台​线程​预热​这份​缓存​——​进程​级​ Event ​防​每​消息​漏​一个​线程​。 agent_init.py ​里​那句话​就是​这里​的​契约​："the first pricing estimate doesn't block"。

docs.title: 5. models_dev —— ​目录​权威​与​ _default ​填缝​（models_dev.py:1-7 + 750）
docs.text:
# agent/models_dev.py:1-7 + 24-30（​节选​）
"""Models.dev registry integration — primary database for providers and models.

Resolution: in-memory cache (fresh, or stale served while one background daemon
thread refreshes) → disk cache (~/.hermes/models_dev_cache.json, any age) →
network only when no cache exists. Failed refreshes back off 5 min process-wide.
Refreshes use ETag conditional GET when a servable registry is held. Hot paths
pass ``allow_network=False`` and never do I/O. A corrupt/empty disk cache is
quarantined, never served as ``{}``. ``models_dev.url`` in config.yaml = mirror."""

MODELS_DEV_URL = "https://models.dev/api.json"
_MODELS_DEV_CACHE_TTL = 4 * 3600  # 4 hours — ETag conditional GET makes refresh cheap
_MODELS_DEV_RETRY_DELAY = 300  # 5 minutes after a failed refresh

​比​ OpenRouter ​那份​更​讲究​：​陈旧​注册表​在手​时​由​后台​守护​线程​刷新​（​热​路径​先​吃​陈值​）， ​失败​全​进程​退避​ 5 ​分钟​，ETag ​条件​ GET ​让​刷新​便宜​，​损坏​缓存​隔离​而​不是​当​ {} ​服务​， models_dev.url ​配置​可指​镜像​。​数据模型​三件套​：ModelInfo（:42，​能力​/​模态​/​限额​/​成本​/ ​状态​全字段​）、ProviderInfo、ModelCapabilities。

​用户​覆盖层​（:750-769）​解决​了​"​目录​就是​错​"​的​问题​：

# agent/models_dev.py:750-761 + 764-769（​节选​）
def _default_model_override(provider: str, *, config: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Fill-gap ``_default`` override: per-provider first, then global; or None."""
    section = _provider_override_section(provider, config=config)
    if section is not None and isinstance(section.get("_default"), dict):
        return section["_default"]
    ...
    global_default = overrides.get("_default")
    return global_default if isinstance(global_default, dict) else None


def _override_for(
    provider: str, model: str, *, catalog_hit: bool, config: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Explicit override if any; else the ``_default`` only on a catalog miss."""
    explicit = _explicit_model_override(provider, model, config=config)
    return explicit if explicit is not None or catalog_hit else _default_model_override(provider, config=config)

​三级​语义​：​显式​覆盖​（exact ​模型​ id）​永远​赢​ → ​目录​命中​时​ _default ​不​插手​ → ​目录​ miss ​时​ _default（per-provider ​优先​，​再​全局​）​填缝​（#84482）。​而​ _override_context_window（:788-793）​只用​显式​覆盖​——​它​跑​在​解析​链​早期​，_default ​若​在​此​抢先​会压​过​更​具体​的​来源​。

docs.title: 6. ​错误​反推​窗口​ —— ​从​ 400 ​学​上下文​（model_metadata.py:1218）
docs.text: ​解析​阶梯​之外​还有​一条​"​事后​学习​"​通道​：provider ​的​ 400 ​错误​正文​往往​写​着​真实​窗口​。 parse_context_limit_from_error（:1218）​从​报错​文本​反推​；get_context_length_from_provider_error （:1245）​配合​ get_next_probe_tier（:1213， tiers: 256K→128K→64K→32K→16K→8K，:260） ​逐级​试探​；parse_available_output_tokens_from_error（:1273）​拆出​"​上下文​减​输入​"​的​剩余​ ​输出​配额​；is_output_cap_error（:1384）​区分​输出​上限​错误​（s/glang ​等​各有​专属​短语​组​）。 ​学到​的​值经​ save_context_length（:1134）​写​进​ @<host> ​键​的​持久​缓存​，​下次​直接​命中​。

docs.title: 7. HTTP ​出口​与​本地​探测​兄弟​模块
docs.text:
• model_metadata_http.py（72 ​行​）：​所有​元​数据​ HTTP ​的​唯一​出口​——scope_credentials ​把​当前​ profile ​的​凭据​作用域​绑进​请求​（​多路复用​下​绝不​串号​），resolve_verify ​统一​ TLS ​策略​，stream ​支持​大​目录​的​流式​下载​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​九级​阶梯​排位​即​语义​：​显式​覆盖​ → ​端点​级​ → profile ​自​报​ → ​持久​缓存​ → Bedrock → ​自定义​端点​/​本地​探测​ → Anthropic → provider ​感知​目录​ → OpenRouter → ​硬​编码​ → 256K ​兜底​（​兜底​必​告警​）。​方向性​匹配​只许​ key in model ​单向​。
  • ​粗估​是​工程化​的​"​够用​"：CJK ​密集​码点​一字​一​ token，​其余​按​ UTF-8 ​字节​/4（​不是​ ​字符​/4——​俄语​/​阿拉伯语​曾​因此​低估​ 2 ​倍​，​压缩​永不​触发​）；CHARS_PER_TOKEN=4 ​全仓​ ​唯一​换算​源​。
  • memo ​靠​指纹​和​钉子​：​字符串​ id + ​强​引用​ pin + ​结构化​ dict ​指纹​，​健全性​论证​写​在​ ​注释​里​；4096 ​条​/16 MB/60 ​秒​活动​窗​三重​边界​，​超大​消息​重算​不​冲刷​。
  • ​外部​元​数据​三级​降级​：OpenRouter（​内存​→​磁盘​→​网络​，​失败​回退​陈值​）​与​ models.dev （​内存​陈值​可​服务​ + ​后台​刷新​、ETag ​条件​ GET、​失败​退避​、​坏​缓存​隔离​、​可​配镜​像​）。
  • ​覆盖层​三级​语义​：​显式​ id ​覆盖​永远​赢​；​目录​命中​ _default ​不​插手​；​目录​ miss _default ​填缝​——"​用户​钉​对​的​"​和​"​目录​烂掉​的​"​走​不同​的​路​。
  • ​错误​也​是​数据源​：provider ​的​ 400 ​正文​能​反推​窗口​与​剩余​输出​配额​，​学到​的​值​持久​化​， ​下次​请求​前​就​生效​。

docs.title: model_providers.md — provider ​体系​：​声明​式​ Profile、api_mode ​路由​与​传输层
文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​要​跟​几十家​推理​服务商​对话​，​每家​的​"​方言​"​都​不​一样​：OpenAI ​走​ Chat Completions / Responses，Anthropic ​走​ Messages，AWS ​走​ Bedrock Converse，​还有​插件​自带​ dialect。​这套​体系​ ​分​三层​，​各管​一件​事​：

​层​ ​目录​/​文件​ ​职责​ ​绝不​碰​的​事​ ​声明​层​ providers/（3 ​文件​）+ plugins/model-providers/（38 ​个​插件​） ProviderProfile ​声明​ auth、endpoint、quirks ​不建​ client、​不转​凭据​、​不​做​流式​ ​路由​层​ agent/agent_init.py（_resolve_api_mode/_finalize_routing/_build_client） ​决定​这次​会话​说​哪种​ api_mode、​用​哪个​ client ​不​做​消息​/​工具​格式​转换​ ​数据​层​ agent/transports/（11 ​文件​） ​一个​ api_mode ​的​四步​数据​路径​ ​不管​ client ​生命周期​、​流式​、​凭据​、​缓存​

transports/base.py:1-4 ​的​模块​ docstring ​把​边界​写得​非常​直白​：

A transport owns one api_mode's data path (convert_messages -> convert_tools -> build_kwargs -> normalize_response), NOT client construction, streaming, credentials, caching, interrupts or retries — those stay on AIAgent.

​这层​边界​是​本组​文件​共同​的​宪法​。​下文​按​"​路由​ → client → ​数据​转换​ → profile ​声明​ → ​插件​接入​"​的​顺序​走读​。

docs.title: 1. _resolve_api_mode —— ​有序​阶梯​，​先到​先得​（agent_init.py:277）
docs.text:
​初始化​时​第一个​路由​问题​："​这个​ agent ​说​哪种​ api_mode？"​答案​由​一条​有序​阶梯​给出​， ​第一个​命中​的​分支​获胜​：

# agent/agent_init.py:271-274 + 277-292 + 296-325（​节选​）
_EXPLICIT_API_MODES = {
    "chat_completions", "codex_responses", "anthropic_messages", "bedrock_converse",
    "codex_app_server",
}

def _resolve_api_mode(agent, api_mode, provider_name, base_url):
    """Set ``agent.api_mode`` (and provider rewrites) — ordered ladder, first match wins."""
    from hermes_cli.providers import is_actual_route
    from agent.transports import registered_api_modes
    host, url = agent._base_url_hostname, agent._base_url_lower
    if is_actual_route(agent.provider, base_url):
        agent.api_mode = "chat_completions"
    elif api_mode in _EXPLICIT_API_MODES or (api_mode and api_mode in registered_api_modes()):
        # A provider plugin's own dialect (``register_transport(api_mode, cls)``) is as explicit
        # as the in-tree modes; rewriting it to chat_completions silently dropped its transport.
        agent.api_mode = api_mode
    elif agent.provider in {"openai-codex", "xai", "xai-oauth"}:
        agent.api_mode = "codex_responses"
    elif agent.provider == "anthropic" or (provider_name is None and host == "api.anthropic.com"):
        agent.api_mode = "anthropic_messages"; agent.provider = "anthropic"
    elif url.rstrip("/").endswith("/anthropic"):
        # Third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints (MiniMax, DashScope) end in /anthropic.
        agent.api_mode = "anthropic_messages"
    elif agent.provider == "bedrock" or (
        host.startswith("bedrock-runtime.") and base_url_host_matches(url, "amazonaws.com")):
        agent.api_mode = "bedrock_converse"
    elif agent.provider in {"nous", "nous-portal", "nousresearch"}:
        from hermes_cli.providers import nous_api_mode
        agent.api_mode = nous_api_mode(agent.model)   # Portal ​双线​：anthropic/* ​或​ chat_completions
    else:
        ...
        agent.api_mode = _mandated if _mandated is not None else "chat_completions"   # :325

​四个​要点​：​显式​配置​第一​——​用户​/​插件​明确​给出​的​ api_mode ​永远​赢​， registered_api_modes()（transports/__init__.py:44）​判断​前先​发现​，​插件​用​ register_transport(api_mode, cls) ​注册​的​自有​ dialect ​与​内置​模式​同等​显式​（​教训​写​在​注释​里​： ​早期​把​插件​ mode ​重​写成​ chat_completions，​方言​翻译​被​静默​丢弃​）。provider slug ​次之​、 host ​检测​再次​——​名字​没​给​时​退化​到​ URL ​探测​（chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex、 api.anthropic.com、bedrock-runtime.*、​以​ /anthropic ​结尾​的​兼容​端点​、 nous_api_mode ​双线​判定​）。URL ​驱动​是​设计​：​最后​的​ else ​调​ host_mandated_api_mode(base_url)，​注释​明说​ Meta ​按​名字​强推​会​打爆​指向​别处​的​自定义​端点​ （#63425）。​默认值​是​ chat_completions——​一切​不​命中​落回​ OpenAI ​兼容​方言​。

docs.title: 2. _finalize_routing —— ​定案​后​的​四件​收尾​（agent_init.py:328）
docs.text:
# agent/agent_init.py:328-346（​节选​）
def _finalize_routing(agent, api_mode, credential_pool):
    from hermes_cli.providers import is_actual_route
    # Credential-pool validation runs AFTER provider auto-detection so a pool scoped to
    # "anthropic" isn't rejected for provider=None + anthropic.com URL.
    # Regression from #63048 which placed this check before the URL-based auto-detection block above (fixed
    # #63425).
    if credential_pool is not None:
        try:
            from agent.credential_pool import credential_pool_matches_provider
            if not credential_pool_matches_provider(
                credential_pool, agent.provider, base_url=agent.base_url,
            ):
                agent._credential_pool = None
        except Exception:
            agent._credential_pool = None

    # Warm the transport cache so import errors surface at init (non-fatal: some modes lack one).
    with suppress(Exception):
        agent._get_transport()
  • ​凭据​池​校验​必须​在​ provider ​自动检测​之后​（:334-342）：#63048 ​曾​把​校验​放​前面​， provider=None + anthropic.com URL ​的​池​被​误​拒​（#63425 ​修复​）。​不​匹配​就​静默​清空​ ​池​——​宁可​不用​池​也​不能​用​错池​。
  • transport ​预热​（:344-346）：init ​摸​一次​ _get_transport()，import ​错误​在​构造​期​ ​暴露​，​而​不是​第一个​ turn ​半路上​炸​。
  • ​模型​名归​一​（:359-370）：​非​聚合​器​ provider ​做​ normalize_model_for_provider；Nous ​再​按​路由​ pin_model_for_route（​凭据​池换​路由​时​ _swap_credential ​重新​套用​）。
  • GPT-5.x ​自动​升级​ Responses（:379-401）：api_mode ​未​显式​指定​且​模型​要求​ Responses （​或直​连​ OpenAI URL）​时升​到​ codex_responses，​并​清空​已​预热​的​ transport ​缓存​； ACP ​客户端​（acp://）​与​ Azure OpenAI ​显式​豁免​——Azure ​的​ gpt-5.x ​只有​ /chat/completions。

docs.title: 3. _build_client —— ​按​ wire mode ​建​客户端​（agent_init.py:929）
docs.text:
# agent/agent_init.py:929-942
def _build_client(agent, api_key, base_url, fallback_model):
    # LLM client per wire mode (raw_codex=True: the main agent needs direct
    # responses.stream()). One provider/model timeout up front so every path applies it.
    agent._anthropic_client = None
    agent._is_anthropic_oauth = False
    _provider_timeout = get_provider_request_timeout(agent.provider, agent.model)
    if agent.api_mode == "anthropic_messages":
        _init_anthropic_client(agent, api_key, base_url, _provider_timeout)
    elif agent.provider == "moa":
        _init_moa_client(agent, api_key)
    elif agent.api_mode == "bedrock_converse":
        _init_bedrock_client(agent, base_url)
    else:
        _init_openai_client(agent, api_key, base_url, fallback_model, _provider_timeout)

​四个​分支​对应​四种​ client：Anthropic SDK（OAuth/API key ​双​认证​）、MoA ​聚合​门面​、boto3 Bedrock（​走​ AWS ​凭据​链​，​无​ API key ​也​能​跑​）、​默认​ OpenAI ​兼容​ client。 _init_openai_client（:890-926）​里​两步​值得注意​：custom provider ​的​ TLS/extra_headers ​最后​套用​（"most specific config level wins"，​且​注释​强调​ header ​值​可能​带​凭据​绝不​打​ ​日志​）；agent._client_kwargs ​存​下来​供​中断​后​重建​ client ​复用​。

docs.title: 4. ProviderTransport ABC —— ​四步​数据​路径​（transports/base.py:12）
docs.text:
OpenAI ​形态​（agent ​主​循环​的​唯一​内部​方言​）
     messages[] + tools[] + params（reasoning/temperature…）
                        │
                        ▼
   ProviderTransport.build_kwargs(model, messages, tools, **params)
        ├─① convert_messages()   OpenAI ​消息​ → provider ​原生​结构​
        ├─② convert_tools()      OpenAI ​工具​ schema → provider ​原生​格式​
        └─③ ​组装​ SDK kwargs      reasoning ​钳制​、extra_body、max_tokens ​策略​
                        │
                        ▼
        provider SDK / HTTP  ← AIAgent ​持有​ client、​流式​、​凭据​、​重试​、​缓存​
                        │
                        ▼
   ④ normalize_response(raw) ──► NormalizedResponse（​回到​ OpenAI ​词汇表​）

# agent/transports/base.py:12-17 + 32-41 + 51-53（​节选​）
class ProviderTransport(ABC):
    """Base class for provider-specific format conversion and normalization."""

    # Provider stop_reason -> OpenAI finish_reason. ``None`` means the provider
    # already speaks OpenAI vocabulary and map_finish_reason passes through.
    _STOP_REASON_MAP: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None

    @abstractmethod
    def build_kwargs(
        self, model: str, messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
        tools: Optional[list[dict[str, Any]]] = None, **params,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Primary entry point: convert messages/tools and return kwargs ready for the provider SDK."""

    @abstractmethod
    def normalize_response(self, response: Any, **kwargs) -> NormalizedResponse:
        """Normalize a raw provider response to NormalizedResponse (the only transport-layer return type)."""

    def map_finish_reason(self, raw_reason: str) -> str:
        return raw_reason if self._STOP_REASON_MAP is None else self._STOP_REASON_MAP.get(raw_reason, "stop")

​四个​ @abstractmethod（api_mode/convert_messages/convert_tools/build_kwargs/ normalize_response）​是​硬​合同​；validate_response / extract_cache_stats / map_finish_reason ​是​可选​挂件​。​返回​类型​收敛​到​ types.py ​的​ NormalizedResponse—— ​协议​专属​状态​（Codex ​的​ reasoning items、Anthropic ​的​有序​签名​块​）​塞进​ provider_data ​字​段​，​不​拓宽​共享​类型​。

docs.title: 5. ​四个​内置​ transport ​的​分工
docs.text:
• chat_completions.py（804 ​行​，​默认​）：​消息​/​工具​本来​就是​ OpenAI ​形态​，convert ​是​ ​近​恒等​；​真功夫​在​ build_kwargs ​的​每​ provider ​钳制​——Moonshot ​工具​ schema ​消毒​、 reasoning effort ​钳制​、xAI ​保留​名​ tool_search ​改名​ hermes_tool_search ​再​映射​回来​ （:35，HTTP 400 "reserved for the tool_search tool"，#95003）、​把​持久​化​专用​键​从​消息​ ​里​剥掉​防​ 400（:39-47）。​还有​个​防御​：​某些​路由器​把​上游​超时​伪装成​ HTTP 200 + ​哨兵​文案​ （is_router_timeout_shim，:136，#68396）——​只有​"​精确​哨兵​ + ​无​ tool_calls + ​无正​ completion_tokens"​才​判假​成功​，​真说​了​这些​话​的​模型​凭​ usage ​证据​保住​自己​。
  • anthropic.py（137 ​行​，​薄壳​）：​转换​全部​委托​ anthropic_adapter.py / anthropic_message_convert.py，​自己​只​做​ normalize——​解析​ content blocks、​映射​ stop_reason、​收集​ reasoning_details。​微妙​处​（:70-100）：Anthropic ​对​每个​ thinking ​块​ ​按​前序​块​签名​，thinking ​与​ tool_use ​交错​时​平行​列表​丢序​、​重​放​ HTTP 400——​此时​额外​ ​携带​ anthropic_content_blocks（​有序​块​通道​）。
  • bedrock.py（89 ​行​，​薄壳​）：​委托​ bedrock_adapter.py，boto3 client ​归​ AIAgent。 build_kwargs ​塞​两个​哨兵​键​（__bedrock_converse__/__bedrock_region__，:50-51）​给​ ​分发​器​识别​，boto3 ​调用​前​由​ agent pop ​掉​。
  • codex.py（977 ​行​）：OpenAI Responses API，​负责​ prompt_cache_key ​内容​寻址​、 effort ​钳制​、​保留​名​别名​——​详见​ codex_runtime.md。

docs.title: 6. codex_app_server —— ​整个​ turn ​搬进​子​进程​（transports/codex_app_server.py:83）
docs.text:
​第五种​ api_mode codex_app_server ​不​走​ HTTP：​把​ OpenAI ​的​ codex app-server CLI ​当​ ​模型​运行​时​，stdio ​上​的​ newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 ​驱动​——initialize ​握手​ → thread/start + turn/start → ​流式​ item/* ​通知​直到​ turn/completed（docstring :1-6）。 Hermes ​只当​"​线级​说话​者​"，​投影​/​审批​/​转录​在​兄弟​模块​。

# agent/transports/codex_app_server.py:83-89
class CodexAppServerClient:
    """Minimal synchronous JSON-RPC 2.0 client for ``codex app-server`` over stdio.

    One reader thread routes replies to pending queues and notifications / server
    requests to queues; another captures stderr. Deliberately NOT async:
    AIAgent.run_conversation() is synchronous and cancels via ``turn/interrupt``.
    """

​两个​安全​细节​：spawn ​环境​走​ hermes_subprocess_env(inherit_credentials=True)（:105）—— codex ​需要​ LLM provider ​凭据​认证​模型​端点​，​但​旧​实现​ os.environ.copy() ​把​ Tier-1 Hermes ​秘密​（​网关​ bot token、GitHub auth、​基础设施​ token）​也​交出去​了​，​现在​集中​剥离​； ​崩溃​清理​用​ psutil ​快照​后代​进程​再​ TERM→KILL（:62-80），​防​ PID ​复用​误杀​。​配套​的​ hermes_tools_mcp_server.py ​把​策展​过​的​ Hermes ​工具​子集​经​ MCP ​暴露​给​ codex （codex ​在​那边​拥有​ loop ​和​工具​列表​；EXPOSED_TOOLS :57-67 ​明确​排除​ terminal/file/ search——codex ​自带​，​也​排除​ delegate_task/memory——​需要​活​的​ AIAgent ​上下文​）。

docs.title: 7. providers/ —— ​声明​式​ ProviderProfile ​与​懒​发现​（providers/base.py:141）
docs.text:
"20+ ​布尔​旗标​在​函数​签名​里​飞​"​是​ god-object ​时代​的​遗产​。​声明​层​把​它​压成​一个​ dataclass：

# providers/base.py:1-9 + 141-149 + 161-171（​节选​）
"""Provider profile base class.

A ProviderProfile declares everything about an inference provider in one place:
auth, endpoints, client quirks, request-time quirks. The transport reads this
instead of receiving 20+ boolean flags.

Provider profiles are DECLARATIVE — they describe the provider's behavior.
They do NOT own client construction, credential rotation, or streaming.
Those stay on AIAgent.
"""

@dataclass
class ProviderProfile:
    """Base provider profile — subclass or instantiate with overrides."""

    # ── Identity ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    name: str
    api_mode: str = "chat_completions"
    aliases: tuple = ()
    ...
    # ── Auth & endpoints ─────────────────────────────────────
    env_vars: tuple = ()
    base_url: str = ""
    auth_type: str = "api_key"   # api_key|oauth_device_code|oauth_external|external_process|aws_sdk|plugin-defined
    supports_streaming: bool | None = field(default=None, kw_only=True)

​字段​按​ Identity / Auth & endpoints / Vision / External-process / Model catalog / quirks ​分节​；auth_type ​枚举​里​ external_process ​描述​"​驱动​一个​ agent CLI over stdio（ACP）" ​的​形态​。​行为​钩子​可选覆写​：build_api_kwargs_extras（:351，​返回​ (extra_body_additions, top_level_kwargs) ​二元​组​——OpenRouter ​把​ reasoning ​放​ extra_body，Kimi ​放​顶层​ api_kwargs，​所以​拆​两半​）、prepare_messages、resolve_aux_model（:295，​活​的​便宜​模型​ id——​硬​编码​的​ default_aux_model ​会烂​，docstring ​明说​这个​字​段​ "rots"）。

​一个​精致​的​小类​是​ LazyHeaders（:45）：​插件​ default_headers ​里​常有​一个​带​版本号​的​ User-Agent，​源码​ checkout ​下要​从​ git ​解析​版本​——​若​ import ​时​就​构造​，​每条​ CLI ​命令​ ​都​得​白付​几次​ git ​子​进程​（CLI ​启动​会​ import ​所有​ provider ​插件​）。LazyHeaders ​把​ callable ​存​起来​首次​读取​才​解析​，​且​仍​是​真​ dict（​插件​会​ copy/merge/serialize ​它​）；​解析​ ​用​ _RESOLVE_LOCK ​防​并发​首读​各自​走一遍​ git。

# providers/__init__.py:3-16（​模块​ docstring ​节选​）
Provider profiles can live in three places:

1. Bundled plugins: ``plugins/model-providers/<name>/`` (shipped with hermes-agent)
2. User plugins: ``$HERMES_HOME/plugins/model-providers/<name>/``
3. Pip-installed plugins: distributions exposing a ``hermes_agent.plugins``
   entry point (``module:func`` callable or a self-registering ``module``)

Discovery is lazy: the first call to ``get_provider_profile()`` or
``list_providers()`` imports the bundled and pip-installed plugins once per
process; the ``$HERMES_HOME`` plugins of the profile home bound at lookup time
load into that home's own layer, so one process serving several profiles
(multiplex gateway, Desktop ``serve``) resolves each profile's installs.

​发现​是​懒​的​（​第一次​ get_provider_profile() ​才​触发​），​且​每个​ profile home ​一层​： _HomeLayer（:72-93）​按​查找​时​绑定​的​ $HERMES_HOME ​分层​存​用户​插件​，​目录​ mtime ​戳​ （1 ​秒​ TTL + FAT/HFS+ ​的​ 2 ​秒​粒度​余量​，:66-69）​让​ hermes plugins install ​装完​的​插件​ ​不​重启​进程​就​能​被​发现​。​同​名字​冲突​时​last-writer-wins：​用户​插件​覆盖​ bundled ​插件​。 ​注册​目标​用​ ContextVar（_REGISTRATION_TARGET，:102）​而​不是​模块​全局​——​两个​ turn ​线程​ ​同时​扫​两个​ profile home ​时​不能​交叉​注册​。​新增​ provider ​的​完整​成本​：​建​ plugins/model-providers/<name>/__init__.py（​构造​ ProviderProfile + register_provider） + plugin.yaml，README ​原话​ "Nothing else needs to change"——auth/config/models ​自动​接上​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
​配置​ hermes_cli/config.yaml（model/provider/providers.* ​段​）
        ▼
agent_init::_resolve_api_mode ──► hermes_cli/providers.py（​路由​判定​原语​）
        │                      └──► transports/registered_api_modes
_finalize_routing ──► credential_pool.py（​池​校验​，​见​ credentials_rate.md）
        ▼
_build_client ──► providers/ get_provider_profile（​读​ profile ​的​ auth/quirks）
        ▼
turn ​循环​（turn_api_call.py）──► _get_transport() ──► build_kwargs → normalize_response
        ▼
NormalizedResponse ──► ​回到​主​循环​的​ OpenAI ​形态​世界​
  • transport ​不​碰​的​都​住​在​别处​：client ​生命周期​在​ client_lifecycle.py，​流式​在​ turn_api_call.py/stream_* ​家族​，​凭据​在​ credential_pool.py，​缓存​键​在​ prompt_cache_scope.py。
  • anthropic ​族​是​"​薄壳​ transport + ​厚​ adapter"​的​范本​：​转换​与​端点​判定​在​ anthropic_message_convert.py/anthropic_endpoints.py（​纯​函数​、​无​循环​ import）。
  • codex ​族​另成​一篇​：codex_runtime.md；​凭据​解析​归​ credentials_rate.md。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• ​三层​各管​一件​事​：​声明​层​（Profile ​描述​行为​）→ ​路由​层​（agent_init ​阶梯​定​ api_mode ​与​ client）→ ​数据​层​（transports ​只​做​格式​转换​与​ normalize）。
  • ​路由​是​一条​有序​阶梯​：​显式​（​含​插件​ dialect）→ provider slug → host ​检测​ → ​默认​ chat_completions；URL ​驱动​判定​是​刻意​设计​（#63425）。
  • ​五个​内置​ api_mode：chat_completions、codex_responses、anthropic_messages、 bedrock_converse、codex_app_server（​子​进程​ JSON-RPC）。
  • ​声明​式​压倒​旗标​：ProviderProfile ​一个​ dataclass ​说​清​ auth/endpoints/quirks； LazyHeaders ​把​版本​探活​成本​推迟​到​首读​。
  • ​插件​一等​公民​：register_transport ​注册​ dialect、register_provider ​注册​ profile； ​懒​发现​三​来源​ + ​同名​ last-writer-wins，​第三方​无需​改​仓库​即可​替换​内置​。
  • NormalizedResponse ​是​唯一​的​边界​类型​：​协议​专属​状态​进​ provider_data，​共享​类型​ ​不随​ provider ​膨胀​。

docs.title: multimodal_media.md — ​多​模态​与​媒体​ provider ​注册表​:​六对​ registry/provider、​视觉​消息​准备​与​图片​生命周期
文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​的​"​多​模态​"​不是​模块​而是​注册表​模式​:​每种​能力​(​图片​生成​、​视频​生成​、TTS、​语音​转写​、 ​网页​搜索​、​云​浏览器​)​一对​文件​——*_provider.py ​定义​ ABC ​与​响应​信封​,*_registry.py ​持有​ ProviderRegistry ​并​实现​"​选​谁​"。​插件​经​ PluginContext.register_<kind>_provider() ​注册​,core ​只​ ​认​抽象​基类​——"​窄​腰​内核​ + ​能力​住​边缘​"​的​落法​;​六个​ registry ​共享​引擎​ agent/provider_registry.py。 ​其余​文件​围着​图片​的​生命周期​转​(​入站​路由​、​消息​准备​、​出站​退休​、​成本​学习​、​历史​重​放​); voice_turn_route.py ​是​语音​聊天​的​ per-turn ​换轨​,gemini_long_decode.py ​处理​ Gemini 4 ​多​跳​ ​续传​(​细节​见​模型​层​文档​)。

​模型​要​一张​图​:
  image_generate(prompt, aspect_ratio, image_url?)
    ▼ image_gen_registry.get_active_provider()      ← ​选​谁​
      ​配置​命中​ → ​直接​返回​(​可用性​检查​关掉​,​错误信息​精确​)
      ​未​配置​ → ​唯一​可用​者​ / fal ​遗留​默认​ / None(​工具​指向​ hermes tools)
    ▼ ImageGenProvider.generate(...)                ← ​干活​:​有图​路由​编辑​端点​;​统一​信封​
    ▼ save_b64_image / save_url_image → $HERMES_HOME/cache/generated/images/
    ▼ ​图片​的​后半生​:vision_message_prep ​出站​准备​ / image_eviction_policy ​条件​化​退休​ /
      image_token_cost ​学​每​图价​ / image_replay ​重建​历史​时​重放​ [screenshot]

docs.title: 1. ​注册表​引擎​:ProviderRegistry ​与​ export()
docs.text:
​所有​ *_registry.py ​共享​一个​泛型​引擎​:​全局​表是​插件​注册​的​默认​落点​,per-profile ​的​ _scoped_providers ​服务​多路​网关​;merged() ​用​作用域​表​覆盖​全局​表​;​快照​/​回滚​对​是​插件​卸载​的​ undo ​机制​:

# agent/provider_registry.py:77-112(​节选​)
def register(self, provider: P, *, scope: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    """Register a provider; same-name re-registration overwrites (hot reload)."""
    if not isinstance(provider, self.provider_cls):
        ...raise TypeError(...)
    if not isinstance(provider.name, str) or not provider.name.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{self.label} provider .name must be a non-empty string")
    key = self.normalize(provider.name)
    if key in self.builtin_names:                 # ​内建名​保留​:​撞名​只​警告​,​注册​被​跳​过​
        if self._on_builtin_collision is not None:
            self._on_builtin_collision(key)
        return
    with self._lock:
        self._target(scope, create=True)[key] = provider
        self._bump(scope)

def merged(self, scope: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[str, P]:
    """Global map overlaid with the active profile's scoped map (a copy)."""
    with self._lock:
        merged = dict(self._providers)
        merged.update(self._scoped_providers.get(hermes_home_key(scope), {}))
    return merged

​每个​ *_registry.py ​只​需​三行​:​建​ ProviderRegistry、_registry.export(globals()) ​把​历史​模块​级​ ​名字​(register_provider/get_provider/_providers ​测试​钩子​……)​绑进​自己​命名​空间​,​旧​补丁​路径​ patch("agent.x_registry.get_provider") ​继续​成立​。normalize ​可​选​ str.strip/lower_key/ exact_key——TTS registry ​用​ lower_key ​且​内建​名单​恒​保留​,​插件​名撞​内建​永远​赢​不了​。

docs.title: 2. ​选择​规则​:​配置​命中​与​可用性​的​微妙​关系
docs.text:
​六对​ registry ​的​ get_active_provider() ​形同​实异​,​差异​全在​"​配置​了​但​不可​用​怎么办​"。​图片​生成​的​ ​规则​最有​代表性​——​显式​配置​者​即使​ is_available() ​为​ False ​也​照返​,​让​调度​器​给出​精确​的​ "X_API_KEY is not set"​错误​,​而​不是​悄悄​换后​端​:

# agent/image_gen_registry.py:27-47(​节选​)
def get_active_provider() -> Optional[ImageGenProvider]:
    """...an explicitly configured provider is returned even if ``is_available()`` is False, so the
    dispatcher surfaces a precise "X_API_KEY is not set" error instead of silently switching
    backends; only the unconfigured fallback path is filtered by availability."""
    configured = configured_provider_name("image_gen", logger)
    snapshot = _registry.merged()
    if configured:
        if snapshot.get(configured) is not None:
            return snapshot[configured]           # ​配置​命中​:​可用性​检查​关掉​
        logger.debug("image_gen.provider='%s' configured but not registered; falling back", configured)
    available = [p for p in snapshot.values()
                 if is_available_safe(p, logger, "image_gen provider %s.is_available() raised %s")]
    if len(available) == 1:
        return available[0]                       # ​未​配置​回落​:​唯一​可用​者​,​或​ fal ​遗留​默认​
    fal = snapshot.get("fal")
    return fal if fal is not None and is_available_safe(fal, logger, "...") else None

​对照​另外​三种​口味​:​视频​生成​配置​未注册​时​ fail-closed(​返回​ None,​不​回落​);​浏览器​沿​ _LEGACY_PREFERENCE ​走​遗留​偏好​序​;​网页​搜索​ 5 ​级​优先​序​(​配置​键​ → ​唯一​可用​ → ​遗留​偏好​ → keyless ​免费​ → None),supports_search/supports_extract ​能力​过滤​每步​生效​。is_available_safe ​把​抛​异常​ ​的​ provider ​视为​不可​用​——​插件​代码​永远​不该​炸​穿​注册表​。

docs.title: 3. Provider ABC ​们​与​密钥​作用域
docs.text:
ImageGenProvider.generate ​的​签名​浓缩​了​这类​设计​的​取舍​:​一个​工具​同时​覆盖​文生​图​和​编辑​ (image_url/reference_image_urls ​存在​即​路由​到​编辑​端点​),​未知​ kwargs ​必须​忽略​(​前向​ ​兼容​),capabilities() ​动态​进​工具​ schema:

# agent/image_gen_provider.py:46-60(​节选​)
@abc.abstractmethod
def generate(
    self,
    prompt: str,
    aspect_ratio: str = DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO,
    *,
    image_url: Optional[str] = None,
    reference_image_urls: Optional[list[str]] = None,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Generate an image, or edit ``image_url`` ...; any source image routes to the edit endpoint.
    Unknown ``kwargs`` MUST be ignored (forward compat); ``upscale`` (bool) is a post-generation
    high-res pass, reported as ``upscaled: True`` in ``extra``."""

​响应​信封​由​ success_response/error_response ​统一​构造​,extra ​键​只能​追加​不能​覆盖​标准​键​; ​落盘​共用​ agent/provider_media.py(save_b64_image/save_url_image,25MB ​上限​)。​视频​ ABC ​镜像​ ​这套​但​刻意​不​暴露​视频​编辑​/​扩展​——​各家​后端​太​不​一致​。TTS ​的​额外​面是​流式​(stream() ​产出​ int16 mono PCM,​每句​可​并发​必须​ thread-safe),​整段​ synthesize ​仍​保底​;​转写​ ABC ​的​流式​面是​ TranscriptionStreamSession.push_audio(16kHz mono s16le)+ finalize(​不得​抛​)。

​密钥​侧​,web_search_provider.get_provider_env ​是​"​配置​层​密钥​"​的​读取​口​,​其​最后​一段​是​最​重要​的​多​ profile ​防线​——​作用域​未​绑定​时​拒绝​回落​ os.environ(​那里​躺​的​是​启动​ profile ​的​密钥​):

# agent/web_search_provider.py:44-53
    scope_bound, multiplex_active = _secret_scope_state()
    if val is None and multiplex_active and not scope_bound:
        from agent.secret_scope import UnscopedSecretError

        raise UnscopedSecretError(name, f"get_provider_env({name!r}) called with no active profile scope")
    if val is None and not scope_bound:
        val = os.getenv(name, "")
    return (val or "").strip()

​被​路由​的​ profile ​没有​ Exa/Parallel ​密钥​时​必须​拒绝​,​而​不是​拿​另​一个​ profile ​的​密钥​去​搜索​。 browser_page_backend.py ​是​密钥​安全​的​另一半​:​插件​浏览器​自带​页面​时​,evaluate(..., secret=True) ​的​ ​契约​——​嵌入​凭据​的​表达式​只​走​ loopback/HTTPS、​不进​ argv、​不​跟随​重定向​、​不进​日志​;core ​负责​包装​ ​脚本​让​页面​异常​永远​到​不了​后​端的​错误​文本​。

docs.title: 4. ​入站​路由​:decide_image_input_mode ​与​魔法​字节
docs.text:
​用户​发​的​图​走​两条路​:native(OpenAI ​风格​ image_url part,​模型​原生​看​图​)​或​ text(​先跑​ vision_analyze ​把​有损​描述​垫​在​前面​,​给​非​视觉​模型​)。auto ​裁决​:​显式​ auxiliary.vision ​后​端​强制​ text(​即使​主模型​有​视觉​);​否则​ supports_vision(​配置​覆盖​ > ​模型​目录​)​裁决​:

# agent/image_routing.py:375-391(​节选​)
def decide_image_input_mode(provider: str, model: str, cfg: Optional[dict[str, Any]], *,
                            requested_provider: str = "") -> str:
    """Return ``"native"`` or ``"text"`` for the given turn (``cfg`` None behaves as auto)."""
    mode_cfg = _coerce_mode(_dict_or_empty(_dict_or_empty(cfg).get("agent")).get("image_input_mode"))
    if mode_cfg != "auto":
        return mode_cfg
    if _explicit_aux_vision_override(cfg):  # auto: an explicit auxiliary.vision backend wins
        return "text"
    extra = {"requested_provider": requested_provider} if requested_provider else {}
    return "native" if _lookup_supports_vision(provider, model, cfg, **extra) is True else "text"

​同一​文件​埋着​两个​鲁棒性​细节​。​其一​,​尺寸​处理​是​反应式​的​:​全​尺寸​附上​,​等​ provider ​报​ 400 ​再​缩小​ ​重试​——​主动式​尺寸​表会​过时​并​悄悄​降质​。​其二​,MIME ​用​魔法​字节​嗅探​(_sniff_mime_from_bytes, image_routing.py:419):​平台​会​说谎​(Discord ​把​ PNG ​贴纸​伺服​成​ image/webp),Anthropic ​对​ media_type ​不​匹配​直接​ 400。​自由​文本​挖图​(extract_image_refs)​也​在​这​:​局部​路径​必须​真实​存在​、URL ​不​验证​、​代码​围栏​里​的​匹配​跳过​——​贴​的​代码​片段​不该​变成​活​附件​。

docs.title: 5. ​出站​消息​准备​:VisionMessagePrepMixin ​的​非​视觉​回退
docs.text: ​模型​不​支持​视觉​但​历史​里​有​图​怎么办​?_describe_image_for_anthropic_fallback(vision_message_prep.py:92) ​把​图​交给​ vision_analyze ​换成​详尽​文字描述​,​替换​图片​ part:​描述​按​图片​内容​的​ sha256 ​缓存​,data: URL ​先落​临时文件​再​喂​,20MB base64 ​上限​防​共享​网关​被​打爆​内存​。​兜底​形状​值得注意​——​分析​失败​不是​抛​异常​, ​而是​ [Image analysis failed: ...]:turn ​继续​,​错误​对模型​可见​;​材料​化​失败​的​临时文件​必须​删​ (delete=False ​否则​每次​失败​漏​一个​ 0 ​字节​文件​)。

docs.title: 6. ​出站​退休​:image_eviction_policy ​的​"​条件​化​阈值​"
docs.text:
​老​图片​要​从​每​请求​拷贝​里​退休​——​但​为什么​触发​阈值​是​ provider ​限值​而​不是​"​保留​最近​ N ​张​"?​退休​ ​图片​等于​编辑​一条​ provider ​已​缓存​的​消息​,Anthropic ​的​提示​缓存​按​精确​字节​前缀​匹配​;"keep-newest-N" ​每来​一张​新图​就​多​退休​一条​消息​,​每​ turn ​都​是​全​前缀​ miss。​按住​不​动​直到​请求​真​会​越过​ API ​限值​, ​然后​成批​退休​,​每批​只花​一个​慢​ turn:

# agent/image_eviction_policy.py:42-55(​节选​)
OUTBOUND_IMAGE_LIMIT = 20            # Anthropic ​更严​ 2000px ​帽​的​文档​阈值​
OUTBOUND_IMAGE_HARD_LIMIT = 100
OUTBOUND_IMAGE_BUDGET_BYTES = 24_000_000
IMAGE_EVICTION_BATCH = 8
MANY_IMAGE_DIMENSION_LIMIT = 2000

20 ​是​条件​化​的​:Anthropic ​的​更严​ 2000px ​帽​文档​阈值​就是​ 20,​而​ Hermes ​入​历史​前​已​把​工具​图缩​到​ 1568px——​第​ 21 ​张​截图​不​触发​ provider ​约束​,​在​那里​退休​只会​白付​一次​全​前缀​重写​、​还​作废​后续​所有​ thinking ​块​。​仅​当​某​张图​实测​超过​ 2000px ​才​适用​ 20,​否则​天花板​是​硬限​ 100。​分类​只读​图片​头​(​前​ 32KB base64 ​前缀​解​出​ PNG IHDR / JPEG SOF),​读不出​尺寸​一律​按​不​安全​处理​(fail-closed)。​两趟​退休​ (OpenAI ​形​列表​与​ Anthropic wire ​列表​)​共享​这​ stdlib-only ​的​一册​策略​——​必须​在​同一​前沿​退休​,​否则​ ​第二趟​会以​不同​前沿​再​退休​一次​(#113517)。

docs.title: 7. ​学​出来​的​每图​成本​与​历史​重​放
docs.text:
​固定​每图​ token ​常数​两头​都​错​:​同​一张​ 1080p ​截图​在​一个​ provider ​花​ ~1,100 tokens,​本地​ mmproj ​模型​ 4,000+。​但​ provider ​在​携带​它​的​那个​请求​里​把​图​定价​得​明明白白​——​用​新鲜​的​ usage ​锚​,​残差​ (prompt_tokens - anchor - ​纯​文本​增量​)​就是​本次​引入​的​ N ​张图​的​价格​:

# agent/image_token_cost.py:1-12(docstring ​节选​)
"""Per-image token cost learned from the provider's own usage, never from a vendor formula. ...
The learned value is kept per ``model@host`` in ``~/.hermes/cache/image_token_costs.json`` so a
new session starts calibrated, and bound per turn through a ContextVar so every estimator
(preflight trigger, tail-budget walk, gateway hygiene) prices images the same way."""

​学习​值​按​ model@host ​存​ image_token_costs.json(​合理​带​ 64..32768 ​之外​的​观测​是​文本​估计​噪声​, ​不入表​),​经​ ContextVar ​每​ turn ​绑定​——​预检​触发器​、​尾部​预算​游走​、​网关​卫生​检查​全部​同价​; _table() ​有​ profile ​分叉​,​路由​ profile ​用​自己​的​缓存​文件​,​否则​会​把​ A profile ​学到​的​价写​进​每个​ home。

DB ​只存​文本​行​([screenshot]),--resume/API ​服务器​/​网关​重启​后​的​重建​历史​会​让​模型​看到​占位​符而非​ ​一​消息​前​的​照片​。​字节​没​丢​(​在​ profile ​的​ native-inputs/<sha256>/),image_replay ​把​最近​的​图变​回​ image_url part:

# agent/image_replay.py:12-21(docstring ​节选​)
"""On the WIRE COPY only, when this turn sends images natively, the ``vision.replay_recent_images``
newest images (default 3, 0 = off) go back as ``image_url`` parts; older ones drop in whole
batches of that size (``replay_frontier``), so the cached prefix is rewritten at most once per
batch rather than on every new photo. ... byte-identical ... the prompt-cache prefix holds."""

​三个​"​只​"​字​是​安全​边界​:​只改​ wire ​拷贝​(​存储​行不动​)、​只​重放​留存​且​摘要​仍​匹配​的​字节​(​远程​ URL ​会​过期​然后​每​ turn 400;​网关​的​ settled-media ​清扫​会​收走​旧​文件​;​两者​都​保持​ [screenshot] ​文本​)、 data URL ​来自​与​实况​ turn ​相同​的​ _file_to_data_url——​重建​行​与​首次​发送​它​的​请求​字节​一致​,​前缀​ ​才​保得住​。_split_rebuilt_row ​按行序​拆出​ text/image ​部件​,marker ​与​ [Image attached…] ​提示​ 1:1 ​配对​,​数量​不符​则​放弃​重​放​。

docs.title: 8. ​语音​换轨​:voice_turn_route ​的​快照​/​回装
docs.text:
​语音​ turn(CLI ​语音输入​、​桌面​/TUI ​语音​对话​、​消息​语音​便签​)​可以​跑​更​快​的​小​模型​。​关键​约束​:​路由​绑定​ ​在​ turn setup ​末尾​(​系统​提示​词和会​话行​已​按​主模型​建​好​、​预检​压缩​已​按​主模型​窗口​判过​),turn ​后​ ​工作​(​记忆​同步​、​后台​审查​)​前​解除​——turn ​之外​没​人​看见​它​:

# agent/voice_turn_route.py:134-163(​节选​)
def begin_voice_turn_route(agent: Any, messages, system_prompt: Any) -> Any:
    """Bind the voice route for a marked turn; returns the system prompt the turn should send."""
    if not getattr(agent, "_voice_turn_pending", False):
        return system_prompt
    agent._voice_turn_pending = False
    ...
    state: dict[str, Any] = {"reasoning_config": copy.deepcopy(getattr(agent, "reasoning_config", None))}
    agent._voice_route_state = state
    if target is not None:
        state.update(_capture(agent))          # ​快照​ + ​外部​字段​整包​抓走​
        if reason:                             # bind ​失败​或​装不下​(​超​语音​模型​窗口​)
            _reinstall(agent, state)           # ​原样​放​回​ + ​警告​一次​
            _warn_once(agent, target, reason)
            agent._voice_route_state = {"reasoning_config": state["reasoning_config"]}
            return agent._cached_system_prompt or system_prompt

​换​轨前​ _capture ​把​ _primary_runtime ​快照​ + ​一串​外部​字​段​(fallback ​状态​、​凭据​池​、reasoning ​拒绝​ ​旗标​)​整包​抓走​;​失败​或​"​装不下​"(​会话​ token ​超过​语音​模型​的​压缩​阈值​——​切​语音​绝不​为​小​模型​压缩​ ​对话​)​就​ _reinstall ​原样​放回​并​警告​一次​。session_runtime_view ​再​补​一刀​:turn ​进行​中​ surfaces ​应当​报告​的​是​会​话​的​模型​而​非​语音​路由​——​否则​桌面​把​临时​路由​采纳​进​ composer、​新​聊天​继承​ reasoning off。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ ProviderRegistry / export / configured_provider_name / is_available_safe agent/provider_registry.py:31/167/190/179 ​注册表​引擎​与​配置​读取​;​抛​异常​ provider = ​不可​用​ ImageGenProvider.generate / success_response / save_b64_image agent/image_gen_provider.py:47/106/83 ​文生​图​/​编辑​合一​;​统一​信封​;​生成物​落盘​ get_active_provider(image_gen) agent/image_gen_registry.py:27 ​配置​命中​即返​(​可用性​只​过滤​回落​路径​) TTSProvider.stream / TranscriptionStreamSession agent/tts_provider.py:43, transcription_provider.py:51 PCM ​流式​;16kHz ​流式​转写​会话​ get_provider_env agent/web_search_provider.py:24 ​作用域​安全​的​密钥​读取​(​未​绑​ scope ​拒绝​回落​) BrowserProvider.create_session / BrowserPageBackend.evaluate agent/browser_provider.py:44, browser_page_backend.py:32 ​云​浏览器​会话​;secret ​求值​契约​ decide_image_input_mode / extract_image_refs / _sniff_mime_from_bytes agent/image_routing.py:375/69/419 native/text ​裁决​;​自由​文本​挖图​;​魔法​字节​ MIME ​嗅探​ _describe_image_for_anthropic_fallback / image_dimensions_from_bytes agent/vision_message_prep.py:92, image_eviction_policy.py:63 ​非​视觉​回退​;​仅​读头​的​尺寸​探针​ learned_image_token_cost / current_image_token_cost / _split_rebuilt_row agent/image_token_cost.py:72/77, image_replay.py:53 ​学到​的​每​图价​;turn ​绑​定价​;​重建​行​拆回​原始​部件​ begin_voice_turn_route / end_voice_turn_route / session_runtime_view agent/voice_turn_route.py:134/200/192 ​语音​路由​绑定​/​幂​等​解除​/​会话​运行​时​视图​ long_decode_max_output_tokens / long_decode_hops agent/gemini_long_decode.py:29/37 Gemini 4 ​长​解码​预算​与​跳数​上界

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text:
文件​ ​主题​ ​一句​话​ agent/image_gen_provider.py ​图片​生成​ ABC + ​统一​信封​ + ​生成物​落盘​ agent/image_gen_registry.py ​图片​生成​ registry ​与​选择​规则​(​配置​命中​即返​) agent/video_gen_provider.py ​视频​生成​ ABC(​编辑​/​扩展​刻意​不​暴露​) agent/video_gen_registry.py ​视频​生成​ registry(​配置​未注册​ fail-closed) agent/tts_provider.py ​语音​ TTS ABC(​整段​ + ​可​选​ PCM ​流​) agent/tts_registry.py ​语音​ registry(​内建名​保留​) agent/transcription_provider.py ​语音​ STT ABC + ​流式​会话​ agent/transcription_registry.py ​语音​ registry(​内​建​优先​) agent/web_search_provider.py ​搜索​ Web ABC + ​作用域​安全​ env ​读取​ agent/web_search_registry.py ​搜索​ registry(5 ​级​优先​序​) agent/browser_provider.py ​浏览器​ ​云​浏览器​ ABC(​会话​三件套​) agent/browser_registry.py ​浏览器​ registry(​遗留​偏好​序​) agent/browser_page_backend.py ​浏览器​ ​自有​页面​传输​的​求值​ ABC agent/browser_page_registry.py ​浏览器​ ​页面​后​端​ registry agent/image_routing.py ​图片​生命周期​ ​入站​路由​/​挖图​/MIME ​嗅探​/data URL agent/vision_message_prep.py ​图片​生命周期​ VisionMessagePrepMixin ​出站​准备​ agent/image_eviction_policy.py ​图片​生命周期​ ​出站​旧图​条件​化成​批​退休​ agent/image_token_cost.py ​图片​生命周期​ ​从​ usage ​残差​学​的​每​图价​ agent/image_replay.py ​图片​生命周期​ DB ​重建​历史​的​图片​重​放​ agent/voice_turn_route.py ​语音​ turn per-turn ​模型​换轨​(​快照​/​回装​) agent/gemini_long_decode.py ​模型​层​ Gemini 4 ​多​跳续​传​(​细节​见​模型​层​文档​)

(agent/provider_registry.py ​是​共享​引擎​,​已​在​走读​ 1 ​讲​。)

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/:image_generate、video_generate、text_to_speech、transcribe_audio、 web_search/web_extract、browser_exec ​的​包装​器​消费​这些​ registry;vision_analyze_tool ​是非​ ​视觉​回退​的​分析器​;tools/browser_vault ​与​ browser_page_backend ​的​ secret ​求值​协作​(​见​ platform_misc.md ​的​ vault ​族​)。
  • plugins/:​六个​ registry ​全部​由​ PluginContext.register_*_provider() ​从​ plugins/<kind>/<name>/ ​或​ ~/.hermes/plugins/<kind>/<name>/ ​填充​;​卸载​走​快照​/​回滚​对​。
  • agent/​其余​:provider_media.save_b64/save_url ​是​生成物​落盘​底座​;secret_scope ​支撑​ get_provider_env ​的​ fail-closed;model_metadata ​与​ turn_preflight ​消费​ image_token_cost ​的​ ContextVar ​价​;anthropic_message_convert._evict_old_screenshots ​与​ context_compressor.evict_stale_outbound_tool_images ​是​退休​策略​的​两个​消费者​。
  • gateway/:​桌面​语音​便签​、​消息​附件​与​ voice turn ​标记​(_voice_turn_pending)​来自​网关​; runtime_footer.py ​的​ opt-in served_model ​字​段​消费​ served_model ​捕获​。
  • models.dev / ​目录​:supports_vision ​目录​查询​ + ​配置​覆盖​决定​ native ​路由​;_coerce_capability_bool ​防​ YAML ​引号​陷阱​("false" ​静默​启用​ native)。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​一组​的​骨架​是​一对​模式​:provider ABC ​定义​"​能​做​什么​",registry ​定义​"​用​哪​一个​",​插件​注册​, core ​零​知识​。​学会​读​ get_active_provider() ​的​变体​(​配置​命中​即返​ / fail-closed / ​遗留​偏好​ / keyless ​兜底​)​就​学会​了​ Hermes ​对​"​可​插拔​后​端​"​的​全部​态度​——​显式​配置​的​错误​要​精确​,​静默​换后​端​ ​是​ bug。​图片​生命周期​则​展示​了​第二课​:​缓存​是​设计​约束​,​不是​优化​项​。​退休​按​ provider ​限值​ ​条件​化成​批​触发​、​重放​按​批次​推进​且​字节​一致​、​成本价​经​ ContextVar ​让​每个​估计​器​同价​——​所有​这些​ ​都​在​回答​同一​道题​:"​改动​历史​里​的​一张​图​,​要​让​ provider ​重写​多少​字节​的​前缀​?"​答案​永远​是​: ​尽量​一次​都​不​写​。

docs.title: onboarding_sessions.md — ​会话​生命周期​与​新手​引导​:​一次性​提示​、first-run ​状态机​、​转录​持久​化​与​缓存​安全​注入
文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​讲​ agent ​侧​"​会话​"​的​一​整圈​外围​:​会话​从​哪里​来​(​来源​标签​、​客户端​环境​)、​活​没​活着​ (​活动​时钟​、​看门狗​喂食​)、​怎么​落盘​(SQLite ​转录​持久​化​、​持久​化​回执​)、​怎么​换皮​(​表面​切换​、 ​编码​姿态​),​以及​两条​新手​引导​路径​——CLI/​网关​上​的​一次性​ first-touch ​提示​,​和​桌面​端​ first-run ​的​ "​一次​聊天​跑​完​所有​节拍​"​状态机​。​主旋律​是​那条​最老​的​不​变量​:​不要​动已​缓存​的​前缀​——​范例​是​ subdirectory_hints.py:​新​发现​的​上下文​文件​"​骑​"​在​工具​结果​上​注入​,​系统​提示​词一字​不动​。

first-run ​引导​是​纯​数据​状态机​:onboarding_flow.py ​定义​ 7 ​个​节拍​(name → theme → layout → connectors → plugins → tour → build),apply(record, event, facts) ​返回​"​新​记录​ + ​模型​可见​结果​ + ​提醒​键​";onboarding_record.py ​把​记录​存进​会话行​的​ sessions.model_config(​不​加​ schema); onboarding_session.py ​折入​ onboarding ​工具集​,onboarding_text.py ​出​文案​, onboarding_facts.py ​提供​无需​同意​的​机器​事实​,onboarding_first_tasks.py ​是​ build ​节拍​的​任务​ ​目录​。

​桌面​ first-run ​引导​(​一次​聊天​,setup_beat ​工具​驱动​):
  start(db, session_id, facts)  →  ​写​ onboarding_run + set_run(True)
  ​聊天​循环​:
    ​脚本​开场​(​问候​+name ​卡​,onboarding_prelude)
    ​模型​调​ setup_beat(beat=...) → apply(record, Shown/Answered/Wrote/...)
        → Step(record, result, reminder)            onboarding_flow
    ​普通​工具​结果​也​结算​节拍​:set_theme/manage_connections/gui_tour → Applied
        (observe_tool_result, onboarding_record.py:161)
  build ​卡​的​答案​被​结算​ → phase=COMPLETE → ​安装​级​ flag ​关闭​
​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/onboarding.py 251 ​一次性​ first-touch ​提示​(busy/tool-progress/OpenClaw ​残留​/​首条​消息​ note)+ first-run ​入口​ agent/onboarding_facts.py 35 ​无需​同意​的​"​类​ A"​机器​事实​(OS/arch/​机器​类型​/NVIDIA ​平台​/locale) agent/onboarding_first_tasks.py 328 build ​节拍​的​首​任务​目录​(FirstTask + ​资格​门​) agent/onboarding_flow.py 429 ​节拍​与​运行​记录​的​纯​状态机​:apply() ​是​唯一​事件​归约​器​ agent/onboarding_record.py 178 ​运行​记录​存取​:​一次​数据库​事务​里​的​ load→apply→save agent/onboarding_session.py 92 ​会话级​拼装​:​工具集​折入​、​脚本​开场​、per-turn note agent/onboarding_text.py 392 ​全部​文案​:​多​语言​问候​、​隐藏​首​ turn ​的​开场​提示​词​、​提醒​渲染​ agent/session_source.py 72 ​来源​词表​:tui/desktop/cli/oneshot/... ​与​"​有人​在​看​"​判定​ agent/session_client_env.py 170 shell ​客户端​冻结​进会​话​的​白名单​环境​(ContextVar ​绑定​) agent/session_activity.py 149 ​活动​观察​契约​:​时间​戳​ + ​有​界​描述​ + provenance ​枚举​ + ​睡眠​修正​ agent/activity_tracking.py 149 ActivityTrackingMixin:_touch_activity ​单写​路径​ + ​限频​持久​化​ agent/session_persistence.py 607 SessionPersistenceMixin:SQLite ​转录​落盘​、​去​重​标记​、​脚手架​过滤​ agent/persisted_turn_receipt.py 65 message.complete.persisted_turn ​回执​:​按​ row_id ​绑定​流式​回复​ agent/history_commentary.py 181 Codex commentary ​显示​投影​(REST/​网关​历史​共用​,​源​数据​不​动​) agent/coding_context.py 592 "​我们​在​写​代码​吗​"​的​唯一​裁决​点​:​冻结​的​ RuntimeMode ​姿态​ agent/subdirectory_hints.py 326 ​渐进​子目录​提示​:​首访​目录​把​ AGENTS.md ​骑上​工具​结果​ agent/surface_switch.py 140 ​表面​切换​不​重建​提示​词​:​当前​表面​指导​走​ per-turn note agent/served_model.py 68 ​路由​代理​的​"​实际​服务​模型​"​捕获​(httpx ​响应​钩子​)

docs.title: 1. ​一次性​提示​:onboarding.seen.<flag> ​与​"​任务​优先​"​条款
docs.text:
CLI/​网关​上​的​引导​极轻​:​每个​提示​只​在​每个​安装​出现​一次​,​旗标​存​ config.yaml ​的​ onboarding.seen ​下​; ​文件​刻意​小​而​无​依赖​。​首条​消息​的​ note ​有个​关键​条款​——​绝不​让​引导​语​吃掉​真实​任务​:

# agent/onboarding.py:131-136 + 138-143(​节选​)
TASK_FIRST_CLAUSE = (
    "If this message is itself a real request or task, DO THE TASK FIRST -- call "
    "whatever tools it needs -- and only then, in the closing sentences of that same "
    "reply, do what this note asks. Never let this note replace or skip work the user "
    "actually asked for. "
)
# PLAIN_INTRO_NOTE = "[System note: ... " + TASK_FIRST_CLAUSE + "briefly introduce yourself ...]"

first_contact_turn_note()(onboarding.py:146)​决定​首条​消息​挂​哪份​ note:profile_build: ask ​且​ ​旗标​未落​ → profile-build ​指令​(​先问​后查​、​绝不​静默​读​已​连接​账号​),​否则​普通​自我介绍​;​会话​历史​非空​、 ​安装​里​已有​旧会话​、first-run ​进行​中​三者​任一​即​返回​ None。mark_seen()(onboarding.py:210)​用​ atomic_config_write ​原子​落​旗标​,​失败​静默​(​引导​失败​不该​毁掉​真实​回复​)。

docs.title: 2. first-run ​状态机​:BEATS ​与​ apply()
docs.text:
​整个​引导​是​数据​:​节拍​表​ + ​事件​归约​。Beat ​自带​ when ​门​(​这台​机器​要​不要​跳过​)、values(​可​接受​ ​的​答案​ id)、after(​结算​后​的​提醒​键​);_settle_unfit ​建​记录​时​就​把​不​适用​节拍​标成​ skipped:

# agent/onboarding_flow.py:174-187(​节选​)
BEATS: tuple[Beat, ...] = (
    Beat("name", lambda facts, picks: {}, picks=("name",), value="name"),
    Beat("theme", lambda facts, picks: {"picker": "accent"}, picks=("accent", "mode"), value="accent"),
    Beat("layout", lambda facts, picks: {"options": list(LAYOUT_OPTIONS)}, picks=("layout",), value="layout",
         values=lambda facts, picks: _option_ids(LAYOUT_OPTIONS)),
    Beat("connectors", lambda facts, picks: {}, picks=("connected", "newly_connected")),
    Beat("plugins", ..., when=lambda facts, picks: bool(facts.plugins)),   # ​这台​机器​没装​就​不​显示​
    Beat("tour", ..., when=lambda facts, picks: facts.tours),
    Beat("build", ..., value="build", values=build_values),                # ​首个​任务​卡​,​结算​即​完成​
)

apply()(onboarding_flow.py:412)​是​唯一​入口​:​深​拷贝​记录​、​按​事件​类型​分派​给​ _HANDLERS ​表​、build ​结算​即​完成​。​事件​ 9 ​种​——Shown(​出​卡片​)、Answered(​卡上​作答​)、Wrote(​改​发消息​)、TimedOut (​卡片​超时​ 300s)、Recorded(​值用​文字​给出​)、Skipped、End(Skip setup)、Done、Applied (​普通​工具​结果​结算​节拍​);​文件​纯​,​无​ I/O ​无​时钟​。valid_answer()(onboarding_flow.py:271)​防​ ​越权​:​答案​只能​携带​本​节拍​的​ pick ​键​、id ​必须​来自​卡片​自己​的​选项​,label ​只是​显示​文本​、​绝不​入库​。

docs.title: 3. ​运行​记录​存取​与​工具集​折入
docs.text:
​记录​存在​ sessions.model_config ​的​ onboarding_run ​键下​——​不​加​ schema,​压缩​轮转​顺带​携带​。 advance ​是​ start ​之后​的​唯一​写者​,​用回​调式​事务​把​读​和​写​放进​同一​临界​区​(Skip setup ​与​卡片​作答​ ​并发​时​,​旧​副本​不会​覆盖​新​状态​):

# agent/onboarding_record.py:47-70(​节选​)
def _transition(db, session_id: str, event: Event) -> Step | None:
    """Apply *event* and write the result in one database transaction at the compression tip ..."""
    holder: dict[str, Any] = {}
    def update(current: Any) -> Any:      # ​事务​内​回调​:load → apply → save
        holder["was_active"] = is_active(current)
        holder["step"] = apply(current, event, Facts.from_stored(current["facts"]), now=time.time())
        return holder["step"].record
    db.update_conversation_model_config_value(session_id, KEY, update)
    step = holder.get("step")
    # Told before the flag write, which can fail: the record already says the run ended.
    if step is not None and holder["was_active"] and not is_active(step.record):
        _announce(step.record.get("run_id"), session_id, step.record["ended_by"])
    if step is not None and not is_active(step.record) and active_session_id(db) is None:
        _close_install_flag()

​两个​次序​细节​:​结束​公告​在​写​安装​旗标​之前​发​(​旗标​写​可能​失败​,​而​记录​已​宣布​结束​);​旗标​只​在​ ​没有​别的​ run ​还开​着​时​关闭​——​旗标​属于​活着​的​ run,​旧​聊天​不能​替​它​收尾​。delete_chat() (onboarding_record.py:125)​则​先关​旗标​再​删​、​删除​失败​把​旗标​设回​,​并​把​每份​压缩​副本​逐行​写​上​ End("deleted")。

setup_beat ​什么​时候​进​工具​数组​?​答案​是​ agent ​构建​时定​死​——​工具​数组​是​缓存​前缀​的​一部分​, run ​结束​绝不​撤掉​(​已​结束​的​ run ​会​对​ setup_beat ​回绝​,​直到​会话​重建​):

# agent/onboarding_session.py:39-48(​节选​)
def onboarding_chat_toolsets(enabled, db, session_id: str):
    """...Keyed on the record existing, never on the run being open: the tool array is part of
    the cached prefix; a run that ends must not change it mid-conversation."""
    from agent.onboarding_record import load
    if keeps_toolsets(enabled) or db is None:
        return enabled
    tip = db.get_compression_tip(session_id) or session_id
    return with_onboarding(enabled) if load(db, tip) is not None else enabled

​判据​是​"​记录​存在​"​而​非​"run ​还开​着​"——​每​ turn ​都​解析​工具集​的​会​话​权威​,​若​按​ run ​开关​切换​, run ​结束​那一​ turn ​会​原地​丢弃​缓存​前缀​。​脚本​开场​ onboarding_prelude()(onboarding_session.py:58) ​只​在​ name ​节拍​从未​展示​时​产出​问候​ + ​第一次​ setup_beat ​调用​,​重启​时​问候​已​在​历史​里​就​不再​说​。

docs.title: 4. ​转录​持久​化​:​去​重​标记​与​临时​脚手架​过滤
docs.text:
SessionPersistenceMixin ​把​对话​落​ SQLite,​两个​契约​值得​背下来​。"​已落盘​"​标记​必须​挂​在​ dict ​的​键​ ​上​而​非​ id(msg) ​集合​——id() ​会​把​被​释放​ dict ​的​地址​别​名叫​到​新​消息​上​;​恢复​用​的​临时​脚手架​绝不​ ​进​持久​转录​,​否则​续会​话​会​重放​合成​ turn ​或​破坏​前缀​缓存​复用​:

# agent/session_persistence.py:34-44 + 52-60(​节选​)
_EPHEMERAL_SCAFFOLDING_FLAGS = (
    "_empty_recovery_synthetic",
    "_empty_terminal_sentinel",
    "_thinking_prefill",
    "_verification_stop_synthetic",  # verify-on-stop nudge; the assistant candidate itself is NOT synthetic
    "_pre_verify_synthetic",
    "_kanban_stop_synthetic",  # kanban worker stop-guard
    "_dropped_toolcall_nudge",  # internal retry instruction; must not replay as user context
)

# `_DB_PERSISTED_MARKER` ... is the intrinsic "already written to SQLite" marker: an
# id(msg) set can alias a freed dict's address onto a new message, a key on the dict cannot. ...
# CONTRACT: the marker asserts the dict's CONTENT is durable as written — any in-place mutation
# that must persist MUST pop it (turn_finalizer, context_compressor).

​落盘​是​文本​投影​:_durable_content()(session_persistence.py:122)​把​多​模态​信封​压成​摘要​、 ​图片​ part ​变成​位置​保​真的​ [screenshot](​带​ detail= ​的​标记​供​ image_replay ​重建​原始​ part)。 ​图片​字节​本体​没​丢​——​会话​权威​把​它们​提交​到​ profile ​的​内容​寻址​ native-inputs/<sha256>/,​行内​写​ [Image attached at: <path>],​这是​ image_replay ​的​前提​。​会话​ id ​是​可能​不可​信​的​ X-Hermes-Session-Id,_safe_session_filename_component()(session_persistence.py:63)​清洗​非法​ ​字符​并加​内容​哈希​防​碰撞​——​导出​/​轨迹​文件​的​路径​安全​层​。

docs.title: 5. ​活动​时钟​:​单写​路径​、​代数​计数​与​限频​心跳
docs.text:
ActivityTrackingMixin._touch_activity ​是​活动​戳​的​唯一​写​路径​。​在​一个​锁里​同时​推进​ monotonic ​代数​ ​和​时间​戳​,​让​看门狗​把​"​停滞​观察​"​绑定​到​确切​的​ (generation, timestamp),​避免​中断​一个​恰好​在​观察​ ​间隙​恢复​了​的​ turn:

# agent/activity_tracking.py:63-89(​节选​)
resolved_provenance = normalize_activity_provenance(provenance)
with _activity_lock(self):
    self._turn_liveness_activity_generation = (getattr(self, "_turn_liveness_activity_generation", 0) + 1)
    self._last_activity_ts = time.time()
    self._last_activity_desc = bound_activity_description(desc)
    self._last_activity_provenance = resolved_provenance
    self._turn_liveness_abort_claim = None   # real progress invalidates a reserved abort claim
if os.environ.get("HERMES_KANBAN_TASK"):     # kanban ​心跳​桥​(​限频​、best-effort、​永不​抛进​循环​)
    with suppress(Exception):
        heartbeat_current_worker_from_env(); inject_new_comments_from_env(self)  # OUT-OF-BAND steer
if force_persist or is_terminal_compression_provenance(resolved_provenance):
    # ... deferring this write leaves the durable row advertising a compression that has already
    # ended — the permanently "stuck" chat (#72039).
    reset_session_activity_persist_window(self)
self._persist_session_activity_if_due()

session_activity.py ​定义​共享​契约​:​描述​钳​ 120 ​字符​;provenance ​是​封闭​名词​枚举​(​默认​ unknown, ​压缩​写手​带​ agent.compression*);​心跳​下限​ 60s ​是​代码​常量​(​不许​任何​配置​把​它​变成​高频​写手​)。 AwakeIdleMeter(session_activity.py:121)​修​一个​真实​ bug:​挂​起​的​笔记本​按​ wall clock ​算​ idle, ​唤醒​后​第一​拍会​误杀​健康​ turn——time.monotonic() ​睡眠​时​暂停​,​两钟​之​差​就是​睡掉​的​秒数​。

docs.title: 6. ​来源​标签​、​客户端​环境​与​持久​化​回执
docs.text:
session_source.py ​是​词表​叶子​(​唯一​依赖​ stdlib-only):tui/desktop ​是​ UI ​传输​来源​、oneshot ​让​ hermes chat -q ​在​人工​选择器​里​隐藏​、ATTENDED_SOURCES ​判定​"turn ​运行​时​有人​在​看​":

# agent/session_source.py:17-30
UI_TRANSPORT_SOURCES = frozenset({"tui", "desktop"})
ONESHOT_SOURCE = "oneshot"
CLI_FAMILY_SOURCES = frozenset({"cli", ONESHOT_SOURCE})
DAYBREAK_SOURCES = UI_TRANSPORT_SOURCES | {"cli"}
ATTENDED_SOURCES = UI_TRANSPORT_SOURCES | {"cli", "acp"}

session_client_env.py ​解决​"​一个​网关​进程​服务​所有​会话​"​后​的​环境​归属​:​客户端​在​ session.create ​时​把​白名单​值​(​行为​名​ + ​工具​链名​ + profile ​配置​的​额外​名​)​随会话​冻结​,​绑​到​ ContextVar (client_env_scope),​绝不​写​进​网关​的​ os.environ。session_env() ​读​行为​值​、toolchain_environ() ​为​工具​子​进程​装配​环境​——​本​客户端​没​导出​的​工具​链​变量​被​显式​ unset(​一个​客户端​的​ venv ​不能​经​ daemon ​渗进​另​一​客户端​的​会​话​),_travels() ​还​拦下​命中​密钥​策略​的​ NODE_ ​前缀​名​;​非​ local ​客户端​(Desktop)​只​保留​不​指名​本​主机​的​值​。

persisted_turn_receipt() ​为​ message.complete.persisted_turn ​事件​产出​本​ turn ​已​提交​行​的​地址​; docstring ​里​的​设计​意图​一句​话​:​报告​已​提交​的​ row ​地址​,​绝不​做​文本​/​时间​戳​搜索​。​回执​分级​: row_ids(​部分​)、user_row_ids(turn ​里​每条​可见​ user ​行​,​支持​ steer/redirect ​多​ prompt)、 final_assistant_row_id,​以及​ complete ​标志​——​要求​前缀​逐行​匹配​、​无​压缩​、​无​重定向​边界​。 committed_row_id()(persisted_turn_receipt.py:15)​要求​消息​同时​带​ _DB_PERSISTED_MARKER ​和​正​ ​整数​ _row_id——​回执​只​认真​正落盘​的​行​;TUI/​桌面​据此​把​乐观​气泡​绑定​到​存储​行​,​重启​后​也​不错​位​。

docs.title: 7. ​子目录​提示​:​缓存​安全​注入​的​教科书​范例
docs.text:
​最后​深讲​本篇​样板戏​。​启动​时​ prompt_builder.py ​只​加载​ CWD ​的​ AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md;agent ​通过​ ​工具​调用​走进​子目录​时​,SubdirectoryHintTracker ​在​首次​触及​每个​目录​时​把​该​目录​的​提示​文件​追加​ ​到​工具​结果​上​——​上下文​到达​了​,​系统​提示​词一字​未动​:

# agent/subdirectory_hints.py:187-196
def check_tool_call(self, tool_name: str, tool_args: dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return formatted hint text for newly visited directories, or None."""
    from agent.safe_worker_policy import safe_worker_enabled

    if not self.enabled or safe_worker_enabled():
        return None
    if self._home_is_working_dir:
        return None
    all_hints = [h for d in self._extract_directories(tool_name, tool_args) if (h := self._load_hints_for_directory(d))]
    return "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(all_hints) if all_hints else None

​短​函数​下叠​了​四层​防御​,​每层​都​有​真实​事故​背书​:​路径​仲裁​(_resolved_hint_target,subdirectory_hints.py:40) ——read_text ​会​跟随​符号​链接​,​仓库​里​一个​ sub/AGENTS.md -> ~/.aws/credentials ​就​能​把​树外​ ​文件​注入​工具​结果​,​所以​ resolve ​后​的​目标​必须​留在​工作​目录​内​、​通过​规范​读​黑名单​,​黑名单​查询​失败​ fail-closed ​拒载​;​家​目录​不是​项目​(subdirectory_hints.py:123)——​无​默认​项目​的​桌面​应用​把​ cwd ​解析​到​ $HOME,​包含​检查​对​整个​ home ​子树​空洞地​为​真​,​所以​ home/​容器​ home ​直接​禁用​提示​ ​发现​,​会话​领养​真实​项目​后​ rebind_working_dir() ​再开​;​内容​去​重​(subdirectory_hints.py:299-303) ——​同一​文件​经​符号​链接​/​硬​链接​/​拷贝​到达​也​只发​一次​,​以​ sha256 ​摘要​去​重​;​上限​+​警告​ (_MAX_HINT_CHARS = 32_000)——​超限​保留​头尾​、​带​路径​标记​让​ agent ​可​ read_file ​续读​,​并​打​ WARNING(​旧​的​ 8k ​静默​截尾​把​ apps/desktop/AGENTS.md ​切掉​了​几个​月​无人​察觉​)。

​目录​提取​同样​讲究​:_nav_targets() ​用​ shlex ​分词​只认​ shell ​段​开头​的​ cd/pushd ​操作数​ (echo cd backend ​是​散文​不是​导航​);_is_excluded ​与​搜索​探针​共享​ SEARCH_PRUNE_DIR_NAMES ​排除​依赖​/​构建​树​;enabled=False ​镜像​ skip_context_files——​启动​时​拒绝​ AGENTS.md ​注入​的​会​话​, ​后面​也​不许​从​工具​结果​偷渡​回来​(cron ​转述​精确​ stdout ​曾​把​它​漏进​聊天​,#9441)。

docs.title: 8. ​表面​切换​、​编码​姿态​与​ served model
docs.text: surface_switch.py ​处理​ desktop↔TUI ​换皮​:​重建​系统​提示​词会​让​ 220K ​会话​的​缓存​命中​掉​到​ 1%。 ​方案​是​保留​已存​字节​,​把​当前​表面​的​指导​装进​一次性​ turn note(​骑​ user ​消息​ sidecar api_content, ​字节​稳定​、​后续​ turn ​原样​重​放​),​提示​词​本体​等到​下次​重建​边界​(​压缩​)​再​收敛​;note_inert_pinned_tools() ​还要​点名​本​表面​没​构建​的​"​惰性​钉住​工具​"——​移除​它们​才​会​真的​ re-prefill,​所以​只能​告诉​模型​"​调​了​会​ ​失败​"。coding_context.py ​在​会​话​初​把​"​编码​姿态​"​冻结​为​不可​变​ RuntimeMode:workspace ​快照​每会话​ ​探针​一次​,​之后​ system_prompt_parts(workspace_block=...) ​重放同​一份​字节​——​同​为​缓存​安全​。 served_model.py ​补​最后​一块​:LiteLLM ​式​代理​把​真实​路由​的​部署​放进​响应​头​(x-litellm-model-id), OpenAI SDK ​解析​对象​会​丢头​,​所以​捕获​挂​ httpx ​响应​钩子​,​值落​ agent.last_served_model——None ​表示​ ​本次​响应​没​带头​,​值​永不​比​产生​它​的​请求​活得久​。history_commentary.py ​同属​"​显示​与​存储​分离​"​族​: ​存储​的​ reasoning ​原样​保留​供​模型​重​放​,​公开​转录​文本​只准​用​投影​字​段​。
