docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ first_contact_turn_note / mark_seen agent/onboarding.py:146/210 ​首条​消息​一次性​ note;​旗标​原子​写​ Facts / new_record / apply / valid_answer agent/onboarding_flow.py:27/191/412/271 ​类​ A ​事实​;​建​记录​;9 ​种​事件​归约​;​卡​答案​防​越权​ start / advance / delete_chat / observe_tool_result agent/onboarding_record.py:87/99/125/161 run ​记录​写​/​事务​推进​/​删除​聊天​/​工具​结果​结算​节拍​ onboarding_chat_toolsets / onboarding_prelude / reminder agent/onboarding_session.py:39/58, onboarding_text.py ​缓存​安全​的​工具集​折入​;​脚本​开场​;​提醒​渲染​ ActivityProvenance / AwakeIdleMeter / _touch_activity agent/session_activity.py:24/121, activity_tracking.py:41 ​来源​枚举​;​睡眠​修正​;​活动​单写​路径​ _is_ephemeral_scaffolding / durable_user_row_content / persisted_turn_receipt agent/session_persistence.py:52/94, persisted_turn_receipt.py:20 ​脚手架​过滤​;​持久​行​分野​;​行​地址​回执​ SubdirectoryHintTracker / check_tool_call agent/subdirectory_hints.py:136/187 ​首访​目录​提示​,​骑​工具​结果​注入​ stage_surface_switch_note / install_served_model_capture agent/surface_switch.py:103, served_model.py:35 ​表面​切换​ note;​代理​真实​路由​模型​捕获​ is_attended / session_source_for agent/session_source.py:61/39 ​有人​在​看​判定​;​来源​标签​解析​ client_env_scope / toolchain_environ agent/session_client_env.py:112/147 ​会话​冻结​环境​绑定​;​工具​子​进程​环境​ RuntimeMode(coding_context) agent/coding_context.py ​冻结​的​编码​姿态​(auto/focus/on/off)

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​主题​ ​一句​话​ agent/onboarding.py ​引导​ ​一次性​提示​ + ​首条​消息​ note + first-run ​入口​ agent/onboarding_facts.py ​引导​ ​类​ A ​机器​事实​,​无需​同意​ agent/onboarding_first_tasks.py ​引导​ build ​节拍​首​任务​目录​与​资格​门​ agent/onboarding_flow.py ​引导​ ​节拍​状态机​(​纯​数据​,9 ​种​事件​归约​) agent/onboarding_record.py ​引导​ run ​记录​存取​(model_config ​键​ + ​事务​推进​) agent/onboarding_session.py ​引导​ ​工具集​折入​、​脚本​开场​、per-turn note agent/onboarding_text.py ​引导​ ​多​语言​文案​、​开场​提示​词​、​提醒​渲染​ agent/session_source.py ​会话​ ​来源​词表​ + attended ​判定​ + Daybreak ​表面​ agent/session_client_env.py ​会话​ ​客户端​环境​冻结​进会话​(ContextVar) agent/session_activity.py ​会话​ ​活动​观察​契约​ + ​睡眠​修正​计时器​ agent/activity_tracking.py ​会话​ ActivityTrackingMixin:​活动​单写​路径​ agent/session_persistence.py ​持久​化​ SessionPersistenceMixin:SQLite ​转录​落盘​ agent/persisted_turn_receipt.py ​持久​化​ turn ​完成​回执​(row ​地址​绑定​) agent/history_commentary.py ​持久​化​ Codex commentary ​显示​投影​(​源​数据​不​动​) agent/coding_context.py ​姿态​ "​我们​在​写​代码​吗​"​唯一​裁决​点​ agent/subdirectory_hints.py ​注入​ ​首访​子目录​提示​(​缓存​安全​范例​) agent/surface_switch.py ​姿态​ ​表面​切换​不​重建​提示​词​ agent/served_model.py ​模型​ ​路由​代理​真实​服务​模型​捕获

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/:first-run ​引导​由​ tools/setup_beat_tool.py ​驱动​;set_theme_tool、gui_tour、 manage_connections ​的​结果​经​ observe_tool_result ​结算​节拍​;kanban ​心跳​桥​在​ _touch_activity ​里​。
  • hermes_state/:sessions.model_config ​是​ run ​记录​的​家​,hermes_state_compression ​保证​压缩​轮转​ ​携带​它​;touch_session_activity/clear_session_activity_labels ​是​活动​投影​落点​。
  • gateway/:​来源​标签​由​ gateway/session_context.get_session_env ​供给​;run ​结束​公告​发给​每个​窗口​; gateway/session_finite ​参与​ attended ​判定​;​表面​切换​ note ​由​网关​换皮​触发​。
  • hermes_cli/:onboarding_run.set_run ​是​安装​级​ flag ​的​唯一​写者​;atomic_config_write ​支撑​ mark_seen。
  • agent/​其余​:_DB_PERSISTED_MARKER ​定义​在​ context_compressor.py;_touch_activity ​由​ turn ​循环​ ​与​ MoA ​扇​出桥​(moa_loop._reference_liveness_hook)​喂食​;subdirectory_hints ​复用​ prompt_builder ​的​读取​/​扫描​/​截断​三件套​与​ search_policy ​的​排除​目录​。
  • hermes_platform:onboarding_facts.read_facts ​全部​取自​ hermes_platform.host.summary; apps/desktop ​的​多​语言​问候​与​桌面​ first-run ​文案​必须​逐字​一致​(​注释​互相​钉住​)。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​一组​文件​是​"​会话​"​这个​名词​的​全部​周边​:​出生​(​来源​、​客户端​环境​)、​活着​(​活动​时钟​与​回执​)、​落盘​ (​去​重​标记​ + ​脚手架​过滤​的​转录​)、​变脸​(​表面​切换​、​编码​姿态​、​代理​后​真实​模型​)​和​新生​(​两条​引导​ ​路径​)。​三个​手法​值得​带走​:​一次性​状态​用​ install ​级​旗标​ + ​原子​写​,​永不​重复​打扰​;​会话级​可变​ ​物​冻结​进会​话行​(model_config、client_env),​一​进程​多​ profile ​不​串台​;​而​最​核心​的​——​任何​"​中途​ ​想​给​模型​加点​上下文​"​的​冲动​都​必须​过​缓存​这道​闸​,subdirectory_hints ​的​四层​防御​、surface_switch ​的​ turn note ​通道​、onboarding ​工具集​的​"​记录​存在​"​判据​,​都​是​同​一句​话​的​不同​拼法​:​新​信息​骑​在​ user/tool ​消息​上​,​已​缓存​的​前缀​不​动​。

docs.title: platform_misc.md — agent/ ​其余​一切​:​凭据​保险库​、​密钥​来源​链​、i18n、LSP、​桌宠​、​监控​、​验证​与​杂项
文件​概览
docs.text:
​这是​ agent/ ​的​兜底​篇​:​前面​各篇​讲完​ turn ​循环​、​压缩​、​模型​、​凭据​池​、​记忆​、​媒体​之后​剩下​的​ ​所有​文件​,​按​主题​分成​八组​收拢​。​每组​ 2-5 ​句​ + ​表格​;vault ​族​与​ LSP ​集成​做​深度​走读​。​各组​共享​的​ ​底色​还是​那​两条​:​密钥​/​机密​数据​绝不​流入​模型​可​见面​(vault ​是​ model-blind ​的​、​密钥​来源​只进​ ​环境​、​脱敏​ fail-closed),​注册表​模式​处处​复用​(vault ​后​端​、secret ​来源​、locale ​包全​走​ PluginContext.register_*)。

agent/ ​的​"​平台​层​"​全景​:
  ​凭据​三链​                         ​集成​与​体验​                    ​守护​与​杂项​
  ┌──────────────────┐            ┌────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────┐
  │ secret_sources/ 7 │ ​启动​时​     │ lsp/ 14 ​文件​        │        │ monitoring/ 9 ​文件​│
  │ proxy_sources/ 2  │ ​环境​注入​   │  ​写后​诊断​           │        │  fire-and-forget │
  │ secret_scope      ├───────────>│ pet/ 11 ​文件​        │        │  OTLP ​出口​       │
  │ vault ​族​ 12 ​文件​   │ ​沙箱​出口​   │  ​桌宠​(CLI/TUI/​桌面​) │       │ verify ​族​ 7 ​文件​  │
  │  model-blind      │ ​代理​注入​   │ i18n 3 ​文件​         │        │ misc 19 ​文件​      │
  │                   │            │ acp ​族​ 3 ​文件​       │        │                  │
  └──────────────────┘            └────────────────────┘        └──────────────────┘
​组​ ​文件​数​ ​一句​话​ vault ​族​ 12 model-blind ​浏览器​填密​保险库​ + ​登录​后​端​注册表​ secret_sources/ + proxy_sources/ + secret_scope 10 ​启动​时​把​外部​密钥​管理器​解析​成​环境变量​;​沙箱​出口​代理​ i18n ​族​ 3 ​分层​ locale ​目录​(​插件包​ > ​用户​覆盖​ > ​内置​) lsp/ 14 ​真​语言​服务器​的​写​后​诊断​(​门控​于​ git workspace) pet/ 11 Petdex ​桌宠​引擎​(CLI/TUI/​桌面​共享​核心​,​纯​显示​层​) monitoring/ 9 ​网关​健康​与​脱敏​诊断​的​ fire-and-forget OTLP ​出口​ verify ​族​ 7 ​被动​验证​证据​台账​ + turn ​结束​验证​闸​ ​杂项​ 19 ​脱敏​、​轨迹​、​标题​生成​、webhook、ACP、​看门狗​补丁​等

docs.title: 1. vault ​族​(​深讲​):model-blind ​的​凭据​保险库
docs.text:
​浏览器​自动​填密​需要​"​知道​密码​"——​但​模型​永远​不该​看到​密码​。vault_store.py ​的​设计​把​这件​事​ ​做成​结构性​保证​:​元​数据​(​类型​/​标签​/​来源​)​与​加密​载荷​同​住​,model ​只见​不​透明​句柄​;​明文​只​在​浏览器​ ​填充​路径​上​服务端​解析​,​不进​工具​结果​、​日志​或会​话​库​:

# agent/vault_store.py:1-18(docstring ​节选​)
"""Local encrypted vault for browser autofill secrets.

Profile-scoped, model-blind credential store. Metadata (kind, label, origin,
timestamps) lives alongside an encrypted secret payload; the payload is
encrypted at rest with a locally generated Fernet key. The model only ever
sees opaque handles + metadata — secret values are resolved server-side by
the browser fill path and never enter tool results, logs, or the session DB.
...
- Three item kinds: ``login`` (password-only secret), ``payment`` (card fields) and
  ``address``; ``PAYMENT_FIELDS`` / ``ADDRESS_FIELDS`` are the canonical payload names."""

​存储​是​ profile ​作用域​的​:<HERMES_HOME>/vault/ ​下​ 0600 ​的​密钥​文件​ + ​密文​文件​,​跨​进程​用​ fcntl/ msvcrt ​文件​锁​;vault.key_storage: keychain(opt-in)​把​密钥​搬进​ OS ​凭据​库​(vault_keychain.py, ​经​ keyring ​包​),home ​只​剩非​密钥​指针​ vault.keyref——​备份​与​同步​目录​从此​只有​密文​。VaultStore ​的​方法​面​覆盖​ add/list/remove、TOTP(normalize_otp_secret ​接受​ otpauth:// URI ​并​保留​非​默认​的​ ​位数​/​周期​/​算法​)、​以及​密钥​迁移​(migrate_key,file↔keychain ​双向​)。​每种​载荷​字段​都​钉死​到​ WHATWG autocomplete token(PAYMENT_FIELDS/ADDRESS_FIELDS),​填表​端​不用​猜​用户​的​字​段​命名​。

​登录​后端​是​注册表​模式​的​又​一次​复用​,​但​契约​相反​:​后端​只​列元​数据​、​按​句柄​解析​一个​密码​。 ​外部​管理器​(1Password/Bitwarden)​需要​会话​解锁​,​锁定​时​ resolve_password ​抛​ UnlockRequired ​让​ surface ​去​提示​;​句柄​用​ prefix ​命名​空间​化​,backend_for_handle ​不​需要​查表​:

# agent/vault_backends/base.py:47-56
    @abstractmethod
    def list_items(self) -> list[VaultItemMeta]:
        """Metadata only. Locked external backends return [] (the agent sees a lock hint instead)."""

    @abstractmethod
    def get_meta(self, handle: str) -> Optional[VaultItemMeta]: ...

    @abstractmethod
    def resolve_password(self, handle: str) -> str:
        """Server-side only; raises ``UnlockRequired`` when locked."""

    def resolve_otp(self, handle: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Current one-time code for a login that stores a TOTP seed, else None (the user is asked).
        Server-side only, like resolve_password."""
        return None

​四个​内建后​端​:local(Fernet vault,​恒​可用​)、onepassword/bitwarden(CLI ​子​进程​,​会话​令牌​ OP_SESSION_*/BW_SESSION ​只存​进程​内存​的​闭​包里​、​空闲​ TTL ​到期​即弃​,​永不​写​ env/​磁盘​—— vault_backends/unlock.py)、browser(​真实​浏览器​ profile ​的​已存​密码​,​只读​:list ​只读​快照​ Login Data ​的​明文​列​,resolution ​让​浏览器​自己​在​原​ origin ​上​解密​、Hermes ​经​ CDP ​读回​——​没有​ ​解密​代码​,​复用​ browser.use_real_profile ​的​既有​同意​)。​解锁​提示​由​ surface ​拥有​ (set_unlock_prompt_callback);​无头​上下文​(cron/webhook/​单​查询​)​不​装​回调​、​保险库​保持​锁定​—— ​和​审批​无人​应答​时​的​姿态​一致​。

​插件​后端​走​ vault_backend_registry.py ​注册​(ctx.register_login_backend),​拒绝​规则​是​全​仓库​最​ ​严​的​静态​审查​之一​——​因为​注册​时要​读​ provider.name,​属性​钩子​会​在​守卫​外跑​插件​代码​:

# agent/vault_backend_registry.py:45-60(​节选​)
def static_name(provider) -> str:
    """The backend's name, judged without running plugin code (``ValueError`` with a fixed message when refused).

    Registration reads ``provider.name``; a property, a ``__getattribute__`` hook or a ``__class__`` override
    would run the plugin's code there, outside any guard, and its exception text would reach the loader log."""
    cls = type(provider)
    if not issubclass(cls, LoginBackend):
        raise ValueError("login backend must subclass LoginBackend")
    if cls.__getattribute__ is not object.__getattribute__ or any("__class__" in vars(k) for k in cls.__mro__[:-1]):
        raise ValueError("login backend must not override attribute access")
    name, prefix = inspect.getattr_static(provider, "name", None), inspect.getattr_static(provider, "prefix", None)
    if type(name) is not str or type(prefix) is not str:
        raise ValueError("login backend name and prefix must be plain string attributes")
    error = _namespace_error(name) or ("" if prefix == f"{name}:" else "login backend prefix must be '<name>:'")
    if error:
        raise ValueError(error)
    return name

​插件​后​端​最终​只能​以​ vault_backends/plugin.py ​的​ PluginLoginBackend ​包装​形态​到达​ vault ​工具​: ​命名​空间​取​注册​键​(​永不​读​插件​可变​属性​)、​只发​句柄​不​给​页面​/CDP/​主​密码​、needs_unlock ​恒​ False、 ​异常​替换​为​固定​文本​在​ except ​之外​抛出​(​插件​错误​文本​里​的​机密​到​不了​任何​工具​结果​/​日志​/​异常​链​)、 ​返回值​在​守卫​内​校验​并​拷贝​成​ core ​对象​(​读​插件​对象​的​属性​字段​也​可能​跑​插件​代码​)。​填密​的​目标​控件​由​ vault_login_classifier.py ​选​——OpenInstinct ​内核​分类器​的​ Python ​移植​(~170 ​行​):autocomplete token ​精确​匹配​ 100 ​分​、type=password 90、new-password/one-time-code ​与​"​确认​新密码​"​文案​硬​ ​排除​。

docs.title: 2. ​密钥​来源​链​:secret_sources/ + proxy_sources/ + secret_scope
docs.text:
secret_sources/ ​解决​"API key ​不想​躺​在​ .env ​里​":​启动​时​(.env ​加载​后​、​其余​ Hermes ​读​ os.environ ​前​)​把​外部​密钥​管理器​解析​成​环境变量​形状​的​值​。​契约​刻意​窄​——​只读​、​启动​期​、​同步​、 ​每​ fetch ​一次​(​注册表​强制​墙钟​超时​)、​永不​抛​、​永不​交互​提示​(​错误​进​ FetchResult.error ​带​ ErrorKind);SECRET_SOURCE_API_VERSION ​门控​插件​兼容​。​三个​内建后​端​:bitwarden(Bitwarden Secrets Manager bws,PM ​工具​库​自动​装​固定​版本​、SHA-256 ​校验​;​唯一​ bootstrap ​密钥​是​ .env ​里​的​ access token)、onepassword(op://vault/item/field ​引用​逐个​ op read,Hermes ​永不​代替​ ​用户​认证​)、command(​用户​自己​的​ helper ​走​ /bin/sh -c,key ​只经​ HERMES_SECRET_KEY ​传递​、 3s ​硬​超时​ + 1MiB ​输出​帽​、​失败​只记​结构化​字​段​)。registry.apply_all ​统一​排序​("mapped ​胜​ bulk"、 ​先​声明​先得​)、override_existing ​语义​(​可胜​ .env/shell,​永不​胜​另​一​来源​、​永不​胜受​保护​变量​)​与​ ​来源​溯源​。​两半​缓存​(​进程​内​ + ​磁盘​)​共享​在​ _cache.py,​磁盘​半​原子​写​ 0600、​纯​ best-effort—— ​缓存​问题​不许​阻塞​启动​。

proxy_sources/iron_proxy.py ​是​出口​侧​的​镜像​:​沙箱​(Docker/Modal/SSH)​里​只有​不​透明​代理​令牌​, iron-proxy——TLS ​拦截​式​默认​拒绝​出口​防火墙​——​在​出去​的​路上​把​令牌​换成​真​凭据​,​泄露​的​令牌​在​可信​ ​代理​边界​之外​无用​;CA、proxy.yaml、mappings、pidfile ​都​在​ <hermes_home>/proxy/,​失败​只​警告​、 ​绝不​阻塞​启动​。secret_scope.py ​是​多路​网关​的​另一半​:​每个​ profile ​的​ .env ​不能​并进​ os.environ(A ​的​密钥​会​漏进​ B ​的​ turn ​和子​进程​),set_secret_scope ​以​ ContextVar ​装载​活跃​ profile ​的​密钥​(​经​ copy_context() ​传进​ worker ​线程​),​多路​激活​而​作用域​未设​时​ get_secret ​直接​抛​而​非​回落​——​与​ web_search_provider.get_provider_env ​的​防线​互为表里​。

docs.title: 3. i18n ​族​:​三层​目录​、​每层​可​残缺
docs.text: i18n.py ​用​扁平​点号键​解析​五层​目录​(​插件​语言包​ → ​用户​覆盖​ $HERMES_HOME/locales/<lang>.yaml → ​内置​ locales/<lang>.yaml → ​同链​的​ en → ​裸键​);t() ​是​热​路径​,​每​ (home, lang) ​缓存​一份​ ​合并​字典​,​包​注册​时​失效​。​语言​解析​序​:​显式​ lang= > HERMES_LANGUAGE > display.language > en;​任何​有层​供给​的​ id ​都​接受​,​所以​纯包​语言​(pl)​在​插件​加载​瞬间​即可​用​。i18n_layers.py ​拥有​ ​插件包​与​用户​覆盖​两层​,​且​包是​多​表面​的​(<lang>.yaml ​给​ core、<lang>.tui.yaml/ <lang>.desktop.yaml ​对​ Python ​不​透明​、​经​ i18n.catalog ​供​渲染器​);i18n_languages.py ​是​ ​内置​ locale ​的​表​(endonym + RTL ​方向​),​与​桌面​ TS ​侧​的​ LOCALE_ENDONYMS ​必须​一致​(​有​测试​钉住​)。

docs.title: 4. lsp/ ​集成​(​深讲​):​写后​诊断​的​完整​管线
docs.text:
LSP ​让​ pyright/gopls ​等​真​语言​服务器​成为​写后​校验​器​。​门控​是​第一条​原则​——LSP ​只​在​ git workspace ​里​跑​(lsp/workspace.py),Telegram ​网关​里​ home ​目录​的​聊天​永不​孵化​守护​进程​; lsp/__init__.py ​的​ get_service() ​返回​单例​或​ None。​服务​层​(lsp/manager.py)​桥接​同步​的​ file_operations ​层​与​异步​客户端​:​一个​后台​线程​里​的​ asyncio ​循环​,​每​ (server_id, workspace_root) ​一个​惰性​客户端​,pyright ​这​类​ multi_root ​服务器​只有​一个​客户端​、​更​多根​经​ didChangeWorkspaceFolders ​挂上去​:

# agent/lsp/manager.py:1-12(docstring ​节选​)
"""Service-level orchestration for LSP clients.
:class:`LSPService` bridges the synchronous file_operations layer and the async
:class:`agent.lsp.client.LSPClient`: one asyncio loop in a background thread, one lazily
spawned client per ``(server_id, workspace_root)`` — servers flagged ``multi_root`` (pyright) get ONE
client per ``server_id`` and further roots (typically sibling git worktrees) are attached to the running
process via ``workspace/didChangeWorkspaceFolders`` — a **broken-set** of pairs that failed
to spawn/initialize (retried only after ``lsp.broken_retry_seconds``; never, by default), and a **delta baseline**
per file (``snapshot_baseline()`` runs BEFORE a write; the next ``get_diagnostics_sync()``
returns only diagnostics not in it).  Off unless config enables it."""

​客户端​(lsp/client.py)​的​新鲜度​用​文档​版本​而​非​时间​戳​:​每次​ didChange bump version,​每条​ ​存储​的​诊断​带​着​描述​它​的​版本​——​慢​服务器​的​残留​诊断​永远​不能​冒充​当前​内容​的​判定​("ghost diagnostics");ContentModified(-32801)​指数​退避​重试​。​编辑​检查​(lsp/edit_check.py)​是​一次​ ​协同​程上​的​快​检查​:​同步​编辑​后​快照​、​等​判定​;​只有​判定​真有​诊断​,​才​对照​编辑​前​快照​(​或​复用​早前​为​ ​同一​文本​留下​的​判定​)​取​"​本次​编辑​引入​"​的​增量​。​两个​快照​都​是​写入​本身​持有​的​字节​,​不是​事后​重读​ ​文件​——​排队​时​另​一个​会话​可能​又​写​了​文件​,​那​不是​本次​编辑​的​错误​。​同步​诊断​(lsp/sync_diagnostics.py) ​先问​ typescript-language-server ​的​ tsserverRequest(syntacticDiagnosticsSync/ semanticDiagnosticsSync,​暖​项目​ ~10ms),​无​同步​请求​或​失败​再​回落​ push/pull ​等待​。

​最​精巧​的​一件​是​延迟​交付​(lsp/deferred.py):write_file/patch ​在​字节​落盘​并​验证​后​立即​ ​返回​,​语言​服务器​判定​在​ LSP ​循环​上​排队​,​下​一次​工具​结果​(​或​没有​工具​再​跑​时​的​下​一次​ user turn) ​带给​该会​话​的​ agent——​作为​一条​尚未​ flush ​的​新行​,​不​移动​任何​缓存​字节​。​同一​文件​的​更新​编辑​接管​ ​未​交付​判定​(​新​检查​ diff ​旧​基线​,​第一笔​编辑​引入​的​错误​仍然​上报​,​除非​第二笔​修好​了​它​);turn ​的​ ​最后​一次​工具​调用​也​没​丢​判定​——track_pending ​按会话​追踪​在​跑​的​检查​,turn ​最终​答案​被​接受​前​ settle_for_agent ​有​界​等待​并​交出​全部​未​交付​判定​,agent.turn_stop_gates ​把​它们​作为​新​消息​递给​ ​模型​。​配套​件​:range_shift.py ​用​ difflib ​建​ pre→post ​行​移位​图​,​免得​"​同一​错误​挪​了​行号​"​被​当成​ ​全新​错误​;reporter.py ​把​增量​格式化​成​紧凑​的​ <diagnostics> ​块​(​默认​只​ ERROR,​每​文件​ 20 ​条帽​); eventlog.py ​的​稳态​静默​模型​(DEBUG ​满地跑​、INFO ​每会话​一次​、WARNING ​才​是​动作​项​)​让​ agent.log ​仍​可​ grep;install.py ​把​缺失​的​服务器​二进制​装进​ Hermes ​自有​的​ <HERMES_HOME>/lsp/bin/(​用户​的​ ​全局​工具​链不动​,​失败​一律​返回​ None ​让​工具​层​退回​内​建​语法​检查​);servers.py ​是​每​语言​ ServerDef ​注册表​,cli.py ​提供​ hermes lsp status/list/install/restart/which。

docs.title: 5. pet/:​桌宠​是​纯​显示​层
docs.text: Petdex ​桌宠​引擎​的​ docstring ​开宗明义​:​无​模型​工具​、​无​提示​词​/​工具集​改动​,​零​缓存​影响​。CLI (Python)​与​ TUI(Ink,​经​ tui_gateway)​共享​同一​核心​:constants(​几何​ + PetState ​行​分类​, 8 ​列​ × 9 ​行​ Codex ​图集​或​旧​ 8 ​行​图集​)、state(agent ​活动​ → ​状态​行​的​唯一​裁决​点​,​优先​序​与​桌面​ TS ​镜像​互钉​)、store(get_hermes_home()/pets/<slug>/ ​的​安装​/​枚举​,profile ​作用域​)、render(​解​ spritesheet、kitty/iTerm2/sixel/half-block ​编码​,​能力​检测​在​ terminal_image;Pillow ​惰性​导入​, ​缺​了​降级​为​空串​不​抛​)、manifest(petdex.dev ​公开​清单​,​只读​无​凭据​)、generate/(5 ​文件​: atlas/imagegen/orchestrate/prompts,​用​图像​生成​后端造​新宠​)。

docs.title: 6. monitoring/:​微秒​级​ emit、fail-isolated ​出口
docs.text: monitoring/emitter.py ​是​生产者​与​消费者​之间​唯一​的​缝​,​热​路径​不​变量​写得​斩钉截铁​:emit() ​必须​ ​微秒​级​返回​、​必须​不​阻塞​磁盘​/​网络​、​必须​永不​抛进​调用​方​——​队列​满​丢​最​老​的​;daemon ​线程​批量​分发​ ​给​ fail-isolated ​订阅​者​,​什么​都​不​持久​化​(​监控​是​出​站​路径​,​不是​存储​)。events.py ​的​类型化​事件​ ​内容​自由​:​无​提示​词​、​消息​、​工具​参数​、​会话​历史​或​用量​分析​——​那些​属于​ NeMo Relay(​见​ relay_moa.md)。​出站​前​ redaction.py ​一把​无条件​洗​(redact_for_egress fail-closed,​脱敏​器坏​ ​就​不出​原文​),​再​ PII ​化​;otlp_exporter.py ​映射​到​ OTel span(​可​选​ extra,​惰性​导入​,headers_env ​出口​时读​、​永不​记录​);gateway_health(_export).py ​与​ cron_health.py ​是​两个​生产者​;policy.py ​管可​重置​的​伪​匿名​安装​ id。

docs.title: 7. verify ​族​:​被动​台账​ + ​有​界​停机​闸
docs.text: verification_evidence.py ​记录​ agent ​在​代码​工作​区里​实际证明​了​什么​——​刻意​被动​:​不​跑​测试​ ​套件​、​不​阻塞​完成​、​不​把​定点​检查​升格​为​"repo ​全绿​"。verification_stop.py ​是​唯一​动​它​的​闸​: policy-only,​当​模型​刚​编辑​完​代码​、​没有​新鲜​证据​就​试图​收工​时​,​把​台账​转​成​一次​有界​的​后续​追问​ (nudge ​里​点名​改动​路径​,​截断​ 8 ​条​/1200 ​字符​)。verify_hooks.py ​把​内建​编码​指导​骑​在​验证​ nudge ​上​ ​而​非​另立​默认​停机​闸​(​默认​ token ​成本​与​"​缺​验证​证据​"​的​决定​绑定​,pre_verify ​钩子​留给​用户​/​插件​ ​策略​);verify/ 4 ​文件​是​ hermes verify ​的​运行​器​——​从​ grok-cli ​移植​的​静态​ run-recipe ​检测​ (recipes.py,​与​ coding_context.detect_project_facts ​分层​:​字节​稳定​的​提示​期​事实​ vs ​深度​运行​ ​时​配方​)、<project>/.hermes/environment.json ​清单​(​用户​可​编辑​、​有效​即​胜过​新鲜​检测​)、 bootstrap→build→test→​后台​ start→readiness→teardown ​流程​。

docs.title: 8. ​杂项​ 19 ​文件​:​每个​都​小​而​硬
docs.text:
redact.py(1,950 ​行​)​是​全部​日志​/​工具​输出​脱敏​的​正则​底座​(​短​ token ​全​遮​、​长​ token ​留头​ 6 ​尾​ 4; redact_for_egress ​是​出​站​强制​版​,monitoring/MoA ​都​压​在​它​上​);redact_connstr.py ​补​关键词​/​值​ ​连接​串​(ADO.NET/libpq)​的​密码​遮蔽​——URL ​形式​归​ redact.py,.NET ​连接​串​曾​原文​漏过​。 trace_upload.py ​把​会​话​转录​以​ Claude Code JSONL ​形状​传​ HF(​默认​私有​数据​集​ + ​强制​脱敏​,​永不​抛​); trajectory.py ​是​轨迹​保存​ + scratchpad→think ​转换​的​小​叶子​。title_generator.py ​两段式​会话​ ​标题​(​模型​调用​前​的​确定性​即时​标题​ → ​一次​小​模型​升级​,​溯源​ derived < llm < user,​升级​线程​用​ WeakSet ​登记​供​退出​前​ join);notification_presentation.py ​把​"​仅​诊断​"​唤醒​的​呈现​按​ turn ​静音​ (​执行​与​控件​不​受​影响​);reactions.py ​正则​探测​用户​对​ agent ​的​ affection(<3、good bot—— "this is great" ​不算​),​单一​事实​源​喂​ CLI ​宠物​/TUI ​红心​/​桌面​红心​。outbound_webhooks.py ​是​ hooks.outbound ​的​ fire-and-forget POST(​有​界​队列​ + ​单​ daemon ​工人​,HMAC-SHA256 ​签名​,​目标​永远​ ​影响​不了​ agent ​流​);thread_scoped_output.py ​用​每​线程​路由​代理​替换​ sys.stdout/stderr (contextlib.redirect_stdout ​是​进程​全局​的​,​后台​工人​静音​自己​会​静音​网关​事件​循环​——​装​一次​、 ​幂​等​、​永不​卸载​)。

kanban ​侧​两个​补丁​:kanban_stop.py ​是​ worker ​的​ turn ​结束​闸​(​没调​终端​看​板​工具​就​叙述​收工​ → ​有​界​合成​ nudge ​续​跑​,​避免​ dispatcher ​记​ protocol violation);kanban_turn_recovery.py ​把​死​于​ ​可​重试​失败​的​ worker turn ​原地​重试​——​同会​话​同​历史​、​有​界​预算​、​显式​退避​,​预算​耗尽​则​非​零​退出​ ​诚实​记账​。​计划​面​:plan_prompt.py ​的​ /plan ​是​无​引擎​内​建​(build_plan_prompt ​作为​普通​ turn ​喂​ ​给​ agent,​系统​提示​词不动​);plan_snapshot_sync.py ​用​ Nous ​回复​自带​的​ usage-window ​头​比​对​缓存​ ​的​账户​快照​,​不​一致​才​后台​刷新​一次​。ACP ​三件套​:acp_client.py ​是​ external_process ​模型​ provider ​的​通用​ stdio ​客户端​(​每​请求​短命​ ACP ​会话​,​一个​ prompt ​进​、​文本​块​出​、OpenAI ​形状​回​); acp_openai_bridge.py ​补​ ACP ​没有​ tools ​通道​的​缺口​——Hermes ​工具​ schema ​进​ prompt ​的​文本​、 ​调用​从​响应​文本​解析​回来​,​各​客户端​只差​ allowlist;copilot_acp_client.py ​是​弃用​别名​模块​(​列出​ ​的​目录​ ACP provider ​钉​在​旧版​,​整面​保留​ + ​每​进程​警告​一次​)。custom_entry_pool.py ​处理​ providers: ​条目​与​内​建池​同​ slug ​的​凭据​归属​(​条目​作用域​视图​,​内建​的​账号​永不​顶替​条目​声明​的​凭据​)。 empty_response_guard.py ​是​双保险​守卫​(​均​ fail-open):​连续​两次​ usage ​在场​且​ output_tokens==0 ​的​空​响应​ → ​跳过​余下​重试​直达​ fallback ​链​;​单次​空​尝试​的​预估​输入​成本​超​ $0.25 → ​重试​预算​ 3→1。 battery.py ​给​ CLI/TUI ​状态​条读​电池​(psutil + ​几秒​ memoize,​一律​可​降级​)。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/:browser_vault/browser_exec ​是​ vault ​填密​的​消费者​(​浏览器​路径​上​服务端​解析​密码​); write_file/patch ​经​ FileOperations._check_lint_delta ​消费​ LSP ​诊断​;hermes tools ​面板​画​ ​全部​ provider ​的​ is_available ​与​ vault ​后​端​;tools.code_execution_env ​的​秘密​名​策略​被​ session_client_env._travels ​复用​。
  • plugins/:vault ​后​端​、secret ​来源​、locale ​包​、​媒体​ provider ​都​经​ PluginContext.register_* ​注册​;plugins.isolation: host ​是​插件​隔离​的​最终​边界​(vault ​的​进程​内存​防线​挡​意外​不挡​同​进程​ ​代码​)。
  • hermes_state/:​验证​证据​台账​落​ SQLite;​会话行​与​活动​投影​被​ notification_presentation、 plan_snapshot_sync ​等​杂项​读写​。
  • gateway/:monitoring ​的​全部​生产者​都​来自​网关​运行​状态​;bot ​链​(​见​ relay_moa.md)​与​ gateway.bot_loop_guard ​共享​设置​;kanban_turn_recovery ​服务​ cron/kanban ​调度​器​的​ worker ​生命周期​。
  • hermes_cli/:hermes vault(add/list/key migrate)、hermes lsp、hermes verify ​都​是​本组​ ​文件​的​ CLI ​面​;apply_all ​由​ hermes_cli.env_loader ​在​启动​时​调用​;copilot_acp_client ​的​弃用​ ​面由​插件​ compat ​契约​钉住​。
  • agent/​其余​:secret_scope ​支撑​ web_search_provider.get_provider_env ​与​ MoA ​隐私​过滤​; redact ​是​ monitoring/redaction、MoA、trace_upload ​的​公共​底座​;verification_stop ​的​ nudge ​由​ turn_stop_gates ​递给​模型​;empty_response_guard ​挂​在​ turn ​重试​路径​上​。
  • apps/desktop:vault ​的​ Add ​对话框​写​ PAYMENT_FIELDS/ADDRESS_FIELDS ​规范​字段名​;pet ​的​ TS ​镜像​(state ​优先​序​)​与​ i18n ​的​ endonym ​表互​有​测试​钉住​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​兜底​篇​最大​的​收获​是​看清​"​模式​复用​"​的​复利​:​同一个​ ProviderRegistry ​引擎​驱动​了​媒体​ provider、 vault ​登录​后​端​、secret ​来源​、locale ​包​——​注册​、​命名​空间​保留​、​快照​/​回滚​只有​一份​实现​。​而​ vault ​族​与​ LSP ​是​两个​镜像​的​教学​案例​:vault ​把​"​模型​不​可见​"​做成​结构​(​句柄​ + ​元​数据​出去​、​明文​只​在​ ​服务端​解析​路径​上​存在​、​插件​被​剥到​只​剩​句柄​、​异常​固定​文本​),LSP ​把​"​不拖慢​写​路径​"​做成​结构​ (​写​即​返回​、​判定​排队​、​下​一行​交付​、turn ​收尾​有​界​等待​)。​杂项​堆里​反复​出现​同​一条​纪律​:​凡是​有​ ​副作用​的​旁路​(webhook、​轨迹​上传​、​标题​升级​、​快照​同步​)​一律​ fire-and-forget + ​有​界​ + ​永不​抛进​主​ ​循环​;​凡是​防御​(​脱敏​、​作用域​、​守卫​)​一律​ fail-closed。​这​正是​ AGENTS.md ​里​ "no defensive clutter" ​的​反面教材​检查法​——​这里​的​每​一层​防御​背后​都​站​着​一个​真实​事故​或​一个​明确​的​威胁​模型​。

docs.title: Prompt ​缓存​规划​器​（agent/ ​缓存​四件套​）
文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​对​ Anthropic ​式​ prompt caching ​的​支持​由​四个​小​文件​组成​，​每个​都​是​纯​函数​或​ ​进程​内​登记表​，​不​依赖​ AIAgent：

​文件​ ​角色​ prompt_caching.py ​规划​器​：​决定​每​请求​把​ 4 ​个​ cache_control ​断点​放在​哪​ prompt_cache_boundary.py ​声明​式​边界​：​构建​者​注册​ user ​消息​里​的​稳定​脚手架​前缀​ prompt_cache_scope.py ​作用域​：​物理​会话​ id → ​压缩​谱系​根​，​保证​轮换​/​分支​不串​缓存​桶​ cache_bounds.py ​长寿命​进程​内​缓存​的​通用​淘汰​原语​ prompt_refresh.py ​运维​触发​的​ prompt ​刷新​ epoch（​一次性​断​缓存​的​受控​方式​）

​理论​基础​（​为什么​「​每会话​ prompt ​缓存​神圣​」、​什么​操作​会​破坏​缓存​前缀​）​在​ 01_architecture/caching_invariants.md，​本篇​是​它​的​实现​篇​。​四件套​的​设计​动机​ ​一致​：​缓存​的​键​是​字节​级​前缀​，​任何​「​聪明​」​的​运行​时​改写​都​是​缓存​杀手​，​所以​ Hermes ​只​在​请求​装配​的​最后​一刻​做​标记​，​且​全部​标记​是​请求​本地​的​（copy-on-write， ​不落库​）。

docs.title: 1. ​四​断点​布局​：apply_anthropic_cache_control
docs.text:
​默认​布局​是​ 4 ​个​断点​：​静态​系统​前缀​尾​、​系统​提示​尾​、​最后​两条​非​系统​消息​（​没有​静态​ ​前缀​时​退化​为​ 1 ​个​系统​断点​ + ​最后​ 3 ​条​消息​）。​函数​是​幂​等​的​：​先​剥离​旧​装饰​再​重贴​， ​第二次​调用​绝不会​累积​出​第​ 5 ​个​标记​：

# agent/prompt_caching.py:345（​节选​）
def apply_anthropic_cache_control(
    api_messages: list[dict[str, Any]], cache_ttl: str = "5m", native_anthropic: bool = False,
    static_system_prefix: str | None = None, tool_part_markers: bool = True,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Apply Anthropic cache-control markers to API messages.

    With a matching ``static_system_prefix`` the prefix and full system prompt each get a
    marker and the remaining two go to the latest cacheable non-system messages; otherwise
    the legacy system-and-3 layout applies. Idempotent: prior decoration is stripped from a
    per-message copy first, so a second call (or messages a prior call already planned) can never
    accumulate past 4 markers (#90971). Returns a shallow list copy with deep copies of modified
    messages.
    """
    messages = _strip_prior_decoration(list(api_messages))
    marker = _build_marker(cache_ttl)
    breakpoints_used = 0
    if messages[0].get("role") == "system":
        messages[0] = copy.deepcopy(messages[0])
        breakpoints_used = _apply_system_cache_markers(messages[0], marker, static_system_prefix,
                                                       native_anthropic=native_anthropic)
    non_sys = [i for i, m in enumerate(messages) if m.get("role") != "system"
               and _can_carry_marker(m, native_anthropic=native_anthropic, tool_part_markers=tool_part_markers)]
    for idx in non_sys[-(4 - breakpoints_used):]:
        messages[idx] = copy.deepcopy(messages[idx])
        _apply_cache_marker(messages[idx], marker, native_anthropic=native_anthropic, ...)
    _split_unmarked_scaffolds(messages)
    return messages

​细节​三连​：

  • _apply_system_cache_markers（​行​ 178）​把​存储​中​的​系统​提示​保持​为​一个​字符串​， ​只​在​请求​里​拆成​ [​前缀​, ​后缀​] ​两个​ part —— ​落库​形状​永不​变​。
  • _can_carry_marker（​行​ 102）​与​ _apply_cache_marker ​必须​一致​：envelope ​布局​ ​只认​ content part ​内​的​标记​，​空​ content ​的​消息​浪费​断点​；LiteLLM ​式​路由​ （tool_part_markers=False）​上​ part ​级​标记​会​变成​ tool_result.content[0] → ​不可​重试​的​ 400。
  • _split_unmarked_scaffolds（​行​ 88）：​没带​标记​的​脚手架​也​要​拆​。provider ​缓存​ ​键​在​内容​上​，​两个​ text part ​和​一个​字符串​是​不同​内容​ —— ​技能​消息​带​着​断点​时​被​拆过​， ​滚动​标记​窗口​移走​之后​必须​保持​同样​的​ parts，​否则​下​一次​请求​重写​整个​脚手架​（#81867）。

docs.title: 2. ​一次性​请求​跳过​：is_one_shot_request
docs.text:
​标记​不是​免费​的​：Anthropic ​上​缓存​写入​按​ 1.25x（5m）/ 2x（1h）​计费​。​一条​后面​ ​没人会​再​读​的​请求​贴​标记​只​买​一个​永远​读​不到​的​写入​：

# agent/prompt_caching.py:35
def is_one_shot_request(messages: list[dict[str, Any]] | None, tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> bool:
    """True for a request no later call can read back from cache: no tools, no assistant/tool
    turns, at most one user turn (compression summaries, titles, MoA synthesis). A marker there
    only buys a cache write (1.25x input at 5m, 2x at 1h) that nothing ever reads. A caller that
    already decorated the request (a MoA advisor's first iteration, whose prefix later
    iterations replay) decided it will reuse it, so that decision wins over the shape."""
    if tools:
        return False
    msgs = [m for m in messages or [] if isinstance(m, dict)]
    if any("cache_control" in m or _has_part_marker(m.get("content")) for m in msgs):
        return False
    roles = [m.get("role") for m in msgs]
    return roles.count("user") <= 1 and not any(r in ("assistant", "tool") for r in roles)

​判断​「caller ​已贴​标记​即​视为​声明​复用​」​是​这条​规则​的​关键​软化​：​形状​不​决定​命运​， ​意图​优先​。

docs.title: 3. ​声明​式​边界​：prompt_cache_boundary.py
docs.text:
​技能​/webhook/cron ​构建​者​把​一大块​静态​脚手架​和​一小​段​易变​尾巴​拼进​一条​ user ​消息​。 ​只有​构建​者​知道​尾巴​从​哪​开始​ —— ​所以​构建​者​在​构建​时​注册​，​规划​器​请求​时​查表​。​刻意​ ​不​做​请求​时​重新​解析​标记​字符串​：​标记​可能​合法​地​出现​在​技能​正文​里​，​任何​分隔符​ ​启发式​都​会​缩小​缓存​前缀​或​吞掉​易变​字节​：

# agent/prompt_cache_boundary.py:26
def register_stable_prefix(prefix: str) -> None:
    """Record ``prefix`` as the stable scaffold of a just-built message."""
    if not prefix:
        return
    with _lock:
        _prefixes[prefix] = None
        _prefixes.move_to_end(prefix)
        while len(_prefixes) > _MAX_ENTRIES:            # 32 ​条​
            _prefixes.popitem(last=False)
        while len(_prefixes) > 1 and sum(map(len, _prefixes)) > _MAX_CHARS:  # 4MB
            _prefixes.popitem(last=False)

# agent/prompt_cache_boundary.py:39
def find_stable_prefix(content: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Longest registered *proper* prefix of ``content`` with a non-whitespace tail.

    The tail must be non-whitespace so the split never yields an empty text
    block (Anthropic rejects it with HTTP 400). A hit refreshes the entry's LRU
    position so a scaffold fired every minute by cron is not evicted by a
    burst of one-off skill invocations.
    """
    with _lock:
        best: Optional[str] = None
        for prefix in _prefixes:
            if (content.startswith(prefix) and content[len(prefix):].strip()
                    and (best is None or len(prefix) > len(best))):
                best = prefix
        if best is not None:
            _prefixes.move_to_end(best)  # after the scan: never mutate mid-iteration
        return best

​进程​本地​、miss ​即​回退​整条​消息​策略​ —— ​登记表​只是​优化​，​不是​正确性​依赖​。

docs.title: 4. ​作用域​：​压缩​谱系​根​ prompt_cache_scope.py
docs.text:
​老式​压缩​轮换​会​在​会​话​中途​铸造​新​的​物理​ session_id，​请求​于是​掉​进新​的​缓存​桶​。 resolve_prompt_cache_scope() ​把​物理​ id ​映射​到​压缩​谱系​根​，​让​压缩​轮换​保持​ ​缓存​作用域​，​而​ /new、​分支​、​委派​子​代理​各自​隔离​：

# agent/prompt_cache_scope.py:1（​模块​ docstring，​节选​）
"""Rotation-stable logical cache scope for prompt_cache_key derivation.

Legacy compression rotation mints a new physical ``session_id`` mid-conversation, moving it
into a fresh cache bucket. ``resolve_prompt_cache_scope()`` maps the physical id to the ROOT
of its compression lineage — NOT ``get_conversation_root`` (the Portal-attribution walk),
which would collapse /branch children and delegate trees into one id. ``/new`` starts a
fresh scope; fork children (branch, delegate, tool-tagged) are isolated. Hosts minting one id
per RESPONSE declare the conversation via ``gateway_session_key``, which wins over the lineage
walk and is hashed to ``gwk_<sha256[:24]>`` (it embeds platform/chat/user identifiers).
"""

​网关​会话键​（host ​每​响应​铸​一个​ id ​的​场景​）​走​声明​式​作用域​，​哈希​ (source, gateway_session_key, generation) ​三元组​：

# agent/prompt_cache_scope.py:160
# Same identity tuple the peer queries use: same key under different sources must not collapse.
carrier = f"{source}|{key}|{generation}"
digest = hashlib.sha256(carrier.encode("utf-8", errors="replace")).hexdigest()[:24]
return f"{_DECLARED_SCOPE_PREFIX}{digest}"

generation ​是​持久​化​的​会话代​计数​：​声明​键​刻意​在​ /new ​之后​存活​，​若​只​哈希​键​本身​ ​就会​跨会话​复用​同一​作用域​；​压缩​不​推进​它​。

docs.title: 5. TTL ​选择​：auto ​按会话​节奏​分档
docs.text:
cache_ttl: auto ​根据​谁​在​推进​会话​选择​ 5m/1h。1h ​层​写入​ 2x（5m ​是​ 1.25x）， ​只有​轮次​间隔​超过​五分钟​才​划算​ —— ​也​就是​人​走开​又​回来​的​场景​：

# agent/prompt_caching.py:154
AUTO_CACHE_TTL = "auto"
MACHINE_PACED_SOURCES = frozenset({"subagent", "cron", "oneshot", "webhook", "kanban", "api", "tool", "batch"})

def auto_cache_ttl_for_source(source: str | None) -> str:
    """The tier ``auto`` resolves to for a session source: ``5m`` for machine-paced sources,
    ``1h`` for everything a human types into (cli, tui, desktop, messaging platforms)."""
    return "5m" if (source or "").strip().lower() in MACHINE_PACED_SOURCES else "1h"

​路由​能力​钳制​在​ effective_cache_ttl（​行​ 164）：Qwen/Alibaba ​系只​支持​ 5m；1h ​白名单​ MEASURED_1H_PROVIDERS ​只收​实测​保留​过​ 1h ​标记​的​路由​ —— ​未测​路由​是​ UNMEASURED ​而​非​ known-bad，​宁可​降档​也​不发​ 400。​注意​模块​注释​的​警告​：​收窄​ ALIBABA_FAMILY_PROVIDERS ​会​直接​禁用​这些​路由​的​缓存​，​不要​用​它​来​扩​ TTL。

docs.title: 6. ​长寿命​缓存​边界​：cache_bounds.py
docs.text:
​网关​进程​活得​很​久​，​进程​内​缓存​必须​会​收缩​。​这个​文件​是​三个​通用​原语​ + ​一个​闭环​表​：

# agent/cache_bounds.py:27
def publish_lru(table: dict, key: Any, value: Any, limit: int, *siblings: dict) -> list:
    """Store ``key`` as most recently used; past ``limit``, drop the least recently used keys from
    ``table`` and every sibling. Returns the evicted keys (for companions that are not dicts)."""
    table.pop(key, None)
    table[key] = value
    evicted = []
    while len(table) > limit:
        stale = next(iter(table))
        evicted.append(stale)
        for scoped in (table, *siblings):
            scoped.pop(stale, None)
    return evicted

「sibling ​联动​淘汰​」​是​核心思想​：​主表​和​它​的​伴生​表​（​如​ stamp ​表​、scope ​表​）​必须​ ​同步​收缩​，​否则​淘汰​只腾​了​主表​的​空间​。

docs.title: 7. ​受控​断​缓存​：prompt_refresh.py
docs.text:
SOUL.md/​技能​/​项目​上下文​的​编辑​在​ /new ​之前​永远​到​不了​持续​会话​（​存储​的​系统​提示​ ​逐字​重放​以保​缓存​温度​）。hermes sessions refresh-prompts ​记录​一个​刷新​ epoch， ​会话​下​一​ turn ​开头​比​对​：

# agent/prompt_refresh.py:1（​模块​ docstring，​节选​）
"""Adopt an operator's prompt refresh request on a continuing session's next turn.

... At the start of the session's next turn this module compares
that epoch with the one stamped when the session's prompt was built (``model_config``) and, when
the prompt is older, rebuilds it once through the normal builder: history, session id and the
tools[] pin are kept, ``on_session_start`` does not fire, and the new bytes plus the epoch are
persisted so every later turn restores them verbatim. One prefix-cache break per request.

No request recorded means the stored prompt is reused exactly as before: the only extra work is
one ``state_meta`` point read. Nothing watches files and nothing changes mid-turn.
"""

​设计​要点​：​每会话​恰好​一次​前缀​断裂​；​不​监听​文件​、turn ​中途​绝不​换​ prompt（​否则​ ​破坏​「turn ​中不改​系统​提示​」​的​缓存​不​变量​）；​无​请求​时​成本​是​一次​点读​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​文件​:​行号​ ​职责​ PromptCachePlan prompt_caching.py:15 ​请求​本地​的​ messages+tools ​及其​标记​（frozen dataclass） apply_anthropic_cache_control() prompt_caching.py:345 ​四​断点​规划​器主​入口​，​幂​等​ build_prompt_cache_plan() prompt_caching.py:313 ​每个​解析​目的地​的​计划​构建​（​含​工具​缓存​布局​） is_one_shot_request() prompt_caching.py:35 ​一次性​请求​识别​，​跳过​没人读​的​标记​ auto_cache_ttl_for_source() prompt_caching.py:158 auto TTL：​机器​节奏​ 5m / ​人类​节奏​ 1h effective_cache_ttl() prompt_caching.py:164 TTL ​钳制​到​目的地​路由​支持​档位​ strip_anthropic_cache_control() prompt_caching.py:206 ​剥​标记​ + ​还原​装饰​形状​（failover ​前重​贴用​） _split_unmarked_scaffolds() prompt_caching.py:88 ​未​标记​脚手架​也​保持​ parts ​形状​（#81867） register_stable_prefix() prompt_cache_boundary.py:26 ​构建​者​注册​稳定​脚手架​前缀​（LRU 32 ​条​/4MB） find_stable_prefix() prompt_cache_boundary.py:39 ​请求​时查​最长​注册​前缀​，​命中​刷新​ LRU ​位次​ resolve_prompt_cache_scope() prompt_cache_scope.py:166 ​物理​会话​ id → ​压缩​谱系​根​/​声明​作用域​ conversation_id() prompt_cache_scope.py:40 ​插件​键控​每会话​状态​的​稳定​ id（​谱系​根​） declared_conversation_scope() prompt_cache_scope.py:109 ​网​关键​ → gwk_<sha256[:24]> drop_expired() / evict_oldest() / publish_lru() cache_bounds.py:11/18/27 ​长寿命​缓存​淘汰​三​原语​ stored_prompt_refresh_epoch() prompt_refresh.py:50 ​有待​应用​的​刷新​ epoch ​则​返回​之

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ prompt_caching.py Anthropic ​缓存​规划​器​：​四​断点​、​一次性​跳过​、TTL ​钳制​（​纯​函数​） prompt_cache_boundary.py ​构建​者​声明​的​稳定​前缀​登记表​（​进程​内​ LRU） prompt_cache_scope.py ​缓存​作用域​解析​：​谱系​根​ / gwk_ ​声明​ / fork ​隔离​ cache_bounds.py ​长寿命​进程​内​缓存​的​过期​/​最老​/LRU ​淘汰​原语​ prompt_refresh.py ​运维​ prompt ​刷新​ epoch（​一次​受控​断​缓存​）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• 01_architecture/caching_invariants.md：​理论​篇​。​本篇​四件套​是​它​列出​的​不​变量​ （​不改​已​发送​前缀​、​标记​请求​本地​、​压缩​即​谱系​轮换​）​的​执行机构​。
  • agent/context_compressor / conversation_compression：​压缩​是​唯一​被​认可​的​ ​历史​变更​，​也​是​最大​的​缓存​破坏者​ —— ​谱系​根​作用域​、commit fence、​压缩​后​ prompt_refresh epoch ​推进​都​是​围绕​它​的​补偿​机制​。
  • skills/ ​构建​器​：register_stable_prefix ​的​主要​调用​方​；​技能​消息​的​ [​脚手架​, ​尾巴​] ​拆分​形状​由此​约定​。
  • gateway：gateway_session_key ​是​声明​式​作用域​的​来源​；​网关​多路复用​多个​ profile ​会话​时​作用域​解析​必须​按会话​绑定​（HX002 ​家族​规则​）。
  • chat_completion_helpers.build_api_kwargs：​规划​器​的​最终​消费​点​ —— ​标记​在​ ​请求​装配​最后​一刻​贴​上​，failover ​时先​ strip_anthropic_cache_control ​再​重贴​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这套​代码​的​原则​高度​统一​：​让​「​保持​字节​稳定​」​成为​默认​，​把​每​一次​改写​变成​显式​、 ​可​审计​、​一次性​的​动作​。​规划​器​只​在​请求​边界​贴​ 4 ​个​断点​且​幂​等​；​构建​者​用​登记表​ ​声明​边界​而​不靠​启发式​解析​；​作用域​走​谱系​根让​压缩​不​换​缓存​桶​；TTL ​按会话​节奏​分档​ ​并​钳制​到​实测​路由​能力​；​运维​刷新​用​ epoch ​保证​恰好​断​一次​。​读完​本篇​后​，​回看​ caching_invariants.md ​的​每条​不​变量​，​都​能​在​这里​找到​对应​的​执行​文件​ —— ​这​正是​ 「​不​变量​ → ​机制​」​一一​映射​的​好​样本​。

docs.title: relay_moa.md — NeMo Relay ​观测​运行​时​与​ Mixture-of-Agents:​作用域​栈​、​多​模型​备援​循环​与​ bot ​链防环
文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​讲​ agent ​侧​两套​"​多​模型​协作​"​机制​,​外加​两个​模型​行为​调节器​。​先​澄清​一个​容易​望文生义​的​点​: relay_*.py ​的​ relay ​指​的​是​ NeMo Relay——NVIDIA ​的​ LLM ​观测​/​追踪​管线​,​不是​ CLI ​与​网关​之间​ ​的​"​消息​中继​面​"。Hermes ​把​ Relay ​嵌成​代理​执行​的​观测​骨架​:​每个​会话​一根​作用域​栈​(Agent scope),​每个​ turn ​一个​ Function scope,​每次​ LLM ​尝试​/​工具​执行​/​压缩​都​作为​ span ​挂到​正确​的​父​ ​节点​上​;​用户​配置​ Relay ​导出​器​即可​看到​全​链路​,Hermes ​自己​不添​任何​出站​路径​。

MoA(Mixture-of-Agents)​则​是​备援​的​智力​面​:/moa ​把​一个​ user turn ​标记​为​ MoA ​开启​,​正常​ agent ​循环​照旧​持有​工具​调用​与​终止​权​,moa_loop.py ​只​在​每次​模型​迭代​前​并行​征询​若干​参考模型​ (advisor),​把​它们​的​建议​合成​"​引导​块​"​附加​给​聚合​器​(aggregator,​即​当前​ acting model)。​引导​块​ ​作为​独立​的​尾部​ user ​消息​追加​——​这是​全篇​最​重要​的​缓存​决策​。bot_chain.py ​防​ bot-to-bot ​死循环​,fast_mode.py ​管有界​快​窗​。

Relay ​作用域​栈​(​每会话​一栈​,turn ​之间​ LIFO):
  push SESSION_SCOPE (ScopeType.Agent)             ensure_session
   ├── push TURN_SCOPE (ScopeType.Function)         begin_turn
   │    ├── LLMRequest span(chat_completions/codex_responses/anthropic_messages)
   │    │      relay_llm._ManagedAttempt — codec ​往返​、​请求​/​响应​捕获​
   │    ├── ToolExecution span                      relay_tools.execute
   │    │      managed_callback_guard:​工具​内部​的​辅助​ LLM ​调用​绕过​托管​
   │    └── hermes.compaction mark                  relay_compaction
   └── ​并发​ turn?​同一​物理​栈​,​兄弟​ scope ​不能​ LIFO ​关闭​
         → pop_relay_scope_if_top ​拒绝​,​孤儿​由会话​关闭​排水​回收​

MoA ​一次​ create():
  ​参考​扇出​(≤8 workers,​并行​) → ​失败​变​模型​专属​占位​(​不炸​循环​)
  aggregate_moa_context:​聚合​器​合成​一次​ → guidance(​中央​脱敏​ + MoA PII ​过滤​)
  _attach_reference_guidance:guidance ​作​独立​尾部​ user ​消息​(​前缀​字节​稳定​)
  ​聚合​器​请求​ → 400 role_alternation? → moa_alternation ​反应式​合并​一次​ + ​记住​目的地​
​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/relay_runtime.py 1,440 RelayRuntime:​作用域​栈​、​会话​/turn ​生命周期​、​插件​配置​、​关停​排水​ agent/relay_llm.py 964 LLM ​尝试​适配器​:_ManagedAttempt + ​三​协议​ codec + ​流式​累加器​ agent/relay_tools.py 106 ​工具​执行​适配器​:execute() ​把​工具​调用​挂​上​ ToolExecution span agent/relay_compaction.py 93 ​压缩​记录​ → hermes.compaction mark(​挂会话​/turn ​作用域​) agent/relay_cwd.py 91 ​逻辑​工作​目录​解析​:session_cwd/turn_cwd ​进​ scope input agent/chat_completion_helpers_relay.py 82 chat_completions ​流式​ wire ​的​ Relay ​侧​累加器​ agent/moa_loop.py 1,564 MoA ​运行​时​:​参考​扇出​、​引导​构建​、MoAChatCompletions ​门面​ agent/moa_alternation.py 64 ​严格​交替​模板​ 400 ​的​反应式​合并​(​目的地​记忆​) agent/moa_trace.py 115 ​全​ turn ​追踪​持久​化​(opt-in moa.save_traces,JSONL) agent/bot_chain.py 178 Bot Mode ​的​ bot-to-bot ​链​:​运行​时​持有​的​跳数​、​去​重​、​回复​规则​ agent/fast_mode.py 120 ​有界​快​窗​(/fast auto / /fast cold)​与​ static tier

docs.title: 1. RelayRuntime:​一个​进程​、​多个​ profile、​每会话​一根​栈
docs.text:
RelayRuntime ​构造​时​做​三件​事​:​加载​ nemo-relay ​库​、​认领​当前​ profile、​加入​进程​级​插件​配置​。 ​会话表​按​ session_id ​存​ RelaySession(​每会话​一根​隔离​的​作用域​栈​ + ​自己​的​ RLock + ​关闭​状态​ + ​段​轮转​旗标​):

# agent/relay_runtime.py:402-424(​节选​)
def __init__(self, relay: Any = None, *, profile_key: str | None = None) -> None:
    self.relay = relay or _load_nemo_relay()
    self.profile_key = profile_key or current_profile_key()
    self.runtime_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    self._sessions_lock, self._execution_consumers_lock = threading.RLock(), threading.RLock()
    self._sessions: dict[str, RelaySession] = {}
    ...
    self._plugin_configuration_state = _PLUGIN_CONFIGURATION.acquire(self, self.relay)
    if self._plugins_active():
        self.retain_managed_execution(RELAY_PLUGINS_EXECUTION_CONSUMER)
    atexit.register(self.shutdown)

​会话​ scope ​的​开栈​是​有界​异步​的​:_open_session_scope ​把​ scope.push ​提交​到​ 8 ​工人​的​ daemon ​池​,future.result(timeout=SCOPE_OP_TIMEOUT=10s)——​一根​卡死​的​管线​最​多​损失​一个​ span,​永远​不会​ ​堵住​ agent。​子​代理​的​ scope ​挂​在​派生​它​的​ turn/session handle ​之下​ (metadata["nemo_relay_scope_role"]="subagent"),​父会​话​不​存在​时​ resolve_parent ​先建​它​。

docs.title: 2. turn ​生命周期​:begin_turn / end_turn ​与​并发​守卫
docs.text:
​同一​会话​的​两个​并发​ Hermes turn ​共享​物理​作用域​栈​——​后​开者​的​兄弟​ scope ​关闭​时​不​满足​ LIFO。 begin_turn ​用​ active-turn ​表​守卫​:​发现​并发​就​关掉​本​ turn ​的​ Relay ​插桩​,​只​损失​观测​、​不​损失​ ​正确性​:

# agent/relay_runtime.py:1046-1089(​节选​)
def begin_turn(self, lease, *, turn_id: str, task_id: str, metadata=None) -> RelayTurnContext:
    if lease.released:
        raise RuntimeError("Hermes Relay conversation lease is released")
    turn = RelayTurnContext(lease=lease, turn_id=turn_id, task_id=task_id)
    key = (lease.profile_key, lease.session_id)
    with self._active_turns_lock:
        if self._active_turns.get(key):
            # One physical scope stack per session; concurrent turns' sibling scopes would not close LIFO.
            turn.relay_enabled = False
            logger.warning("Skipping Relay instrumentation for concurrent Hermes turn %s in session %s", ...)
        else:
            self._active_turns[key] = {id(turn)}
            turn._active_registered = True
    host = lease.live_runtime() if turn.relay_enabled else None
    if host is not None:
        # Rotation happens HERE: no live turn scope on the stack, so the session scope can close/reopen LIFO.
        _warn_on_error("segment rotation", self._maybe_rotate_segment, host, lease.session)
        ...
        turn.handle = _warn_on_error("turn initialization", host.run_in_session, lease.session,
            host.relay.scope.push, TURN_SCOPE, host.relay.ScopeType.Function, handle=lease.session.handle,
            input=_scope_input(lease.turn_cwd), metadata=turn_metadata, timeout=SCOPE_OP_TIMEOUT)
    turn._previous_turn = _CURRENT_TURN.get()
    _CURRENT_TURN.set(turn)
    return turn

​两个​设计​点​:​段​轮转​(​压缩​或​ max_turns ​触发​的​ session scope ​关闭​重开​)​只​发生​在​ turn ​边界​—— ​这是​唯一​ LIFO ​安全​的​时点​,​压缩​打​旗标​、begin_turn ​消费​;_CURRENT_TURN ContextVar ​把​"​当前​ turn"​带给​深层​代码​(relay_compaction._turn_target ​用​它​寻​挂载​点​)。end_turn(relay_runtime.py:1100) ​幂​等​;pop_relay_scope_if_top(relay_runtime.py:118)​拒绝​弹​出​兄弟​之上​的​ scope,​真实​输出​存进​ _deferred_scope_outputs,​由会话​关闭​排水​收尾​。

docs.title: 3. LLM ​尝试​与​工具​执行​:​托管​判定​ + ​回调​ guard
docs.text:
​每次​物理​ provider ​尝试​若落​在​托管​执行​里​,_ManagedAttempt.resolve ​组装​请求​状态​:​请求​体经​ Relay codec ​做​往返​基线​(_codec_round_trip_request_body),​让​拦截器​改写​后​的​请求​与​原​请求​可比​。 ​协议​名​按​ api_mode ​归一化​:

# agent/relay_llm.py:31-35 + 58-71(​节选​)
_RELAY_PROTOCOL_BY_API_MODE = {
    "chat_completions": ("openai.chat_completions", "OpenAIChatCodec"),
    "codex_responses": ("openai.responses", "OpenAIResponsesCodec"),
    "anthropic_messages": ("anthropic.messages", "AnthropicMessagesCodec"),
}

class _ManagedAttempt:
    @classmethod
    def resolve(cls, session_id, request, metadata, *, name: str, model_name: str):
        """Return the managed attempt for ``session_id`` ..., or None to run unmanaged."""
        if session_id is None:
            session_id = _current_session_id()
        if not session_id:
            return None
        runtime, session, parent = relay_runtime.resolve_execution_context(session_id)
        if runtime is None or session is None or not runtime.managed_execution_enabled():
            return None
        return cls(runtime, session, parent, request, metadata, name=name, model_name=model_name)

​回调​跑​在​捕获​上下文​的​副本​里​(self.context = contextvars.copy_context()),​且​套​ managed_callback_guard()——Relay ​管线​驱动​流​时​,​回调​内部​发起​的​嵌套​ relay ​调用​必须​绕过​托管​ (#77244:​管线​的​ Future ​绑定​在​正在​被​阻塞​的​循环​上​)。​工具​侧​ relay_tools.execute(relay_tools.py:16) ​同一​套路​:​先判​托管​,​让​ Relay ​拦截器​有​机会​改写​工具​参数​(invoke ​收​ next_args),​回调​全程​ guard。​流式​侧​的​对称​件​是​ chat_completion_helpers_relay.py ​的​ RelayChatAccumulator:Relay ​的​ finalizer ​在​ provider ​流​结束​时​立刻​跑​,​与​ Hermes ​消费​线程​并发​——​它​只能​用​自己​ collector ​观测​ ​到​的​状态​重建​响应​,​绝不能​碰​消费者​闭包里​的​东西​。

docs.title: 4. ​压缩​标记​与​ cwd:​挂​对父​节点
docs.text: relay_compaction.py ​处理​一个​只有​观测​层​才​有​的​问题​:​压缩​发生​在​ turn ​外​(​网关​卫生​)​时​没有​活​ turn scope,mark ​该​挂​哪​?​寻挂​顺序​是​"​同会​话​的​活​ turn → ​该会​话​的​ session scope → ​压缩​ agent ​启动​ ​时​所在​的​活​ turn",​而​Relay ​只​对​持有​压缩​标记​的​ agent scope ​重置​ LLM ​历史​新鲜度​——​挂​错父​ ​节点​,​下​一条​ LLM span ​就​不会​重新​记录​完整​历史​。mark ​是​纯​观测​:​一次​停滞​发布​就让​本​进程​对​ Relay ​停止​等待​(​有​界​超时​),​导出​器​由​用户​配置​、mark ​不添​出站​路径​。relay_cwd.py ​为​ scope input ​提供​ ​逻辑​ cwd:​任务​可用​与​所属​会话​不同​的​ worktree,​远程​路径​按​声明​保留​、​未知​路径​省略​而​不是​拿​ Hermes ​主机​的​ cwd ​顶替​。

docs.title: 5. MoA ​主​循环​:MoAChatCompletions.create
docs.text:
MoAChatCompletions ​是​ OpenAI-chat ​兼容​门面​:client.chat.completions.create() ​长着​ SDK ​的​ ​脸​,​内部​做​参考​扇出​ + ​引导​注入​ + ​聚合​器​请求​:

# agent/moa_loop.py:1434-1483(​节选​)
def create(self, **api_kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    ...
    preset, moa_raw = _resolve_preset_cached(self.preset_name)
    self._privacy_mode = _moa_privacy_mode(moa_raw)
    messages = list(api_kwargs.get("messages") or [])
    # A disabled preset = "use the aggregator directly".
    reference_models = [slot for slot in (preset.get("reference_models") or []) if slot.get("enabled", True)] ...
    aggregator = preset.get("aggregator") or {}
    # The MoA path's virtual model/provider have no pricing entry; expose the real slot.
    self.last_aggregator_slot = dict(aggregator) if aggregator else None
    ...
    ref_messages = _reference_messages(messages)
    cache_key = self._fanout_cache_key(preset, ref_messages, reference_models)
    cache_hit = bool(cache_key == self._ref_cache_key and self._ref_cache_outputs)
    if cache_hit:
        # HIT: already ran and accounted. Do NOT zero pending totals ...
        reference_outputs = list(self._ref_cache_outputs)
        self._pending_trace = None
    else:
        reference_outputs = self._run_fanout(preset, ref_messages, reference_models, aggregator, aggregator_temperature, cache_key)
    agg_messages = [dict(m) for m in messages]
    guidance = self._build_guidance(reference_outputs, aggregator, ...)
    if guidance:
        _attach_reference_guidance(agg_messages, guidance)
    ...
    return self._call_prepared_aggregator(prepared_request, api_kwargs)

​扇出​有​节奏​(_fanout_cache_key,moa_loop.py:1272):​默认​ user_turn ​只​哈希​到​最后​一条​真实​ user ​消息​为止​的​前缀​——​工具​迭代​ 2+ ​全是​缓存​ HIT,advisor ​每​ user turn ​只​跑​一次​(​合成​在​开头​, acting model ​随后​独力​干活​,​原始​ MoA ​形态​);per_iteration ​每次​工具​迭代​重跑​;every_n:<N> ​折中​, ​迭代​ 1 ​与​每​第​ N ​次​上​节奏​,​中间​复用​上​一次​的​引导​。​参考​调用​走​ _run_references_parallel(≤8 workers),​失败​变​模型​专属​占位​而​非炸​循环​;advisor ​输出​先过​中央​脱敏​器​再​过​ MoA ​自己​的​ email/ ​电话​模式​(​电话​模式​刻意​要求​分隔符​,​免得​误伤​行号​/​日期​/SHA/IP)。usage/​成本​按​ advisor ​自己​的​ ​费率​计价​再​美元​求和​(_RefAccounting),​中断​后​迟到​的​ future ​回调​经​ _fold_pending_accounting ​补账​(​只加​不覆​,​流式​重试​不​重复​计​)。

docs.title: 6. ​引导​块​的​缓存​经济学​:_attach_reference_guidance
docs.text:
​这是​ moa_loop ​全文​最贵​的​一课​。​引导​块​每​ turn ​都​不同​,​追加​它​有​两种​位置​选择​,​而​其中​一种​曾经​把​ ​缓存​打​回​原点​(#112358):

# agent/moa_loop.py:1021-1036
def _attach_reference_guidance(agg_messages: list[dict[str, Any]], guidance: str) -> None:
    """Attach the per-turn reference block as its OWN trailing user message.

    The block varies per turn; appending keeps ``[system][task][tool-history]``
    cache-stable. It is never merged into a trailing user turn: iteration 1 of a
    tool loop ends on ``user(task)``, and a merged ``user(task + guidance)`` byte-differs
    from the ``user(task)`` every later iteration replays, so the provider prefix cache
    collapsed to the system prompt on iteration 2 of every turn (#112358). Converters
    that require strict alternation (Anthropic Messages, Converse, native Gemini) merge
    the two user turns as SEPARATE content blocks, so the task block stays byte-stable
    there too; on the OpenAI-compatible wire the request ends ``user(task), user(guidance)``,
    which a chat template that enforces strict user/assistant alternation rejects."""
    agg_messages.append({"role": "user", "content": guidance})

​读​三遍​:​合并​进​尾部​ user turn,​迭代​ 1 ​的​ user(task + guidance) ​与​迭代​ 2 ​起重​放​的​ user(task) ​字节​不同​——​每次​ turn ​的​第二次​ API ​调用​,​缓存​就​从​系统​提示​词​重新​开始​。"​独立​的​尾部​ user ​消息​" ​则​让​ [system][task][tool-history] ​全程​字节​稳定​。​代价​是​ OpenAI wire ​上​出现​相邻​ user ​对​,​严格​ ​交替​的​聊天​模板​(llama.cpp/vLLM Jinja、Mistral、​部分​ OpenRouter)​会​ 400——​这​正是​ moa_alternation.py ​的​活​:​被​ 400 ​判定​为​ FailoverReason.role_alternation ​后​只​对​这​一个​目的​ ​地​合并​重试​一次​,​并​在​门​面上​记住​ (route, model),​后续​迭代​预​合并​、​永不​付​第二次​ 400;​接受​分离​ ​形状​的​目的地​永不​被触​碰​。peel_reference_guidance ​是​精确​逆​操作​,​让​缓存​断点​绝不​落​在​每​ turn ​变化​ ​的​引导​上​。

docs.title: 7. ​参考​系统​的​"​自白书​"、one-shot ​路径​与​追踪
docs.text:
advisor ​看到​的​是​一份​咨询​视图​(_reference_messages):​工具​结果​被​头尾​预览​到​ 4000 ​字符​(​工具​ ​调用​保留​全文​),​外加​一条​把​它们​钉​在​"​顾问​"​位置​上​的​系统​提示​词​——​没有​它​,advisor ​会​以为​自己​是​ acting agent,​拒绝执行​或​假装​执行​:

# agent/moa_loop.py:183-197(​节选​)
_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are a reference advisor in a Mixture of Agents (MoA) process. You are "
    "NOT the acting agent and you do NOT execute anything: you cannot call "
    "tools, run commands, browse, or access files, repositories, or URLs, and "
    "you should not try to or apologize for being unable to. A separate "
    "aggregator/orchestrator model holds those capabilities and will take the "
    "actual actions.\n\n"
    "CRITICAL: You must NEVER claim or imply that you have executed a command, "
    "downloaded a file, accessed a URL, or performed any action. ..."
    "Advise in prose: never emit a tool call or a JSON "
    "tool-call object, because the aggregator replays what looks like one. "
    "Your response is private guidance handed to the aggregator, not an answer shown to the user. ..."
)

​最后​一句​是​硬​需求​:​聚合​器会​重放​看似​工具​调用​的​文本​,​所以​ advisor ​必须​只出​散文​。 aggregate_moa_context(moa_loop.py:914)​是​ one-shot /moa ​路径​:​扇出​ → ​全​失败​则​跳​过​聚合​器​ (​合成​空转​只会白​等​满​ provider ​超时​)→ ​合成​失败​回落​拼接​的​建议​原文​ → ​统一​包​上​ "[Mixture of Agents context — ​私密​引导​]"​信封​。​追踪​(moa_trace.py)​把​每个​跑​了​扇​出​的​ turn ​追加​一行​ JSONL ​到​ <hermes_home>/moa-traces/<session_id>.jsonl:advisor ​看到​什么​、​说​了​什么​、​花​了​多少​,​加​聚合​器​ ​输入输出​——​侧​通道​是​刻意​的​:​参考​调用​是​咨询​性质​的​副​调用​,​把​它们​的​行写​进​ messages ​表会​腐蚀​ ​角色​交替​、​污染​重​放​。opt-in(moa.save_traces),​关闭​时​唯一​开销​是​一次​配置​读​;full ​隐私​模式​下​ ​追踪​里​的​消息​副本​也​过​脱敏​。surface ​层经​ reference_callback ​收​ moa.reference/moa.progress/ moa.phase/moa.aggregating ​事件​——​显示​回调​失败​只​ debug,​永不​影响​ turn。

docs.title: 8. bot_chain.py:​跳数​属于​运行​时​,​不​属于​模型
docs.text:
Bot Mode ​允许​ bot ​互发​消息​,​死循环​防护​的​全部​状态​由​运行​时​持有​:​跳数​骑​在​投递​的​ author envelope(hops)​里​,​只有​运行​时写​它​,​模型​无法​重置​;​超过​ gateway.bot_loop_guard.max_hops ​拒发​。 ​同链​内​"​同文同​收件人​"​按​ body ​摘要​去​重​;"​回复​不​需要​回复​"​的​消息​置​ notify-only,​且​该​ turn ​不得​再​ ​回​消息​给​对方​:

# agent/bot_chain.py:139-157(​节选​)
def admit_send(agent: Any, recipients: list[str], body: str) -> Admission:
    """Check one ``message_agent`` call to ``recipients`` ... Admitted recipients reserve their
    ask and the call's hop until ``Admission.release``."""
    settings = _settings()
    if not settings.enabled:
        return Admission()
    author = getattr(agent, "_turn_author", None) or {}
    author_id = str(author.get("id") or "") if author.get("is_bot") else ""
    digest = hashlib.sha256(" ".join(str(body).split()).encode()).hexdigest()
    with _LOCK:
        key = _bound_key(agent)
        state = _CHAINS.setdefault(key, _new_state(time.monotonic()))
        bot_turn = state["hops"] > 0
        hop = state["sent"] + 1 if bot_turn else 1
        if hop > settings.max_hops:
            return Admission(refusal=(
                f"This bot-to-bot exchange already reached its limit of {settings.max_hops} messages "
                "(gateway.bot_loop_guard.max_hops), so nothing was sent. Do not retry; finish your turn "
                "and tell your user where it stands."))

​链​状态​按​ session_id ​键存​进程​级​ _CHAINS,​而​非​挂​在​ agent ​上​——​网关​可能​在​ turn ​间​重建​ agent,​丢​了​计数​等于​送​新​预算​;​压缩​轮​转让​ session_id ​变更​时​ carry_chain ​把​条目​跟着​搬​。​人​发言​即​ ​断链​(​旧​条目​删除​);​拒绝​文案​直接​给​模型​行为​指令​("Do not retry")。Admission.release ​处理​ "​确定​没​发出​去​"​的​回收​:​撤销​ ask ​预订​,​整​ call ​无一​送达​时连​ hop ​也​退回​,​重试​既​不算​重复​也​不算​ ​新​跳​。

docs.title: 9. fast_mode.py:​有界​快​窗​与​字节​不变性
docs.text:
/fast auto ​让​每个​ user turn ​开​一个​ agent.fast_auto_seconds(​默认​ 60s)​的​窗口​,/fast cold ​只​在​无​历史​的​会​话​首​ turn ​开​。​窗口​只​影响​每​请求​参数​(service_tier/speed),​请求​体​其余部分​ ​字节​不变​——​这​是​它​对​提示​缓存​无副作用​的​全部​理由​。Anthropic ​为​每个​ speed ​单独​留​一份​提示​缓存​, ​所以​ Anthropic ​的​窗口​边界​注定​重写​一次​前缀​(​文档​里​明说​,​当作​已知​代价​):

# agent/fast_mode.py:59-74(​节选​)
def begin_turn(agent: Any, conversation_history: Any) -> None:
    """Open (or refuse) the fast window at a user-turn boundary."""
    mode = getattr(agent, "service_tier", None)
    agent._fast_until = 0.0
    if mode not in BOUNDED_MODES:
        return
    if mode == "cold" and any(
        isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("role") in ("user", "assistant", "tool")
        for m in (conversation_history or ())
    ):
        return
    ...
    agent._fast_until = time.monotonic() + max(window, 0.0)

effective_request_overrides(fast_mode.py:77)​只​在​窗口​开着​时​把​ provider ​的​ fast override ​叠加​ ​到​请求​ kwargs ​上​,​且​对​已​标记​"​无​ fast ​容量​"​的​模型​摘除​ speed。​最后​一对​函数​处理​"​组织​根本​没有​ fast ​容量​":429 ​且​ fast ​限额​头为​ 0 → fast_mode_unprovisioned ​判定​为​无解​(​等待​/​换​ key ​都​没用​), mark_fast_mode_unavailable ​把​模型​标记​进会​话级​黑名单​,caller ​每​模型​最​多重​试​一次​。 SERVICE_TIER_WORDS ​是​所有​表面​(config、CLI/​网关​/TUI ​的​ /fast)​共用​的​唯一​解析​表​——​新​ tier ​加​ ​一行​即可​。

docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ RelayRuntime / RelaySession agent/relay_runtime.py:399/225 ​作用域​栈​ owner + ​段​轮转​旗标​;atexit ​关停​ ensure_session / begin_turn / end_turn agent/relay_runtime.py:492/1046/1100 ​会话​ scope ​取​或​建​;turn ​推弹​ + ​并发​守卫​ pop_relay_scope_if_top agent/relay_runtime.py:118 ​只弹​栈顶​;​兄弟​之上​的​ scope ​延迟​排水​ resolve_execution_context agent/relay_runtime.py:1273 (runtime, session, parent) ​解析​统一​入口​ _ManagedAttempt.resolve agent/relay_llm.py:58 ​物理​尝试​的​托管​判定​与​状态​组装​ RelayChatAccumulator agent/chat_completion_helpers_relay.py:26 ​并发​安全​:​只用​ collector ​观测​态​重建​响应​ relay_tools.execute agent/relay_tools.py:16 ​工具​调用​的​托管​执行​ + guard emit_compaction_mark ​族​ / resolve_relay_scope_cwds agent/relay_compaction.py, relay_cwd.py:27 mark ​挂载​点​寻址​;(session_cwd, turn_cwd) ​解析​ MoAChatCompletions.create agent/moa_loop.py:1434 ​扇出​缓存​判定​ + ​引导​注入​ + ​聚合​器​调用​ _attach_reference_guidance / _fanout_cache_key agent/moa_loop.py:1021/1272 ​引导​独立​尾部​消息​;user_turn/every_n ​节奏​ _REFERENCE_SYSTEM_PROMPT / _run_references_parallel agent/moa_loop.py:183/619 advisor ​自白书​;≤8 workers ​扇出​ + liveness ​桥​ aggregate_moa_context agent/moa_loop.py:914 one-shot /moa ​的​扇​出​+​合成​ merge_same_role_messages / is_role_alternation_rejection agent/moa_alternation.py:32/53 ​反应式​合并​ + 400 ​分类​ save_moa_turn agent/moa_trace.py ​全​ turn ​追踪​ JSONL ​追加​(​脱敏​副本​) on_turn_start / admit_send / carry_chain agent/bot_chain.py:71/139/61 ​链​跳数​推进​ / ​发送​准入​ / session_id ​迁移​ begin_turn(fast_mode) / effective_request_overrides agent/fast_mode.py:59/77 ​快窗​开闭​ / ​窗口​内​的​ tier ​叠加​ fast_mode_unprovisioned / mark_fast_mode_unavailable agent/fast_mode.py:97/110 429+​限额​头​ 0 ​的​无解​判定​ / ​会话级​黑名单

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​主题​ ​一句​话​ agent/relay_runtime.py Relay ​作用域​栈​/turn ​生命周期​/​插件​配置​/​关停​排水​ agent/relay_llm.py Relay LLM ​尝试​适配器​ + ​三​协议​ codec + ​流式​累加​ agent/relay_tools.py Relay ​工具​执行​的​托管​入口​ + managed_callback_guard agent/relay_compaction.py Relay ​压缩​记录​ → hermes.compaction mark agent/relay_cwd.py Relay scope input ​的​逻辑​ cwd ​解析​ agent/chat_completion_helpers_relay.py Relay chat_completions ​流式​的​ Relay ​侧​累加器​ agent/moa_loop.py MoA ​参考​扇出​、​引导​构建​、OpenAI ​兼容​门面​ agent/moa_alternation.py MoA ​严格​交替​ 400 ​的​反应式​合并​(​目的地​记忆​) agent/moa_trace.py MoA opt-in ​全​ turn ​追踪​ JSONL agent/bot_chain.py ​备援面​ bot-to-bot ​链​的​跳数​/​去​重​/​回复​规则​ agent/fast_mode.py ​调节器​ ​有界​快​窗​与​ static service tier

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• transports / ​模型​层​:relay_llm ​的​托管​执行​挂​在​传输层​之下​——chat_completion_helpers ​逐​ attempt ​调​ _ManagedAttempt.resolve;RelayChatAccumulator ​复用​ chat_completion_helpers_tool_calls._ToolCallAccumulator ​与​ reasoning_summaries。
  • auxiliary:moa_loop ​的​参考​/​聚合​调用​全部​经​ agent.auxiliary_client.call_llm (task="moa_aggregator" ​等​),​记账​进​ aux ​面​(​见​ auxiliary_clients.md);MoA ​扇出​的​活跃度​经​ _reference_liveness_hook ​桥回​ _touch_activity(​否则​看门狗​会​在​ advisor ​流式​期间​误杀​ turn)。
  • gateway/:bot_chain ​与​ gateway.bot_loop_guard ​共享​ load_settings ​与​ max_hops ​上限​; gateway.response_filters.is_machinery_display_kind ​参与​链​判定​;Relay ​的​ gateway.telemetry.session_segments ​配置​读取​刻意​避开​ gateway.run ​的​ import ​副作用​ (#87183/#95577)。
  • cli/:/moa ​斜杠​命令​只​标记​ turn;hermes_cli/moa_config.resolve_moa_preset ​是​预设​解析​; hermes_cli/runtime_provider ​为​ slot ​解析​真实​ base_url/api_key/api_mode(​按​ profile ​缓存​, TTL 5 ​分钟​)。
  • agent/​其余​:_touch_activity ​被​ MoA liveness ​桥​与​ voice_turn_route ​双向​使用​; error_classifier.classify_api_error ​供​ role_alternation ​判定​;redact.redact_sensitive_text ​是​ MoA ​隐私​过滤​的​中央​底座​;surface_switch ​明确​跳过​ MoA turn(api_content sidecar ​不​盖章​)。
  • tools/:tools.daemon_pool.DaemonThreadPoolExecutor ​是​ Relay scope ​操作​的​执行器​;​终端​会话​ cwd(tools.terminal_tool.get_session_cwd)​供​ relay_cwd ​读取​。
  • NeMo Relay ​库​:​由​ PM ​环境​提供​;Relay ​插件​配置​(plugins.toml)​激活​时​托管​执行​对​整个​进程​保留​ (_ProcessRelayPluginConfiguration,​外方​配置​已​存在​则​ FOREIGN ​状态​礼让​)。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​两套​机制​是​"​多​模型​"​的​两种​正交​形态​:Relay ​是​看​——​一次​ LLM ​调用​在​观测​骨架​里​留下​完整​的​ ​父子​ span ​链​,​而​它​对​执行​的​唯一​介入​是​"​被​拦截器​改写​",​所以​整套​集成​最重​的​工程​都​在​边界条件​上​ (​并发​ turn ​不​ LIFO、​回调​重​入​、codec ​往返​基线​、10s ​有​界​ scope ​操作​);MoA ​是​想​——acting model ​的​权力​一寸​不让​,advisor ​只​提供​私有​引导​,​而​引导​块​的​每​一点​形状​(​独立​尾部​消息​、​扇出​节奏​、 peel ​逆​操作​)​都​由​提示​缓存​经济学​决定​。bot_chain ​和​ fast_mode ​则​示范​了​两个​纪律​:​防环​状态​必须​放​ ​在​运行​时​手里​(envelope ​由​ runtime ​写​、session_id ​键控​),​请求​调优​必须​收敛​到​单表​单字​段​ (SERVICE_TIER_WORDS)​以保​请求​体​字节​稳定​。​一句​话​:​观测​可以​失败​(​有​界​、​警告​、​跳过​),​引导​ ​可以​缺失​(​占位​、​降级​),​缓存​前缀​不能​变​。

docs.title: skills_runtime.md — ​技能​运行​时​与​策展​人​：slash ​注册​、​预处理​管线​、​索引​增量​与​ Curator ​生命周期​机
文件​概览
docs.text:
​技能​的​格式​与​安装​（SKILL.md frontmatter、hub ​安装​、/skills ​命令​）​在​ 12_skills ​与​ 04_tools/skills_memory.md ​讲​；​本篇​讲​运行​时​：​一个​技能​从​磁盘​走​到​模型​面前​要​经过​

SKILL.md ​磁盘​扫描​ ──► /skill-name slash ​命令​表​（​多槽​缓存​）
                      │
/skill ​或​ /bundle ──► _build_skill_message（​脚手架​ + ​预处理​ + ​缓存​边界​注册​）
                      │                    └─ skill_preprocessing：${HERMES_*} ​展开​、!`cmd`
                      ▼
              user ​消息​（​模型​可见​）
                      ▲
​会话​中途​安装​/​删除​ ──► skills_index_delta：​索引​差量​骑​ user ​注记​通道​
turn ​结束​        ──► background_review：daemon ​线程​回放​快照​问​"​要​不要​存​技能​/​记忆​"
​不​活动​           ──► curator：​生命周期​迁移​ + ​可​选​ LLM fork ​整合​（tar.gz ​快照​先行​）
​文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ agent/skill_commands.py 1,028 /skill-name ​自动​注册​、​脚手架​构造​/​解析​、​多槽​缓存​ agent/skill_bundles.py 213 ​技能​束​：​一个​ slash ​别名​加载​多个​技能​ agent/skill_preprocessing.py 156 ​模板​变量​展开​ + ​内联​ shell ​片段​ agent/skill_utils.py 902 frontmatter/​平台​门​/​搜索​根与​优先级​（​共享​底座​） agent/skills_index_delta.py 138 ​系统​提示​词​技能​索引​的​中途​差量​投递​ agent/background_review.py 1,392 turn ​后台​记忆​/​技能​评审​ fork agent/curator.py 1,218 ​不​活动​触发​的​技能​生命周期​策展​人​ agent/curator_backup.py 492 ​策展​人​ tar.gz ​快照​与​回滚

docs.title: 1. ​技能​即​ slash ​命令​：​多槽​缓存​键​ (platform, home, project)
docs.text:
​每个​技能​自动​注册​一条​ /skill-name。​扫描​结果​按​完整​解析​身份​缓存​——​旧​的​单槽​ memo ​只持​一个​ (platform, home, project) ​三元组​，Desktop serve ​进程​身份​来回​摆动​时​每次​ poll ​都​ miss、​每​ 5 ​秒​ ​重扫​ 3 ​次​（#104849）：

# agent/skill_commands.py:18-36（​节选​）
_skill_commands_by_key: dict[tuple, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
_last_interactive_skill_commands_by_key: dict[tuple, dict[str, Any]] = {}
_skill_commands_sig_by_key: dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
_publish_lock = threading.Lock()

​三个​键​分别​来自​：HERMES_PLATFORM / ​会话​平台​环境​（skills.platform_disabled ​视图​）、 get_hermes_home()（profile ​各带​ skills.external_dirs，#88023）、find_project_root() （​一个多​会话​主机​服务​多个​ repo，#114359）。scan_skill_commands() ​把​扫描​做成​"​本地​构建​ + ​锁内​一次性​发布​"——​直接​写​全局​会​让​并发​扫描​对​着​自己​的​半成品​报​"already claimed"​假​冲突​（#74574）； ​磁盘​签名​（_skill_dirs_signature）​在​扫描​前​取样​，​别的​终端​装​/​删​技能​能​推动​它​触发​重扫​（CFG-8）。 ​注册​时​核心​命令​优先​：​与​ core slash ​撞名​的​技能​跳过​自动​注册​（skill_command_collision_note ​同一​谓词​ ​喂给​ /skills ​列表​与​命令​面板​做​用户​提示​），​同​ slug ​去​重​ first-wins ​保住​ project > local > external ​优先级​。​技能​名​走​ \w ​保留​ Unicode——name: ​小说​拆条​ ​注册​ /​小说​拆条​（#12351）。

docs.title: 2. _build_skill_message：​中途​注入​骑​ user ​消息​ + ​缓存​边界
docs.text:
​技能​内容​不进​系统​提示​词​，​而是​展开​成​一条​模型​可见​的​ user ​消息​。​有​指令​时​，​脚手架​部分​是​稳定​前缀​、 ​调用​方​指令​是​易变​尾部​，​边界​被​显式​注册​给​缓存​规划​器​：

# agent/skill_commands.py:401-416（​节选​）
    stable_prefix = None
    if user_instruction:
        parts.append("")
        # Everything before the caller-supplied instruction is a stable scaffold; declare the exact boundary
        # so the Anthropic cache planner can put a breakpoint on it instead of caching the whole message as
        # one atomic block (#81867).
        stable_prefix = append_user_instruction(parts, user_instruction)
    if runtime_note:
        parts += ["", f"[Runtime note: {runtime_note}]"]
    message = "\n".join(parts)
    if stable_prefix is not None and message.startswith(stable_prefix) and len(message) > len(stable_prefix):
        register_stable_prefix(stable_prefix)

​同一​构造​点​的​另一面​是​解析​：extract_user_instruction_from_skill_content ​依赖​脚手架​标记​ （_SKILL_INVOCATION_PREFIX、_SINGLE_SKILL_INSTRUCTION ​等​）​逐字​节​稳定​，​从​展开​后​的​消息​里​还原​ "​用户​到底​说​了​什么​"——​记忆​ provider ​存​ turn ​时要​的​就是​这个​（MemoryManager._strip_skill_scaffolding ​直接​引用​它​），​会话​标题​/​预览​同理​（describe_skill_invocation ​渲染​成​ /work — fix the title leak）。 ​构造​方与​解析​方​的​标记​必须​ byte-identical，​这​是​全​文件​最硬​的​隐含​契约​。

docs.title: 3. skill_preprocessing：​令牌​展开​与​ !cmd`` ​内联​ shell
docs.text:
# agent/skill_preprocessing.py:142-156
def preprocess_skill_content(content, skill_dir, session_id=None, skills_cfg=None) -> str:
    """Apply configured SKILL.md template and inline-shell preprocessing."""
    if not content:
        return content
    cfg = skills_cfg if isinstance(skills_cfg, dict) else load_skills_config()
    if cfg.get("template_vars", True):
        content = substitute_template_vars(content, skill_dir, session_id)
    if cfg.get("inline_shell", False) and not _is_community_hub_skill(skill_dir):
        content = expand_inline_shell(content, skill_dir, int(cfg.get("inline_shell_timeout", 10) or 10))
    return content
  • ${HERMES_SKILL_DIR} / ${HERMES_SESSION_ID}：​解析​不了​的​原样​保留​，​作者​看得见​。
  • !`cmd`：​单行​ shell ​片段​在​加载​时​执行​、​替换​为​ stdout，​输出​上限​ 4000 ​字符​ （_INLINE_SHELL_MAX_OUTPUT，​防​ runaway ​命令​撑​爆​上下文​）；​失败​返回​ [inline-shell ...] ​标记​ ​而​非​抛​异常​。
  • ​安全门​：inline_shell ​默认​关​；​即便​开​了​，hub ​社区​信任​级​的​技能​也​不​自动​执行​——hub ​的​ INSTALL_POLICY ​本会​拦截​高危​社区​安装​，​但​ --force ​能​把​它​放上​磁盘​，​内联​ shell DSL ​又​扫描​为​高危​， ​自动​执行​等于​把​被​拒​的​东西​重新武装​（#63307）。​锁​不可​读时​对​树内​技能​ fail-closed。
  • Windows ​上​ bash ​解析​复用​终端​工具​的​ _find_bash()（CreateProcess ​会先​搜​ System32、​可能​选中​ WSL ​启动器​），​子​进程​环境​经​ delegated_child_subprocess_env()（delegation_context，​见​本组​ delegation_subagents.md）。

docs.title: 4. skills_index_delta：​不​重建​提示​词​的​索引​更新
docs.text:
<available_skills> ​索引​住​在​系统​提示​词里​，​会话​一生​不动​它​（​缓存​前缀​！）。​会话​中途​安装​/​创建​/​删除​ ​技能​（hub install、skill_manage、curator、​另​一​进程​），​索引​就​过期​了​。​解法​是​每​ turn ​对比​ "​提示​词​携带​的​索引​"​与​"​现在​会​构建​的​索引​"，​把​完整​差量​发到​每​ turn ​的​ user ​消息​注记​通道​ （​骑​在​缓存​前缀​之后​；​移植​自​ cloudflare/cloudflare-os#267）：

# agent/skills_index_delta.py:1-13（​模块​ docstring）
"""Skills that change mid-conversation reach the model without a prompt rebuild.
...
Each note states the FULL difference against the prompt, so the prompt plus the newest note is the
complete record of what the model was told. A fresh agent (the gateway builds one per turn) reads that
record back from the transcript once; a long-lived agent (CLI, TUI, Desktop) keeps it on itself. A note
is sent only when the difference changes."""

"​完整​差量​"​是​关键​：​最新​一条​注记​ + ​提示​词​ = ​模型​被​告知​过​的​完整​记录​，​所以​网关​每​ turn ​重建​的​ agent ​只​需​从​转录​读回​一次​。

docs.title: 5. curator.py ​深讲​：​生命周期​状态机
docs.text:
Curator ​不靠​ cron ​守护​：​由会话​启动​钩子​在​ agent ​空闲​时​调用​ maybe_run_curator()。 ​调度​门槛​（should_run_now）​与​状态机​如下​：

                      .usage.json ​遥测​（use/view/patch ​计数​、last_activity_at、pinned）
                                      │
        ┌─────────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
        │ maybe_run_curator(idle_for_seconds)                        │
        │  should_run_now: enabled ∧ ¬paused ∧ last_run_at ​距今​      │
        │                  ≥ interval_hours（​默认​ 7d，​首观​播种​推迟​）  │
        │  idle_for_seconds ≥ min_idle_hours（​默认​ 2h）              │
        │  _claim_run():  .locks/curator-run O_EXCL ​跨​进程​认领​       │
        └──────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                       ▼
        run_curator_review（trigger="scheduled"）
         ① consolidate ⇒ curator_backup.snapshot_skills("pre-curator-run")
         ② apply_automatic_transitions（​纯​函数​，​无​ LLM）
         ③ ​落盘​ .curator_state（last_run_at/run_count，​先于​ LLM pass，​崩溃​可​查​）
         ④ consolidate ⇒ fork AIAgent ​跑​ CURATOR_REVIEW_PROMPT（opt-in）

  ​生命周期​状态机​（​对​每条​ curated ​记录​）：
     active ──anchor ≤ stale_after_days(14d)──► stale
     stale  ──anchor > stale_cutoff───────────► active     （​又​用​了​）
     active/stale ──anchor ≤ archive_after_days(30d)──► archived（​目录​移入​ .archive/，​可​恢复​）
     ✗ pinned / cron ​引用​ / locked：​全部​豁免​
     ✗ use_count==0 ​且​未​到​ stale ​期​：​缺席​证据​≠​陈旧​，​只​ reactivate

# agent/curator.py:209-268（​节选​）
def apply_automatic_transitions(now=None) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Move every curator-managed skill between active/stale/archived based on its latest real
    activity; pinned skills are never touched."""
    ...
    protected = _cron_referenced_skills()          # cron ​引用​ = ​在​用​，​视同​ pinned
    ...
    for row in _u.curated_report():
        name = row["name"]
        if row.get("pinned") or name in protected or (locked_names and is_locked_skill(name, locked_names)):
            continue
        if not row.get("_persisted", True):
            _u.seed_record_if_missing(name)        # ​首见​：​时钟​锚到​现在​，​推迟​一期​
            continue
        ...
        if anchor <= archive_cutoff and current != _u.STATE_ARCHIVED:
            if _archive_as_curator(_u, name):      # ledger actor ​打成​ 'curator'
                counts["archived"] += 1
        elif anchor <= stale_cutoff and current == _u.STATE_ACTIVE:
            _set(name, _u.STATE_STALE, "marked_stale")
        elif anchor > stale_cutoff and current == _u.STATE_STALE:
            _set(name, _u.STATE_ACTIVE, "reactivated")

​三条​不​变量​贯穿​全​文件​：​只​碰​ created_by: "agent" ​的​本地​策展​技能​（bundled/hub/external ​在​候选​列表​前​就​被​滤掉​）；​永不​删除​——archive ​是​上限​、​进​ .archive/ ​可​ hermes curator restore； pinned（​以及​ cron ​引用​、​锁定​的​）​技能​豁免​一切​迁移​。LLM ​整合​ fork（_run_llm_review，curator.py:1086） ​是​辅助​客户端​、opt-in（curator.consolidate，​默认​ False）：enabled_toolsets=["skills"] ——​没有​ terminal，"shell mv/cp/rm ​不留​ ledger，​回滚​只会​恢复​空心​技能​，​砍掉​ toolset ​从​构造​上​封洞​"； max_iterations=9999（​伞形​整合​数百​技能​要​ 50-100 ​次​调用​）；memory_agent_context="subagent" ​只​为​压缩​检查点​持有​ provider；_memory_write_origin="background_review" ​让​ skill_manage ​的​ ​后台​写​守卫​生效​。LLM pass ​跑​在​ daemon ​线程​上​，​且​必须​ copy_context() ​携带​调用​方​的​ profile ​作用域​——​裸线​程会​掉​回​进程​ home，​把​另​一个​ profile ​的​技能​库读​改写​（curator.py:1018-1026 ​注释​）。

docs.title: 6. curator_backup.py：​回滚​是​"​可回​滚​的​"
docs.text:
​任何​会​重写​内容​的​ pass（​只有​ LLM ​整合​会​原地​改写​；​纯​ prune ​只是​目录​改名​）​之前​，​整个​ skills/ ​树​ tar.gz ​进​ .curator_backups/<utc-iso>/，​带​ manifest.json，​并​顺手​拷贝​ cron/jobs.json ​的​两个​ ​字​段​（​整合​会​原地​改写​ cron ​的​ skills/skill ​引用​）。​排除​名单​本身​就是​一份​事故​史​：

# agent/curator_backup.py:37-43
_EXCLUDE_TOP_LEVEL = {".curator_backups", ".hub", ".locks", ".git", ".archive", ".curator_ledger.jsonl"}

​注释​里​记着​教训​：.git ​回滚会​破坏​ git ​追踪​且​快照​嵌套​膨胀​（38MB ​涨​到​ 24GB）；.archive/ ​与​ append-only ​的​ .curator_ledger.jsonl ​回滚​到​旧​副本​会​丢失​条目​/​技能​——​而​"​永不​删除​"​的​承诺​ ​正押​在​它们​身上​（650MB ledger ​曾​让​每次​快照​ 820MB、​每次​ archive ​解压​全程​卡​ CLI 6 ​分钟​）。 ​嵌套​的​ venv/node_modules ​等​可再生​目录​也​跳​过​（​单个​ torch venv 1.3GB，#107539）。 ​回滚​（rollback_snapshot）​先给​当前​树拍​快照​再​解压​目标​——​回滚​自身​可​撤销​。

docs.title: 7. background_review.py：turn ​后​的​记忆​/​技能​评审
docs.text: run_conversation ​结束​后​可派​ daemon ​线程​，​回放​对话​快照​进​一个​ fork ​的​ AIAgent，​问​ "​该​保存​/​更新​什么​技能​或​记忆​？"。​三个​决定性​事实​：fork ​继承​父​运行​时​（provider/model/​凭据​/​缓存​ ​系统​提示​词​）​因此​命中​同一​前缀​缓存​；​写​直接​进​ memory + skill ​存储​，​主会​话​与​主​缓存​零​接触​； fork ​运行​在​ dispatch ​侧​工具​白名单​下​。_BackgroundReviewRun ​提供​每​评审​的​取消​/​完成​握手​ （cancel_background_review_for_live_turn ​让​新​ turn ​到来​时在途​评审​让路​）； managed local runtime（​本地​ llama-server）​上​评审​ fork ​会​霸占​ GPU，review_idle_queue.py ​因此​把​评审​排队​到​ ​机器​空闲​（/slots ​安静​ 15s ​才​算​ idle；​每会话​一槽​、​最新​快照​胜出​、​超龄​ 30 ​分钟​照发​）。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• 12_skills/：SKILL.md frontmatter ​规范​、/skills、hub ​安装​与​信任​级​——​本篇​的​扫描​/​门控​ （skill_matches_*、_is_community_hub_skill）​都​是​那份​规范​的​执行​侧​。
  • 04_tools/：tools/skills_tool.py（_skill_catalog/skill_view/_skills_scan_signature）​是​ ​扫描​的​数据源​；tools/skill_usage.py（.usage.json：use/view/patch ​计数​、last_activity_at、 active/stale/archived、pinned）​是​ curator ​状态机​的​遥测​底座​；tools/skill_ledger.py ​是​审计​账本​ （curator ​归档​时​把​ actor ​打成​ 'curator'）；tools/skill_manager_guards ​的​ read-before-write ​标记​由​两个​ fork（curator ​与​ background_review）​显式​播种​。
  • agent/ ​内​：prompt_cache_boundary.register_stable_prefix ​是​ #81867 ​缓存​断点​的​注册处​； delegation_context.delegated_child_subprocess_env ​在​内联​ shell ​子​进程​里​携带​/​清洗​委托​标记​； memory ​侧​ MemoryManager._strip_skill_scaffolding ​复用​脚手架​解析​（​见​ memory_learning.md）。
  • cron/：_cron_referenced_skills() ​把​ cron ​作业​引用​的​技能​视同​ pinned；​整合​重写​ cron ​引用​后​ ​备份​负责​恢复​那​两个​字​段​。
  • CLI/​网关​：hermes curator run/--dry-run、/reload-skills、Desktop/TUI ​的​命令​面板​都​消费​ published_scopes_signature() ​的​作用域​签名​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​技能​运行​时​的​主线​是​"​缓存​友好​地​中途​变化​"：​技能​体骑​ user ​消息​（​稳定​前缀​ + ​注册​断点​）， ​索引​差量​骑​注记​通道​，curator ​与​ background_review ​两个​后台​机都​走​ fork、​不​碰主会​话​。 Curator ​的​克制​值得​细读​——​它​把​"​自动​"​限定​在​确定性​状态机​（​无​ LLM ​也​能​跑​），​把​ LLM ​交互​限成​ opt-in ​的​辅助​ fork，​用​"​永不​删除​ + ​先​快照​ + ledger"​兜底​，​再用​排除​名单​把​过往​事故​（820MB ​快照​、 24GB ​膨胀​）​固化​成​常量​。​多槽​缓存​则​是​"​进程​服务​多​身份​"​这一​现实​在​技能​域​的​直接​投影​： platform、home、project ​任一​漂移​都​不能​复用​别人​的​扫描​结果​。

docs.title: 流式​与​响应​整流​（agent/ ​流式​子系统​）
文件​概览
docs.text:
​模型​响应​从​ socket ​到​用户​屏幕​要​过​五道​工序​，​每​道工序​一组​文件​：

  1. ​请求​双​路径​：chat_completion_helpers.py（4,001 ​行​）—— ​流式​ _StreamingCall ​与非​流式​ _NonStreamRequest（worker ​线程​ + ​轮询​监控​）， ​外加​ build_api_kwargs ​请求​装配​。
  2. ​流​纪律​：stream_single_writer.py（​单写​者​围栏​）、stream_diag.py （​断流​诊断​）、stream_max_lifetime.py（​总​寿命​帽​）、stream_delivery.py （delta ​风扇​出​）、chat_completion_stream_monitor.py（​心跳​/​陈旧​检测​）。
  3. ​推理​清洗​：think_scrubber.py（​跨​ delta ​状态机​剥​ <think> ​块​）、 reasoning_carriers.py（provider ​原生​思考​载体​）、reasoning_effort/params/ promotion/summaries/timeouts.py。
  4. ​响应​整流​：message_sanitization.py（​消毒​）、bounded_response.py （​有​界​错误​体​读取​）、empty_response_guard.py（​空​响应​守卫​）、 repetition_guard.py（​重复​循环​检测​）、markdown_tables.py（CJK ​表格​对齐​）。
  5. ​呈现​：display.py（spinner/​工具​预览​）、status_output.py（​状态​/​警告​管线​）。

​双​路径​的​统一​入口​是​ interruptible_api_call（​非​流式​）​与​ interruptible_streaming_api_call（​流式​），​两者​都​跑​在​「​可​中断​」​语义​下​：​调用者​ ​不必​等​完整​ HTTP ​往返​就​能​感知​中断​。

docs.title: 1. ​非​流式​路径​：worker ​线程​ + ​陈旧​调用​击杀
docs.text:
​非​流式​请求​在​ worker ​线程​上​跑​，​调用者​轮询​。​陈旧​连击​（​连续​多次​无​响应​）​超过​阈值​ ​就​直接​抛错​，​不再​碰​网络​：

# agent/chat_completion_helpers.py:1260
def interruptible_api_call(agent, api_kwargs: dict):
    """Run the API call on a worker thread so the caller can detect interrupts
    without waiting for the full HTTP round-trip. Each worker gets its own
    per-request client (interrupts close only that one); a stale-call detector
    kills the connection and raises so the main retry loop can back off / rotate
    credentials / fall back."""
    # Nested-pool contexts (cron, delegated children) wedge on a worker thread
    # (#62151): run inline. See should_use_direct_api_call.
    if should_use_direct_api_call(agent):
        return direct_api_call(agent, api_kwargs)
    _check_stale_giveup(agent)  # cross-turn stale breaker (#58962), non-streaming sibling
    from agent.chat_completion_nonstream import _NonStreamRequest

    return _NonStreamRequest(agent, api_kwargs).run()

_NonStreamRequest（chat_completion_nonstream.py:13）​把​ worker（_call）​与​ ​轮询​循环​共享​的​状态​放在​实例​上​，_abort_request ​可能​从​轮询​的​「​陌生​线程​」​调用​ —— ​所以​共享​状态​全部​按​跨​线程​可变​设计​。

docs.title: 2. ​流式​路径​：_StreamingCall
docs.text:
​流式​请求​是​一个​「​请求​线程​ + ​轮询​监控​」​双线​程​协作​体​。​看​ __init__ ​的​字​段​就​能​ ​读懂​它​要​处理​的​所有​边界​情况​：

# agent/chat_completion_helpers.py:2699（​节选​）
class _StreamingCall(StreamingWaitMonitor):
    """One streaming request on the chat_completions / anthropic_messages wire.
    State shared between the request worker and the poll-loop monitor (heartbeat,
    stale kill, interrupt abort) lives on the instance, mutated from both threads."""

    def __init__(self, agent, api_kwargs: dict, on_first_delta):
        self.agent = agent
        self.api_kwargs = api_kwargs
        self.on_first_delta = on_first_delta
        self.worker = None  # request thread; None in inline mode
        self.result = {"response": None, "error": None, "partial_tool_names": []}
        self.clients = _RequestClientRegistry(agent)
        # Request-local cancel flag: the worker recognizes its own interrupt
        # force-close (RemoteProtocolError) and exits instead of retrying (#6600).
        self._request_cancelled = {"value": False}
        self.first_delta_fired = {"done": False}
        self.deltas_were_sent = {"yes": False}  # for the partial-delivery fallback
        self.provider_tool_in_flight = {"yes": False}
        # Last REAL chunk; the monitor detects SSE-ping-only connections with it.
        self.last_chunk_time = {"t": time.time()}
        ...
        # Per-attempt: single-writer token, request-local client, raw HTTP response (chat wire).
        self._writer_token = self._attempt_request_client = self._attempt_stream_response = None
        # The route ``api_kwargs`` was assembled for; a retry must not replay it on another one.
        self._request_route = self._live_route()

​值得注意​的​三个​字​段​：last_chunk_time ​用来​识别​「​只发​ SSE ping ​不发​真实​块​」​的​ ​僵尸​连接​；_request_route ​捕获​请求​装配​时​的​路由​，/model ​中途​切换​时​重试​会​把​ ​错误​交回​ turn ​循环​重建​请求​（_route_switched_under_request，​行​ 2738）​而​不是​把​ ​旧​模型​的​ payload ​发到​新​ base_url；​每个​ attempt ​拿​独立​的​单写​者​ token ​和​请求​级​ client。

​流式​入口​在​最终​分派​前​处理​特殊​ api_mode ​并​做​同样​的​陈旧​连击​检查​：

# agent/chat_completion_helpers.py:3977
def interruptible_streaming_api_call(agent, api_kwargs: dict, *, on_first_delta=None):
    """Streaming variant of _interruptible_api_call: fires the delta callbacks per
    text token (tool-call turns suppress them) and returns a SimpleNamespace in
    the non-streaming response shape. codex_responses delegates to the already-
    streaming codex runner; cron turns and delegated children run inline."""
    if agent._interrupt_requested:
        raise InterruptedError("Agent interrupted before streaming API call")
    if agent.api_mode == "codex_responses":
        return _stream_codex_passthrough(agent, api_kwargs, on_first_delta)
    if agent.api_mode == "bedrock_converse":
        return _BedrockStream(agent, api_kwargs, on_first_delta).run()
    # Cross-turn stale-stream circuit breaker (see ``_stale_streak()``).
    _check_stale_giveup(agent)
    return _StreamingCall(agent, api_kwargs, on_first_delta).run()

​陈旧​熔断器​本身​只有​十行​，​但​它​区分​「​显式​ env ​设定​ = ​用户​死线​，​永不​封顶​」：

# agent/chat_completion_helpers.py:608
def _check_stale_giveup(agent) -> None:
    """Raise immediately when the consecutive-stale streak is past the
    give-up threshold — no network attempt, no stale-timeout wait."""
    _giveup = stale_giveup()
    _streak = _stale_streak(agent)
    if _giveup > 0 and _streak >= _giveup:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Provider has been unresponsive (no response received) for "
            f"{_streak} consecutive stale attempts — aborting this call to "
            "avoid an indefinite stall. Switch models or start a new session, then retry."
        )

docs.title: 3. ​单写​者​纪律​：stream_single_writer.py
docs.text:
​同一​会话​可能​出现​两个​并发​ delta ​源​（​比如​重试​叠加​）。​围栏​只​丢弃​可​证明​被​取代​ ​的​流​，​绝不​丢弃​唯一​写者​；agent ​没有​围栏​时​降级​为​「​无​围栏​」​而​不是​崩溃​：

# agent/stream_single_writer.py:1（​模块​ docstring，​节选​）
"""Best-effort accessors for the single-writer stream fence.

The fence lives on ``AIAgent`` (``_claim_stream_writer`` / ``_stream_writer_is_current``) but is
used from other streaming modules. Calling it directly would turn an *additive* safety net into a
fatal AttributeError on a partially-updated checkout, hot-reloaded gateway, duck-typed agent, or
test double (a cron job died this way). The fence may only drop a *provably* superseded stream,
never the sole writer, so when it is unavailable or raises the degradation is "no fence".
"""

def claim_stream_writer(agent: Any) -> int:
    """Claim the delta sink for this stream attempt; ``0`` (never fenced) when the agent lacks the fence or the claim raised."""
    return _fence_call(agent, "_claim_stream_writer", int, 0, "claim failed; proceeding unfenced")

docs.title: 4. ​推理​清洗​：​跨​ delta ​的​ <think> ​状态机
docs.text:
​逐​ delta ​跑​正则​会​把​「​单独​到达​的​ <think> ​开头​」​抹掉​，​导致​下游​状态机​泄漏​推理​ ​文本​。StreamingThinkScrubber ​在​ delta ​边界​持有​半个​标签​，​直到​它​被​证实​或​证伪​：

# agent/think_scrubber.py:23（​节选​）
# The one list of model reasoning tag names. Every surface that hides reasoning (this scrubber,
# the CLI stream filter, the gateway stream filter, the final-response regex stripper) binds to
# these; a tag added here is covered everywhere. Consumers match case-insensitively, so the
# literal tags are lowercase. The CJK names cover models (MiniMax-M3) that emit Chinese reasoning
# tags: ​思考​ (think), ​反思​ (reflect), ​推理​ (reason), ​推敲​ (deliberate).
THINK_TAG_NAMES: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "think", "thinking", "reasoning", "thought", "REASONING_SCRATCHPAD",
    "​思考​", "​反思​", "​推理​", "​推敲​",
)

# agent/think_scrubber.py:31
class StreamingThinkScrubber:
    """Stateful scrubber for streaming reasoning/thinking blocks.

    State: ``_in_block`` (inside an open block; text discarded), ``_buf`` (held-back partial-tag
    tail), ``_last_emitted_ended_newline`` (True iff the last emission ended with ``\\n`` or nothing
    was emitted yet — decides whether an open tag at buffer position 0 sits at a block boundary).
    """

​一个​标签​名单​覆盖​所有​表面​：​流式​ scrubber、CLI ​流​过滤器​、​网关​流​过滤器​、​最终​响应​ ​正则​剥离​器​ —— ​在​这里​加​一个​标签​，​到处​生效​。​开​标签​只​在​块​边界​（​流首​/​换行​后​）​开启​ ​块​，​所以​提到​ <think> ​的​正文​不会​被​误伤​；​闭合​对​则​总是​抑制​。

provider ​原生​的​思考​载体​由​ reasoning_carriers.py ​处理​：Gemini ​的​ thought_signature ​等​被​捕获​为​一条​私有​ reasoning_details ​记录​持久​化​，​发送​时​只​ ​由​声明​它​的​路由​重新​抬回​线上​（shape_wire_carriers），​其他​路由​全部​剥离​。

docs.title: 5. ​响应​整流​四​守卫
docs.text:
​消毒​（message_sanitization.py）：​修复​或​剥离​会​让​ OpenAI SDK ​的​ json.dumps ​崩溃​或​被​上游​拒绝​的​字符​ —— ​纯​函数​、​原地​变更​语义​有​文档​标注​。

​有​界​错误​体​读取​（bounded_response.py）：​非​ OK ​的​流式​响应​要读​ body ​出​诊断​， ​但​裸​ response.read() ​既​可能​内存​爆炸​也​可能​永远​卡住​：

# agent/bounded_response.py:1（​节选​）
"""Bounded reads of HTTP error response bodies.

On a non-OK *streaming* response Hermes reads the body for a diagnostic (only ever shown truncated to
a few hundred chars). A bare ``response.read()`` is unbounded two ways: arbitrarily large body
(memory) or a body that stalls forever (hang). ``read_streaming_error_body`` caps bytes and enforces a
hard wall-clock deadline; ... ``httpx.iter_bytes()`` blocks *inside* the socket read, so the
read runs on a daemon thread; on timeout we close the response (unblocking the read) and return the
partial bytes.
"""

​空​响应​守卫​（empty_response_guard.py）：​无​信号​空​完成​（success、​零​输出​ token）​与​被​信号​拒绝​（content_filter）​不同​，​前者​重试​最​多​ 3 ​次后​走​ fallback ​链​， ​每次​重试​都​全额​计费​输入​。​两个​独立​守卫​都​ fail-open：​连续​两次​ output_tokens == 0 ​的​确定性​空​ → ​直接​跳​ fallback；​单次​空​响应​估算​输入​成本​超​阈值​ → ​提前​止损​。

​重复​循环​守卫​（repetition_guard.py）：​退化​重复​循环​能​烧光​全部​输出​预算​ （​真实​事故​：​一条​ 60k ​字符​的​ turn ​被​拆成​ 31 ​条​ Discord ​消息​）。​检测​在​ finish_reason=length ​的​「​继续​」​助推​之前​做​，​只​对​ 60+ ​字符​的​长​逐字​重复​且​占​片段​ ​多数​的​情况​触发​ —— ​刻意​保守​。

docs.title: 6. ​呈现​层
docs.text: display.py ​是​无​ AIAgent ​依赖​的​纯​展示​函数​（spinner、​工具​预览​、diff）； markdown_tables.py ​用​ wcwidth ​重排​模型​输出​的​ CJK ​表格​（​模型​按​「​一格​一​字符​」 ​补​空格​，​中日韩​字形​占​两格​，​行会​漂移​）；status_output.py ​是​ AIAgent ​的​状态​/ ​警告​管线​：​安全​打印​、quiet-mode ​门控​、​去​重​的​上下文​溢出​警告​，​以及​只​在​所有​重试​/ ​回退​耗尽​后​才​展示​的​缓冲​重试​碎语​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
