docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• webhook/msgraph ​的​入​站​在​收据​层​就​交给​ SessionAuthority（webhook_ingress.py），​与​ message_flow.md ​第​ 3 ​步​的​ durable FIFO ​同源​；​投递​经​ delivery.py ​路由​到​任何​网关​平台​。
  • api_server ​的​ runs ​复用​ turn_executor._UnboundedThreadExecutor（turn_machinery.md）​与​权威​ turn ​门​（sessions_authority.md）；wake.py ​对​无​状态​ api_server ​的​会​话​恢复​走​自​ POST /v1/chat/completions（​见​ streaming.md ​唤醒​小节​）。
  • serves_profile_prefix = True ​让​三者​都​受​ shared_ingress.py ​的​多路复用​前缀​规则​约束​；profile ​前缀​解析​ fail-closed（_prefix_names_served_profile）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​三个​内置​平台​展示​了​适配器​框架​的​另一面​：​不是​「​聊天​ bot」，​而是​「HTTP ​进​、HTTP ​出​」​的​机器​集成​面​。webhook ​把​任意​签名​事件​变成​一次​ agent ​运行​，​用​合并​器​解决​幂​等​拦不住​的​连发​；msgraph ​适配​ Graph ​的​订阅​拉取​模型​；api_server ​则​把​整个​ agent ​变成​一个​ OpenAI ​兼容​服务​——​包括​ run ​生命周期​、​审批​、steer ​和​ previous_response_id ​会话​链​。​它们​共同​演示​了​两个​教训​：​执行权​永远​归会话​权威​（HTTP ​任务​只​拿​收据​），​以及​每​请求​重建​ agent ​时​，​跨​请求​的​状态​（MemoryManager、response ​链​）​必须​显式​停泊​与​续接​。

docs.title: message_flow.md —— ​一条​消息​的​七步​全​链路
文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​把​「​用户​在​ Telegram ​发了​一句​『​你好​』​到​ agent ​回帖​」​拆成​ 7 ​步​，​每步​给​真实​代码​。​链路​贯穿​三组​文件​：​入站​管线​（run_inbound*.py + ​授权​/​忙碌​）、​会话​接纳​（session_ingress.py + SessionAuthority）、​投递​与​落盘​（delivery*、response_filters.py、SessionStore）。​读完​本篇​，gateway/ ​里​一半​以上​的​文件​都​有​了​坐标​。

(1) ​适配器​收包​        (2) ​入站​管线​           (3) ​会话​接纳​          (4) turn ​执行​
Telegram update  ─▶  MessageEvent ​归一​  ─▶  ​授权​/​忙碌​/​入站​准备​ ─▶ SessionAuthority  ─▶  _handle_message_with_agent
                     (platforms/event)      (authz/run_inbound)   admit_session_input     (run_turn.py:200)
                                                                          │
   (7) ​落盘​            (6) ​最终​回复​            (5) ​流式​                   ▼
SessionStore ​转录​  ◀─  send_final_ledgered ◀─  GatewayStreamConsumer ◀─  agent ​线程​
+ ​重试​队列​/​关机​排水​     + delivery_ledger       ​逐步​编辑​一条​消息​

docs.title: 第​ 1 ​步​：​适配器​收包​，​归一为​ MessageEvent
docs.text:
​所有​平台​的​消息​先​被​各自​适配器​归一成​同一个​数据​类​ MessageEvent（gateway/platforms/event.py，​叶子​模块​，​谁​都​能​ import）。​字段​在​追加​时​保持​「​只​增不改​位置​」​的​纪律​，​这是​数据​类​在​ 60+ ​处​ event.<attr> ​读法​下​的​生存之道​：

# ​来源​：gateway/platforms/event.py:66-98（​节选​）
@dataclass
class MessageEvent:
    """Incoming message from a platform — the normalized shape all adapters produce."""
    text: str
    message_type: MessageType = MessageType.TEXT
    user_id: Optional[str] = None
    user_name: Optional[str] = None
    source: SessionSource = None          # ​生产​路径​必填​；Optional ​只为​单测​
    raw_message: Any = None
    message_id: Optional[str] = None
    ledger_message_id: Optional[str] = None   # /queue ​链​的​最终​回复​按链​尾​消息​记账​
    reply_anchor_override: Optional[str] = None  # ​忙碌​重定向​后​回复​锚点​改指​重定向​消息​
    media_urls: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    ...
    internal: bool = False                # ​合成​事件​（​后台​通知​）​绕过​用户​授权​
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    allow_gateway_control: bool = True    # ​主动​插件​事件​置​ False，​防​不可​信​文本​执行命令​

​适配器​把​事件​交给​ BasePlatformAdapter.handle_message（platforms/base.py:3924）。​这里​是​第一道​忙碌​守卫​：session_key ​已​在​ _active_sessions ​里​就​转​ _handle_message_while_active（​排队​或​绕行​），​否则​先​同步​装​好​守卫​再​ spawn ​后台任务​，​杜绝​第二条​消息​抢跑​：

# ​来源​：gateway/platforms/base.py:3941-3966（​节选​）
        if event.allow_gateway_control:
            coerce_plaintext_gateway_command(event)
        # Identity FIRST: every key below (routing check, guard lookup, batch lane) derives from it.
        if self._drop_unresolved(event):
            return
        ...
        session_key = self._event_session_key(event)
        ...
        from gateway.session_ingress_burst import burst_gate
        behind_burst = await burst_gate(self, event, session_key)  # a serial reader's command waits too
        if session_key in self._active_sessions or behind_burst:
            await self._handle_message_while_active(event, session_key)
            return
        # Guard installed synchronously BEFORE the task spawns so a second message can't race in.
        event._gateway_accepted = self._start_session_processing(event, session_key)

​注意​ _drop_unresolved：​多路复用​下​身份​解析​不​出来​，​事件​在​适配器​缝上​就​被​丢弃​——​绝不​落到​默认​ profile（HX002）。

docs.title: 第​ 2 ​步​：​入站​管线​——​授权​、​忙碌​、​文本​/​媒体​准备
docs.text:
​后台任务​进入​ runner ​的​ _handle_message（GatewayInboundMixin，run_inbound.py）。​这​条​管线​依次​做​：​更新​提示​回复​、​紧急​停止​门​、​授权​判定​（authz_mixin.py：​允许​名单​、DM ​策略​、​未​授权​发送者​的​配对​码​回复​、bot ​回环​守卫​ bot_loop_guard.py ​的​回环​预算​）、slash ​命令​改写​与​未知​命令​应答​、​语音​转写​（run_inbound_transcription.py）、​插件​注入​（run_plugin_injection.py）、​回复​上下文​与​媒体​注记​前缀​、​忙碌​会话​分流​（run_busy.py）：

# ​来源​：gateway/run_inbound.py:1-5
"""Inbound message pipeline (_handle_message, text/media preparation, durable-turn markers, plugin
injection) for GatewayRunner.

Split out of ``gateway/run.py``; bound onto ``GatewayRunner`` via the MRO.
``gateway.run`` internals are imported lazily inside method bodies (import cycle),
so ``patch("gateway.run.X")`` keeps intercepting them at call time."""

# ​来源​：gateway/authz_mixin.py:1-5
"""User-authorization mixin for ``GatewayRunner``: may this user/chat talk to the agent,
the per-adapter DM policy, the unauthorized-DM behavior, and the bot loop guard.

``gateway.run`` is never imported at module import time (cycle). The unauthorized-DM method still
logs through ``gateway.run``'s logger so its records keep that name."""

​忙碌​分发​的​关键​不​变量​（gateway/AGENTS.md § The gateway has TWO message guards）：agent ​运行​中​，​入站​消息​先过​适配器​守卫​（_pending_messages），​再​过​ runner ​守卫​（run_busy.py ​拦​ /stop /new /queue /status /approve /deny，​绝不​放​它们​去​ running_agent.interrupt()）。​任何​新​的​「​必须​在​ agent ​阻塞​时可达​」​的​命令​要​同时​绕过​两道​守卫​并​内联​分发​——_process_message_background() ​与会​话​生命周期​有​竞态​，​禁用​。

docs.title: 第​ 3 ​步​：​会话​接纳​——durable FIFO
docs.text:
​通过​忙碌​分流​的​消息​来到​ session_ingress.py::admit_message，​对​着​ session_authority.py::SessionAuthority ​完成​接纳​。​接纳​不是​内存​排队​，​而是​把​输入​写​进​ SQLite ​的​ session_admissions ​表​（durable FIFO，​由​状态​层​的​ hermes_state_runtime.py::admit_session_input ​承接​）：

# ​来源​：gateway/session_ingress.py:39-64（​节选​）
async def admit_message(authority, event):
    ...
    receipt = await authority.admit_native(event)
    ...
    except RuntimeStoreError as exc:
        if exc.reason == 'stale_generation' and exc.field == 'route':
            return None  # a later /stop or /new of the chat fenced it, as main cancels a queued row
        if exc.reason == 'invalid_params' and exc.field:
            # Refused before commit (_validate_native): a refusal notice instead of a generic turn error.
            named = f'{exc.reason}: {exc.field}' if exc.field in _CONTENT_CLAUSES else exc.reason
            return (f'⚠️ Hermes refused this message ({named}), so it was not saved '
                    'or answered. Ask the operator to check gateway.log.')
        if exc.reason != 'queue_full':
            raise
        return QUEUE_FULL_REPLY

# ​来源​：hermes_state_runtime.py:130-168（​节选​）
def admit_session_input(db, *, epoch: int, principal_id: str, session_id: str,
                        request_id: str, payload: dict, intent: str = 'queue', ...) -> dict:
    """Admit input; the trusted private guard raises to refuse a NEW write."""
    ...
    def write(conn):
        _epoch(conn, epoch)
        _session(conn, session_id)
        old = conn.execute('''SELECT * FROM session_admissions
            WHERE principal_id=? AND target_session_id=? AND request_id=?''', ...).fetchone()
        if old is not None:
            if old['payload_digest'] != digest:
                raise RuntimeStoreError('admission_conflict', **ADMITTED_REQUEST_CONFLICT)
            ...
            return _row(old)
        queued = conn.execute('''SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_admissions WHERE target_session_id=?
            AND status='queued' ''', (session_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        if queued >= ADMISSION_QUEUE_MAX:      # 32：​与​ main ​的​忙碌​队列​上限​一致​
            raise RuntimeStoreError('queue_full')
        ...
        conn.execute('''INSERT INTO session_admissions(...,status,owner_epoch) VALUES(...,'queued',?)''', ...)
        return _row(_admission(conn, admission_id))
    return db._execute_write(write)

​三个​拒绝​理由​各有​用途​：admission_conflict（​同​ request_id ​不同​内容​——​重​放​冲突​）、queue_full（​每会话​ 32 ​条​上限​，​回复​ QUEUE_FULL_REPLY ​提示​稍后​再发​）、epoch ​校验​（​进程​换代​后旧​ epoch ​的​写入​作废​）。​接纳​返回​ receipt ​后​，​调用者​挂​在​ asyncio.shield(waiter) ​上​等​执行​结果​；​进程​崩溃​后​，​未决​行由​启动​恢复​接手​。

docs.title: 第​ 4 ​步​：turn ​执行
docs.text:
run_turn.py:200 ​的​ _handle_message_with_agent ​在​ _running_agents ​哨兵​守卫​下​运行​：​解析​会话​（_hmwa_resolve_session）、​准备​ turn（_hmwa_prepare_turn：​装​历史​、​获取​ turn ​租约​、​绑定​ profile ​作用域​、agent:start hook），​然后​调​ _run_agent：

# ​来源​：gateway/run_turn.py:200-268（​节选​）
    async def _handle_message_with_agent(self, event, source, _quick_key: str, run_generation: int):
        """Inner handler that runs under the _running_agents sentinel guard."""
        ...
        resolved = await self._hmwa_resolve_session(event, source)
        if resolved is None:
            return
        source, session_entry, session_key = resolved
        prepared, _session_env_tokens = await self._hmwa_prepare_turn(
            event, source, session_entry, session_key, _quick_key, run_generation,
        )
        ...
            agent_result = await self._run_agent(
                message=message_text, context_prompt=prepared.context_prompt, history=history,
                source=_turn_source, session_id=_run_start_session_id, session_key=session_key,
                run_generation=run_generation, ...)

​这​一步​的​机器​细节​——​租约​为什么​按​ session_id ​而​不是​路由​键​、​线程​怎么​停车​复用​、agent ​缓存​怎么​驱逐​——​全部​留给​ turn_machinery.md。

docs.title: 第​ 5 ​步​：​流式​事件
docs.text: agent ​线程​产出​的​ delta ​经​ GatewayStreamConsumer（stream_consumer.py）​桥到​事件​循环​：​同步​回调​ on_delta() ​入队​，​异步​任务​缓冲​、​限速​、​逐步​编辑​同​一条​平台​消息​。​流式​只是​「​展示​」——​事件​描述​传输​、​从不​描述​上下文​，​被​网关​「​吃掉​」​的​任何​字​都​不许​偏离​ agent ​自己​持有​的​消息​历史​。​深讲​见​ streaming.md。

docs.title: 第​ 6 ​步​：​最终​回复​——​先​记账​，​再​发送
docs.text:
turn ​结束​，​最终​文本​走​ send_final_ledgered（platforms/base.py:4281）：​先​把​投递​义务​写​进​ delivery_ledger（state.db ​里​的​表​），​再​发送​，​最后​按​ SendResult ​结账​——​崩溃​在​中间​任何​一点​，​重启​清扫​都​能​补​投​或​明确​放弃​：

# ​来源​：gateway/platforms/base.py:4281-4304（​节选​）
    async def send_final_ledgered(
        self, event: MessageEvent, session_key: str, text_content: str, metadata: dict[str, Any], *,
        reply_to: Optional[str], is_ephemeral_response: bool = False,
    ) -> "tuple[SendResult, BasePlatformAdapter]":
        """The delivery-ledger bracket every final text goes through, on the CURRENT transport
        (a reconnect may have replaced this adapter): record the obligation before the send,
        send with retry, finalize from the result — so a refused final (flood control, a dead
        transport) leaves a ledger row the boot sweep / runtime redelivery can act on."""
        delivery_adapter = self._final_delivery_adapter(event.source)
        obligation_id = await self._record_delivery_obligation(
            event, session_key, text_content, delivery_adapter, is_ephemeral_response)
        if obligation_id is not None:
            await self._release_turn_marker(event)  # the ledger now owns the crash recovery
        result = await delivery_adapter._send_with_retry(
            chat_id=event.source.chat_id, content=text_content, reply_to=reply_to, metadata=metadata)
        ...
        if obligation_id is not None:
            await self._finalize_delivery_obligation(obligation_id, result, event, delivery_adapter)
        return result, delivery_adapter

​账本​的​状态机​（delivery_ledger.py:1-11 docstring）：pending（​未​开始​，​重投​ plainly）→ attempting（​发送​中​崩溃​，​平台​可能​已​收到​，​重投​必须​带​「​可能​重复​」​标记​）→ delivered（​剪除​）/ failed（​明确​拒绝​，​重启​即​重试​边界​）；​尝试​封顶​、​过期​转​ abandoned。​账本​失败​绝不​阻塞​发送​——​所有​调用​包​在​ try/except ​里​。​投递​路线​的​选择​在​ delivery.py::DeliveryRouter（home channel ​解析​、cron deliver=<name> ​目标​）；mirror.py ​把​回复​镜像​到​绑定​会话​；response_filters.py ​在​发送​前​净化​（​意向​沉默​不​投递​、​内部​指令​剥离​、README ​尾巴​过滤​）。

docs.title: 第​ 7 ​步​：​落盘
docs.text: ​回复​发​完​，​转录​由​ SessionStore（session.py:787）​追加​到​ SQLite（session_transcript.py mixin）。​转录​写入​失败​不​丢​数据​——​进​内存​重试​队列​（_dirty_transcripts + _transcript_append_failures，session.py:817-822）​由​排水​器重​放​；​父​→​子会​话​的​队列​迁移​靠​ _transcript_drain_lock ​保持​线性化​。​进程​关闭​时​ run_shutdown.py/shutdown_flush.py ​排空​所有​脏​队列​，shutdown_forensics.py ​留证​。​崩溃​恢复​则​靠​ SessionEntry.active_turn_token：kill ​在​「​终态​提交​」​与​「​账本​写入​」​之间​时​，​下次​不洁​启动​能​找回​确切​的​会​话​并​补​投​持久​化​回复​。

docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ run_inbound.py GatewayInboundMixin ​主管​线​：​授权​、​文本​/​媒体​准备​、durable-turn ​标记​ run_inbound_consumer.py ​入站​消费​循环​（​事件​到​ turn ​的​派发​层​） run_inbound_hooks.py GatewayInboundHooksMixin：​处理​生命周期​钩子​ run_inbound_media.py ​入站​媒体​搬运​（rehome_inbound_media） run_inbound_transcription.py GatewayInboundTranscriptionMixin：​语音​转​文字​ run_inbound_unauthorized.py ​未​授权​发送者​处理​：​配对​码​、owner ​提示​、​限流​ run_plugin_injection.py GatewayPluginInjectionMixin：​插件​注入​内容​进​ turn run_topics.py GatewayTopicThreadsMixin：​话题​/thread ​恢复​路由

docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ delivery.py DeliveryRouter：​投递​目标​解析​与​发送​通道​选择​ delivery_ledger.py durable ​投递​义务​账本​（pending/attempting/delivered/failed/abandoned） dead_targets.py ​死​目标​分类​与​停​投​ response_filters.py ​回复​净化​：​意向​沉默​、​部分​沉默​标记​、​尾巴​剥离​ mirror.py ​回复​镜像​到​绑定​会话​转录​ rich_sent_store.py ​富​文本​已​发送​记录​（edit ​目标​查找​） message_timestamps.py ​消息​时间​戳​去​重​/​节流​ media_fetch.py ​入站​媒体​抓取​ media_policy.py ​媒体​策略​（​大小​/​类型​门​） media_repair.py ​媒体​修复​（​损坏​图片​重取​等​） sticker_cache.py ​贴纸​缓存​ whatsapp_identity.py WhatsApp ​号码​归一化​/​别名​展开

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​第​ 3 ​步​的​ durable FIFO ​属于​状态​层​：hermes_state_runtime.py ​是​ gateway ​之下​、hermes_state.py ​家族​的​ runtime ​表​操作​；gateway ​自己​不​写队​列表​。
  • ​第​ 4/5 ​步​的​执行​与​流式​分别​在​ turn_machinery.md、streaming.md ​展开​；​本篇​只​给​链路​坐标​。
  • ​适配器​从​哪来​（platform_registry + 26 ​个​插件​）​见​ platforms_framework.md；3 ​个​内置​ HTTP ​平台​见​ builtin_platforms.md。
  • cron ​与​后台​进程​通知​复用​同一​管线​：​它们​是​ internal=True ​的​合成​事件​（wake.py、run_notifications.py，​见​ streaming.md ​末节​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​七步​链路​里​每​一步​都​在​回答​一个​可靠性​问题​：​第​ 1 ​步​「​消息​是​谁​的​、​允​不​允许​进来​」（​身份​优先​ + ​授权​ + ​回环​守卫​）；​第​ 2/3 ​步​「agent ​忙​时​消息​去​哪​」（​两层​守卫​ + durable FIFO，​重启​不​丢​）；​第​ 4/5 ​步​「​怎么​跑​、​怎么​边​跑​边​说​」（​租约​串行化​ + ​流式​只管​展示​）；​第​ 6 ​步​「​回复​怎么​保证​送达​」（​先​记账​后​发送​，at-least-once + ​诚实​标记​）；​第​ 7 ​步​「​写盘​失败​怎么办​」（​内存​重试​队列​ + ​关机​排水​ + ​活跃​ turn ​令牌​）。​把​这​条链​背下来​，gateway/ ​顶层​ 300 ​个​文件​就​不再​是​一团​散沙​。

docs.title: platform_adapters.md —— 26 ​个​平台​插件​与​ Telegram ​适配器​解剖
文件​概览
docs.text: Hermes ​的​真正​平台​适配器​不​在​ gateway/platforms/（​那里​只有​框架​，​见​ platforms_framework.md），​而是​ 26 ​个​插件​：​每个​平台​一个​目录​ plugins/platforms/<name>/，​内含​ adapter.py（​继承​ BasePlatformAdapter）​与​ plugin.yaml，import ​时​经​ ctx.register_platform() ​注册​进​ gateway/platform_registry.py::platform_registry。​本章​给出​ 26 ​个​平台​的​分组​清单​（​每​平台​一行​：​一句​话​特点​ + adapter.py ​路径​），​然后​以​最大​的​原生​适配器​之一​ Telegram ​为例​解剖​一个​ adapter.py ​的​内部结构​（7,385 ​行​，​与​ Discord ​的​ 7,308 ​行​并列​全​仓库​最大​适配器​）。

docs.title: A. ​主流​聊天​平台
docs.text: 平台​ ​目录​ / adapter.py ​一句​话​特点​ Telegram plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py 7,385 ​行​；MarkdownV2、UTF-16 ​计长​、forum topics、​断线​保持​入站​（​本篇​深讲​） Discord plugins/platforms/discord/adapter.py 7,308 ​行​，​最大​适配器​：​语音​混音​/opus、slash ​授权​、​组件​（​按钮​）​授权​、guild scope ​隔离​、​自动​建​ thread Slack plugins/platforms/slack/adapter.py 6,961 ​行​；Block Kit、thread ​水印​、​原生​流式​（draft_stream_is_message，​四条​流式​不​变量​的​主战场​） Matrix plugins/platforms/matrix/adapter.py 3,283 ​行​；E2E ​加密​（Olm/Megolm）、​服务器​ scope Signal plugins/platforms/signal/adapter.py signal-cli ​桥​、UUID ​主键​（user_id_alt ​的​由​来​） LINE plugins/platforms/line/adapter.py 60 ​秒​单次​ reply token ​硬​时限​；_keep_typing ​子​类化​范式​的​出处​（​中途​气泡​ + RequestCache ​状态机​） ​微信​（​个人​） plugins/platforms/weixin/adapter.py ​个人​微信​接入​ ​企业​微信​ plugins/platforms/wecom/adapter.py ​原生​ msgtype "stream" ​流式​（stream consumer ​的​ native ​传输​之一​） QQ（​官方​机器人​） plugins/platforms/qqbot/adapter.py QQ ​官方​开放平台​ ​钉​钉​ plugins/platforms/dingtalk/adapter.py DingTalk AI Cards（REQUIRES_EDIT_FINALIZE ​强制​最终​编辑​的​案例​） ​飞​书​ plugins/platforms/feishu/adapter.py 4,536 ​行​；union_id（user_id_alt）、​卡片​消息​、​长​连接​事件​ iMessage plugins/platforms/bluebubbles/adapter.py ​经​ BlueBubbles ​桥接​ iMessage

docs.text:
平台​ ​目录​ / adapter.py ​一句​话​特点​ WhatsApp（Baileys ​桥​） plugins/platforms/whatsapp/adapter.py ​非官方​桥​；​与​ Cloud API ​共享​ whatsapp_common.py::WhatsAppBehaviorMixin；​桥​按​ profile ​独立​（pid+​端口​+​启动​时间​的​ pidfile ​认领​） WhatsApp Cloud plugins/platforms/whatsapp_cloud/adapter.py Meta ​官方​ Cloud API；​同一​行为​ mixin，​独立​ Platform.* ​枚举​可​并存​ IRC plugins/platforms/irc/adapter.py 619 ​行​；token lock ​的​ canonical ​实现​（acquire_scoped_lock ​防两​ profile ​共享​一个​ nick） Nostr plugins/platforms/buzz/adapter.py 1,966 ​行​；Nostr ​协议​ SimpleX plugins/platforms/simplex/adapter.py ​隐私​优先​消息​协议​ A2A plugins/platforms/a2a/adapter.py agent-to-agent ​协议​面​ Raft plugins/platforms/raft/adapter.py ​广播​面​（​对​ /login ​报​ dm） Photon plugins/platforms/photon/adapter.py 1,758 ​行​；Photon ​接入​

​每个​目录​除​ adapter.py ​外​通常​还有​ plugin.yaml（​声明​ requires_env/optional_env、setup ​提示​）​与​若干​辅助​模块​（​如​ discord ​的​语音​混音​、telegram ​的​ update_admission.py）。

docs.title: 关键​代码​走读​：Telegram ​适配器​解剖
1. ​类​声明​与​能力​自述
docs.text:
# ​来源​：plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py:519-557（​节选​）
class TelegramAdapter(TelegramHeldInboundMixin, TelegramTopicRoutingMixin, BasePlatformAdapter):
    """Telegram bot adapter: users/groups, MarkdownV2 replies, forum topics, media."""

    MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 4096
    supports_code_blocks = True  # MarkdownV2 renders fenced code blocks
    splits_long_messages = True  # send() chunks via truncate_message(MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH)
    RICH_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS = 32768  # Bot API 10.1 rich cap; above it use legacy chunking
    MEDIA_GROUP_WAIT_SECONDS = 0.8
    HELD_INBOUND_MAX = 64  # inbound events held across a disconnect window; oldest dropped first
    # send() can race a disconnect blip; failing "Not connected" (retryable=False) parks the answer in the
    # delivery ledger until next boot, so wait briefly for _bot (or a replacement adapter) instead.
    _RECONNECT_WAIT_SECONDS = 15.0
    ...
    # edit_message applies MarkdownV2 only on finalize=True; without this flag stream_consumer skips
    # the final edit when raw text is unchanged.
    # Fixes #25710.
    REQUIRES_EDIT_FINALIZE: bool = True
    FALLBACK_ON_FINAL_EDIT_FLOOD: bool = True  # retrying a final edit burns the same flood budget

​开头​的​类​属性​是​给​框架​看​的​「​问卷​」：​长度​上限​ 4096、​按​ UTF-16 code units ​计长​（message_len_fn ​返回​ utf16_len，adapter.py:581-584——emoji ​会​占​两个​ UTF-16 ​码元​，​用​ len ​会​超限​）、REQUIRES_EDIT_FINALIZE ​让​ stream consumer ​在​原始​文本​未变​时​也​强制​做​最终​编辑​。​两个​ mixin ​排​在​基类​前面​（WhatsApp ​同款​纪律​）：TelegramHeldInboundMixin ​在​断​连​窗口​内​持有​入站​事件​（​最​多​ 64 ​条​，​最旧​先​丢​），TelegramTopicRoutingMixin ​管​论坛​话题​路由​。_RECONNECT_WAIT_SECONDS ​的​注释​展示​这个​代码​库​的​典型​因果​链​：send ​与​断​连​竞态​ → ​非​ retryable ​失败​ → ​回复​被​投递​账本​扣押​到​下次​启动​ → ​与其​如此​，​不如​短​等​ 15 ​秒​换​重连​的​ bot。

docs.title: 2. ​构造​：update ​收据​要​活过​适配器​替换
docs.text:
# ​来源​：plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py:586-603（​节选​）
    def __init__(self, config: PlatformConfig):
        super().__init__(config, Platform.TELEGRAM)
        extra = self.config.extra
        self._app: Optional[Application] = None
        self._seen_update_ids: dict = {}
        self._inflight_update_ids: dict = {}
        # Completed update IDs survive adapter replacement and restarts (update_admission.py).
        # Resolved now: secondary profiles construct adapters inside their own home scope.
        from hermes_constants import get_hermes_home
        self._update_receipt_dir = get_hermes_home()
        self._update_receipts_loaded: set = set()
        self._update_receipts_dirty: set = set()
        self._update_receipt_flush: Optional[asyncio.Task] = None
        self._bot: Optional[Bot] = None

_seen_update_ids / _inflight_update_ids ​是​ getUpdates ​的​去​重​与​并发​防抖​；​已​完成​的​ update id ​会​落盘​（_update_receipt_dir）——​适配器​被​替换​、​进程​重启​后​，Telegram ​的​同​一批​ update ​不会​被​二次​消费​。get_hermes_home() ​在​构造​时​解析​是​刻意​的​：​次要​ profile ​的​适配器​在​自己​的​ home ​作用域​里​构造​（​这​正是​ Profile scope ​的​「​绑定​点​」​之一​）。

docs.title: 3. ​论坛​话题​：chat_type ​的​归​一​与​建题
docs.text:
Telegram ​的​ forum ​群组​对​网关​是​第五种​ chat_type：

# ​来源​：plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py:809-815
    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_chat_type(chat_type: Any, *, is_forum: bool) -> str:
        """Telegram chat type → gateway chat type (``private``→``dm``, ``supergroup``→forum/group)."""
        ...
            return "forum" if is_forum else "group"

chat_type="forum" ​进入​ SessionSource，​配合​ thread_id（​话题​ id）​参与​ session_key ​派生​；_forum_topic_send_kwargs（:1051）​为​ forum ​与​ DM ​话题​生成​发送​参数​（​注意​ :1110 ​的​注释​：General ​话题​下​ sendChatAction ​仍​必须​带​ message_thread_id ​才能​把​「​正在​输入​」​气泡​放进​ General）。DM ​里​还​能​反向​建题​（create_forum_topic，Bot API 9.4+，:2500）——​这是​ TelegramTopicRoutingMixin ​的​题材​恢复​与​话题​延续​能力​的​底层​。

docs.title: 4. ​事件​上报​路径​（​组装​视角​）
docs.text: Telegram ​适配器​的​入​站​组装​链​：PTB handler ​收​ update → ​去​重​/​在​飞​登记​ → _canonicalize(event.source)（​身份​最先​，​见​ platforms_framework.md）→ _normalize_chat_type + mention ​模式匹配​ + reply_to ​上下文​抓取​ → ​组​ MessageEvent（_group_allow_from ​按​ dm/group ​选​允许​名单​键​，:966）→ handle_message。​出站​链​：send() → MarkdownV2 ​渲染​（​失败​落​ bad_format，​基类​分类器​接手​转纯​文本​重试​）→ ​长度​切块​（splits_long_messages）→ SendResult(message_id=​最后​一块​ id, continuation_message_ids=​全部​块​)。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​每个​适配器​只​依赖​框架​（BasePlatformAdapter + PlatformEntry ​钩子​ + _shared scoped ​读取​），​经​ ctx.register_platform() ​注册​——platforms_framework.md ​是​本篇​的​前置​。
  • ​适配器​的​入​站​事件​最终​都​汇入​ message_flow.md ​的​ 7 ​步​链路​；​流式​行为​（draft/native stream）​与​ streaming.md ​的​消费者​契约​耦合​。
  • ​凭据​唯一​型​适配器​（IRC、Telegram ​等​）​在​ connect ​时取​ acquire_scoped_lock()，​是​ Profile scope「​一个​凭据​只属​一个​ profile」​的​执法​点​。
  • WhatsApp ​桥​的​ pidfile ​认领​（pid+start time+port）​与​ _update_platform_runtime_status ​的​ needs_attention ​写入​点​，​见​ gateway/AGENTS.md § Unserved is reported。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: 26 ​个​插件​适配器​是​「​能力​住​在​边缘​」​的​最​直接​体现​：​核心​（gateway ​框架​）​只​定义​问卷​，​每个​平台​在​插件​里​作答​。​体量​从​ SMS ​的​ 359 ​行到​ Telegram/Discord ​的​ 7,300+ ​行不等​，​但​结构​同构​：​能力​自述​的​类​属性​ → ​构造​期​解析​ profile ​作用域​ → ​入站​归​一​（​身份​最先​）→ ​出站​ SendResult + ​错误​分类​。​平台​ API ​的​怪癖​（UTF-16 ​计长​、60 ​秒​ reply token、forum ​的​ General ​气泡​）​全部​留在​插件​注释​与​测试​里​，​框架​绝不​为​其开​分支​。​想​写​第​ 27 ​个​平台​，​从​ platforms_framework.md ​第​ 6 ​节​的​ ADDING_A_PLATFORM ​摘要​开始​，​抄​ irc/（​最小​完整​示例​）​与​ line/（​子​类化​范式​）。

docs.title: platforms_framework.md —— ​适配器​框架​：BasePlatformAdapter、MessageEvent ​与​平台​注册表
文件​概览
docs.text: ​先​纠正​一个​直觉​错误​：gateway/platforms/（42 ​个​文件​）​不是​各​平台​的​适配器​集合​——​它​是​适配器​框架​加上​ 3 ​个​内置​ HTTP ​平台​。​真正​的​ 26 ​个​聊天​平台​适配器​（Telegram、Discord、Slack……）​都​是​插件​，​住​在​ plugins/platforms/<name>/adapter.py，​在​ import ​时​把​自己​注册​进​ gateway/platform_registry.py::platform_registry；​网关​按​需​实例​化​。​框架​这​一层​提供​的​是​：​所有​适配器​的​公共​基类​与​投递​括号​（base.py）、​归一化​入站​事件​（event.py）、​注册表​（platform_registry.py）、​多路复用​安全​的​ secret/YAML ​读取​（_shared.py）、​媒体​缓存​与​投递​目标​等​横切​设施​。​本篇​清单​覆盖​全部​ 17 ​个​框架​文件​（webhook/msgraph/api_server ​三个​内置​平台​共​ 25 ​个​文件​留给​ builtin_platforms.md）。

docs.title: 1. BasePlatformAdapter：​一个​适配器​要​回答​什么
docs.text:
​基类​的​类​属性​就是​一张​「​能力​自述​表​」，​网关​读​它​来​决定​行为​，​绝不​ if ​平台​名​：

# ​来源​：gateway/platforms/base.py:1809-1856（​节选​）
class BasePlatformAdapter(ABC):
    """Base class for platform adapters: connect/auth, receive, send, handle media."""

    supports_code_blocks: bool = False     # ``` ​渲染​成​真​代码​块​
    supports_status_text: bool = False     # typing ​指示器​渲染​ TEXT（​状态​行​）
    # Can wake a fresh turn AFTER a turn ends (detached-subagent completions); False for stateless
    # adapters (API server). Propagated to ``HERMES_SESSION_ASYNC_DELIVERY`` so tools never promise
    # a delivery they can't keep.
    supports_async_delivery: bool = True
    splits_long_messages: bool = False     # send() ​自​切块​ → ​路由器​跳过​截断​
    typed_command_prefix: str = "/"        # ​客户端​吃掉​开头​ "/" ​的​平台​给​ "!"
    # A human can answer "session restored — what next?"; webhook-style platforms set False so
    # auto-resume finishes the work instead of asking nobody.
    interactive_resume: bool = True
    # Port-binding adapter that answers ``/p/<profile>/...`` for every served profile on the default
    # listener under ``gateway.multiplex_profiles``.
    serves_profile_prefix: bool = False
    # Back-reference to the running ``GatewayRunner`` (set by gateway/run.py); ``build_source``
    # resolves the inbound profile via ``runner._profile_name_for_source``.
    gateway_runner = None

__init__（base.py:1858-1925）​里​藏​着​第一道​忙碌​守卫​的​全部​状态​：_active_sessions（session_key → interrupt Event）、_pending_messages（​忙碌​期待​处理​）、_requeue_counts（​弹回​退避​，#123229）、_post_delivery_callbacks（​投递​后​一次性​回调​，​带​ generation ​防​陈旧​ run ​清掉​新​ run ​的​回调​）。​注意​两个​「runner ​事后​安装​」​的​字​段​——_busy_text_mode ​和​ _human_delay_range_ms——​注释​明说​构造​期读​进程​ env ​会​把​启动​ profile ​的​值​冻进​每个​ profile ​的​适配器​（#116893/#116895），​这是​ Profile scope ​在​框架​层​的​落点​。

​抽象​/​半​抽象​接口​很窄​：connect() / disconnect()（​连接​与​令牌​锁​）、send()（​返回​ SendResult）、stop_typing()；​辅以​一组​可​覆盖​的​呈现​钩子​（format_message、format_tool_event、render_message_event）。​每个​适配器​还要​选​一个​基础​ toolset（Telegram → "messaging"）。

​凭据​作用域​锁​是​接口​的​一部分​（gateway/AGENTS.md § Token locks）：​用​唯一​凭据​连接​的​适配器​在​ connect()/start() ​里调​ gateway.status.acquire_scoped_lock()、​断开​时​释放​，​两个​ profile ​就​永远​不能​共享​同一个​ bot token。canonical ​实现​见​ plugins/platforms/irc/adapter.py。​基类​的​ _acquire_platform_lock（base.py:2143）​是​封装​层​。

docs.title: 2. SendResult ​与​发送​错误​分类
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/platforms/base.py:1596-1611
class SendResult:
    """Result of sending a message."""
    success: bool
    message_id: Optional[str] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    # Adapter-specific metadata. Contracts: raw_response["partial_overflow"] (Telegram edit-overflow
    # partial: the stream consumer sends the missing tail); raw_response["failure_notice_sent"] ...
    raw_response: Any = None
    retryable: bool = False  # transient connection error — base retries automatically
    retry_after: Optional[float] = None  # server-requested delay (Telegram FloodWait) beats our backoff
    # Extra ids (send order) when a payload was split; ``message_id`` is then the LAST id so
    # later edits target the newest chunk.
    continuation_message_ids: tuple = ()
    # SEND_ERROR_KINDS member (failures only) via :func:`classify_send_error`, so consumers
    # branch without substring-matching ``error``.
    error_kind: Optional[str] = None

error_kind ​是​七值​封闭​枚举​（SEND_ERROR_KINDS，base.py:1623：too_long / bad_format / forbidden / not_found / rate_limited / transient / unknown），​由表​驱动​的​ _SEND_ERROR_CLASSIFIERS（:1648）​从​异常​文本​里​分类​——​消费​方​按类​分支​，​不​做​子串​匹配​。not_found ​还要​再​分​「​整个​聊天​没​了​」​与​「​只是​子​聊天​没​了​」（is_chat_level_not_found，:1669）：​只有​前者​允许​把​目标​标记​为​死​。retry_after ​与​ classify_send_error ​一起​支撑​ delivery_ledger ​的​ flood ​策略​（​见​ message_flow.md ​第​ 6 ​步​）。

docs.title: 3. send_final_ledgered：​投递​括号
docs.text: ​每个​最终​回复​都​过​ send_final_ledgered（base.py:4281，​走读​见​ message_flow.md ​第​ 6 ​步​）：​在​当前​ transport ​上​先记​投递​义务​、​发送​重试​、​按​结果​结账​，​返回​的​二元​组​里​带上​真正​完成​发送​的​ adapter——message_id ​的​所有权​（​后续​ edit、ephemeral ​删除​）​归​它​。​同一​括号​还​负责​释放​崩溃​恢复​的​ turn marker（_release_turn_marker，:4306）：​账本​一旦​接管​恢复​义务​，durable ​活跃​标记​就​该​撤​了​。

docs.title: 4. MessageEvent：​归一化​的​入​站​形状
docs.text:
event.py ​是​叶子​模块​（adapters、helpers、runner ​都​ import ​它​，​所以​它​不许​ import ​回​ gateway.platforms.*）。MessageType ​枚举​九类​（text/location/photo/video/audio/voice/document/sticker/command）；MessageEvent ​的​字​段​纪律​与​安全​属性​（internal、allow_gateway_control、ledger_message_id、reply_anchor_override）​已​在​ message_flow.md ​第​ 1 ​步​走读​。​这里​补​两个​容易​漏​的​方法​：

  • is_command() / get_command()（event.py:176-186）：​先​剥掉​ Desktop ​的​ @image:/@file: ​附件​引用​前缀​（_ATTACHMENT_REF_RE）​再​识别​斜杠​，​文件​路径​形式​的​假​命令​（​含​ /）​直接​判​ None。
  • absorb_reply_expected() / extend_media()（:150-163）：​照片​连发​合并​成​一条​事件​时​，​寻址​标志​按​「addressed ​优先​、unknown ​次之​」​吸收​，​附件​按​平行​数组​拼装​。

docs.title: 5. platform_registry：​插件​自​注册
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/platform_registry.py:42-58（​节选​）
@dataclass
class PlatformEntry:
    """Metadata and factory for a single platform adapter."""

    name: str  # config.yaml identifier (e.g. "irc")
    label: str  # human-readable
    adapter_factory: Callable[[Any], Any]  # PlatformConfig -> adapter (factory allows custom init)
    # PASSIVE dependency probe (deps importable RIGHT NOW); must be side-effect free since it
    # runs from status displays and the config enablement pass, which may never pip-install.
    check_fn: Callable[[], bool]
    ...
    # ACTIVE dependency installer: make the platform's dependencies available, installing them
    # (pm.sync_venv) if needed. ... Called by ``create_adapter()`` when ``check_fn`` returns False.
    ensure_deps_fn: Optional[Callable[[], bool]] = None

check_fn ​与​ ensure_deps_fn ​拆成​两个​字段​是​一段​血泪史​（#79812，registry ​注释​整段​保留​）：​曾经​把​主动​安装​器​注册​成​ check_fn，​结果​每个​状态​展示​页​都​顺手​ pip install（​桌面​端​ 94% ​死循环​）；​换成​被动​探针​，create_adapter() ​又​提前​返回​ None，​依赖​永远​装不上​（Teams ​死锁​）。​拆开​后​两个​调用​点​各自​正确​。​插件​侧经​ PluginContext.register_platform() ​注册​；​网关​侧​ GatewayRunner._create_adapter() ​先查​注册表​、​再​走​遗留​内置​路径​——​没有​任何​ if platform == ​链​。​其余​字​段​同样​是​声明​式​钩子​：apply_yaml_config_fn（YAML→env ​桥​，​必须​用​ _shared.apply_yaml_bridge ​造​，​手写​ os.environ[...] = ​会​ first-profile-wins）、trusted_inbound（​事件​总线​类​平台​跳过​允许​名单​；​注释​警告​：​聊天​平台​永远​不许​设它​）、standalone_sender_fn（​无共驻​网关​的​ cron ​投递​）​等​。

docs.title: 6. ADDING_A_PLATFORM.md ​摘要
docs.text:
​加新​平台​的​推荐​路径​是​插件​：​在​ plugins/platforms/（​或​ ~/.hermes/plugins/）​建​目录​，​写​ plugin.yaml + adapter.py（​继承​ BasePlatformAdapter，​在​ register(ctx) ​里​ ctx.register_platform()），​核心​代码​零​改动​。​要点​：

  • env ​使能​钩子​：env_enablement_fn ​用​ _shared.seed_extra_from_env ​建表​驱动​（​所有​读取​过​ _shared.get_scoped_secret，​多路复用​安全​，​绝不​ os.getenv）。
  • YAML ​桥​：apply_yaml_config_fn ​声明​ (yaml_key, ENV_VAR, kind) ​表​，​交​ _shared.apply_yaml_bridge——​只​在​未​设置​时写​ env（env > YAML），​且​从不​在​次要​ profile ​作用域​下写​。
  • ​平台​特有​ UX ​用子​类化​而​非​扩核​：LINE ​的​ 60 ​秒​单次​ reply token ​这类​硬​时限​，​覆盖​ _keep_typing ​叠加​中途​气泡​、​务必​ await super()._keep_typing(...)，finally ​里​拆​自己​的​任务​（​完整​范式​见​ plugins/platforms/line/）。
  • ​同​平台​双​传输​共享​行为​ mixin：WhatsApp ​的​ Baileys ​桥​与​ Cloud API ​两个​适配器​共用​ whatsapp_common.py::WhatsAppBehaviorMixin（​门控​、​允许​名单​、mention ​解析​、WhatsApp ​风味​ markdown）；mixin ​必须​放在​基类​前面​（class WhatsAppAdapter(Mixin, BasePlatformAdapter)），​它​的​ format_message ​才能​覆盖​基类​默认​。​两个​适配器​注册​不同​的​ Platform.* ​枚举​值​，​网关​可​同时​跑​两套​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 符号​ ​位置​ ​职责​ BasePlatformAdapter platforms/base.py:1809 ​适配器​基类​：​能力​自述​属性​、​忙碌​守卫​状态​、​投递​括号​、​呈现​钩子​ SendResult platforms/base.py:1596 ​发送​结果​（message_id、retryable、error_kind、continuation ids） classify_send_error() platforms/base.py:1662 ​表​驱动​错误​分类​，​未​识别​一律​ unknown（​不​误判​为​良性​） send_final_ledgered() platforms/base.py:4281 ​记账​→​发送​→​结账​的​投递​括号​，​返回​真正​发送​的​ adapter MessageEvent / MessageType platforms/event.py:66/46 ​归一入​站​事件​与​九类​消息​类型​ PlatformEntry platform_registry.py:42 ​注册表​条目​：factory、check_fn（​被动​）、ensure_deps_fn（​主动​）、​声明​式​钩子​ register() / create_adapter() platform_registry.py ​插件​自​注册​；​网关​按名​实例​化​ get_scoped_secret() platforms/_shared.py ​唯一​的​ scoped ​凭据​读取​实现​（​适配器​里​ import ​为​ _get_scoped_secret） apply_yaml_bridge() platforms/_shared.py YAML→env ​桥​：​只​在​未​设置​时写​，​多路复用​下次​要​ profile ​永不​写​ env CachedMedia platforms/base.py:1444 ​下载​媒体​的​缓存​条目​与​ context ​注记​ ExecApprovalPrompt platforms/base.py:1574 ​命令​审批​提示​的​呈现​形状

docs.title: A. ​框架​核心​（gateway/platforms/）
docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ base.py BasePlatformAdapter、SendResult、SendResult ​错误​分类​、​媒体​缓存​函数​、​投递​括号​ event.py MessageEvent/MessageType/ProcessingOutcome（​叶子​模块​） _shared.py get_scoped_secret / extra_or_secret / seed_extra_from_env / env_is_connected / platform_gate_env / apply_yaml_bridge _http_client_limits.py ​出站​ HTTP ​客户端​的​超时​/​体积​上限​ helpers.py ​去​重​、markdown ​转换​、typing ​元​数据​等​适配器​助手​ access_policy_mixin.py ​访问​策略​ mixin（​允许​名单​/​群​策略​的​组合​件​） media_cache.py ​入站​/​出站​媒体​缓存​目录​与​清理​ send_targets.py ​发送​目标​解析​助手​ docker_media_paths.py Docker ​沙箱​路径​到​宿主​路径​的​媒体​翻译​ tcp_site.py ​端口​绑​定型​适配器​的​ TCP ​站点​辅助​（webhook/api_server ​共用​） shared_ingress.py ​多路复用​下次​要​ profile ​共享​默认​监听器​（/p//） base_exec_approval.py ​命令​审批​提示​的​基类​逻辑​ base_log_safety.py ​日志​脱敏​基类​逻辑​ base_post_delivery.py ​投递​后​一次性​回调​的​基类​逻辑​ base_streaming_tts.py ​流式​ TTS ​适配器​基类​（​配合​ streaming_tts_consumer） whatsapp_common.py WhatsAppBehaviorMixin：Baileys ​桥​与​ Cloud API ​共享​的​行为​ ADDING_A_PLATFORM.md ​加​平台​ step-by-step ​指南​（​本篇​第​ 6 ​节​的​摘要​来源​） __init__.py ​包​标记

docs.title: B. ​网关​侧​的​注册​与​插件​接线
docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ platform_registry.py PlatformEntry + ​注册表​ + create_adapter（check/ensure ​双字​段​设计​） platform_activation.py ​平台​启用​/​依赖​就绪​判定​（​配合​注册表​） platform_env.py ​平台​环境变量​目录​（setup ​展示​） plugin_command_choice.py ​插件​命令​与​内置​命令​同名​时​的​仲裁​ plugin_keyless_inject.py ​无​密钥​插件​的​注入​ plugin_messages.py ​插件​消息​辅助

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• plugins/platforms/（26 ​个​适配器​）​是​本​框架​最大​的​消费者​：​它们​只​依赖​ BasePlatformAdapter + PlatformEntry + _shared，​通过​ ctx.register_platform() ​注册​，​经​ plugin_api.json ​边界​访问​核心​（scripts/boundary_lint.py ​拦截​越界​）。
  • GatewayRunner（run_adapters.py）​经​注册表​实例​化​适配器​、​安装​ runner ​侧​ handler（busy ​文本​模式​、human delay、​授权​回调​），​并​把​ intake/delivery ​两个​适配器​缝​接进​ authz。
  • 3 ​个​内置​ HTTP ​平台​（webhook、msgraph、api_server）​直接​住​在​本​目录​，​因为​它们​不​依赖​任何​外部​ SDK——​见​ builtin_platforms.md。
  • relay/ ​的​ RelayAdapter ​也​继承​ BasePlatformAdapter，​但​把​能力​声明​全部​换成​了​握手​协商​的​ CapabilityDescriptor——​见​ relay.md。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​框架​层​的​全部​设计​都​指向​一句​话​：​让​「​加​一个​平台​」​不​需要​动​核心​。​适配器​用类​属性​自述​能力​（​网关​读​属性​，​不​做​平台​分支​）；​用​ PlatformEntry ​的​声明​式​钩子​自述​依赖​与​配置​（​被动​探针​与​主动​安装​器​分离​，​两个​调用​点​各自​正确​）；​用​ _shared ​的​ scoped ​读取​自述​凭据​来源​（​多路复用​下​永远​不会​读错​ profile）。​少数​必须​共享​的​协议​行为​（WhatsApp ​双​传输​）​下沉​为​ mixin ​且​强制​排​在​基类​前面​。​读完​本篇​再​去​读​任何​一个​ plugins/platforms/*/adapter.py，​都​会​发现​它​只是​在​回答​同​一张​问卷​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
gateway/relay/（13 ​个​文件​，​全部​标注​ EXPERIMENTAL）​实现​一条​实验性​通道​：​把​「​每个​平台​一个​适配器​」​的​模型​换成​一个​通用​ RelayAdapter。​外部​ connector（​例如​ Hermes Cloud ​的​ Team Gateway）​拥有​真实​平台​的​ bot（Telegram/Discord/Slack token ​在​它​手里​），​网关​通过​ WebSocket ​主动​拨​出​与其​相连​；connector ​把​平台​消息​转发给​网关​、​网关​把​回复​转回​。​激活​方式​：​设置​ GATEWAY_RELAY_URL（​或​ gateway.relay_url）——​此时​ gateway/config_env.py::_relay ​会​关闭​所有​直连​适配器​（​该​部署​根本​配不出​自己​的​ bot）。​本篇​用​一张​ ASCII ​说明​三方​拓扑​，​然后​走读​ RelayAdapter、CapabilityDescriptor ​握手​、egress ​授权​、​账号​ linking ​与​生产​传输​。

        Hermes ​实例​ (gateway)                 connector (​拥有​真实​ bot)              ​平台​
┌─────────────────────────────┐  WS (​网关​拨​出​)  ┌──────────────────────┐   Bot API   ┌──────────┐
│ RelayAdapter (Platform.RELAY)│◀──────────────▶│ Team Gateway/Cloud    │◀──────────▶│ Telegram │
│  hello → descriptor ​握手​     │  hello/inbound  │  · ​平台​ token、​租户​    │◀──────────▶│ Discord  │
│  outbound/inbound_ack …      │  outbound/result│  · egress ​授权​地板​     │◀──────────▶│ Slack …  │
└─────────────────────────────┘  passthrough    └──────────────────────┘            └──────────┘
   ​直连​适配器​全部​关闭​ (config_env._relay)          ​一个​ connector ​可​服务​多​实例​

​为什么​值得​一条​独立​通道​：​社区​/​托管​部署​配不起​自己​的​ bot（​没有​服务器​、​不想​管​ token），​或者​平台​侧​只​允许​一个​租户​ bot；connector ​把​「​连接​平台​」​变成​服务​，​网关​把​「​理解​消息​」​留在​实例​侧​——​信任​边界​由​帧​协议​与​ egress ​授权​显式​划定​。

docs.title: 1. RelayAdapter：​一个​适配器​顶​ N ​个​平台
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/relay/adapter.py:116-133（​节选​）
class RelayAdapter(RelayDiscordInteractionMixin, BasePlatformAdapter):
    """Generic relay adapter advertising a connector-negotiated capability profile."""

    # Connector egress splits against negotiated max_message_length, so the
    # gateway-level cap must not pre-truncate relay deliveries.
    splits_long_messages = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: PlatformConfig,
        descriptor: CapabilityDescriptor,
        transport: Optional[RelayTransport] = None,
    ) -> None:
        # Fronts many platforms but presents to the runner as Platform.RELAY.
        super().__init__(config, Platform.RELAY)
        self._transport = transport
        self._apply_descriptor(descriptor)
        # Per-chat egress routing caches learned from inbound events (send() only
        # receives a chat_id). The connector's egress guard resolves the owning tenant
        # from OUTBOUND metadata.scope_id / user_id, so we re-attach what we saw
        # inbound (_capture_scope).
        self._scope_by_chat: dict[str, str] = {}
        ...
        # chat_id -> UNDERLYING platform ("discord", ...): one adapter fronts N
        # platforms on one WS and a reply must egress through the platform the
        # inbound came from. Empty for a single-platform gateway (connector default).
        self._platform_by_chat: dict[str, str] = {}
        # chat_id -> Hermes profile the connector routed the inbound to (multiplex mode). Echoed
        # on every outbound frame's metadata so the connector can stamp the SAME profile on the
        # next passthrough_forward for that chat; empty on a single-profile gateway.
        self._profile_by_chat: dict[str, str] = {}

​设计​核心​是​「​每个​ chat ​学​一条​路由​缓存​」：send() ​只​拿​得到​ chat_id，​但​ connector ​的​租户​判定​需要​ scope_id/user_id/​底层​平台​/​路由​ profile——​全部​从入​站​事件​里​捕获​（_capture_scope），​出站​时​回贴​到​ metadata。_profile_by_chat ​的​回声​是​ Profile scope ​在​ relay ​上​的​形态​：_with_scope（adapter.py:1119）​把​路由​ profile ​盖​在​每​一帧​出站​ metadata ​上​，follow_up ​从​ key ​命名​空间​推导​它​，connector ​下​一次​ passthrough_forward ​就​盖​同一个​章​。​能力​一律​来自​握手​协商​的​ descriptor（_descriptor_for_chat、max_message_length_for_chat ​全部​查表​），adapter ​自己​不​做​平台​分支​——Slack ​的​特例​也​走​ _slack_flag/_relay_slack_extra ​这​类​「connector ​报告​的​开关​」。​流式​侧​维护​「​开启​中​的​ draft」​与​「​已​封缄​ draft」​两张​表​（_open_draft_by_chat/_sealed_draft_by_chat），​把​ stream-is-the-message ​契约​落到​帧​上​（​封缄​墓碑​与​ connector ​侧​镜像​，​防​迟到​的​帧​重开​已​封缄​流​）。

docs.title: 2. CapabilityDescriptor：​握手​即​能力​契约
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/relay/descriptor.py:17-58（​节选​）
# Bump additively (never reinterpret an existing field); a breaking change
# requires updating both repos in lockstep.
CONTRACT_VERSION = 1


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CapabilityDescriptor:
    """Immutable capability profile negotiated at relay handshake (frozen: fixed for the connection)."""

    contract_version: int
    platform: str
    label: str
    max_message_length: int
    supports_draft_streaming: bool
    supports_edit: bool
    supports_threads: bool
    markdown_dialect: str
    len_unit: str  # "chars" | "utf16"
    ...
    # Outbound op names the connector implements for this platform. Empty = the
    # connector predates the field; callers MUST treat that as LEGACY_OPS, not
    # "nothing supported". Tuple keeps the frozen dataclass hashable.
    supported_ops: tuple = ()

    # Assumed capability set when a legacy connector sends no supported_ops.
    LEGACY_OPS = ("send", "edit", "typing", "follow_up")

    def supports_op(self, op: str) -> bool:
        """Whether the connector advertises ``op`` (legacy set when none advertised).

        A NEW op is therefore only True when explicitly advertised — capability
        can be probed without trying the op and parsing an error."""
        return op in (self.supported_ops or self.LEGACY_OPS)

connector ​在​握手​时​交出​一份​冻结​的​ capability ​档案​：​它​替​哪个​平台​出头​、​字数​上限​、draft/edit/thread、markdown ​方言​、​计长​单位​（Telegram ​类​平台​报​ utf16）。from_json ​的​信任​边界​规范化​值得注意​：​垃圾​的​ max_message_length ​映射​到​文档​化​的​ 4096 ​默认值​，supported_ops ​变成​非空​字符串​元组​——​畸形​输入​永远​不​破坏​握手​。schema ​演进​只许​加法​（​新字​段​默认​ False/​空​，​旧​ connector ​对​旧​网关​安全​）；supports_op ​的​默认​ LEGACY_OPS ​让​「​没报​ ops」​读作​旧​集合​而​不是​「​全不​支持​」，​新​ op ​则​必须​显式​广告​——​能力​探测​不用​试错​。

docs.title: 3. egress.py：​出口​授权​（P5）
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/relay/egress.py:1-20（​节选​）
"""Gateway-side relay EGRESS AUTHORIZATION (P5).

Two halves of one security surface, kept together because they are the same
concern seen from both ends of the wire:

**(a) Target hygiene.** The ``send_message`` model tool takes a free-form
``target`` string (``'platform:chat_id'``). Nothing stopped a model from
naming an arbitrary chat id and having the gateway emit an outbound frame for
it. The connector now refuses such a frame (its egress-authorization floor),
but the gateway must not *silently* ask: a destination the gateway has no
record of is refused HERE, with a visible tool error naming the target.
:func:`authorize_relay_target` is that guard; :func:`attested_relay_targets`
is the set of destinations this gateway can show a provenance for (operator
home channel, channel directory, its own gateway session origins).

**(b) Decline visibility.** The connector answers an unauthorized destination
with a DEFINITE, non-ambiguous failure whose text is deliberately UNIFORM
(``"<platform> egress declined: target is not an approved destination for
this connection"``) — it must not leak whether the destination belongs to
another tenant or to nobody. :func:`is_egress_decline` recognises THAT a
decline happened; it never tries to parse WHY. Egress lanes that legitimately
degrade a *transport drop* (advisory progress, cosmetic reactions, media
falling back to a text notice) must NOT degrade a decline — a refusal that
turns into a different op, or into a wrong "op unavailable" reason, is a
security event laundered into an apparent success."""

​两半​合​起来​才​是​完整​的​安全​面​：​网关​侧​目标​卫生​（​模型​不能​凭空​指​一个​ chat_id ​就让​网关​发帧​——​无​出处​记录​的​目标​在​网关​就​拒​，​工具​报错​点名​目标​），connector ​侧​是​授权​地板​（​网关​漏问​它​也​拒​）。EGRESS_DECLINE_CODE = "egress_declined"（:30）​是​结构化​拒绝​的​首选​信号​；​兜底​匹配​那句​刻意​单一化​的​拒绝​文本​——​只​识别​「​发生​了​拒绝​」，​绝不​解析​「​为什么​拒​」（​不​泄漏​目标​属于​别的​租户​还是​不​存在​，finding F-005）。​最​锋利​的​一条​规则​在​结尾​：​可以​把​「​传输​丢包​」​降级​的​通知​/​表情​/​媒体​通道​，​不许​把​「​拒绝​」​降级​——​拒绝​被​洗成​另​一种​ op ​或​「op ​不可​用​」​就是​安全事件​伪装​成功​。

docs.title: 4. link.py ​与​ ws_transport.py：​账号​绑定​与​生产​传输
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/relay/link.py:1-8（​节选​）
"""Account linking to the shared Team Gateway bot, done from the instance itself.

A relay-fronted deployment (Hermes Cloud with Team Gateway) reaches Telegram, Discord and Slack
only through the connector's SHARED bot: the gateway turns every direct adapter off
(``config_env._relay``), and the connector routes a chat account's messages to this instance once
that account is linked (``/link <code>`` DMed to the shared bot). The Portal can mint those codes;
this module lets the instance's own dashboard and Desktop do it too ..."""

linking ​解决​「​共享​ bot ​上​谁​的​消息​归​谁​」：​用户​把​ /link <code> ​发给​共享​ bot，connector ​据此​把​该​账号​路由​到​实例​。code ​由​ per-gateway secret ​铸造​（secret ​只活​在​网关​进程​，self_provision_relay），dashboard ​经​控制​ socket ​的​ relay-link ​动词​取​；Portal ​托管​的​ agent ​是​例外​——​实例​铸​的​ code ​无​ owner，​绑定​必须​在​ Portal ​完成​。

# ​来源​：gateway/relay/ws_transport.py:1-7（​节选​）
"""Production WebSocket RelayTransport — the gateway's live link to the connector.

The gateway dials OUT to the connector's relay endpoint and speaks the
newline-delimited JSON frame protocol of ``website/docs/developer-guide/relay-connector-contract.md``:
gateway -> connector: hello, outbound, interrupt, going_idle, inbound_ack;
connector -> gateway: descriptor, inbound, outbound_result, interrupt_inbound,
going_idle_ack, passthrough_forward. Outbound calls block on a per-request future
keyed by ``requestId`` until the matching ``outbound_result``; a background reader
pumps inbound frames to the registered handler. EXPERIMENTAL schema."""

​帧​协议​是​对称​的​ 11 ​种​帧​；​出站​调用​按​ requestId ​挂​ future ​等​ outbound_result（30 ​秒​超时​），​后台​ reader ​把​ inbound ​泵​给​ handler。WS ​升级​鉴权​在​ auth.py：Authorization: Bearer make_upgrade_token(gateway_id, secret)，​线​字节​必须​与​ connector ​的​ TypeScript ​实现​完全一致​（base64url(f"{payload}:{exp}:{sig}")，HMAC-SHA256，TTL 300 ​秒​，connector ​侧​支持​多​密钥​轮换​）。inbound_admission.py ​决定​ ACK ​时机​：​接纳​在​ socket reader ​之外​的​ task ​里​跑​、​同​ chat ​的​接纳​按​到达​顺序​串行​，​帧​在​接纳​返回​（​或​其​返回​的​ task ​完成​）​时才​ ACK——​接纳​过程​可能​还​需要​ adapter.send()（​忙碌​确认​、prompt ​卡片​），​而​它​的​ outbound_result ​只有​那个​ reader ​能​送​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 符号​ ​位置​ ​职责​ RelayAdapter relay/adapter.py:116 ​通用​适配器​：descriptor ​能力​、per-chat ​路由​缓存​、draft ​墓碑​ CapabilityDescriptor relay/descriptor.py:20 ​冻结​握手​契约​：​平台​、​上限​、draft/edit/thread、ops；​加法​式​演进​ RelayTransport（Protocol） relay/transport.py:27 ​线​协议​面​：connect/handshake/send/inbound ​注册​ WebSocketRelayTransport relay/ws_transport.py ​生产​传输​：11 ​种​帧​、requestId future、 teardown ​预算​ sign() / make_token() relay/auth.py WS ​升级​ bearer（HMAC-SHA256，​与​ connector ​字节​级​一致​） authorize_relay_target() relay/egress.py ​出站​目标​卫生​（​有​出处​的​目标​集​之外​拒绝​） is_egress_decline() relay/egress.py ​识别​「​被​拒​」；​永不​解析​原因​ admit_relay_delivery() relay/inbound_admission.py ​接纳​即​ ACK：​按​ chat ​串行​的​接纳​ lane MediaClient.download()/upload() relay/media.py ​媒体​按​引用​传输​：re-host URL ↔ ​本地​文件​ _discord_interaction_to_event() relay/adapter_discord_interaction.py ​转发​的​ Discord interaction → MessageEvent build_manifest() relay/command_manifest.py hello ​帧​上​的​ Discord slash ​清单​（​与​原生​树​镜像​）

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ __init__.py ​包​标记​ adapter.py RelayAdapter ​主体​（2,305 ​行​）：​能力​应用​、scope ​捕获​、draft ​表​、​红​撤​监控​ adapter_discord_interaction.py ​转发​的​ Discord interaction → MessageEvent ​归一​ auth.py WS ​升级​ token（HMAC、TTL、​多​密钥​轮换​兼容​） command_manifest.py hello ​帧​上​的​ slash ​命令​清单​（​连接器​侧​幂​等​注册​） descriptor.py CapabilityDescriptor：​握手​契约​、CONTRACT_VERSION、​信任​边界​规范化​ egress.py P5 ​出口​授权​：​目标​卫生​ + ​拒绝​可见​性​ http_diagnostics.py ​网关​→connector HTTP ​路由​的​非​ 2xx ​归因​（​识别​代理​的​ 403 ​页​） inbound_admission.py ​接纳​ lane：​同​ chat ​串行​、ACK ​绑​接纳​完成​ link.py /link <code> ​账号​绑定​（​实例​侧​铸造​ code、Portal ​托管​例外​） media.py ​媒体​面​客户端​：​按​引用​传输​（download/upload） transport.py RelayTransport ​协议​面​（​生产​ WS + ​测试​内存​桩​共用​） ws_transport.py WebSocketRelayTransport：​帧​协议​、requestId future、​断开​排水

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• RelayAdapter ​继承​ BasePlatformAdapter ​但​不​做​平台​分支​——​所有​能力​问题​查​ descriptor；​这​与​ platforms_framework.md ​的​「​能力​自述​」​哲学​同源​，​只是​答案​从类​属性​换成​了​握手​。
  • ​入站​经​ inbound_admission.py ​进​ message_flow.md ​的​同​一条​接纳​链​（SessionAuthority durable FIFO）；SessionSource.delivered_via_upstream_relay（wire ​不​可见​）​标记​「​经​认证​ WS ​而​来​」，authz ​据此​键控​上游​信任​。
  • Profile scope ​的​ relay ​面​：_with_scope ​每帧​回声​路由​ profile、follow_up ​从​ key ​命名​空间​推导​、parked profile ​的​帧​ ACK ​且​拒收​（ParkedProfileRefusal——ACK ​门控​的​排水​不能​被​ withheld ​卡死​）。
  • config_env._relay ​激活​时​关闭​直连​适配器​，​是​ run.md ​配置​组里​最​特殊​的​一个​开关​。
  • ​共享​ ingress ​平台​（Relay）​只​跑​在​默认​ profile；​次要​ profile ​启用​会​被​记录​ remedy（gateway/AGENTS.md § Unserved is reported）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: relay ​是​把​「​平台​连接​」​外​包​出去​的​完整​协议​面​：​一个​ RelayAdapter ​顶​ N ​个​平台​、​能力​靠​握手​冻结​、​路由​靠​ per-chat ​缓存​学习​、​身份​靠​每​帧​回声​。​它​的​安全​设计​值得​单独​记​：​两端​各有​一道​授权​（​网关​的​目标​卫生​ + connector ​的​授权​地板​），​拒绝​信号​刻意​单一化​且​永不​降级​，​能力​探测​靠​显式​ ops ​广告​而​非​试错​。​线​协议​（11 ​帧​、requestId future、​接纳​即​ ACK）​与​媒体​按​引用​传输​则​说明​「​实验性​」​只是​ schema ​演进​策略​的​标注​，​不是​工程质量​的​豁免​——​每个​对端​字​段​不​匹配​、​代理​误判​、ACK ​时序​的​角落​都​有​编号​的​思考​。

docs.title: gateway/run.py —— ​网关​进程​的​启动​、​门面​与​关闭
文件​概览
docs.text: gateway/run.py（5,204 ​行​）​是​网关​的​门面​：​模块​ docstring ​自述​ "Gateway runner — entry point for messaging platform integrations"，​对外​暴露​ start_gateway()（​进程​生命周期​，​实现​在​ gateway/run_bootstrap.py）​和​ GatewayRunner（​控制器​类​，​实现​在​ 19 ​个​ mixin ​里​）。​真正​的​ main() ​做​的​是​「​进程​级​」​的​事​：​进程​身份​注册​、​启动​看门狗​、UTF-8 stdio、venv ​同步​——​都​是​「​让​这个​进程​活​得​健康​、​死得​干净​」​的​工程​，​而​消息​怎么​跑​那​是​ mixin ​的​事​。​本篇​同时​覆盖​ gateway ​顶层​的​进程​生命周期​组​（​引导​、​多​ profile ​装配​、​关闭​排水​、​状态​可​观测​、​控制​面​、​托管​房间​、​看​板​ watcher）​约​ 80 ​个​文件​。

docs.title: 1. main()：​先​保证​「​进程​」​健康​，​再谈​「​服务​」
docs.text:
main() ​的​第一步​不是​加载​配置​，​而是​拒绝​解析​失败​的​ config（​宁可​退​不​出来​也​不能​带​着​半​猜​的​默认值​启动​），​然后​按​固定​顺序​执行​四个​ best-effort ​的​进程​级​步骤​：

# ​来源​：gateway/run.py:5072-5101（​节选​）
def main():
    """CLI entry point for the gateway."""
    # Before any config-dependent startup (watchdog, DB opens, provider resolution).
    _guard_corrupt_user_config()
    from hermes_cli.resource_limits import apply_malloc_arena_max  # runs before any thread (glibc latches)
    os.environ.setdefault("AI_AGENT", "hermes-agent")
    os.environ.setdefault("HERMES_AGENT", "true")

    def _register_identity() -> None:
        # Ledger registration + Windows job-object attach so update-time reapers can identify this gateway.
        from hermes_cli.process_identity import attach_self_to_kill_on_close_job, register_self
        register_self("gateway")
        attach_self_to_kill_on_close_job()

    def _arm_watchdog() -> None:
        # Armed before config load / DB opens so a pre-loop deadlock is respawned by the supervisor instead
        # of wedging as a live-PID zombie. GatewayRunner disarms it.
        from hermes_startup_watchdog import arm_startup_watchdog
        arm_startup_watchdog()

    def _utf8_stdio() -> None:
        # Windows: gateway logs and banner would UnicodeEncodeError on cp1252 consoles. No-op on POSIX.
        from hermes_cli.stdio import configure_windows_stdio
        configure_windows_stdio()

    for _step in (apply_malloc_arena_max, _register_identity, _arm_watchdog, _utf8_stdio):
        _best_effort(_step)

​顺序​是​有​讲究​的​：apply_malloc_arena_max ​必须​在​任何​线程​启动​前​跑​（glibc ​会​在​第一个​线程​上​锁死​ arena ​设置​）；​看门狗​必须​在​配置​加载​/DB ​打开​之前​武装​——「​启动​早期​死锁​」​是​最难​排查​的​僵尸​形态​，​让​监督者​直接​重新​拉起​比​挂​着​一个​活​ PID ​强​。​进程​身份​注册​（hermes_cli/process_identity.py + Windows job object）​让​ hermes update ​的​收割​器能​认出​「​这是​网关​」，​而​不是​误杀​别的​ Python ​进程​。​随后​是​ PM ​的​ venv ​同步​检查​与​ post-update bootstrap，​再进​ asyncio.run(start_gateway(config))。

docs.title: 2. ​退出​必须​「​防​卡死​」：os._exit ​后门
docs.text:
start_gateway() ​自己​完成​全部​优雅​拆除​（​适配器​断​连​、​会话​保存​、SQLite ​关闭​、cron/MCP ​停止​、PID ​文件​与​运行​时锁​释放​），​但​ main() ​仍然​在​它​返回​或​抛​ SystemExit ​之后​强制​硬​退出​：

# ​来源​：gateway/run.py:5139-5155（​节选​）
    try:
        success = asyncio.run(start_gateway(config))
        exit_code = 0 if success else 1
    except SystemExit as e:
        exit_code = 0 if e.code is None else e.code if isinstance(e.code, int) else 1
    _exit_after_graceful_shutdown(exit_code)

​原因​写​在​ run.py:5142-5150 ​的​注释​里​：​解释器​正常​退出​会​ Py_FinalizeEx join ​所有​非​ daemon ​线程​——​一个​卡死​在​无​超时​ LLM ​调用​上​的​ worker ​线程​能​把​已经​拆除​一半​的​网关​永远​吊住​，​监督者​没法​重启​它​（#53107）。​所以​ _exit_after_graceful_shutdown（run.py:5158）​显式​做​了​本该​由​ atexit ​做​的​事​：flush stdio → ​释放​ PID/​锁​ → ​盖​「clean exit」​戳​（lifecycle_ledger.py，​下次​启动​的​不洁​死亡​检测​只认​ SIGKILL/OOM）→ flush ​指标​ → CPU profile → ​有​界​日志​排水​，​最后​ os._exit(exit_code)。

docs.title: 3. start_gateway()：​门面​把​生命周期​委托​给​ bootstrap
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/run.py:5052-5056
async def start_gateway(config: Optional[GatewayConfig] = None, replace: bool = False,
                        verbosity: Optional[int] = 0, force: bool = False, idle_exit: bool = False) -> bool:
    """Run the process lifecycle; the runner facade remains the public entrypoint."""
    from gateway.run_bootstrap import start_gateway as bootstrap
    return await bootstrap(config, replace, verbosity, force, idle_exit)

bootstrap ​阶段​（run_bootstrap.py）​串联​：host ​附着​判定​（_host_attach_or_none：ATTACH ​附着​现役​实例​ / REFUSE ​拒绝​第二​实例​ / REPLACE ​走​替换​握手​）→ ​替换​旧​实例​ → ​构造​ runner、​连接​适配器​ → ​启动​ cron ​与​家务​ watcher → ​装​信号​ handler → ​关闭​尾巴​。​测试​把​各​阶段​当​ gateway.run ​属性​ patch，​所以​这​几个​阶段​函数​以​ _start_gateway_* ​名字​从​ bootstrap ​模块​导入​回​门面​（run.py:5010-5013）。

docs.title: 4. GatewayRunner ​构造​：​多路复用​从​第一行​就​生效
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/run.py:3411-3449（​节选​）
    def __init__(self, config: Optional[GatewayConfig] = None):
        global _gateway_runner_ref
        self.config = config if config is not None else load_gateway_config_for_runner()
        ...
        # Multiplexer flag flips agent.secret_scope.get_secret() to fail-closed on unscoped credential
        # reads, so a missed migration crashes loudly instead of leaking a cross-profile value.
        try:
            from agent.secret_scope import set_multiplex_active
            set_multiplex_active(bool(getattr(self.config, "multiplex_profiles", False)))
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("could not set multiplex-active flag", exc_info=True)
        self.adapters: dict[Platform, BasePlatformAdapter] = {}
        self._profile_adapters: dict[str, dict[Platform, BasePlatformAdapter]] = {}
        self._profile_configs: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._warn_if_docker_media_delivery_is_risky()
        _gateway_runner_ref = _weakref.ref(self)

        self._init_runtime_settings()
        self._init_session_store()
        self._init_lifecycle_state()
        self._init_runtime_caches()
        self._init_session_db()
        self._init_registries_and_clocks()

​三个​要点​：self.adapters ​永远​只是​默认​ profile ​的​适配器​表​，​次要​ profile ​的​在​ _profile_adapters（​谁​直接​读​ self.adapters[p] ​做​投递​就​会​把​回复​发给​默认​ bot）；​多路复用​开关​会​把​ agent.secret_scope ​切成​ fail-closed——​任何​未经​作用域​绑定​的​凭据​读取​直接​崩​，​而​不是​静默​泄漏​跨​ profile ​的​值​（#64674/#72348）；_session_db ​是​一个​ property（run.py:3510-3516），​每次​访问​都​按​当前​活动​作用域​解析​ SQLite ​句柄​并​按​路径​缓存​，​因为​ SessionDB() ​在​构造​时读​ context ​局部​的​ HERMES_HOME，​冻结​在​ __init__ ​里会​把​所有​ profile ​的​行写​进根​ home（#88532/#98573）。

docs.title: 5. SessionState：19 ​个​ dict ​变​一个​容器
docs.text:
​历史​上​ GatewayRunner ​有​约​ 19 ​个​按​ session_key ​键控​的​ dict（​运行​中​ agent、​排队​事件​、​待​审批​……），​字段​该​在​什么​时候​清​、​由​谁​清​全靠​口口相传​，​边界​漂移​和​「​整体​清空​竞态​」​不断​。​现在​收敛​为​一个​容器​，​按​清理​时机​分​三个​生命周期​格​：

# ​来源​：gateway/session_state.py:1-4、93-99
"""Per-session gateway state in one container (replaces ~19 session_key-keyed dicts on
GatewayRunner that bred boundary drift and wholesale-reset races).  Scopes follow where each dict
was CLEARED: ``turn`` at the end of every turn; ``conversation`` at conversation boundaries (/new,
/resume, auto-reset, expiry); ``persistent`` fields have their own lifecycles."""
...
@dataclass
class SessionState:
    """All per-session gateway state, grouped by lifecycle scope."""

    turn: TurnState = field(default_factory=TurnState)
    conversation: ConversationState = field(default_factory=ConversationState)
    persistent: PersistentState = field(default_factory=PersistentState)

TurnState.lease_tokens ​特意​不​在​ clear() ​里​清​——turn ​租约​由​ _release_turn_lease ​精确​释放​一次​（​见​ turn_machinery.md）；PersistentState.run_generation ​单调​递增​永不​重置​，​陈旧​ turn ​靠​它​自认​过时​。

docs.title: 6. ​关闭​排水​：​三种​文件​、​一条​流水线
docs.text: ​关闭​侧​的​分工​：run_shutdown.py（GatewayShutdownMixin）​逐会话​ _finalize_session（​在​该会​话​所属​ profile ​的​作用域​里​ flush——AGENTS.md ​明确​把​ shutdown ​列为​必须​绑定​ _profile_runtime_scope ​的​非​ turn ​路径​）；shutdown_flush.py ​排空​脏​转录​与​投递​队列​；shutdown_forensics.py ​在​排水​失败​时​留下​取证​现场​；shutdown_watchdog.py ​是​关闭​本身​的​看门狗​（​拆​到​一半​卡死​时​至少​放​监督者​进来​）。​最后​回到​上文​ os._exit ​后门​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• run.py ​依赖​ agent/（​压缩​状态​常量​、​中断​兼容​、​活动​计量​）​与​ hermes_cli/（config ​读取​、multiplex ​决策​、​进程​身份​）——​注意​ gateway ​读​用户​ YAML ​走​的​是​自己​的​ loader（run.py + config.py），​不​经过​ DEFAULT_CONFIG；CLI ​看得见​而​网关​看不见​的​ key，​说明​你​用​错​了​ loader。
  • run_bootstrap.py ​与​ run.py ​互相​回导​（bootstrap ​阶段​函数​以​ _start_gateway_* ​名字​在​门面​可见​），​这​是​本​项目​「​兄弟​模块​函数​内晚​导入​门面​」​的​标准​形态​。
  • Desktop ​的​ serve ​后端经​ /api/gateway/* detached ​拉起​本​进程​；status.py ​写​的​ gateway_state.json ​供​更新​器​验证​。
  • ​托管​房间​、​看​板​ watcher、cron ​都​最终​把​工作​转​成​普通​入站​事件​（internal=True）​走同​一条​消息​流​（​见​ message_flow.md）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: run.py ​的​骨架​是​三段​：main() ​管​「​进程​能​不能​活​」（​身份​、​看门狗​、​编码​、​硬​退出​），start_gateway ​管​「​服务​怎么​起​」（​单​实例​仲裁​、​替换​、​适配器​连接​、​信号​），GatewayRunner ​管​「​消息​怎么​流​」（​但​那​部分​代码​几乎​全在​ mixin ​里​）。​多路复用​不是​事后​补丁​而是​构造​期​开关​：secret scope fail-closed、per-profile ​适配器​表​、​按​访问​解析​的​ SessionDB ​句柄​，​都​在​ __init__ ​里​就位​。​关闭​侧​的​哲学​是​「​优雅​拆除​一次​做​完​，​然后​绝不​相信​解释器​退出​」——os._exit ​后门​加​生命周期​台账​，​让​监督者​永远​能​重启​一个​半死不活​的​网关​。

docs.title: sessions_authority.md —— ​会话​索引​、​路由​身份​与​ durable ​接纳​权威
文件​概览
docs.text:
gateway ​的​会话层​回答​三个​问题​：​这​条​消息​属于​哪个​会话​（​路由​索引​ SessionStore + session_identity.py ​的​冻结​身份​）、​谁​说了算​（session_authority.py::SessionAuthority，durable FIFO ​的​ owner）、​接纳​之后​谁​执行​（session_ingress*.py + ​各​入口​ turn）。​本篇​深讲​承重​文件​，​并用​分组​表​覆盖​ gateway ​顶层​全部​ 138 ​个​ session*.py——​它们​大多​是​ SessionAuthority ​或​ SessionStore ​的​一个​切面​（mixin、​控制​面​、​本地​会话​、​查看器​、worker）。

​两个​核心​对象​的​分工​：

  • SessionStore（session.py:787）：session_key → SessionEntry ​的​持久​化​路由​索引​ + ​转录​存储​，SQLite（SessionDB）+ ​旧​ JSONL ​兜底​。​它​知道​「​这个​聊天​当前​轮​到​哪个​ session_id」。
  • SessionAuthority（session_authority.py:134）：​每个​被​服务​ profile ​一个​实例​，​持有​ runtime epoch，​管理​ durable FIFO ​的​接纳​、​认领​（claim）、​结算​（settle）、​转向​（steer）​与​取消​；​它​知道​「​这个​会话​现在​哪个​ generation ​在​跑​、​队列​里排​着​谁​」。

docs.title: 1. SessionStore：​路由​索引​ + ​转录​重试​队列
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/session.py:787-828（​节选​）
class SessionStore(
    SessionPersistenceMixin, SessionRecoveryMixin, SessionLifecycleMixin, SessionTranscriptMixin,
    SessionPromptPinMixin,
):
    """Session routing index + transcripts: SQLite (SessionDB), legacy JSONL fallback."""

    def __init__(self, sessions_dir: Path, config: GatewayConfig, has_active_processes_fn=None):
        ...
        self._lock = threading.Lock()      # guards _entries / _loaded only
        self._save_lock = threading.Lock() # whole-index persistence, never held with _lock
        # Fast (single-entry) and full saves share one generation counter so they are totally
        # ordered; _fast_persisted_entries: key -> (revision, entry_json) since the last rewrite.
        self._routing_generation = 0
        self._inflight_sessions: dict[str, _SessionFlight] = {}
        ...
        self._transcript_retry_lock = threading.Lock()
        # One transcript drainer at a time: parent->child queue migration stays linearizable.
        self._transcript_drain_lock = threading.RLock()
        self._transcript_reroutes: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._dirty_transcripts: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        self._transcript_append_failures: dict[str, int] = {}

​五件​事​值得注意​：​索引​是​双写​的​（SQLite ​路由表​ + ​旧​ JSONL ​兜底​，​句柄​恢复​后​对账​）；_lock ​与​ _save_lock ​永不​嵌套​持有​；​快存​与​全量​存​共享​一个​单调​代​计数器​保证​总序​；_inflight_sessions ​让​同一​路由​的​并发​首​消息​只飞​一次​（_SessionFlight ​的​ event/result/error ​三件套​）；​转录​写入​失败​进​ _dirty_transcripts ​内存​重试​队列​，​排水器​由​ _transcript_drain_lock ​串行化​（​父​→​子​队列​迁移​必须​线性化​）。SQLite ​句柄​按​路径​缓存​、​每次​经​ _db ​解析​（session.py:829-845 ​注释​：​多路复用​下​一个​进程​服务​所有​ profile，​句柄​冻结​在​根​ home ​会​把​所有​ profile ​的​行写​进根​ state.db，#88532）。

docs.title: 2. SessionEntry：​一行​路由​记录​都​记​了​什么
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/session.py:484-541（​节选​）
@dataclass
class SessionEntry:
    """Routing-index entry: maps a session key to its current session ID and metadata."""
    session_key: str
    session_id: str
    ...
    # Durable marker of the executing turn; CAS-cleared on normal unwind, left behind by
    # SIGKILL/OOM so unclean startup recovers the exact session instead of guessing.
    active_turn_token: Optional[str] = None
    ...
    # Profile owning the bot that received this lane's traffic (``RoutingIdentity.transport_profile``,
    # "default" spelled out). The key namespace only says where the turn RUNS; after a restart this is
    # what says which bot may DELIVER to it. None = unknown (row predates the field, or standalone).
    transport_profile: Optional[str] = None
    # Exact session-context/channel inputs from the last human turn. Append-only dataclass field so
    # older positional construction of transport_profile keeps its meaning.
    prompt_pin: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None

active_turn_token ​是​崩溃​恢复​的​锚​：​正常​卸场​ CAS ​清除​，SIGKILL ​留下​它​，​下次​不洁​启动​据此​找回​确切​会话​。transport_profile ​与​ key ​命名​空间​的​分工​是​ Profile scope ​的​核心​设计​：namespace ​说​这条​ lane ​在​哪​跑​（runtime），​这​一列​说​哪个​ bot ​能​向​它​投递​（transport）。session_key ​本身​由​ build_session_key（session.py:686）​按​ agent:<profile>: ​命名​空间​拼出​；_session_key_namespace（session.py:665）​保证​与​ RoutingIdentity.namespace ​字节​一致​。

docs.title: 3. RoutingIdentity：​一个​事件​一个​身份​，​最先​解析
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/session_identity.py:43-66（​节选​）
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RoutingIdentity:
    """Everything a turn needs to know about who it is, resolved once at ingress.

    ``transport_profile`` owns the receiving adapter (its credential and allowlist);
    ``runtime_profile`` is the profile that executes the turn — the same name unless a
    ``profile_routes`` entry re-homed the event. Both are explicit (``"default"`` is spelled out);
    ``None`` never means default here. ``multiplexed`` is False for a standalone gateway, whose
    keys stay in the legacy ``agent:main`` namespace whatever profile it was launched with."""

    transport_profile: str
    runtime_profile: str
    authorization_home: Path
    runtime_home: Path
    multiplexed: bool = True
    # Receiving adapter; None for restored/synthetic sources (no live provenance → fail closed).
    transport: Optional[weakref.ref] = field(default=None, compare=False, hash=False)
    # True when nothing named the receiving bot ... ``transport_profile`` is the primary by default.
    transport_inferred: bool = field(default=False, compare=False, hash=False)

resolve_identity ​把​它​钉​在​ source ​的​ _identity ​属性​上​（wire ​不​可见​，​和​ _transport_adapter_ref ​一样​不进​ to_dict）；transport_profile ≠ runtime_profile ​是​正常​形态​（​共享​ bot → ​路由​卫星​ profile）。​两个​配套​缝​：replace_source（session_identity.py:124）​让​ dataclasses.replace ​复制​ source ​时​把​身份​等​ provenance ​一起​带走​（_apply_topic_recovery ​靠​它​）；IdentityUnresolved（:37）​规定​多路复用​下​解析​失败​必须​丢弃​事件​——​绝不​静默​落回​默认​ profile。session_route_identity.py / session_route_recovery.py ​负责​路由​身份​的​持久​侧​与​恢复​侧​。

docs.title: 4. SessionAuthority：​一个​权威​对象​管住​全部​执行权
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/session_authority.py:134-160（​节选​）
class SessionAuthority:
    def __init__(self, runner, *, profile_id, instance_id, db, epoch):
        self.runner = runner
        self.profile_id = profile_id
        self.instance_id = instance_id
        self.db = db
        self.epoch = epoch
        self.sessions = {}
        self.waiters = {}
        self.native_waiters = set()
        self.pending_results = {}
        self.pending_stops = {}       # ​尚未​ adopt agent ​的​ Stop，​按​ session→generation ​存​
        self.pending_steers = {}      # adopt ​前​收到​的​转向​文本​，​只​交给​那​一代​
        self.adopted = {}             # session -> (generation, agent)：Stop ​只​去​这个​ agent
        self.executing = {}           # session id -> ​执行​中​的​ generation（​发布​围栏​）
        self._route_epochs = {}       # route ​被​多少​次​ /stop、/new ​围栏​过​

​字段名​就是​它​的​职责​清单​：epoch（hermes_state_runtime.begin_runtime_epoch ​递增​的​运行​时代​——​进程​换代​后旧​ epoch ​的​写​全部​作废​）、adopted/executing（Stop ​与​结果​只​投给​当前​代​）、_route_epochs（​对​聊天​维度​的​围栏​计数​，​旧值​永远​提交​不了​）。durable FIFO ​的​实际​落盘​在​状态​层​：admit_session_input（​已​在​ message_flow.md ​第​ 3 ​步​走读​）​写​ session_admissions ​表​；​权威​对象​再​提供​ claim_session_input / settle_session_input / steer_session_input ​的​编排​。​接纳​入口​按​来源​分流​：session_api_turn.py（API ​服务器​）、session_cli_turn.py（​本地​ CLI）、session_cron.py / session_automation.py（​定时​与​自动化​）——​全部​汇聚​到​同一个​ store ​调用​，​这是​「canonical local CLI/TUI/Desktop sessions ​也​走​同一​ durable FIFO」​的​机制​保证​。

docs.title: 5. session_ingress ​族​：​接纳​的​五道​切面
docs.text: session_ingress.py::admit_message（message_flow.md ​已​走读​）​是​主干​；​四个​切面​各管​一件​事​：session_ingress_burst.py ​的​ burst_gate ​在​适配器​缝上​合并​照片​/​文本​连发​（​串行​读者​的​命令​也​要​等​）；session_ingress_context.py ​处理​历史​回填​的​渠道​上下文​；session_ingress_live_turn.py ​管​「​活动​ turn ​期​」​的​接纳​语义​；session_ingress_media.py ​管​媒体​就绪​等待​。​配套​的​ session_admission.py / session_retry_admission.py ​处理​重试​语义​，session_producer_lifecycle.py ​定义​ producer turn ​的​生命周期​（close_producer_turn ​等​）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​状态​层​：durable FIFO、epoch、admission ​表都​在​ hermes_state_runtime.py（gateway ​之外​的​共享​状态​库​）；SessionAuthority ​是​它们​的​ gateway ​侧​编排​者​。
  • run.py：_session_state()（​进程​内​三格​容器​）​与​本篇​的​ SessionStore（​持久​索引​）+ SessionAuthority（​执行​权威​）​是​三个​不同​层次​——​进程​内​易变​状态​、​持久​路由​、​执行权​，​各归​各家​。
  • message_flow.md ​第​ 3 ​步​、turn_machinery.md ​的​租约​都​在​本篇​对象​的​掌控​之下​：admission ​管跨​重启​的​执行权​，​租约​管​进程​内​的​串行化​。
  • streaming.md ​的​通知​唤醒​：​后台​完成​事件​经​ admit_internal_event ​收据​进入​同一​ durable FIFO——​观察者​从不​拥有​这些​ turn。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​会话层​的​铁律​有​三条​。​一​、​身份​先于​一切​：RoutingIdentity ​在​入口​一次性​解析​并​冻结​，​多路复用​下​解析​不出​就​丢弃​，​任何​ helper ​都​只是​读​它​而​不是​再​猜​一遍​。​二​、​路由​归​索引​，​执行​归​权威​：SessionStore ​只​回答​「​这个​聊天​是​哪个​ session_id」，SessionAuthority ​按​ generation ​记账​执行权​（adopted/executing/route fences），Stop ​和​结果​永远​只​给​当前​代​。​三​、​一切​可​恢复​：active_turn_token ​找回​被​ kill ​的​ turn，transcript ​重试​队列​接​住​写盘​失败​，runtime epoch ​让​旧​进程​的​残余​写​全部​作废​。138 ​个​ session_*.py ​都​只是​这三条​铁律​在​某个​切面​上​的​展开​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​覆盖​「agent ​边​跑​边​说​」​的​整套​机制​与​「​跑​完​之后​的​主动​告知​」：

  • typed ​事件​契约​（stream_events.py）：agent ​线程​向​网关​广播​「​发生​了​什么​」​的​冻结​数据​类​——​事件​描述​传输​，​从不​描述​上下文​：​网关​「​吃掉​」​的​任何​字节​都​不许​偏离​ agent ​自己​持有​的​消息​历史​。
  • GatewayStreamConsumer（stream_consumer.py）：​把​同步​的​ agent ​回调​桥到​异步​平台​投递​——on_delta() ​入队​，​异步​任务​缓冲​、​限速​、​逐步​编辑​同​一条​平台​消息​。
  • ​四个​横切​ mixin（think ​过滤​、​代码​围栏​、​附件​ hold-back、​回退​）​与​ TTS ​流式​消费者​。
  • ​通知​与​唤醒​（run_notifications*.py、wake.py、run_goals.py ​家族​）：​后台​进程​完成​、​目标​续​跑​、​心跳​——​它们​以​ internal=True ​合成​事件​回到​ message_flow.md ​的​同​一条​管线​。

docs.title: 1. stream_events.py：​七个​事件​、​一个​显式​ union
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/stream_events.py:1-7
"""Structured streaming events — the agent→gateway delivery contract.

Typed *what happened* events (frozen dataclasses, no I/O) emitted from the agent's
worker thread; ``GatewayStreamConsumer`` is the sink and the adapter decides rendering.
Events describe *transport*, never *context*: whatever the gateway "eats" must never
diverge from the agent-owned message history."""

​七个​事件​各管​一件​事​：MessageChunk（​正文​增量​，think ​内容​已​在​源头​滤掉​）、MessageStop（final=True ​仅​用于​ turn ​的​终点​停​——​中间​停​表示​ text→tool→text ​的​段​切换​）、Commentary（​工具​迭代​之间​的​完整​过渡​消息​，​非​增量​）、ToolCallChunk（​工具​开​跑​，index ​单调​可​关联​起止​）、ToolCallFinished（​工具​结束​，​带时长​与​ ok；​工具​输出​永远​不​走​这里​——​输出​是​历史​）、LongToolHint（​长​工具​的​一次性​引导​提示​，​网关​按​平台​能力​与​首用​门控​）、GatewayNotice（​网关​自​产​控制​消息​，kind ​是​稳定​字符串​：restart/online/long_run…）：

# ​来源​：gateway/stream_events.py:70-72
# Explicit union (not a marker base class) so a missing ``case`` in an
# exhaustive match is a visible type error rather than a silent fall-through.
StreamEvent = MessageChunk | MessageStop | Commentary | ToolCallChunk | ToolCallFinished | LongToolHint | GatewayNotice

​用​显式​ union ​而​不是​公共​基类​：​消费​端​ match ​少写​一个​ case ​就是​类型​错误​，​不是​静默​漏接​。​分发​器​ stream_dispatch.py ​把​事件​分两路​——​消息​事件​进​ consumer，​工具​事件​经​ adapter ​的​ format_tool_event（​返回​ None = ​在​没有​工具​「chrome」​的​平台​吃掉​）​后进​同​一条​工具​进度​队列​，​同步​、​可​在​ agent ​工作​线程​直接​调​，​两条路​因此​永不​竞速​。

docs.title: 2. GatewayStreamConsumer：​同步​→​异步​的​桥
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/stream_consumer.py:1-7
"""Gateway streaming consumer — bridges sync agent callbacks to async platform delivery.

on_delta() queues deltas from the agent's worker thread; the async run() task buffers,
rate-limits and progressively edits one platform message (send, then editMessageText;
draft/native transports are optional per adapter)."""

​桥​的​两侧​都​用​最​简单​的​原语​。agent ​侧​是​ queue.Queue ​的​ put（​永不​阻塞​ worker ​线程​）；​哨兵​分裸​对象​与​元组​两类​（stream_consumer.py:43-56）：_DONE（​结束​）、_NEW_SEGMENT（finalize ​后开​新​消息​）、_COMMENTARY/_TOOL_PROGRESS（​过渡​消息​/​原生​气泡​叠加​）、(_FINAL_TEXT, text)（​权威​ final_response，​含​流式​之后​才​补齐​的​增强​内容​，​排​在​ _DONE ​前​入队​）、(_FLUSH, event)（​屏障​）、(_APPROVAL_BOUNDARY, ...)（​审批​等待​边界​）、_REOPEN_SEED（​澄清​回答​后​ EAGER ​原生​重播​——WeCom ​的​ typing ​由​种子​帧​驱动​，​惰性​重播​实测​ 48 ​秒​死寂​）：

# ​来源​：gateway/stream_consumer.py:538-553（​节选​）
    def on_delta(self, text: str) -> None:
        """Thread-safe callback from the agent's worker thread.  ``None`` signals a tool
        boundary: the current message is finalized and subsequent text goes out as a new
        message below any tool-progress messages."""
        if text:
            self._queue.put(text)
        elif text is None:
            self.on_segment_break()

    def finish(self, final_text: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Signal stream completion.  ``final_text`` is the AUTHORITATIVE completed
        final_response (incl. post-stream augmentation the accumulator never saw); the drain
        loop adopts it as the finalize payload.  Interrupt/error paths call ``finish()`` bare."""
        if final_text is not None:
            self._queue.put((_FINAL_TEXT, final_text))
        self._queue.put(_DONE)

​消费​侧​ run() ​的​循环​每轮​先查​ _run_still_current()——/new、/stop ​之后​放弃​而​非​投递​陈旧​ delta；​意向​沉默​标记​（NO_REPLY/[SILENT]）​在​流式​预览​里​就要​撤回​，​因为​网关​的​整​响应​过滤器​对​流式​来说​太晚​了​：

# ​来源​：gateway/stream_consumer.py:555-595（​节选​）
    async def run(self) -> None:
        """Async task that drains the queue and edits the platform message."""
        self._len_fn, self._safe_limit = self._resolve_length_budget()
        await self._start_transports()
        try:
            while True:
                # Session reset (/new, /stop): abandon rather than deliver stale deltas.
                if not self._run_still_current():
                    await self._abandon_native_stream()
                    return
                tick = self._drain_queue()
                if tick.approval_boundary is not None:
                    await self._handle_approval_boundary(*tick.approval_boundary)
                    continue
                ...
                if tick.got_done:
                    self._flush_think_buffer()
                    # A bare intentional-silence marker (NO_REPLY / [SILENT]): the
                    # gateway's whole-response filter runs too late for a streamed
                    # preview, so retract it here instead of finalizing.
                    if _is_intentional_silence_response(self._clean_for_display(self._accumulated)):
                        await self._suppress_silence_marker()
                        return
                if self._should_edit(tick) and (...):
                    # Seal first: it clears the message id, so a remainder still over the limit
                    # is split again below. A plain first send would let the adapter split it and
                    # adopt only the LAST chunk as the preview; the next seal then overwrites that
                    # chunk with the head of the whole remainder (duplicated + lost text, #25349).
                    await self._seal_overflow_heads()

​结构​由​四个​ mixin ​组成​（stream_consumer.py:102）：StreamTransportMixin（draft/native/edit ​三种​传输​的​解析​与​失败​降级​）、StreamFallbackMixin（​编辑​失效​后​的​回退​发送​）、StreamThinkFilterMixin（<think> ​块​过滤​状态机​）、​加上​主类​。StreamConsumerConfig ​携带​运行​参数​：edit_interval（​限速​）、buffer_threshold、cursor、fresh_final_after_seconds（​预览​可见​过久后​ final ​改为​新​消息​，​让​平台​时间​戳​反映​完成​时刻​——​移植​自​ openclaw#72038）。

turn ​终态​的​对账​在​ _clear_turn_final_flags（stream_consumer.py:224-243）：_final_response_sent / _final_content_delivered / _delivered_final_text ​三个​旗标​在​每次​工具​/​段​边界​清零​（#29346——​边界​前​交付​的​只是​过渡​前奏​，​冒充​不了​ final），​唯一​保留​ legacy ​信任​的​是​ _delivery_ambiguous（​全量​ final ​发送​超时​但​可能​已​到达​——​重​发​反而​制造​重复​，#95382）。gateway ​侧​据此​比​对​ delivered_final_matches ​决定​是否​补发​——​这​条​对账​链​与​ gateway/AGENTS.md § Streaming delivery contract ​的​四条​不​变量​（draft ​前缀​稳定​、​消费者​宣布​ final、​临时​发送​带​ _interim_send、​对账​靠​ edit ​不靠​ send）​一一对应​，​每条​不​变量​背后​都​是​一次​线上​重复​事故​（NS-658 ​账本​，#85796/gateway-gateway#210）。

docs.title: 3. ​横切​细节​：think、​围栏​、​指令​ hold-back、​回退
docs.text:
• think ​过滤​（stream_consumer_think.py）：<think> ​块​的​开关​状态机​镜像​ CLI ​的​ _stream_delta——​增量​切片​随时​可能​把​标签​切成​两半​，​必须​按​缓冲​重​放​判定​。
  • ​围栏​闭合​（stream_consumer_fences.py::ensure_closed_code_fences）：​预览​里​的​未​闭合​ ``` ​围栏​在​每次​编辑​时​临时​闭合​，​防止​平台​渲染​把​后续​正文​吞进​代码​块​；​只​在​ edit ​路径​——draft ​前缀​稳定​不​变量​禁止​在​帧​上​做​这件​事​。
  • ​指令​ hold-back（stream_consumer_directives.py）：​附件​指令​（MEDIA:<path>、[[…]] ​旗标​、markdown/HTML ​图片​标签​）​还​在​「​正在​打​的​最后​一行​」​时​被​扣住​不​显示​；_PENDING_MEDIA_RE ​只​匹配​「​还​能​长成​路径​」​的​ MEDIA: ​前缀​，​散文​里​的​ "social media: Twitter" ​永远​不会​扣住​一行​。hold ​的​附件​最终​被持​回​，​交给​ turn ​后​的​媒体​投递​。
  • ​回退​（stream_consumer_fallback.py）：progressive edit ​不可​用​（flood ​三连​、edit ​不​支持​）​时​降级​为​分段​发送​/​尾部​补发​；Telegram ​的​编辑​重试​上限​ 5 ​秒​约束​了​回退​的​等待​预算​。

docs.title: 4. streaming_tts_consumer：​增量​到​声音
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/streaming_tts_consumer.py:1-8（​节选​）
"""Gateway streaming-TTS consumer — LLM deltas to adapter PCM audio sink.

``on_delta`` (agent worker thread) never blocks: SentenceChunker -> thread-safe queue. The
``_run`` task on the gateway loop drains, synthesises via a ``StreamingTTSProvider`` and writes
PCM so playback starts mid-generation. Outcome: success -> ``completed``; failure before audible
output -> ``suppress_whole_file=False`` (gateway falls back to whole-file TTS); failure after
partial audio -> ``partial`` + suppress (never replay the response from the beginning)."""

​同一​「​队列​ + ​循环​」​模式​换​了​介质​：SentenceChunker ​按句​切块​，StreamingTTSProvider ​合成​ PCM，​播放​随​生成​开始​。​结果​分​三档​：​成功​ completed；​尚未​出声​就​失败​ → ​回退​整​文件​ TTS；​已出​部分​声音​再​失败​ → partial ​且​抑制​整​文件​重​放​（​绝不能​从头​把​整段​回复​再说​一遍​）。​适配器​侧​的​基类​协议​在​ platforms/base_streaming_tts.py；​已​完成​流式​ TTS ​的​ turn ​记进​ BasePlatformAdapter._streaming_tts_completed_turns（base.py:1917-1921），​整​文件​自动​ TTS ​路径​据此​跳过​，​避免​双份​语音​（#60671）。​语音​频道​的​装配​在​ run_voice.py（GatewayVoiceMixin）。

docs.title: 5. ​通知​与​唤醒​：​跑​完​之后​主动​开口
docs.text:
​后台​事件​回到​网关​的​入口​都​遵循​同一​模式​——​合成​的​ MessageEvent(internal=True) ​走​ handle_message，​与​人类​输入​共用​授权​豁免​与​ durable FIFO：

# ​来源​：gateway/wake.py:1-8（​节选​）
"""Wake an existing agent session from a background completion event. Push-capable adapters
(``supports_async_delivery``) get a synthetic ``MessageEvent(internal=True)`` via handle_message;
stateless adapters (API server) would run that under a ``build_session_key()`` key that never
matches the raw ``X-Hermes-Session-Id`` real turns use (invisible parallel session), so we self-POST
``/v1/chat/completions`` with the raw id header to resume the REAL session. Exception:
async-delegation completions: the CLIENT owns the next turn, so they are never self-POSTed as a
new ``role=user`` prompt (could cross a pending human-confirmation gate); instead
``persist_delegation_delivery`` writes a durable DELIVERY row ... Failures RAISE (after bounded
retries on transient errors) so callers can rewind cursors / retry instead of silently losing the event."""

terminal(background=true, notify_on_complete=true) ​在​网关​循环​上布​ watcher（run_notifications.py::arm_process_watcher），​完成​时​启动​新​ turn；​注入​必须​拿到​ admit_internal_event ​的​收据​（handler ​返回​ None ​不算​接受​），​被​拒​的​注入​会​退还​同批​兄弟​条目​、​不​消耗​重试​次数​（gateway/AGENTS.md § Background process notifications）。wake.py ​补足​推送​不可​用​的​平台​：api_server ​无​状态​、​合成​事件​的​ key ​对不上​真实​会话​，​改为​自​ POST /v1/chat/completions ​带​原始​ X-Hermes-Session-Id ​恢复​真身​；​异步​委派​的​完成​则​永不​自​ POST（​下​一​ turn ​归​客户端​所有​，​盲发​可能​撞​上​等​人​确认​的​门​），​只​写​ durable DELIVERY ​行​。​失败​必须​ raise（​有​界​退避​后​）——​调用​方要​回卷​游标​重试​，​不​允许​静默​丢​事件​。

​家族​成员​的​分工​：run_goals.py（GatewayGoalsMixin）​管​目标​/​心跳​的​续​跑​、run_heartbeat_acceptance.py / run_heartbeat_restore.py ​管​心跳​ turn ​的​验收​（heartbeat_owner_is_current ​守卫​执行​前​身份​）​与​恢复​；run_notifications_update.py ​管​更新​通知​、run_notifications_ownership.py ​管​通知​的​投递​所有权​；warning_notifications.py ​统一​告警​文案​（warning_text ​按​平台​与​ display ​档位​降噪​）；channel_directory.py ​维护​「​哪个​ profile ​的​哪个​平台​是​ home channel」​目录​，​通知​去​重键​在​多路复用​下带​ <profile>:<platform> ​前缀​；run_delivery_queue_watch.py ​监视​投递​队列​（​配合​ delivery_ledger ​的​运行​时重​投​）；rich_sent_store.py ​记录​富​文本​已​发送​（edit ​目标​查找​）。​观察者​只​看​不​动手​：canonical ​本地​会话​把​完成​与​观察​事件​接纳​进​同一​ durable FIFO，​但​观察者​从不​拥有​或​消费​那些​ turn。
