docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​事件​的​生产​端​在​ agent/：worker ​线程​经​ stream ​回调​发出​ StreamEvent；turn_machinery.md ​的​ turn executor ​线程​正是​生产​现场​。
  • ​流式​只管​「​展示​」：SessionStore ​的​转录​以​ agent ​的​历史​为准​（​第​ 1 ​节​的​格言​），message_flow.md ​第​ 6 ​步​的​ send_final_ledgered ​是​最终​投递​的​唯一​出口​——​消费者​交付​过​的​内容​通过​ _run_agent_mark_streamed_delivery ​报告​给​ turn ​侧​，​避免​重复​发送​。
  • relay ​平台​的​ Slack ​原生​流式​（draft_stream_is_message=True）​是​四条​不​变量​的​最​严格​执行者​：relay.md ​的​ draft ​墓碑​表​就是​不​变量​ 1 ​与​ 4 ​的​落地​。
  • ​通知​唤醒​依赖​ session_authority ​的​ admit_internal_event ​收据​门​（sessions_authority.md）​与​ delivery.py ​的​目标​解析​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​流式​层​的​两个​关键词​是​「​桥​」​与​「​对账​」。​桥​：​同步​的​ agent ​线程​永不​阻塞​，​一切​经​ queue.Queue ​的​哨兵​语法​交给​事件​循环​侧​的​一个​消费者​任务​；​传输​可以​换​（edit/draft/native），​队列​不变​。​对账​：​消费者​知道​自己​交付​过​什么​（​三个​终态​旗标​ + ​交付​文本​快照​），gateway ​拿​它​与​权威​ final ​比​对​，​宁可​少说​不​谎报​；​意向​沉默​、​溢出​封缄​、​审批​边界​这些​「​非​正文​」​状态​都​成​了​队列​里​的​一等​公民​。​通知​唤醒​则​是​同一​可靠性​哲学​的​主动​面​：​后台​事件​要么​拿到​收据​、​要么​大声​失败​，​绝不​静默​消失​——​推送​不行​就​自​ POST，​委派​完成​就​写​ durable ​行​，​让​每个​「​跑​完​了​」​都​有​下文​。

docs.title: turn_machinery.md —— turn ​租约​、​无​界线​程​执行器​与​ agent ​缓存
文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​讲​ turn ​执行​的​并发​机器​，​回答​三个​「​为什么​」：

  1. ​为什么​忙碌​保护​按​路由​键​不够​，​还要​ turn ​租约​按​ session_id ​串行化​？——​因为​路由​键到​ session_id ​是​多​对​一​的​（/resume ​从​第二个​聊天​恢复​、CLI ​续聊​、​委派​固定​、​话题​游走​都​会​让​两个​键​映射​到​同​一份​转录​），​两个​键​可以​在​一份​转录​上​交错​ flush，​即​ turn_lease.py ​注释​里​的​ user;user ​楔死​事故​（#64934）。
  2. ​为什么​ _UnboundedThreadExecutor ​不是​ ThreadPoolExecutor？——​因为​「​无​界​」​的​ ThreadPoolExecutor ​其实​是​ min(32, cpu_count + 4) ​的​有界​池加​静默​队列​；​而​ turn ​的​ submit ​全部​发生​在​事件​循环​上​，Thread.start() ​要​在​循环​里​等​新​线程​拿到​ GIL，turn ​一​多​每次​ submit ​都​冻结​整个​循环​（#142061）。
  3. agent ​缓存​为什么​要​有​内存​压力​信号​？——LRU ​上限​数​的​是​条目​数​不是​字节​，​一个​缓存​ agent ​钉​着​整份​活动​转录​（​工具​重​的​会​话​几十​ MB），​空闲​ TTL ​又​对​忙碌​会话​视而不见​。

docs.title: 1. turn_lease.py：​按​「​解析​后​的​ session_id」​串行化
docs.text:
​模块​ docstring ​一句​话​讲清​全部​前提​：

# ​来源​：gateway/turn_lease.py:1-10
"""Per-session turn lease — serializes the [load history -> run -> flush] region.

Busy guards are keyed by ROUTING KEY but the transcript is owned by SESSION_ID, and
``switch_session()`` makes key->id many-to-one (/resume from a second chat, CLI-continuity,
delegation pinning, topic tip-walks), so two keys could interleave flushes on one transcript
(``user;user`` wedge). The lease serializes per RESOLVED session_id: acquired right before the
transcript load, released in the dispatch layer's ``finally``; identity-checked release; a
timed-out waiter fails CLOSED (:class:`TurnLeaseTimeoutError`); only idle entries evict. Limits:
CLI-continuity processes are outside this lock; mid-turn rotation alias is closed by ``rebind``."""

​获取​端​是​最​讲究​的​一段​。​等待​者​统计​ pending_acquires ​覆盖​了​「​锁​已​释放​但​唤醒​还​没​跑​」​的​交接​窗口​——​否则​驱逐​逻辑​可能​把​旧锁​孤立​、​给​同一​会话​造出​第二把​锁​：

# ​来源​：gateway/turn_lease.py:98-137（​节选​）
    async def acquire(
        self, session_id: str, *, owner_key: str, generation: int, timeout: Optional[float] = None
    ) -> Optional[TurnLeaseToken]:
        if not session_id:
            return None
        wait = float(timeout) if timeout and timeout > 0 else DEFAULT_LEASE_WAIT  # 5.0s
        lease = self._get_or_create(session_id)
        token = TurnLeaseToken(session_id, owner_key, int(generation), lease=lease)
        if lease.lock.locked():
            logger.warning(
                "turn lease contention on session %s: routing key %s (gen %s) waiting behind "
                "in-flight turn held by routing key %s (gen %s, held %.0fs) — two routing keys "
                "are mapped to one session_id (#64934); serializing this turn behind the previous "
                "turn's flush", ...)
        lease.pending_acquires += 1
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(lease.lock.acquire(), timeout=wait)
        except TimeoutError:
            logger.error("turn lease wait timed out after %.0fs on session %s ... — failing closed: "
                         "refusing to run this turn UNSERIALIZED against the still-held lease", ...)
            raise TurnLeaseTimeoutError(...) from None
        finally:
            lease.pending_acquires -= 1
        lease.holder = token
        lease.acquired_at = lease.last_used = time.time()
        return token

​三个​设计​决定​值得​背下来​：

  • fail-closed：​等待​超时​抛​ TurnLeaseTimeoutError，​宁可​拒绝​这一​ turn ​也​不无​串行化​地​闯进​转录​区​；​外层​ dispatch ​把​它​翻成​一条​「​请​稍后​重​发​」​的​提示​。
  • ​按代​释放​：​租约​令牌​记在​ SessionState.turn.lease_tokens[run_generation]（session_state.py:33），​被​驱逐​的​旧​ turn ​卸场​时​只​释放​自己​那​一代​的​，​绝不​放掉​继任者​的​。
  • rebind() ​关掉​轮换​别名​：turn ​中途​压缩​会​让​ session_id ​轮换​，rebind ​把​同一​把​ _SessionLease ​登记​到​新​ id ​下​，​让​ flush ​目标​仍​被​串行化​；​若​新​ id ​上​已有​活锁​，​大声​记​日志​并​保留​旧​ id（fail-open，#64934 ​轮换​别名​边缘​）。

​获取​点​在​ run_turn_prepare.py:522：

# ​来源​：gateway/run_turn_prepare.py:522-541（​节选​）
    async def _hmwa_acquire_turn_lease(self, _quick_key, run_generation, session_entry, _session_env_tokens):
        """Serialize [load history → run → flush] per resolved SESSION_ID so another routing key on
        the same session waits for the prior flush. Fail-closed on timeout (outer dispatch returns
        a resend notice). Released in _handle_message's finally, granted per (routing key, run
        generation) so a stale unwind can't release a newer turn's."""
        ...
            _lease_token = await _lease_registry.acquire(
                session_entry.session_id, owner_key=_quick_key, generation=run_generation,
                timeout=_float_env("HERMES_TURN_LEASE_TIMEOUT", DEFAULT_LEASE_WAIT),
            )

​注册表​本体​在​ run_runtime_init.py:85（self._turn_leases = SessionTurnLeaseRegistry()），​进程​内​、​单​事件​循环​——​与​它​所​扩展​的​路由​键​守卫​同一​可见​范围​。

docs.title: 2. turn_executor.py：​每​ turn ​一个​线程​，​线程​停车​复用
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/turn_executor.py:25-42（​节选​）
class _UnboundedThreadExecutor(concurrent.futures.Executor):
    """Every submitted item starts at once on its own thread; no queue, no cap.

    ``ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=None)`` is NOT unbounded (it is ``min(32, cpu_count + 4)``),
    which is the same silent queue at a larger number. An item goes to a parked (idle) worker when
    one exists, otherwise to a new thread. Reuse matters because ``submit`` runs on the event loop
    and ``Thread.start()`` waits there until the new thread gets the GIL: with many turns running,
    every submit (the handoff watcher's 2 s idle gates included) froze the loop (#142061). Handing an
    item to a parked worker is a queue put. A worker parked for ``idle_timeout`` exits."""

submit ​是​一个​临界​区​完成​「​检查​ + ​交接​/​启动​ + ​登记​」：​有​空闲​ worker ​就​ self._idle.pop()（LIFO：​最暖​的​线程​先​用​，​最冷​的​让​它​超时​退出​）​然后​ inbox.put(item)——​一次​队列​ put，​不​等​ GIL；​没有​才​新建​线程​。​线程​退出​边界​还有​一句​反​直觉​的​注释​：​先​ t.start() ​再​登记​进​ _threads，​因为​到达​ OS ​线程​上限​时​ start() ​抛​异常​，​一个​没​启动​的​线程​留在​集合​里会​让​ shutdown ​的​ join ​炸掉​、​跳过​静默​判定​。

​复用​的​线程​必须​对下​一个​ item ​伪装成​新​线程​：

# ​来源​：gateway/turn_executor.py:77-98（​节选​）
    def _work(self, worker: _Worker, item) -> None:
        while item is not None:
            fut, fn, args, kwargs = item
            del item
            if fut.set_running_or_notify_cancel():
                try:
                    fut.set_result(contextvars.Context().run(fn, *args, **kwargs))
                except BaseException as exc:
                    fut.set_exception(exc)
            del fut, fn, args, kwargs  # a parked worker must not pin the last item's arguments
            item = self._park(worker)

    def _park(self, worker: _Worker):
        """Reset this thread, then wait for its next item; None means exit."""
        from gateway.turn_thread_reset import reset_reused_thread_state
        try:
            reset_reused_thread_state()
            reusable = True
        except Exception:
            logger.warning("turn worker state reset failed; retiring the thread", exc_info=True)
            reusable = False

​两重​清洁​：​每个​ item ​在​空​ contextvars.Context ​里​跑​（​等价​于​新​线程​的​起点​；​注意​这里​有​一条​ # health: allow HX012 ​豁免​，​理由​正是​「worker ​服务​多个​ item，​每个​都​在​全新​ Context ​里​跑​」）；​停车​前​ reset_reused_thread_state() ​清掉​上​一​ turn ​落下​的​线程​键​状态​（​如​线程​局部​会话​绑定​），​重置​失败​的​线程​退役​，​绝不​复用​。​空闲​ 60 ​秒​（_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S）​后​ worker ​退出​；​超时​与​ submit ​抢车​的​竞态​也​有​处理​——_park ​拿锁​检查​后​发现自己​在​ _idle ​里​已​被​摘除​，​说明​ item ​已经​在​路上​，​继续​ inbox.get()。

docs.title: 3. run_turn.py：_handle_message_with_agent ​与​ _run_agent ​家族
docs.text:
GatewayTurnMixin（run_turn.py:170）= Background + Prepare + Hygiene + Persistence ​四个​子​ mixin。turn ​主链​在​ message_flow.md ​第​ 4 ​步​已经​走过​；​这里​补​执行​侧​的​两个​细节​：

  • ​陈旧​结果​丢弃​：turn ​结束​先查​ self._is_session_run_current(_quick_key, run_generation)（run_turn.py:286），​不是​当前​代​就​ _hmwa_discard_stale_result ​丢弃​——/stop、/new、​驱逐​都​会​推进​代数​，​慢​ turn ​的​结果​绝不能​覆盖​新​状态​。
  • ​流式​已​交付​则​正文​不再​发​：agent_result.get("already_sent") ​时​ footer ​单独​补发​（run_turn.py:298-299），​避免​流式​消费者​与​最终​发送​双份​。

_run_agent ​自身​是​一组​小​函数​的​组合​（_run_agent_build_turn_context、_run_agent_start_turn_worker、_run_agent_await_turn_worker、_run_agent_cleanup_turn_taskasks…）：worker ​在​ _UnboundedThreadExecutor ​上​跑​同步​ agent，​事件​循环​侧​同时​跑​打字​指示​、​不​活跃​告警​、​中断​监测​（_run_agent_monitor_for_interrupt、​备份​检查​ _run_agent_backup_interrupt_check）；finally ​半场​ _run_agent_cleanup_turn_tasks ​取消​后台任务​、flush ​流​、​按代​释放​会话​槽​。

docs.title: 4. agent ​缓存​与​内存​压力
docs.text:
# ​来源​：gateway/run.py:51-53
# Per-session AIAgent cache bounds (agents are heavy); see _enforce_agent_cache_cap/_session_housekeeping_watcher.
_AGENT_CACHE_MAX_SIZE = 128
_AGENT_CACHE_IDLE_TTL_SECS = 3600.0  # evict agents idle for >1h

​缓存​的​实现​与​驱逐​策略​在​ run_agent_cache.py（GatewayAgentCacheMixin，​还​兼管​会话​模型​覆盖​ /model、run ​代数​、​会话级​重置​）。​关键​规则​：​驱逐​必须​在​ owning profile ​的​作用域​里​做​——_run_release_in_profile_scope ​让​ TTL/LRU/​内存​压力​三条​驱逐​路径​都​过​ _profile_runtime_scope，​这样​ on_session_end ​与​ memory flush ​才​会​命中​会话​所属​ profile ​的​ provider（HX005：​曾经​有​驱逐​在​启动​作用域​下​ flush，​把​次要​ profile ​的​记忆​写进​了​默认​库​）。

# ​来源​：gateway/agent_cache_pressure.py:1-11（​节选​）
"""Memory-pressure bounds for the gateway's per-session AIAgent cache.

Each cached ``AIAgent`` pins its full live transcript (tens of MB on a tool-heavy
session); the LRU cap counts entries, not bytes, and the idle TTL defers eviction
for busy sessions, so neither sees actual memory use.  This module supplies that
signal — own anonymous RSS against a budget derived from the cgroup limit — and
``GatewayRunner`` sheds LRU transcripts via soft eviction (rebuilt from the
persisted session next turn).  Pure/read-only; config under ``agent.agent_cache``."""

​参数​同样​克制​：​自动​预算​取​ cgroup ​限额​的​ 65%（_AUTO_BUDGET_FRACTION）——​留给​ SIGTERM flush ​完成​的​时间​；512 MB ​下限​（​小​容器​每个​回合​都​驱逐​等于​没有​暖​前缀​）；​每轮​最多​驱逐​ 16 ​个​；​最热​的​ 8 ​个会话​永不​驱逐​（_DEFAULT_PROTECT_RECENT，​它们​的​提示​缓存​最​值钱​，​驱逐​只是​把​成本​挪到​下​一​ turn）。

docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ turn_lease.py ​每会话​ turn ​租约​：​串行化​ load→run→flush，fail-closed，rebind turn_executor.py _UnboundedThreadExecutor：​无​界线​程​、parked worker ​复用​ turn_thread_reset.py ​复用​线程​的​状态​重置​ turn_context.py TurnContext：​单​ turn ​的​执行​上下文​对象​ active_lease_io.py ​活跃​租约​的​ I/O ​读写​（​跨​进程​可见​的​活跃​槽​） run_turn.py GatewayTurnMixin：_handle_message_with_agent、_run_agent ​主链​ run_turn_prepare.py GatewayTurnPrepareMixin：​会话​解析​、​历史​装载​、​租约​获取​ run_turn_runner.py TurnRunner：agent ​实例​化​与​同步​执行​的​封装​ run_turn_runner_approval_settle.py ​审批​结算​（approve/deny ​后​的​ turn ​续行​） run_turn_runner_clarify_delivery.py ​澄清​提问​的​投递​ run_turn_followup_ack.py ​队列​跟进​消息​的​确认​ run_turn_hygiene.py GatewayTurnHygieneMixin：​上下文​卫生​（​压缩​失败​冷却​阶梯​） run_turn_persistence.py GatewayTurnPersistenceMixin：​转录​/​账本​落盘​半场​ run_turn_progress.py GatewayTurnProgressMixin：​迭代​进度​广播​ run_background.py GatewayBackgroundMixin：​后台​进程​ watcher ​装配​ run_agent_cache.py GatewayAgentCacheMixin：​缓存​/​覆盖​/​代数​/​会话​重置​ agent_cache_pressure.py ​内存​压力​信号​与​软​驱逐​参数​ stuck_loop_counts.py ​卡​死循环​计数​（​恢复​失败​升级​ suspended） run_voice.py GatewayVoiceMixin：​语音​频道​ streaming_tts_consumer.py LLM ​增量​→PCM ​的​ TTS ​消费者​（​详见​ streaming.md）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​上游​是​ message_flow.md ​第​ 3 ​步​的​接纳​层​：durable FIFO ​保证​输入​不​丢​，​本篇​的​租约​保证​执行​不​交错​——​两者​合​起来​才​是​完整​的​「​一个​会话​一个​ turn」。
  • agent/ ​是​真正​的​ turn ​本体​：TurnRunner ​调​ AIAgent；​租约​区域​串行化​的​正是​ agent ​的​转录​读写​。
  • ​驱逐​与​ shutdown ​都​必须​进入​ _profile_runtime_scope（run_agent_cache.py / run_shutdown.py），​是​ Profile scope（HX005/PS-P05）​在​执行层​的​落点​。
  • SessionState.turn（session_state.py）​是​租约​令牌​与​ run ​代数​的​家​；hermes_state_runtime.py ​的​ admission ​表是​另​一​维度​的​「​执行权​」​记录​（durable），​两者​互补​：​租约​管​进程​内​，admission ​管跨​重启​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​一层​的​三个​组件​各堵​一个​真实​事故​的​洞​：​租约​堵​「​两个​路由​键​交错​写​一份​转录​」（#64934），​手段​是​把​串行化​点​从​「​谁​收到​了​消息​」​换​到​「​这份​转录​属于​谁​」，​等待​超时​宁可​ fail-closed；​无​界​执行器​堵​「submit ​冻结​事件​循环​」（#142061），​手段​是​彻底​放弃​队列​——​每​ turn ​一线​程​ + ​停车​复用​ + ​双重​上下文​清洁​；​内存​压力​驱逐​堵​「LRU ​数不出​字节​」，​手段​是​拿​ cgroup ​推导​预算​、​软​驱逐​（​下​ turn ​从​持久​化​重建​）、​保护​最热​的​会​话​。​读​这类​代码​的​方法论​：​每个​看起来​过度​的​防御​，​注释​里​都​躺​着​一个​带​编号​的​事故​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
CLI ​层​是​ Hermes ​四个​表面​（CLI、​网关​、TUI、​桌面​）​中​用户​最​常​接触​的​一个​。​它​由​两​部分​组成​：

  • cli.py（1,792 ​行​）——HermesCLI ​门面​：​交互式​ REPL ​的​入口​与​组装​点​；
  • hermes_cli/（843 ​个​ py ​文件​）——​门面​的​兄弟​模块​群​：16 ​个​ mixin、​中央​命令​注册表​、65 ​个​ argparse ​子​命令​、Web ​服务器​、​更新​系统​、​网关​客户端​、​看板​等​。

​本层​遵守​仓库​级​「​门面​ + ​兄弟​」​布局​：cli.py ​只​保留​公共​入口​和​被​其他​包​ import ​的​名字​（​机械​拆分​ #116911 ​之后​ re-export ​数百个​符号​），​行为​全部​下沉​到​ hermes_cli/cli_*_mixin.py ​与​主题​兄弟​文件​中​。

docs.title: 关键​代码​走读
docs.text:
cli.py ​的​启动​顺序​是​刻意​安排​的​——hermes_bootstrap ​必须​是​第一个​ import（Windows ​上装​ UTF-8 stdio ​并​激活​ PM ​环境​），​随后​立刻​压掉​子​模块​的​启动​噪音​：

# cli.py:6-31
# Must be the very first import (UTF-8 stdio on Windows). Missing only mid-``hermes update``.
try:
    import hermes_bootstrap
except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
    if exc.name != "hermes_bootstrap" and not "hermes_bootstrap".startswith(f"{exc.name}."):
        raise  # the bootstrap exists but cannot load: skipping it would skip PM activation

...
os.environ["HERMES_QUIET"] = "1"  # suppress our modules' startup chatter

HermesCLI ​类​由​ 18 ​个​ mixin ​组装​（​行​ 881）。MRO ​顺序​即​能力​清单​：

                CLITerminalMixin, CLIInfoMixin, CLILoopsMixin, CLIChatTurnMixin):

​建议​阅读​顺序​：​先​ 1→2→3 ​建立​骨架​（REPL ​与​派发​），​再​按​需​跳入​ 4-12 ​的​子系统​。​每篇​的​「​本组​文件​清单​」​表格​都​是​该​簇​的​完整​文件​地图​，​可​当​索引​用​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/：HermesCLI ​在​交互​模式​下​构建​ AIAgent；​但​在​网关​模式​下​ CLI ​从不​构建​ agent——​它​持有​ gateway_agent.GatewayAgent ​这个​「AIAgent ​兼容​表面​」（​见​ gateway_client.md）。
  • gateway/：CLI ​是​网关​会话​的​查看​者​。​网关​拥有​ turn、​工具​与​ state.db；CLI ​提交​ prompt.submit ​并​回放​事件​流​。
  • tools/ toolsets.py：/tools、toolset ​开关​、​会话级​ surface ​工具​都​从​这里​读取​。
  • hermes_state.py：​会话​存储​、/resume、/history ​经​ SessionDB。
  • plugins/：process_command ​触发​ fire_pre_command_hook，​插件​命令​通过​ plugin_command_dispatch ​执行​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
CLI ​层​的​三个​要点​：

  1. ​门面​窄​、​能力​在​边​：cli.py ​是​装配​点​与​ re-export ​表​；​任何​一个​能力​都​住​在​ hermes_cli/ ​的​某个​主题​兄弟​文件​里​。
  2. ​一张​注册表​喂​所有​表面​：slash ​命令​的​ CLI help、​网关​派发​、Telegram BotCommands、​补​全都​从​ COMMAND_REGISTRY ​派生​——​加​命令​只改​一处​。
  3. CLI ​是​网关​的​查看​者​：​连接​共享​网关​时​，CLI ​进程​从不​构建​ agent、​从不​跑​工具​、​从不​写​ state.db；turn ​在​网关​跑​，CLI ​只​回放​事件​流​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​配置​簇约​ 27 ​个​文件​，​围绕​ config.py（3,945 ​行​门面​）​组织​：

  • ​读写​：config.py（load/save/validate/save_env_value）；​写回​原语​ config_backend seam；
  • ​叠加​：config_effective.py = config.yaml + managed overlay + ${VAR} ​展开​（​无​默认值​层​）；
  • ​路由​：config_env_routing.py ​决定​一个​键落​ .env ​还是​ config.yaml；
  • ​迁移​：config_migrations.py ​表​驱动​注册表​（+ config_migrations_browser.py）；
  • IT ​下发​：managed_scope.py ​用户​不可​变​的​托管​层​；
  • ​守护​：backups/issues/show/section_guard/value_checks/key_notices/read_errors/runtime_keys/worker_save/version_stamp/language/check_diagnostics；
  • ​皮肤​：skin_engine.py（​主题​ SDK）+ skin_cmd.py（hermes skin）。

docs.title: config.py ​门面
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/config.py:1-3
"""Configuration management for Hermes Agent: config.yaml / .env loading, saving,
validation, migration, and the ``hermes config`` command."""

​核心​入口​：load_config()（​行​ 1978，​先​合并​ DEFAULT_CONFIG）、load_config_readonly()（​行​ 1985）、_load_config_impl()（​行​ 2215）、save_config()（​行​ 2366）、save_env_value()（​行​ 2688）、get_config_value()（​行​ 3450）、validate_config_structure()（​行​ 1052）。

docs.title: config_effective ​三层
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/config_effective.py:1-14
"""The effective USER config: config.yaml + managed overlay + ``${VAR}`` expansion, no defaults.

``load_config()`` merges ``DEFAULT_CONFIG`` first, which is wrong for readers that treat a
missing key as "unset" (the gateway's presence-sensitive env bridge, ``cfg == {}`` sentinels,
cron model pinning) — so nine surfaces used to hand-roll raw-read → overlay → expand in
differing orders and none of them replayed the model-key canonicalization or the last-known-good
recovery ``load_config()`` gained. This module is that one primitive.

​叠加​顺序​与​ _load_config_impl ​一致​：​用户​层先​展开​ ${VAR}，​再叠​ managed overlay——​托管​层里​的​ ${VAR} ​只​对​进程​环境​解析​，​永远​不会​被​某个​ profile ​的​ secret ​作用域​再​解析​（docs/design/managed-scope.md §4.1）。​该​模块​还​带​「​最后​一次​成功​解析​的​ raw ​用户​映射​」​缓存​：​文件​中途​被​改坏​时​按​上​个​好​版本​继续​服务​。

docs.title: config_env_routing：​按​形状​路由
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/config_env_routing.py:1-14（​节选​）
"""Which ``hermes config`` keys live in ``.env`` instead of ``config.yaml``, and their lifecycle.
...
The routing rule is the key's SHAPE, not a registry: a bare ``UPPER_SNAKE`` name is an environment
setting and goes to ``.env`` — the file every runtime reader (``os.getenv``, the gateway's
``platform_gate_env``) resolves against — whether or not Hermes enumerates it anywhere.
"""
# ​行​ 26-28
_ENV_SHAPE_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$")

​路由​规则​是​键​的​形状​而​非​注册表​：​裸​ UPPER_SNAKE ​名进​ .env；​小写​裸名​留在​ config.yaml ​顶层​。​约​ 700 ​个​文档​变量​中​的​ 290 ​个​只​从​环境​读​（TELEGRAM_GROUP_ALLOWED_USERS、HERMES_TIMEZONE……），​注册表​检查​总会​漏​——​所以​用​形状​。​这​与​ AGENTS.md ​的​铁律​一致​：.env ​只放​密钥​，​行为​进​ config.yaml。

docs.title: managed_scope：IT ​下发​层
docs.text: managed_scope.py ​是​「Managed scope — IT-pushed, user-immutable config & env layer」：​组织​下发​的​覆盖层​，​用户​不可​变​；config_effective ​把​它​叠​在​用户​层​之上​。

docs.title: 迁移
docs.text: config_migrations.py ​是​表​驱动​注册表​；config_migrations_browser.py ​注册​ 51→52 ​步​（agent-browser ​配置​迁移​）。config_version_stamp.py ​负责​从​ config.yaml ​裸读​ _config_version ​戳​。

docs.title: skin_engine：​每个​表面​的​主题​ SDK
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/skin_engine.py:1-37（​节选​）
"""Hermes skin/theme engine — the theme SDK for every surface."""

@dataclass
class SkinConfig:
    """Complete skin configuration."""
    name: str
    description: str = ""
    colors: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    # Paired palettes for the opposite background polarity (mirrors the desktop app's
    # colors/darkColors pairing): a light terminal prefers `light_colors` (falling back to
    # `colors`), and vice versa for `dark_colors`.
    light_colors: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    dark_colors: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    spinner: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    branding: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tool_prefix: str = "┊"
    tool_emojis: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)  # per-tool emoji overrides
    banner_logo: str = ""    # Rich-markup ASCII art logo (replaces HERMES_AGENT_LOGO)
    banner_hero: str = ""    # Rich-markup hero art (replaces HERMES_CADUCEUS)
    custom_css: str = ""     # Raw CSS injected as a <style> tag on the desktop GUI (32 KiB cap)

skin_cmd.py ​提供​ hermes skin ​的​ list/switch/tweak。​皮肤​同时​喂​ CLI、TUI、Web、​桌面​（custom_css ​直接​注入​桌面​ GUI ​的​ <style> ​标签​）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway/：​网关​的​ presence-sensitive env bridge ​读​ config_effective（​缺键​=​未​设置​语义​）。
  • doctor/setup：config_issues/config_check_diagnostics ​喂​体检​输出​。
  • dashboard/web_routers/config_env.py：config/env ​的​ HTTP ​视图​经同​一套​保存​原语​。
  • pm/：.env ​是​密钥​唯一​容身​处​的​政策​由本​簇​执行​（ UPPER_SNAKE ​形状​路由​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​配置​系统​的​分层​一句​话​：​默认​（DEFAULT_CONFIG）→ ​用户​（config.yaml，${VAR} ​先​展开​）→ ​托管​（managed overlay）。​想读​「​用户​到底​设没设​」​就​用​ config_effective；​想​写​就​回​ config.py ​门面​；​键​去​哪​由​形状​决定​。​皮肤​是​横切​所有​表面​的​纯​数据​ SDK。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​是​ CLI ​层​的​收尾​，​覆盖​四个​相关​簇​：

  • ​网关​客户端​簇​（35 ​文件​）：CLI ​进程​与​共享​网关​会话​之间​的​全部​通信​——gateway_agent.py（AIAgent ​兼容​表面​）、gateway_connection.py（​每​进程​一条​连接​）、gateway_client.py（​纯​传输​）、gateway_runtime*（​发现​/​附加​/​一次性​票据​）、gateway_connections_*（​远程​网关​含​ SSH ControlMaster）；
  • profiles ​簇​（15 ​文件​）：​隔离​ profile ​的​创建​/​克隆​/​改名​/​删除​/​分发​；
  • auth ​簇​（27 ​文件​）：​多​ provider ​凭据​系统​；
  • models ​簇​（20 ​文件​）：​模型​目录​/​切换​/​定价​/setup ​向导​。

docs.title: gateway_agent.py：CLI ​从不​构建​ agent
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/gateway_agent.py:1-8
"""The AIAgent surface main's HermesCLI uses, backed by the shared gateway session (CALLMAP §3.2-3.3).

``run_conversation`` submits ``prompt.submit`` and replays the gateway's event stream, on the
calling (agent) thread, into the SAME callbacks HermesCLI passed to ``AIAgent`` on main, then
returns a dict shaped like ``AIAgent.run_conversation``'s. The CLI process never builds an agent,
never runs a tool and never writes ``state.db``: the turn runs in the gateway.

Event contract: wave_a.md (frozen). Every frame is a gateway ``event`` with params
``{type, session_id, execution_generation, admission_id?, payload}``.
"""

​哲学​：GatewayAgent ​是​一个​AIAgent ​兼容​外壳​——HermesCLI ​以为​自己​在​和​ AIAgent ​说话​，​实际上​ run_conversation()（gateway_agent.py:750）​只是​提交​ prompt.submit RPC，​然后​在​调用​线程​上​回放​网关​事件​流​进​原来​的​回调​。CLI ​进程​不​构建​ agent、​不​跑​工具​、​不写​ state.db。​状态栏​读​的​ token ​计数​、​压缩器​视图​都​由​网关​的​ session.usage ​帧​映射​回来​（_COUNTER_FROM_USAGE ​表​，gateway_agent.py:47-58）。

docs.title: gateway_connection.py：​每​进程​一条​连接
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/gateway_connection.py:1-12
"""One gateway connection per classic-CLI process (CALLMAP §3.1, §4).

A daemon thread owns an asyncio loop and one ``GatewayClient``. It never calls a HermesCLI
method and never blocks: every event frame goes into a thread-safe ``queue.Queue`` that the
agent thread drains (``GatewayAgent.run_conversation``), and ``session.info``-class frames
also update the plain-attribute ``SessionState`` caches the status bar reads.

Callers on any other thread use ``call()``, which blocks on the loop's future; calling it on
the loop thread itself is a deadlock and raises.
"""

​线程​模型​：daemon ​线程​拥有​ asyncio loop + ​一个​ GatewayClient（gateway_connection.py:156 class GatewayConnection）；​事件​帧​进​ queue.Queue ​由​ agent ​线程​消费​；​其他​线程​用​ call()（​行​ 397）​阻塞​等​ future——​在​ loop ​线程​上​再​调​ call() ​是​死锁​，​直接​抛​。gateway_client.py ​则​是​「Transport-only RPC client. Closing a viewer never stops its authority」——​关掉​查看​者​不​停止​权威​（​网关​的​会​话​）。

docs.title: runtime attach：​一次性​会话​票据
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py:1-6
"""One client attach: find (or start) the profile's owner, then mint its single-use session ticket.

Shared by ``hermes gateway attach`` (any local client) and Ink's ``ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py``.
The ticket is a credential for the one process that dials: never log it, never put it in a repr.
"""

attach ​三步​：​发现​（gateway_runtime_discovery.py，​无​诊断​回退​）→ ​找​不到​就​启动​ owner（gateway_runtime_start.py ​一个​ detached ​进程​原语​）→ ​铸造​单次​会​话​票据​。​启动​策略​（​模型​、toolsets、kanban ​板​等​）​装在​ session.create ​里​走​ CLIENT_LAUNCH_ENV（gateway_runtime_attach.py:16-21），​不进​ daemon ​全局​默认​——​否则​一个​终端​启动​的​ daemon ​会​把​它​的​板​解析​强加​给​之后​所有​会话​。

docs.title: 远程​网关​：SSH ControlMaster
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/gateway_connections_ssh.py:1-10
"""Gateway SSH connections: a ControlMaster tunnel to a remote ``hermes serve``.

Server-side port of Desktop's SSH attach path. ``ensure_tunnel`` opens (or reuses) a ControlMaster
to the registry entry's host, starts or attaches a provably-owned ``serve --isolated`` there and
forwards a 127.0.0.1-only local port to it. Linux/macOS on both ends.

Ownership is scoped to THIS gateway's connections store, not to a Desktop install: two clients
sharing one remote never reap each other's serve. The serve's session token lives in process
memory only; a fresh process cannot prove the old serve's token, so it reaps that (provably owned)
serve and spawns anew.
"""

​隧道​=OpenSSH ControlMaster（gateway_connections_ssh_transport.py）；​远端​ serve --isolated ​的​可​证明​所有权​决定​生死​：token ​只​在​本​进程​内存​，​新​进程​证明​不了​旧​ serve ​的​ token，​就​ reap ​旧​ serve ​再起​新​的​——​两个​客户端​共享​一个​远程​也​不会​互相​ reap。

docs.title: auth.py：​凭据​系统核心
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/auth.py:1-11
"""Multi-provider authentication system for Hermes Agent.

- ``ProviderConfig`` / ``PROVIDER_REGISTRY`` describe every known inference provider.
- The auth store (``~/.hermes/auth.json``) holds per-provider state, the credential pool and
  suppression markers; ``_auth_store_lock`` / ``_load_auth_store`` / ``_save_auth_store`` are the
  only I/O primitives (cross-process flock, atomic 0o600 writes).
- ``resolve_provider()`` picks the active provider via the documented priority chain.
- ``OAUTH_PROVIDER_FLOWS`` maps each OAuth provider to its resolver/status builder; ...
"""

​身份​事实​源​是​ providers.py（「Single source of truth for provider identity」）​与​ provider_catalog.py；OAuth ​流程​住​在​ auth_nous/auth_codex/auth_xai/... ​并​ re-import ​回​ auth.py ​保持​可​补丁​面​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/：GatewayAgent ​实现​与​ AIAgent ​相同​的​ run_conversation ​契约​——mixin ​感知​不到​差异​。
  • gateway/（​服务端​）：wave_a.md ​事件​契约​冻结​；gateway/run.py ​的​ Guard-1/Guard-2 ​消费​ busy_policy。
  • cli.py：process_command ​里​ gateway_setting_commands/gateway_cli_commands/gateway_plugin_commands ​是​本​簇​伸进​ slash ​派发​的​桥​（​见​ slash_registry.md）。
  • **web_routers/gateway_connections.py*：Webapp ​的​保存​网关​/SSH reach ​路由​调本​簇​。
  • update_system：​舰队​重启​的​对象​就是​本簇​负责​发现​/​附加​的​网关​。
  • config_skins：profile ​隔离​以​ get_hermes_home() ​为​锚​；profiles ​簇是​其​管理​面​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这四簇​共享​一个​主题​：​所有权​与​事实​源​的​唯一性​。​网关​拥有​ turn（CLI ​只​回放​）；owner ​网关​拥有​ profile ​的​服务​定义​；providers.py ​拥有​ provider ​身份​；auth.json ​的​三个​ I/O ​原语​拥有​凭据​字节​。CLI ​侧​的​全部​复杂度​——​单​连接​、​事件队列​、​一次性​票据​、ControlMaster ​所有权​——​都​是​「​不​构建​ agent ​的​进程​如何​安全​参与​」​这个​问题​的​答案​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
hermes_cli/ ​下​ 25 ​个​ kanban*.py ​文件​构成​跨​ profile ​的​任务​看​板​：

  • ​板​：kanban_db.py（SQLite ​板​，​跨​ profile ​协调​原语​）+ _boards/_connect/_graph/_notify/_context/_workspace ​兄弟​；
  • ​派发​：kanban_db_dispatch.py（​崩溃​检测​/​断路器​/​并发​上限​/worker ​生成​/​守护​循环​）+ kanban_worker_client.py（worker ​侧​）；
  • ​命令​面​：kanban.py（hermes kanban … ​派发​ + /kanban）+ kanban_parser/_output/_boards/_ops；
  • ​工作​流​：kanban_workflow.py（​列​定义​）、kanban_swarm/decompose/specify/transfer/pr_acceptance/resume_guard/diagnostics/owner_recovery。

docs.title: kanban_db.py：SQLite ​板
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/kanban_db.py:1-13
"""SQLite-backed Kanban board shared across profiles (the cross-profile coordination primitive).

Lives under the shared Hermes root: ``default`` board DB at ``<root>/kanban.db`` (pre-boards
back-compat), other boards at ``<root>/kanban/boards/<slug>/``; a worker on one board never sees
another. Board resolution: ``board=`` arg > ``HERMES_KANBAN_BOARD`` > ``HERMES_KANBAN_DB`` (pins
the file path) > ``<root>/kanban/current`` > ``default`` — but only for unfenced callers; the
dispatcher injects these into workers, and dispatched workers (``HERMES_KANBAN_TASK``), delegated
children and board-enumerating machine flows ... always resolve through the pin, so workers
physically cannot see other boards.
Concurrency: WAL + ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` + compare-and-swap on ``tasks.status``/``claim_lock`` —
SQLite serializes writers so one claimer wins, losers see zero rows (no retries, no distributed
locks). Schema: tasks, task_links, task_comments, task_events, task_runs, attachments, notify subs.
"""

​两个​设计​支点​：

  1. ​板​隔离​是​物理​的​：worker ​经​环境​ pin（HERMES_KANBAN_TASK ​等​）​解析​板​，​永远​看不到​别的​板​——​不是​靠​约定​，​是​靠​注入​；
  2. ​并发​靠​ SQLite ​写者​串行化​：WAL + BEGIN IMMEDIATE + ​对​ tasks.status/claim_lock ​的​ CAS——​一个​认领​者​赢​，​输家​看到​零行​更新​，​无需​重试​、​无需​分布式​锁​。

docs.title: 派发​器​：​崩溃​检测​ + ​断路器
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/kanban_db_dispatch.py:1-7
"""Dispatcher: crash/stale/orphan detection, failure accounting and the respawn circuit breaker,
memory-aware concurrency caps, the one-shot ``dispatch_once`` pass, worker spawning
(``_default_spawn``), worker-log rotation and the long-lived ``run_daemon`` loop.
...
"""
# ​行​ 33-44
# After this many consecutive non-success attempts on a task/profile the
# dispatcher parks the task in ``blocked`` with a reason — prevents retry storms.
DEFAULT_FAILURE_LIMIT = 2

# Keep a little wall-clock budget for the worker to observe a terminal timeout
# and make a terminal board call (kanban_block/kanban_complete/kanban_request_review)
# before max_runtime_seconds kills it.
KANBAN_TERMINAL_TIMEOUT_GRACE_SECONDS = 30

​断路器​：​同一​ task/profile ​连续​ 2 ​次非​成功​就​把​任务​停进​ blocked ​并​附​原因​——​掐灭​重试​风暴​。​终止​超时​前留​ 30 ​秒​宽限​，​让​ worker ​有​机会​做​一次​终态​板​调用​（kanban_block/kanban_complete/kanban_request_review）​再​被​杀​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• worktree_ ​簇​*：​看​板​任务​的​ worktree ​工作​区​落到​同​一套​ worktree ​注册表​/​回收​（​见​ repl_mixins.md ​的​ /worktree）。
  • gateway/：​通知​订阅​由​ gateway kanban-notifier ​消费​；worker ​的​ turn ​经​ profile owner（​网关​）​执行​。
  • cron/：kanban cron ​行​；daemon ​由​调度​器拉起​。
  • gateway_runtime_attach.py：CLIENT_LAUNCH_ENV ​里​有​ HERMES_KANBAN_BOARD——​启动​策略​随会话​传递​，daemon ​不会​把​本​终端​的​板​泄漏​给​后续​所有​会话​。
  • kanban_resume_guard.py：​恢复​看​板​拥有​会话​的​唯一​守卫​（#68779）——​防止​被​派发​的​会​话​被​用户​误​接手​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​看板​是​「​用​ SQLite ​做​分布式​协调​」​的​教科书​案例​：​写者​串行化​代替​分布式​锁​，​环境​ pin ​代替​命名​约定​，​断路器​代替​无限​重试​。worker ​永远​只是​提交​认领​的​薄壳​，​真正​的​ turn ​由​ profile owner ​跑​——​与​「CLI ​是​网关​的​查看​者​」​一脉相承​。

docs.title: 本地​模型​运行​时​与​转发​代理
文件​概览
docs.text:
​本篇​覆盖​两个​小子​系统​：

  • hermes_cli/local_runtime/（19 ​文件​ + catalog.json）：​托管​ llama.cpp ​本地​模型​运行​时​——​检测​、​硬件​估算​、​进程​监督​、​恢复​；
  • hermes_cli/proxy/（5 ​文件​ + adapters/ 4 ​文件​）：​本地​ OpenAI ​兼容​转发​代理​，​给​ OAuth ​化​的​上游​附加​凭据​。

docs.title: detect.py：​指纹​级​实例​检测
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/local_runtime/detect.py:1-9
"""Detection of running llama-server instances.

Probes well-known local roots and fingerprints genuine llama-server via /props (build_info + model
fields — Ollama and LM Studio answer /v1/models but not /props). Detection never needs a key, but
honors one if the probed server requires it (401 -> detected, auth_required=True).
"""

# ​行​ 13-15
# Always 127.0.0.1 — resolving localhost costs ~2s/request on Windows.
DEFAULT_PROBE_PORTS = (8080,)  # llama-server default; managed port comes from config

​指纹​用​ /props ​而​非​ /v1/models：Ollama ​和​ LM Studio ​都​会​应答​后者​，​但​只有​真​ llama-server ​有​ /props ​的​ build_info + model ​字​段​。​探测​永远​打​ 127.0.0.1——Windows ​上​解析​ localhost ​每​请求​多花​约​ 2 ​秒​（IPv6 ​回退​），​这​条​教训​在​ supervisor.py ​里​重复​出现​。

docs.text:
# hermes_cli/local_runtime/estimator.py:1-5
"""Per-layer context-memory estimator + physics check.

The estimator is ADVISORY: fit's allocation is authoritative at launch and the touch generation is
ground truth after it. Unknown shapes round UP (never underestimate memory).
"""
# ​行​ 12-17
# q8_0: 34-byte blocks of 32 f16-equivalent elements (exact).
_Q8_BYTES_PER_ELEM = 34 / 32
_F16_BYTES_PER_ELEM = 2.0

# Architectures with a known SWA layer pattern: arch -> fraction of layers that are
# sliding-window. Unknown SWA archs treat every layer as full attention (overestimate; safe).
_SWA_LAYER_FRACTION = {"gemma3": 5 / 6, "gemma2": 1 / 2}

​估算​器​只是​建议​：​启动​时以​ fit ​的​分配​为准​，​启动​后以​ touch generation（​真跑​一遍​）​为准​。​未知​形状​一律​向上​取整​——​永不​低估​显存​。

docs.title: supervisor.py：​路由​模式​的​进程​监督
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/local_runtime/supervisor.py:1-6
"""Supervision of one llama-server in router mode.

The router process is ours (restart with backoff on crash); router children are its problem — child
failures surface via GET /models exit_code, never auto-retried here. Learned on real hardware:
health-200 is NOT readiness — every readiness claim requires a touch generation (temp-0, expected
token, generous budget, reasoning_content scanned); always dial 127.0.0.1 ...

​监督​边界​清晰​：router ​进程​归​我们​（​崩溃​退避​重启​），router ​的​子​模型​是​它​自己​的​事​——​子​失败​经​ GET /models ​的​ exit_code ​冒​出​，​这里​绝不​自动​重试​。​健康检查​ 200 ≠ ​就绪​：​每次​就绪​声明​都​要​一次​ touch generation（temp-0、​期望​ token、​宽​预算​、​扫​ reasoning_content）。

docs.title: proxy/server.py：​凭据​附加​转发器
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/proxy/server.py:1-5
"""HTTP server that forwards OpenAI-compatible requests to a configured upstream.

A credential-attaching forwarder: request/response bodies are never mediated, logged, or rewritten.
The one shim: after a *clean* upstream EOF, a ``text/event-stream`` response that carried a terminal
``finish_reason`` or ``lastOne: true`` but omitted ``data: [DONE]`` gets a single ``[DONE]`` frame.
"""
# ​行​ 37-40
_HOP_BY_HOP_HEADERS = frozenset({
    "host", "content-length", "connection", "keep-alive", "proxy-authenticate",
    "proxy-authorization", "te", "trailers", "transfer-encoding", "upgrade", "authorization",
})

​转发​语义​：​请求​/​响应​体​不​中介​、​不​记录​、​不​重写​；​剥离​ hop-by-hop ​头​，authorization ​换成​上游​ bearer。​唯一​的​ shim ​是​ SSE [DONE] ​帧​补全​——​严格​ OpenAI ​客户端​把​没有​ data: [DONE] ​的​流​视为​截断​：

# hermes_cli/proxy/sse_done.py:1-6
"""SSE ``[DONE]`` sentinel normalization for OpenAI-compatible proxies.

Strict OpenAI clients treat a stream without ``data: [DONE]`` as truncated. The tracker watches the
forwarded SSE bytes and says whether to append ONE ``[DONE]`` after a *clean* upstream EOF: only after
a terminal choice (``finish_reason`` non-null) or ``lastOne: true``; never after an error event, an
interrupted stream, or when the upstream already sent ``[DONE]``.
"""

​适配器​：adapters/base.py ​定义​ UpstreamAdapter ​抽象​；nous_portal.py、xai.py ​是​两个​ OAuth ​上游​实现​。​代理​默认​绑​ 127.0.0.1:8645，​请求​体​上限​ 10 MB。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​本地​运行​时​的​三条​硬​教训​写​在​源码​注释​里​：(1) ​指纹​用​ /props ​不用​ /v1/models；(2) ​永远​打​ 127.0.0.1；(3) health-200 ​不是​就绪​——​就绪​必须​ touch generation。​代理​则​是​一个​诚实​的​转发器​：​只​附加​凭据​与​补​ [DONE]，​其余​字节​不​碰​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
hermes_cli/observability/ ​共​ 32 ​个​ py ​文件​ + schemas/ 4 ​个​ JSON schema（v1..v4），​实现​ shared_metrics：​同意​门控​的​用量​遥测​。​设计​分层​：

  • ​门​：shared_metrics_consent.py——​唯一​的​同意​答案​；​未​同意​一切​为​ no-op；
  • ​采集​ API：shared_metrics_events.py（​进程​级​事实​）、shared_metrics_gateway.py（​网关​/cron）、shared_metrics_desktop.py——​调用​点​直接​调​，raw ​值进​、​永不​抛​；
  • ​契约​：shared_metrics_contract.py（​有​界​产品​契约​）+ shared_metrics_fields.py（​字​段​构造​器​）+ shared_metrics_catalog.py（​公开​名​目录​）；
  • ​领域​事实​：busy/connectors/efficiency/engagement/harness/loop/model/install/setup/update/startup/process/disabled/drift/prepared_compaction/signals ​等​一个​主题​一​文件​；
  • ​出口​：shared_metrics.py（SQLite ​聚合​ + ​本地​导出​）、shared_metrics_sender.py（​上传​ Nous ​遥测​服务​）、relay_shared_metrics.py（NeMo Relay ​直连​）、shared_metrics_subscriber.py（Relay ​订阅​者​）、shared_metrics_send_config.py（​传输​配置​）。

docs.title: 关键​代码​走读
docs.text:
​一条​事件​的​数据流​：

​调用​点​ → _emit()（enabled ​门​）→ fields_ ​归一化​ → relay_shared_metrics.record_process_mark → SQLite ​聚合​ → ​每日​导出​包​ → sender ​上传​。

​中途​任何​异常​都​在​ _emit ​的​ try ​内​吞掉​——​遥测​永远​不​影响​用户​的​ turn；​字​段​构造​器​返回​ None ​时该​ mark ​整个​不落盘​。

docs.title: 同意​是​唯一​开关
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/observability/shared_metrics_consent.py:1-10（​节选​）
"""The one shared-metrics consent answer, and the terminal's first-run offer.

Every surface reads and writes the same two keys in the profile's config.yaml:
``telemetry.shared_metrics.enabled`` (collect) and ``.send`` (upload daily). The offer has two
answers, and each sets both keys: "Share with Nous" turns both on, "No thanks" turns both off.
The question counts as answered once either key is written explicitly; the shipped defaults are
not an answer.

​要点​：

  • ​两个​键​ telemetry.shared_metrics.enabled（​收集​）​与​ .send（​每日​上传​）​总是​成对​写​；​出厂​默认​不算​回答​；
  • ​消息​网关​从不​询问​——​聊天​参与者​不是​安装​所有者​；​终端​在​ hermes setup ​末尾​问​，​未​回答​的​ profile ​在​首次​交互​ hermes ​前问​一次​；​桌面​把​征求​画成​ composer strip；
  • 「No thanks」​若缺​ offer_version（​早​于​ type-ahead ​修复​，​启动​中误​按​ Enter ​可能​ unseen ​保存​）​会​再​问​一次​并​附​原因​。

docs.title: 调用​点​ API：no-op ​默认​、​永不​抛
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/observability/shared_metrics_events.py:1-8（​节选​）
"""Call-site API for process-level shared-metrics facts.

Setup completion, slash commands, compression, model switches, fallbacks and extension installs
happen outside any single tool or model call, so their producers call these functions directly.
Every function takes RAW values (normalization lives in shared_metrics_fields), is a no-op unless
shared metrics are enabled, and never raises into the caller.
"""

def _emit(mark: str, build: Callable[..., dict[str, str] | None], **raw: Any) -> None:
    try:
        from .relay_shared_metrics import enabled, record_process_mark

        if not enabled():
            return
        data = build(**raw)
        if data is not None:
            record_process_mark(mark, data)
    except Exception:

docs.title: record_slash_command：CLI ​每条​命令​的​计数​点
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/observability/shared_metrics_events.py:50-51
def record_slash_command(*, command: str, surface: str) -> None:
    _emit(contract.SLASH_COMMAND_MARK, fields_.slash_command_fields, command=command, surface=surface)

​调用​方是​ cli.py process_command（cli.py:1164）——canonical ​名​ + surface（"cli"）。​类​属性​ _slash_metrics_surface: str | None = "cli" ​的​注释​说明​了​ None ​的​语义​：​另​一个​进程​拥有​计数​（TUI slash worker ​场景​由​ tui_gateway ​记账​），​避免​双计​。

docs.title: 持久​化​与​发送
docs.text: shared_metrics.py ​用​ SQLite（hermes_cli.sqlite_util.write_txn）​做​持久​聚合​，​按天​导出​ JSON ​包​（utils.atomic_json_write），atexit ​兜底​ flush。schema ​版本​ v1→v4 ​演进​记录​在​ observability/schemas/hermes.shared_metrics.v*.schema.json——​旧版本​行经​ shared_metrics_drift.py「conform」（​未知​维度​形状​整行​降级​）​而​不是​丢弃​。

docs.title: schema ​演进​与​ drift ​收敛
docs.text:
schema ​内容​要点​ v1 ​第一片​：slash ​命令​、​压缩​、provider setup ​等​进程​级​事实​ v2 ​参与度​/​效率​/​模型​质量​等​日​聚合​行​ v3 connector ​链路​、harness ​准确性​、v5 ​信号​（shared_metrics_signals） v4 ​桌面​自​报​、install.run、prepared compaction

shared_metrics_drift.py ​的​职责​：​一个​更​早​ build ​或​旧​目录​写入​的​行​，​其​维度​形状​当前​契约​已​不​认识​时​，conform_counter_dimensions() ​把​它​收敛​成​已知​形状​、counter_dimensions_shape_is_known() ​判定​是否​整行​降级​——​数据​向前​兼容​，​而​不是​静默​丢弃​。​发送​侧​ shared_metrics_send_config.py ​决定​包​怎么​传​，shared_metrics_sender.py ​执行​上传​，shared_metrics_subscriber.py ​是​ Relay ​订阅​端​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• cli.py：process_command ​记​ slash ​命令​；run() ​挂​ shared_metrics_startup.cli_prompt_ready_handler。
  • gateway/：​网关​面经​ shared_metrics_gateway ​上报​（chat ​参与者​永不​被​问​同意​）。
  • web_routers/shared_metrics.py：dashboard ​的​ /api/shared-metrics/consent ​端点​。
  • apps/desktop/：​桌面​经​ RPC（consent-strip.tsx）​读写​同一​对​同意​键​。
  • AGENTS.md ​铁律​：​遥测​必须​有​ opt-in ​门​——​本​子系统​的​同意​键​就是​那道​门​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​整套​遥测​的​骨架​是​三句话​：​同意​（​两个​键成​对​写​，​默认​不是​回答​）→ ​原子事件​（raw ​进​、​永不​抛​、​未​同意​即​ no-op）→ ​契约​收敛​（schema ​有​界​、​旧行​ drift-conform ​而​不​丢​）。​新增​指标​ = ​契约​加​一行​ + fields ​加​一个​构造​器​ + ​主题​文件​加​一个​调用​点​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
cli.py ​的​ HermesCLI ​类​由​ 18 ​个​ mixin ​组装​（​行​ 881）。​每个​ mixin ​拆出​ cli.py ​的​一个​主题​：

  • ​每个​ mixin ​文件​都​遵循​同一​约定​：cli.py ​内部​符号​在​方法​内​惰性​ import（from cli import _cprint），​绝不​模块​级​ import——​避免​循环​且​让​ cli.py ​保持​补丁​ seam；
  • ​行为​写​在​兄弟​文件​里​，cli.py ​门面​只​保留​公共​入口​和​ re-export（​机械​拆分​ #116911）。

docs.title: run() ​五步
docs.text:
HermesCLI.run()（cli.py:1407）​是​ REPL ​的​装配​点​，​可​读作​五步​：

# cli.py:1407-1426
def run(self):
    """Run the interactive CLI loop with persistent input at bottom."""
    if not self._claim_active_session("cli"):
        return                                  # ​步骤​ 1：​跨​进程​活动​会话​租约​（active_sessions.py）

    self._tui_print_startup()
    self._tui_init_run_state()
    kb = self._tui_build_key_bindings()         # ​步骤​ 2：​构建​ key bindings / layout / Application
    layout, style = self._tui_build_layout(kb)
    app = self._tui_build_application(layout, kb, style)

# cli.py:1436-1452（​步骤​ 3：patch prompt_toolkit ​渲染器​修​ ghost-line）
        try:
            import prompt_toolkit.renderer as _pt_renderer
            from prompt_toolkit.renderer import _output_screen_diff as _orig_osd

            if not getattr(_pt_renderer, "_hermes_osd_patched", False):
                _pt_renderer._output_screen_diff = functools.partial(
                    _hermes_call_output_screen_diff, _orig_osd
                )
                _pt_renderer._hermes_osd_patched = True
        except Exception:
            pass

ghost-line ​补丁​的​ WHY（​源码​注释​，cli.py:1437-1440）：prompt_toolkit ​渲染器​每次​绘制​后​把​光标​移​到​画布​底部​以​滚动​终端​；​终端​列宽​收缩​时旧​的​全宽行​被​重​排成​多行​推入​回滚区​，​留下​重复​的​「​幽灵​」​状态栏​。​包装​ _output_screen_diff，​在​其​ current_height > previous_screen.height ​分支​前​膨胀​ previous_screen.height，​让​分支​不​触发​。

​步骤​ 4：​后台​线程​与​清理​——spinner ​线程​、TUI ​处理​线程​、​唤醒​词​线程​；atexit.register(_run_cleanup)（hermes_cli/cli_shutdown.py）+ ​信号处理器​。​步骤​ 5：with patch_stdout(): app.run()，EOFError/KeyboardInterrupt ​直接​吞掉​作为​正常​退出​。

docs.title: 输入​入口​：/ ​开头​走​ slash ​派发
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/cli_tui_runtime_mixin.py:173-183
def _tui_run_slash_input(self, user_input: str):
    """Dispatch a slash command. Returns the pending agent seed to run as a chat turn, else None."""
    from cli import _cprint
    _cprint(f"\n⚙️  {user_input}")
    try:
        if not self.process_command(user_input):
            self._should_exit = True
            if self._app.is_running:
                self._app.exit()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        # Ctrl+C during a slow slash command returns to the prompt instead of exiting.
        _cprint(f"\n[dim]{t('cli.tui.command_interrupted')}[/dim]")

process_command ​返回​ False ​即​退出​ REPL；​慢​命令​中​的​ Ctrl+C ​只​回到​提示符​。

docs.title: 每​ turn ​相位​（cli_chat_turn_mixin）
docs.text:
chat() ​把​一个​用户​输入​跑​成​相位​链​：​图片​路由​ → ​暂存​（staging）→ agent ​线程​ → ​中断​监视​ → ​渲染​。turn ​之后​的​簿记​在​ _tui_after_turn：

# hermes_cli/cli_tui_runtime_mixin.py:184-206
def _tui_after_turn(self):
    """Post-turn bookkeeping after chat() returns (normal, error, or interrupt)."""
    from cli import _DIM, _RST, _cprint
    self._agent_running = self._pet_reasoning = False
    self._spinner_text = self._last_scrollback_tool = ""
    ...
    # After an interrupt the renderer may have drifted (leaked CPR text, VT100 parser
    # stalled mid-escape): drain stray bytes and force a clean redraw.
    if self._last_turn_interrupted:
        self._recover_terminal_after_interrupt()

docs.text:
clarify（ctx.ask_choice）、​工具​批准​、sudo/secret ​捕获​、​命令​面板​、​外部​编辑器​都​做成​ prompt_toolkit ​覆盖层​。​工具​回调​在​ run ​时​挂接​：

# cli.py:962-966
    def _install_tool_callbacks(self) -> None:
        """Install tool callbacks that need the live prompt UI."""
        if self._tool_callbacks_installed:

        set_sudo_password_callback(self._sudo_password_callback)

docs.title: 流式​渲染​（cli_stream_mixin）
docs.text: agent ​的​流式​输出​、reasoning ​预览​、​工具​进度​回调​都​在​这里​落到​屏幕​；agent ​忙碌​时​由​状态栏​ mixin ​的​ spinner ​循环​驱动​，slash ​命令​在​忙碌​期由​ busy_policy ​决定​拒绝​/​打断​/​照常​派发​（​见​ slash_registry.md）。

docs.title: 一次性​模式​：-q / -Q
docs.text: ​非​交互​不​走​ run()：-q ​一次性​问答​由​ hermes_cli/cli_single_query.py ​编排​（goal ​循环​、​退出​码​映射​、​图片​路由​、​信号处理​）；-Q ​静默​模式​由​ hermes_cli/quiet_single_query.py ​处理​——​它​还要​绑定​本会话​ key、​恢复​嵌套​ notify，​供​ Bot Mode ​的​ hermes -p <bot> chat -Q --query-file ​使用​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/：cli_agent_setup_mixin ​构建​ AIAgent；​流式​回调​契约​由​ cli_stream_mixin ​实现​。
  • gateway/：gateway_setting_commands/gateway_cli_commands/gateway_plugin_commands ​在​ process_command ​中​被​调用​，​把​网关​拥有​的​设置​/​命令​接进来​。
  • observability/：run() ​挂​ cli_prompt_ready_handler；​每条​ slash ​命令​经​ record_slash_command ​计数​。
  • tools/：quick command ​的​ exec ​用​ tools.environments.local.build_subprocess_env ​洗​环境变量​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: REPL ​的​可读​入口​只有​两个​：run()（​装配​）​与​ process_command()（​派发​）。​其余​一切​——​渲染​、​模态​、​语音​、​模型​切换​、​会话​生命周期​——​都​是​ 18 ​个​ mixin ​中​一个​主题​文件​的​责任​。​改动​时先​找​ mixin，​再​回到​ cli.py ​只​为​确认​ seam。

docs.title: Slash ​命令​注册表​与​两层​派发
文件​概览
docs.text:
slash ​命令​有​两个​事实​源​，​分​两层​：

  • ​层​ 1：cli.py:1117 ​的​类级表​ _SLASH_DISPATCH——canonical ​名​ → (​方法​名​, ​是否​传​原始​输入​)，​缺席​命令​按​命名​约定​ _handle_<name>_command ​经​ getattr ​命中​；
  • ​层​ 2：hermes_cli/commands.py ​的​中央​注册表​ COMMAND_REGISTRY——「CLI help、gateway dispatch、Telegram BotCommands、Slack subcommand mapping、autocomplete ​都​从​ COMMAND_REGISTRY ​派生​」。​加​命令​ = ​追加​一个​ CommandDef。

​兄弟​文件​：commands_completion.py（​补全​）、commands_platforms.py（Telegram BotCommands/Discord/Slack ​列表​派生​）、slash_exec.py（​表面​无关​执行器​）。

docs.title: CommandDef：​注册表​的​一行
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/commands.py:45-93
class CommandDef:
    """Definition of a single slash command."""
    name: str                          # canonical name without slash: "background"
    description: str                   # human-readable description
    category: str                      # "Session", "Configuration", etc.
    aliases: tuple[str, ...] = ()      # alternative names: ("bg",)
    args_hint: str = ""                # argument placeholder: "<prompt>", "[name]"
    subcommands: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # tab-completable subcommands
    cli_only: bool = False             # only available in CLI
    gateway_only: bool = False         # only available in gateway/messaging
    gateway_config_gate: str | None = None  # config dotpath; truthy overrides cli_only for gateway
    # Mid-run (agent busy) gateway behavior ...
    busy_policy: str = "reject"
    busy_handler: str | None = None  # key of a special mid-run handler in Guard-2 table
    # Key in ``hermes_cli.slash_exec.EXECUTORS`` (a string, not a callable: keeps this module
    # import-light for the gateway).
    execute: str | None = None
    argument_mode: str | None = None  # desktop composer: options|text|mixed; None inferred
    desktop: str | None = None
    desktop_subcommands: tuple[str, ...] | None = None

execute ​存​字符串​键​而​非​可​调用​对象​，​是​有意​的​：commands.py ​被​ gateway ​在​早期​ import，​执行器​（slash_exec.EXECUTORS）​惰性​解析​，​保持​模块​ import ​轻​。

docs.title: 两层​派发​（ASCII）
docs.text:
​用户​输入​ "/bg 5"
      │
      ▼
process_command()  cli.py:1152
      │ ​小写​化​(​仅​匹配​用​，args ​保​大小写​)
      ▼
resolve_command("bg") ──── hermes_cli/commands.py:402   ​别名​→canonical "background"
      │                                      （​层​ 2：​注册表​）
      ▼
_slash_handler("background")  cli.py:1139                （​层​ 1：​类级表​）
      │ _SLASH_DISPATCH ​命中​ → ("_handle_background_command", True)
      │ ​缺席​时试​ getattr(cls, "_handle_<name>_command")
      ▼
gateway_setting_commands.run → ​插件​ pre_command ​钩子​ → gateway_cli_commands.run → mixin handler

docs.title: process_command ​六步
docs.text:
# cli.py:1152-1200（​节选​）
    def process_command(self, command: str, *, redispatch: bool = False) -> bool:
        cmd_lower = command.lower().strip()  # lowercase only for matching; args keep their case
        cmd_original = command.strip()

        # Aliases resolve via the central registry (hermes_cli/commands.py).
        from hermes_cli.commands import resolve_command as _resolve_cmd
        _base_word = cmd_lower.split()[0].lstrip("/")
        _cmd_def = _resolve_cmd(_base_word)
        canonical = _cmd_def.name if _cmd_def else _base_word
        if not redispatch and self._slash_metrics_surface:
            from hermes_cli.observability.shared_metrics_events import record_slash_command
            record_slash_command(command=canonical, surface=self._slash_metrics_surface)

​六步​依次​是​：(1) ​小写​化​匹配​用​副本​；(2) resolve_command ​别名​→canonical；(3) ​记​ shared_metrics_events.record_slash_command（redispatch ​标记​内部​重​入​，​用户​命令​只计​一次​）；(4) _slash_handler ​查层​ 1；(5) ​网关​设置​命令​ gateway_setting_commands.run + ​插件​ pre_command ​钩子​（plugins.fire_pre_command_hook）+ gateway_cli_commands.run（checkpoints/.env/handoff ​等​网关​拥有​的​状态​）；(6) mixin handler，​返回​ False ​即​退出​ REPL。

docs.title: 未注册​命令​的​优先级​链
docs.text:
# cli.py:1202-1233
    def _process_unregistered_slash(self, cmd_original: str, cmd_lower: str) -> bool:
        """Slash input with no built-in handler; precedence: quick_commands -> plugins -> bundles -> skills -> prefix expansion."""
        base_cmd = cmd_lower.split()[0]
        bare = base_cmd.lstrip("/")
        skill_bundles = get_skill_bundles()
        quick_commands = self.config.get("quick_commands", {})
        user_args = cmd_original[len(base_cmd):].strip()
        if bare in quick_commands:
            return self._run_quick_command(base_cmd, quick_commands[bare], user_args)
        ...
        if plugin or (plugin is None and bare in _get_plugin_cmd_handler_names()):
            gone = self._run_plugin_slash_command(base_cmd, user_args) is gateway_plugin_commands.GONE
            if not gone:
                return True
            skill_commands = _session_skill_commands(self)  # the reload may have changed the skills
        if base_cmd in skill_bundles:  # also a name a gateway plugin reload just dropped (GONE)
            self._run_skill_bundle_command(base_cmd, skill_bundles[base_cmd], user_args)
        elif base_cmd in skill_commands:
            self._run_skill_slash_command(base_cmd, skill_commands[base_cmd], user_args)
        elif not (gone and gateway_plugin_commands.report_gone(bare, skill_commands, skill_bundles)):
            return self._expand_slash_prefix(cmd_original, cmd_lower, skill_commands, skill_bundles)

​优先级​：​用户​ quick_commands（alias ​重​派发​ / exec shell ​片段​）→ ​网关​插件​命令​ → ​插件​ slash handlers → skill bundles → skill commands → _expand_slash_prefix。​都​没​命中​则​打印​ cli_unknown_command.py ​的​文案​。

docs.title: busy_policy ​语义​（​网关​ Guard-2 ​派发​器​）
docs.text: 值​ ​语义​ dispatch agent ​忙碌​时​照常​执行​（​或​走​ busy_handler ​变体​） reject ​忙碌​期​拒绝​（​通用​「Agent is running」，​或​ busy_handler ​指定​的​拒绝​文案​） interrupt_then_dispatch ​先​打断​当前​ turn ​再​执行​（/stop、/new、/reset；Guard 1）

docs.text:
# hermes_cli/slash_exec.py:1-6
"""Registry-owned slash command execution (thin slice).

Invariant: an executor's output depends only on ``ctx.args`` / ``ctx.options`` — never on
``ctx.surface`` — so the core text is identical across surfaces for a fixed context (enforced by
tests/hermes_cli/test_commands_execute.py).
"""

CommandContext(surface, args, options, config_get) ​进​、CommandReply(text, data, format) ​出​；​执行器​是​纯​格式化​器​，​不​动​ agent/session。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• observability/：​每次​用户​键入​的​命令​经​ record_slash_command ​进​ shared_metrics。
  • plugins/：fire_pre_command_hook ​观察者​钩子​；​插件​命令​经​ plugin_command_dispatch ​执行​。
  • skills/：skill bundles（/<bundle> ​一次​装多​技能​）​与​ skill slash ​命令​是​优先级​链​末端​。
  • gateway/：busy_policy ​的​消费​方在​ gateway/run.py Guard-2 ​派发​器​与​ platforms/base.py Guard-1。
  • apps/desktop/：desktop/argument_mode/desktop_subcommands ​字段​喂​桌面​命令​面板​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​记住​三件​事​：(1) ​加​命令​ = ​在​ COMMAND_REGISTRY ​追加​一个​ CommandDef +（​可​选​）​一个​ mixin handler ​或​ EXECUTOR；(2) ​层​ 1 ​快表​只是​ CLI ​的​方法​路由​，​层​ 2 ​注册表​才​是​跨​表面​契约​；(3) ​未注册​输入​走​一条​明确​优先级​链​，quick_commands ​永远​最先​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
hermes_cli/subcommands/ ​共​ 65 ​个​文件​，​每个​是​ hermes <topic> ​的​ argparse ​构建​器​。​分发​结构​：

  • hermes_cli/_parser.py ​只放​顶层​ parser ​和​ chat ​子​ parser；
  • ​其余​每个​子​ parser ​由​ subcommands/<group>.py ​构建​，​在​ main._build_cli_parser ​中​接线​并​注入​ cmd_* handler；
  • ​大多数​ handler ​走​惰性​ import（cmd_sessions_lazy ​模式​）：​只有​子​命令​真正​运行​时才​ import ​对应​实现​模块​；
  • _shared.py ​提供​ add_json_flag / add_yes_flag ​等​共用​旗标​。

docs.title: 分发​接线
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/_parser.py:1-6
"""Top-level argparse construction for the hermes CLI.

Only the top-level parser and the ``chat`` subparser live here. Every other subparser (model,
gateway, sessions, …) is built by ``hermes_cli/subcommands/<group>.py`` and wired in
``main._build_cli_parser`` with its ``cmd_*`` handler injected.
"""

--profile / -p ​不​在​ parser ​上​——​它​在​ argparse ​之前​被​ main._apply_profile_override ​消费​（​设置​ HERMES_HOME ​并​把​自己​从​ argv ​剥掉​），​文件​里​用​ PRE_ARGPARSE_INHERITED_FLAGS ​保留​这份​元​数据​。

docs.title: 代表​一​：update.py（​简述​，​详见​ update_system.md）
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/subcommands/update.py:9-30（​节选​）
def build_update_parser(subparsers, *, cmd_update: Callable) -> None:
    """Attach the ``update`` subcommand to ``subparsers``."""
    from hermes_cli.release_channels import validate_name
    update_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "update", help="Update Hermes Agent to the latest version",
        description="Pull the latest changes from git and reinstall dependencies")
    update_parser.add_argument(
        "--check", action="store_true", default=False,
        help="Check whether an update is available without installing anything")
    update_parser.add_argument(
        "--plan", action="store_true", default=False,
        help="Show the update plan and exit without changing anything: install "
            "kind (git/docker/nix), every running Hermes service across all "
            "profiles with its supervisor and running code version, and how "
            "each will be restarted. Read-only; safe on a live fleet.")

​旗标​族​：--gateway（​文件​ IPC ​提示​模式​）、--check、--plan（​只读​舰队​计划​）、--list-venv-holders（Windows venv ​占用​者​ JSON ​清单​）。​实现​散布​在​ update_cmd*.py 44 ​个​文件​里​，update_cmd.py ​是​管线​派发​器​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
hermes update ​的​实现​散布​在​ 44 ​个​文件​里​（42 ​个​ update_*.py + 2 ​个​退役​ shim）：

  • ​管线​：update_cmd.py（​派发​器​ + git plumbing）；​每个​关注点​一个​ update_cmd_<concern>.py，re-import ​回​门面​保持​可​补丁​；import ​单向​：main → update_cmd → update_cmd_*；
  • ​承诺​恢复​：update_cmd_commit.py（​树​替换​的​唯一​提交​点​）、_early_recovery*.py（​撕裂​树​恢复​）、update_finish/handoff；
  • ​互斥​与​保管​：update_lock.py（​跨​进程​互斥​）、update_custody.py（​子​进程​生成​策略​）；
  • ​舰队​：update_cmd_fleet*.py（​网关​重启​ + ​验证​）、update_inventory（​运行​时​清单​）、update_receipt（​结构化​回执​）；
  • Windows：update_cmd_zip.py（ZIP ​回退​）、update_cmd_windows.py、update_windows_acl.py；
  • ​退役​ shim：_old_updater.py、_update_takeover.py（​历史​ updater ​的​逃生​口​）。

docs.text:
hermes update

   ▼
┌─ check（update_cmd_check：​碎片​清理​/​通道​目标​/​范围​ fetch/​裁决​）──​否​──▶ ​结束​

docs.title: update_cmd.py ​门面
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/update_cmd.py:1-6
"""Hermes update pipeline: dispatchers (``_cmd_update_impl``/``_cmd_update_check``) + git plumbing.

Each concern lives in ``update_cmd_<concern>.py`` and is re-imported here so
``hermes_cli.update_cmd.<name>`` keeps resolving (and stays monkeypatchable). Imports are one-way:
main -> update_cmd -> update_cmd_*; ``_m()`` resolves ``hermes_cli.main`` at call time.
"""

_m()（​行​ 158）​在​调用​时​解析​ hermes_cli.main——​兄弟​模块​晚​ import ​门面​的​标准​做法​。git ​一律​经​ _git_run（​行​ 263）​执行​，​网络​步骤​显式​标注​ network=True。

docs.title: 深讲​ update_cmd_commit.py：​唯一​提交​点
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/update_cmd_commit.py:1-12
"""The single commit point of a source ``hermes update``: everything the tree move needs armed first.

Before git (or the ZIP swap) writes the first file of the new code, three things are durable:

* the interrupted-pull marker (``.git/hermes-update-pull``) naming the commit git moves to, for EVERY
  tree move (branch switch, upstream fork pull, the pull itself) so a launch after any exit that left
  a torn tree puts the old one back (``_early_recovery.restore_interrupted_pull``);
* the source-completion tail (``venv_sync.arm_completion``) and the host fleet-restart obligation,
  so a kill after the move but before the completion child starts still leaves the tail owed to the
  next launch (``venv_sync.prepare_launch``) and the restart owed to the next ``hermes update``.

Failures before the move are no-ops: ``disarm_commit_obligations`` puts both obligations back the
way this run found them once the tree is verified at its pre-update commit again.
"""

​核心​不​变量​：​新​代码​写下​第一个​文件​之前​，​恢复​所​需​的​一切​必须​已经​持久​。​三样​东西​：​撕裂​ pull ​标记​（​命名​ git ​要​去​到​的​ commit，​任何​退出​留下​的​撕裂​树​都​会​在​下​一次​启动​时​被​放回​旧树​）、​源​完成​尾巴​、​主机​重启​义务​。​移动​前​失败​是​无​操作​——disarm_commit_obligations ​在​树​被​验证​回到​ pre-update commit ​后​把​义务​原样​归还​（​模块​级​快照​ _armed_snapshot ​记录​「​本​ run ​武装​前​各​路径​的​原始​字节​」，disarm ​只​归还​仍​精确​匹配​的​记录​）。

​武装​入口​：

docs.text: update_cmd_zip.py：「ZIP-download fallback for hermes update (Windows with broken git): two-phase stage/commit swap」。git ​不可​用时​下载​ ZIP，​两段式​ stage/commit ​交换​整棵树​——​同样​是​提交​点​武装​的​消费者​。_should_zip_fallback_on_update_error()（update_cmd.py:469）​决定​何时​触发​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• hermes_bootstrap / _early_recovery：​撕裂​树​在​下​一次​启动​时​恢复​——​更新​系统​的​最后​防线​在​启动​路径​上​。
  • gateway/：​暂停​/​重启​的​都​是​网关​服务​；gateway_multiplex_s6.py ​与​ fleet restart ​协作​。
  • pm/：venv ​同步​尾巴​由​ PM ​环境​消费​；shim ​检疫​与​ PM ​策略​衔接​。
  • cli.py：/update slash ​命令​最终​落到​ _cmd_update_impl（gateway ​模式​用​文件​ IPC ​提示​）。
  • observability/：​更新​事实​经​ shared_metrics_update ​上报​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​更新​系统​的​一切​复杂度​都​源于​一个​事实​：​正在​更新​的​代码​就是​正在​运行​的​代码​。​于是​它​把​每​一步​危险​操作​变成​「​先​武装​义务​、​再​动手​、​失败​即​无​操作​」——​提交​点​、​互斥​、​暂停​ gate、​舰队​验证​、​结构化​回执​都​是​围绕​这条​不​变量​的​防御工事​。Windows ​的​ ZIP ​回退​不是​简化版​，​而是​同一​提交​点​契约​的​第二个​实现​。

  • dashboard_auth/（18 ​文件​）：​仪表盘​认证​中间件​栈​——auth gate ​只​在​受控​模式​下​启用​，provider ​框架​ + middleware + WS ​票据​。

​事件​通道​状态​从​ app.state ​惰性​取​（TestClient ​没跑​ lifespan ​时​兜底​），​且​ Lock ​必须​在​正确​的​事件​循环​上​创建​——​注释​明确​写​了​这​一点​（chat_ws.py:39-44）。

docs.title: ws_tickets.py：WS ​升级​凭据
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/dashboard_auth/ws_tickets.py:1-10
"""WS-upgrade auth credentials for gated mode.

Browsers cannot set ``Authorization`` on a WebSocket upgrade, and gated mode has no token
injected into the SPA, so two credential shapes exist: (1) single-use browser tickets
(``mint_ticket`` / ``consume_ticket``) fetched via authenticated ``POST /api/auth/ws-ticket``
and passed as ``?ticket=`` on the upgrade — 30 s TTL, a leak is uninteresting; (2) a
process-lifetime internal credential (...) for *server-spawned* WS clients ...
"""

​两种​凭据​形状​解决​同一个​物理​限制​——​浏览器​不能​在​ WS upgrade ​上带​ Authorization ​头​：

  1. ​浏览器​票据​：mint_ticket() ​签发​ 32 ​字节​ base64url ​一次性​票据​，30 ​秒​ TTL（TTL_SECONDS = 30），consume_ticket() ​消费​即​焚​；
  2. ​进程​内​凭据​：internal_ws_credential ​给​服务器​自己​拉起​的​ WS ​子​进程​（​内嵌​ TUI ​的​ PTY child），​进程​寿命​、​多次​使用​、​永不​进​ HTML/SPA——​只​通过​子​进程​环境变量​离开​本​进程​，XSS ​读​不到​，​权限​也​不​比​票据​多​。
# hermes_cli/dashboard_auth/ws_tickets.py:23-26
#: Long enough for ``getWsTicket()`` -> open WS, short enough that a leaked ticket is uninteresting.
TTL_SECONDS = 30

_lock = threading.Lock()
_tickets: dict[str, tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]] = {}  # ticket -> (expires_at, info)

​纯​内存​、time.time ​可​打补丁​——​这是​测试​友好​的​刻意​设计​。

docs.text:
• web_server.py：​挂载​所有​ router；web_deps.late ​保证​补丁​ seam ​不破​（​另见​ web_server.md）。
  • web_server_chat.py / web_server_profiles.py：chat_ws ​的​ helper ​属主​，​是​ seam ​的​另一端​。
  • gateway/：/api/ws sidecar ​把​浏览器​ socket ​接到​网关​事件​流​；active_sessions ​供​ WS ​复用​。
  • observability/：shared_metrics ​路由​暴露​同意​端点​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​两件事​值得​记住​：(1) dashboard ​的​每个​业务​面​一个​ router ​文件​，helper ​留在​ web_server_<concern> ​并​经​ web_deps late-binding ​回调​——​补丁​永远​打​在​属主​模块​上​；(2) WS ​认证​的​本质​约束​是​「​升级​请求​带​不了​ Authorization ​头​」，​于是​有​了​ 30 ​秒​一次性​票据​与​进程​内部​凭据​两种​形状​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: web_server.py（1,537 ​行​）​是​ FastAPI app ​的​组装​点​；​路由​在​ web_routers/（​另见​ web_routers.md），helper ​在​约​ 30 ​个​ web_server_<concern>.py ​兄弟​里​，re-import ​回​门面​让​ web_server.<name> ​保持​唯一​的​ late-binding seam（​测试​ monkeypatch ​目标​）。​相关​簇​：web_deps.py（seam ​实现​）、web_models.py（Pydantic ​模型​）、web_session_sockets.py、web_upload_limit.py、webapp* 7 ​文件​。

docs.title: 组装​：​一个​ app、​多个​ surface
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/web_server.py:1-7
"""Hermes Agent — Web UI server: FastAPI app assembly, auth/host middleware, ``start_server``.

Route handlers live in ``web_routers/``; their helpers live in the sibling
``web_server_<concern>`` modules and are re-imported here so ``web_server.<name>``
stays the single late-binding seam tests monkeypatch (``web_deps.late``).
Usage: ``python -m hermes_cli.main web [--port 8080]``."""
# ​行​ 210
app = FastAPI(title="Hermes Agent", version=get_version_info().base_version, lifespan=app_lifespan)

​启动​入口​ start_server()（​行​ 1415）。fastapi ​缺失​时​惰性​安装​ dashboard extras——​只有​真正​跑​ hermes dashboard ​的​用户​才​需要​ fastapi+uvicorn。

docs.title: surface ​矩阵
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/web_server_surface.py:1-9
"""What each launch surface of the one web-server stack may do.

The host serving the app records its surface once on ``app.state.ui_surface``; unset, it reads
as ``gateway`` on the gateway's own listener for native clients (the app has a ``gateway_runner``,
as the lifespan choice reads) and ``dashboard`` elsewhere (the standalone ``hermes dashboard``
and ``hermes serve``). Every surface-dependent decision reads this table instead of re-deriving
it, and :func:`route_on` keeps a route off the surfaces that do not use it.
"""
# ​行​ 19-27
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SurfacePolicy:
    #: Mounts a browser UI; ``serve`` is JSON-RPC/WS only.
    serves_spa: bool
    #: Public HTML may carry the session token. Where it may not, every HTML entry
    #: (``/index.html`` included) gets the token-free bootstrap instead of the raw file.
    ...

​同​一套​ app ​栈​按​ surface ​服务​三种​启动​方式​：gateway ​自己​的​ listener（​原生​客户端​，JSON-RPC/WS）、hermes dashboard、hermes serve。​每个​依赖​ surface ​的​决策​都​读​这​张表​，​不​重新​推导​；route_on ​把​不​适用​ surface ​的​路由​直接​摘掉​。auth ​与否​不​在​表里​——​由​运行​时​ auth gate ​决定​（​状态​函数​）。

docs.title: 生命周期
docs.text: web_server_lifecycle.py：「Serve-process lifecycle: parent death watchdog, port-conflict preflight, READY announcement, browser open」。hermes serve ​子​进程​带父​进程​死亡​看门狗​与​端口​冲突​预检​，​就绪​后​宣告​ READY。Desktop ​拥有​的​ --isolated ​后端​另​有​三种​退出​路径​：web_server_idle_exit.py（​空闲​退出​）、web_server_owner_exit.py（​被​新​属主​取代​而​退​）、web_server_skew_exit.py（​代码​版本​偏斜​而​退​）——​三者​的​ docstring ​都​指向​ SSH ​远程​场景​（#101626）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​记住​一个​ seam ​与​一张​表​：web_server.<name> ​是​唯一​的​ monkeypatch seam（helper ​全部​ re-import ​回​门面​，​路由​用​ web_deps.late ​惰性​回调​）；SurfacePolicy ​是​所有​ surface ​分支​的​唯一​事实​源​。​文件​下载​不​直接​给​路径​——​给​票据​；Desktop ​后端​不​常驻​——​空闲​/​被​取代​/​偏斜​三条​退出​路径​各归​一个​模块​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
Hermes ​的​所有​会话​状态​——​会话行​、​消息​转录​、token ​用量​、FTS ​全文索引​、​网关​路由​索引​、cron ​记录​——​都​落​在​一个​单​文件​ SQLite ​库里​：HERMES_HOME/state.db。​入口​是​根目录​的​门面​ hermes_state.py（SessionDB ​类​），​它​由​一组​ hermes_state_<topic>.py ​兄弟​模块​按​ mixin ​组装​而成​。​当前​树上​共有​ 64 ​个​ hermes_state_*.py ​根级​兄弟​文件​（​文件​数量​随​版本​演进​，​本篇​以​当前​ main ​树​为准​逐一​清点​）；​加上​门面​本身​，​构成​约​ 2.8 ​万行​的​持久​层​。

​设计​上​这​一层​回答​三个​问题​：

  1. ​一个​文件​，​多个​进程​——gateway ​长驻​、cron ​定时​进出​、CLI ​一次性​打开​，​都​要​安全​地​共用​ state.db。​答案​是​ WAL ​多读​一写​ + ​耐心​预算​ + ​文件​身份​探测​ + ​孤儿​锁​防护​。
  2. ​谁​有权​改​什么​——​所有​"​改​状态​"​的​动作​（/model、/branch、​压缩​、​删除​、​重置​）​走​ mutation ​回执​事务​：​一个​闭合​动作​ = ​一个​ BEGIN IMMEDIATE = ​一张​可​精确​重放​的​回执​。
  3. ​坏​了​怎么办​——​每​一类​损伤​（​清零​、​损坏​、​被​替换​、WAL ​世代​丢失​、FTS ​索引​损坏​）​都​有​专门​的​检疫​/​修复​/​降级​路径​，​且​"​绝不​原地​修库​"​是​底线​。

docs.title: 存储​模型​：​多读​连接​ / ​写​连接​ / WAL / ​回执​事务
docs.text:
HERMES_HOME/state.db  （​单​ SQLite ​库​，WAL ​模式​）
                          ├── state.db-wal      （​写前​日志​，journal_size_limit 64 MiB）
                          └── state.db-shm      （​共享内存​索引​）
                                       ▲
   ​进程​ A（gateway ​长驻​）               │               ​进程​ B（cron ​一次性​）
 ┌──────────────────────────┐         │         ┌──────────────────────────┐
 │ SessionStore ──┐         │         │         │ run_agent：SessionDB()   │
 │ GatewayRunner ─┴→registry│         │         │ ​直接​ open + close        │
 │   acquire() ​每​路径​ refcount=1      │         │ （​或经​ registry acquire） │
 │        │                 │         │         │        │                 │
 │  ┌─────▼──────┐  ┌──────┐│         │         │  ┌─────▼──────┐          │
 │  │ 1 ​写​连接​    │  │​读​连接池​││  ​读​不​排队​ │         │  │ 1 ​写​连接​    │          │
 │  │ BEGIN      │  │mode=ro││  ​写​互斥​   │         │  │ BEGIN      │          │
 │  │ IMMEDIATE  │  │​上限​ 8/ ││         │         │  │ IMMEDIATE  │          │
 │  │ +​抖动​重试​   │  │​文件​ 24/││         │         │  │ +​抖动​重试​   │          │
 │  └─────┬──────┘  │​进程​    ││         │         │  └─────┬──────┘          │
 │        │         └──────┘│         │         │        │                 │
 │  _execute_write(fn)      │         │         │  _execute_write(fn)      │
 │  ── ​回执​事务​ ──────────────┘         │         └──────────┬───────────────┘
 │  admit → claim → settle              │                    │
 │  （runtime_epoch + admission ​回执​）   │                    │
 └──────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────┘
                                        │
            ​每​ 50 ​次​成功​写​ → PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE)
            ​每​ 1000 ​次​写​   → ​有​界​ FTS 'merge'（​每​索引​ ≤4 ​命令​ × 500 ​页​）
            NFS/SMB/ZFS/virtiofs → journal_mode ​回退​ DELETE（​只读​池​随之​关闭​）

​要点​：

  • ​写​互斥​靠​应用层​耐心​，​不靠​ SQLite busy handler。SessionDB ​把​ busy timeout ​压​到​ 1 ​秒​，​锁​冲突​时​释放​ Python ​锁​、​睡​一个​随机​抖动​、​然后​整段​回调​重跑​（​回调​必须​幂​等​）。
  • ​读​路径​在​ WAL ​下​走​独立​ mode=ro ​连接池​，​读​不​排队​在​写​锁​后面​；​池满​或非​ WAL（DELETE ​回退​）​时​降级​到​写​连接​上​的​带锁读​——"​慢​但​活着​"​优于​ EMFILE ​崩溃​。
  • ​回执​事务​是​唯一​的​合法​写​通道​（​运行​时​动作​）：admit_session_input ​入队​ → claim_session_input ​领取​ → settle_session_input ​结算​，​每​一步​都​在​一个​ BEGIN IMMEDIATE ​里​完成​校验​+​写​+​回执​落盘​，​天然​可​精确​重​放​。

docs.title: 写​耐心​预算​（hermes_state.py:488-513，​已​核实​）
docs.text: 预算​ ​值​ ​用途​ _WRITE_PATIENCE_S 20s ​常规​写​默认​预算​（​兄弟​进程​合法​持锁​：VACUUM、checkpoint、​修复​） _TRANSCRIPT_WRITE_PATIENCE_S 60s ​转录​写​（​失败​会​中止​整轮​对话​，​给​最长​耐心​） _ACTIVITY_WRITE_PATIENCE_S 0.5s ​心跳​/​活动​观察​写​（​在​响应​关键​路径​上​，​跳过​即​下次​重试​） _COMPRESSION_BUSY_WAIT_S 5s ​压缩​锁忙​等​（​租约​是​正确性​边界​，​超时​必须​拒绝​而​非​硬闯​） _WRITE_RETRY_MIN/MAX_S 0.020–0.150s ​前​ 2 ​秒​的​快​抖动​ _WRITE_RETRY_SLOW_MIN/MAX_S 0.250–1.000s 2 ​秒​后​的​慢​抖动​ _CHECKPOINT_EVERY_N_WRITES 50 ​每​ 50 ​写​一次​ PASSIVE checkpoint _FTS_MERGE_EVERY_N_WRITES 1000 ​每​ 1000 ​写​做​有界​ FTS merge（​代替​ 9–18 ​秒​的​ 'optimize'）

docs.title: 66 → 64：​兄弟​文件​主题​地图
docs.text:
​任务书​按​ 66 ​个​兄弟​计数​，​当前​树​实测​为​ 64 ​个​（​数量​随​提交​漂移​，​以​文件系统​为准​）。​按​八篇​文档​分组​如下​；​每篇​文末​的​「​本组​文件​清单​」​表会​再​逐行​展开​：

​篇​ ​主题​ ​兄弟​文件​数​ facade.md ​门面​、​共享​常量​、id ​铸造​、​身份​键​、​注册表​、​可移植性​ 6 wal_mutations.md WAL ​策略​、runtime ​回执​事务​、mutation ​处理器​、worker/local ​三​族​ 19 sessions_messages.md ​会话行​、​转录​、​标题​、​时间​线​、resume ​组装​ 11 compression_state.md ​压缩​谱系​、​覆盖​、​显示​、​原位​重写​、api_content ​边车​ 5 locks_guards.md ​测试​隔离​守卫​、OFD ​锁​、​锁主​、PID ​命名​空间​、​健康​闩​、​读池​ 8 search_maintenance.md FTS ​索引​、​检索​、​保留​修剪​、​修复​、schema ​漂移​、/undo 10 misc_state.md ​网关​持久​化​、​异常​分类​、schema DDL、​用量​、terminal ​墓碑​ 5 ​合计​ 64

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway（gateway/session.py）：SessionStore ​是​路由​索引​+​转录​的​门面​，​落库​全部​经​ SessionDB；​长驻​进程​按​ hermes_state_registry.acquire() ​共享​每​路径​唯一​写​连接​（​注释​见​ gateway/session.py:791："Session routing index + transcripts: SQLite (SessionDB)"）。
  • cron（cron/scheduler.py）：​每次​ fire ​用​ hermes_state_registry.acquire/release_or_close ​借​还​句柄​（cron/scheduler.py:1869），​并用​ _BoundedCronSessionDB ​代理​清理​调用​防止​卡死​。
  • run_agent / TUI / Desktop：​经​ AsyncSessionDB（hermes_state.py:1725，​每个​调用​ asyncio.to_thread）​或​直接​ SessionDB；runtime ​回执​事务​（hermes_state_runtime.py）​是​ gateway RPC session.* ​的​存储​后​端​。
  • hermes doctor / hermes sessions recover：​消费​ hermes_state_repair.py、hermes_state_holders.py、hermes_state_lockowners.py、hermes_state_health.py ​暴露​的​诊断​与​修复​面​。
  • ​插件​：​只能​通过​已​发布​的​ plugin API ​间​接触​碰​状态​层​；hermes_state_* ​不是​插件​面​。

docs.title: 本​系列​文档​导航
docs.text:
1. facade.md — ​门面​与​基础设施​组​
  2. wal_mutations.md — WAL ​与​ mutation ​回执​事务​
  3. sessions_messages.md — ​会话​与​消息​
  4. compression_state.md — ​状态​层​压缩​
  5. locks_guards.md — ​锁​、​守卫​与​持有者​
  6. search_maintenance.md — ​检索​与​维护​
  7. misc_state.md — ​网关​持久​化​与​收尾​

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​状态​层​是​一个​"​窄​腰​"：​所有​进程​共写​一个​ SQLite ​文件​，​靠​ WAL ​换​并发​、​靠​耐心​预算​换​公平​、​靠​回执​事务​换​幂​等​、​靠​检疫​而​非​原地​修复​换​安全​。64 ​个​兄弟​文件​各守​一个​主题​，​门面​只​做​组装​；​下​一篇​从​门面​本身​读​起​。

docs.title: 状态​层​压缩​：​谱系​、​覆盖​、​显示​与​原位​重写
文件​概览
docs.text:
​上下文​压缩​在​存储​层​留下​四类​痕迹​：​谱系​（parent_session_id ​链​ + end_reason='compression'）、​归档​行​（active=0, compacted=1 ​或​轮转​到子会​话​）、​覆盖​账目​（​压缩器​到底​"​持有​"​了​哪些​行​）​和​边车​（api_content——​模型​实际​看到​的​字节​）。​本篇​五个​文件​各管​一类​：

  • hermes_state_compression.py（963 ​行​）：​谱系​行走​、​冷却​/​连击​计数器​、​压缩​锁​、turn ​租约​——​压缩​的​"​控制​面​"。
  • hermes_state_coverage.py：​原位​压缩​时​判定​哪些​ durable ​行​确实​被​压缩器​持有​——​提交​正确性​的​"​账面​"。
  • hermes_state_compaction_display.py：​显示​层​把​压缩​过​的​工具​结果​画成​归档​原貌​而​非​缩短​ stub。
  • hermes_state_prune_rewrite.py：proactive prune ​的​原位​行​重写​（​行​ id ​不变​、​内容​变​了​）​及其​ CAS ​陈旧​探测​。
  • hermes_state_api_content.py：api_content ​边车​的​两个​回​填写​入​。

docs.title: 1. ​谱系​单步​ SQL ​与​链​行走
docs.text:
# hermes_state_compression.py:30-50（​节选​）
_CHAIN_STEP_SQL = f"""
                    SELECT child.id
                    FROM sessions parent
                    JOIN sessions child ON child.parent_session_id = parent.id
                    WHERE parent.id = ?
                      AND parent.end_reason = 'compression'
                      AND {_sql_json_extract('child.model_config', '$._branched_from')} IS NULL
                      AND {_sql_json_extract('child.model_config', '$._delegate_from')} IS NULL
                      AND NOT ({_RESET_CHILD_SQL.format(a='child')})
                      AND COALESCE(child.source, '') != 'tool'
                    ORDER BY
                      CASE
                        WHEN child.end_reason = 'compression' THEN 0
                        WHEN child.ended_at IS NULL THEN 1
                        ELSE 2
                      END,
                      ...
                    LIMIT 1
                    """

"​首选​延续​子​"​的​四重​排除​（branch/delegate/reset/tool）​与​优先​序​（​压缩​边​ > ​未​结束​ > ​已​结束​）​定义​了​唯一​推进​方向​——​注释​点名​ #114271：reset fork ​不是​延续​，​跟着​走会​劫持​ tip ​投影​。_walk_compression_chain（:92-108）​据此​ root-first ​走链​，_CHAIN_CAP = 1000（:82）​防御​截断​谱系​（#125041）。

        ...
    def get_compression_tip(self, session_id: str) -> Optional[str]:

get_compression_lineage（:916）​给出​全链​；​这些​读是​ sessions_messages ​组与​ worker ​回执​读取​的​共享​底座​。

docs.title: 2. ​租约​：​单​事务​声明
docs.text:
# hermes_state_compression.py:62-76
def _claim_lease_row(conn, table: str, key_col: str, key: str, holder: str, now: float, expires_at: float,
                     stale) -> tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
    """Single-transaction lease claim: DELETE a stale holder's row (``stale(holder,
    expires_at)``), INSERT OR IGNORE ours, then SELECT to confirm ownership (INSERT OR
    IGNORE gives no rowcount signal). Returns ``(acquired, reclaimed_holder)``."""

​压缩​锁​（compression_locks ​表​）​与​ turn ​租约​（session_turn_leases）​共用​这个​原语​。​上层​的​ try_acquire_compression_lock（:651）/refresh_compression_lock（:633）/acquire_session_turn_lease（:744）​把​"​持有者​进程​已死​"​的​判定​（hermes_state._compression_lock_holder_process_is_dead，hermes_state.py:142）​作为​ stale ​回调​注入​——PID ​复用​读作​活着​（​保守​），​外来​ PID ​命名​空间​交给​ TTL（​见​ pidns）。

docs.title: 4. ​覆盖​：​压缩器​持有​了​哪些​行
docs.text:
# hermes_state_coverage.py:62-79（docstring ​节选​）
    def _carried_tail_ids(
        self, conn, tail_ids: list[int], compacted_messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> tuple[dict[int, int], set[int]]:
        """Rows of *tail_ids* that *compacted_messages* already carry -> ``({row id: carrying dict index}, weak)``.

        A row above the watermark is normally a concurrent append the summary never saw, so the commit
        clones it after the compacted set. A row the compressor ALSO held ... is already in the compacted
        set as a carried copy; cloning it too stores the message twice... A claim must prove the occurrence
        AND the version, so the next request sees exactly what it would have seen with the clone minus the
        second copy: only a dict that names the row (``_row_id``, else ``message_uid``) may claim it, never
        matching text, which another surface can append independently."""

​两遍​声明​：​第一遍​认领​"​点名​且​内容​逐字​节重​放​"（_replays_as :157）；​第二遍​允许​"​压缩器​自己​的​重写​能​解释​差异​"（_rewrite_explains :192）​且​全库​唯一​携带​该​ uid ​的​ dict ​认领​。​其余​一律​克隆​——​宁可​重复​，​不可​陈旧​或缺​模型​输入​。_proved_coverage（:398）​汇总​证据​，archive_and_compact（messages，:908）​据此​决定​归档​集​或​回退​水位​。

docs.text:
# hermes_state_compaction_display.py:26-32
def not_a_later_tool_copy_sql(alias: str) -> str:
    """Filter that drops *alias* rows that are a later copy of an archived tool result."""
    return (f" AND NOT ({alias}.role = 'tool' AND {alias}.message_uid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ("
            f"SELECT 1 FROM messages AS original WHERE original.session_id = {alias}.session_id "
            f"AND original.timestamp = {alias}.timestamp AND original.message_uid = {alias}.message_uid "
            "AND original.role = 'tool' AND original.active = 0 AND original.compacted = 1 "
            f"AND +original.display_order < {alias}.display_order AND {_ORIGINAL_VISIBLE_SQL}))")

​规则​只用​身份​（session、uid、timestamp、display slot），​从不​看​内容​、​不改​存储​行​：​同一​ slot ​上​活跃​行​胜出​（in-place prune ​的​ stub ​继续​显示​），​更​晚​ slot ​的​拷贝​让​位于​更​早​ slot ​的​归档​原文​。later_tool_copy_ids（:35）​是​ Python ​对偶​，​供​已​加载​行​集合​使用​。​文件​头​（:1-13）​解释​了​为什么​工具​结果​故意​把​ payload ​留在​显示​键里​——​归档​输出​绝不能​折叠​进它​的​ stub。

docs.title: 6. ​原位​重写​与​ CAS ​陈旧​探测
docs.text:
# hermes_state_prune_rewrite.py:29-48（docstring ​节选​）
    def rewritten_held_row_ids(self, session_id: str, held: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[int]:
        """Ids among *held* message dicts whose ACTIVE row no longer holds the payload the dict holds.

        An in-place commit (the proactive prune's ``rewrite_pruned_rows``) changes what a row says and
        keeps its id and its ``active`` flag, so an id/activity staleness check cannot see it. A lease-less
        writer holding the pre-rewrite bodies must not publish them: that archives rows it never compared
        and republishes the stale text over the newer generation (#124102)."""

​比较​是​表示​安全​的​：​活字典​内容​先过​加载​器​镜头​（_loaded_view_content），​或​直接​用​字典​携带​的​存储​行​ CAS ​摘要​（DB_ROW_SNAPSHOT）；held_row_mismatches（:52）​是​调用者​已持​事务​连接​时​的​版本​——​预检​必须​在​ BEGIN IMMEDIATE ​窗口​内​，​否则​ check ​与​ commit ​之间​落下​的​重写​会​被​归档​。rewrite_pruned_rows（:133）​本身​是​原语​：​固定​列​（session_id/role/timestamp/active/display_identity）​永不​移动​，​只有​"​行说​什么​"​变​。

docs.text:
# hermes_state_api_content.py:17-39（​节选​）
    def set_latest_user_api_content(self, session_id: str, content: Any, api_content: str) -> int:
        """Backfill the ``api_content`` sidecar onto the newest ACTIVE user row (0/1 rows). Preflight compaction
        inserts that row BEFORE the sidecar exists and the later persist identity-skips compacted dicts;
        without this a reload reopens the prompt-cache divergence. ``content`` match guards a racing rewrite.
        POSITIONAL, and only safe when the caller already knows the newest active user row IS the message
        it stamped. ..."""
        return self._write_rowcount(
            "UPDATE messages SET api_content = ? WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM messages "
            "WHERE session_id = ? AND role = 'user' AND active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
            ") AND content IS ?",
            (_scrub_surrogates(api_content), session_id, self._encode_content(content)))

set_message_api_content（:41-67）​是​按行​寻址​的​孪生​：​调用者​传​ _row_id，​不会​落到​"​恰好​同样​文本​"​的​邻居​行​——​重复​的​ "ok"/"continue" ​会​让​ positional ​版本​写错​行​（docstring ​点名​为​"​更糟​的​缓存​破坏​"）。​两者​都​保留​ active=1 + content ​匹配​作为​防御​栏​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• mutation ​压缩​：hermes_state_mutation_compress.compress_in_transaction ​调​ archive_on_connection/publish_on_connection（worker_compression）​完成​归档​与​发布​；​本组​的​锁​/​租约​是​它​的​守卫​面​。
  • messages：archive_and_compact（hermes_state_messages.py:908）​是​压缩​的​物理​写​入口​，​消费​ coverage ​的​结论​与​ _ARCHIVE_ACTIVE_SQL（hermes_state_messages.py:74）。
  • runtime：​守卫​ _require_transcript_unleased（mutation_guards:34）​用​ _ENDED_ROW_SQL/_ended_by_compression ​判定​"​逻辑​ owner ​已​被​压缩​关闭​"。
  • timeline / display：compaction_display ​的​ SQL ​被​ _display_rows_sql（timeline）​与​ stored_reads ​复用​，​保证​压缩​后​各端​显示​一致​。
  • worker：CompressionSnapshot（worker_compression:103）​直接​借用​本组​ get_compression_chain ​等​读​算法​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​压缩​在​存储​层​被​拆成​"​控制​面​"（​锁​、​租约​、​冷却​）​与​"​数据​面​"（​归档​、​覆盖​、​显示​、​重写​）。​控制​面​的​原则​是​租约​即​正确性​边界​——​宁可​拒绝​写​也​不​硬闯​；​数据​面​的​原则​是​证明​优于​猜测​——​覆盖​要​证明​确实​持有​，​重写​要​ CAS ​比​对​，​显示​要​按​身份​而​不是​内容​。api_content ​边车​则​守护​最后​一段​一致性​：​用户​行落库​了​，​但​模型​看到​的​字节​还​没落​时​，​由回​填补​齐​，​且​必须​按行​寻址​。

docs.title: 门面​与​基础设施​：hermes_state.py ​与​它​的​六块​基石
文件​概览
docs.text:
hermes_state.py ​是​状态​持久​层​的​门面​：​约​ 1738 ​行里​，​它​只​做​四件​事​——​组装​ SessionDB ​的​ mixin MRO、​管理​写​连接​与​写​耐心​、​守护​文件​身份​（​替换​/​世代​丢失​/​损坏​检疫​）、​提供​ token ​队列​与​ meta ​键值​等​门面​级​工具​。​行为​都​住​在​兄弟​模块​里​，​门面​不​实现​具体​业务​，​这是​ AGENTS.md "facade + siblings" ​布局​的​标准​形态​。

​本篇​同时​讲​门面​脚下​的​六块​基石​：hermes_state_common.py（​破​导入​环​的​共享​层​）、hermes_state_ids.py（id ​铸造​）、hermes_state_keys.py / hermes_state_identity.py（​身份​与键​）、hermes_state_registry.py（​进程​内​共享​）、hermes_state_portability.py（​导出​/​导入​）。

docs.title: 1. SessionDB ​的​ mixin ​组装​（MRO ​即​架构图​）
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:464-471
class SessionDB(
    SessionSessionsMixin, SessionFtsSetupMixin, SessionSearchMixin, SessionSchemaMixin,
    SessionPortabilityMixin, SessionTelegramTopicsMixin, SessionCompressionMixin,
    SessionGatewayMixin, SessionMaintenanceMixin, SessionUsageMixin, SessionTitlesMixin,
    SessionMessagesMixin, SessionPruneRewriteMixin, SessionApiContentMixin, SessionCoverageMixin, SessionRewindMixin, SessionProfileRepairMixin,
    SessionPromptRefreshMixin,
):
    """SQLite-backed session storage with FTS5 search; many reader threads, one writer (WAL)."""

​直接​基类​共​ 18 ​个​ mixin；SessionMessagesMixin ​自身​又​继承​ SessionDetachedResultsMixin、SessionTodoResultMixin、SessionStoredReadsMixin（hermes_state_messages.py:124），​所以​ MRO ​里​实际​有​ 21 ​个​ mixin ​模块​。​任何​一个​模块​都​"​必须​绝不​ import hermes_state"（​否则​成环​）。

docs.title: 2. ​默认​库​路径​与​导入​时​快照
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:179-204
DEFAULT_DB_PATH = _IMPORT_DEFAULT_DB_PATH = get_hermes_home() / "state.db"
...
def _default_db_path() -> Path:
    """Default state DB path at CALL time: a re-pointed ``DEFAULT_DB_PATH`` wins, else
    ``get_hermes_home()`` is resolved fresh (a runtime HERMES_HOME redirect works regardless of import)."""
    return DEFAULT_DB_PATH if DEFAULT_DB_PATH != _IMPORT_DEFAULT_DB_PATH else get_hermes_home() / "state.db"

canonical store ​就是​ HERMES_HOME/state.db。​导入​时​快照​ _IMPORT_DEFAULT_DB_PATH ​让​测试​ monkeypatch DEFAULT_DB_PATH ​常量​也​能​被​ _default_db_path() ​感知​；​运行​时​重定向​ HERMES_HOME ​则​无需​补丁​即可​生效​。
