docs.title: 4. _execute_write：​抖动​重试​ + ​回​调整​体重​跑
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:1014-1021（​节选​ docstring）
def _execute_write(
    self, fn: Callable[[sqlite3.Connection], T], patience_s: Optional[float] = None,
) -> T:
    """Run *fn(conn)* inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE with jittered lock retry; commit
    is handled here (callers must not commit). Returns *fn*'s result.
    BEGIN IMMEDIATE takes the WAL write lock up front so contention surfaces
    immediately; on locked/busy the Python lock is released, a jitter slept,
    and the WHOLE callback retried — *fn* must stay idempotent under retry."""

​成功​路径​上​每​ 50 ​写​做​一次​ PASSIVE checkpoint、​每​ 1000 ​写​做​一次​有​界​ FTS merge（hermes_state.py:1063-1067）；​压缩​锁​冲突​单独​走​ _COMPRESSION_BUSY_WAIT_S ​的​短​预算​，​耗尽​仍​被​锁​则​拒绝​写​（​租约​是​正确性​边界​，​不是​普通​忙碌​信号​）。

docs.title: 5. ​读​路径​分裂​：​只读​池​ + ​降级
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:927-936（​节选​）
@contextmanager
def _read_ctx(self, *, reopen: bool = True, pooled_only: bool = False) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
    """Yield a connection for read-only statements: a pooled read-only
    connection with NO lock under WAL; otherwise (non-WAL, open failure,
    ceiling reached) the writer connection under self._lock — deliberate
    degradation: slower beats EMFILE, which the supervisor cannot see."""

WAL ​已​确认​时读​走​ mode=ro ​池​（​上限​由​ hermes_state_readpool ​的​每​文件​/​每​进程​预算​决定​）；​否则​借用​写​连接​并​在​ DELETE ​模式​下​临时​抬高​ busy_timeout（hermes_state.py:971-978）。

docs.title: 6. registry ​共享​：close() ​变成​释放​引用
docs.text:
# hermes_state.py:1536-1543（​节选​）
def close(self):
    ...
    if self._shared_registry_owned:

​经​ hermes_state_registry.acquire() ​打开​的​实例​，close() ​只减​引用​计数​，​物理​连接​的​生死​归​注册表​管​——​一个​调用者​的​ close ​不能​拆掉​同​进程​其他​调用者​还​在​用​的​写​连接​。

docs.title: 7. common：​破​导入​环​的​共享​层

# hermes_state_common.py:1-2
"""Shared constants and helpers for the SessionDB family of modules.  Lives outside hermes_state so
the mixin modules can import it without a cycle."""

​标题​出处​常量​（TITLE_SOURCE_DERIVED/LLM/USER，:22-24）、​预览​ SQL、escape_like、stat_db_file_identity、schema SQL ​等​都​在​这里​。​它​也​反向​ late-import（​如​ :44-52 ​的​ routed_sessions_setting ​在​函数​内​ import config），​把​"​哪个​ profile ​的​配置​"​在​多路复用​下读​对​。

docs.title: 8. ​兄弟​的​ late-import seam
docs.text:
​兄弟​模块​不​ import ​门面​，​但​在​函数​体内​ late-import ​门面​拿​常量​/​类型​：

# hermes_state_titles.py:62-73（​节选​）
@staticmethod
def sanitize_title(title: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Strip control/zero-width/bidi chars (and lone surrogates sqlite3 cannot bind),
    collapse whitespace, normalize empty to None. ValueError past MAX_TITLE_LENGTH."""
    from hermes_state import SessionDB          # ← ​函数​内​ late import，​破环​
    ...
    if len(cleaned) > SessionDB.MAX_TITLE_LENGTH:

​这​形成​一条​工程​约定​：​给​生产​代码​打补丁​时要​打​在​定义​处​，​而​测试​可​通过​门面​ patch——​门面​是​ seam。

docs.title: 9. ids：​会话​ id ​的​唯一​铸造​点
docs.text:
# hermes_state_ids.py:53-60
DEFAULT_HEX_LEN = 6


def new_session_id(now: Optional[datetime] = None, *, hex_len: int = DEFAULT_HEX_LEN) -> str:
    """``<timestamp>_<random hex>`` for a fresh session; ``now`` pins the timestamp to a clock the
    caller already captured (``agent.session_start``) so the id and the row agree to the second."""
    stamp = (now or datetime.now()).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    return f"{stamp}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:hex_len]}"

​形状​是​ YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<hex>；​交互​面用​ 6 ​位​ hex，gateway 8 ​位​、portability ​导入​ 12 ​位​（​同一​秒​铸​多行​）。SESSION_ID_RECOGNIZERS（:21-39）​枚举​所有​表面​派生​的​ id ​形状​（cron_*、bg_*、room_*、api_*、uuid4 ​等​），salvage ​靠​它​区分​"​像​会​话​ id ​的​单元格​"。

docs.title: 10. keys / identity：​身份​派生​与​ durable ​消息​身份
docs.text:
# hermes_state_keys.py:62-74
def admission_fingerprint(*, canonical_target: str, payload: dict) -> str:
    """Canonical payload identity after authorization and immutable media capture."""
    encoded = json.dumps(
        {'target': canonical_target, 'payload': payload}, ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False,
    ).encode('utf-8', errors='surrogatepass')
    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def local_identity(profile_id, principal_id, request_id):
    """The deterministic session id of a LOCAL creation receipt."""
    identity = json.dumps([profile_id, principal_id, request_id], separators=(',', ':'))
    return 'local-' + hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest()

hermes_state_identity.py ​是​ schema v31 ​引入​的​ durable message identity ​列​（message_uid / absorbed_message_uids / tool_call_uids / tool_call_uid）​在​"​活字典​ ↔ ​存储​行​"​两个​表示​之间​的​编解码器​（hermes_state_identity.py:1-3），​转录​写入​、​恢复​与​修复​共用​一套​，​不​漂移​。

docs.text:

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​门面​把​"​多​进程​共写​一个​ SQLite ​文件​"​的​全部​难点​集中​在​ __init__/_execute_write/close ​三个​方法​里​：​打开​时​检疫​与​守卫​、​写入​时​耐心​与​节拍​、​关闭​时​干净​收代​。​六个​基石​模块​则​各管​一件​纯事​：​共享​常量​、id、​键​、​身份​、​共享​注册表​、​可移植性​。​下​一章​进入​ WAL ​与​ mutation ​回执​事务​——​这​一层​真正​的​"​写​协议​"。

docs.title: 锁​、​守卫​与​持有者​：​谁​在​用​这个​文件
文件​概览
docs.text:
state.db ​会​被​多个​进程​同时​打开​，​因此​"​谁​持有​写锁​""​这个​进程​是否​测试​进程​""​文件​是否​被​换掉​"​是​持久​层​每天​要​回答​的​问题​。​本组​八个​文件​构成​一张​进程​与​文件​健康​的​防护网​：

  • hermes_state_guard.py：​活库​测试​隔离​守卫​——pytest ​上下文​的​进程​绝不​打开​生产​库​。
  • hermes_state_lockguard.py：​把​ WAL ​文件​锁​补成​ OFD（open file description）​锁​，​防本​进程​内​游离​的​ close() ​取消​ SQLite ​自己​的​ POSIX ​锁​。
  • hermes_state_lockowners.py：​读​ /proc/locks，​在​写​等待​超时​时​点名​持锁者​。
  • hermes_state_holders.py：​结构​维护​前​的​进程​/​描述符​权威​（read_only_db_uri ​也​在​这​）。
  • hermes_state_pidns.py：PID ​命名​空间​身份​——​跨​容器​不​误收​别人​的​租约​。
  • hermes_state_health.py：​每​路径​的​ STORAGE_CORRUPT ​健康​闩​（​进程​级​，​一次性​）。
  • hermes_state_dbfile.py：​文件​级​健康​——​清零​检疫​、​交叉​锁​、​退休​ WAL ​代​捕获​、​锁​安全​ header ​探测​。
  • hermes_state_readpool.py：​读​连接​预算​（​每​文件​ 8 / ​每​进程​ 24 / fd ​余量​门​）。

docs.title: 1. ​活库​测试​隔离​守卫
docs.text:
# hermes_state_guard.py:23-51（​节选​）
_STATE_DB_GUARD_BYPASS_ENV = "HERMES_STATE_DB_GUARD_BYPASS"
...
_TEST_ISOLATION_MARKER_ENV = "HERMES_TEST_ISOLATION"

​守卫​的​判定​面在​ hermes_state._ensure_test_isolation（hermes_state.py:214-244）：pytest ​上下文​（​环境变量​或​进程​祖先​）​解析​到​生产​ DB ​就​在​任何​连接​/mkdir/pragma/​字节​探测​之前​抛错​。​为什么​环境​不够​？docstring（:218-220）​说​得​直白​："a child spawned with a rebuilt environment loses PYTEST_* and HERMES_HOME together, which is precisely the state in which it writes to production"。​所以​自家​的​ HERMES_TEST_ISOLATION ​标记​默认​继承​进子​进程​，​携带​它​还​解析​到​生产​库​的​进程​按​定义​是​隔离​逃逸​。​祖先​检测​走​ psutil cmdline ​的​ basename ​匹配​（_process_looks_like_pytest :76），​绝不​猜​"​读​不到​ cmdline"​的​方向​。

docs.title: 2. OFD ​锁​守卫​：​防​游离​ close
docs.text:
# hermes_state_lockguard.py:1-23（​模块​ docstring ​节选​）
"""Hold a state.db writer's WAL-mode file locks in a form a stray ``close()`` cannot cancel.

SQLite protects a live WAL generation with two POSIX advisory locks: a SHARED lock on the main
file's lock range and a shared lock on the DMS byte of ``state.db-shm``. A sibling process may
checkpoint and unlink ``-wal``/``-shm`` at its close only after taking both EXCLUSIVE. POSIX locks
are per process, so any ``open()``/``close()`` of those two files inside the holder — a raw probe,
a plugin, a tool reading ``~/.hermes`` — cancels both (sqlite.org/howtocorrupt.html §2.2)...
This module adds the same two ranges as *open file description* locks (``F_OFD_SETLK``) on the
descriptors SQLite itself holds."""

OFD ​锁​属于​描述​而​非​进程​：​本​进程​其他​代码​随手​ close ​那​两个​文件​不会​取消​它​，​而​外来​ EXCLUSIVE ​依旧​冲突​——​兄弟​的​ close-time unlink ​因此​被​拒绝​。​锁​几何​取自​ SQLite unix VFS（_PENDING_BYTE/_SHARED_FIRST/_SHM_DMS_BYTE，:39-42）。​持有​计数​按​ inode ​记​（_HANDLES: dict[Identity, int]，:82），fd ​号​复用​不会​被误​当成​幸存​的​锁​。hold（:146）/release（:167）​是​门面​调用​点​（_open_writer ​末尾​ self._wal_lock_guard = _lockguard.hold(...)，hermes_state.py:729；close ​前​释放​ :1580）。Windows ​无​ POSIX advisory ​锁​，​模块​承诺​ no-op（:50-53 ​先​按​平台​ gating，​连​第三方​ fcntl ​撞名​模块​都​不信​）。

docs.title: 3. /proc/locks：​点​名叫​锁者
docs.text:
# hermes_state_lockowners.py:49-56
def parse_proc_locks(text: str, inodes: dict[tuple[int, int], str]) -> list[tuple[int, str, str]]:
    """``(pid, lock kind, sidecar)`` for every WRITE lock on one of ``inodes``.

    ``inodes`` maps ``(st_dev, st_ino)`` to ``""`` (main file), ``"-wal"`` or ``"-shm"``. Read locks
    are dropped: they never block a writer in WAL mode. An OFD lock is reported with pid ``-1``
    (the kernel does not export its owner)."""

SQLite unix VFS ​的​字节​偏移​编码​锁​种类​（_SHM_LOCK_NAMES :21-26：120=WAL write、128=shm dead-man switch ​等​），​内核​带​着​ pid ​导出​。log_write_lock_holders（:115-124）​在​写​耐心​耗尽​的​那一刻​打​一条​ WARNING，​把​"​等​了​ 20 ​秒​"​升级成​"​是​谁​在​等​了​ 20 ​秒​"；​连续​三轮​读​ /proc/locks ​取​并​集防​中途​翻页​漏读​（:96-105）。

docs.title: 4. holders：​结构​维护​的​权威
docs.text:
# hermes_state_holders.py:27-30
def read_only_db_uri(db_path) -> str:
    """``file:`` URI for a ``mode=ro`` open. ``as_uri()`` percent-encodes ``?``/``#`` in the home
    path; a raw ``f"file:{path}?mode=ro"`` truncates there and opens the wrong (empty) database."""
    return Path(db_path).resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro"

​除​只读​ URI ​外​，​本​模块​证明​"​没有​外来​进程​仍​持有​活动​的​或​已​ unlink ​的​ SQLite DB/WAL/SHM ​世代​"——foreign_state_db_holders ​扫描​打开​描述符​，describe_holder_pid（:60）​产出​ PID 123 (hermes gateway run) ​形式​的​操作者​可​读行​。​它​还​按​ argv ​语义​分类​"​谁​算​ Hermes ​进程​"（_HERMES_PYTHON_SCRIPTS ​等​ :36-42），​遵循​"​不​从​ argv ​子串​推断​"​的​项目​红线​——​脚本​/​模块​名是​白名单​匹配​。

docs.title: 5. PID ​命名​空间​：​租约​归属
docs.text:
# hermes_state_pidns.py:96-117（​节选​）
def _qualify(recorded: Optional[str], *, unstamped_checkable: bool) -> bool:
    """The shared matrix; *unstamped_checkable* is the policy for a record that
    carries no namespace (see the module docstring for why there are two)."""
    local = _local_pid_namespace()
    if not local.supported:
        return True  # single-namespace platform: a pid is evidence on its own
    if recorded is None:
        return unstamped_checkable
    if local.id is None:
        return False  # our own lookup failed: unknown authority is not authority
    return recorded == local.id


def holder_pid_checkable(holder: str) -> bool:
    """STRICT: may a structured holder string's ``pid=`` be probed here? ..."""
    return _qualify(_recorded_namespace(holder), unstamped_checkable=False)

​持有者​字符串​被​盖​ pidns=<inode of /proc/self/ns/pid> ​章​（holder_namespace_token :81）；​另​一个​命名​空间​里​的​读者​把​"​活​的​持有者​"​看成​"​不​存在​"，​会​错误​回收​未​过期​租约​——​所以​外来​章​永不​探测​。​两档​策略​：TTL ​行​（​压缩​锁​/turn ​租约​）​严格​，​无章​ defer ​到​过期​（​错放​自愈​）；​无​过期​的​ flock ​记录​宽容​（​错放​会​永久​禁用​孤儿​锁​清理​）。

docs.title: 6. ​健康​闩​：​进程​级​一次性
docs.text:
# hermes_state_health.py:60-72（​节选​）
def mark_storage_corrupt(db_path, reason: object) -> None:
    """Latch *db_path* as corrupt for the life of this process (idempotent)."""
    key = _key(db_path)
    with _lock:
        if key in _corrupt:
            return
        _corrupt[key] = str(reason)
    logger.error(...)

​只有​结构性​损坏​闩​上​（is_structural_corruption_error :49：​非​ FTS ​范围​的​ SQLITE_CORRUPT/NOTADB，​且​非​可​修复​的​ malformed-schema）。​闩​永不​自愈​——​损坏​的​镜像​不会​自己​长好​，​闪烁​的​ "ok/corrupt" ​正是​它​要​替换​的​静默​失败​。​读取​方​：storage_state（:83）​被​ _raise_if_db_corrupt(storage=True)（hermes_state.py:1445-1454）​与​ gateway readiness ​消费​，​让​同​进程​的​所有​ handle ​在​碰​ SQLite ​前先​拒绝​。

docs.title: 7. dbfile：​锁​安全​的​ header ​探测​与​检疫
docs.text:
# hermes_state_dbfile.py:63-73（​注释​节选​）
# _read_sqlite_application_id runs on EVERY write (_raise_if_db_replaced) against the LIVE
# state.db.  A bare open()/read()/close() there is the howtocorrupt §2.2 bug: close() cancels
# every POSIX advisory lock this process holds on the file... So the probe preads through a per-path fd
# cached for the life of the process (opening never cancels locks).  When the path is re-pointed
# at a new inode (the very replacement this probe detects) the stale fd is RETIRED, never closed.
_HEADER_PROBE_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_HEADER_PROBE_FDS: dict[str, tuple[int, int, int]] = {}  # key -> (fd, dev, ino)
_RETIRED_HEADER_PROBE_FDS: list[int] = []  # intentionally never closed

_pread_db_range（:77）​实现​该​探测​；_prepare_connection_retirement（:36）​在​ <3.12 ​的​ Python ​上用​ Py_IncRef ​把​被​检疫​连接​钉​活过​解释器​关停​（close ​会​在​错误​页​号​上​ checkpoint）。​清零​库​检疫​（quarantine_invalid_state_db）、​交叉​进程​锁​检疫​（quarantine_cross_process_lock）、​退休​ WAL ​代​捕获​（capture_retired_wal_generation，​产​ manifest.json ​供​取证​）​都​在​这里​；​门面​侧​的​调用​点见​ _handle_quarantine_if_invalid（hermes_state.py:775）​与​ _capture_retired_generation（:1307）。

docs.title: 8. ​读​连接​预算
docs.text:
# hermes_state_readpool.py:140-151（​节选​）
class _PathReadBudget:
    """Read-connection permits for ONE database file, shared process-wide
    (per-instance semaphores let N SessionDBs peak at N x (1 + MAX)). An idle
    pooled connection keeps its permit, so a permit miss first reclaims an IDLE
    connection from a peer on the same path.

    ``_READ_POOL_MAX`` used to be enforced by a ``BoundedSemaphore`` owned by each SessionDB, which bounded
    the wrong noun: the descriptors are spent on a *file*, so N SessionDB objects on one state.db each got
    their own allowance and peak scaled as ``N x (1 + _READ_POOL_MAX)`` ... which is how a healthy process
    walked into EMFILE — #98573."""

​三级​门​，​由​宽​到​窄​（acquire :198-212）：fd ​余量​（_FD_HEADROOM_RESERVE = 64，:56——SQLite ​的​描述符​只是​ fd ​表​的​一部分​，EMFILE ​往往​先炸​在​ httpx/​终端​管道​上​）→ ​每​进程​ 24（_READ_POOL_PROCESS_MAX，​多路复用​网关​ N ​个​ profile ​各​一个​ state.db）→ ​每​文件​ 8（_READ_POOL_MAX，:35）。​许可​不足​时先​回收​同​路径​同伴​的​空闲​连接​（reclaim_idle :230），​仍​不得​才​降级​到​写​连接​上​的​带锁读​。​同一​文件​ >4 ​个活​ handle ​触发​一次性​ WARNING ​并列​出​各​ handle ​的​创建​点​（register :160-191）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​门面​：SessionDB.__init__/_open_writer/close ​是​本组​所有​机制​的​最大​消费​方​（​隔离​检查​、OFD hold/release、​身份​记录​、​检疫​）；_execute_write ​超时​后调​ log_write_lock_holders。
  • mutation/​压缩​：​租约​回收​的​ stale ​回调​依赖​ holder_pid_checkable；_halt_db_corrupt ​调​ mark_storage_corrupt ​广播​给​全​进程​。
  • hermes doctor：holders/lockowners/dbfile ​的​扫描​是​ doctor ​与​ hermes sessions recover ​的​取证​后​端​。
  • gateway：readiness ​探针​读​ storage_state，​把​ /api/status ​的​ components.storage ​与​桌面​侧栏​对齐​到​同一​事实​源​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​一组​把​"​多​进程​ SQLite"​里​最​容易​悄悄​烂掉​的​部分​变成​可​命名​的​事实​：​锁​有​名字​（lockowners）、​锁​丢​不了​（lockguard）、pid ​有​命名​空间​（pidns）、​损坏​有闩​（health）、​替换​有​探测​（dbfile）、​读有​预算​（readpool）、​测试​进不了​生产​（guard）。​它们​大多​只有​几百​行​，​却​各自​堵住​一类​真实​事故​——​每一处​ docstring ​里​的​ issue ​号​就是​曾经​的​停机​记录​。

docs.title: 收尾​：​网关​持久​化​、​异常​分类​、Schema、​用量​与​ Terminal ​墓碑
文件​概览
docs.text:
​最后​五个​兄弟​模块​不​属于​前​七篇​的​任何​单一​主题​，​却​各自​被​多方​依赖​：

  • hermes_state_gateway.py（1033 ​行​）：gateway ​需要​的​一切​持久​化​——​路由​索引​、peer ​恢复​、​孤儿​会话​、​后​端​心跳​、​跨平台​ handoff。
  • hermes_state_errors.py（326 ​行​）：​异常​类型​与​字符串​级​错误​分类​谓词​（​让​ wrapped RPC ​字符串​与​活​异常​走同​一套​判定​）。
  • hermes_state_schema.py（1367 ​行​）：​声明​式​ DDL、​列​调和​、FTS ​重建​编排​——​打开​连接​时​跑​的​那段​。
  • hermes_state_usage.py（469 ​行​）：​合并式​后台​ token ​写入​器​与​每​模型​用量​行​。
  • hermes_state_terminal.py（170 ​行​）：terminal ​专用​的​退休​墓碑​查询​——​精确​重​放​，​绝无​历史​重建​。

​本篇​末尾​附​64 ​文件​全​覆盖​核对表​：​前​七篇​清单​与​本篇​清单​的​并​集即​全部​ hermes_state_*.py ​兄弟​。

docs.title: 1. ​路由​索引​与​ peer ​恢复
docs.text:
# hermes_state_gateway.py:60-76（​节选​）
_PEER_BY_KEY_SQL = f"""{_PEER_SELECT_HEAD}                WHERE s.session_key = ?
                  AND s.source = ?
                  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.end_reason IN ({_RECOVERABLE_END_REASONS_SQL})
                       OR {_HANDOFF_OWNED_ROW_SQL})
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM sessions b
                      WHERE b.session_key = s.session_key
                        AND b.source = s.source
                        AND b.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND b.end_reason IN ({_RESET_END_REASONS_SQL})
                        AND b.ended_at
                            > COALESCE(s.last_activity_at, s.started_at)
                  )
                ORDER BY _has_messages DESC,
                         COALESCE(s.last_activity_at, s.started_at) DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """

find_latest_gateway_session_for_peer（:496）​先​按​精确​ key、​再​按​ peer ​五元​组​（source/user/chat/type/thread）​恢复​"​这个​对话​上次​是​哪​一行​"；_HANDOFF_OWNED_ROW_SQL = "(s.handoff_state = 'completed')"（:59）​让​已​完成​交接​的​行​无视​ end_reason ​保持​可​恢复​——​源侧​ teardown ​可能​在​目的地​首条​回复​前​打​上​ cli_close，​否则​交接​腿​会​被​孤儿​化​。_COMPRESSION_LINEAGE_CTE（:25）​把​压缩​祖先​绑​在​同一个​ routing peer ​上​。

docs.title: 2. ​孤儿​、​心跳​与​ handoff
docs.text: find_orphaned_gateway_sessions（:540）​找​"​有​ key ​无​活跃​ backend ​且​超时​"​的​会​话​；adopt_orphaned_gateway_session（:598）​把​孤儿​捐给​接管​者​。​心跳​四件套​ register_backend_heartbeat（:901）/clear_backend_heartbeat（:918）/prune_stale_heartbeats（:926）/list_backend_heartbeats（:939）。handoff ​状态机​ request_handoff（:946）→claim_handoff（:980）→complete_handoff（:991）→fail_handoff（:997），​外加​ reclaim_stale_running_handoffs（:1011）。save/load_gateway_routing_entries（:304/:337）​维护​ gateway_routing ​表​（scope ​为空​的​行​是​本地​路由​）；rekey_profile_state（:673）/purge_profile_state（:782）​服务​ profile ​改名​与​清除​。

docs.title: 3. ​异常​分类​：​字符串​也​要​能判
docs.text:
# hermes_state_errors.py:49-56
def is_sqlite_lock_error(exc_or_str) -> bool:
    """SQLITE_BUSY / SQLITE_LOCKED: wait and retry, never treat as damage. A known result code
    decides; only without one (our own re-raised messages, RPC-wrapped strings) does the text."""
    code = _sqlite_primary_code(exc_or_str)
    if code is not None:
        return code in _SQLITE_LOCK_CODES
    text = str(exc_or_str).lower()
    return "locked" in text or "busy" in text

​分类​桶​全集​ PERSISTENCE_ERROR_CAUSES（:99-102）：locked / compression / compression_closed / turn_lease / corrupt / fts_index / replaced / deleted_wal / disk / session_row_missing / unknown。​顺序​敏感​：_DB_CORRUPTION_MARKERS ​的​注释​（:105-109）​强调​ "database disk image is malformed" ​含​ "disk"，​必须​先于​磁盘​桶​判​，​否则​ B-tree ​损坏​会​被​读成​"​清​一下​磁盘​"。StateDbCorruptError/StateDbReplacedError/DeletedWalGenerationError ​等​类型​与​ classify_persistence_error ​都​定义​于​此​。

docs.title: 5. ​用量​：​合并式​后台​ token ​写入​器
docs.text:
# hermes_state_usage.py:107-114（​节选​）
    def queue_token_counts(self, session_id: str, **kwargs) -> None:
        """Enqueue a token/cost delta for the background writer (same kwargs as
        :meth:`update_token_counts`). After close() stopped the writer, falls back to the
        synchronous path and may raise."""

SessionUsageMixin（:83）​维持​单写​线程​：queue_token_counts ​只是​ deque append，​连续​同​路由​的​增量​被​合并​（​合并​键​ _TOKEN_DELTA_SUM_FIELDS/_TOKEN_DELTA_ROUTE_FIELDS，hermes_state.py:1605-1613——​合并​后​的​ UPDATE ​等价​于​顺序​施加​）；​精确​读​走​ flush_token_counts（:159）。SQL ​生成器​ _token_update_sql（:21）​区分​ delta（CLI ​逐​调用​）​与​ absolute（gateway ​累计​）​两种​模式​；session_model_usage ​表​的​ UPSERT（:53-72）​按​ (session_id, model, provider, base_url, mode, task) ​累加​。record_auxiliary_usage（:392）​与​ usage_totals（:456）​补齐​辅助​用量​与​汇总​。​线程​空闲​ _TOKEN_WRITER_IDLE_SECONDS = 30s ​后​退休​（hermes_state.py:512-513），​避免​绑定​方法​把​废弃​ handle ​钉​在​内存​里​。

payload. A retired target permits only that exact digest, never fresh admission.

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway：​本组​ SessionGatewayMixin ​是​ gateway/session.py ​路由​索引​的​直接​后​端​；session_admissions/worker_executions/gateway_routing ​表​的​读写​分散​在​ runtime（​回执​）​与​本​模块​（​索引​/​心跳​）。
  • hermes doctor / hermes status：classify_persistence_error ​的​桶​ + hermes_state_user_copy ​的​文案​ = ​每个​故障​一张​"​发生​了​什么​、​怎么办​"​的​卡片​。
  • agent / turn loop：queue_token_counts ​由​轮次​记账​调用​；api_call_count、per-model ​行​喂​ dashboard ​用量​页​。
  • run_agent / TUI：schema ​编排​决定​首次​打开​的​耗时​特征​；retry_deferred_fts_recovery ​保证​被​挡​的​恢复​不​丢​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​五个​文件​没有​共同​主题​，​但​有​一个​共同​气质​：​做​某​张表​/​某类​错误​的​唯一​权威​。gateway ​持久​化​独占​路由​与​ peer ​语义​，errors ​独占​"​什么​算​什么​"，schema ​独占​打开​时​的​编排​，usage ​独占​记账​节奏​，terminal ​独占​墓碑​协议​。​至此​，64 ​个​兄弟​各归​其位​——​门面​组装​它们​，​回执​事务​约束​它们​，​谱系​与​守卫​保护​它们​，​这​一层​就​完整​了​。

docs.title: 检索​与​维护​：FTS、​修剪​、​修复​与​ /undo
文件​概览
docs.text:
​状态​库​不仅​要​写​得​对​，​还要​找​得到​、​瘦得​下​、​坏​得​起​。​本组​十个​文件​覆盖​三件​事​：

  • ​检索​：hermes_state_fts.py（FTS5 ​索引​ ensure ​与​ tokenizer ​能力​回退​）+ hermes_state_search.py（​全文​/trigram/CJK ​检索​与​重建​引擎​）。
  • ​维护​：hermes_state_maintenance.py（​保留​修剪​、​陈旧​归档​、VACUUM）、hermes_state_repair.py（​修复​/​备份​/​可​写性​预检​）、hermes_state_profile_repair.py（​跨​ profile ​修复​）、hermes_state_reconcile.py（schema ​漂移​）、hermes_state_media.py（durable ​媒体​回收​）、hermes_state_prompt_refresh.py（​提示​词​刷新​ epoch）。
  • ​回退​：hermes_state_rewind.py（/undo /retry ​的​ carrier-aware user-turn ​回退​）​与​ hermes_state_legacy_refusal.py（​旧版​安全​拒绝​行​的​一次性​迁移​修复​）。

docs.title: 1. FTS ​布局​注册表​：​版本​化​ DDL
docs.text:
# hermes_state_fts.py:39-62（​节选​）
# Every stored definition a released version has created, oldest first; the LAST entry is the one this code
# creates. optimize-storage rebuilds only the older entries: an unrecognised definition (a newer release's, after
# a downgrade) is left alone. Literal on purpose: a change to FTS_SQL / FTS_TRIGRAM_SQL fails
# test_the_layout_registry_ends_with_the_shipping_ddl until its new form is appended here...
FTS_VTABLE_LAYOUTS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "messages_fts": (
        "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE messages_fts USING fts5(content,content=messages,content_rowid=id)",
        ...
        "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE messages_fts USING fts5(content,tool_name,tool_calls,"
        "content='messages_fts_src',content_rowid='id')",
    ),
    "messages_fts_trigram": (... tokenize='trigram' ...),
}

​注册表​把​"​历史​上​发过​哪些​ FTS ​定义​"​钉成​字面​量​；fts_layout_drift（:93）​报告​旧​布局​（optimize-storage ​的​重建​对象​），fts_layout_current（:105）​判定​当前​态​（fts_storage_version ​唯一​可​盖戳​的​状态​）。tokenizer ​能力​回退​：​无​ trigram ​支持​的​ SQLite ​上​ messages_fts_trigram ​直接​不建​（​只读​ attach ​用​ SELECT ​探测​，hermes_state.py:743-747）。

docs.title: 2. FTS ​损坏​的​ fail-open
docs.text: FTS ​影子​表​损坏​会​让​每次​写​都​炸​（​同步​触发器​），​而​ canonical ​行​完好​。​写​路径​ _execute_write ​里​ _enter_fts_fail_open（hermes_state.py:1126）​原子​卸下​ FTS ​触发器​并重​试​——​绝不​在​写​路径​重建​。​判定​谓词​ is_fts_scoped_corruption_error（hermes_state_errors.py:122）​让​"SQLITE_CORRUPT_VTAB ​结果​码​优先​于​散文​"。

docs.title: 8. carrier-aware ​回退​（/undo /retry）
docs.text:
# hermes_state_rewind.py:1-3（​模块​ docstring）
"""Carrier-aware user-turn rewind (``/undo``, ``/retry``) — the ONE implementation behind the CLI, the
gateway and the TUI. Rewind is a persisted-history operation: the durable transcript is the authority,
the warm (in-memory) history only has to agree with it. A composite compaction carrier (retained
summary + live human ask in one row) keeps its hidden handoff scaffold as the new head."""

plan_user_turn_rewind（:236）​产出​ RewindPlan（​目标​、​将​停用​的​ ids、​预览​），rewind_user_turn（:182）​落库​（​底层​即​ hermes_state_mutation_transcript.rewind_in_transaction）；retain_refused_turn_for_display（:95）​把​刚​被​安全​过滤​拒绝​的​整轮​移出​模型​上下文​、​同时​在​显示​面​保留​灰色​ content_refused ​通知​——​注意​它​住​在​ owner ​侧​（​持​直接​ SessionDB ​的​ CLI/ACP），​不是​ worker ​对​ RuntimeSessionStore ​的​调用​。

docs.title: 9. legacy ​拒绝​修复​与​提示​词​刷新
docs.text:
• hermes_state_legacy_refusal.py：#149708 ​之前​的​构建​把​拒绝​轮​留在​上下文​里​，​整条​聊天​被​锁死​。​本​模块​以​ failed_turn ​边界​上​的​ content_policy_blocked ​元​数据​为​标记​做​一次性​数据​迁移​（repair_legacy_refused_turns :252，advance_legacy_refusal_repair :304）：​只动​"​最新​稳定​轮全​是​拒绝​"​的​交互​聊天​；​拒绝​后​有​真实​回答​、​已​折进​压缩​摘要​、​非​聊天​来源​（cron/subagent/kanban…）​一律​不​动​。​发现​阶段​无写​锁​（​每会话​一次​索引​探测​），​写锁​只​按​修复​的​会​话​取​。
  • hermes_state_prompt_refresh.py：request_prompt_refresh（:22）​在​ state_meta ​写​ prompt_refresh.epoch（profile ​级​）​或​ prompt_refresh.epoch:<sid>（​会话级​），prompt_refresh_epoch（:41）​读​"​适用​于​该会​话​的​最新​ epoch"。agent ​侧​的​ agent/prompt_refresh.py ​据此​决定​下​一轮​是否​重建​提示​词​——epoch ​也​随​压缩​轮转​带到​子行​（​见​ compression ​组​ _CONVERSATION_MODEL_CONFIG_KEYS）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• schema ​组​（misc）：hermes_state_schema ​在​打开​时​编排​ FTS ensure/​重建​，​消费​本组​ fts_layout_* ​与​ legacy_refusal ​迁移​。
  • messages：rewind ​落到​ hermes_state_mutation_transcript.rewind_in_transaction；prune ​重写​（compression ​组​）​与​ rewritten_held_row_ids CAS ​协作​。
  • hermes doctor / optimize-storage：repair/reconcile/search ​的​导出​面是​这​两条​ CLI ​的​后​端​；fts_layout_drift ​同时​喂​更新​提示​。
  • gateway/TUI：search_messages ​与​ get_session_timeline（sessions ​组​）​共同​支撑​面板​搜索​与​跳转​；RewindOutcome ​是​各端​统一​的​回退​结果​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​维护​代码​的​第一性​原则​在​文档​串里​反复​出现​：​绝不​原地​修库​（​先​备份​、​先​检疫​）、​预算内​自愈​（​读​路径​也​修​，​但​有​ busy/​时间​预算​）、​迁移​一次性​且​可续​（state_meta ​游标​ + ​一秒​预算​）、​回收​走​候选​（​删除​事务​只​记账​，​物理​释放​后置​）。​检索​层则​把​"​索引​可以​烂​"​当成​常态​设计​：FTS ​坏​了​就​ fail-open ​卸掉​，canonical ​行​完好​即可​继续​服务​。

docs.title: 会话​与​消息​：sessions / messages ​及其​卫星​模块
文件​概览
docs.text:
​如果说​回执​事务​是​"​写​协议​"，​这​一组​就是​数据​本身​：hermes_state_sessions.py（1992 ​行​）​管会​话行​的​生老病死​，hermes_state_messages.py（1992 ​行​）​管​转录​的​追加​、​替换​、​回退​与​显示​投影​。​围绕​它们​的​是​九个​卫星​模块​——​标题​、​时间​线​、Todo ​恢复​、​间隙​结果​、​存储​读​投影​、Telegram ​话题​、​白话文​案​——​各自​从大​文件​里​按​ FILE_LINES ​棘轮​拆出​，​经​ MRO ​绑回​ SessionDB。

​所有​ mixin ​共享​同​一批​原语​：_read_ctx（​读​）、_execute_write（​写​）、_read_one/_read_all（​便捷​读​）。

docs.title: 1. ​会话行​的​谱系​ CTE
docs.text:
# hermes_state_sessions.py:48-74（​节选​）
_LINEAGE_CTE_SQL = f"""
            WITH RECURSIVE
              ancestors(id) AS (
                SELECT ?
                UNION
                SELECT parent.id
                FROM ancestors a
                JOIN sessions child ON child.id = a.id
                JOIN sessions parent ON parent.id = child.parent_session_id
                WHERE parent.end_reason = 'compression'
{_non_continuation_child_sql('child.', 'parent.id')}
              ),
              descendants(id) AS (...)

​压缩​谱系​只​沿​ parent_session_id ​的​ compression ​边​扩展​；_non_continuation_child_sql ​把​ branch/delegate ​子行​排除​在​边​之外​（branch ​是​另​一段​对话​，​不是​延续​）。_expand_compression_lineage_ids（:159）​是​它​的​ Python ​对偶​，_collect_delegate_child_ids（:195）​单独​收集​ delegate ​子树​。

docs.title: 3. ​会话级​ model_config ​的​读​改写
docs.text:
# hermes_state_sessions_model_config.py:12-33
def update_conversation_model_config_value(db, session_id: str, key: str,
                                           update: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Read a conversation-wide ``key`` at *session_id*'s compression tip and write ``update(value)``
    back, in one write transaction: a concurrent writer of the key cannot be overwritten with a stale
    copy, and a rotation cannot publish between finding the tip and writing it (the child would keep
    the old copy). ``update`` may run more than once (lock retry) and must be pure; returning None
    removes the key. Returns the id written, None when the row does not exist."""
    def _do(conn) -> Optional[str]:
        tip = db._compression_tip_on(conn, session_id)
        row = conn.execute("SELECT model_config FROM sessions WHERE id = ?", (tip,)).fetchone()
        ...
        conn.execute("UPDATE sessions SET model_config = ? WHERE id = ?", (json.dumps(config), tip))
        return tip
    return db._execute_write(_do)

​关键​在​"​先​在​事务​内​找​ tip、​再​写​ tip"：​轮转​不能​插​在​两步​之间​，​否则​子行​带走​旧​副本​。session_ids_with_model_config_key（:36）​是​反向​索引​扫描​。

def project_compression_tips(db, sessions: list[dict[str, Any]], compact_rows: bool) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

docs.title: 8. ​标题​：​净化​ + ​出处​排序
docs.text:
# hermes_state_titles.py:62-74
    @staticmethod
    def sanitize_title(title: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
        """Strip control/zero-width/bidi chars (and lone surrogates sqlite3 cannot bind),
        collapse whitespace, normalize empty to None. ValueError past MAX_TITLE_LENGTH."""
        from hermes_state import SessionDB
        if not title:
            return None
        cleaned = _TITLE_INVISIBLE_RE.sub('', _TITLE_CONTROL_RE.sub('', _sanitize_surrogates(title)))
        cleaned = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', cleaned).strip()
        if not cleaned:
            return None
        if len(cleaned) > SessionDB.MAX_TITLE_LENGTH:
            raise ValueError(f"Title too long ({len(cleaned)} chars, max {SessionDB.MAX_TITLE_LENGTH})")
        return cleaned

​出处​按​ TITLE_SOURCE_DERIVED(0) < TITLE_SOURCE_LLM(1) < TITLE_SOURCE_USER(2) ​排序​（_title_rank :54-59；NULL ​视为​ user，​兼容​前​溯源​时代​的​手​打​标题​）。bot_chat_title_released（:17-24）​是​"​归档​的​ Bot Chat ​不再​占用​其名​"​的​唯一​判定​；next_title_in_lineage（:36）​产​ "my session #2" ​式​命名​。

# hermes_state_detached_results.py:40-59（​节选​）
    def _append_detached_result(self, session_id: str, content: str, display_kind: str, metadata: dict[str, Any],
                                match_sql: str, params: tuple) -> int:
        """Record a result that arrived between turns as a user row once, including replay after rotation: a row
        ``match_sql`` (a condition on ``m``) finds in the compression lineage is returned instead. Check and insert
        share the writer transaction, so independent gateway processes cannot duplicate it; a live turn refuses it."""

docs.text:
• agent：​转录​行​的​列​契约​对齐​ agent.transcript_repair._OWNED_COLUMNS（hermes_state.py:1638-1646 ​的​ _CONVERSATION_ROW_COLUMNS ​注释​明言​）；split_user_originated_turn（agent.context_compressor）​被​ timeline/detached_results/rewind ​共用​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​会话​与​消息​是​存储​层​的​"​表​"，​其余​是​"​视图​"。​两张​大​文件​守住​不​变量​：​谱系​边​只认​ compression、​一条​ INSERT ​形状​、​转录​写​必过​守卫​、​显示​投影​身份​稳定​。​卫星​模块​则​把​"​大而全​"​拆成​一题​一​文件​，​每个​都​只​依赖​门面​原语​与​谱系​原语​——​这​让​它​能​安全​地被​单独​ patch ​与​测试​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​这​一组​回答​两个​问题​：​文件​用​什么​ journal ​模式​打开​（hermes_state_wal.py），​以及​"​改​状态​"​这一​动作​如何​被​原子​且​可​重放地​记账​（hermes_state_runtime.py + hermes_state_mutations.py + 16 ​个​ mutation_* / worker_* / local* ​兄弟​）。

​核心​模型​：​一个​闭合​动作​（closed action）= ​一个​ BEGIN IMMEDIATE ​事务​ = ​一张​写​进​ state_meta ​的​回执​（receipt，​键形​如​ gateway.mutation.v1.*）。​调用​方先​"​乐观​准备​"（​在​事务​外算​好​快照​），​事务​内重​校验​快照​（revision/generation ​围栏​），​然后​提交​动作​+​回执​。​同一​ (principal, session, request_id) ​的​精确​重​放​直接​返回​旧​回执​，​绝不​重复​施加​。

docs.title: 1. WAL ​激活​与​文件系统​回退
docs.text:
# hermes_state_wal.py:25-31
# WAL needs mmap shared memory + fcntl byte-range locks. Network filesystems (NFS, SMB/CIFS, some FUSE, WSL1) raise
# ``locking protocol``; ZFS corrupts the -shm file under concurrent bursts (COW + mmap) -> ``disk I/O error``.
# Either would silently break everything on state.db/kanban.db, so fall back to DELETE (readers block on writes).
_WAL_INCOMPAT_MARKERS = ("locking protocol", "not authorized", "disk i/o error")
_WAL_SIZE_LIMIT_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024  # 64 MiB

apply_wal_with_fallback（hermes_state_wal.py:254）​是​唯一​允许​发起​ journal-mode ​切换​策略​的​地方​，​不​变量​是​"​绝不​把​在​盘​ WAL ​降级​成​ DELETE"——probe ​读​不到​模式​（None）​与​读​到​ WAL ​同样​拒绝​切换​（:395-398），​因为​所有权​不可​证明​时​切换​会​毁掉​兄弟​连接​未​ checkpoint ​的​提交​。_set_journal_mode_no_wait（:419）​用​ busy_timeout=0 ​把​"​有​并发​打开​者​"​变成​立即​失败​而​不是​抢​在​写者​事务​之间​翻​模式​。macOS ​额外​强制​ synchronous=FULL + checkpoint_fullfsync（:96-128），virtiofs/9p（Docker Desktop bind mount）​在​启用​ WAL ​之前​就​直接​拒绝​（:184-235）。

docs.title: 2. PRAGMA ​应用层
docs.text:
# hermes_state_wal.py:644-651
def apply_database_pragmas(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, db_label: str = "state.db") -> None:
    """Apply optional performance and WAL-sizing PRAGMAs from ``config.yaml``.

    Journal mode is NOT handled here (owned by :func:`apply_wal_with_fallback`). ``database:`` keys: ``cache_size``
    (negative = KiB, positive = pages), ``mmap_size`` (bytes, 0 = off), ``temp_store`` (0-3), ``wal_autocheckpoint``
    (pages), ``journal_size_limit`` (bytes), ``synchronous`` (unset leaves the compile-time default...).

​写者​、​只读​ attach、WAL ​读池​三种​连接​统一​走​这里​；synchronous ​语义​特殊​（​决定​落盘​与否​），​不​认识​的​值​警告​后​保持​原样​而​非​猜​一个​（_apply_synchronous_pragma，:624）。

docs.title: 3. runtime epoch：​实例​世代​的​栅栏
docs.text:
# hermes_state_runtime.py:116-123
def begin_runtime_epoch(db, *, instance_id: str) -> int:
    """Caller MUST hold the profile ownership lock, not merely an endpoint ticket."""
    _text(instance_id)
    def write(conn):
        conn.execute('''INSERT INTO runtime_epoch(singleton,epoch,instance_id) VALUES(1,1,?)
            ON CONFLICT(singleton) DO UPDATE SET epoch=runtime_epoch.epoch+1, instance_id=excluded.instance_id''', (instance_id,))
        return conn.execute('SELECT epoch FROM runtime_epoch WHERE singleton=1').fetchone()[0]
    return db._execute_write(write)

​每个​回执​写​都​带​ _epoch(conn, epoch) ​校验​（:66-69）：epoch ​不​匹配​ → stale_epoch。​旧​ owner ​重启​后​带​着​旧​ epoch ​的​任何​写​都​被​拒绝​。

docs.title: 4. admit：​入队​与​精确​重​放
docs.text:
# hermes_state_runtime.py:130-177（​节选​）
def admit_session_input(db, *, epoch: int, principal_id: str, session_id: str,
                        request_id: str, payload: dict, intent: str = 'queue',
                        _authorize_write=None, _replay_guard=None) -> dict:
    """Admit input; the trusted private guard raises to refuse a NEW write. ...
    Exact existing and terminal replays bypass it: they cannot create or change accepted work."""
    ...
    def write(conn):
        _epoch(conn, epoch)
        _session(conn, session_id)
        old = conn.execute('''SELECT * FROM session_admissions
            WHERE principal_id=? AND target_session_id=? AND request_id=?''', (principal_id, session_id, request_id)).fetchone()
        if old is not None:
            if old['payload_digest'] != digest:
                raise RuntimeStoreError('admission_conflict', **ADMITTED_REQUEST_CONFLICT)
            if _replay_guard is not None:
                _replay_guard(conn)
            return _row(old)
        queued = conn.execute('''SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_admissions WHERE target_session_id=?
            AND status='queued' ''', (session_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        if queued >= ADMISSION_QUEUE_MAX:
            raise RuntimeStoreError('queue_full')
        if _authorize_write is not None:
            _authorize_write(conn)
        ...INSERT INTO session_admissions(...status='queued'...)

​同一​ request id + ​同一​ digest = ​精确​重​放​（​返回​旧​回执​）；digest ​不同​ = admission_conflict，​且​ ADMITTED_REQUEST_CONFLICT（:38）​是​唯一​能​证明​"​请求​已​被​受理​过​"​的​冲突​形态​。​守卫​ _authorize_write(conn) ​收到​的​是​事务​连接​：​不许​ commit、​不许​有​外部​副作用​、SQLite ​重试​时​可能​再​跑​一次​。​队列​上限​ ADMISSION_QUEUE_MAX = 32（:127）。

docs.title: 5. claim / settle / cancel / recover
docs.text:
• claim_session_input（hermes_state_runtime.py:206）：​领取​ FIFO ​头​；​有​ started/unknown ​的​ admission ​或活​ worker ​就​返回​ None；head ​参数​实现​预检后​二次​确认​；​同时​记录​转录​高​水位​ transcript_mark（:240），​结算​时​据此​区分​本轮​失败​边界​与​更​早​轮次​（#134889 GW-21）。
  • settle_session_input（:245）：stale_generation ​三重​校验​（status/owner_epoch/generation），_terminal_write(conn, row) ​是​ owner ​的​同​事务​效果​，​抛错​即​整体​回滚​。
  • cancel_session_input（:280）、recover_session_inputs（:453）、resolve_unknown_session_input（:657）​分别​处理​取消​、owner ​重启​后​的​悬空​恢复​与​"​结局​未知​"​裁决​。
  • mutation_receipt_key / replay_mutation_receipt（:467 / :478）：​回执​键​与​重放​读取​的​公共​底座​。

docs.title: 6. ​闭合​动作​分派
docs.text:
# hermes_state_mutations.py:89-102
def apply_action(db, conn, session_id, operation, payload, *, prepared=None):
    if operation == 'compress':
        from hermes_state_mutation_compress import compress_in_transaction
        return compress_in_transaction(db, conn, session_id, payload, prepared)
    if operation in {'model', 'reasoning', 'workspace', 'editor_mcp', 'edit_policy'}:
        from hermes_state_mutation_prepared import POLICY_HANDLERS
        return POLICY_HANDLERS[operation](db, conn, session_id, payload, prepared)
    if operation == 'branch':
        from hermes_state_mutation_branch import branch_in_transaction
        ...
    handlers = {'delete': _delete, 'import': _import, 'rewind': _rewind, 'reset': reset_in_transaction}

validate_action（:8-55）​是​所有​操作​载荷​的​白名单​校验​（​每个​键​、​每个​类型​都​点名​）。​处理器​统一​返回​ (affected_session_ids, result_dict)。

docs.title: 7. ​乐观​准备​快照​的​事务​内重​校验
docs.text:
# hermes_state_mutation_prepared.py:23-29
def validate_prepared(db, conn, session_id, prepared):
    if not isinstance(prepared, dict) or 'snapshot' not in prepared:
        raise RuntimeStoreError('runtime_coordination_required')
    current = local_snapshot(db, conn, session_id)
    if current != prepared['snapshot']:
        raise RuntimeStoreError('revision_conflict')
    return current

local_snapshot（:12-20）​读取​ POLICY_PREFIX ​回执​、validate_local_lineage ​解析​物理​目标​、require_target_advanceable ​守卫​，​并​抓​下​ runtime_revision。​事务​内​快照​不​等​ ⇒ revision_conflict。POLICY_HANDLERS（:113-115）​把​ model/reasoning/workspace/editor_mcp/edit_policy ​五个​处理器​挂​在​同一​快照​协议​上​。

docs.title: 8. ​守卫​在​写​连接​上​跑
docs.text:
# hermes_state_mutation_guards.py:52-61
def require_idle(db, conn, session_ids):
    for sid in session_ids:
        admissions = conn.execute("SELECT status FROM session_admissions WHERE target_session_id=? AND status IN ('queued','started','unknown')", (sid,)).fetchall()
        workers = conn.execute("SELECT status FROM worker_executions WHERE session_id=? AND status IN ('registered','running','unknown')", (sid,)).fetchall()
        states = {row[0] for row in [*admissions, *workers]}
        if 'unknown' in states:
            raise RuntimeStoreError('unknown_execution')
        if states:
            raise RuntimeStoreError('session_busy')
        _require_transcript_unleased(db, conn, sid)

​守卫​直接​在​回执​事务​的​写​连接​上​查询​，​杜绝​"​检查​-​提交​窗口​"​竞态​。require_not_executing（:19）​是​宽松​版​（​允许​ queued ​跟随者​）；delete_targets（:81）​计算​删除​闭包​：​本地​谱系​ + ​压缩​链​双向​走查​ + delegate ​子树​，​固定点​收敛​，_CHAIN_CAP ​兜底​。

docs.title: 9. ​压缩​的​原子​提交
docs.text:
# hermes_state_mutation_compress.py:6-27（​节选​）
def compress_in_transaction(db, conn, session_id, payload, prepared):
    snapshot = validate_prepared(db, conn, session_id, prepared)
    ...
    if prepared['in_place']:
        child = target
        archive_on_connection(db, conn, target, prepared['messages'])
        affected = {session_id, target}
    else:
        child = uuid.uuid4().hex
        publish_on_connection(db, conn, parent_session_id=target, child_session_id=child,
            source=policy['source'], model=policy['model'], messages=prepared['messages'],
            model_config={'_compressed_from': target}, cwd=policy['cwd'], require_compression_lease=False)
        affected = set()  # Rotation publication already advances the logical revision.
    conn.execute('UPDATE sessions SET runtime_generation=runtime_generation+1 WHERE id=?', (session_id,))

​摘要​、​物理​目标​（​原位​或​轮转​子行​）、​代数​递增​、​回执​，​一个​事务​全部​落地​；validate_prepared ​已​确认​无​ worker/turn/compactor ​活跃​，​因此​无需​再​走​ legacy ​事务​。

docs.title: 10. branch / chat_pick / reset / transcript
docs.text:
• branch_in_transaction（hermes_state_mutation_branch.py:52）：​铸​ local_identity ​子​ id、​复制​父​冻结​策略​（​编辑器​ MCP ​例外​，​必须​子​自带​ :34-49）、_branch_boundary ​定​复制​边界​（assistant ​行​自动​带上​紧跟​的​ tool ​结果​ :12-31）、​克隆​转录​行​、​写子​回执​+​路由​条目​。
  • prepare_chat_pick / commit_chat_pick（hermes_state_mutation_chat_pick.py:41 / :52）：​消息​端​聊天​没有​冻结​策略​，​拾取​（/model、/reasoning）​以​ gateway.mutation.v1.* ​回执​ + revision/generation ​围栏​落地​，​精确​重​放​先于​覆盖​检查​。
  • reset_in_transaction（hermes_state_mutation_reset.py:12）：​发布​ model_config={'_reset_from': target} ​子行​、​旧​目标​ end_reason='session_reset'、advance_local_target ​推进​物理​目标​并​抬​ revision。
  • rewind_in_transaction（hermes_state_mutation_transcript.py:5）：​转录​写​守卫​ → ​可​选​ CAS（expected_active_ids）→ ​把​ >= target ​的​活跃​行置​ active=0 → ​可​选​保留​ compaction handoff ​的​替换​行​ → ​回填​计数​。​它​同时​服务​存储​层​ /undo /retry ​与​ mutation ​回执​两条路​。

docs.title: 11. local ​三​族​：​创建​回执​ / ​谱系​交接​ / legacy ​绑定
docs.text:
# hermes_state_local.py:14-31（​节选​）
def commit_local_session(db, *, epoch, receipt):
    """Reserve the row, route and immutable policy together, before publication. ..."""
    ...
    def write(conn):
        _epoch(conn, epoch)
        old = conn.execute('SELECT value FROM state_meta WHERE key=?', (key,)).fetchone()
        if old is not None:
            ...  # ​精确​重​放​：​同一​ (profile, principal, request) + ​同一​冻结​请求​
            return saved
        from hermes_state_mutation_retirement import RETIRED_PREFIX
        if conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM state_meta WHERE key=?', (RETIRED_PREFIX + sid,)).fetchone():
            # Deleted: its receipt was retired with the transcript; a create/cron retry must not
            # resurrect the row (and re-fire its prompt) under the same deterministic id.
            raise RuntimeStoreError('not_found')
  • hermes_state_local.py：​私有​本地​创建​回执​（POLICY_PREFIX = 'gateway.local_policy.v1:'，:9）；local_identity ​决定性​ id ​保证​重试​天然​幂​等​；on_create ​快照​只​在​获胜​事务​里​ publish、​失败​即​ withdraw（:78-86）。
  • hermes_state_local_lineage.py：validate_local_lineage（:14-40）​逐跳​验证​谱系​（reset ​边​看​ _reset_from、​压缩​边​看​ _CHAIN_STEP_SQL）；advance_local_target（:70）​在​发布​事务​内​完成​物理​目标​交接​（​回执​+​路由​条目​+revision ​一起​写​）；adopt_untracked_compression（:145）​收编​超过​一次​ _CHAIN_CAP ​的​未​跟踪​压缩​步​。
  • hermes_state_local_migration.py：bind_legacy_target（:103）​把​老​ CLI/TUI/GUI/​手机​ app ​的​无​路由​行​事务性​绑定​为​本地​会话​（​验证​ legacy ​行​形状​、​无链​、​空闲​、​无​ turn ​租约​，​然后​补​路由​列​ + ​写​ LEGACY_PREFIX ​绑定​记录​）；client_label/legacy_history_row（:41/:57）​决定​谁​能​被​收编​，​第三方​ WebUI ​的​行​刻意​排除​（​不​合法化​第二个​写者​）。

docs.title: 12. worker ​三​兄弟
docs.text:
• hermes_state_runtime_workers.py：runtime_lineage（:5-23）​让​ worker ​排除​跟随​逻辑​会话​+​物理​谱系​；worker_states（:26）​一条​ json_each ​索引​探测​整条​链​；compact_terminal_receipts（:88）​把​终态​执行​的​读​回执​缩成​ {'retired': True} ​墓碑​（​否则​每次​托管​轮留​一份​全史​拷贝​，state.db ​平方​增长​），​并​级联​退休​子​执行​（descendant_range :62 ​用​前缀​区间​一次​索引​探测​全部​后代​）。
  • hermes_state_worker_compression.py：worker ​回执​连接​上​的​闭合​压缩​操作​——​压缩​锁​ acquire/renew/release/holder（:26）、​失败​冷却​记录​/​恢复​/​清除​（:51/:64/:86，​恢复​带​逐列​验证​ :79-82）、CompressionSnapshot（:103）​只​借​生产​读​算法​不​给​写​能力​、worker_publish（:311）​发布​轮转​子​、worker_receipt_assignment（:360）​落​分配​回执​。
  • hermes_state_worker_context.py：​构造​上下文​闭合​读​——worker_context（:16）、worker_prompt（:29）、worker_sidecars（:39，​只许​白名单​键​ _usage_anchor ​等​）、worker_tool_names（:47，4 MiB ​上限​）、worker_tail_role/worker_row_role（:74/:83）。​模块​头​一句​话​定调​："​这​不是​任意​ SessionDB RPC"。
  • hermes_state_worker_lifecycle.py：worker_create（:17，worker ​不能​铸行​或​改​路由​/​谱系​/cwd，​身份​字段​不​一致​即​ permission_denied）、worker_end（:43）、​标题​三件套​（:63/:77/:85，​标题​去​重​要求​"​已授​标题​或​已​回执​的​标题​尝试​"）​等​；insert_session_row_in_transaction（:209）​是​行​插入​原语​。

docs.title: 13. retirement ​与​ terminal ​墓碑
docs.text: hermes_state_mutation_retirement.py ​定义​ durable ​删除​围栏​：RETIRED_PREFIX = 'gateway.retired_session.v1.'（:9）。​删除​后该​ id ​永久​拒绝​重建​（create_conflict :28）；​派生​ id（Bot Chat、hosted-room ​成员​等​）​被删​后​自动​升​到​下一代​（first_generation :38）；​沿途​路过​的​围栏​被​ keep_passed_fences（:57）​转为​永久​。retire_terminal_receipts（:100）​把​ admission/worker ​行​缩成​保留​ digest ​的​墓碑​——​精确​重放​仍​能​解析​，​用户​输入​副本​不再​保留​。

docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ apply_wal_with_fallback hermes_state_wal.py:254 journal-mode ​决策树​；​绝不​活​降级​ WAL apply_database_pragmas hermes_state_wal.py:644 config ​驱动​的​性能​ PRAGMA（​全​连接​类型​） begin_runtime_epoch hermes_state_runtime.py:116 ​铸​/​递增​ owner epoch admit_session_input hermes_state_runtime.py:130 ​入队​ + ​精确​重​放​ + ​队列​上限​ claim_session_input hermes_state_runtime.py:206 ​领取​ FIFO ​头​ + transcript_mark settle_session_input hermes_state_runtime.py:245 ​三重​围栏​结算​ + ​同​事务​终端​效果​ apply_action hermes_state_mutations.py:89 ​闭合​动作​处理器​分派​ validate_prepared hermes_state_mutation_prepared.py:23 ​乐观​快照​事务​内重​校验​ require_idle / require_target_advanceable hermes_state_mutation_guards.py:52 / :43 ​写​连接​上​的​空闲​/​推进​守卫​ compress_in_transaction hermes_state_mutation_compress.py:6 ​摘要​+​目标​+​代数​+​回执​原子​提交​ branch_in_transaction hermes_state_mutation_branch.py:52 ​独立​路由​+​转录​+​冻结​策略​一​提交​ rewind_in_transaction hermes_state_mutation_transcript.py:5 ​事务​内​回退​原语​ commit_local_session hermes_state_local.py:14 ​本地​创建​回执​（​幂​等​ id + ​围栏​） advance_local_target hermes_state_local_lineage.py:70 ​发布​事务​内​物理​目标​交接​ bind_legacy_target hermes_state_local_migration.py:103 ​事务性​ legacy ​绑定​ compact_terminal_receipts hermes_state_runtime_workers.py:88 ​终态​回执​缩​墓碑​ + ​子​执行​级联​退休

（hermes_state_terminal.py ​属​收尾​组​，​但​其​ retry_terminal_admission ​是​ admit ​的​退休​侧​对偶​，​见​ misc_state.md。）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway：session.mutate、session.input ​等​ RPC ​全部​落​在​ hermes_state_runtime + mutation ​处理器​上​；_authorize_write ​守卫​由​ gateway ​的​授权​层​注入​。
  • agent：agent.conversation_compression_archive.ABSORBED_ROW_IDS、agent.message_metadata ​的​ uid ​键​被​ runtime ​直接​引用​；​压缩​发布​经​ worker_compression.publish_on_connection。
  • ​锁层​：hermes_state_compression._claim_lease_row ​是​ worker ​压缩​锁​与​ hermes_state_compression ​压缩​锁​共用​的​租约​原语​；​守卫​里​的​ SessionTurnLeaseLostError/SessionCompressionInProgressError ​来自​ hermes_state_errors。
  • owner_identity：gateway.owner_identity.same_owner ​决定​绑定​/​收编​语义​，​存储​层​只存​ [profile_id, subject]。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: WAL ​是​"​性能​决策​"，​回执​事务​是​"​正确性​协议​"。​前者​只​在​文件系统​允许​时开​ WAL、​绝不​停用​已开​的​ WAL；​后者​把​每个​用户​可见​的​状态​变更​变成​"​校验​+​写​+​回执​"​的​单一​事务​，​靠​ digest ​和​围栏​把​重放​、​冲突​、​世代​漂移​全部​变成​可​判定​的​错误码​。​这​两层​合​起来​，​就是​一个​能​被​多​进程​安全​共写​的​状态机​。

docs.title: 08 tui_gateway/ —— TUI、​桌面​端​与​仪表盘​共用​的​ JSON-RPC ​后​端​总览
docs.text:
tui_gateway/（103 ​个​顶层​文件​ + contracts/ 25 ​个​契约​文件​）​是​ Hermes ​的​终端​ UI ​后​端​：​一个​把​ agent ​能力​暴露​成​ JSON-RPC ​方法​的​ Python ​进程​。​它​同时​是​三个​消费者​的​后​端​——hermes --tui ​的​ Ink ​终端​界面​、Electron ​桌面​应用​（apps/desktop/）、​以及​仪表盘​内嵌​的​ /chat（web/ + ui-tui ​经​ PTY ​复用​）。​改​这里​的​一行​代码​，​三个​界面​同时​受​影响​；​这​正是​ tui_gateway/AGENTS.md ​开篇​的​第一句​话​。

​这个​模块​是​「​瘦腰​架构​」​在​ UI ​侧​的​体现​：Python ​拥有​行为​（​会话​、​工具​、​模型​调用​、slash ​逻辑​），TypeScript ​拥有​屏幕​（​转写​渲染​、​输入框​、​提示​卡片​）。​把​任何​ agent ​行为​搬进​渲染器​都​是​违反​设计​方向​的​——​渲染器​只是​一个​会​画​ JSON-RPC ​事件​的​客户端​。

docs.title: 进程​模型​：​一个​ ASCII ​说​清​全部
docs.text:
hermes --tui
  └─ Node (Ink)  ──WebSocket /api/ws, ​子​协议​ hermes-gateway-v1──▶  ​该​ profile ​的​共享​网关​ owner
       │  (URL + ​一次性​票据​：                                        ├─ ​会话​权威​：sessions、AIAgent、​工具​
       │   ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py)                     └─ tui_gateway handlers（​非会话​方法​）
       └─ ​渲染​转写​、​输入框​、​提示​、​活动​流​

​三个​关键​事实​：

  • Ink ​从不​ spawn ​私有​ agent。ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py ​是​ hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py::attach_gateway ​的​薄​包装​——​与​任何​本地​客户端​跑​的​ hermes gateway attach --json ​完全​同​一条​路​。​它​按​需拉起​该​ profile ​的​共享​网关​ owner（hermes gateway run，​空闲​自动​退出​），​拿到​ URL + ​一次性​票据​后经​ WebSocket ​附加​过去​。​唯一​拨向​别处​ URL ​的​是​仪表盘​ /chat（HERMES_TUI_GATEWAY_URL），​它​从​ listener ​的​ ready ​帧​协商​ wire。
  • stdio ​通道​仍​在​。tui_gateway/entry.py ​是​老​的​ stdio JSON-RPC ​入口​（​换行​分隔​ JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout），​如今​只供​开发​ harness（​如​ apps/desktop/e2e/real-session-builder.ts）​使用​——​产品​面​全部​走​ WS ​附加​；entry.py::main ​甚至​会因​ gateway.lock ​被​占​而​拒绝​启动​。
  • desktop ​不​另​起​后​端​。​桌面​应用​经​ apps/shared ​的​ JsonRpcGatewayClient（onRequest）​连同​一个​服务器​；​仪表盘​把​真实​ TUI ​嵌进​ PTY（web/AGENTS.md），​再开​一条​ back-WS ​把​事件​镜像​到​侧边​栏​（event_publisher.py）。

docs.title: 传输层​一句​话
docs.text:
Wire ​是​换行​分隔​的​ JSON-RPC ​帧​，​对​等​（peer-to-peer）​双向​：

​方向​ ​形态​ ​例子​ client→server ​方法​调用​ prompt.submit、session.list、slash.exec server→client ​请求​（agent ​问​用户​，​要​应答​） approval、clarify、sudo、secret、vault.*、connection server→client event ​通知​（​单向​广播​） message.delta、tool.start、request.cancel

server→client ​请求​是​这套​协议​最​独特​的​部分​：agent ​线程​在​ server_requests.py::send() ​上​阻塞​等待​，​直到​应答​帧​带​着​同一个​ srq-<n> id ​回来​。​客户端​在​连接​建立​时​声明​ client.capabilities {server_requests: true}；​从不​声明​的​旧版​客户端​会​被​快速​失败​而​不是​让​ agent ​干​等​超时​。

docs.title: 方法​面​与​契约​面
docs.text:
• ​方法​实现​按​主题​拆进​ 34 ​个​ methods_*.py ​兄弟​模块​（methods_session、methods_config、methods_browser、methods_bot_relay……），​经​ method_ctx.HandlerRegistry ​重​绑定​到​ server.py ​的​命名​空间​——​没有​ if method == ... ​链​。
  • Wire ​在​ Python ​里​声明​，​为​ TypeScript ​生成​：tui_gateway/contracts/（25 ​个​文件​）​给​每个​方法​、​每个​ server→client ​请求​、​每个​事件​各​一个​ Pydantic ​模型​；scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py ​渲染​出​ apps/shared/src/gateway-contract.generated.ts ​与​ OpenRPC JSON，​陈旧性​测试​让​ CI ​失败​。
  • hermes-gateway-v1 ​规范​传输​另有​独立​的​ CANONICAL_METHODS ​目录​（contracts/canonical*.py），​由​ gateway/session_controls.py::AuthorityConnection ​服务​。

docs.title: 关键​界面​速查​（Ink ​组件​ ↔ ​网关​方法​/​事件​）
docs.text: 界面​ Ink ​组件​ ​网关​方法​ / ​事件​ ​聊天​流式​ app.tsx + messageLine.tsx prompt.submit → message.delta / message.complete ​工具​活动​ thinking.tsx tool.start / tool.generating / tool.complete ​审批​ prompts.tsx server→client ​请求​ approval → ​应答​ {choice} clarify / sudo / secret prompts.tsx, maskedPrompt.tsx server→client ​请求​ clarify / sudo / secret ​会话​选择器​ sessionPicker.tsx session.list / session.resume slash ​命令​ ​本地​处理​ + ​兜底​ slash.exec → _SlashWorker；command.dispatch ​补全​ useCompletion hook complete.slash / complete.path ​主题​ theme.ts + branding.tsx gateway.ready ​携带​ skin ​数据​ ​连接​操作​卡​（desktop） desktop store/connection-request.ts connection.request → connection.update* → connection.respond {op_id}

docs.title: 多​ profile：​一个​进程​服务​多个​家
docs.text: ​一个​ serve ​进程​可能​同时​承载​多个​ profile ​家​的​会​话​（Desktop ​池化​后​端​、​仪表盘​）。​第一个​非​启动​ profile ​家​注册​时​，launch_profile_policy.py ​冻结​启动​环境​并​把​ get_secret ​翻​成​ fail-closed；​每个​读写​家​/​配置​/.env ​派生​状态​的​方法​都​必须​挂​在​ server.py::@_profile_scoped ​装饰​器下​——​只设​ get_hermes_home_override() ​是​"​半​绑定​"，​凭据​和​ TERMINAL_* ​策略​仍会​泄漏​启动​ profile ​的​值​。​详见​本组​ process_model.md。

docs.title: 三个​消费者​，​一条​后​端
docs.text:
维度​ Ink ​终端​（hermes --tui） Desktop ​应用​ ​仪表盘​ /chat ​渲染器​ Node + Ink（ui-tui/） Electron + React（apps/desktop/） ​嵌入​真实​ TUI ​经​ PTY ​连接​方式​ gateway_bootstrap.py ​附加​（WS，​协议​ hermes-gateway-v1） apps/shared::JsonRpcGatewayClient（WS） HERMES_TUI_GATEWAY_URL ​拨​别处​ URL ​附加​通道​ attach_gateway（URL + ​一次性​票据​） ​同一​ attach_gateway listener ready ​帧​协商​ ​额外​面​ stdio（​开发​ harness） server→client ​桥​：preview.read/act、terminal.read、window.read、tour back-WS ​事件​镜像​（event_publisher.py） ​代码​归属​ TypeScript ​画​屏幕​ TypeScript ​画​屏幕​ Python ​画​转写​，TS ​嵌壳​

"TypeScript ​拥有​屏幕​"​的​边界​在​ Desktop ​上​最​容易​被​误判​：desktop ​插件​的​ plugin.js ​有​ App ​全部​权限​，​但​目录​准入​（​规则​ 8）​把​它​锁死​在​ SDK ​表面​——​同样​的​隔离​哲学​，UI ​侧​的​投影​。

docs.title: 一次​ prompt.submit ​的​完整​旅程
docs.text:
​把​前面​的​抽象​串成​时间​线​，​是​理解​三个​消费者​共用​后​端的​最快​方式​：

​用户​在​ Ink ​输入框​敲​下​回车​
  → Node ​渲染器​本地​处理​内置​命令​（/help、/quit、/clear、/resume…）
  → ​其余​走​ slash.exec ​或​直接​ prompt.submit（JSON-RPC ​方法​调用​帧​）
  → WebSocket /api/ws → ws.py ​读​循环​排队​ → rpc_dispatch.dispatch
  → ​契约​校验​（​未知​参数​键​ 4000）→ handler（methods_prompt.py）
  → ​延迟​ agent ​构建​等待​（session_registry._wait_agent_for_prompt）
  → prompt_turn._run_prompt_submit：admit → ​绑​作用域​ → run_conversation（​独立​线程​）
  → ​流式​期间​：message.delta / tool.start … ​事件​帧​（​经​ write_json ​路由​到​会​话​ transport）
  → ​需要​用户​决定​时​：server_requests.send("approval") ​阻塞​ agent ​线程​ → ​客户端​弹卡​
  → ​应答​帧​带​ srq-<id> ​回来​ → resolve_response ​结算​ → turn ​继续​
  → message.complete → history ​提交​ → ​目标​/​循环​钩子​ → ​排队​续​跑​

​三个​消费者​差异​只​在​两端​：Ink ​从​ stdio/WS ​读帧​、​画成​终端​组件​；Desktop ​经​ apps/shared ​的​ JsonRpcGatewayClient ​画成​ React ​卡片​；​仪表盘​ /chat ​干脆​把​真实​ TUI ​嵌进​ PTY、​再用​ back-WS ​镜像​事件​到​侧边​栏​。​中间​的​ Python ​后​端​完全​同​一条​路​。

docs.title: server.py ​的​骨架​：​门面​里​住​着​什么
docs.text:
server.py（2041 ​行​）​作为​门面​，​值得​记住​它​顶部​的​几个​全局​（server.py:102-122）：

  • _sessions（​会话表​）​与​ _sessions_lock（​可​重入​——​关闭​路径​可能​在​已持​锁​的​调用者​下​运行​）。
  • _methods（​方法​表​）：​唯一​的​注册​ seam ​是​ register_method/@method + ​分身​模块​的​ HandlerRegistry.install。
  • _idempotency_keys：session.create ​的​幂​等​注册表​——​重试​的​ create（​应答​丢失​在​途​）​返回​同一​会话​而​不是​拉​起​重复子​进程​，​条目​随会话​过期​（TTL 300s）。
  • _SLASH_WORKER_TIMEOUT_S：slash worker ​问答​的​默认​ 45s ​上限​。
  • panic ​钩子​（:86-93）：​把​每个​未​捕获​异常​写​进​ logs/tui_gateway_crash.log——stdout ​是​ JSON-RPC ​管道​、stderr ​在​退出​前​可能​不刷​，​崩溃​不留​ forensics ​就​无从​排查​。

​门面​之外​的​ 34 ​个​兄弟​模块​经​ method_ctx.bind_module ​重​绑定​（​详见​ methods_slash.md），​所以​ tests/tui_gateway/ ​里​的​ monkey-patch ​目标​始终​是​ tui_gateway.server ​的​名字​。

docs.title: 新​方法​ / ​新​事件​ / ​新​问题​的​落地​清单
docs.text:
​开发者​的​三个​高频​动作​，​各自​的​最小​完整​改动​集​：

​动作​ Python ​侧​ TS ​侧​ ​守卫​ ​新​ RPC ​方法​ ​契约​ method(...) + handler（​新​ methods_<topic>.py ​或​现有​兄弟​的​条目​，​注册​进表​——​绝不​ if ​链​） ​生成​契约​后​ tsc ​显示​消费者​ test_generated.py ​陈旧​即​ CI ​失败​ ​新​事件​ contracts/events.py ​里​ event("<type>", Payload)；​发射器​被​ check_payload ​盯住​ gateway-events.ts ​只加​客户端​本地​合成​事件​ STRICT ​下​发射​漂移​抛​ ContractViolation ​新​ server→client ​问题​ ​发射器​ _ask("<method>", sid, params, timeout)；​契约​ server_request(...) apps/desktop/.../server-requests.ts + ui-tui/src/app/createServerRequestHandler.ts ​两个​ handler assert_complete ​拒​孤儿​契约​

​规范​传输​（hermes-gateway-v1）​另有​ canonical_method(...) / canonical_namespace(...) ​一条​平行​轨道​（contracts.md），​由​ gateway/session_controls.py::AuthorityConnection ​服务​。

docs.title: 本组​文档​导航
docs.text:
文档​ ​内容​ ​核心​文件​ index.md（​本篇​） ​三​消费者​、​进程​模型​、​导航​ — process_model.md ​附加​而​非​私有​ spawn、​空闲​退出​、compute-host ​隔离​、​多​ profile ​作用域​ server.py、host_supervisor.py、compute_host.py、launch_profile_policy.py rpc_transport.md ​帧​格式​、​三类​帧​、server→client ​请求​、Transport ​家族​、worker ​池​分发​ ws.py、entry.py、transport.py、server_requests.py、rpc_dispatch.py contracts.md ​契约​即​文档​：Pydantic ​三表​、​代码生成​、canonical ​方法​目录​ contracts/registry.py、contracts/base.py、contracts/canonical.py、scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py methods_slash.md 34 ​个​方法​模块​导览​ + slash worker、​事件​发布​/​重​放​、​会话​生命周期​深读​ methods_*.py、slash_worker*.py、event_*.py、session_*.py

​阅读​顺序​建议​：​先​ process_model.md ​弄清​"​谁​是​谁​的​进程​"，​再​ rpc_transport.md ​建立​ wire ​直觉​；contracts.md ​是​改​协议​前​必读​；methods_slash.md ​是​日常​开发​的​目录​册​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​上游​：agent/（AIAgent、turn ​循环​）、hermes_state.py（SessionDB）、tools/（​工具​编排​）——​网关​方法​在​ handler ​里​调用​它们​。
  • ​同层​：gateway/ ​的​ session_controls.py / session_discovery.py / session_commands.py ​提供​ canonical ​会话​权威​面​；tui_gateway ​的​ sidecar ​方法​在​票务​ socket ​上​作为​受限​ fallback ​与​之​共存​（ws_legacy_fallback.py：​会话​动词​归​权威​，​其余​ sidecar ​方法​需要​完整​交互​授权​）。
  • ​下游​（TypeScript）：ui-tui/（Ink ​渲染器​）、apps/desktop/（Electron）、apps/shared/（​共享​ TS ​客户端​与​生成​契约​）、web/（​仪表盘​ /chat）。
  • ​宿主​：hermes_cli/gateway_runtime*.py ​负责​ owner ​的​发现​/​拉​起​/​票据​；gateway/runtime_ownership.py ​的​ gateway.lock ​是​唯一​的​ owner ​仲裁​。

docs.title: 常见​踩​坑​速查
docs.text:
​先给​一张​小​术语表​，​后面​每篇​都​会​用到​：

​术语​ ​含义​ owner ​某个​ profile ​的​共享​网关​进程​（hermes gateway run），​会话​权威​与​ sidecar ​方法​都​在​其中​ ​票据​（ticket） ​附加​时​铸造​的​一次性​凭据​；​可​附加​上去​，​不可​转发​，​绝不​出现​在​日志​或​ repr ​里​ sidecar ​方法​ server._methods ​注册​的​ RPC ​面​（​本组​的​ 34 ​个​ methods_*.py），​区别​于​权威​的​ canonical ​方法​ canonical ​方法​ hermes-gateway-v1 ​的​权威​动词​目录​（contracts/canonical*.py），​仅​ AuthorityConnection ​服务​ srq-<n> server→client ​请求​的​ id ​前缀​；​应答​帧​带​同一​ id ​才​算​结算​ ​重放环​ per-session ​的​有界​事件​缓冲​，session.events.since ​从中​续传​ fanout ​多​订阅​者​的​有界​信箱​ transport；​慢​订阅​者​被​摘除​而​非​拖累​全队​ compute-host dashboard.turn_isolation ​下​承载​ agent turn ​的​持久​子​进程​ multiplex ​一个​进程​承载​多个​ profile ​家​；​激活​后​凭据​读取​ fail-closed ​症状​ ​根因​ ​指向​ ​客户端​调用​成功​但​字​段​丢失​ ​客户端​拼错​/​旧​字段名​被​静默​忽略​ ​契约​ extra="forbid" ​会​让​它​变​ 4000（contracts.md） config.set ​写进​了​错误​的​ profile ​配置​ handler ​只设​了​ home override，​没挂​ @_profile_scoped process_model.md §3；rg ​排查​命令​ agent ​干​等​ 300 ​秒​没人​应答​ ​客户端​从未​声明​ client.capabilities {server_requests: true} rpc_transport.md §3（​快速​失败​护栏​） ​浏览器​刷新​泄漏​一个​ python ​进程​ ​孤儿​ WS ​会话​的​ slash worker（#38591 ​修复​后​有​ 20s ​宽限​收割​） server.py _resolve_ws_orphan_reap_grace ​重连后​弹卡​消失​但​问题​还​在​ ​未​应答​的​ server→client ​请求​经​ open_requests ​重​放​ rpc_transport.md §3 ​重连段​ ​流式​文本​卡​顿成​"​手风琴​" token ​帧​未经​ message.delta ​合并​车道​ ws.py _STREAMING_EVENT_TYPES + 33ms ​缓冲

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ tui_gateway/contracts/registry.py 231 ​契约​目录​：​三张​表​ + ​运行​时​校验​ + ​完整性​断言​ tui_gateway/contracts/base.py 56 Params / Result / Payload / WireEnum ​基类​ tui_gateway/contracts/events.py — ​每个​事件​名​的​ Payload ​模型​ tui_gateway/contracts/server_requests.py — ​每个​ server→client ​请求​的​ Params/Result tui_gateway/contracts/canonical.py ​等​ 4 ​个​ canonical_*.py — hermes-gateway-v1 ​规范​方法​目录​ scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py 400 ​渲染​ TS + OpenRPC tests/tui_gateway/contracts/test_generated.py — ​陈旧性​测试​（CI ​门​）

25 ​个​文件​里​，​每个​ client→server ​方法​、​每个​ server→client ​请求​、​每个​事件​通知​各​一个​ Pydantic ​类​。Wire ​在​ Python ​里​声明​，​为​ TypeScript ​生成​——base.py ​的​ docstring ​说​得​最​直白​：Python ​是​ JSON-RPC wire ​的​唯一​事实​源​。

docs.title: 1. ​三个​基类​立​住​建模​规则
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/contracts/base.py:32-52
class Params(BaseModel):
    """Client→server method params / server→client request params. Unknown keys are rejected."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", populate_by_name=True)


class Result(BaseModel):
    """Method / server-request result. Serialised with ``exclude_none=False`` so an explicit
    ``null`` stays a ``null`` on the wire (clients distinguish absent from null)."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class Payload(BaseModel):
    """Notification payload (``event`` frame ``params.payload``)."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class WireEnum(StrEnum):
    """A closed string set on the wire; renders as a TS literal union."""

​建模​规则​（docstring ​原文​归纳​）：​字段名​就是​ snake_case ​的​ wire ​拼写​；​闭合​集合​用​ StrEnum（​渲染​成​ TS ​字面​量​联合​）；​判别​字段​用​ Literal；X | None = None ​渲染​成​ x?: X | null；​契约​里​禁止​ dict[str, Any]——​要么​声明​形状​，​要么​用​ JsonValue。​少量​刻意​ extra="allow" ​的​ payload（​皮肤​、​宠物​、goal ​状态​）​其​闭合​形状​归​别的​模块​所有​，​用​ OpenPayload ​子类​。

docs.title: 2. ​三张​表​ + ​声明​函数
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/contracts/registry.py:61-68
METHODS: dict[str, MethodContract] = {}
# ``hermes-gateway-v1`` verbs only ``gateway/session_controls.py::AuthorityConnection`` serves
# (``contracts/canonical.py``), plus explicit overrides where a shared name has a different wire.
CANONICAL_METHODS: dict[str, MethodContract] = {}
SERVER_REQUESTS: dict[str, ServerRequestContract] = {}
EVENTS: dict[str, EventContract] = {}
# Dynamic ``hermes-gateway-v1`` namespaces the session authority serves after its own verbs.
CANONICAL_NAMESPACES: dict[str, NamespaceContract] = {}

​表由​ contracts.* ​主题​模块​在​ import ​时​填充​；​读表​的​是​ tui_gateway/server.py（​运行​时​校验​）​和​ scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py（TS/OpenRPC ​渲染​）。​四个​声明​函数​：

# tui_gateway/contracts/registry.py:85-115 (​节选​)
def method(name: str, *, params: type[Params], result: type[Result], doc: str = "") -> MethodContract:
    entry = MethodContract(name, params, result, doc)
    _declare(METHODS, entry)
    return entry


def canonical_method(name: str, *, params: type[Params], result: type[Result], doc: str = "") -> MethodContract:
    entry = MethodContract(name, params, result, doc)
    _declare(CANONICAL_METHODS, entry)
    return entry


def canonical_namespace(name: str, *, prefix: str, capability: str, params: type[Params],
                        doc: str = "") -> NamespaceContract:
    if not name.startswith(prefix):
        raise RuntimeError(f"namespace {name!r} must start with its prefix {prefix!r}")
    entry = NamespaceContract(name, prefix, capability, params, doc)
    _declare(CANONICAL_NAMESPACES, entry)
    return entry


def server_request(name: str, *, params: type[Params], result: type[Result], doc: str = "") -> ServerRequestContract:
    ...


def event(name: str, payload: type[Payload] | None = None, *, doc: str = "") -> EventContract:
    ...

_declare（77-82 ​行​）​拒绝​同一​传输​目录​里​的​重复​声明​；server.py::register_method ​则​在​ import ​时​拒绝​没有​契约​的​注册名​——wire ​上​不​存在​未声明​的​表面​。​方法​名​只​在​运行​时​存在​的​家族​（plugin.<plugin_id>.<name>）​是​一个​ canonical_namespace ​条目​而​不是​逐个​方法​：

# tui_gateway/contracts/canonical.py:380
canonical_namespace("plugin.{plugin_id}.{name}", prefix="plugin.", capability="plugin-rpc-v1", ...)

​客户端​以​ runtime.describe ​里​的​ plugin-rpc-v1 ​能力​为门​，​未知​的​家族​成员​像​普通​未知​方法​一样​答​ -32601。

docs.title: 3. ​运行​时​校验​：​谁​在​严格​模式​下​失败
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/contracts/registry.py:118-151 (​节选​)
# Params are validated on every call: an unknown or mistyped key is the CLIENT's bug and answers
# JSON-RPC ``4000`` with the field path, never a silent ignore. Results and payloads are OUR bug when
# raises, which is what makes the suite the gate.

STRICT = bool(os.environ.get("HERMES_TEST_ISOLATION"))

class ContractViolation(AssertionError):
    """A result or payload the gateway produced does not match its declared contract."""


def _report(kind: str, name: str, exc: ValidationError) -> None:
    if STRICT:
        raise ContractViolation(f"{kind} {name!r} violates its contract: {exc}") from exc
    logger.error("%s %r violates its wire contract: %s", kind, name, exc)


def validate_params(contract, params) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
    """Reject UNKNOWN keys (``4000`` with the key path) — the one check no handler performs, and the
    one that catches a renamed or misspelled field on either side. ..."""
    try:
        contract.params.model_validate(params)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        for err in exc.errors():
            if err.get("type") == "extra_forbidden":
                loc = ".".join(str(p) for p in err.get("loc", ())) or "params"
                return None, (f"invalid params for {contract.name}: {loc}: ... — the client and "
                              "the Hermes backend are out of sync (different versions); run `hermes update` "
                              "and restart both")
    return params, None

​职责​划分​很​精妙​：validate_params ​只拦​未知​键​（​捕获​改名​/​拼错​字段​这​一类​两端​失​同步​），​必填​与​类型​错误​留给​ handler——​因为​ handler ​拥有​自己​的​域码​（4006 ​缺​ session_id、4015 ​坏​ url），​客户端​已经​在​分支​这些​码​。​配套​的​ check_params_accepted（169 ​行​）​反向​闭环​：handler ​成功​接受​了​契约​认为​非法​的​参数​，​说明​契约​比​ wire ​更窄​。check_result / check_payload ​检查​产出​方向​，HERMES_TEST_ISOLATION=1 ​下​抛​ ContractViolation，​生产​只记​日志​。

​规范​侧​（canonical）​另有​ canonical_param_problems（154 ​行​）：​未知​和​缺失​键​都​回​ 4001 invalid_params——​闭合​集合​的​ handler ​本来​就​手工​强制​了​这​一点​。

docs.title: 4. ​完整性​断言​与​代码生成
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/contracts/registry.py:202-219 (​节选​)
def assert_complete(methods: dict[str, object], emitted_events: set[str], server_requests: set[str]) -> None:
    """Every registered method / emitted event name / sent server request has a contract, and no
    contract is orphaned. Raises with the full lists."""
    problems = []
    if missing := sorted(set(methods) - set(METHODS)):
        problems.append(f"methods without a contract: {missing}")
    if orphan := sorted(set(METHODS) - set(methods)):
        problems.append(f"method contracts with no handler: {orphan}")
    ...
    if problems:
        raise ContractViolation("tui_gateway/contracts is incomplete:\n  " + "\n  ".join(problems))

​生成器​读​这​四张​表​渲染​两个​文件​（scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py:39-40）：

# scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py:39-46
TS_OUT = ROOT / "apps" / "shared" / "src" / "gateway-contract.generated.ts"
OPENRPC_OUT = ROOT / "apps" / "shared" / "src" / "gateway-contract.openrpc.json"
...
HEADER = (
    "// GENERATED by scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py from tui_gateway/contracts — DO NOT EDIT.\n"
    "// Regenerate: .venv/bin/python scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py\n"
    "// tests/tui_gateway/contracts/test_generated.py fails when this file is stale.\n"
)

TS ​输出​携带​ RpcMethods、ServerRequestMap、BackendGatewayEventMap ​与​每个​值​形状​；canonical ​同一​生成器​输出​ CanonicalRpcMethods ​与​ OpenRPC ​的​ x-canonical-methods / x-canonical-namespaces，​不​拓宽​ RpcMethods。​生成器​刻意​用​一个​小​的​ JSON-Schema ​子集​渲染器​——​遇到​不​支持​的​ schema ​就​在​生成​时​抛错​，​逼​你​在​模型​侧修​，​而​不是​在​输出​侧绕​。

​迭代​闭环​：​改​模型​ → ​跑​生成器​ → tsc ​立刻​向​每个​消费者​展示​字​段​搬家​了​；​忘​了​重新​生成​，test_generated.py ​在​ Python ​侧​让​ CI ​失败​。

docs.title: 5. handler ​注册​端
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/server.py:775-786
def register_method(name: str, fn) -> None:
    """The ONE registration seam (``@method`` here and ``HandlerRegistry.install`` for the split
    modules). ``tests/tui_gateway/contracts/test_generated.py::test_every_method_has_a_contract`` and the
    generator's ``assert_complete`` fail when a registered name has no contract."""
    _methods[name] = fn


def method(name: str):
    def dec(fn):
        register_method(name, fn)
        return fn
    return dec

​新​问题​的​完整​落地​路径​（AGENTS.md ​原文​）：​发射器​里​ _ask("<method>", sid, params, timeout)、TS ​侧​ handler（apps/desktop/.../server-requests.ts ​与​ ui-tui/src/app/createServerRequestHandler.ts）、​契约​ server_request(...)——​三处​，​缺一不可​。​新​事件​同理​：contracts/events.py ​里​ event("<type>", Payload)，​发射器​被​契约​盯住​。

​一个​具体​事件​的​契约​长​这样​：

# tui_gateway/contracts/events.py:40-48 (​节选​)
class GatewayReadyPayload(Payload):
    """``tui_gateway/entry.py`` (stdio) / ``tui_gateway/ws.py`` (WebSocket) first frame."""

    skin: SkinPayload
    change_events: bool
    replay_epoch: str
    heartbeat: bool | None = None  # WebSocket transport only
    session_authority: bool | None = None

​每个​模型​的​ docstring ​命名​它​类型​的​ Python ​发射器​——​发射器​是​事实​源​，​手写​ TS ​只​曾​是​地图​。

docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ Params / Result / Payload contracts/base.py:32/38/45 ​三个​ extra="forbid" ​基类​ MethodContract / ServerRequestContract / EventContract / NamespaceContract contracts/registry.py:22/30/40/47 ​四种​契约​的​ frozen dataclass METHODS / CANONICAL_METHODS / SERVER_REQUESTS / EVENTS / CANONICAL_NAMESPACES ​同​上​ :61-68 ​五张​目录​表​ method / canonical_method / server_request / event / canonical_namespace ​同​上​ :85-115 ​声明​入口​；​重复​即​ RuntimeError validate_params ​同​上​ :136 ​只拦​未知​键​ → 4000 + ​字​段​路径​ canonical_param_problems ​同​上​ :154 ​未知​+​缺失​键​ → 4001 invalid_params check_result / check_payload ​同​上​ :179/:186 ​产出​方向​校验​；STRICT ​下​抛​ ContractViolation assert_complete ​同​上​ :202 ​无​孤儿​契约​、​无​无​契约​方法​的​完整性​门​ Renderer / _Schema scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py TS/OpenRPC ​渲染​；​稳定​ $defs ​命名​ register_method / method tui_gateway/server.py:775/782 ​唯一​注册​ seam

docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ contracts/base.py ​基类​与​建模​规则​（JsonValue、WireEnum） contracts/registry.py ​目录​表​、​声明​函数​、​运行​时​校验​、​完整性​断言​ contracts/events.py ​所有​事件​ Payload（SkinPayload、GatewayReadyPayload…） contracts/server_requests.py server→client ​请求​契约​（approval/clarify/…） contracts/canonical.py ​规范​ hermes-gateway-v1 ​方法​（admission、receipt、cancel…） contracts/canonical_sessions.py / canonical_projections.py / canonical_stored_reads.py ​共享​名​的​权威​覆盖​与​投影​ contracts/sessions.py / prompt_voice.py / tools_commands.py / tools_mcp_plugins.py / config_free_tier_control.py / connectors.py / connectors_operation.py / display.py / groups_bot_relay.py / i18n.py / machine.py / profiles_vault_complete_foreign_subagents.py / projects_pets.py / billing_delegation_pets.py / liveness.py / common.py ​按​主题​的​ Params/Result/Payload ​主题​模块​ scripts/gen_gateway_contracts.py TS + OpenRPC ​生成器

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tui_gateway/server.py：dispatch ​时​按​契约​校验​入​参与​出参​；_event_frame ​发射​前调​ check_payload。
  • gateway/session_controls.py::AuthorityConnection：​对​ canonical ​方法​做​参数​与​成功​结果​的​校验​（4001 invalid_params）。
  • apps/shared/src/gateway-contract.generated.ts：TS ​消费者​（ui-tui、apps/desktop）​的​类型​世界​从​这里​生长​；gateway-events.ts ​只​叠加​客户端​本地​合成​事件​与​ GatewayEvent ​信封​。
  • tests/tui_gateway/contracts/test_generated.py ​与​ tests/gateway/test_canonical_wire_contract.py：​分别​盯​ TS ​陈旧​与​ canonical ​覆盖​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​契约​层​把​"​文档​"​从​注释​变成​了​类型​：extra="forbid" ​的​ Pydantic ​模型​同时​是​运行​时​校验​器​、TS ​类型​源​和​ OpenRPC ​文档​。​方向感​要​记住​：​未知​入​参是​客户端​ bug（4000），​出参​漂移​是​自己​的​ bug（​测试​里​炸​）；handler ​的​域码​不​被​契约​抢走​。​改​协议​的​完整​循环​——​改​模型​、​重新​生成​、tsc ​暴露​所有​消费者​——​由​陈旧性​测试​兜底​。​这​正是​「Python ​拥有​行为​，TypeScript ​拥有​屏幕​」​能​长期​成立​的​前提​：​屏幕​和​行为​之间​隔​着​一层​机器​生成​、​测试​把守​的​契约​。

docs.title: 08.4 ​方法​面​导览​ —— 34 ​个​ methods_*.py ​与​ slash worker ​机制
docs.text: server.py（2041 ​行​）​是​门面​，​真正​的​ RPC ​方法​按​主题​拆​在​ 34 ​个​ methods_*.py ​兄弟​模块​里​（​合计​约​ 15,000 ​行​）。​这些​模块​用​ method_ctx.HandlerRegistry ​声明​方法​，server.py import ​完​自己​的​全局​后​统一​ install ​重​绑定​——bodies ​以​ types.FunctionType ​复制到​ server ​命名​空间​，​裸​引用​ _sessions、_ok、_err ​等​ global。
