docs.title: 1. ​拆分​ seam：HandlerRegistry ​如何​把​兄弟​模块​接到​门面
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/method_ctx.py:44-50, 65-70 (​节选​)
class HandlerRegistry:
    """Deferred @method registrar used by the split modules."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._pending: list[tuple[str, types.FunctionType]] = []

    def method(self, name: str):
        """Drop-in for server.py's ``@method`` decorator (defers registration)."""
        def dec(fn):
            self._pending.append((name, fn))
            return fn
        return dec
    ...
    def install(self, server) -> None:
        """Rebind pending handlers onto ``server``'s globals and register them."""
        g = vars(server)
        for name, fn in self._pending:
            real = rebind(fn, g)
            if getattr(fn, "_hermes_profile_scoped", False):
                ...

rebind（19-41 ​行​）​复制​函数​并重​绑闭​包里​同​模块​的​函数​，​连​ contextlib.contextmanager ​包装​的​生成器​也​经​ __wrapped__ ​重绑​。​没有​ import ​环​：​兄弟​模块​从不​在​模块​级​ import server，​是​ server ​在​自己​ import ​末尾​把​名字​递​进去​。

docs.title: 2. slash ​在​ worker ​里​跑​：_SlashWorker
docs.text:
slash ​命令​不​跑​在​ gateway ​进程​内​，​而是​跑​在​持久​子​进程​ tui_gateway.slash_worker（​每个​会话​一个​ HermesCLI）。​客户端​协议​只有​两行​注释​：

# tui_gateway/slash_worker.py:1-4
"""Persistent slash-command worker — one HermesCLI per TUI session.

Protocol: reads JSON lines from stdin {id, command}, writes {id, ok, output|error} to stdout.
"""

gateway ​侧​的​ _SlashWorker ​负责​把子​进程​拉​对​：

# tui_gateway/slash_worker_client.py:56-58, 74-76, 91-94 (​节选​)
        argv = [sys.executable, "-P", "-m", "tui_gateway.slash_worker", "--session-key", session_key] \
            + (["--model", model] if model else []) \
            + (["--provider", provider] if provider else [])
        ...
        env = _prepend_tool_paths(served_profile_child_env(
            target_home=profile_home or (_hermes_home if is_multiplex_active() else None),
            inherit_credentials=True))
        ...
        self.proc = spawn_owned(
            argv, purpose="slash-worker", stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", bufsize=1,
            cwd=os.getcwd(), env=env, creationflags=windows_hide_flags())

​四个​细节​都​有​ issue ​背书​：--provider ​钉住​父​ agent ​的​虚拟​ provider（MoA ​会话​否则​把​ preset ​名字​发给​真实​ provider ​然后​ 402/503，#57283）；served_profile_child_env ​让​多路复用​下​的​ worker ​拿到​该​ profile ​的​ home + secrets（#40677/#115427）；spawn_owned ​让​ worker ​领​自己​的​进程​组​——gateway ​被​ SIGKILL/OOM ​时​ worker ​组​跟着​死​，​否则​一个​快速​命令​的​ shell ​会​永远​挂​着​；-P ​让​ worker ​的​ cwd ​不进​ sys.path（​用户​目录​里​的​ utils/ ​包​不许​遮蔽​ Hermes ​顶层​模块​）。run()（109-127 ​行​）​写​一行​ JSON、​在​ _SLASH_WORKER_TIMEOUT_S（​默认​ 45s）​内​等​匹配​ id ​的​应答​。

methods_slash.py ​里​还有​一层​"​活会话​短路​"：/context、/tools、/help ​在​ compute-host ​会话​上​直接​答​，​本地​ /context ​在​进程​内​渲染​（worker ​的​ CLI ​是​懒建​ agent ​的​，slash ​命令​永远​答​"(._.) No active agent"，#81251/#93280）；/review、/refine ​直接​派发​到活​ agent ​而​不是​ fork worker（_format_live_review_output，methods_slash.py:29）。

docs.title: 3. ​事件​发布​与​重放​：event_publisher.py / event_replay.py
docs.text:
event_publisher.py ​是​ PTY ​侧​的​尽力而为​ WS ​镜像​：

# tui_gateway/event_publisher.py:1-5 (docstring)
"""Best-effort WebSocket publisher transport for the PTY-side gateway.

The dashboard's `/api/pty` spawns `hermes --tui`, which spawns ``tui_gateway.entry`` — three
processes from the dashboard server. To surface events in the sidebar (`/api/events`), that gateway
opens a back-WS to the dashboard at startup and mirrors every emit through this transport as
newline-framed JSON (no JSON-RPC envelope; ``/api/pub`` rebroadcasts bytes verbatim). Failure mode:
silent — the agent loop must never block on the sidecar."""

WsPublisherTransport（31 ​行​）​用​ 256 ​深度​的​队列​ + ​守护​线程​排空​，​满​了​就​丢​——​侧边​栏​不许​拖住​ agent ​循环​。entry.py::_install_sidecar_publisher（87-93 ​行​）​把​它​ tee ​在​ stdio transport ​后面​。

event_replay.py ​是​ WS ​重连​的​记忆​：

# tui_gateway/event_replay.py:1-8 (docstring ​节选​)
"""Per-session event sequencing + bounded replay for WS reconnects.

Every event frame through :func:`server.write_json` (hence ``_emit``) gets a per-session monotonic
``seq`` and lands in a small ring per session; a reconnecting client calls ``session.events.since``
with its last seen seq and gets everything newer. ...
"""

​内存​上限​三重​：​每会话​ 512 ​条​或​ 4 MB ​冻结​ UTF-8 ​字节​；​全​进程​ 64 MB、64 ​个会话​；FIFO ​逐出​（_REPLAY_BUFFER_MAX = 512、_REPLAY_BUFFER_BYTES_MAX = 4 * 1024 * 1024 ​等​，27-34 ​行​）。​逐出​留下​水位​线​，​重连​客户端​发现​有洞​就​整段​重取​。_REPLAY_EPOCH（22 ​行​）​解决​"​服务器​重启​ seq ​归​ 1、​客户端​还举​着​ 97"​的​错位​——epoch ​让​客户端​识别​重启​并​重置​水位​线​。

docs.title: 4. ​会话​注册​与​生命周期
docs.text:
session_registry.py ​管会​话​槽​里​ agent ​的​就绪​等待​。_wait_agent_for_prompt（33 ​行​）​是​防​"​第一条​消息​被​吃​"​的​关键​：

# tui_gateway/session_registry.py:18-19, 33-40 (​节选​)
_AGENT_BUILD_WAIT_SLICE = 5.0
_AGENT_BUILD_SLOW_NOTICE_AFTER = 30.0
...
def _wait_agent_for_prompt(session: dict, rid: str, sid: str) -> dict | None:
    """Patient ``_wait_agent`` for deferred prompt.submit: the client already got ``streaming`` and the
    first message IS the turn, while a cold build routinely outlives the flat 30s ceiling (timing out
    silently discarded it). Waits in short slices (cancel honored promptly), notifies once (keyed) past
    ``_AGENT_BUILD_SLOW_NOTICE_AFTER``, fails only on a dead build thread or the bounded cap.
    ...

​旧​的​ 30s ​平顶​是​"​消息​被​永久​丢弃​的​悬崖​"（#63078）：prompt.submit ​已回​ {"status": "streaming"}，​冷启动​构建​（MCP ​逐​服务器​重试​退避​、​同步​模型​元​数据​ HTTP、​技能​扫描​）​却​常常​超过​ 30 ​秒​。​现在​按​ 5 ​秒片​等待​（​取消​能​及时​响应​），​过​ 30 ​秒​发​一次​ keyed ​慢​构建​通知​，​上限​可经​ agent.build_wait_timeout ​调​（​默认​ 600s）。

session_lifecycle.py ​管​终结​与​拆除​。​两个​小而​重要​的​片段​：

# tui_gateway/session_lifecycle.py:21-27, 39-45
def _start_session_work(target, *, name: str, session: dict | None = None):
    """Reserve before spawning; release only after the worker (including cleanup) has unwound."""
    from agent.memory_provider import spawn_context_thread
    from hermes_cli.backend_retirement import retirement

    if not retirement.acquire():
        return None
    ...
def _notify_session_boundary(event_type: str, session_id: str | None, platform: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Fire session lifecycle hooks with CLI parity; returns plugin ``on_session_finalize`` user messages."""
    ...
        invoke_hook(event_type, session_id=session_id, platform=_resolve_agent_platform(platform))

​后台​线程​经​ agent.memory_provider.spawn_context_thread ​起步​（​绝不​裸​ threading.Thread——​作用域​跟​线程​走​）；_finalize_session / _teardown_session ​进入​ _session_profile_runtime_scope(session) ​再​跑​ on_session_end、​记忆​提交​与​ agent.close()，​因为​它们​的​调用者​是​无​作用域​的​ reaper、Timer、atexit ​和​池​线程​。​自动​结束​原因​（ws_orphan_reap、idle_timeout、lru_evict…）​集合​在​ _AUTOMATIC_SESSION_END_REASONS（47 ​行​附近​）。

docs.title: 5. agent ​工厂​与​ turn ​主体
docs.text:
agent_factory.py ​决定​新会话​ agent ​的​种子​：_resolve_model（10 ​行​）​按​ env seed → config → cost-safe ​静默​默认​（get_preferred_silent_default_model）​解析​，"​从不​落到​未​选定​的​旗舰​"；_resolve_session_platform（26 ​行​）​区分​ desktop/tui。agent_callbacks.py ​提供​构造​ AIAgent ​时​的​回调​桥​。

prompt_turn.py ​的​ docstring ​就是​一张​ turn ​流程图​：

# tui_gateway/prompt_turn.py:4-7 (docstring)
"""The prompt turn: ``_run_prompt_submit`` and the per-phase helpers it drives.

... Turn shape (one fresh daemon thread):
admit -> crash marker -> bind scopes -> resolve message -> run_conversation ->
commit history / message.complete -> goal & loop hooks -> release scopes ->
post-turn follow-ups (queued prompt, goal continuation, notifications).
"""

checkpoints.py ​解决​ Desktop ​会话​检查点​被​环境变量​单​闸门​误关​的​问题​（#79625）：

# tui_gateway/checkpoints.py:1-11 (docstring ​节选​)
"""Checkpoint-enablement resolution for TUI-created agents (issue #79625).

Desktop sessions (``hermes serve`` → TUI gateway) never set ``HERMES_TUI_CHECKPOINTS``
(that env var is only set by the ``hermes --tui --checkpoints`` CLI path), so agent
creation previously gated filesystem checkpointing on the env var alone and silently
ignored ``checkpoints.enabled`` in config.yaml. These helpers resolve enablement the
way the messaging gateway does ...: the env var (explicit CLI opt-in) wins when set, otherwise the ``checkpoints`` config section applies with ``DEFAULT_CONFIG`` defaults.
"""

docs.title: 6. ​多人​房间​、​账单​视图​与​主题​桥
docs.text:
hosted_room_*.py ​七个​文件​（driver/member_activity/peer_deadline/peer_http/peer_transport/prepare_stall/router_call/service）​把​ gateway/hosted_room* ​的​多​人​讨论​房间​接到​ RPC ​面​；hosted_room_service.py ​开头​一句​自述​："Production coordinator for same-gateway hosted Discussion rooms."。billing_view.py ​用​结构化​信封​（result.ok/result.error）​而​不是​ JSON-RPC ​错误​，​客户端​永远​能​解析​并​在​类型化​ billing code ​上​分支​。theme_bridge.py ​把​ theme.apply（​值​请求​，​渲染器​毫秒​级​应答​）​和​ theme.pick（​卡片​等​用户​）​分​到​两个​超时​（15s/300s）：

# tui_gateway/theme_bridge.py:8-10, 18-22 (​节选​)
# Applying a theme is a store write the renderer answers in ms; a picker waits for a person.
THEME_TIMEOUT_S = 15
THEME_PICK_TIMEOUT_S = 300

def theme_request(sid: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
    """The renderer's answer; a dismissed picker and an expired one are told apart."""
    from tui_gateway import server_requests
    from tui_gateway.server import _ask

_ask（server.py:969）​是​"​向​用户​提新​问题​"​的​标准​入口​。render.py ​供​出​ make_stream_renderer / render_diff / render_message，Python ​侧​的​文本​投影​与​ Ink ​的​屏幕​保持​职责​分离​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ HandlerRegistry tui_gateway/method_ctx.py:44 ​兄弟​模块​的​延迟​ @method ​注册器​，install ​重​绑定​ _SlashWorker tui_gateway/slash_worker_client.py:44 ​持久​ slash ​子​进程​：run() ​问答​、stderr ​尾巴​、​组​销毁​ WsPublisherTransport tui_gateway/event_publisher.py:31 PTY ​侧​ back-WS ​事件​镜像​（​尽力而为​） _stamp_event / replay_epoch / events_since tui_gateway/event_replay.py per-session seq + ​有界​重放环​ _wait_agent_for_prompt tui_gateway/session_registry.py:33 ​冷​构建​下​的​耐心​等待​（​防​首条​消息​被​吃​） _start_session_work tui_gateway/session_lifecycle.py:21 retirement ​预留​ + spawn_context_thread ​起​线程​ _notify_session_boundary ​同​上​ :39 ​会话​边界​插件​钩子​（​与​ CLI ​对齐​） _resolve_model tui_gateway/agent_factory.py:10 env → config → cost-safe ​默认​ _run_prompt_submit tui_gateway/prompt_turn.py turn ​主链​（​见​ docstring ​流程图​） resolve_checkpoints_enabled tui_gateway/checkpoints.py:36 env ​覆盖​优先​、config ​兜底​ theme_request tui_gateway/theme_bridge.py:18 ​主题​应答​（dismissed vs expired ​可​分辨​） _ask tui_gateway/server.py:969 server→client ​请求​的​统一​入口​（​默认​ 300s ​超时​）

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ method_ctx.py rebind + HandlerRegistry：​拆分​模块​接入​门面​的​ seam methods_*.py（34 ​个​） ​按​主题​的​ RPC handler（​见​文件​概览​表​） slash_worker.py worker ​子​进程​本体​：stdin JSON ​行​协议​ + ​父​进程​看门狗​ slash_worker_client.py gateway ​侧​ worker ​客户端​：spawn/env/​超时​/​组​管理​ event_publisher.py / event_replay.py ​侧边​栏​镜像​ / ​重连​重放​ session_registry.py / session_lifecycle.py / session_transports.py / session_reaper.py / session_history.py / session_compression.py / session_auto_continue.py / session_notifications.py / session_workdir.py ​会话​槽​与​生命周期​家族​ agent_factory.py / agent_callbacks.py agent ​构造​种子​与​回调​桥​ prompt_turn.py / prompt_attachments.py / synthetic_turn.py / turn_marker.py turn ​主体​与​辅助​ checkpoints.py ​检查点​使能​解析​ hosted_room_*.py（7 ​个​） ​多人​房间​的​ RPC ​面​ billing_view.py / theme_bridge.py / render.py / command_discovery.py / slash_fuzzy.py / project_tree.py / pet_sheet.py / git_probe.py / stream_segments.py / tool_progress.py / loop_noise.py / user_messages.py ​数据​构建​器​与​渲染​辅助

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• hermes_cli/commands.py：slash ​注册表​的​定义​源​；command_discovery.py ​构建​目录​数据​但​不​ import ​旧​ server。
  • agent/memory_provider.py::spawn_context_thread：​一切​后台​线程​的​正确​起点​（​作用域​随​线程​）。
  • gateway/session_commands.py：canonical ​传输​上​的​ slash ​执行​适配​（​不​加载​ worker）；​本组​的​ slash.exec ​是​ sidecar ​面​。
  • apps/desktop/ui-tui：methods_connectors.py ​的​连接​操作​卡​、methods_vault.py ​的​预览​ fill ​都​以​ TS ​侧​ handler ​为​对​端​（​见​ contracts.md）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​方法​面​的​组织​哲学​是​「​门面​ + ​主题​兄弟​ + ​表​驱动​」：server.py ​只留​方法​表​和​全局​，34 ​个​模块​经​ HandlerRegistry ​延迟​注册​、install ​时重​绑定​——​没有​ if ​链​，​没有​ import ​环​。slash ​命令​跑​在​自己​的​持久​ worker ​子​进程​里​，​环境​经​ served_profile_child_env ​精确​注入​；​事件​面靠​ per-session seq + ​有界​重放​环撑​起重​连​；​会话​生命周期​把​"​无​作用域​的​清理​者​"​全部包​进​ _session_profile_runtime_scope。​读到​这​一层​，tui_gateway ​的​行为​就​不再​是​黑盒​，​而是​一张​可​ grep ​的​方法​目录​。

docs.title: 08.1 ​进程​模型​ —— ​附加​、​空闲​退出​与​多​ profile ​作用域
docs.text: tui_gateway ​的​进程​模型​只有​一条​主轴​：​渲染器​附加​到​共享​网关​ owner，​绝不​ spawn ​私有​ agent。​这​一篇​读​三组​文件​：​附加​链​（gateway_runtime_attach.py）、​承载​进程​（server.py ​的​ profile ​作用域​）、​以及​可选​的​ turn ​隔离​子​进程​（host_supervisor.py + compute_host.py）。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数级​ ​角色​ hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py 97 ​一次​客户端​附加​：​发现​/​拉​起​ owner，​铸造​一次性​票据​ ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py 83 Ink ​的​附加​引导​，​薄​包装​上​一行​ tui_gateway/server.py 2041 JSON-RPC ​门面​：​方法​表​、​会话表​、@_profile_scoped tui_gateway/launch_profile_policy.py 244 ​多​ profile ​托管​的​策略​开关​与​环境​冻结​ tui_gateway/host_supervisor.py — compute-host ​子​进程​的​监督者​（dashboard.turn_isolation） tui_gateway/compute_host.py — ​持久​ compute-host ​子​进程​本体​：​行​ JSON over stdin/stdout

docs.title: 1. ​附加​：​一次​调用​找到​（​或拉起​）owner ​并​铸造​票据
docs.text:
attach_gateway ​是​任何​本地​客户端​（hermes gateway attach、Ink bootstrap）​共同​走​的​唯一​入口​：

# hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py:68-97 (​节选​)
def attach_gateway(home: str | Path, *, start: bool, recover: bool = False, timeout: float) -> GatewayAttach:
    home = gateway_profile_home(home)
    receipt = (ensure_gateway_runtime(home, timeout=timeout, idle_exit=True) if start
               else discover_gateway_endpoint(home, timeout=min(timeout, DISCOVER_TIMEOUT)))
    if not start and recover and not attachable(receipt):
        receipt = ensure_gateway_runtime(home, timeout=timeout, idle_exit=True)
    if not attachable(receipt):
        return GatewayAttach(receipt)
    try:
        # A profile served by the default multiplexer has no socket of its own; the host mints its ticket.
        return GatewayAttach(receipt, _session_ticket(home, receipt.endpoint))
    except DiscoveryError as exc:
        raise TicketUnavailable(exc.reason, exc.bounded_detail(500)) from exc

​注意​三点​：idle_exit=True——​由此​拉起​的​ daemon ​空闲​自灭​，​这​正是​"Ink ​关掉​ TUI ​后​ owner ​不会​永久​驻留​"​的​机制​；--recover ​模式​在​ owner ​崩溃​/​空闲​退出​/​被​ stop/​版本​过​旧时​重新​ ensure，​让​打开​着​的​ TUI ​能​自愈​；​票据​是​一次性​凭据​，"never log it, never put it in a repr"（​模块​ docstring ​原话​）。

​附加​前​还有​一步​防污染​——​把​客户端​启动​期​的​策略性​环境变量​从​进程​里​剥掉​，​否则​拉起​的​ daemon ​会​把​这些​值​当作​ daemon ​级​默认​：

# hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py:20-25, 30-35 (​节选​)
CLIENT_LAUNCH_ENV = (
    "HERMES_MODEL", "HERMES_INFERENCE_MODEL", "HERMES_TUI_PROVIDER", "HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER",
    "HERMES_TUI_TOOLSETS", "HERMES_TUI_SKILLS", "HERMES_CWD", "TERMINAL_CWD", "HERMES_YOLO",
    "HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS", "HERMES_TUI_CHECKPOINTS", "HERMES_TUI_PASS_SESSION_ID", "HERMES_KANBAN_BOARD",
    "HERMES_TUI_CLIENT_ENV",
)

def scrub_client_launch_env() -> None:
    for key in CLIENT_LAUNCH_ENV:
        os.environ.pop(key, None)

​注释​点明​原因​：hermes --tui ​钉住​的​看板​ HERMES_KANBAN_BOARD ​如果​传进​ daemon，​会​让​之后​的​每​一场​ chat、​每个​ Desktop ​窗口​、​每个​ cron ​任务​都​解析​到​这台​终端​的​启动​期看​板​，​而​不是​各​ profile ​自己​的​ kanban/current。​启动​策略​应​在​ session.create ​里​随会话​旅行​，​不进​ daemon ​默认​。

Ink ​侧​的​引导​只是​薄​包装​（ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py:53）：

# ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py:53-64 (​节选​)
    attached = attach_gateway(get_hermes_home().resolve(), start=start, recover=recover, timeout=30)
    ...
    endpoint = attached.receipt.endpoint
    url, protocols = gateway_ws_target(endpoint, attached.ticket)
    return {"url": url, "protocols": protocols,
            "profile_id": endpoint.profile_id, "instance_id": endpoint.instance_id}

docs.title: 2. ​多​ profile：​第一个​"​第二个​家​"​改变​整个​进程
docs.text:
​一个​ serve/dashboard ​进程​可能​承载​多个​ profile ​家​。server.py::_profile_home ​在​注册​第二个​家时​触发​策略​翻转​：

# tui_gateway/server.py:467-477 (​节选​)
    if home.resolve() == Path(_hermes_home).resolve():
        return None  # already the launch profile (no override needed)
    if home not in _served_profile_homes:
        # This process now hosts a second profile home: freeze the launch env as the launch
        # profile's own and flip get_secret() to fail closed, so an unscoped read for a
        # secondary raises instead of returning the launch profile's os.environ value
        from tui_gateway.launch_profile_policy import activate_multi_profile_hosting
        activate_multi_profile_hosting()
    _served_profile_homes.add(home)

​而​ launch_profile_policy.py ​的​模块​ docstring ​是​理解​这一​整层​的​钥匙​：​多路复用​激活​之前​，​一个​未​被​作用域​包裹​的​ get_secret() ​调用​会​静默​借​到​启动​ profile ​的​ os.environ ​值​——​这​是​最​危险​的​ fail-open。​激活​后读​失败​改为​抛​异常​：

# tui_gateway/launch_profile_policy.py:46-51
def activate_multi_profile_hosting() -> None:
    """This process now hosts a profile home other than its launch home: freeze the launch env
    and make unscoped credential reads fail closed (``get_secret`` raises instead of borrowing)."""
    from agent.secret_scope import set_multiplex_active
    capture_launch_env()
    set_multiplex_active(True)

capture_launch_env()（33-43 ​行​）​在​第一个​次要​家​注册​前​把​ os.environ ​快照​冻结​——"​最后​一次​可​证明​环境​属于​启动​ profile ​的​时刻​"。​此后​启动​ profile ​自己​的​ turn ​也​必须​走​ launch_secret_scope（​冻结​ env + ​自己​的​ .env），​不再​读​活体​环境​，​因为​次要​上下文​可能​已​污染​了​ os.environ（#107422）。

docs.title: 3. @_profile_scoped：​每个​触​状态​方法​的​护栏
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/server.py:485-514 (​节选​)
def _profile_scoped(handler):
    """Bind ``params['profile']``'s full runtime scope (HERMES_HOME + secrets + terminal policy) around a
    handler, ...
    No ``profile`` param but a ``session_id`` naming a live session: that session's ``profile_home``
    is the scope. ... a ``config.set`` from a focused worker session otherwise persisted into the
    LAUNCH profile's config.yaml while the worker's stayed unchanged (#85669)."""
    def wrapper(rid, params):
        p = params if isinstance(params, dict) else {}
        if str(p.get("profile") or "").strip():
            home = _profile_home(p.get("profile"))
            profile_home = str(home) if home else None
        else:
            session = _sessions.get(str(p.get("session_id") or ""))
            profile_home = session.get("profile_home") if isinstance(session, dict) else connection_profile_home()
        with _session_profile_runtime_scope({"profile_home": profile_home or None}):
            return handler(rid, params)
    return wrapper

​作用域​令牌​（home + secret scope + terminal scope）​由​ model_switch.py::_profile_runtime_scope_tokens(profile_home) ​生成​。docstring ​给出​的​反例​值得​记住​：​只设​ get_hermes_home_override() ​的​方法​是​"​半​绑定​"——config ​路径​解析​对​了​，​凭据​和​ TERMINAL_* ​策略​还是​启动​ profile ​的​。​排查​方式​：rg -n "^(async )?def " tui_gateway/methods_*.py | rg -v _profile_scoped。

docs.title: 4. compute-host：​可选​的​ turn ​隔离​子​进程
docs.text:
dashboard.turn_isolation ​开启​时​，agent turn ​跑​在​一个​持久​的​ python -m tui_gateway.compute_host ​子​进程​里​，​避免​重​ agent ​线程​与​事件​循环​争​ GIL。​监督者​维护​一张​路由表​，​声明​每个​ mutator ​方法​如何​穿越​进程​边界​：

# tui_gateway/host_supervisor.py:28-35
MUTATOR_ROUTE_TABLE: dict[str, str] = {
    "prompt.submit": "turn-path", "session.interrupt": "turn-path", "reload.mcp": "run-concurrent",
    "session.save": "run-concurrent", "session.compress": "idle-gated",
    "prompt.submit.truncate": "idle-gated", "slash.model": "idle-gated",
    "slash.personality": "idle-gated", "slash.prompt": "idle-gated", "slash.compress": "idle-gated",
    "slash.refine": "idle-gated",
    "session.reset": "idle-gated", "session.history.reload": "idle-gated",
    "slash.retry": "idle-gated"}

​子​进程​本体​（compute_host.py）​用​帧​类型​ → ​处理器​方法​名​的​表​分发​：

# tui_gateway/compute_host.py:61-66
class ComputeHost:
    # frame ``type`` -> handler method name (resolved per call so monkeypatches take effect).
    _FRAME_HANDLERS: dict[str, str] = {
        "turn.start": "_handle_turn_start", "interrupt": "_handle_interrupt",
        "respond": "_handle_respond", "reload_mcp": "_handle_reload_mcp",
        "control": "_handle_control", "shutdown": "_handle_shutdown"}

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ attach_gateway hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py:68 ​发现​/​拉​起​ owner + ​铸造​一次性​票据​（GatewayAttach） scrub_client_launch_env ​同​上​ :30 ​附加​前​剥离​ CLIENT_LAUNCH_ENV ​策略​变量​ activate_multi_profile_hosting tui_gateway/launch_profile_policy.py:46 ​冻结​启动​ env + ​翻转​ get_secret fail-closed activate_multi_profile_hosting_eagerly ​同​上​ :71 ​宿主​启动​时​一次性​判定​（​懒​激活​会​漏掉​已​跑​过​的​启动​期​工作​） launch_profile_runtime_scope ​同​上​ :187 ​启动​ profile ​的​完整​运行​时​作用域​（home+secret+terminal） _profile_scoped tui_gateway/server.py:485 ​方法​装饰​器​：​按​ profile/session_id ​解析​作用域​ _profile_home ​同​上​ :455 ​附近​ ​解析​ profile ​名​ → ​家​目录​；​第二个​家​触发​策略​翻转​ ComputeHost tui_gateway/compute_host.py:61 turn ​隔离​子​进程​：​帧​分发​、​心跳​、​父​进程​守卫​ MUTATOR_ROUTE_TABLE tui_gateway/host_supervisor.py:28 mutator ​方法​ → turn-path/run-concurrent/idle-gated _claim_launch_home tui_gateway/entry.py:303 stdio ​服务器​用​ gateway.lock ​抢占​启动​家​，​冲突​即​拒

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ tui_gateway/server.py ​门面​：​方法​表​ _methods、​会话表​ _sessions、write_json、@_profile_scoped tui_gateway/launch_profile_policy.py ​多​ profile ​托管​策略​：​环境​冻结​、fail-closed ​翻转​、​启动​ profile ​作用域​ tui_gateway/host_supervisor.py compute-host ​监督​：​注册表​ dashboard-compute-host.json、​重生​窗口​、​控制​帧​等待​ tui_gateway/compute_host.py compute-host ​子​进程​：turn ​线程​池​、​心跳​、shutdown ​排空​ tui_gateway/compute_host_bridge.py ​父​进程​侧​的​ compute-host RPC ​桥​ tui_gateway/entry.py stdio JSON-RPC ​入口​（​现​主要​供​开发​ harness） hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_attach.py ​附加​原语​（owner ​发现​ + ​票据​），CLI ​与​ Ink ​共用​ ui-tui/scripts/gateway_bootstrap.py Ink ​的​附加​引导​（TS ​经​ localGatewayBootstrap.ts ​调​起​）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway/runtime_ownership.py：process_ownership.reserve ​是​启动​家​唯一​ owner ​的​仲裁​（gateway.lock）；entry.py::main ​冲突​时​退出​并​提示​"attach to it instead"。
  • agent/secret_scope.py：set_multiplex_active / is_multiplex_active ​是​ fail-closed ​的​实际​开关​，​每次​ get_secret ​都​读​它​。
  • gateway/session_controls.py::AuthorityConnection：​票务​ WS socket ​上​的​会​话​权威​；​本​模块​的​ sidecar ​方法​经​ ws_legacy_fallback.py ​作​受限​ fallback。
  • tools/environments/local.py::served_profile_child_env：​任何​为​所​服务​ profile ​派生​子​进程​（slash worker、hermes -p X worker）​都​从​它​取​环境​，​绝不​ dict(os.environ)。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​进程​模型​可以​压缩成​三句话​：​渲染器​永远​附加​到​共享​ owner（attach_gateway，​按​需拉起​、​空闲​退出​、--recover ​自愈​）；​第一个​次要​ profile ​家​把​进程​变成​ fail-closed ​多​租户​（launch_profile_policy ​冻结​环境​ + @_profile_scoped ​包住​每个​触​状态​方法​）；​重​ turn ​可选下​放到​ compute-host ​子​进程​（MUTATOR_ROUTE_TABLE ​决定​谁​能​穿越​边界​）。​读懂​这三条​，server.py ​里​任何​一个​ handler ​为什么​长​那样​就​都​有​了​答案​。

docs.title: 08.2 RPC ​传输层​ —— ​换行​分隔​的​ JSON-RPC、​双向​请求​与​ Transport ​家族
文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ tui_gateway/transport.py 359 Transport ​协议​ + StdioTransport / FanoutTransport / TeeTransport tui_gateway/ws.py 763 WebSocket ​传输​：​读​循环​、​队​列车​道​、token ​合并​、​重​放​ tui_gateway/entry.py 425 stdio ​传输​：stdin ​读​循环​（​现​主要​供​开发​ harness） tui_gateway/server_requests.py 436 server→client ​请求​：send() ​阻塞​等待​应答​ tui_gateway/rpc_dispatch.py 100 JSON-RPC ​准入​ + worker ​池​分发​（​重​绑定​到​ server ​命名​空间​）

docs.title: 1. wire：​一种​帧​格式​，​两种​承载
docs.text:
ws.py ​的​模块​ docstring ​一句​话立​住​整层​的​设计​原则​——​两个​传输​共用​同一个​ dispatcher：

# tui_gateway/ws.py:1-4 (docstring ​节选​)
"""WebSocket transport for the tui_gateway JSON-RPC server: reuses :func:`tui_gateway.server.dispatch`
verbatim so every RPC, slash command, approval flow and agent event takes the same handlers as Ink over
stdio. Wire protocol is identical to stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC both ways; ``gateway.ready`` right
after accept). Mount as ``@app.websocket("/api/ws") async def ws(ws): await handle_ws(ws)``."""

​协议​是​ peer-to-peer ​的​ JSON-RPC，​双向​都​是​换行​分隔​帧​。stdio ​侧​的​读​循环​（entry.py:387-421）​逐行​ json.loads ​后​交给​ dispatch；WS ​侧​入口​是​ handle_ws（ws.py:431）。​连接​建立​后​第一​帧​都​是​ gateway.ready（​携带​ skin、change_events、replay_epoch），entry.py:371-375 ​就是​ stdio ​侧​的​发射点​。

docs.title: 2. Transport ​协议​与​ ContextVar
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/transport.py:37-59 (​节选​)
@runtime_checkable
class Transport(Protocol):
    """Minimal interface every transport implements."""

    def write(self, obj: dict) -> bool:
        """Emit one JSON frame. Return ``False`` when the peer is gone."""

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Release any resources owned by this transport."""

_current_transport: contextvars.ContextVar[Optional[Transport]] = contextvars.ContextVar(
    "hermes_gateway_transport", default=None
)

​请求​的​传输​放在​ ContextVar ​里​，​这样​ worker ​池里​的​ handler ​写回​正确​的​ peer；​没有​绑定​时​ write_json ​回落​到​模块​级​ StdioTransport（​惰性​解析​ _real_stdout，​测试​ monkey-patch ​才能​生效​）。

​三个​实现​各有​分工​：

  • StdioTransport（98-130 ​行​）：​串行​锁​ + flush；write() ​返回​ False ​仅​表示​ peer ​已​走​，​其他​错误​必须​ re-raise ​进​ crash log（_raise_unless_peer_gone，66-80 ​行​）——UnicodeEncodeError ​不能​伪装成​"​干净​断开​"。
  • FanoutTransport（143 ​行起​）：​多​订阅​者​的​有界​信箱​。​慢​ socket ​不许​拖住​发射​ turn ​或​健康​订阅​者​——_MAX_PENDING_FRAMES = 16384、_MAX_PENDING_BYTES = 4MB，​溢出​者​丢​订阅​、​被​关闭​让​客户端​重连​重放​。
  • TeeTransport（334 ​行起​）：PTY ​子​进程​用​——​每帧​同时​写​ stdio（Ink）​和​ back-WS（​仪表盘​侧边​栏​），​副​通道​尽力而为​绝不​阻塞​主​路​。

​序列化​集中​在​ serialize_frame（83-95 ​行​）：​不可​序列化​的​ payload ​变成​带原​ id ​的​ -32603 ​错误​帧​，​而​不是​让​ executor ​吞掉​ TypeError ​后​客户端​永远​等待​（#92506）。

docs.title: 3. server→client ​请求​：agent ​问​用户
docs.text:
​这是​协议​最​独特​的​半边​。​每个​"​问​渲染器​"​的​桥​（clarify、approval、sudo、secret、vault ​提示​、​桌面​ GUI ​读​、MCP ​安装​同意​、tour）​都​是​一次​ send() ​加​一个​应答​帧​——​没有​成对​的​ *.request ​通知​ / *.respond ​方法​。

# tui_gateway/server_requests.py:53-98 (​节选​)
class ServerRequest:
    def __init__(self, sid: str, method: str, params: dict, *, qids=None, on_result=None) -> None:
        self.id = f"srq-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
        self.sid = sid
        self.method = method
        self.params = dict(params)
        self.replayable = can_replay_request(method, params)
        self.event = threading.Event()
        self.result: dict | None = None
        ...

    def frame(self) -> dict:
        return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": self.id, "method": self.method,
                "params": {"session_id": self.sid, **self.params}}

id ​是​ srq-<12 hex>：​字符串​永不​与​客户端​铸造​的​整数​ id ​冲突​，​随机​部分​让​ compute-host ​子​进程​的​请求​与​父​进程​的​到达​同一​ socket ​时​也​能​区分​。

send() ​在​ agent ​线程​上​阻塞​等待​：

# tui_gateway/server_requests.py:208-248 (​节选​)
def send(method: str, sid: str, params: dict, *, timeout: float | None,
         qids=None, transport=None) -> dict | None:
    """Send one request and block for the response ``result`` (a dict).

    Returns ``None`` when the renderer never answered (timeout, cancel, or an error response ...).
    """
    if transport is None and _unanswerable(method, sid):
        return None
    req = ServerRequest(sid, method, params, qids=qids)
    req.transport = transport
    _register(req)
    try:
        req.event.wait(timeout)
    except BaseException:
        # The wait itself died ...: withdraw the request or it stays in _open forever
        with _lock:
            still_open = _open.pop(req.id, None) is req
        if still_open:
            _emit_cancel(req, "interrupted")
        raise
    with _lock:
        # The verdict is the state committed under the lock, never wait()'s return value ...
        timed_out = _open.pop(req.id, None) is req
        answered, result, locked = req.answered, req.result, dict(req.locked)
    if answered:
        return result
    if timed_out:
        _emit_cancel(req, "timeout")
        ...
    return None

​超时​/​取消​发出​一条​ request.cancel {id, method, reason} ​事件​，​所有​渲染器​用​同一​方式​拆卡​。​已​不​在​ _open ​里​的​应答​帧​直接​丢弃​——​等待​早已​返回​。​重连​路径​：​未​应答​的​请求​由​ session.resume / session.events.since ​经​ open_requests(sid)（394 ​行​）​重​放​，​通知​重放环​永远​不必​携带​"​还​在​等​答案​的​问题​"。

​两个​护栏​值得​记住​：

  • ​能力​协商​：​客户端​连接​时​声明​ client.capabilities {server_requests: true} → advertise()（148 ​行​）​登记​；​从不​声明​的​ WS ​客户端​是​"​早​于​ server→client ​请求​的​构建​"，send() ​快速​返回​ None ​而​不是​让​ agent ​白等​ clarify ​的​ 300 ​秒​（#112548）。
  • ​窗口​归属​：preview.read / preview.act / terminal.read / window.read / tour ​只​由​显示​该会​话​的​窗口​应答​；​其他​窗口​以​ NOT_SHOWN_CODE = 4404（131 ​行​）​谢绝​，​且​谢绝​不​结算​请求​——​除非​所有​应答​客户端​都​谢绝​了​（#113348/#119333）。

docs.title: 4. dispatch：​长​ handler ​进​ worker ​池
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/rpc_dispatch.py:50-96 (​节选​)
def dispatch(req: dict, transport: Optional[Transport] = None) -> dict | None:
    """Route inbound RPCs — long handlers to the pool (returns None; the worker writes its own
    response via the bound transport), everything else inline (returns the response dict)."""
    t = transport or _stdio_transport
    token = bind_transport(t)
    try:
        from tui_gateway import server_requests
        if server_requests.is_response_frame(req):
            # The renderer answering one of OUR requests (clarify, approval, ...): no response frame goes back.
            if not server_requests.resolve_response(req, t) and not _relay_compute_host_response(req):
                logger.debug("dropping response for unknown server request id=%r", req.get("id"))
            return None
        normalized = _normalize_request(req)
        if isinstance(normalized, dict):
            return normalized
        if normalized[1] not in _LONG_HANDLERS:
            return handle_request(req)
        ...
        ctx = contextvars.copy_context()  # the pool worker must see the bound transport
        ...
        def run():
            try:
                resp = _handle_admitted_request(req)
            except Exception as exc:
                ...
                resp = _err(req.get("id"), -32000, f"handler error: {exc}")
            if resp is not None:
                t.write(resp)
        future = _pool.submit(lambda: ctx.run(run))
        ...
        return None
    finally:
        reset_transport(token)

​分发​决策​：​先判​应答​帧​（​渲染器​回答​我们​的​问题​，​原​路​返回​ None），​再判​ retirement（​后​端​退役​期​统一​拒答​ 5035），​再​走​准入​ _handle_admitted_request（8-47 ​行​）——​契约​校验​（​未知​参数​键回​ 4000 ​带字段​路径​）→ ​执行​ handler → check_params_accepted/check_result ​回验​。​列入​ _LONG_HANDLERS ​的​方法​复制​ context ​后​投进​ _pool，worker ​自己​写​应答​帧​。

docs.title: 5. WS ​读​循环​的​车道
docs.text:
handle_ws ​不是​简单​串行​——​一个​长​ handler ​不许​饿死​心跳​：

  • _WS_DISPATCH_QUEUE_MAX = 256（99 ​行​）：​每​连接​一个​ dispatcher ​任务​按​到达​序​消费​队列​，​读​循环​继续​应答​ gateway.ping。
  • ​并发​读​车道​：session.context_breakdown、session.transcript ​这类​只​投影​已有​状态​的​昂贵​读进​ _WS_CONCURRENT_READ_LIMIT = 2 ​的​并发​槽​（104-107 ​行​）。
  • clarify.lock ​与​一切​应答​帧​绝不​排队​——​串​行车道​上​可能​正跑​着​等​它​答案​的​ handler。
  • ​流式​ token ​合并​：message.delta / reasoning.delta / thinking.delta ​缓冲​ 33ms（​约​ 30fps）​批量​刷​，​其余​事件​刷​缓冲​前先​走​，​保持​顺序​（128-130 ​行​）。

docs.title: 6. write_json：​出帧​的​最后​一站
docs.text:
# tui_gateway/server.py:567-584 (​节选​)
def write_json(obj: dict) -> bool:
    """Emit one JSON frame via the most-specific transport: (1) event frames with a session id → that
    session's transport (async events reach the owner even from threads with no contextvar binding);
    (2) the context-bound transport (:func:`dispatch`); (3) module stdio (tests monkey-patch ``_real_stdout``).
    Every event frame gets a per-session monotonic ``seq`` + replay-ring entry so ``session.events.since`` can resume."""
    from tui_gateway.event_replay import _stamp_event
    from tui_gateway.hosted_room_member_activity import project_room_member_activity
    _stamp_event(obj)
    params = obj.get("params")
    if obj.get("method") == "event" or (isinstance(obj.get("id"), str) and "method" in obj):
        # Event notifications AND server→client requests carry ``params.session_id``; both route to the
        # owning session's transport. ...
        project_room_member_activity(obj, _sessions)
        sid = ((params or {}).get("session_id")) if isinstance(params, dict) else ""
        if sid and (t := (_sessions.get(sid) or {}).get("transport")) is not None:
            return t.write(obj)
    return (current_transport() or _stdio_transport).write(obj)

​三级​路由​：​会话​事件​帧​ → ​会话​自己​的​ transport；server→client ​请求​同样​带​ session_id ​走​同一​路径​；​都​没有​才​走​ context ​绑定​/stdio。​每个​事件​帧​顺路​盖上​ per-session ​单调​ seq ​并​落进​重放环​。

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ tui_gateway/transport.py Transport ​协议​、Stdio/Fanout/Tee、serialize_frame、ContextVar ​绑定​ tui_gateway/ws.py WebSocket ​传输​：​车道​队列​、token ​合并​、​重​放​ epoch、​会话​权威​接入​ tui_gateway/entry.py stdio ​传输​：stdin ​读​循环​、​私有​ RPC stdin（Windows NUL ​交换​）、sidecar ​发布​器​ tui_gateway/server_requests.py server→client ​请求​全​生命周期​ + NOT_SHOWN ​谢绝​协议​ tui_gateway/rpc_dispatch.py ​准入​ + ​契约​校验​ + worker ​池​分发​ tui_gateway/ws_legacy_fallback.py ​票务​ socket ​上​非会话​方法​的​ legacy ​回退​授权​ tui_gateway/_stdin_recovery.py ​伪​ EOF（​子​进程​翻转​ O_NONBLOCK）​与​真​ EOF ​的​区分​ tui_gateway/event_replay.py per-session seq + ​有界​重放环​（​详见​ methods_slash.md）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tui_gateway/server.py：dispatch/write_json/_ok/_err ​都​住​在​门面​里​，rpc_dispatch.py ​经​ method_ctx.bind_module ​重​绑定​后​裸​引用​它们​。
  • apps/shared（TS）：JsonRpcGatewayClient + onRequest ​是​客户端​半边​；gateway-events.ts ​在​契约​之上​加​客户端​本地​合成​事件​。
  • gateway/scale_to_zero.py：WS ​客户端​每​ 15s ping ​一次​，ws.py ​节流​触碰​心跳​标记​文件​，​让​网关​ owner ​的​空闲​判定​知道​"​还有​ dashboard ​客户端​挂​着​"。
  • event_replay.py：replay_epoch() ​让​客户端​识别​服务器​重启​（seq ​归​ 1）​并​重置​水位​线​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​传输层​的​一切​都​可以​从​一句​话​推出​：peer-to-peer ​的​换行​分隔​ JSON-RPC，​两种​承载​（WS/stdio）​共用​一个​ dispatcher。​三个​方向​（​方法​调用​ / server→client ​请求​ / ​事件​通知​）​中​，​最​需要​工程​纪律​的​是​中间​那个​——send() ​阻塞​ agent ​线程​，​所以​能力​协商​、​窗口​谢绝​协议​、request.cancel ​撤回​、​重连​重放​缺一不可​。​理解​ dispatch ​的​三岔口​（​应答​帧​→​结算​、​长​任务​→​池​、​其余​→​内联​）​和​ write_json ​的​三级​路由​，​你​就​掌握​了​这条​ wire ​上​的​每​一次​呼吸​。

docs.title: 09 plugins/ —— ​插件​系统​总览​：​五套​发现​系统​与​一条​铁律
docs.text: plugins/（19 ​组​内置​插件​ + 3 ​个​共享​模块​）+ plugin-catalog/（​约​ 1,150 ​个​ YAML ​条目​）​是​ Hermes ​的​能力​扩展​层​。​整个​系统​压在​一句​话​上​（plugins/AGENTS.md ​首节​，Teknium, May 2026）：​插件​永不​触碰​核心​——​插件​住​在​自己​的​目录​里​，​在​框架​提供​的​ ABC / hooks / ctx ​表面​内​工作​；​缺​能力​就​加宽​通用​插件​面​（​新​ hook、​新​ ctx ​方法​），​绝不​把​插件​特有​逻辑​硬​编码​进​核心​（PR #5295 ​就​是从​ main.py ​里​摘除​了​ 95 ​行硬​编码​的​ honcho argparse）。

docs.title: 五套​发现​系统
docs.text:
​理解​ plugins/ ​的​关键​是​："​插件​"​不是​一个​单一​系统​，​而是​五套​并存​的​发现​系统​，​每套​有​自己​的​目录​、​优先​序​和​激活​方式​：

​类别​ ​位置​ ​发现​机制​ ​优先​序​ ​通用​插件​ plugins/<name>/、~/.hermes/plugins/、./.hermes/plugins/、pip entry points PluginManager（hermes_cli/plugins.py） later-wins（​后​发现​的​同名​者​赢​） ​记忆​提供​方​ plugins/memory/<name>/ plugins/memory/__init__.py：bundled → $HERMES_HOME/plugins/ → ./.hermes/plugins/（​需​ HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS）→ hermes_agent.memory_providers entry points bundled-first（​防止​投进来​的​目录​遮蔽​内置​） ​模型​提供​方​ plugins/model-providers/<name>/ providers/__init__.py._discover_providers()，​懒​（​首次​ get_provider_profile()/list_providers() ​才​跑​） last-writer-wins（​用户​插件​覆盖​内置​ profile） ​上下文​引擎​/​图像​生成​/​委派​/cron ​提供​方​/​配置​后​端​/​仪表盘​鉴权​ plugins/context_engine/、image_gen/、delegation/、cron_providers/、config_backends/、dashboard_auth/ ​各自​ ABC + ​编排​器​ + ​目录​ ​各自​独立​（​通常​ bundled ​赢​） ​平台​适配器​ plugins/platforms/<name>/adapter.py ​网关​平台​注册表​（26 ​个​：irc、​飞​书​、telegram、discord…） token-lock ​与​ scoped-secret ​规则​见​ gateway/AGENTS.md；​禁改​ os.environ

docs.title: 进程​中​的​发现​时刻
docs.text:
import model_tools.py（​副作用​）
        │
        ▼
discover_plugins()  ──​幂​等​；force=True ​中途​重扫​──▶  PluginManager.discover_and_load()
        │                                                ├ ​目录​扫描​ plugins/<name>/ + ​用户​/​项目​目录​
        │                                                ├ pip entry points（​目录​同名​者​优先​）
        │                                                ├ register(ctx)：hooks/tools/CLI/locale
        │                                                └ on_plugin_loaded → ​激活​摘要​
        ▼
hooks ​由​ model_tools.py（pre/post tool）​与​ run_agent.py（​生命周期​）​调用​

​三条​时机​纪律​（plugins/AGENTS.md「Discovery timing pitfall」）：

  • discover_plugins() ​只​在​ import model_tools.py ​的​副作用​里​跑​；​不​ import ​它​的​代码​要​显式​调用​（​幂​等​）。
  • ​非​强制​的​ discover_plugins() ​在​ _discovered ​标志​上​短路​；​每个​中途​加载​路径​（​任意​表面​的​ install/enable/update、reload-plugins ​动词​）​都​跑​ discover_plugins(force=True)，PluginManager.on_plugin_loaded ​从​这次​重扫里​对​新​加载​的​插件​发​激活​摘要​（hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py：gateway handler ​立即​活​；tools/prompt ​下个​会​话​；deferred.mcp_servers ​等到​ mcp.reload）。​绝不​从​ RPC ​里发​那个​事件​。
  • ​辅助​ LLM ​调用​（titling、​压缩​、MoA、vision…）​从​ agent/auxiliary_hooks.py ​发​ pre_auxiliary_call/post_auxiliary_call，​绝不​发​ turn ​范围​的​ pre/post_api_request（#79733）。

docs.title: 目录​速览
docs.text:
plugins/
├── plugin_loader.py      # ​共享​的​按​路径​加载​器​（memory/cron/context_engine ​复用​）
├── plugin_storage.py     # ​插件​存储​辅助​
├── plugin_utils.py       # ​工具​函数​
├── platforms/            # 26 ​个​平台​适配器​（​最大​组​）
├── model-providers/      # ​声明​式​ ProviderProfile ​提供​方​
├── memory/               # ​记忆​提供​方​（​对​新​成员​关闭​，​迁往​目录​）
├── browser/ computer_use/ web/ image_gen/ video_gen/ context_engine/
├── delegation/ cron_providers/ config_backends/ dashboard_auth/
├── kanban/ disk-cleanup/ google_meet/ teams_pipeline/
├── security-guidance/ hermes-achievements/
plugin-catalog/           # ~1,150 ​个​ YAML + removed.yaml ​黑名单​

docs.title: 兼容​契约​一览
docs.text:
​兼容性​是​行为​契约​，​不是​单一​的​ PLUGIN_API_VERSION ​或​清单​级​版本号​（​详见​本组​ plugin_api.md）：

  • hook payload ​以​关键字​字​段​增量​添加​；​回调​按​签名​检查​——​旧窄​签名​只​收到​自己​声明​的​字​段​，**kwargs ​回调​收到​完整​ payload。
  • PluginContext ​方法​绝不​移除​或​改名​；​新​参数​可选带​默认​、​尽量​ keyword-only。
  • ​本地​ schema ​版本​只​存在​于​有​ wire/​持久​契约​的​能力​上​；​旧​状态​/​配置​/​会话​重放​被​保留​或​迁移​。
  • ​弃用​：​每​进程​一次​警告​、​文档​化​替代​ + ​迁移​说明​、​移除​前​ ≥ 2 ​个​ minor ​释放​窗口​。

docs.title: plugin.yaml ​清单​速查
docs.text:
​通用​插件​的​最小​骨架​与​常用字​段​（​完整​语义​见​ plugin_api.md）：

name: my-plugin              # ​目录名​即​默认​名​
version: 1.0.0
description: "​一行​描述​"        # plugin_loader.read_plugin_description ​只读​这个​
kind: general                # general / memory-provider / model-provider…；​缺省​按​源码​启发式​判型​
requires_env:                # ​安装​/​启用​时​提示​的​凭据​名​
  - MY_PLUGIN_API_KEY
config_schema:               # hermes memory setup ​等​设置​流​读取​的​形状​
  memory.my_plugin: {...}
provides_locales: ["zh-CN"]  # ​清单​语言包​无需​ __init__.py
capabilities:
  provides_tools: [...]
  provides_hooks: [...]

​通用​插件​目录​里​必须​有​ __init__.py（plugins/plugin_loader.py::iter_plugin_dirs ​以​它​为准​，​跳过​ _/. ​开头​目录​）；​纯​清单​语言包​是​唯一​的​例外​。

docs.title: 发现​的​完整​时序​（​从​进程​启动​到​钩子​可用​）
docs.text:
​进程​启动​
  ├ load_hermes_dotenv（import ​期​，​先于​插件​密钥​源​）
  ├ start_background_plugin_discovery()   # CLI ​启动​重叠​（~150ms，​守护​线程​）
  │      └ ​同步​消费者​经​ discover_plugins() join，​绝不​看到​半​装载​注册表​
  ▼
import model_tools.py（​副作用​）→ discover_plugins()
  ├ PluginManager.discover_and_load()
  │   ├ _collect_directory_manifests()   # plugins/<name>/ + $HERMES_HOME/plugins/ + ./.hermes/plugins/
  │   ├ _scan_entry_points()             # pip entry points（​目录​同名​者​优先​）
  │   ├ ​逐个​ import <dir>/__init__.py → register(ctx)
  │   ├ _evict_stale_persistent_registrations()   # ​没​回来​的​注册​者​被​清退​
  │   └ _refresh_secret_sources_after_discovery() # ​插件​密钥​源补拉​
  └ on_plugin_loaded → ​激活​摘要​（gateway handler ​立即​活​；tools ​下个​会​话​）
  ▼
turn ​中​：hooks ​由​ model_tools.py（pre/post tool）​与​ run_agent.py（​生命周期​）​分发​

​三条​反​直觉​的​时机​事实​，​调试​时​先查​它们​：HERMES_SAFE_MODE=1 ​会​整体​跳过​发现​；​不​ import model_tools.py ​的​代码​读到​的​插件​状态​是​空​的​（​要​显式​ discover_plugins()）；​中途​安装​/​启用​/update ​的​表面​全部​走​ force=True ​重扫​。

docs.title: 宿主​隔离​一览​（plugins.isolation: host）
docs.text:
​默认​ in_process ​把​用户​插件​ import ​进​ Hermes ​进程​；host ​则​把​每个​非​捆绑​插件​放进​ per-profile ​宿主​进程​（hermes_cli/plugin_host.py ​父侧​、plugin_host_child.py ​子侧​、plugin_host_wire.py ​帧​协议​）。​五条​不​变量​（AGENTS.md ​原文​归纳​）：

  1. ​一切​用户​代码​导入​路径​要么​路由​进​宿主​要么​拒绝​——​通用​插件​、memory/context engine/cron ​提供​方​（load_instance）、​模型​提供​方​ profile（​按​文件​指纹​缓存​的​免​凭据​提取​）、dashboard API（ASGI ​桥​）​都​一样​；​新​加载​器​必须​照​做​。
  2. ​过不去​的​东西​只有​一张​表​：plugin_isolation.HOST_UNSUPPORTED_CTX_METHODS（​活​网关​/​适配器​对象​）；​运行​时​拒绝​与​静态​审计​读同​一张​。
  3. ​值​跨​ wire ​保持​ ABC ​声明​的​类型​：JSON ​只会​传​ dict/list/​标量​，plugin_host_wire.restore ​按​ ABC ​注解​重建​（FetchResult、Path、​枚举​、​引擎​代理​）。
  4. ​宿主​永不​ spawn ​宿主​（HERMES_PLUGIN_HOST_PROCESS=1 ​强制​ in-process），​且​不​在​模块​导入​持锁​时​启动​。
  5. ​隔离​方在​操作员​钉死​时​不能​退出​：isolation_mode()/host_launcher() ​经​托管​ overlay ​读​——/etc/hermes/config.yaml ​压​过​ profile ​自己​的​ config。

​对​插件​作者​完全​透明​：​没有​新​ API，​同一个​ ctx；per-profile ​环境​经​ served_profile_child_env，​宿主​只见​自己​ profile ​的​ secrets。

docs.title: 插件​作者​的​三条​红线​（​踩​了​会​被​机器​拦下​）
docs.text:
红线​ ​执法者​ ​后果​ import ​了​ plugin_api.json ​之外​的​核心​名字​ scripts/boundary_lint.py --check（CI）+ hermes plugins validate ​警告​ CI ​失败​；​正确​出路​是​先加​ seam（​见​ boundary_lint.md） ​运行​时​覆盖​核心​（patch AIAgent.<method>、​写​ sys.modules） catalog ​准入​规则​ 9 ​的​ no core override ​检查​ ​条目​被​拒​；hook ​缺失​就​开​ issue ​加​ seam ​裸读​ os.environ ​取​凭据​ ​多路复用​下​ fail-closed（get_secret ​抛​ UnscopedSecretError） ​插件​在​多​ profile ​宿主​上​直接​故障​；​改走​ agent.secret_scope.get_secret

​反向​红线​同样​硬​：​核心​代码​ import ​一个​具体​的​内置​插件​（plugins.platforms.discord.adapter）​会​被​同一个​ lint ​抓住​——​边界​是​双向​的​。

docs.title: 本组​文档​导航
docs.text:
文档​ ​内容​ index.md（​本篇​） ​五套​发现​系统​、​时机​纪律​、​目录​地图​ plugin_api.md ​已​发布​ API：​钩子​点​、ctx ​表面​、​可​实现​ ABC、plugin.yaml ​清单​、​加载​机制​ boundary_lint.py ​边界​治理​：scripts/boundary_lint.py + baseline、left_core_migration catalog.md plugin-catalog/：​准入​规则​、removed.yaml、loader ​与​ CLI ​面​ bundled_plugins.md 19 ​组​内置​插件​逐组​清单​与​政策​注记​

​阅读​顺序​：​先​ index.md ​建立​地图​，​再​ plugin_api.md ​看​作者​能​用​什么​，boundary_lint.md ​看​核心​怎么​守住​边界​，catalog.md ​看​第三方​生态​的​信任​模型​，​最后​ bundled_plugins.md ​当​字典​查​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• ​核心​侧​入口​：hermes_cli/plugins*.py（30+ ​兄弟​模块​：loader/dispatch/ledger/cmd_*/manifest…）​是​通用​插件​系统​的​宿主​；model_tools.py ​是​发现​的​触发​点​与​钩子​调用​点​。
  • ​网关​侧​：​平台​适配器​经​ gateway/platform_registry.py ​注册​；token-lock ​与​ scoped-secret ​规则​在​ gateway/AGENTS.md。
  • agent ​侧​：agent/memory_provider.py（MemoryProvider ABC）、providers/base.py（ProviderProfile）、agent/context_engine.py / image_gen_provider.py / delegation_provider.py ​是​各​专用​插件​系​的​对接​面​。
  • ​宿主​隔离​：plugins.isolation: host ​时​一切​用户​代码​导入​走​ hermes_cli/plugin_host.py ​家族​（​详见​ plugin_api.md ​的​边界​小结​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: plugins/ ​的​设计​可以​用​三组​对立统一​概括​：​通用​插件​ later-wins（​用户​覆盖​内置​）​与​记忆​/​引擎​系​ bundled-first（​按名​激活​者​不许​被​遮蔽​）；​目录​ + entry points ​双源​与​目录​为准​（pip ​包装​同名​时以​用户​安装​的​目录​为准​）；​永不​触碰​核心​的​铁律​与​加宽​通用​面​的​出口​。​五套​发现​系统​各管​一类​能力​，​共用​的​地基​只有​两个​：plugin_loader.py ​的​按​路径​导入​，​和​"​钩子​在​所属​ profile ​作用域​下​触发​、​状态​按​ hermes_home_key() ​键控​"​的​多​租户​纪律​。

docs.title: 09.2 ​边界​治理​ —— boundary_lint ​与​"​特性​离开​核心​"​的​迁移​表
docs.text: 「​插件​永不​触碰​核心​」​不是​口号​，​而是​CI ​里​跑​得动​的​两向​ lint + baseline ​棘轮​。​这​一篇​读​ scripts/boundary_lint.py（181 ​行​）​的​判定​逻辑​，​以及​配套​的​ hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json ​与​ hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ scripts/boundary_lint.py 181 ​两向​ import lint：​模块​→​核心​、​核心​→​模块​ scripts/boundary_lint_baseline.json — ​每个​跨越​的​计数​棘轮​ hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json — ​已​发布​插件​ API（module ​与​ module:Name ​条目​） hermes_cli/plugin_validate_private_imports.py — lint ​复用​的​核心​判定​（​与​ hermes plugins validate ​同源​） hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py 1338 LEFT_CORE ​迁移​表​：​离开​核心​的​特性​自动​装回​ scripts/gen_plugin_api_docs.py — ​从​ plugin_api.json ​渲染​ public-api.md

docs.title: 1. ​两向​规则
docs.text:
# scripts/boundary_lint.py:2-21 (docstring ​节选​)
"""Report-only import lint for the core/module boundary, in both directions.

* **module -> core internals**: a bundled module imports a Hermes module or name that is not on the
  published plugin API (``hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json``), e.g. ``gateway.run``. The rule is the one
  ``hermes plugins validate`` warns with (``plugin_validate_private_imports.private_import_findings``),
  so the lint and the plugin-author warning cannot drift.
* **core -> module**: core code imports a specific module (``plugins.platforms.discord.adapter``)
  instead of reaching it through discovery and the plugin contracts.

A *module* is a directory under ``plugins/`` with a ``plugin.yaml`` manifest, or a ``plugins/<name>/``
with a ``dashboard/manifest.json``. Everything else under ``plugins/`` (``plugin_loader``,
``plugin_utils``, ``plugins/memory/__init__.py`` discovery, ...) is core plugin plumbing. *Core* is
every other file of the shipped packages (pyproject ``packages.find``) and the root ``*.py`` modules;
tests, scripts, docs and skills are neither.

​两个​方向​的​措辞​值得​逐字​体会​：​模块​ → ​核心​禁​的​是​"import ​一个​不​在​已​发布​ API ​上​的​名字​"；​核心​ → ​模块​禁​的​是​"import ​一个​具体​的​模块​"——​核心​应该​经​发现​与​插件​契约​到达​模块​，​而​不是​点名​。​判定​范围​也​有​精确​定义​：​有​ plugin.yaml ​的​目录​才​算​"​模块​"，plugin_loader/plugin_utils/plugins/memory/__init__.py ​这些​是​核心​插件​管线​。

docs.title: 2. ​模块​判定​与​发现​函数
docs.text:
# scripts/boundary_lint.py:51-65 (​节选​)
def module_dirs(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[Path]:
    """Every bundled module directory under ``plugins/``."""
    plugins = root / "plugins"
    dirs = {p.parent for p in plugins.rglob("plugin.yaml") if not _SKIP_PARTS.intersection(p.relative_to(plugins).parts)}
    dirs |= {p.parent.parent for p in plugins.glob("*/dashboard/manifest.json")}
    return sorted(dirs)


def module_to_core(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    """``["plugins/<module>/<rel>:<line> <target>", ...]`` for every module import of a core internal.
    An in-tree module's full-path import of itself (``plugins.web.exa.provider``) or of another module
    is not a core import, so it is left out."""
    modules = module_dirs(root)
    return [f"{d.relative_to(root).as_posix()}/{hit}" for d in modules for hit in private_import_findings(d)
            if not _in_module(hit.split(" ", 1)[1], root, modules)]

​模块​自己​的​全​路径​导入​或​对​另​一​模块​的​导入​不算​核心​导入​。​反向​扫描​用​ AST：

# scripts/boundary_lint.py:110-127 (​节选​)
def core_to_module(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    """``["<rel>:<line> <module path>", ...]`` for every core import that names a specific module."""
    modules = module_dirs(root)
    found: set[tuple[str, int, str]] = set()
    for path, rel in _core_files(root, modules):
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        except (OSError, SyntaxError, ValueError):
            continue
        skipped = _type_checking_nodes(tree)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if id(node) in skipped:
                continue
            for spellings in _targets(rel, node):
                # Collapse the spellings of one alias to one target; distinct aliases count separately.
                if hits := [t for t in spellings if _in_module(t, root, modules)]:
                    found.add((rel.as_posix(), getattr(node, "lineno", 0), min(hits, key=len)))
    return [f"{rel}:{line} {target}" for rel, line, target in sorted(found)]

_targets ​把​相对​ from . import x ​折算​成​绝对​点名​再判​归属​；TYPE_CHECKING ​块​里​的​导入​跳过​（​类型​引用​不是​运行​时​耦合​）。

docs.title: 3. baseline ​棘轮​：​只拦​"​增量​"，​不​追​"​存量​"
docs.text:
# scripts/boundary_lint.py:134-155 (​节选​)
def _key(site: str) -> str:
    """What a site couples: ``<importing file> <target>`` (repo-relative path, line dropped). Two
    branches that add the same target from different files add two different keys; a file that imports
    one target twice counts 2 under one key."""
    loc, target = site.split(" ", 1)
    return f"{loc.rsplit(':', 1)[0]} {target}"


def regressions(current: dict[str, dict[str, int]], baseline: dict[str, dict[str, int]]) -> list[str]:
    """One line per key whose count rose above the baseline: a swap still fails, and the line names
    the new import."""
    return [f"{d}: {key} ({n}, baseline {baseline.get(d, {}).get(key, 0)})" for d in DIRECTIONS
            for key, n in current[d].items() if n > baseline.get(d, {}).get(key, 0)]

baseline ​按​导入​文件​ × ​目标​计数​。​所以​：​已存​的​跨越​不​失败​（​存量​豁免​）；​同一​文件​的​跨越​搬家​仍会​失败​（​计数​按​导入​文件​走​，​搬家​使​新​文件​超出​ baseline）——​这​正是​ AGENTS.md ​说​"import ​搬到​另​一个​文件​也​要​跑​ --update"​的​原因​；​消除​跨越​后​跑​ --update ​让​更​低​的​计数​钉住​。main()（158-177 ​行​）​提供​ --list / --check / --update；CI ​跑​的​是​ --check，tests/scripts/test_boundary_lint.py ​同步​把守​。

docs.title: 4. plugin_api.json：​发布​面​的​机器​形态
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json ​的​ _comment（​节选​）
# The modules and names a plugin may import from Hermes core. `hermes plugins validate` warns on any other
# Hermes import (hermes_cli/plugin_validate_private_imports.py), and scripts/gen_plugin_api_docs.py renders
# website/docs/developer-guide/plugins/public-api.md from this file.
# A `module` entry allows the module and its non-underscore names; `module:Name` allows that one name.

​结构​是​ {_comment, groups: [...]}，groups ​按​"​来源​"​分组​（developer-guide / plugins docs / ctx ​交出​的​对象​ / ​文档​教​作者​调​的​名字​），​共​ 8 ​组​、​每​条目​形​如​ agent.memory_provider、gateway.platforms.base ​或​窄​到​单名​的​ hermes_cli.auth_model_picker:prompt_model_selection。​这份​清单​就是​ API：​加​名字​ = ​发布​能力​给​每​一个​插件​作者​，​所以​ AGENTS.md ​警告​"never list one just to pass the lint"。​修复​一个​ lint ​失败​的​正当​顺序​（AGENTS.md §Boundary lint）：​先​用​清单​上​已有​的​名字​ / ctx ​方法​ / ​发现​路径​；​都​不行​就​单独​一个​ PR ​先加​ seam，​指名​哪个​插件​需要​它​——​优先​ ctx ​方法​或​ hook，​其次​ plugin_api.json（module:Name），​再​ scripts/gen_plugin_api_docs.py ​重新​生成​ public-api.md、​写​文档​、​加​行为​测试​。

docs.title: 5. ​特性​离开​核心​：LEFT_CORE ​迁移​表
docs.text:
​边界​治理​的​另一半​是​"​已​被​移出​核心​的​特性​，​怎么​把​还​在​用​的​家​自动​接上​"。hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py ​的​ docstring ​就是​合同​：

# hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py:1-13 (docstring ​节选​)
"""Move a home onto the catalog plugin of a feature that left core.

A feature (gateway platform, toolset, bundled plugin) that moves from core into a standalone catalog
plugin keeps its names, config keys and env vars, so migrating is only "install the plugin". Each row of
:data:`LEFT_CORE` names the catalog plugin and a read-only predicate "does this home use it". The
contract is the one memory providers established (``memory_provider_migration``, whose helpers this
reuses; memory is not a row because its plugin name comes from ``memory.provider``, not a table):

* ``hermes update`` installs the plugin for every profile home sharing the venv that uses the feature.
* Agent start and gateway start retry once per process for the active home ...
* After a failed attempt ... starts skip the row for an hour, doubling with each further failure up to a week ...
* A home gets the plugin automatically at most once (``_left_core_installed`` in its config.yaml):
  ``hermes plugins remove`` afterwards is the user's choice and sticks."""

​表​本体​（572 ​行起​）​每行​是​一个​特性​，​字段​即​语义​：

# hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py:572-580 (​节选​)
LEFT_CORE: tuple[LeftCoreFeature, ...] = (
    LeftCoreFeature(
        plugin="homeassistant", label="Home Assistant", in_use=homeassistant_in_use,
        unchanged="HASS_TOKEN/HASS_URL, platforms.homeassistant and the ha_* tool names are unchanged",
        secret_env=("HASS_TOKEN",), private_env=("HASS_URL",),
        toolsets=("homeassistant",), off_platforms=("acp", "webhook"), platform="homeassistant",
        enable_env=("HASS_TOKEN",), channel_env_prefixes=("HASS_",),
    ),
    LeftCoreFeature(
        plugin="spotify", label="Spotify", in_use=spotify_in_use,
        unchanged="your Spotify login, the spotify toolset and the spotify_* tools are unchanged; "
                  "`hermes auth spotify` is now `hermes spotify login`",
        cli="spotify",
    ),

​字​段面​（AGENTS.md「Other features that leave core」​节​的​完整​规则​）：in_use ​是​只读​谓词​（​无家​内​信号​的​特性​如​ MCP ​客户端​恒​ False——​只​提示​不​自动​装​）；toolsets/providers/hosts/terminal_backend ​让​各类​"​未​知名​"​错误​报出​安装​命令​；cli + command/old_command ​让​旧​拼写​打印​新​去向​（hermes mcp serve → hermes mcp-serve）；secret_env/private_env/profile_env/launch_env ​分类​核心​保留​的​ env ​写​权限​；notice ​给​每个​结果​附加​一句​ per-home ​提示​。​安装​与​状态​转换​是​两步​：toolset ​范围​转换​按家​×​行记​在​ _left_core_scoped，​自动​安装​记在​ _left_core_installed（​目录​存在​后​才​写​）——​所以​ hermes plugins remove ​之后​不再​自动​装​回来​，​失败​安装​会​重试​。

Home Assistant（Oct 2026）、Spotify toolset、Singularity ​终端​后​端​、GitHub Copilot ​提供​方​、Langfuse ​都​在​这​张表上​——​它们​离开​核心​时​名字​、config、env ​全​保留​，​迁移​只是​"​装​插件​"。

docs.title: 6. ​内部​导入​路径​不是​ API
docs.text: PR #102117 ​把​内部​搬进​ <stem>_<topic> ​兄弟​模块​时留​过​的​临时​兼容​层​已​在​ 2026-09-14 ​窗口​后移​除​：​旧​路径​现在​抛​ ImportError，​以​插件​加载​错误​的​形态​出现​在​ hermes plugins list ​里​。​永远​不​为​内部​搬迁​加​ re-export shim。hermes_cli/plugin_compat.py ​只​剩​三个​惰性​ stub，​供​已​在​运行​的​旧​ updater ​导入​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ module_dirs scripts/boundary_lint.py:51 ​判定​哪些​ plugins/ ​子目录​是​"​模块​" module_to_core ​同​上​ :59 ​方向​一​：​模块​ import ​核心​内部​名​ core_to_module ​同​上​ :110 ​方向​二​：​核心​ import ​具体​模块​（AST ​扫描​） _key / tally ​同​上​ :134/:142 ​跨越​键​（​文件​×​目标​）​与​计数​ regressions ​同​上​ :151 ​只报​超过​ baseline ​的​增量​ main ​同​上​ :158 --list / --check / --update private_import_findings hermes_cli/plugin_validate_private_imports.py ​与​ hermes plugins validate ​共用​的​判定​源​ LeftCoreFeature / LEFT_CORE hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py:486/:572 ​离核​特性​行​定义​与​全表​ install_for_homes ​等​ ​同​上​（​复用​ memory_provider_migration ​助手​） ​自动​安装​与​一次性​标记

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ scripts/boundary_lint.py ​两向​ lint（​本篇​主角​） scripts/boundary_lint_baseline.json ​棘轮​ baseline（--update ​重写​全量​） hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json ​已​发布​ API ​清单​（module / module:Name） hermes_cli/plugin_validate_private_imports.py ​判定​内核​（validate ​与​ lint ​共用​） hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py LEFT_CORE ​表​ + ​自动​安装​引擎​ hermes_cli/memory_provider_migration.py ​被​复用​的​迁移​助手​（​首例​） scripts/gen_plugin_api_docs.py plugin_api.json → public-api.md hermes_cli/plugin_compat.py ​三个​惰性​ stub（​兼容​层​遗骸​） tests/scripts/test_boundary_lint.py CI ​侧​的​同步​把守

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• CI：boundary lint ​是​阻塞​检查​；plugin-catalog-ci.yml ​在​目录​侧​做​准入​扫描​（​见​ catalog.md）。
  • hermes plugins validate：​对​单个​插件​给出​同样​的​ private-import ​警告​（​判定​源同​上​），​作者​本地​就​能​跑​。
  • ctx/plugin_api.json：​见​ plugin_api.md——lint ​是​那​张​清单​的​执法者​。
  • catalog ​安装​路径​：left_core ​的​自动​安装​走​普通​目录​安装​（kill list、​依赖​约束​、enable ​全​适用​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​边界​治理​是​三件​互相​咬合​的​机器​：lint ​用​ baseline ​棘轮​只拦​增量​（​搬​文件​也​算​新​跨越​，​删​跨越​要​主动​钉住​更​低​的​计数​）；plugin_api.json ​是​发布​面​（​加​名字​就是​向​每个​作者​发布​能力​，​不许​为​过​ lint ​加​名字​）；LEFT_CORE ​是​离核​特性​的​接生​表​（​保留​名字​与​环境​、​自动​安装​一次​、​失败​退避​、remove ​后​不再​自动​装​）。​加上​"​内部​导入​路径​不是​ API"​的​ shim ​禁令​，​这套​机器​保证​边界​只会朝​"​更​薄​的​核心​、​更​多​的​边缘​"​单向​移动​。

docs.title: 09.4 ​内置​插件​ 19 ​组​清单​ —— plugins/ ​目录​逐组​导览
docs.text: plugins/ ​顶层​除​ 3 ​个​共享​模块​（plugin_loader.py、plugin_storage.py、plugin_utils.py）​外​，​有​ 19 ​组​内置​插件​。​本篇​逐组​一行​角色​ + ​各组​的​发现​机制​注记​，​可​当​字典​用​。​行号​引用​均​为​ plugins/<​组​>/__init__.py。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 组​ ​形态​ ​一行​角色​ platforms/ 26 ​个​适配器​ ​最大​组​（151 ​个​ .py）：IRC、​飞​书​、telegram、discord、slack、signal、matrix、whatsapp(_cloud)、wecom/weixin、qqbot、dingtalk、email、sms、ntfy、line、a2a ​等​——​聊天​平台​进​网关​ model-providers/ ​提供​方​目录​ ​声明​式​ ProviderProfile（anthropic、openai、alibaba、azure-foundry、ai-gateway、arcee…），​懒​发现​ + last-writer-wins memory/ ​提供​方​目录​ MemoryProvider ABC（byterover、retaindb ​留任​至​ 2026-10-15 ​移除​）+ query_rewrite/config_schema ​辅助​ context_engine/ ​单​引擎​目录​ ContextEngine ABC；context.engine ​配置​点名​（​默认​核心​ Compressor），bundled ​赢​ image_gen/ ​提供​方​目录​ ​图像​生成​提供​方​（openai、fal、deepinfra、krea、meta-ai、openrouter…） video_gen/ ​提供​方​目录​ ​视频​生成​提供​方​（deepinfra、fal、openrouter、xai） delegation/ default/ ​委派​路由​——plugins/delegation/default ​就是​今天​的​委派​路由​本体​ browser/ ​后​端​目录​ ​浏览器​后​端​（browser_use、browserbase、firecrawl） computer_use/ cua/ ​计算机​使用​驱动​：​内置​ cua ​也​在​里面​，computer_use.backend ​每次​调用​时读​、​无​ fallback web/ ​提供​方​目录​ ​网络​搜索​提供​方​（brave_free、ddgs、exa、firecrawl、keenable…）​经​ ctx.register_web_search_provider() cron_providers/ chronos/ cron ​调度​器​提供​方​；​内置​ InProcessCronScheduler ​是​核心​、​不可​被​摘除​，cron.provider ​选​ config_backends/ remote/ ​配置​后​端​（HERMES_CONFIG_BACKEND）——​不​经​通用​插件​ loader ​发现​（​先有​鸡​后​有​蛋​，​见​下​） dashboard_auth/ ​多​方式​目录​ ​仪表盘​鉴权​（basic、nous、self_hosted、session_token、drain） kanban/ dashboard+systemd ​看​板​ disk-cleanup/ ​单​插件​ ​会话​临时文件​自动​清理​（​钩子​驱动​的​先例​插件​） google_meet/ ​单​插件​ agent ​加入​ Meet、​抓​字幕​转写​、​跟进​（headless Chromium + ​可​选​ Realtime ​语音​） teams_pipeline/ ​单​插件​ Teams ​会议​管线​——​只​注册​操作员​侧​ CLI ​面​（agent ​经​ terminal ​工具​调用​），​无​模型​工具​ security-guidance/ ​单​插件​ ​文件​写入​的​快速​模式匹配​安全​提示​（​追加​ guidance ​块​，​文件​照常​写入​） hermes-achievements/ dashboard+docs ​成就​系统​（​带​ dashboard ​面​与​测试​）

docs.title: 1. config_backends：​为什么​它​绕过​通用​ loader
docs.text:
# plugins/config_backends/__init__.py:1-5 (docstring)
"""Config backends (``HERMES_CONFIG_BACKEND``). Selected by ``hermes_cli.config_backend``
directly from the environment, never discovered through the general plugin loader: that loader
reads config.yaml, and the backend is what serves config.yaml (D11). User plugins cannot supply a
config backend."""

​这是​全部​ 19 ​组​里​唯一​"​从​环境​直接​选​、​不进​发现​"​的​组​——​加载​器要​读​ config.yaml，​而​ config.yaml ​恰恰​由​这个​后​端​伺服​。​鸡​生蛋​问题​让​它​必须​是​硬​连线​；​也​因此​用户​插件​不能​提供​配置​后​端​。

docs.title: 2. computer_use：​一次​一个​、​按名​激活​、​无​回退
docs.text:
# plugins/computer_use/__init__.py:1-4 (docstring)
"""Computer-use provider discovery: bundled ``plugins/computer_use/<name>/`` (the built-in ``cua`` driver lives
here too) then user ``$HERMES_HOME/plugins/<name>/`` (bundled wins on collision). Exactly one provider is active:
``computer_use.backend`` in the active profile's config.yaml names its directory (default ``cua``), read per call.
Only that provider is imported; the others stay on disk, so a plugin that is installed but not selected is just an
option in ``hermes tools``. A configured name that resolves to nothing fails; there is no fallback driver."""

​三个​细节​是​所有​"​按名​激活​"​组​的​通用​模式​：​只​ import ​被​选中​的​那个​（​其余​留在​磁盘​上​，​装​了​没选​只是​ hermes tools ​里​的​一个​选项​）；bundled ​赢​碰撞​（​同​ memory ​系​的​ bundled-first）；​配置​的​名字​解析​不到​就​失败​——​没有​回退​驱动​。

docs.title: 3. cron_providers：​内置​的​不能​被​摘
docs.text:
# plugins/cron_providers/__init__.py:1-4 (docstring)
"""Cron scheduler provider discovery: bundled ``plugins/cron_providers/<name>/`` then user
``$HERMES_HOME/plugins/<name>/`` (bundled wins on collision). The built-in InProcessCronScheduler
is core, not discovered here, so the fallback can't be removed; one provider is active
(``cron.provider`` in config.yaml, empty = built-in)."""

​与​ computer_use ​对照​着​读​：​计算机​使用​把​内置​驱动​也​放进​插件​目录​（cua ​是​默认​名​），cron ​的​内置​调度​器​留在​核心​——​目录​发现​系​不​存在​"​选中​空目录​时​的​兜底​"，​所以​兜底​必须​住​核心​。

docs.title: 4. web：​通用​ ctx ​方法​注册​的​提供​方
docs.text:
# plugins/web/__init__.py:1-3 (​注释​)
# Bundled web search providers: plugins/web/<name>/{plugin.yaml, __init__.py, provider.py}
# (image_gen plugin layout). They auto-load via kind: backend and register via
# ctx.register_web_search_provider() into agent.web_search_registry.

web ​组走​的​是​通用​插件​路径​（kind: backend ​自动​加载​ + ctx.register_web_search_provider()），​而​不是​专用​目录​发现​——​和​ image_gen ​同构​。​这​说明​ 19 ​组​里​其实​混着​两种​接入​：​专用​ ABC ​目录​（memory/context_engine/computer_use/cron）​与​通用​ ctx ​注册​（web/image_gen/model-providers ​经​ register_provider）。

docs.title: 5. memory：​对​新​成员​关闭
docs.text:
# plugins/memory/__init__.py:1-9 (docstring ​节选​)
"""Memory provider plugin discovery: bundled ``plugins/memory/<name>/``, user
``$HERMES_HOME/plugins/<name>/``, project ``./.hermes/plugins/<name>/`` (opt-in via
HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS), then ``hermes_agent.memory_providers`` entry points.
Precedence is deliberately the REVERSE of PluginManager's later-source-wins:
bundled wins, then user, project, entry point — a provider is activated by name
(``memory.provider``, one at a time), so a directory dropped into the working tree
must never shadow a shipped provider. Changing this order is a breaking change."""

memory.provider ​按名​激活​、​一次​一个​——​所以​发现​顺序​必须​是​ bundled-first：​用户​往​工作​树里​扔​一个​同名​目录​不许​遮蔽​出货​的​提供​方​。​这​与​通用​插件​的​ later-wins ​恰好相反​（index.md ​的​对照表​）。​目录​内​现在​只​剩​ byterover、retaindb ​两个​老​成员​（2026-10-15 ​移除​倒计时​）​加​两个​共享​辅助​文件​；hindsight、honcho、supermemory、mem0、openviking、holographic ​等​已​迁往​ plugin-catalog（hermes_cli/memory_provider_migration.py ​自动​迁移​）。

docs.title: 6. ​三个​钩子​驱动​的​"​先例​"​插件
docs.text:
# plugins/security-guidance/__init__.py:1-5 (docstring ​节选​)
"""security-guidance plugin — fast pattern-matched security warnings on file writes.

Scans content written by ``write_file`` / ``patch`` / ``skill_manage`` for known dangerous patterns
and appends a ``⚠️ Security guidance`` block to the tool result; the file is still written ..."""

# plugins/disk-cleanup/__init__.py:1-5 (docstring ​节选​)
"""disk-cleanup plugin — auto-cleanup of ephemeral Hermes session files.

``pre_tool_call`` + ``post_tool_call`` silently track test/temp paths CREATED by write_file/patch/terminal;
``on_session_end`` runs :func:`disk_cleanup.quick` when any test file was tracked this turn; ..."""

​这​两个​组​加上​ teams_pipeline（"​只​注册​操作员​侧​ CLI ​面​、​无​模型​工具​"）​演示​了​通用​插件​系统​的​三种​典型​形态​：​纯​ hook ​观察者​（security-guidance）、hook + ​生命周期​副作用​（disk-cleanup）、CLI-only ​能力​（teams_pipeline）。google_meet ​则​示范​了​"​插件​携带​ SKILL.md + CLI + ​桥接​层​"​的​复合​形态​。

docs.title: 7. platforms：​最大​组​的​两条​纪律
docs.text: 26 ​个​适配器​全部​遵循​ gateway/AGENTS.md ​的​ token-lock ​与​ scoped-secret ​规则​（AGENTS.md："irc、feishu are canonical"）；​平台​ YAML ​只许​经​ PlatformConfig.extra（_shared.apply_yaml_bridge）​与​ platform_gate_env ​通道​生效​——​平台​插件​永不​改​ os.environ。​核心​特例​一律​变成​ PlatformEntry seam（trusted_inbound、display_tier、shared_env_prefixes），​没有​名字​检查​。

docs.title: 政策​注记​（AGENTS.md ​三条​红​字​）
docs.text:
1. plugins/memory/ ​对​新​提供​方​关闭​（May 2026）。​新后​端​作为​独立​仓库​实现​同一​ MemoryProvider ABC、​经​ catalog ​发现​、hermes memory setup / post_setup() ​集成​。​宿主​侧​残留​代码​（honcho_host_block ​存储​类​、profile clone/rename ​钩子​）​经​ plugins.memory.import_provider_module ​解析​——​绝不​ plugins.memory.<name> ​直​ import；​通用​ seam（on_profile_created、STORAGE_PROVIDER + read_config_fields/write_config_fields）​一旦​目录​提供​方​实现​即​取代​宿主​代码​，​新​的​ provider ​专属​宿主​代码​会​被​拒​。
  2. ​无新​的​第三方​产品​插件​（June 2026）。​可​观测​后​端​、​厂商​ SaaS ​连接器​、​分析​面板​、​付费​服务​绑定​都​以​独立​插件​仓库​发布​。​理由​：​每​吸收​一个​产品​，​就是​我们​在​一个​我们​不​拥有​的​快速​演进​的​ backend ​上​背负​维护​。kanban/、disk-cleanup/ ​是​先例​，​不是​邀请​（Langfuse ​已​移出​到​官方​ catalog ​条目​）。​关掉​这​类​ PR ​是​耦合​决定​，​不是​质量​评判​。
  3. ​参考​/​文档​伴随​插件​住​在​别的​仓库​。example-dashboard、strike-freedom-cockpit、plugin-llm-example、plugin-llm-async-example ​都​在​ hermes-example-plugins（github.com/NousResearch/hermes-example-plugins），​不​在​本树​。

docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ _discover_providers providers/__init__.py:860 model-providers ​懒​发现​（entry points ​最先​=​最低​优先​） register_provider providers/__init__.py:140 last-writer-wins ​注册​点​ MemoryProvider ​发现​ plugins/memory/__init__.py bundled-first ​枚举​，​不​ import ​即​列举​ ContextEngine ​发现​ plugins/context_engine/__init__.py context.engine ​点名​激活​ ​计算机​使用​发现​ plugins/computer_use/__init__.py ​选中​即​ import、​无​回退​ cron ​发现​ plugins/cron_providers/__init__.py ​内置​调度​器留​核心​做​兜底​ config ​后​端​选择​ hermes_cli/config_backend.py → plugins/config_backends/ ​环境​直选​、​用户​插件​不可​供​ ctx.register_web_search_provider ctx（09.1 ​篇​） web ​组​的​注册​通道​ ​平台​注册表​ gateway/platform_registry.py + plugins/platforms/<name>/adapter.py 26 ​适配器​接入

docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ plugins/plugin_loader.py ​专用​系​共享​的​按​路径​加载​器​（​见​ 09.1 ​篇​） plugins/plugin_storage.py / plugin_utils.py ​存储​与​工具​函数​ plugins/platforms/（26 ​目录​） ​平台​适配器​（​核心​树内​最大​插件​面​） plugins/model-providers/ ​声明​式​模型​提供​方​ plugins/memory/（​关闭​中​） byterover、retaindb ​至​ 2026-10-15 ​其余​ 16 ​组​ ​见​开头​清单​表

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/ ​五个​ ABC：memory_provider.py、context_engine.py、image_gen_provider.py、video_gen_provider.py、delegation_provider.py ​是​专用​插件​的​对接​面​；providers/base.py ​是​模型​提供​方​的​。
  • gateway/：platforms ​组​的​全部​纪律​与​ token-lock ​规则​在​那里​；dashboard_auth ​组​服务​ hermes_cli/web_server.py ​的​鉴权​。
  • plugin-catalog/：memory ​组​被​关闭​的​成员​已​迁过去​；​离核​特性​（boundary_lint.md ​的​ LEFT_CORE）​也​落进​ catalog。
  • hermes_example_plugins ​仓库​：​参考​插件​的​家​，​与​本树​零​代码​共享​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: 19 ​组​插件​按​接入​方式​其实​是​三层​的​样本​集​：​通用​ ctx ​注册​（web、image_gen、teams_pipeline、security-guidance、disk-cleanup、kanban…）、​专用​ ABC ​目录​（memory、context_engine、computer_use、cron_providers、model-providers、delegation）、​硬​连线​（config_backends——​鸡​生蛋​问题​的​唯一​豁免​）。​政策​层面​记住​三个​坐标​：memory ​关门​、​第三方​产品​不​收​、​先例​不是​邀请​。​查​任何​一组​前先​问​一句​"​它​属于​哪层​"，​发现​机制​与​优先​序​就​自动​确定​了​。

docs.title: 09.3 plugin-catalog/ —— ​约​ 1,150 ​条​ YAML ​的​信任​模型
docs.text: plugin-catalog/ ​是​树外​插件​的​唯一​发现​系统​：​一个​ YAML ​一个​条目​（0bull.yaml、3ds-platform.yaml…​共​约​ 1,150 ​个​，​外加​ README.md ​与​黑名单​ removed.yaml），​可经​ hermes plugins catalog / hermes plugins search ​浏览​，hermes plugins install <name> ​安装​。README ​第一句​立​住​信任​模型​："Presence in this directory is the trust signal."——​目录​里​的​存在​本身​就是​人工​准入​的​信号​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ plugin-catalog/README.md 260 ​准入​政策​ 18 ​条​ + ​条目​ schema + ​黑名单​语义​ plugin-catalog/<name>.yaml ×~1150 — ​每个​插件​一个​条目​，40-hex SHA ​钉​ plugin-catalog/removed.yaml — kill list hermes_cli/plugin_catalog.py 534 loader、​活​刷新​、​回退​ hermes_cli/plugins_cmd_catalog.py 1011 ​解析​、provenance sidecar、search/info/validate、re-pin .github/workflows/plugin-catalog-ci.yml — ​每个​变更​条目​在​其​ pin ​上​ clone ​并​跑​ hermes plugins validate

docs.title: 1. ​准入​规则​（18 ​条​，README ​逐字​镜像​进​开发者​指南​）
docs.text:
# plugin-catalog/README.md:14-29 (​规则​ 1-4)
1. **Human-merged gate.** Entries are added *only* via a PR to the
   `hermes-agent` repository, reviewed and merged by a maintainer. There is
   no self-serve registry, no automated ingestion.
2. **Exact SHA pins are mandatory.** Every entry pins a full 40-character
   commit SHA. Branches, tags, and short SHAs are rejected by the loader.
   Installs clone the repository and check out exactly that commit.
3. **No self-updating code.** A listed plugin must not fetch and replace
   its own files ... The exact SHA pin *is* the trust model; a
   self-updater lets an installed copy move to a commit nobody reviewed.
   Updates reach users only through a SHA-bump PR here plus
   `hermes plugins update <name>`.
4. **SHA bumps are new PRs.** Updating an entry's pin is a new PR whose diff
   (old SHA → new SHA) is re-reviewed like any other change — reviewers are
   expected to look at the upstream commit range being adopted.

​完整​ 18 ​条​的​主干​（​每条​都​在​ README ​带​编号​小节​）：​人工​合并​ PR ​门​（1）；40-hex SHA ​钉​强制​（2）；​禁自​更新​代码​（3）；SHA ​升级​ = ​新​ PR ​重审​（4）；owner-or-major-contributor ​提交​或​维护者​梳理​批入​（5）；capabilities: ​必须​与​ pin ​上​的​实际​注册​相符​，​未声明​的​能力​蔓延​按​安全​问题​处理​（6）；​准入​时​跑​安装​扫描​，dangerous ​拒绝​、caution ​由​审阅​者​读过​再合​（7）；desktop ​插件​限​ SDK ​表面​——​禁​ prototype ​补丁​、​禁​ eval/new Function、​禁非​ SDK ​的​ import()、​禁​伸进​应用​内部​ store ​或​标记​（8）；​禁​运行​时​覆盖​ Hermes ​核心​（​禁​ AIAgent.<method> = ...、sys.modules[...] ​写入​等​，hook ​不​存在​就​开​ issue ​加​ seam，9）；​依赖​安全​政策​归​插件​但​受​核心​约束​、​裸​地板​版本​会​被​要求​加​天花板​（10）；​凭据​只​走​ Hermes ​路由​——get_secret / credentialed_provider_request / oauth: ​声明​，​绝不​读​ .env/auth.json/​别的​工具​的​ token ​文件​（11）；​尊重​审批​系统​、​无人​值守​下​干净​失败​（12）；​风险​行为​须​披露​、​遥测​ opt-in（13）；requires_hermes ​是​ SemVer ​地板​且​被​执行​、version ​与​ pin ​相符​（14）；​禁​皮肤​/​禁​捆绑​插件​的​ fork ​竞品​（15）；​一个​插件​谱系​只列​一次​（16）；​禁​不可​扫​的​二进制​ payload——​源码​可读​是​准入​前提​，​真​需要​原生​组件​就​由​插件​仓库​自己​的​公开​ Actions ​构建​并​带​ GitHub build attestation（17）；​密码​管理器​登录​后端​只​收​ vendor ​仓库​的​ verified/official ​条目​（18）。

docs.title: 2. ​条目​ schema ​与​一个​真实​条目
docs.text:
# plugin-catalog/README.md:180-208 (schema ​节选​)
name: example-plugin        # [a-z0-9_-]{1,64}, the catalog key
repo: https://github.com/owner/repo   # https:// only
sha: <40-hex commit sha>    # mandatory exact pin
description: One-line description.
maintainer: OwnerName
tier: community             # official | verified | community (default community);
                            # official and verified are set by Nous maintainers only
category: memory            # desktop | memory | platform | web | tools | voice | automation | models | general
requires_hermes: ">=0.19"   # optional; enforced at install and update (also declare it in plugin.yaml)
version: "1.4.0"            # optional human label for the sha (quote it); shown as "1.4.0 @ abcd1234"
platforms: []               # optional, e.g. [linux, macos]; empty = all
capabilities:
  provides_tools: []
  provides_hooks: []
  provides_middleware: []
  requires_env: []

tier ​说​的​是​"​谁​站​在​条目​背后​"：official（NousResearch ​维护​）、verified（Nous ​核实​来自​被​集成​公司​的​官方​仓库​）、community（​其余​）。version/image/screenshots/readme ​是​装饰性​的​——SHA ​才​是​ release；bump version ​要​与​ bump sha ​同​ PR。​图片​只许​ GitHub ​主机​（raw.githubusercontent.com ​等​），URL ​钉​到​条​目的​ commit——​图​与​代码​一样​不可​变​。​真实​条目​（0bull.yaml）​展示​了​披露​字段​的​样子​：description ​里明​写​"hosted-only connector; screenshots… go to 0bull.net; posts publish publicly…"。

docs.title: 3. removed.yaml：kill list
docs.text:
# plugin-catalog/removed.yaml:1-9
# Blocklist for plugins pulled from the catalog for security or policy
# reasons. The installer refuses to install anything whose name or repo URL
# matches an entry here (unless the caller explicitly bypasses the check).
# Each entry: {name, repo, reason, date}. Removals land via reviewed PRs,
# same as additions.
#
# Name only. Do not set repo: the replacement entry is the same repository,
# and a repo match would refuse that install too.
removed:
- name: or-picker
  reason: "Folded into openrouter-picker. ..."
  date: "2026-09-28"

​每条​安装​路径​（CLI、dashboard、TUI）​都​拒绝​与​移除​条目​匹配​的​名字​或​ repo URL——repo URL ​按​ canonical ​的​ host/owner/repo ​比较​，git@/ssh:///www. ​拼写​照样​命中​。​移除​后​：​已装​插件​停止​更新​、​无法​ enable、​加载​时​被​ gate_manifest ​拒​。​只有​ CLI ​有​响亮​的​ --allow-removed，​它​记录​在​安装​记录​上​，​也​是​ update/enable/load ​时​唯一​能​豁免​同​项​检查​的​东西​。​注意​黑名单​与​下架​（delisting）​的​区别​：​不再​维护​/​换名​抢位​/​违反​新​规则​是​普通​文件​删除​，​已装​用户​不​受​影响​，​修好​后​欢迎​回来​；​进​ removed.yaml ​是​安全​/​政策​处置​。

docs.title: 4. loader：​活​刷新​与​三层​回退
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/plugin_catalog.py:1-9 (docstring)
"""Plugin catalog — curated, Nous-approved Hermes plugins shipped with the repo.

Mirrors the ``optional-mcps/`` MCP-catalog pattern: one YAML file per entry under the in-tree
``plugin-catalog/`` directory, pinned to an exact 40-character commit SHA. Presence in the directory IS
the human-merged approval gate; SHA bumps are new, re-reviewed PRs; ``removed.yaml`` is the kill list
(installs of a removed name/repo are refused with the recorded reason). Full policy:
``plugin-catalog/README.md``.

Live refresh: the docs build publishes the same data as ONE JSON document
(``website/scripts/extract-plugins.py`` → ``/docs/api/plugin-catalog.json``, like the skills index), so
an installed Hermes sees new entries and removals without updating. A fetch failure reuses the last valid
cached copy regardless of age, then falls back to the in-tree copy when no valid cache exists."""

​关键​常量​（37-45 ​行​附近​）：LIVE_CATALOG_URL = "https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/api/plugin-catalog.json"、TTL 6 ​小时​、​离线​ pin 24 ​小时​过期​但​缓存​的​移除​条目​是​永久​ kill list、​请求​超时​ 5s、​上限​ 2 MB、_SHA_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")（​分支​/tag/​短​ SHA ​一律​拒绝​）。​安装​来源​三选​：​活​ JSON（​最新​）→ ​有效​缓存​（​无论​多旧​）→ ​树内​目录​（​兜底​）。

docs.title: 5. CLI ​面​：​解析​、provenance、re-pin
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/plugins_cmd_catalog.py:1-4, 24, 51-63 (​节选​)
"""``hermes plugins`` catalog surface: resolution, provenance sidecar, search/browse/info/validate,
catalog-aware update, plus the dashboard/TUI-facing catalog payload helpers."""

CATALOG_SIDECAR = ".hermes-catalog.json"
...
def looks_like_catalog_name(identifier: str) -> bool:
    """Bare ``[a-z0-9_-]`` token — not a URL, ``owner/repo`` or path."""
    from hermes_cli.plugins_cmd import _URL_SCHEMES
    return bool(identifier) and "/" not in identifier and "\\" not in identifier \
        and not identifier.startswith(_URL_SCHEMES) and bool(_NAME_RE.match(identifier))


def raise_if_removed(*candidates: str) -> None:
    """``PluginOperationError`` when any candidate (name or repo URL) is on the kill list."""

​裸名​解析​只经​ catalog ​或​报错​——​绝不​加​第二套​名字​索引​（AGENTS.md ​原话​）。provenance ​的​存放​位置​有​一条​铁律​：​目录​来源​（catalog ​块​、sha = ​实际​ checkout ​的​ commit）​住​在​安装者​拥有​的​ .install-metadata.json ​记录​里​，​绝不​进​插件​树​——​树内​的​ .hermes-catalog.json ​是​ Desktop "Install here" ​读​的​便利​副本​，Python ​永不​信任​它​（​仓库​可以​伪造​一份​）。update ​时​按​ catalog re-pin ​到​新​的​已​审​ commit；search/info/validate（​含​ --install-deps，CI ​跑​的​那个​）​都​在​这个​模块​。
