docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ plugin-catalog/README.md 18 ​条​准入​ + schema + removed ​语义​（​与​开发者​指南​逐字​镜像​） plugin-catalog/<name>.yaml ×~1150 ​条目​本体​（40-hex pin ​强制​） plugin-catalog/removed.yaml kill list（canonical URL ​匹配​） hermes_cli/plugin_catalog.py loader + ​活​刷新​ + ​回退​ hermes_cli/plugins_cmd_catalog.py ​解析​/provenance/search/info/validate/re-pin website/scripts/extract-plugins.py ​文档​构建​期​产出​单一​ JSON .github/workflows/plugin-catalog-ci.yml ​变更​条目​在​ pin ​上​ clone + validate tests/website/test_catalog_rules_mirror.py README ​与​文档​站​的​镜像​一致性​测试

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• hermes_cli/plugins_cmd*.py：catalog ​是​安装​来源​之一​；​裸名​安装​经​ catalog ​解析​。
  • hermes_cli/left_core_migration.py（​上​一篇​）：​离核​特性​的​自动​安装​走​的​就是​这​条​ catalog ​安装​路径​（​受审​ pin、kill list、​依赖​约束​）。
  • ​文档​站​：​每个​条目​在​ /docs/plugins/<name> ​有​生成​页​；/docs/api/plugin-catalog.json ​就是​活​刷新​源​。
  • Desktop/TUI：methods_plugin_catalog.py（08 ​篇​）​把​目录​ payload ​接​进​ RPC ​面​；Desktop ​读​ sidecar ​提供​"Install here"。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​目录​的​信任​模型​一句​话​说完​：​目录​里​的​存在​ = ​人工​准入​，SHA = ​被​审​的​ release，removed.yaml = ​永久​否决​。​机器​执法​分布​在​三处​——loader ​拒绝​非​ 40-hex ​钉​与​坏​ URL、CI ​在​ pin ​上​ clone ​并​ validate、​安装​路径​ canonical ​匹配​ kill list；​人​的​判断​集中​在​ PR ​门​与​ 18 ​条​规则​。provenance ​只住​在​安装​记录​里​、​便利​副本​永不​信任​，​是​"​插件​可以​对​用户​做​什么​"​这​条​主线​的​最后​一次​落实​：​连​目录​自己​都​不许​被​插件​伪造​。

docs.title: 09.1 ​已​发布​的​插件​ API —— hooks、ctx、ABC ​与​清单
docs.text: ​插件​作者​能​碰到​的​一切​，​就是​这​一篇​里​的​四样​东西​：​钩子​点​、PluginContext（ctx）、​可​实现​的​核心​ ABC、​以及​ plugin.yaml ​清单​。​任何​超出​这个​表面​的​工作​方式​（​改​核心​文件​、patch ​核心​对象​、​读​别的​插件​的​内部​）​都​违反​「​插件​永不​触碰​核心​」（​见​ index.md）。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​行​数​ ​角色​ hermes_cli/plugins_context.py — PluginContext：​插件​拿到​的​唯一​把柄​ hermes_cli/plugins_dispatch.py — ​钩子​分发​：​超时​分档​、​签名​检查​ hermes_cli/plugins_loader.py / plugins/plugin_loader.py 278（​后者​） ​按​路径​导入​ + ​有​界​等待​锁​ hermes_cli/plugins_manifest.py — plugin.yaml ​解析​ hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py — ​中途​加载​的​"​现在​活​ vs ​下个​会​话​"​摘要​ hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json — ​已​发布​核心​名​清单​（boundary lint ​的​依据​）

docs.title: 1. ​钩子​点
docs.text:
​通用​插件​在​ register(ctx) ​里​注册​钩子​。​分发​层​的​分档​表​就是​钩子​世界​的​地图​：

# hermes_cli/plugins_dispatch.py:42-49 (​节选​)
_HOOK_TIMEOUT_BOUNDED_HOOKS: set[str] = {
    "post_tool_call", "transform_terminal_output", "transform_tool_result", "transform_llm_output",
    "pre_llm_call", "post_llm_call", "pre_api_request", "post_api_request", "api_request_error",
    "pre_auxiliary_call", "post_auxiliary_call", "pre_verify", "on_session_start", "on_session_end",
    # Fail-open consumer on every inbound gateway message: a hung plugin must not stall the profile.
    "post_gateway_admission",
    ...
}
_HOOK_TIMEOUT_FAIL_CLOSED_HOOKS: set[str] = {"pre_tool_call"}

​核心​六钩​是​ pre_tool_call / post_tool_call / pre_llm_call / post_llm_call / on_session_start / on_session_end，​另有​辅助​调用​对​的​ pre_auxiliary_call / post_auxiliary_call（payload ​是​ *_api_request ​形状​ + aux_task ​字​段​）。​超时​纪律​：​有​界​钩子​跑​在​ plugins.hook_callback_timeout ​下​（worker ​被​弃置​、​绝不​ join）；pre_tool_call ​是​唯一​ fail-closed ​的​——​超时​或​仍​在​跑​就​阻塞​该​工具​，​消息​是​ "pre_tool_call plugin callback timed out or is still running"（67 ​行​）。​回调​按​签名​检查​：​旧窄​签名​只​收到​自己​声明​的​字​段​，**kwargs ​收​完整​ payload——​这​就是​"payload ​以​关键字​字​段​增量​添加​"​的​兼容​契约​的​落实​处​。

pre_llm_call ​可以​返回​ {"context": "..."}（​或​字符串​）​注入​上下文​；​辅助​钩子​由​ agent/auxiliary_hooks.py ​从​ titling/​压缩​/MoA/vision ​等​路径​发出​，​绝不​与​ turn ​范围​钩子​混淆​（#79733）。

docs.title: 2. ctx ​表面​：​插件​拿到​的​把柄
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/plugins_context.py:36, 270, 442, 723, 834 (grep ​视角​)
class PluginContext(PluginCapabilityCtxMixin):   # :36
    ...
    def register_tool(self, ...):                # :270
    def ask_choice(self, question, choices): ... # :425
    def register_cli_command(self, ...):         # :442
    def register_locale_dir(self, ...):          # :723
    def register_login_backend(self, provider):  # :834

​关键​方法​与​语义​：

  • register_tool：​把​一个​ Python ​函数​注册​成​模型​工具​；​工具​出现​在​下个​会​话​（prompt-cache ​不​变量​，​见​ activation）。
  • register_cli_command：argparse ​子树​在​启动​时接​进​ hermes ​主​解析器​——​不​需要​改​ main.py，​这​正是​「​加宽​通用​面而非​硬​编码​」​的​样板​。
  • register_locale_dir：​清单​里​ provides_locales ​的​语言包​（locales/<lang>[.tui|.desktop].yaml）​自动​注册​；​纯​清单​语言包​连​ __init__.py ​都​不​需要​，hermes_cli/plugin_validate_locales.py ​校验​它们​。
  • agent.secret_scope.get_secret：​凭据​的​唯一​正确​读法​。​多路复用​下​一个​进程​服务​多个​ profile，​裸​ os.environ ​读​可能​拿到​另​一个​ profile ​的​ key（plugins/AGENTS.md「Lifecycle hooks fire under the owning profile's scope」​节​）。
  • credentialed_provider_request：​订阅​式​登录​（Codex/ChatGPT）​的​唯一​用法​——Hermes ​附​ token，​插件​永远​不​持有​它​。
  • spawn_context_thread：​一切​后台​工作​的​起点​；​裸​ threading.Thread ​起​的​ worker ​没有​作用域​，fail-closed ​或​写​进​启动​ profile ​的​租户​。
  • register_login_backend（browser_vault ​登录​后​端​）：​加载​时​只​接受​捆绑​插件​或​verified/official ​层​目录​插件​在​受审​ pin ​上​的​安装​（plugin-catalog/README.md ​规则​ 18）。

docs.title: 3. ​可​实现​的​核心​ ABC
docs.text:
ABC ​文件​ ​说明​ MemoryProvider agent/memory_provider.py sync_turn/prefetch/shutdown，​可​选​ post_setup；​编排​者​ agent/memory_manager.py；profile ​归属​经​ on_profile_created/on_profile_renamed ProviderProfile providers/base.py ​声明​式​ auth/endpoints/quirks；__init__.py ​在​加载​时调​ providers.register_provider(ProviderProfile(...)) Context engine / image-gen / video-gen / delegation provider agent/context_engine.py ​等​ ​各自​的​ ABC + ​目录​（plugins/context_engine/ ​等​）；plugins/delegation/default ​就是​今天​的​委派​路由​ PlatformEntry seams gateway/platforms/base.py ​平台​插件​设置​ trusted_inbound、display_tier、shared_env_prefixes ​等​ seam——​核心​特例​变成​插件​设置​的​ seam，​永不​是​名字​检查​

​模型​提供​方​的​ last-writer-wins ​在​ providers/__init__.py ​有​明确​设计​意图​（docstring，731-732 ​行​）："documented override precedence via last-writer-wins in register_provider() — a pip package cannot hijack a first-party profile"——​顺序​靠​发现​步骤​的​先后​实现​：pip entry points ​先跑​（​最低​优先​），​然后​捆绑​目录​、$HERMES_HOME ​层​，​后者​覆盖​前者​。

docs.title: 4. plugin.yaml ​清单
docs.text:
# ​典型​内置​清单​（plugins/memory/byterover/plugin.yaml ​节选​）
name: byterover
version: 1.0.0
description: "ByteRover — persistent knowledge tree with tiered retrieval via the brv CLI."
external_dependencies:
  - name: brv
    install: "curl -fsSL https://byterover.dev/install.sh | sh"
    check: "brv --version"
config_keys:
  - memory.byterover

​通用字​段面​（plugin-catalog/README.md ​条目​ schema ​与​ AGENTS.md ​归纳​）：name、version、description、kind（general/memory-provider/model-provider…；​缺​ kind: ​的​清单​按​源码​启发式​自动​判型​——​同时​出现​ register_provider + ProviderProfile ​即判​ model-provider，PluginManager ​只​记录​其​清单​却​绝不​ import，​否则​会双​实例​化​）、requires_env、config_schema、oauth:、capabilities:、python_dependencies、provides_locales。​未知​原生​清单​字段​被​忽略​（​兼容​契约​）。

docs.title: 5. ​加载​机制​：plugins/plugin_loader.py
docs.text:
​这是​ memory/cron/context_engine ​各​专用​系​共用​的​按​路径​加载​器​：

# plugins/plugin_loader.py:144-149 (docstring ​节选​)
def load_plugin_module(module_name: str, plugin_dir: Path, *, parents: tuple[str, ...],
                       logger: logging.Logger, synthetic_namespace: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Any]:
    """Import ``plugin_dir/__init__.py`` as *module_name* (reusing sys.modules when loaded).
    Order matters: parents first (relative imports need them), then siblings as ``module_name.<stem>``
    (so ``from ._x import Y`` resolves), then module. ..."""

​父包​与​兄弟​模块​预​注册​成​合成​包​（register_synthetic_package，72-78 ​行​），​相对​导入​才能​解析​，monkeypatch ​才​有​正常​的​模块​形状​。​并发​纪律​靠​一套​锁​与​有界​等待​：

# plugins/plugin_loader.py:22-31 (​节选​)
_MODULE_LOAD_LOCKS: dict[str, threading.RLock] = {}
_MODULE_LOAD_LOCKS_GUARD = threading.Lock()
# Inside bounded_load_wait(), how long a second caller waits for another thread's in-flight load of
# the same module. Past it the module is marked stalled (a hung import) and later bounded callers
# refuse at once until it finishes.
_CONCURRENT_LOAD_WAIT_SECS = 10.0
_BOUNDED_WAIT: ContextVar[bool] = ContextVar("plugin_load_bounded_wait", default=False)
_STALLED_LOADS: set[str] = set()
_LOAD_OWNERS: dict[str, int] = {}  # module -> thread id running its load
_LOAD_WAITERS: dict[int, str] = {}  # thread id -> module whose load it waits for

bounded_load_wait()（56-64 ​行​）​让​每​ turn ​的​调用​方​最​多​等​ 10 ​秒​，​超时​标记​ stalled ​并​立即​拒绝​；​死锁​检测​ _load_would_deadlock（42-53 ​行​）​沿着​加载​锁​ + importlib ​模块​锁​的​等待​图​走​回​自己​就​放弃​——PluginManager ​每次​重扫​的​差异​在​ hermes_cli/plugins.py:391-436：​安全​ worker ​跳过​、force=True ​先​ unload() ​再​重扫​、HERMES_SAFE_MODE=1 ​直接​跳过​发现​、​失败​时回​滚​ _discovered ​标志​免得​"​空​注册表​"​被​缓存​，​扫完​ _evict_stale_persistent_registrations ​处理​没​回来​的​注册​者​、_refresh_secret_sources_after_discovery ​补拉​插件​密钥​源​。

docs.title: 6. ​作用域​纪律​与​宿主​边界
docs.text:
​钩子​在​所属​ profile ​作用域​下​触发​，​调用者​负责​绑定​：on_session_start/on_session_end/sync_turn/shutdown ​既​从​ turn（​已​绑定​）​也​从​ eviction、shutdown、tui_gateway teardown、cron completion ​发出​（​由​调用者​经​ _run_release_in_profile_scope、_session_profile_runtime_scope、_profile_cron_scope ​绑定​）。​提供​方​绝不​把​ initialize() ​拿到​的​ hermes_home ​缓存​成​"​那个​"​家​——​状态​按​每次​调用​交给​它​的​ home ​键控​（hermes_home_key()），​凭据​只​从​ agent.secret_scope.get_secret ​读​。

plugins.isolation: host ​时​，​每个​非​捆绑​插件​跑​在​ per-profile ​宿主​进程​里​（plugin_host.py ​父侧​ / plugin_host_child.py ​子侧​ / plugin_host_wire.py ​帧​协议​）：​一切​用户​代码​导入​路径​要么​路由​进​宿主​要么​拒绝​；​过不去​的​东西​集中​在​ plugin_isolation.HOST_UNSUPPORTED_CTX_METHODS ​一张​表​（​活​网关​/​适配器​对象​）；​宿主​永不​ spawn ​宿主​（HERMES_PLUGIN_HOST_PROCESS=1 ​强制​ in-process）。​隔离​方​不能​在​操作员​钉死​时​退出​：isolation_mode()/host_launcher() ​经​托管​ overlay（load_config_readonly）​读取​，/etc/hermes/config.yaml ​压​过​ profile ​自己​的​配置​。

docs.title: 7. ​中途​激活​摘要
docs.text:
# hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py:1-9 (docstring ​节选​)
"""Mid-run plugin activation: what a just-loaded plugin does NOW vs next session (#87770).

One seam for every surface: ``PluginManager.on_plugin_loaded`` fires with one
:func:`plugin_activation_summary` per loaded plugin. Gateway handlers (slash commands, transform hooks,
platform callbacks) are live as soon as the plugin loads; portable MCP servers and skills go live in
the open chats of the plugin's profile (:func:`load_and_go_live`; MCP tools are deferred behind
tool_search, so the cached prompt prefix is unchanged); Python tools and system-prompt sections stay
deferred to the next session (prompt-cache invariant, same as ``/skills install``)."""

​这张​"​现在​ vs ​下个​会​话​"​表是​ prompt-cache ​神圣​不​变量​在​插件​面​的​投影​：​绝不​从​ RPC ​里发​ on_plugin_loaded（AGENTS.md ​原话​）。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​位置​ ​职责​ PluginContext hermes_cli/plugins_context.py:36 ​插件​唯一​把柄​：register_* / ask_choice / secret ​路由​ register_tool / register_cli_command / register_locale_dir / register_login_backend ​同​上​ :270/:442/:723/:834 ​工具​ / argparse ​子树​ / ​语言包​ / ​登录​后​端​注册​ credentialed_provider_request ctx ​面​ ​订阅​式​登录​请求​（token ​由​ Hermes ​附​） _HOOK_TIMEOUT_BOUNDED_HOOKS / _FAIL_CLOSED_HOOKS plugins_dispatch.py:42/:60 ​钩子​超时​分档​；pre_tool_call ​唯一​ fail-closed discover_plugins(force) hermes_cli/plugins.py:871 ​幂​等​发现​入口​；join ​后台​扫描​ discover_and_load ​同​上​ :390 ​附近​ ​重扫​主体​：SAFE_MODE、unload、​脏​标志​回滚​ load_plugin_module plugins/plugin_loader.py:144 ​按​路径​导入​ + ​父​/​兄弟​预​注册​ bounded_load_wait / _module_load_lock ​同​上​ :56/:67 10s ​有​界​等待​ + stalled ​标记​ register_synthetic_package ​同​上​ :72 ​合成​父包壳​，​相对​导入​的​根基​ MemoryProvider / ProviderProfile agent/memory_provider.py / providers/base.py ​记忆​与​模型​提供​方​ ABC plugin_activation_summary hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py ​现在​活​ vs ​下个​会​话​的​激活​摘要

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text: 文件​ ​一句​话​ hermes_cli/plugins_context.py ctx ​面​（73 ​个​方法​级​定义​） hermes_cli/plugins_dispatch.py ​钩子​分发​、​超时​分档​、​签名​检查​ hermes_cli/plugins_loader.py ​通用​插件​的​导入​与​注册​（isolation ​路由​点​） plugins/plugin_loader.py ​专用​系​共享​的​按​路径​加载​器​ hermes_cli/plugins_manifest.py plugin.yaml ​解析​与​ kind ​判定​ hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py / plugins_activation_live.py ​中途​激活​摘要​与​ go-live hermes_cli/plugins_ledger.py / plugins_state.py / plugins_transaction.py ​注册​账本​与​安装​事务​ hermes_cli/plugins_cmd*.py CLI ​面​（install/remove/toggle/update/catalog/…） hermes_cli/plugin_isolation_audit.py / plugin_host*.py host ​隔离​审计​与​宿主​进程​ hermes_cli/data/plugin_api.json ​已​发布​核心​名​清单​（boundary lint ​依据​）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• model_tools.py：​钩子​的​主​调用​点​（pre/post tool）​与​发现​的​触发​副作用​；run_agent.py ​发​生命周期​钩子​。
  • agent/secret_scope.py：​凭据​路由​与​ fail-closed ​语义​（multiplex ​翻转​见​ 08 ​篇​ process_model.md）。
  • gateway/platform_registry.py：​平台​插件​注册表​；_shared.apply_yaml_bridge / platform_gate_env ​是​平台​ YAML ​的​合法​通道​（​平台​插件​永不​改​ os.environ）。
  • scripts/boundary_lint.py：​本篇​的​清单​文件​就是​它​的​判定​依据​（​下​一篇​细讲​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​已​发布​ API ​的​全部​逻辑​可以​压成​四句​话​：​钩子​有​超时​分档​且​按​签名​演进​；ctx ​是​唯一​把柄​，CLI ​子树​和​工具​都​经​它​注册​而​不​碰​ main.py；ABC ​是​类型​边界​，ProviderProfile ​的​ last-writer-wins ​让​用户​覆盖​而​不​劫持​；​加载​有锁​、​有​界​等待​与​死锁​检测​，​中途​激活​尊重​ prompt-cache。​作者​守住​这​四条​，​插件​就​与​核心​解​耦​；​核心​守住​ plugin_api.json ​这张​清单​，​边界​就​有​机器​执法​——​这​正是​下​一篇​的​内容​。

docs.title: cron/ ​模块​总览​ —— ​定时​任务调度​器
文件​概览
docs.text: cron/ ​是​ Hermes ​的​「​闹钟​ + ​定时​工头​」：​它​让​ agent ​和​用户​能​把​一件​事​安排​到​未来​某个​时刻​自动​执行​——​每天​早上​的​简报​、​每周​的​回顾​、in 30m ​的​一次性​提醒​。​任务​定义​/​存储​在​ cron/jobs.py（​持久​化为​ ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json），​派发​循环​在​ cron/scheduler.py::tick()（​网关​后台​线程​每​ 60 ​秒​调​一次​）。​本​目录​共​ 50+ ​个​ Python ​文件​，​但​结构​极其​规律​：​门面​文件​（jobs.py、scheduler.py）​保留​调用​点​与​公共​入口​，​一切​新​行为​都​放进​ <stem>_<topic>.py ​兄弟​文件​——​这​正是​仓库​「​门面​ + ​兄弟​」​布局​的​教科书​案例​。​本篇​是​第​ 10 ​章​总览​，​后续​ 3 ​篇​分别​精读​调度​器族​、​任务​存储​族​与​「​看​板​/​蓝图​/​建议​」​族​。

docs.title: 一条​任务​的​完整​旅程​（ASCII ​全景​）
docs.text:
​用户​ / Agent
   │  hermes cron add "0 9 * * *"  /  cronjob ​工具​(tools/cronjob_tools.py)
   │  lifespan_guard ​拒绝​自杀式​任务​ → create_job ​写入​
   ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json        （​每​ profile ​一份​，​跨​进程​ flock）│
│  schedule / timezone / grace_minutes / pending_slot / fire_claim│
└───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                │ ​每​ 60s：scheduler_thread.SupervisedTickerThread
                │   └─ scheduler_provider._start_multiplex（​一个​线程​顺序​遍历​ served homes，
                │        ​每个​ home ​在​ _profile_cron_scope(home) ​下​ tick）
                ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ cron/scheduler_tick.py::tick()                                  │
│  1. ​旧​代码​让位​ gate（CronTickYielded）                           │
│  2. ​拿​ <home>/cron/.tick.lock（​进程​间​去​重​）                      │
│  3. get_due_jobs()（jobs.py：​宽限​窗​ / ​时区​钉​ / pending_slot ​恢复​）│
│  4. advance_next_runs()：​先​推进​ next_run_at（​至多​一次​）          │
│  5. ​并行​池​逐个​ _process_due_job                                  │
└───────┬──────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────┘
        │ no_agent/script ​任务​          │ agent ​任务​
        ▼                              ▼
 cron/scheduler_script.py      ​内起​ AIAgent ​会话​（skip_memory=True）
 （​预跑​脚本​，​输出​注入​ prompt）   ​不​活动​看门狗​ / preflight / prompt ​组装​
        │                              │ ​外部​ worker：scheduler.py::_launch_external_cron_worker
        │                              │  → -m cron.scheduler --external-worker-file …
        │                              │  → cron/__init__ → worker_bootstrap → PM activate_dependencies
        ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ~/.hermes/cron/output/{job_id}/{timestamp}.md + executions ​台账​  │
│ ​投递​：scheduler_delivery.py → origin/​家​回退​/​显式​目标​/​群聊​房间​     │
│       delivery_queue.py（​跨​ cgroup ​的​持久​投递​交接​，​至多​一次​）     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: 四类​计划​表达式
docs.text:
cron/jobs.py::parse_schedule()（​行​ 787）​把​一个​字符串​解析​为​ {"kind": ...}，​四类​输入​共用​一个​入口​：

​输入​ kind ​语义​ "30m" / "every 2h" interval ​循环​间隔​（​裸时长​按​文档​约定​=​循环​，​不是​一次性​） "every monday 9am" / "weekdays at 9am" cron ​自然语言​短语​转​ 5 ​字​段​ cron（​需​ croniter ​包​） "0 9 * * *" cron ​标准​ 5 ​字​段​ cron ​表达式​ "2026-06-01T09:00:00Z" / "in 30m" once ​一次性​（naive ​时间​戳​按​配置​好​的​ Hermes ​时​区​解释​，​非​服务器​本地​时​区​）

docs.title: 两条​创建​路径
docs.text:
• Agent：tools/cronjob_tools.py ​注册​的​ cronjob_manage ​工具​（​行​ 1263），agent ​可以​替​用户​建​/​改​/​暂停​任务​。
  • ​用户​：hermes cron list|status|doctor|tick|runs|incidents|notepad|create|edit|pause|resume|run|cancel|remove（hermes_cli/cron.py ​行​ 1019-1032 ​的​动词​表​），REPL ​里​对应​ /cron。

docs.title: 每条​不​变量​守护​一个​真实​故障
docs.text:
cron ​的​「​加固​不​变量​」​清单​是​仓库​里​最长​的​（​见​ cron/AGENTS.md），​每​一条​都​对应​一个​修过​的​ bug：

  • ​不​活动​看门狗​（​默认​ 600s ​空闲​，HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT ​可调​，0 = ​无限​）：​按​空闲​时间​而​非墙​钟​掐​会​话​——​卡死​的​会​话​被​硬​中断​，​不能​霸占​调度​器​；​长时间​但​活跃​的​任务​永不​被​误杀​。
  • catch-up ​窗口​ = ​周期​一半​ clamp ​到​ 120s–2h，​或​ grace_minutes ​覆盖​（0 = ​永不​补跑​——0 == False ​是​ Python ​的​坑​，​校验​代码​里​明确​拒绝​ bool）。
  • ​钉死​ timezone ​拥有​全​路径​：compute_next_run ​解析​「​任务​钉​ → profile ​时​区​」，​且​每个​ next_run_at ​写​点​（quota_hold.plan_hold、unreachable_retry.will_retry、extra_fire.settle……）​都​必须​传钉​；​漏​一处​就是​突发​重跑​或​静默​跳过​一​拍​。
  • ​至多​一次​ occurrence：tick() ​在​派发​前​推进​ next_run_at，​同一​保存​内盖​ pending_slot ​戳​；owner ​死​掉​的​ pending ​槽​位​由​ cron/occurrences.py ​恰好​恢复​一次​；executions ​台账​的​ scheduled_instant ​挡住​第二次​点燃​。
  • headless tick ​拒绝​而​不​孵化​：hermes cron tick（​系统​ crontab）​走​ tick(headless=True)，scheduler_gateway_gate.py ​在​发现​没有​网关​时​跳​过​ agent ​任务​并​盖​ last_fire_error，​绝不​ spawn ​一个​无人​管理​的​网关​守护​进程​。
  • ​一个​ ticker，​绝不​ N ​线程​：scheduler_provider._start_multiplex ​在​ _profile_cron_scope(home) ​下​顺序​迭代​每个​ served profile——​模块​全局​量会​在线​程间​打架​。
  • inflight ​状态​键​ = (home key, job id)：​一个​进程​ tick N ​个​ profile，​两个​ profile ​合法​地​各有​一个​ daily-brief；claims ​必须​在​注册​时​的​ home ​下​释放​（ContextVar ​的​坑​）。
  • ​宿主​网关​为​「​跑​自己​网关​的​ profile」​让位​：gateway/run.py::_cron_profile_gate ​把​ liveness PID ​与​ os.getpid() ​比较​，​避免​把​自己​吓退​。
  • cron ​会话​默认​ skip_memory=True：​记忆​提供者​在​ cron ​里​故意​不​跑​。

docs.title: 磁盘​上​的​文件​布局
docs.text:
~/.hermes/                        ← ​每个​ profile ​自己​的​ home（get_hermes_home()）
├── cron/
│   ├── jobs.json                 ← ​任务​存储​（​原子​写​ + 0600 + ​跨​进程​ flock）
│   ├── .jobs.lock                ← jobs.json ​临界​区​的​跨​进程​锁​文件​
│   ├── .tick.lock                ← tick ​互斥​（​网关​ vs crontab vs ​手动​ tick）
│   ├── ticker_heartbeat          ← ​每次​循环​触碰​：​区分​「​线程​活着​」​与​「​进程​活着​」
│   ├── ticker_last_success       ← ​最近​一次​无​异常​完成​的​ tick
│   ├── dispatch_held.json        ← ​网关​排水​期间​ one-shot ​宽限​重锚​的​持久​记录​
│   ├── catch_up_occurrences      ← profile ​本地​补跑​计数​标记​
│   ├── executions.db             ← ​执行​台账​ + ​失败​事件​（SQLite，​两​模块​共用​）
│   ├── suggestions.json          ← ​统一​建议​面​（0600）
│   ├── admissions/<hash>.json    ← ​传输层​执行​的​ admission journal（0600）
│   └── output/{job_id}/{ts}.md   ← ​每次​运行​的​输出​文档​（id ​是​路径​组件​，​逃逸​被​拒​）
└── scripts/                      ← script ​字​段​引用​的​文件​必须​住​这里​（​绝不​接受命令​行​）

​任务​ id ​是​ output/ ​下​的​路径​组件​，​所以​ _job_output_dir()（jobs.py:431）​拒绝​ ..、​绝对路径​、​分隔符​——​只​接受​单个​安全​组件​；id ​也​在​ _IMMUTABLE_JOB_FIELDS ​里​，​创建​后​不可​改​。

docs.title: 三个​时钟​词汇
docs.text:
​读​ cron ​源码​前先​分清​三个​时间​概念​，​几乎​所有​不​变量​都​围绕​它们​的​边界​展开​：

  • instant（​时刻​）：​绝对​时间​点​（UTC ​规范化​后​比较​）。​台账​的​ scheduled_instant、fire claim ​的​ skew/TTL ​都​在​ instants ​上​运算​。
  • wall clock（​挂钟​）：​某个​时区​的​本地​墙钟​读数​。cron ​表达式​表达​的​是​挂钟​意图​——「​每周​一​ 9 ​点​」​的​意思​随​ zone ​而变​；_stored_wall_clock_is_future（jobs.py:920）​专治​「​时区​改​了​之后​旧​ offset ​让​未来​ run ​看起来​ due」​的​错觉​。
  • idle time（​空闲​时间​）：agent ​最后​产出​的​距今​时​长​。​看门狗​与​ stale-claim ​扫描​都​用​它​而​不是​墙钟​时长​——​活跃​的​长​任务​与​僵死​的​短​任务​由此​分野​。

docs.title: 本组​文档​导航
docs.text: 文档​ ​内容​ scheduler.md scheduler.py + ​全部​ scheduler_*.py ​兄弟​：tick ​准入​、​线程​监督​、​多路复用​、​投递​、​看门狗​、​网​关门​ jobs.md jobs.py ​存储​族​ + ​全部​不​变量​逐条​深讲​：​锁​、​时​区​、pending_slot、executions ​台账​、quota_hold、missed_runs…… kanban_dispatcher.md blueprint_catalog.py / suggestions.py / notepad.py ​等​面向用户​的​自动化​入口​ + ​与​ hermes_cli/kanban* ​看​板​派发​的​关系

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway/：​网关​是​ ticker ​的​宿主​（gateway/run.py::_cron_tick_profile_homes ​决定​ tick ​哪些​ profile home；_cron_profile_gate ​让位​给​跑​自己​网关​的​ profile）。
  • pm/：​外部​ cron worker ​经​ cron/worker_bootstrap.py → pm.environments.activate_dependencies ​自​举​租用​ committed ​依赖​代​。
  • tools/：cronjob_manage ​工具​是​ agent ​侧​创建​入口​；kanban ​工具集​由​看板​派发​器​spawn ​的​ worker ​使用​。
  • agent/：cron ​任务​每次​运行​得到​独立​ AIAgent ​会话​（skip_memory=True、​不​活动​看门狗​、execution_identity.py ​的​ ContextVar ​出处​）。
  • hermes_cli/：hermes cron <verb> CLI ​与​ hermes_cli/kanban* ​看​板​命令​共享​这里​的​存储​原语​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: cron/ ​的​读法​是​「​先抓​两条​主干​」：jobs.py ​管是​什么​、​什么​时候​（​存储​ + ​时间​数学​ + ​不​变量​），scheduler.py ​管去​执行​、​去​投递​（tick ​准入​ + ​执行​ + ​投递​）。​其余​几十个​文件​全部​是​这​两条​主干​按​主题​切出​的​兄弟​件​，​每个​文件​头​ docstring ​都​写明​它​守护​哪个​故障​。​下​一篇​从​调度​器族​开始​。

docs.title: 任务​存储​族​ —— jobs.json、​时间​数学​与​执行​台账
文件​概览
docs.text: cron/jobs.py（3,453 ​行​门面​）​回答​「​任务​是​什么​、​什么​时候​跑​」：​任务​ CRUD、​计划​解析​、due ​扫描​、next_run_at ​推进​。​存储​在​每​ profile ​一份​的​ ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json，​输出​在​ ~/.hermes/cron/output/{job_id}/{timestamp}.md。​行为​按​主题​下沉​到​兄弟​文件​：​时间​旋钮​（jobs_time.py）、​执行​模式​不​变量​（jobs_invariants.py）、​模型​钉​（jobs_model_pin.py）、occurrence ​身份​（occurrences.py）、​执行​台账​（executions.py）​等​。​本篇​先​走读​存储​与​锁​、due ​扫描​与​宽限​窗​，​再​把​加固​不​变量​逐条​对​到​代码​位置​，​最后​给出​全族​清单​。

docs.title: 每​ profile ​的​存储​与​双层​锁
docs.text:
# cron/jobs.py:83-95
# Cron is per-profile by design: anchor at get_hermes_home() (active profile home), NOT
# get_default_hermes_root() — the shared root would funnel every profile's jobs into one jobs.json
# and run them under the ticker's HERMES_HOME, leaking config/credentials/skills across profiles.
# Each profile owns its own cron store under its own HERMES_HOME, and a profile-scoped gateway runs that
# profile's jobs under that same HERMES_HOME — so a job authored in profile `coder` lives in
# `~/.hermes/profiles/coder/cron/jobs.json` and executes with `coder`'s `.env`, `config.yaml`, and skills.
# Do NOT change this to the default root: that re-breaks per-profile isolation. See also the dynamic
# `_get_hermes_home()` / `_get_lock_paths()` resolution in cron/scheduler.py. See #4707.
HERMES_DIR = get_hermes_home().resolve()
# Default-profile fallback and compatibility surface for callers/tests. Cross-profile callers must
# scope paths with use_cron_store() instead of mutating these process-wide.
CRON_DIR = HERMES_DIR / "cron"
JOBS_FILE = CRON_DIR / "jobs.json"

​跨​ profile ​调用者​用​ use_cron_store(home)（​行​ 192）​这个​ ContextVar ​把​存储​路由​到​任意​ home，​绝不​改​进程​级​常量​。​锁​是​两层​的​：

# cron/jobs.py:293-300
@contextlib.contextmanager
def _jobs_lock():
    """Serialize a load_jobs→modify→save_jobs critical section: in-process RLock (parallel tick
    threads) plus a cross-process flock on ``<cron dir>/.jobs.lock`` (gateway vs. CLI writes —
    otherwise a `cron pause` could be clobbered and keep firing). Nested calls in one thread
    reuse the held lock. Without a flock backend, or on flock timeout (logged loudly), it
    degrades to in-process-only locking: a briefly torn cross-process write beats a dead
    scheduler."""

​进程​内​ threading.RLock ​管​ tick ​并行​池​线程​之间​；fcntl（Unix）/msvcrt（Windows）​跨​进程​ flock ​管​「​网关​ vs hermes cron pause」。flock ​是​有界​轮询​（30s ​超时​，​行​ 115-118）：​每个​ cron ​函数​都​汇入​ _jobs_lock()，​被​一个​卡死​的​兄弟​进程​无限​阻塞​会​冻结​整个​调度​器​；​超时​则​大声​降级​为​仅​进程​内锁​——​短暂​的​撕裂​写​好​过​死​掉​的​调度​器​（#60703）。​任务​级​还有​第三层​ _fire_job_lock（​行​ 348）：​可​跨​网络​投递​持有​、​按​ profile+job ​分片​，​拿​不到​时​失败​关闭​。

docs.title: 四类​计划​与​宽限​窗
docs.text:
# cron/jobs.py:947-960
def _compute_grace_seconds(schedule: dict, grace_minutes: Any = None) -> int:
    """How late a job can be and still catch up rather than fast-forward: half the period, clamped
    to [120s, 2h], so daily jobs catch up but frequent jobs fast-forward quickly.

    A per-job ``grace_minutes`` overrides that window (0 = never catch up), floored at the
    120s tick tolerance: the ticker always fires a few seconds after the slot, so a 0s window
    would classify every on-time run as missed."""
    override = jobs_time.grace_seconds_override(grace_minutes)
    if override is not None:
        return max(override, _MIN_GRACE_SECONDS)
    period_seconds = _schedule_cadence_seconds(schedule)
    if not period_seconds:
        return _MIN_GRACE_SECONDS
    return max(_MIN_GRACE_SECONDS, min(int(period_seconds) // 2, _MAX_GRACE_SECONDS))

​宽限​窗​决定​一次​迟到​派发​是​ late（​补跑​）​还是​ catch_up（​跳过​积压​、​只​执行​现在​这​一次​，_classify_dispatch_lateness ​行​ 969）。grace_minutes ​是​每​任务​覆盖​，0 ​是​真实​值​（​永不​补跑​）——​所以​ normalize_grace_minutes（jobs_time.py:80-111）​显式​拒绝​ bool：0 == False ​的​ Python ​恒等式​正是​ workdir ​更新​ lambda v in {None, "", False} ​会​踩​的​坑​。​时​区​旋钮​同理​：normalize_timezone（jobs_time.py:56-77）​把​非法​ IANA ​名​在​写入​前​抛​ ValueError，​错别字​永远​到​不了​ 60s ​扫描​循环​。

docs.title: pending_slot：​至多​一次​的​持久​证据
docs.text:
tick() ​在​派发​前​推进​ next_run_at（​防​崩溃​重​放​），​但​这​留下​一个​窗口​——​推进​已落盘​、fire claim ​未​拿到​（​解释器​终态化​、​执行器​拒绝​、​进程​被​杀​）——​此时​重启​后​的​扫描​看到​未来​的​ next_run_at，​什么​都​没​跑​过​（#107485）。pending_slot ​是​这个​窗口​的​持久​记录​：

# cron/occurrences.py:62-69
# The tick advances a recurring job's ``next_run_at`` BEFORE dispatch (at-most-once: a crash
# mid-run must not re-fire on every restart). That leaves a window — advance done, fire claim
# not yet taken (interpreter finalizing, executor refusing work, process killed) — in which the
# process exiting loses the occurrence silently: the restarted scan sees a future ``next_run_at``
# and nothing ever ran (#107485). ``pending_slot`` is the durable record of that window: the due
# scan stamps it with the exact stored instant plus the stamping owner, ``claim_job_for_fire``
# (the point after which side effects may exist) clears it, and any explicit rewrite of the
# schedule drops it. A slot still pending once its owner is provably gone (or its lease has
# expired) was never claimed, so it is restored ONCE as the due instant and then flows through
# the ordinary late / fast-forward / ``cron.catch_up_missed`` policy — never N replays.

​恢复​谓词​ unclaimed_pending_slot（​行​ 78-103）​的​判定​链​：​非​循环​任务​/​坏​戳记​→None（​永不​触发​）；​本​进程​仍​在​跑​该​任务​→None（​排队​中​的​ worker ​会​自己​认领​并​清​戳​）；​别的​进程​盖​的​戳​且​ fire-claim ​租约​（FIRE_CLAIM_TTL_SECONDS，300s）​还​活着​→None（​第二个​活​网关​正在​派发​，​不是​死​了​）。​同一​保存​内​盖戳​是​关键​：advance_next_runs ​与​ pending_slot ​写​进同​一次​ save_jobs，​不​存在​「​推进​了​、​没​盖戳​」​的​中间​态​。

docs.title: executions ​台账​：​身份​与​防​双发
docs.text: cron/executions.py ​是​ profile ​本地​的​ SQLite ​台账​（​与​ incidents.py ​共用​ cron/executions.db）。​它​记录​已知​的​每次​尝试​，​不是​重试​队列​；「unknown」​只​在​拥有者​进程​被​证明​死亡​（​启动​时间​指纹​不​匹配​ = ​死亡​证据​）​之后​才​落账​；​终态​不可​变​。​每次​执行​携带​ scheduled_instant——​由​ occurrences.scheduled_instant（​行​ 9-19）​规范化​的​ aware UTC ​时刻​，​是​独立​于​ jobs.json ​可变​派发​戳​的​「​确切​计划​身份​」。​台账​里​同一​ (job_id, scheduled_instant) ​已有​ completed ​行时​，due ​扫描​和​ fire claim ​双​闸门​都​吃掉​这个​槽​位​而​不​跑​（completed_occurrence ​行​ 22-55）——​唯一​的​痕迹​是​一行​ WARNING（#111414）。

docs.title: 失败​面​：hold、​补跑​与​不可​达​重试
docs.text:
• quota_hold.py：provider ​明说​「retry after Ns」​且​整条​ fallback ​链​都​不可​用时​，mark_job_run ​把​ next_run_at ​停​到​恢复​边界​（​或​窗内​第一个​合法​ occurrence）​并​盖​ quota_hold_until——​否则​每次​按​节奏​重燃​都​是​一次​用量​探测​ + ​一条​失败​告警​。​任何​真正​到达​模型​的​运行​清除​标记​。
  • unreachable_retry.py：​借鉴​ Claude Cowork ​的​ 5/15/30 ​分钟​阶梯​，​但​类别​刻意​窄​——​必须​是​瞬时​网络​/DNS ​错误​且​ agent ​一次​ API ​调用​都​没​完成​（​零​开销​、​零​副作用​，​所以​重跑​不​可能​翻倍​任何​副作用​）；​循环​任务​专属​，one-shot ​由​ claim_dispatch ​预​认领​不可​再生​。
  • missed_runs.py：​机器​关机​/​网关​停机​期间​的​ occurrence ​有​ catch_up ​三态​——​任务​自己​的​ true/false ​优先​；​缺席​时​循环​任务​跟​ cron.catch_up_missed（​默认​ true）、one-shot ​保持​ 120s ​宽限​规则​（#93526：​陈年​提醒​默认​跳过​）。​跳过​/​合并​的​槽​位​记为​一行​ missed ×N ​台账​——​绝不​静默​丢槽​。
  • dispatch_hold.py：​网关​排水​（​重启​等待​在​途​ turn）​期间​ tick ​跳过​派发​；one-shot ​的​ 120s ​宽限​从​「hold ​的​最后​一次​ tick」​起算​而​不是​原​ due ​时刻​——​否则​一次​等​了​三分钟​的​更新​会​把​用户​定​在​那​一分钟​的​提醒​当​ missed ​退休​。hold ​跨​重启​持久​在​ <cron store>/dispatch_held.json。
  • extra_fire.py：​手动​「​立即​运行​」​是​额外​的​ fire——​离开​ pending ​的​计划​ occurrence ​与​ repeat ​预算​原封不动​。​否则​一个​测试​点燃​会​吃掉​ in 30m ​提醒​本身​。

fire_claim_fence() jobs.py:348/410 ​任务​级​ fire ​栅栏​（​失败​关闭​） use_cron_store() jobs.py:192 ContextVar ​路由​存储​到​任意​ home parse_schedule() jobs.py:787 ​四类​计划​字符串​ → {"kind": ...} compute_next_run / _ensure_aware() jobs.py:863 ​时区​归​一​（due ​扫描​传​任务​钉住​的​ zone） _compute_grace_seconds() jobs.py:947 ​宽限​窗​ = ​周期​一半​ clamp 120s–2h ​或​ grace_minutes create_job() / update_job() jobs.py:1809/2119 ​创建​/​更新​（​都​过​ jobs_invariants ​校验​） advance_next_runs() jobs.py:2672 ​派发​前​推进​（​同​保存​盖​ pending_slot） claim_job_for_fire() jobs.py:2723 fire ​认领​：​清​ pending_slot、​判重​、​盖​ fire_claim get_due_jobs() jobs.py:2868 due ​扫描​（​宽限​窗​、​时​区​修复​、​槽​位​恢复​） mark_job_run() jobs.py:2484 ​终局​簿记​ + quota_hold ​停泊​ normalize_timezone() / normalize_grace_minutes() jobs_time.py:56/80 ​写入​前​校验​；​拒绝​ bool ​的​ 0 docs.title: 不​变量​逐条​对码
docs.text: 不​变量​ ​守护​的​故障​ ​代码​位置​ ​不​活动​看门狗​（​空闲​ 600s） ​卡死​会话​独占​调度​器​ scheduler.py::_cron_inactivity_seconds + scheduler_liveness.py ​宽限​窗​ clamp 120s–2h ​日​任务​不补​跑​ / ​分钟​任务​无限​积压​ jobs.py:947 timezone ​钉​拥有​全​路径​ ​一个​写点​漏传​钉​ = ​突发​重跑​或​静默​跳​拍​ jobs_time.py + quota_hold.plan_hold + unreachable_retry.will_retry + extra_fire.settle ​钉住​任务​跳过​ _repair_timezone_shifted_cron ​东侧​任务​在​ profile ​时区​下​被判​「​未来​」、​重锚​越过​ due（​永不​触发​） jobs.py:3009 + _evaluate_due_job（jobs.py:3177） ​派发​前​推进​ + ​同​保存​盖​ pending_slot ​崩溃​重​放​ / ​推进​后​死亡​丢​拍​ scheduler_tick.py:160 + occurrences.py ​台账​ scheduled_instant ​防​双发​ ​双​闸门​之间​的​重复​点燃​ executions.py + occurrences.completed_occurrence ​每​ home tick ​锁​ ​双​进程​同时​ tick ​一个​ store scheduler.py::_get_lock_paths headless ​拒绝​而​非​孵化​ crontab ​每​ tick ​留​一个​野​网关​ scheduler_gateway_gate.py skip_memory=True ​记忆​提供者​污染​无​上下文​的​ cron ​会话​ ​会话​构造​（scheduler.py） ​创建​期​拒绝​网关​重启​任务​ SIGTERM→​复活​→​重跑​ ​的​循环​ lifecycle_guard.py cron.max_parallel_jobs ​按​ profile ​一个​ home ​吃光​全局​并行​额度​ scheduler.py::_resolve_max_parallel_workers + _get_parallel_pool

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• scheduler ​族​（​见​ scheduler.md）：due ​扫描​的​产出​被​ scheduler_tick ​消费​；claim_job_for_fire ​是​「​副作用​可能​存在​」​的​分界点​。
  • hermes_constants：get_hermes_home()/display_hermes_home()——​绝不​硬​编码​ ~/.hermes。
  • utils：atomic_write_text/atomic_json_write/fsync_directory——jobs.json ​与​标记​文件​的​原子​性​。
  • agent/：agent.deadline.poll_until（​有界锁​轮询​）、agent/estop（hermes pause ​让​ tick ​拒绝​派发​）。
  • tools/cronjob_tools.py：​创建​路径​的​模型​侧​入口​，​同样​经​ create_job ​的​不​变量​校验​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​存储​族​的​读法​是​「​两个​证据​系统​ + ​一组​旋钮​」：jobs.json ​是​意图​与​派发​状态​（​含​ pending_slot ​戳​），executions ​台账​是​事实​记录​（​确切​的​ scheduled_instant ​身份​）；timezone/grace_minutes/catch_up ​是​叠​在​时间​数学​上​的​三个​旋钮​，​每个​旋钮​的​ 0/​空值​语义​都​被​显式​校验​保护​。​所有​不​变量​共享​一个​方向​：​把​「​崩溃​/​竞争​/​坏​输入​」​的​后果​收敛​到​至多​一次​、​可​恢复​、​可​观测​。

docs.title: 面向用户​的​自动化​入口​ —— ​蓝图​、​建议​、​记事本​与​看板​派发​的​关系
文件​概览
docs.text: cron/ ​除了​「​跑​任务​」，​还有​一组​帮​用户​迈出​第一步​的​文件​：blueprint_catalog.py（​自动化​蓝图​目录​——​用户​永远​不写​裸​ cron ​表达式​）、blueprint_plugins.py（​插件​贡献​的​蓝图​）、suggestion_catalog.py + suggestions.py（​开箱​即用​的​建议​任务​，​一键​接受​）、notepad.py（​跨​唤醒​的​每​任务​ KV ​记事本​）、bot_chat_legacy.py（​已​退役​ CLI ​通道​的​遗留​投递​排水​）。​它们​与​看板​（kanban）​没有​直接​代码​耦合​，​但​共享​同​一片​问题​域​——「​把​工作​排队​交给​ agent」——​所以​本篇​同时​讲清​ cron ​与​ hermes_cli/kanban* ​看​板​派发​器​的​分工​边界​（​详细​看​板​机制​见​ tutorial/06_cli/kanban.md）。

docs.title: 蓝图​：​只有​一个​任务​引擎
docs.text:
# cron/blueprint_catalog.py:1-5
"""Automation Blueprints — one slot-schema definition per automation that every surface renders
natively: dashboard form (``blueprint_form_schema``), pre-filled ``/blueprint`` slash command
(``blueprint_slash_command``), agent seed prompt, docs deep-link. ``fill_blueprint`` validates
values into ``cron.jobs.create_job`` kwargs — there is no second job engine. Users never type raw
cron: ``schedule_template`` fixes the recurrence; only human parts (time, weekdays) are slots."""

​设计​要点​有​三层​。​第一​，​蓝图​只是​一个​「​槽​位​ schema」：schedule_template ​钉死​重复​节奏​，​人类​只​填​时间​、​星期​几​这类​自由​部分​——​杜绝​用户​写出​ 0 9 * * 99 ​这种​坏​表达式​。​第二​，fill_blueprint ​验证​后​落进​ cron.jobs.create_job ​的​ kwargs——​同一个​引擎​、​同​一套​不​变量​校验​，​没有​第二条​创建​通道​。​第三​，​同​一份​蓝图​被​四个​表面​原生​渲染​：​仪表盘​表单​、​预填​的​ /blueprint slash ​命令​、agent ​种子​ prompt、​文档​深链​：

# cron/blueprint_catalog.py（blueprint_slash_command ​附近​）
def blueprint_slash_command(blueprint: AutomationBlueprint, values: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str:
    """Build the flattened ``/blueprint <key> slot=val …`` command string. Uses each slot's default
    when ``values`` is omitted (ready-to-paste for docs/dashboard). Free-text slots are quoted."""

​插件​可以​贡献​自己​的​蓝图​（blueprint_plugins.py）：ctx.register_automation_blueprint ​传入​与​内置​相同​的​字​段​，build_plugin_blueprint ​校验​（​坏​输入​抛​ ValueError，​注册​方​记录​并​忽略​），​键名​强制​命名​空间​为​ <plugin>:<key>——​插件​永远​不能​遮蔽​内置​蓝图​。plugin_blueprints() ​在​调用​时读​活动​ profile ​的​插件​管理器​：​插件​按​ profile ​加载​，​这里​没有​任何​跨​ profile ​缓存​。

docs.title: 建议​：​同意​优先​，​绝不​自动​创建
docs.text:
# cron/suggestion_catalog.py:1-8
"""Curated catalog of starter cron-job suggestions.

These are the built-in automations Hermes can offer a new user out of the box — the ``catalog``
source of the unified suggestion surface. Each entry is a ready-to-run ``cron.jobs.create_job`` spec
wrapped as a suggestion; the user accepts via ``/suggestions``. Nothing here auto-schedules.

The "important-mail monitor" entry (``classify_items.py``: poll -> LLM-score urgency -> surface
above-threshold) is ONE catalog automation, not a standalone feature. New entries: append a
CatalogEntry with a self-contained prompt (cron jobs run with no chat context)."""

suggestions.py ​是​统一​建议​面​：​无论​来源​是​ catalog（​策展​ starters）、blueprint（​技能​里​的​ blueprint: ​块​）、usage（​自我​改进​回顾​）​还是​ integration（​已​连接​账号​），​每个​建议​都​是​一个​可​运行​的​ job spec，​用户​接受​（accept_suggestion，​行​ 167——​调​ cron.jobs.create_job）​或​拒绝​（dismiss_suggestion，​行​ 161——​按​ dedup_key ​闩​住​，​绝不​重复​骚扰​）。​存储​镜像​ cron/jobs.py ​的​纪律​：​原子​替换​、0600 ​权限​。​关键词​是​ consent-first：​没有​任何​代码​路径​会替​用户​自动​建​任务​。

docs.title: 记事本​：​跨​唤醒​的​游标​与​水印
docs.text:
# cron/notepad.py:1-7
"""Per-job durable KV notepad (cursors, watermarks) carried across cron wake-ups; profile-local
SQLite next to the executions ledger (same connection/pragma pattern as ``cron/executions.py``).

Caps are a documented contract: ``MAX_VALUE_BYTES`` (16 KB per value, UTF-8) and
``MAX_JOB_TOTAL_BYTES`` (64 KB per job, key+value). Oversized writes raise ``ValueError`` and leave
the store untouched — the notepad is prompt-injected each run. Write path is the CLI
(``hermes cron notepad <job_id> set ...``) via the terminal tool; no model tool is added."""

​任务​的​每次​运行​默认​没有​记忆​；notepad ​给​它​一个​持久​ KV（​游标​、​水位​线​、​上次​见​过​的​ id）。​两个​上限​是​文档​契约​：​超限​写入​抛​ ValueError ​且​完全​不​动​ store——​因为​记事本​每次​运行​都​会​注入​ prompt，​一个​ 16KB ​的​值​就​可能​挤占​任务​上下文​。​写​路径​刻意​只有​ CLI（​经​终端​工具​），​不​加​模型​工具​——​这​正是​根​ AGENTS.md「​足迹​阶梯​」​的​体现​：​终端​ + ​文件​已能​完成​的​事​，​不​新增​核心​工具​。render_notepad_section（​行​ 149）​负责​把​内容​渲染​进​ prompt。

docs.title: 遗留​排水​：​证据​永不​删除
docs.text:
# cron/bot_chat_legacy.py:1-7
"""``cron/bot_chat_pending``: Bot Chat outputs whose target owner was not running yet.

``defer`` parks one (a cross-profile target whose gateway is down or still starting), and
the retired CLI lane left records of the same shape behind. Each still-``queued`` record is handed,
under its own id, to the target profile's live owner through the canonical
``tools.bot_live_delivery.deliver_to_live_owner`` door (idempotent per id). Records are
never deleted: they keep their final status as evidence, exactly as the old drain did.
A ``claimed`` record was an uncertain CLI turn and is never resent."""

​退役​通道​的​遗留​记录​被​ scheduler_tick._pre_dispatch_housekeeping（drain_legacy_pending()）​每次​ tick ​顺手​排​走​：​按​记录​自身​ id ​经​规范​投递​门​幂​等​移交​；claimed ​的​记录​曾​是​一次​不​确定​的​ CLI turn，​永不​重​发​。​记录​保留​终态​作为​证据​——​与​ delivery_queue ​的​「​丢失​好过​重复​」​一脉相承​。

docs.title: cron vs ​看​板​派发​：​同​一片​问题​域​的​两条​通道
docs.text:
维度​ cron ​任务​（​本​模块​） ​看​板​任务​（hermes_cli/kanban*） ​触发​ ​时间​（cron/interval/​一次性​） ​看​板​状态​（​任务​变​ ready ​即​派发​） ​存储​ ​每​ profile ​的​ jobs.json ​跨​ worker ​共享​的​ SQLite ​看​板​ ​通道​ ​独立​ cron ​会话​（skip_memory=True） ​派发​器​ spawn ​的​ worker + ​专用​ kanban_* ​工具集​ ​隔离​边界​ profile（home） board ​是​硬​边界​（HERMES_KANBAN_BOARD ​钉进​ env）；tenant ​是​软​命名​空间​ ​交付​ output/ + ​多​平台​投递​ ​任务​状态机​（complete/request-review/…）+ ​经​拥有​ profile ​的​通知​

​看​板​派发​器​是​长​循环​（​默认​ 60s）：​回收​过期​ claim、​提升​ ready ​任务​、​原子​认领​、spawn ​分配​到​的​ profile——​默认​跑​在​网​关内​（kanban.dispatch_in_gateway: true），​独立​部署​用​ plugins/kanban/systemd/hermes-kanban-dispatcher.service。​两条​通道​在​两处​相遇​：cron ​运行​可能​恰好​与​一个​看​板​ worker ​同机​共存​——​所以​看板​的​ prompt ​注入​点​（agent_init、system prompt ​回退​、stop nudge）​用​ agent/delegation_context.py::owned_kanban_task() ​解析​所有权​，​工具​可见​性​（toolset ​里​有​ kanban_show）​与​继承​的​ HERMES_KANBAN_TASK ​环境变量​都​不算​所有权​；​失败​熔断​是​ kanban.failure_limit（​默认​ 2 ​次连续​非​成功​自动​ block），worker ​以​ KANBAN_TERMINAL_PROVIDER_EXIT_CODE（78——​凭据​被​吊销​、​模型​下架​）​退出​时​第一次​就​熔断​且​粘滞​。​看​板​全貌​见​ tutorial/06_cli/kanban.md。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• **hermes_cli/kanban.py*：​看​板​ CLI ​门面​ + 14 ​个​ kanban_*.py ​兄弟​（boards/db/db_connect/db_dispatch/…）；cron ​与​它​共享​「​排队​交给​ agent」​的​问题​域​但​不​共享​代码​。​派发​器​ spawn ​的​ worker ​用​ tools/kanban_tools.py ​的​专用工具​集​（​足迹​阶梯​第​ 3 ​级​：schema ​占位​在​任务​外为​零​）。
  • tools/blueprints.py：​技能​ frontmatter ​里​的​ blueprint: ​块​变成​ blueprint ​来源​的​建议​。
  • tools/bot_live_delivery.py：​遗留​排水​的​规范​投递​门​（​按​ id ​幂​等​）。
  • agent/delegation_context.py：owned_kanban_task() / DELEGATED_CHILD_ENV_MARKER——cron ​与​看板​ worker ​同机​时​的​所有权​判定​与​后代​围栏​（​围栏​是​路径​不是​旗标​）。
  • gateway/kanban_watchers_notifier.py：​看​板​通知​经​任务​拥有​ profile ​的​适配器​发出​，​绝不​走​ multiplexer ​的​启动​适配器​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这一族​文件​回答​「​用户​怎么​从零开始​有​一个​自动化​」：​蓝图​把​ cron ​表达式​藏​进槽​位​、​建议​把​第一个​任务​变成​一键​同意​、​记事本​给​无​状态​的​任务​一个​跨​唤醒​的​游标​、​遗留​排水​保证​退役​通道​不留​悬案​。​它们​全部​汇入​唯一​的​ create_job ​引擎​——​没有​第二套​任务​语义​。​与​看板​的​分工​也​由此​清晰​：cron ​管​时间​驱动​的​重复​，​看板​管​状态​驱动​的​一次性​协作​。

docs.title: 调度​器族​ —— tick ​循环​、​线程​监督​与​多路复用​派发
文件​概览
docs.text: cron/scheduler.py（4,416 ​行​门面​）​负责​「​到​点​了​去​执行​」：tick() ​的​准入​与​派发​在​兄弟​文件​ scheduler_tick.py，​线程​模型​在​ scheduler_thread.py + scheduler_provider.py，​执行​体​（agent ​会话​、​脚本​、​外部​ worker）​与​清理​留在​门面​内​，​投递​在​ scheduler_delivery*.py，​执行​前​检查​在​ scheduler_preflight.py / scheduler_prompt.py。​整族​的​纪律​是​：​门面​保留​调用​点​，​行为​按​主题​下沉​；​所有​兄弟​件​用​ _sched ​晚​绑定​引用​门面​，​让​ monkeypatch ​定义​模块​仍然​生效​。​本篇​走读​ tick ​主干​、​线程​监督​、​多路复用​、headless ​网​关门​、​不​活动​看门狗​与​外部​ worker ​自​举​，​并​给出​全族​文件​清单​。

docs.title: tick()：​准入​即持​锁
docs.text:
# cron/scheduler_tick.py:33-43
def tick(verbose=True, adapters=None, loop=None, sync=True, *, can_dispatch=None,
         headless: bool = False):
    from hermes_cli.backend_retirement import retirement

    # Hold admission through the entire scan/advance/submit handoff. A predicate alone races
    # prepare after the check but before a due job enters the running-job ledger.
    with retirement.work() as admitted:
        if not admitted:
            return 0
        return _tick_admitted(verbose, adapters, loop, sync, can_dispatch=can_dispatch,
                              headless=headless)

tick() ​是​ tick ​的​公共​入口​，​但​真正​的​流程​在​ _tick_admitted()（​行​ 92-204）：​先​做​「​旧​代码​让位​」​检查​（​进程​的​ checkout ​被​ hermes update ​换​过​、​又​有​更​新鲜​的​网关​持有​ runtime ​锁时​抛​ CronTickYielded，​让位​而​不是​用​混合​的​ sys.modules ​跑​任务​），​然后​拿​ <home>/cron/.tick.lock。​随后​的​顺序​非常​关键​：

# cron/scheduler_tick.py:160-167
        # Advance next_run_at for recurring jobs FIRST, under the lock, before any execution
        # (at-most-once). Re-advancing running jobs keeps the grace window alive; mark_job_run
        # overwrites it on completion. Composes with the claim-time advance in claim_job_for_fire.
        due_jobs = _advance_or_drop_recurring(_sched, due_jobs)
        if not due_jobs:
            _sched._sweep_mcp_orphans()
            return 0

​先​推进​ next_run_at、​再​执行​——​这是​「​至多​一次​ occurrence」​不​变量​的​实现​位置​：​中途​崩溃​只会​丢失​一次​执行​，​绝不会​每次​重启​都​重放​。​当​存储​拒绝​写入​（​磁盘​满​/​只读​）​时​ _advance_or_drop_recurring ​只​放行​ one-shot、​跳过​循环​任务​（​行​ 62-72）——​没有​持久​推进​的​循环​任务​一旦​中途​崩溃​必然​重燃​，​跳过​就是​「​至多​一次​」​这​一侧​。

headless=True ​的​ tick（​系统​ crontab ​的​ hermes cron tick）​在​派发​前多​一道​门​：

# cron/scheduler_gateway_gate.py:66-83
def refuse_agent_jobs_without_gateway(due_jobs: list) -> list:
    """Return the due jobs a headless tick may dispatch; agent jobs are held back (skipped, not
    failed) when no ready gateway serves this home. Logs once per tick, not once per job."""
    from hermes_constants import get_hermes_home

    agent_jobs = [job for job in due_jobs if not job.get("no_agent")]
    if not agent_jobs:
        return due_jobs
    home = get_hermes_home().resolve()
    hint = _gateway_unavailable(home)
    if hint is None:
        return due_jobs
    ids = [str(job["id"]) for job in agent_jobs]
    _note_fire_refused(ids, f"Skipped: {hint}")
    logger.warning(
        "Cron tick for %s skipped %d agent job(s) (%s): %s",
        home, len(ids), ", ".join(ids), hint)
    return [job for job in due_jobs if job.get("no_agent")]

​门​的​原则​是​「​拒绝​，​而​不是​孵化​」：run_canonical_job → connect_gateway → ensure_gateway_runtime ​会​孵化​一个​无人​管理​的​网关​守护​进程​，​对​交互​调用者​是​对​的​，​对​ crontab ​的​每分钟​ tick ​是​灾难​。​拒绝​时​ _note_fire_refused（​行​ 48-63）​盖​ last_fire_error、​清掉​ due ​扫描​刚写​的​ pending_slot ​与​派发​标记​——​槽​位​从未​移交​，​不能​留下​会​被​「​恢复​」​的​痕迹​，due ​时刻​保持​不​动​，​网关​回来​后​的​下​一​拍照​常​触发​。

docs.title: 一个​ ticker ​顺序​遍历​所有​ profile
docs.text:
# cron/scheduler_provider.py:539-547
    def _start_multiplex(
        self, stop_event, *, profile_homes, adapters=None, loop=None, interval=60,
        can_dispatch=None, profile_adapters=None, default_profile=None, profile_gate=None,
        profile_bot_platforms=None,
    ):
        """Tick every profile's store, each scoped via ``_profile_cron_scope``. ``profile_gate(name,
        home)``, when given, is consulted every cycle; a rejected profile is neither ticked nor
        heartbeated."""
        from cron.scheduler import tick as cron_tick

_start_multiplex ​是​「Axis B — ​触发器​」​提供者​：​一个​ ticker ​线程​每​周期​在​ _profile_cron_scope(home)（home + secret ​作用域​ + ​终端​作用域​）​内​顺序​ tick ​每个​ served home。​绝不​ N ​线程​——​模块​全局​量​（inflight ​表​、​锁表​）​会​跨​线程​竞争​。​每个​ home ​的​ store ​打开​、​锁​路径​、​失败​计数​、​任务​ env ​构造​、on_session_end ​冲刷​全部​活在​这个​守卫​里​：​曾经​有​一个​在​进入​作用域​之前​打开​的​ store，​把​次要​ profile ​的​运行​记录​写进​了​启动​ profile ​的​ jobs.json。

​每个​ home ​的​恢复​ + ​心跳​彼此​隔离​（​行​ 575-584 ​附近​）：​一个​坏​ store ​不许​拖垮​其他​ profile ​的​启动​；profile ​可能​已​被​删除​，​心跳​绝不​为​已​删​的​ home ​重建​ cron ​工作​区​（#47368）。

docs.title: 线程​监督​：​死​掉​的​ ticker ​会​被​复活
docs.text:
​门面​里​的​每个​守卫​都​能​在​单次​ tick ​失败​时保活​循环​，​但​没有​任何​东西​能​注意​到​「​线程​已经​整个​结束​」——​网关​继续​服务​、ticker_heartbeat ​冻结​、​任务​再也​不​触发​，​直到​重启​（#111010）。​监督者​是​最​外层​：

# cron/scheduler_thread.py:52-64
    def restart_if_dead(self) -> bool:
        """Respawn the ticker when it crashed without ``stop_event``; True when a restart happened."""
        if self._stop_event.is_set() or self._thread.is_alive() or not self._crashed:
            return False
        self.restarts += 1
        logger.error(
            "Cron ticker thread %r died without a stop request; restarting (restart #%d). Scheduled jobs "
            "did not fire while it was down — check errors.log for the escaping exception.",
            self._name, self.restarts,
        )
        self._thread = self._spawn()
        self._thread.start()
        return True

​只有​「​带​着​异常​逃出​ target」​才​算​死​（_crashed ​标记​）：​外部​提供者​的​ start()（Chronos）​武装​远程​一次性​触发​后​按​设计​返回​，​那​是​活着​的​ ticker，​不是​尸体​。​监督​按​ served home ​一份​，​不是​按​进程​一份​。

docs.title: 不​活动​看门狗​：​按​空闲​时间​，​不​按​墙钟
docs.text:
# cron/scheduler.py:1186-1199
def _cron_inactivity_seconds() -> float:
    """..."""

_run_agent_with_watchdog（​行​ 1937）​用​ agent/session_activity.AwakeIdleMeter ​测​ agent ​的​空闲​时间​：​默认​ 600s ​空闲​即​硬​中断​（HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT ​覆盖​，0 = ​无限​）。​空闲​时间​而​不是​墙钟​意味着​：​卡死​的​会​话​被​掐掉​、​不能​独占​调度​器​；​长​但​活跃​的​任务​（​一直​在​产​ token）​永不​被​误杀​。​随行​脚本​（​预跑​脚本​或​ no_agent=True ​的​任务​）​由​脚本​超时​（_DEFAULT_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT，3600s）​单独​封顶​。​看门狗​与​ scheduler_liveness.py ​读​同一个​信号​、​作用​于​两条​边​：​看门狗​在​空闲​越​限时​中断​；​进度​戳​在​空闲​保持​短时​刷新​ progress_at——​所以​「​健康​拥有者​ vs ​僵尸​」​的​判定​是​「​自​上次​戳​以来​的​沉默​」，​而​不是​「​运行​时​长​」（#115692）。

docs.title: 外部​ worker ​自己​完成​依赖​自​举
docs.text:
​重启​安全​的​ worker ​是​ sys.executable -m cron.scheduler --external-worker-file …——​一个​完整​ Hermes ​入口​，​但​ hermes_bootstrap ​只​在​其​ __main__ ​里​跑​，​而​ -m ​先​执行​的​是​包​本身​：

# cron/__init__.py:7-9
# The restart-safe external worker runs as ``-m cron.scheduler``, which executes this package
# first: boot PM dependencies before ``cron.jobs`` reaches a third-party import. A no-op
# unless ``_launch_external_cron_worker`` marked this process. See cron/worker_bootstrap.py.
from cron.worker_bootstrap import worker_bootstrap as _boot_external_worker

_boot_external_worker()

scheduler_worker_env.py ​只是​把​ committed ​代​的​ site-packages ​钉​回子​进程​ PYTHONPATH——​钉住​路径​不​等于​租用​：​没有​租约​，PM ​收集器​可以​在​网关​退出​后​删掉​那​一代​（#122290）。worker_bootstrap()（cron/worker_bootstrap.py:49-55）​调​ pm.environments.activate_dependencies——​正是​ hermes_bootstrap ​为​其他​入口​做​的​同一个​调用​——​租用​该代​、​执行​ .pth ​文件​、​在​任何​第三方​ import ​之前​激活​。​激活​失败​是​致命​的​：worker ​在​所有权​ ack ​之前​退出​（​这会​被​上报​为​一次​派发​失败​），​而​不是​跑​在​无​租约​的​一代​上​等​收集器​删除​。​网关​自己​绝不​重跑​这个​自​举​（#122222）。​依赖​自举​只​覆盖​依赖​；finish_worker_boot()（​行​ 58-67）​在​ __main__ ​里​跑​ hermes_bootstrap（​可能​因​源码​更新​ re-launch ​整个​ worker），​之后​才​读​ payload、​摘​标记​——​恢复​/​重​执行​必须​重​放​整个​ worker，​绝不能​「ack ​之后​ payload ​没​了​、​依赖​没​启动​」。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数
docs.text: 符号​ ​位置​ ​职责​ tick() scheduler_tick.py:33 tick ​公共​入口​；retirement.work() ​内持​准入​ _tick_admitted() scheduler_tick.py:92 ​让位​ gate → tick ​锁​ → ​预​派发​清扫​ → due ​扫描​ → ​先​推进​后​派发​ _advance_or_drop_recurring() scheduler_tick.py:62 ​存储​拒绝​时​只​放行​ one-shot（​至多​一次​侧​） refuse_agent_jobs_without_gateway() scheduler_gateway_gate.py:66 headless tick ​拒绝​ agent ​任务​而​非​孵化​网关​ _note_fire_refused() scheduler_gateway_gate.py:48 ​盖​ last_fire_error、​清​ pending_slot/run_claim _start_multiplex() scheduler_provider.py:539 ​单​ ticker ​顺序​遍历​ served homes，_profile_cron_scope ​逐个​绑定​ SupervisedTickerThread scheduler_thread.py:19 restart_if_dead ​复活​带​异常​逃出​的​ ticker _profile_cron_scope() scheduler_provider.py:119 per-tick home/secret/terminal ​作用域​ ContextVar _inflight_key() scheduler.py:581 (home key, job id)——​一个​进程​ tick N ​个​ home，​任务​ id ​不​唯一​ try_register_running_job() / release_running_job() scheduler.py:796/826 inflight ​认领​/​释放​（​释放​须传​注册​ home） sweep_stale_inflight() scheduler.py:1035 ​按​沉默​时间​强制​释放​泄漏​的​ claim _cron_inactivity_seconds() scheduler.py:1186 ​看门狗​上限​（​默认​ 600s，HERMES_CRON_TIMEOUT） _run_agent_with_watchdog() scheduler.py:1937 ​空闲​超限​ → ​硬​中断​ cron ​会话​ _launch_external_cron_worker() scheduler.py:3602 spawn ​重启​安全​外部​ worker，​钉​ PYTHONPATH + ​置​ _HERMES_CRON_WORKER_BOOT owns_cron_tick_for() / live_gateway_ticking() scheduler_ownership.py 「​谁​拥有​某​ home ​的​ tick」​两个​谓词​（​探测​失败​一律​答​「​否​」） register_ticked_homes() scheduler_ownership.py ​每​ cycle ​重​发布​ tick ​集合​并​回收​离开​ home ​的​线程​池

docs.title: 本组​文件​清单
docs.text:
文件​ ​角色​ ​关键​符号​ cron/scheduler.py ​门面​：​执行​体​、inflight ​簿记​、​清理​ tick ​调用​点​, _inflight_key, _run_agent_with_watchdog, _launch_external_cron_worker cron/scheduler_tick.py tick ​准入​ + ​派发​顺序​ tick, _tick_admitted, _advance_or_drop_recurring cron/scheduler_thread.py ​监督​线程​ SupervisedTickerThread.restart_if_dead cron/scheduler_provider.py ​触发器​提供者​ + ​多路复用​ _start_multiplex, _profile_cron_scope cron/scheduler_ownership.py tick ​所有权​谓词​ + ticked home ​集合​回收​ owns_cron_tick_for, register_ticked_homes cron/scheduler_gateway_gate.py headless tick ​的​网​关门​ refuse_agent_jobs_without_gateway cron/scheduler_authority.py ​传输层​执行​；output/​投递​仍​在​派发​方​ reconcile_pending, pause_for_unknown cron/scheduler_bookkeeping.py ​终局​簿记​ fail_empty_response, finish_interrupted_run cron/scheduler_delivery.py ​投递​目标​解析​ + ​各​发送​通道​ _deliver_result, transcript mirroring cron/scheduler_delivery_origin.py origin ​的​ relay ​出站​判别​器​ stamp_origin_discriminators cron/scheduler_delivery_room.py deliver: room:<id>[@<profile>] ​群聊​房间​投递​ ​房间​日志​追加​ cron/scheduler_detached_worker.py ​超时​后​仍​存活​的​ worker ​的​回收​ _close_late_session_db_result cron/scheduler_diagnostics.py ​私有​运行​文档​诊断​（​脱敏​） format_run_error, external_worker_stderr_tail cron/scheduler_failure_copy.py ​一行​失败​通知​的话​术​ cron_output_dir_display cron/scheduler_liveness.py ​看门狗​循环​ + ​进度​戳​ ​空闲​信号​双​边缘​ cron/scheduler_preflight.py ​派发​前​检查​ + ​共享​路由​适配器​视图​ _is_transient_provider_resolve_error, SharedRouteAdapters cron/scheduler_prompt.py prompt ​组装​ + ​注入​/​渗出​守卫​ context_from ​注入​, ​扫描​守卫​ cron/scheduler_script.py ​预跑​脚本​执行​ + claim ​心跳​ ​超时​/​进程​树​终止​ cron/scheduler_worker_env.py ​外部​ worker ​的​ import ​路径​ committed site-packages ​钉​回​ cron/scheduler_worker_failure.py worker ​死亡​后​的​不​确定​结果​投影​ record_unknown_worker_outcome cron/scheduler_worktree_maintenance.py worktree ​清扫​的​进程​级​串行化​ ​一扫​一时间​、​一​ repo ​一​区间​ cron/worker_bootstrap.py ​外部​ worker ​的​ PM ​依赖​自​举​ worker_bootstrap, finish_worker_boot, WORKER_MARKER

（cron/constants.py、env_settings.py ​与​任务​存储​族​在​ jobs.md ​清单​；​面向用户​的​蓝图​/​建议​族​在​ kanban_dispatcher.md ​清单​。）

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• gateway/run.py：_cron_tick_profile_homes（​行​ 1654）​决定​宿主​进程​ tick ​哪些​ home（served ​集​ + ​活动​ profile，​与​ gateway.multiplex_profiles ​无关​——​该​旗标​管​适配器​，​不管​ tick ​集合​）；_cron_profile_gate（​行​ 1672）​让位​给​跑​自己​网关​的​ profile，liveness PID ​与​ os.getpid() ​比较​。
  • pm/：​外部​ worker ​经​ activate_dependencies ​租用​ committed ​代​。
  • agent/：cron ​会话​是​独立​ AIAgent；agent/estop.check_paused ​在​ tick ​里​被​查询​；agent/session_activity.AwakeIdleMeter ​是​看门狗​信号源​。
  • tools/：​任务​崩溃​遗留​的​ MCP stdio ​孤儿​由​ tick ​里​的​ _sweep_mcp_orphans ​回收​。
  • hermes_cli/cron.py：hermes cron tick ​调​ tick(headless=True)（​默认​ headless ​拒绝​；hermes cron run ​与​进程​内​ ticker ​不​ headless）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​调度​器族​的​核心​顺序​是​三句话​：​准入​先​让位​、​派发​先​推进​、​执行​先自举​。​让位​ gate ​保证​旧​代码​不​混合​执行​；「​先​推进​ next_run_at ​再​执行​」​把​崩溃​的​代价​从重​放降​为​丢失​一次​；​外部​ worker ​在​任何​第三方​ import ​前​租用​依赖​代​。​单​ ticker ​多路复用​ + inflight ​双元​组键​，​则​是​「​一个​进程​服务​多个​ profile」​这​条​仓库​级​不​变量​在​ cron ​里​的​全部​投影​。

docs.title: pm/ ​模块​总览​ —— ​依赖​管理器​与​ Hermes ​环境
文件​概览
docs.text: pm/ ​是​ Hermes ​的​「PackageManager」：​它​拥有​全部​ Hermes Python ​依赖​变更​——​用​裸​ pip/uv ​改​ Hermes ​环境​是​被​禁止​的​（​根​ AGENTS.md ​铁律​）。​对​使用者​它​暴露​为​ hermes pm CLI（pm/cli.py）：lock（​从​ pyproject.toml ​重锁​ uv.lock；--bump ​把​工具​钉进​ pm/lock.json）、install、env（​打印​已装包​组合​的​环境​）、doctor（​对​ lockfile ​校验​安装​态​）、repair（​按​记录​环境​重建​、​不​改图​）、environment、gc（​清无​引用​ store ​条目​）、bundle（​暂存​ repo+store+facts+​可​迁移​ venv payload）、status（​机器​可​读​同步​回执​）、update（​解析​最新​、​重钉​）。​内部​三层​结构​清晰​：​内容​寻址​ store（pm/store.py）​管​下载​与​发布​；​每​项目​ venv「​代​」（pm/environments.py）​管选代​与​激活​；uv ​引擎​（pm/environment.py）​管​工具​路由​、​隔离​与​命令​执行​。​本篇​是​第​ 11 ​章​总览​；environments.md ​深讲​ store/​代​/registry/​引擎​，pinning_policy.md ​讲钉版​政策​与​ lock/update。

docs.title: 数据流​全景​（ASCII）
docs.text:
pyproject.toml（>=floor,<next_major ​上限​）
        │  hermes pm lock  （Hermes ​锁定​时才​带​ exclude-newer="3 days"）
        ▼
  uv.lock（​版本​+​哈希​，​机器​写​）◄──── CI lock ​检查​
        │  hermes pm install / activate ​同步​
        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ PM store（​内容​寻址​，​机器​级​）：​下载​→​校验​ sha256→​解包​→​原子​发布​  │
│  store.py: ALL_TARGETS / current_target() / hash_url()      │
│  downloader.py: ​可续​传​、​多​连接​、​哈希​验证​                     │
│  artifact_mirror.py + artifact-mirror.json: ​复核​过​的​二进制​   │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ <root>/installs/<install_key>/environments/<gen>            │
│  「​代​」= ​一次​完整​解析​出​的​ venv；facts.json ​记录​ committed ​选择​ │
│  environments.py: install_key / committed_venv /            │
│                   activate_dependencies（​租用​该代​）          │
└───────────────┬───────────────────────────┬───────────────┘
                ▼                           ▼
      ./activate（​开发者​ shell）     cron ​外部​ worker ​自​举​
      PM activate_dependencies      cron/worker_bootstrap.py
      ​重​放​ .pth、​改​ sys.path/PATH    → ​同一个​ activate_dependencies

  ​消费者​：activate ​脚本​、hermes ​启动器​（launch.py）、cron worker、
          build_env/build_operations（CI ​构建​）、testenv（​测试环境​）

docs.title: 「​调用者​拿到​解释器​或​工具​路径​，​不是​ uv」
docs.text:
pm/operations.py ​的​ docstring ​是​整包​的​钥匙​：

Callers describe a dependency graph and its lifetime, never a uv command. Only the private environment engine knows how to obtain or invoke uv.

​也就是说​ pm.build_environment / pm.ensure_environment / pm.sync_venv([...]) ​这​类​公共​ API ​描述​要​什么​，pm.environment.py ​才​知道​怎么​跑​ uv（​含​ uv ​本身​也​是​ store ​里​的​一个​被​钉​版​工具​，pm/_uv.py）。​这个​边界​让​ Nix ​的​声明​式​ uv2nix ​构建​与​用户​自己​的​项目​保持​独立​所有权​——PM ​从不​碰​别人​的​环境​。

docs.title: 机器​事实​的​三条​纪律​（​与​ hermes_platform ​呼应​）
docs.text: PM ​在​应用​可​导入​之前​就要​跑​，​所以​它​对​宿主​的​判断​自带​一​小组​只读​事实​，​且​遵守​同样​纪律​：pm/store.py::_native_machine()（​行​ 38-83）​优先​问​ hermes_platform.host.facts.native_arch()；PM ​独立​引导​运行​时里​没有​ hermes_platform ​时​，​才​直接​问​ OS——macOS ​用​ sysctl.proc_translated、Windows ​用​ IsWow64Process2，​因为​ Rosetta ​与​ WOW64 ​下​ Python ​进程​会​报错​架构​，​选错​ target triple ​就​装错​ artifact。libc ​风味​（glibc/musl/bionic）​也​是​ target triple ​的​一部分​：_is_bionic_libs（​行​ 86-102）​是​全​仓库​唯一​探测​ bionic ​的​地方​。

docs.title: 谁​在​什么​时候​调​ PM
docs.text:
调用​方​ ​入口​ ​语义​ ​开发者​ shell ./activate（fish/PowerShell ​变体​） ​同步​开发​环境​到​ lock；--test-extras ​换​测试​集​ scripts/run-in-hermes-env ACTIVATION_INPUTS mtime ​戳​ ​戳​变​了​才​重新​同步​（​省​启动​时间​） cron ​外部​ worker cron/worker_bootstrap.py → activate_dependencies ​租用​ committed ​代​、​重​放​ .pth，​之后​才能​ import ​第三方​ hermes update PM ​的​依赖​腿​ ​重钉​ + ​安装​ + ​刷​ venv + plugin eviction CI ​构建​ pm.build_env --source . --check-lock ​与​ pm lock ​同​一套​操作​（​隔离​设置​不​漂移​） ​插件​安装​ pm.publication/plugin_eviction ​安装​锁内​快照​与​发布​；​更新期​插件​不​适配​则​驱逐​

​这些​调用​面​的​共同点​是​：​调用者​描述​目标​状态​，PM ​决定​路径​。​没有​人​直接​跑​ uv sync；​因此​隔离​设置​（exclude-newer、workspace、​缓存​策略​）​只​存在​一份​实现​。

docs.title: 十个​ CLI ​动词
docs.text:
# pm/cli.py:1
"""hermes pm: lock / install / repair / env / doctor / gc / bundle."""

​动词​表​（pm/cli.py:966-1059 ​的​ argparse ​注册​）：lock（​无参​ = ​从​ pyproject ​重锁​；--bump <name> <version> = ​解析​每个​ target ​的​归档​、​哈希​、​写​ pm/lock.json）、install（​默认​装​全部​必需​ + ​可​选​默认​）、env、doctor、repair（​重建​记录​环境​、​不​改图​）、environment、gc、bundle、status（​打印​最近​一次​同步​回执​）、update。​改完​ pyproject.toml ​的​工作​流​固定​为​：hermes pm lock → ​重新​ source ./activate → pyproject.toml ​与​ uv.lock ​一起​提交​（_relock_project，​行​ 31-71，​还会​提示​新​引入​的​ opt-in extra ​需要​ --test-extras）。

docs.title: 磁盘​上​的​文件​布局
docs.text:
<​数据​根​>/                          ← dependency_home_root()（​尊重​ HERMES_HOME ​覆盖​）
├── installs/
│   └── <install_key>/            ← checkout ​路径​哈希​（sha256 ​前​ 16 ​位​）
│       ├── facts.json            ← ​安装​态​：committed venv ​选择​ + {{store}} ​模板​ env
│       ├── inputs/               ← ACTIVATION_INPUTS ​的​ mtime ​戳​ + .project-root ​记录​
│       ├── environments/<gen>/   ← ​一代代​完整​解析​出​的​ venv
│       └── testenv/              ← ​测试​ side environment（dev+test ​组​）
├── tools/                        ← store ​的​工具​目录​（hermes launcher exec ​的​解释器​住​这里​）
└── logs/update_receipts/         ← pm.receipt ​与​ update ​回执​共用​目录​（kind ​区分​）

​仓库​内​：
pm/lock.json                      ← ​被​管理工具​（node/uv/ffmpeg/…）​的​版本​ + ​每​ target SHA
pm/uv.lock                        ← PM ​运行​时​自身​的​锁​
pyproject.toml / uv.lock          ← ​应用​依赖​（PM ​的​ lock ​动词​管辖​）

docs.title: 两个​ lock ​文件​、​两种​承诺
docs.text:
文件​ ​回答​ ​谁​写​ ​谁​读​ pyproject.toml + uv.lock Python ​依赖图​（​版本​ + ​哈希​） ​人​编辑​ pyproject；hermes pm lock ​机器​重锁​ hermes pm install、CI lock ​检查​、workspace ​构建​ pm/lock.json ​被​管理工具​的​每​ target ​归档​ URL + sha256 hermes pm lock --bump pm/install.py ​的​ ensure()、nix（​纯​数据​读取​） facts.json ​这台​机器​实际​装​了​什么​ ​每次​ PM ​安装​ doctor/repair/selected_venv/activate_dependencies

​三层​里​最​容易​被​忽略​的​是​ facts.json：​它​是​「​选择​记录​」​也​是​「​完成​标记​」——​只有​在​ flush_before_selecting() ​的​全盘​ sync ​之后​才​写​，​所以​读​它​ = ​信任​一个​已​完整​落盘​的​代​（​详见​ environments.md）。

docs.title: 本组​文档​导航
docs.text: 文档​ ​内容​ environments.md store（​内容​寻址​/9 ​个​ target/​哈希​ URL）、venv「​代​」（install_key/committed ​选择​/​租用​）、registry、uv ​引擎​；install/worker/build/download/artifact_mirror ​组​清单​ pinning_policy.md ​上限​政策​（>=floor,<next_major；pre-1.0 <0.(minor+2)）、git SHA ​钉​、release-age ​隔离​只​在​锁定​时​生效​、lock.py/update.py/uv_cache_health/prune + ​其余​全部​文件​清单

docs.title: 阅读​顺序​建议
docs.text:
​第一次​读​ pm/ ​推荐​按​依赖​方向​走​：index.md（​本篇​，​建​全景​）→ environments.md（store/​代​/​引擎​的​机械​层​）→ pinning_policy.md（​政策​层​）。​三个​反复​出现​的​概念​贯穿​始终​，​先​在​此​定义​：

  • target triple：win32-x64、linux-arm64-musl、darwin-arm64……​九个​取值​（pm/store.ALL_TARGETS）。OS + ​架构​ + libc ​的​组合​，​一个包​为​它​服务​的​每个​ target ​各留​一行​ lock ​表项​。
  • 「​代​」（generation）：​一次​完整​解析​出​的​ venv ​快照​，​住​在​ <root>/installs/<install_key>/environments/<gen>/。facts.json ​指向​ committed ​的​那​一棵​；​进程​启动​时​租用​它​（​收集器​不删​有​租约​的​代​）。
  • receipt（​回执​）：​每次​ venv ​同步​写​一条​机器​可​读​记录​（​与​ hermes update ​的​回执​同​ schema ​同​目录​），hermes pm status ​与​桌面​ IPC ​是​它​的​读者​。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• activate ​脚本​（./activate）​调​ PM ​同步​开发​环境​；scripts/run-in-hermes-env ​按​ ACTIVATION_INPUTS（uv.lock/pyproject.toml/setup.py/pm/lock.json）​的​ mtime ​戳​决定​是否​重新​同步​。
  • cron/：​外部​ worker ​经​ cron/worker_bootstrap.py → pm.environments.activate_dependencies ​在​任何​第三方​ import ​前​租用​ committed ​代​。
  • hermes_platform/：native_arch() ​是​ target triple ​的​权威​来源​（PM ​独立​运行​时​缺该​包时​才​自行​降级​探测​）。
  • acp_adapter/：hermes acp --setup-browser ​经​ pm.ensure("chromium", explicit=True) ​装​ PM ​钉版​的​ Chromium。
  • hermes_cli/：hermes update ​是​ PM ​的​大​消费者​（​依赖​腿​、plugin_eviction）；hermes_cli/runtime_state.py ​提供​ runtime ​锁​与​代​租用​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: pm/ ​的​核心​契约​有​三条​：​一切​依赖​变更​走​ PM（​可​审计​、​可重​放​、​可回收​）；​调用者​描述​图​、​不​描述​命令​（uv ​是​私有​引擎​细节​）；​选择​即​承诺​（facts.json ​的​ committed ​记录​在​ flush_before_selecting ​的​全盘​ sync ​之后​写入​，​选中​的​「​代​」​必然​已​完整​落盘​）。​这三条​撑起​了​「​升级​不碎​环境​、worker ​不死于​收集器​」​的​一系列​下游​不​变量​。

docs.title: store、venv「​代​」​与​ uv ​引擎​ —— PM ​的​环境​机器
文件​概览
docs.text: ​本篇​深讲​ PM ​的​三个​机械​层​：​内容​寻址​ store（pm/store.py——​下载​、​校验​、​解包​、​原子​发布​）、​每​项目​ venv「​代​」（pm/environments.py——install_key、committed ​选择​、activate_dependencies ​租用​）、uv ​私有​引擎​（pm/environment.py——​工具​路由​、​隔离​、​命令​执行​、​解析器​错误​分类​），​以及​把​它们​串​起来​的​ registry.py（​包​注册表​与​依赖​行走​）。​文末​清单​覆盖​ install/worker/build/download/artifact_mirror ​五个​组​。

docs.title: store：​九个​ target、​一个​哈希​契约
docs.text:
# pm/store.py:24-35
ALL_TARGETS = (
    "win32-x64",
    "win32-arm64",
    "linux-x64",
    "linux-arm64",
    "linux-x64-musl",
    "linux-arm64-musl",
    "linux-arm64-bionic",
    "darwin-x64",
    "darwin-arm64",
)
MUSL_TARGETS = frozenset({"linux-x64-musl", "linux-arm64-musl"})

​每个​包为​它​服务​的​ target ​各留​一行​ lock ​表项​（pm/lock.py ​顶部​ schema：packages.name.artifacts[target] = {"url", "sha256"}）；target ​无关​的​ artifact（​如​ npm tarball）​折叠为​ "any"。current_target()（​行​ 152）​由​ OS/​架构​/libc ​三要素​决定​；hash_url()（​行​ 171）​给​ pm lock --bump ​现场​哈希​归档​。​发布​是​原子​的​：publish()（​行​ 450）​从​暂存​目录​改名​进​ store，published()（​行​ 391）​判​存在​。

docs.title: 「​代​」：install_key ​与​ committed ​选择
docs.text:
# pm/environments.py:20-22
def install_key(project_root: Path) -> str:
    canonical = str(Path(project_root).resolve())
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]

​依赖​状态​按​数据​根分域​：<root>/installs/<install_key>/（installs_root()，​行​ 33；dependency_home_root() ​行​ 25 ​尊重​ HERMES_HOME ​覆盖​）。​一个​ checkout ​的​ launch ​可能​被​别的​根​「​借用​」（​测试​的​临时​ HERMES_HOME、​每​任务​ home）——owning_home_root()（​行​ 41-72）​用​ checkout ​自己​的​ hermes launcher ​反查​真正​拥有​状态​的​根​：​只有​ owner ​发布​ launcher，​且​它​ exec ​的​解释器​指向​ owner ​的​ store。

​选择​记录​在​ facts.json：

# pm/environments.py:297-305
def committed_venv(project_root: Path) -> Path | None:
    """The environment PM committed for this install (or a sealed payload's own), else ``None``.

    Unlike ``selected_venv`` this never answers with the in-tree ``venv``/``.venv``: that tree
    predates PM and is built for whichever interpreter created it, so loading it from PM's store
    Python mixes ABIs (compiled modules vanish). PM never deletes it: ``legacy_selection`` reads its
    site-packages again whenever this install has no dependency facts."""

selected_venv（​行​ 285）= committed ​或​首次​同步​前​的​原始​安装​；committed ​记录​损坏​是​错误​而​不是​「​悄悄​回退​旧​依赖​集​」​的​许可​。flush_before_selecting()（​行​ 263-282）​在​写​选择​记录​前​做​一次​文件系统​级​ sync：​记录​是​「​代​」​的​完成​标记​，​必须​先​保证​它​担保​的​每个​文件​已落盘​——​否则​断电​可能​选中​半成品​ venv（Windows ​无​ os.sync，​记录​的​原子​写​是​唯一​保证​，NTFS ​只​ journal ​元​数据​）。

docs.title: activate_dependencies：​启动​时​的​代​租用
docs.text:
# pm/environments.py:464-513（​节选​）
def activate_dependencies(project_root: Path) -> None:
    """Select the committed tree at process boot, before third-party imports.

    A process with no extension selection keeps its original launch contract.
    Already-running processes are never switched after a dependency install.
    """
    ...
        with runtime_lock(project_root) as held:
            if held:
                recover_publication(project_root)
            environment = committed_venv(project_root)
            if environment is None:
                return _require_own_dependencies(project_root)
            release = lease_generation(environment)
            # Without the lock, an installer may commit a new generation between the
            # read and the lease, leaving the leased one unselected and collectable.
            while not held and (current := committed_venv(project_root)) not in (None, environment):
                release()
                environment, release = current, lease_generation(current)

​三个​细节​值得​停顿​。​租用​：​拿到​ committed ​路径​后​ lease_generation ​租用​它​——PM ​收集器​不删​有​租约​的​代​（cron ​外部​ worker ​活​下来​的​关键​）。​无锁​重读​循环​：​没有​持锁​时​，​安装者​可能​在​「​读​选择​」​与​「​租用​」​之间​提交​新代​，​循环​保证​租​的​永远​是​最新​ committed。sys.path ​重写​（​行​ 506-513）：​先​剔掉​旧​ site-packages ​与​项目​根​，site.addsitedir ​让​ uv editable ​成员​的​ .pth ​生效​，​再​把​项目​根与​ selected ​置顶​，​并​同步​改​ PYTHONPATH/PATH——venv ​里​的​ hermes console script ​是​构建​时​快照​的​ editable ​安装​（#124627），​子​进程​解析​ hermes ​必须​先​命中​ checkout ​自己​的​ launcher。_require_own_dependencies（​行​ 450-461）：PM ​的​裸​ store Python ​若​没有​ committed ​代​，​宁可​抛​ NoCommittedEnvironment（​只有​ hermes pm repair ​能修​）​也​不​跑​在​继承​来​的​ PYTHONPATH ​上​。

docs.title: registry：​注册​即​发现​，​懒​加载​内置​表
docs.text:
# pm/registry.py:19-39
_BUILTIN_MODULES = ("pm.packages", "pm.security_packages")


def _builtins_loaded() -> dict[str, Package]:
    """Register the built-in definitions on first read, not on ``import pm``.

    Process boot imports ``pm.environments`` before any dependency is importable;
    pulling the whole package catalogue (downloader, network) in with it would
    cost every launch ~40ms and break the stripped payloads that ship only the
    pre-import files.
    """
    for module in _BUILTIN_MODULES:
        if module not in sys.modules:
            importlib.import_module(module)
    return _packages


def register(cls):
    instance = cls()
    if not instance.name:
        raise ValueError("package has no name")
    _packages[instance.name] = instance
    return cls

pm.packages（1,424 ​行​）​与​ pm.security_packages ​以​ @register ​类​注册​每个​被​管理工具​；​版本​与​哈希​住​在​ lock.json，​定义​文件​里​一个​版本​数字​都​没有​（pm/package.py docstring）。get_package/source_install_packages/tool_roots（pm/registry.py）​是​查询​面​。​懒​加载​的​原因​写​在​注释​里​：​进程​引导​时​ pm.environments ​先于​一切​依赖​被​ import，​把​整个​目录​（downloader、network）​拖进来​会​让​每次​启动​多付​ ~40ms、​并​压垮​只带​ pre-import ​文件​的​精简​ payload。

docs.title: uv ​引擎​：​隔离​与​错误​分类
docs.text:
# pm/environment.py:35-46
# Deliberately narrow: a fetch timeout or index outage must not be misread as a
# conflict — and regardless of classification, nothing here ever disables a
# plugin; the caller decides. Lives here (stdlib-only imports) because the
# bootstrap runner streams uv output from a pre-3.11 system python where
# pm.workspace's tomllib import cannot load.
_RESOLVER_MARKERS = (
    "no solution found",
    "conflicting requirements",
    "conflicting urls",
    "because only the following versions",
    "and your pyproject depends on",
)

​引擎​只认​这​几行​ uv ​输出​为​「​解析​冲突​」（ResolutionConflict）——fetch ​超时​/​索引​故障​不得​误读​为​冲突​；​且​无论​分类​结果​如何​，​这里​永不​禁用​插件​，​调用者​决定​（​配合​ pm/plugin_eviction.py）。​流式​输出​只留​末尾​ 2000 ​字符​，​标记​会​被​缝​回​（_STREAM_TAIL_MARKERS ​行​ 72）——​字节​码​编译​失败​与​原生​构建​失败​的​标记​也​得​走​同​一条​缝​，​否则​修复​路径​看不到​重试​信号​。​损坏​缓存​的​恢复​有​界​：_CACHE_RECOVERY_ROUNDS = 3，​每轮​必须​点名​一个​之前​没清过​的​包​——​这是​「​缓存​里​多处​损坏​」​的​上界​，​不是​对​一个​坏​ wheel ​的​死循环​。​环境​隔离​上​，PM ​剥掉​环境​中​所有​ UV_*（​防止​调用者​的​ uv ​设置​劫持​操作​），​只有​索引​/​传输​旋钮​被​ index_config.py ​显式​转发​（​镜像​/​气隙​网络​需要​）。

• cron/worker_bootstrap.py：activate_dependencies ​是​外部​ worker ​自举​的​全部内容​——​租约​让​ PM ​收集器​绕开​活着​的​ worker。
  • hermes_cli/runtime_state.py：runtime ​锁​、​发布​恢复​、lease_generation ​的​实现​方​；environments.py ​只​消费​。
  • hermes_platform.host.facts：native_arch() ​权威​；store ​自带​降级​探测​仅​用于​ PM ​独立​引导​。
  • plugin ​体系​：plugins_state.py ​读全​ profile ​启用​集​ → workspace ​成员​；plugin_eviction.py ​决定​「​插件​不再​适配​时​更新​继续​」。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这​一层​的​读法​是​「​三个​不动点​」：store ​的​每个​ artifact ​都​有​ sha256 ​且​按​ target ​定位​；「​代​」​的​选择​记录​是​完成​标记​、​租约​是​生命周期​凭证​；uv ​引擎​的​错误​分类​刻意​窄​、​插件​决策​永远​外移​。activate_dependencies ​把​三者​接成​一个​原子​动作​——​选中​即​租用​，​租用​即可​活​——cron worker、activate shell、sealed payload ​三条​入口​共享​同一个​实现​。

docs.title: 钉版​政策​与​ lock/update —— ​上限​、SHA ​与​ release-age ​隔离
文件​概览
docs.text: PM ​拥有​依赖​变更​的​同时​，​也​拥有​钉版​政策​：​全部​依赖​带​上限​、git ​依赖​钉​ 40 ​位​ SHA、release-age ​检查​只​在​ Hermes ​锁定​时​生效​。​本篇​走读​ lock.py（lockfile ​与​安装​态​文件​的​ schema）、update.py（​解析​最新​并重​钉​）、uv_cache_health.py / uv_cache_prune.py（​缓存​守护​），​并​把​政策​里​剩下​的​支持​文件​（recovery/receipt/launch/runtime/…/plugin_*）​全部列​册​。

docs.title: lock.json ​与​ facts.json：​机器​接口
docs.text:
# pm/lock.py:1-16（docstring ​节选​）
"""The lockfile (versions + hashes, machine-written) and the installed-state
file (what is actually on this machine).

lock.json:  {"schema": 1, "packages": {name: {"version": ..., "artifacts": {target: {"url": ..., "sha256": ...}}}}}
facts.json: {"schema": 1, "packages": {name: {"entry": ..., "version": ..., "env": ..., "stamp": ...}}}

A target's value is one {"url", "sha256"} object, or a LIST of them when the
package is split across several archives that must land in one directory
(llama.cpp's engine zip and its cudart zip: Windows resolves a DLL from the
loading executable's own directory). Both shapes read back as a list.

lock.json artifacts carry the RESOLVED url beside the hash: the lockfile is
the complete machine interface (nix reads it as pure data), and the python
url templates are consulted only at `pm lock --bump` time.

facts.json env values hold {{store}} templates so a CI-built file adopts onto
any machine by substitution.
"""

​两个​文件​、​两种​承诺​：lock.json ​是​「​应该​装​什么​」（​版本​+​每​ target ​的​ URL+SHA，​机器​写人​只读​），facts.json ​是​「​实际​装​了​什么​」——env ​值带​ {{store}} ​模板​，CI ​机器​构建​的​安装​态​可以​按​替换​ adopt ​到​任何​机器​。​这​就是​ hermes pm doctor（​对​ lockfile ​校验​安装​态​）​与​ hermes pm repair（​按​记录​环境​重建​、​不​改图​）​的​依据​。

docs.title: 上限​政策​：Shai-Hulud ​的​教训
docs.text: ​政策​全文​（pm/AGENTS.md）​的​数字​都​有​出处​：PyPI ​依赖​ >=floor,<next_major（"httpx>=0.28.1,<1"）；pre-1.0 ​用​ <0.(minor+2)（>=0.29,<0.32）；git URL ​钉​ 40 ​位​ commit SHA；GitHub Actions ​钉​ SHA + # vN ​注释​；CI-only requirements ​用​ ==exact。​裸​ >=X.Y.Z ​会​被​ CI ​和​评审​直接​拒绝​。​背景​是​ litellm ​事件​（#2796/#2810）​与​ 2026 ​年​ 5 ​月​的​ Mini Shai-Hulud ​蠕虫​——​无​上限​的​ >= ​意味着​上游​任意​一次​发布​都​会​自动​进入​你​的​供应链​。

docs.title: release-age ​隔离​：​只​属于​锁定​者
docs.text:
# pm/workspace.py:184-194
def _without_release_age(text: str) -> str:
    """Drop ``[tool.uv] exclude-newer`` from a generated root's pyproject text.

    The lock already holds checked versions; on the user's machine the cutoff only gates the
    build tools uv fetches for source builds (setuptools for Hermes itself), and a mirror that
    serves no upload times rejects all of them (#135589). Text-level so the pre-3.11 bootstrap
    python, which has no tomllib, can run it.
    """
    import re

    return re.sub(r"(?m)^exclude-newer\s*=.*\n", "", text)

[tool.uv] exclude-newer = "3 days" ​的​ release-age ​检查​只​在​ Hermes ​锁定​时​跑​（hermes pm lock、CI ​的​ lock ​检查​），​且​覆盖​ Hermes ​自己​的​全部​依赖​（​含​精确​钉​）、​只有​一类​豁免​：CA ​信任​库​（certifi）——​吊销​发布​必须​当天​进锁​（exclude-newer-package，​别的​包​不许​进​这个​表​）。​每个​用户​机器​上​生成​的​ workspace ​都​会​摘除​这个​截止​（_generate_pyproject ​行​ 165-167 ​先​ pop ​掉​两个​键​，​行​ 179 ​再​对​文本​兜底​）：​锁里​已经​是​被​检查​过​的​版本​，​用户​机器​上​的​截止​只会​拦住​ uv ​为​源码​构建​取​的​构建​工具​，​而​一个​不​提供​上传​时间​的​镜像​会​因此​拒绝​一切​（#135589）。JS ​侧​对应物​是​ pnpm-workspace.yaml ​的​ minimumReleaseAge（14 ​天​），​豁免​是​一行​精确​的​ - name@1.2.3 # why；hermes pm update --pnpm ​会​点名​并​随后​丢弃​豁免​。​插件​依赖​遵循​插件​自己​的​政策​（Teknium ​裁定​：「plugins dont have to abide by our 14 day rule … Only hermes' dependencies themselves have to」）。

docs.title: update：​两种​版本​风格
docs.text:
# pm/update.py:1-22（docstring ​节选​）
"""hermes pm update: resolve the latest versions and re-pin the lockfile.

Each Package subclass declares how to find its own latest via
``latest_versions(target)`` (see pm/package.py); this module is the driver:
it intersects those candidate lists across the targets the package serves,
compares against the lockfile, and (in real mode) re-pins + reinstalls.

Two version styles (``Package.version_style``):

  semver — one shared version across targets (node 26.7.0, uv 0.12.3).
          The update is the highest version every relevant target serves.
  minor  — the lockfile ``version`` field is major.minor; each target's
          exact patch lives in ITS artifact urls. ...

--check ​是​纯干​跑​：​打​上游​索引​（​小​ HTTP GET）​但​不​写​锁​、​不进​ store、​不​下载​ artifact；​真实​ pm update ​重钉​变化​的​包​（pm lock ​式​哈希​）、​安装​、​刷​ venv，​并​在​依赖​腿​启用​时连​ uv.lock ​与​ pnpm-lock.yaml ​一起​刷​。cli.py ​的​ cmd_update（​行​ 760）​是​入口​；pnpm_release_age.py ​专门​负责​「pnpm ​的​ minimumReleaseAge ​拒掉​了​谁​」——pnpm 12 ​的​错误码​不报​包名​，​得​在​ workspace ​决议​输入​的​副本​上用​允许​保存​的​方式​重跑​一次​才能​列出来​。

docs.title: uv ​缓存​：​健康检查​与​精确​修剪
docs.text:
# pm/uv_cache_health.py:1-9（docstring）
"""Find corrupt entries in PM's uv cache.

uv unpacks every wheel into ``<cache>/.tmpXXXX`` and renames the directory
into ``archive-v0/<id>``; it never flushes the file data first. When the
machine stops mid-install (a hosted restart, a power cut), the rename can
survive while the files read back as NUL bytes. uv then reuses that entry on
every later sync and fails at install time with "The wheel is invalid", and
retrying cannot help. These helpers recognise that failure and name the
packages to purge. Deletion goes through ``uv cache clean`` (the caller),
which takes uv's cache lock, so a concurrent sync never loses files mid-read."""

​故障​模式​很​具体​：rename ​存活​、​内容​是​ NUL——​重试​永远​无效​，​必须​按​错误​里​的​ wheel ​名​定位​缓存​条目​清除​。​而​「fetch/​解析​/​磁盘​满​」​类​失败​绝不​打印​这些​标记​，​所以​不会​被​误判​为​损坏​。uv_cache_prune.py ​是​另​一个​方向​：​把​滚动​ CI ​缓存​修剪​到​恰好​ uv.lock ​能​解析​的​集合​（​比​ uv cache prune --ci ​更​精确​，​不​丢​当前​锁​仍​需要​的​ wheel）——​这是​ bundle payload ​与​ CI ​快照​的​「exactness contract」。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• CI：lock ​检查​跑​同​一套​ exclude-newer；scripts/ci/ ​的​归档​链​把​ termux ​库​镜像​进​ R2。
  • hermes update（hermes_cli/update*）：​大​消费者​；​回执​ schema ​与​ pm.receipt ​相同​（​同一​目录​、kind ​区分​）。
  • plugin ​体系​：admission ​拥有​写​、discovery ​只读​；eviction ​的​指纹​在​「​任​一侧​变​了​」​时​重试​。
  • activate：./activate ​与​ scripts/run-in-hermes-env ​消费​ ACTIVATION_INPUTS ​戳​与​ features ​文件​。
  • cron/worker_bootstrap：​租用​ committed ​代​ = ​本篇​政策​的​最终​受益者​（​收集器​不敢​删有​租约​的​代​）。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​钉版​政策​的​每​一​数字​都​对​着​一次​真实​事故​：​上限​对​着​供应链​蠕虫​，SHA ​钉​对​着​ tag ​移动​，release-age ​对​着​刚​发布​的​投毒​版本​，certifi ​豁免​对​着​ CA ​吊销​的​时效性​。​实现​上​政策​被​切成​两个​不变式​：​锁定​者​检查​年龄​，​消费者​信任​锁​（​用户​机器​摘除​截止​）；lock.json ​是​完整​机器​接口​（Nix ​直接​当​数据​读​）。​缓存​健康​/​修剪​、​回执​、​恢复​、​插件​驱逐​都​是​这​两个​不变式​的​配套​件​。

docs.title: skills/ ​模块​总览​ —— ​技能​系统​的​两个​表面
文件​概览
docs.text: ​技能​是​ Hermes ​的​「​可​加载​操作手册​」：​一个​目录​、​一份​ SKILL.md（YAML frontmatter + Markdown ​指令​），​可选​再​带​ references/ templates/ assets/ scripts/。​仓库​里​有​两个​表面​：skills/ ​是​内置​技能​（44 ​个​ SKILL.md，12 ​个​类别​目录​，​默认​可​加载​）；optional-skills/ ​是​更重​、​更小众​的​技能​（141 ​个​ SKILL.md，23 ​个​类别​目录​，​未激活​，​经​ hermes skills install official/<category>/<skill> ​安装​，​适配器​是​ tools/skills_hub_official.py ​的​ OptionalSkillSource）。​运行​时​机器​在​ tools/skills_tool.py（​渐进​披露​的​两个​模型​工具​）、agent/skill_commands.py（​每个​技能​自动​注册​ /skill-name slash）​与​ agent/skill_preprocessing.py（​模板​令牌​ + ​内联​ shell ​展开​）；​生命周期​维护者​是​策展​人​（agent/curator.py）。​本篇​是​第​ 12 ​章​总览​与​全部​内置​技能​名单​。

docs.title: 两​表面​ + ​四级​搜索​目录
docs.text:
​模型​可见​的​技能​目录​按​ agent/skill_utils.get_skill_search_roots()（​行​ 413-423）​给出​的​四级​优先​序​解析​——​这是​技能​列表​、prompt ​索引​、slash ​命令​、skill_view、preload ​与​ cron ​共享​的​唯一​顺序​：

TIER_PROJECT   ​项目​ .hermes/skills/（opt-in）
TIER_LOCAL     ~/.hermes/skills/（​用户​技能​ + ​从​内置​播种​ + hub ​安装​落点​）
TIER_CREATE_DIR ​技能​创建​目录​（​存在​才​加入​）
TIER_EXTERNAL  skills.external_dirs ​配置​的​外部​目录​
（​内置​ skills/ ​与​ optional-skills/ ​经​ bundled ​播种​/​官方​源​进入​ TIER_LOCAL ​世界​）

​同名​时高​ tier ​遮蔽​低​ tier；resolve_skill_catalog ​负责​去​重​与​遮蔽​判定​，​重复​者​用​「​精确​相对路径​」​作为​ skill_view ​的​名字​。

docs.title: 渐进​披露​：​两次​工具​调用
docs.text:
# tools/skills_tool.py:3-4
"""Skills Tool — list and view skill documents (progressive disclosure). A skill is a directory
holding SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter + instructions) plus optional references/, templates/, assets/,
scripts/. `skills_list` returns name/description only; `skill_view` returns full content and
linked files. Sibling modules (skills_tool_setup / _plugin / _dedup) re-export here."""

skills_list（​行​ 290）​只​暴露​名称​ + ​描述​ + ​类别​（​描述​截断​到​索引​宽度​），skill_view（​行​ 613）​才​给​全文​与​链接​文件​。​技能​经​描述​进入​模型​技能​索引​——​所以​描述​质量​就是​触发​质量​，​这​也​是​编写​标准​把​ description ​卡​在​ ≤60 ​字符​一句​的​原因​。​发现​结果​有​每会话​缓存​（​目录​签名​ + 30s TTL，​行​ 33-40）：​签名​ = ​每个​目录​的​ mtime + ​子目录​名​（​装​/​卸​发生​在​同一个​粗粒度​ mtime ​刻度​内​也​能​被​名字​差异​捕捉​）+ ​禁用​集​ + platform；TTL ​管不住​的​只有​原地​改​ SKILL.md（​无​目录​变化​）。

docs.title: 一条​技能​被​触发​后​的​完整​链路
docs.text:
1. ​模型​读​到​ skills_list ​的​行​（name + description + category）
2. ​模型​调​ skill_view(name) → ​全文​ + ​链接​文件​清单​
   ├── frontmatter ​平台​门​/​环境​门​/app ​门​（​不​可见​技能​按​需可查​，skip_disabled ​场景​）
   ├── setup ​检查​：prerequisites.commands / metadata.hermes.config ​的​ env ​提示​
   └── ​预处理​：${HERMES_SKILL_DIR}/${HERMES_SESSION_ID} ​展开​（​默认​开​）
              ！`cmd` ​内联​ shell（​默认​关​；community ​信任​级​永不​自动​执行​）
3. /skill-name slash（agent/skill_commands.py）：​用户​直接​点名​ → ​技能​全文​嵌入​消息​
   └── ​脚手架​标记​让​记忆​提供者​只存​「​用户​的​指令​」​而​不存​技能​正文​
4. usage ​遥测​ +1（tools/skill_usage.py，best-effort、​跨​进程​锁​、​原子​写​）
5. ​策展​人​日后​读​这份​遥测​决定​ active/stale/archived（​见​ curator.md）

docs.title: 一份​技能​目录​长​什么样
docs.text:
skills/software-development/github/
├── SKILL.md            ← frontmatter（name/description/platforms/metadata.hermes.*）+ ​指令​正文​
├── references/         ← ​按​工作​流​拆分​的​参考​文档​（PR ​生命周期​、issue ​管理​……）
├── scripts/            ← helper ​脚本​（​技能​相对路径​引用​；​不让​模型​现写​解析器​）
├── templates/          ← ​可填​模板​
└── assets/             ← ​资源​文件​

​编写​标准​（CI ​强制​）​要求​正文​遵循​现代​章节​顺序​、prose ​用​反​引号​点名​原生​工具​、platforms ​门​与​脚本​实际​ import ​对账​——​完整​字​段表​与​标准​清单​见​ skill_format.md。
