docs.title: 两条​表面​的​准入​差异
docs.text:
维度​ skills/（​内置​） optional-skills/（​可​选​） ​默认​状态​ ​可​加载​（​播种​进​ ~/.hermes/skills/ ​世界​） ​未激活​ ​安装​方式​ ​随​仓库​分发​ hermes skills install official/<category>/<skill> ​适配器​ bundled ​播种​ tools/skills_hub_official.py ​的​ OptionalSkillSource ​准入​标准​ ​同​一套​编写​硬​标准​（CI ​强制​） ​同​上​；​重​依赖​/​小​众​倾向​送​这里​ ​评审​提示​ ​检查​目标目录​：​重​依赖​或小众​技能​去​ optional-skills/ —

​评审​一个​技能​ PR ​的​第一​问​就是​「​该​去​哪个​表面​」：​需要​重​依赖​（manim、office ​套件​）​或​极小​众​（​区块​链​、​游戏​）​的​技能​进​ optional-skills/，​让​默认​安装​保持​轻​。

docs.title: 本组​文档​导航
docs.text: 文档​ ​内容​ skill_format.md SKILL.md frontmatter ​字​段表​、​目录​布局​、​编写​硬​标准​（CI ​强制​）、​渐进​披露​与​ 30s ​缓存​、​预处理​令牌​ curator.md ​策展​人​：​不​活动​触发​、usage ​遥测​、​生命周期​迁移​、LLM ​整合​ opt-in、​备份

docs.title: 常见问题​速查
docs.text:
• ​技能​没​被​触发​？ ​先看​ description：​是否​ ≤60 ​字符​、​是否​描述​能力​而​非​实现​、​是否​撞​了​名字​/​类别​重复​。​触发​质量​ = ​描述​质量​。
  • ​技能​装​了​但​ skill_view ​拒绝​？ ​它​在​ skills.disabled ​名单​里​（skill_view ​按​名单​拒绝​），​或​平台​门​/​环境​门​/app ​门​判定​不​可见​。
  • ​同名​技能​谁​赢​？ ​四级​搜索​根​的​优先​序​（project > local > create > external）；​同级​重复​用​精确​相对路径​点名​。
  • **​内联​ !cmd` ​没​执行​？** ​默认​关闭​（skills.inline_shell`）；​且​ community ​信任​级​的​ hub ​技能​永不​自动​执行​（#63307）。
  • ​技能​被​归档​了​？ ​策展​人​的​不​活动​迁移​；~/.hermes/skills/.archive/ ​里​可​恢复​，pinned ​可​豁免​（​见​ curator.md）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/：skills_tool.py ​注册​进​ tools/registry.py ​的​ skills ​工具集​；​官方​源​适配器​ skills_hub_official.py ​属于​ skills hub ​家族​。
  • agent/：agent/skill_commands.py（slash ​注册​）、agent/skill_preprocessing.py（​预处理​）、agent/skill_utils.py（​搜索​根与​解析​）、agent/skills_index_delta.py（​索引​增量​）；​运行​时​视角​另见​ tutorial/03_agent/skills_runtime.md。
  • cron/：cron ​任务​可以​带​ skills ​字​段​（JOB_DEFINITION_FIELDS），​运行​时​按​技能​根​加载​。
  • hermes_cli/：hermes skills install ... ​与​ /skill-name slash ​命令​分发​。
  • tests/skills/：​编写​标准​由​ tests/skills/test_authoring_standards.py CI ​强制​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​技能​系统​的​读法​是​「​一个​格式​、​两个​表面​、​两级​披露​」：​格式​是​「​目录​ + frontmatter + ​指令​」，​表面​是​内置​/​可​选​，​披露​是​「​索引​里​只有​名字​和​描述​、skill_view ​才​有​全文​」。​所有​机器​行为​都​挂​在​描述​文本​上​——​这​解释​了​编写​标准​为何​如此​苛刻​，​也​解释​了​策展​人​为何​把​「​不​活动​」​作为​唯一​的​生命周期​信号​。

docs.title: 策展​人​ —— ​技能​生命周期​维护
文件​概览
docs.text: ​策展​人​是​后台​的​技能​园丁​：​跟踪​ agent ​创建​技能​的​使用​情况​、​按​不​活动​自动​迁移​生命周期​状态​（active → stale → archived）、​可选地​ fork ​一个​ AIAgent ​做​ LLM ​整合​评审​。​核心​在​ agent/curator.py（1,218 ​行​），​备份​/​回滚​在​ agent/curator_backup.py（492 ​行​），CLI ​在​ hermes_cli/curator.py（hermes curator status|run|pause|resume|pin|unpin|archive|restore|prune|backup|rollback），​遥测​在​ tools/skill_usage.py。​触发​是​「​不​活动​」​而​不是​ cron ​守护​进程​：​当​ agent ​空闲​且​上次​运行​距今​超过​ interval_hours（​默认​ 7 ​天​）​时​，maybe_run_curator() ​才​跑​一遍​——​它​寄生​在​ agent ​的​空闲​心跳​上​，​没有​自己​的​定时器​。

docs.title: 触发​门​：​空闲​ + ​间隔​ + ​认领
docs.text:
# agent/curator.py:1204-1215
def maybe_run_curator(*, idle_for_seconds: Optional[float] = None, on_summary: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Best-effort: run a curator pass if all gates pass. Returns the result dict if a pass was started, else None. Never raises."""
    try:
        # Idle gating: only enforce when the caller provided a measurement.
        if not should_run_now() or (idle_for_seconds is not None and idle_for_seconds < get_min_idle_hours() * 3600.0):
            return None
        if not _claim_run():  # the holder's own pass is the one counted; every tick would re-count it
            return None
        try:
            return run_curator_review(on_summary=on_summary, trigger="scheduled")
        finally:
            _release_run_claim()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug("maybe_run_curator failed: %s", e, exc_info=True)
        return None

​三道​门​全部​是​「​够格​才​跑​」：​时间​门​（should_run_now() ​读​ .curator_state ​的​ last_run_at ​对比​ interval_hours）、​空闲​门​（​调用​方​提供​ idle_for_seconds ​时​要求​ ≥ min_idle_hours，​默认​ 2 ​小时​）、​认领​门​（_claim_run() ​防止​多个​宿主​/​线程​同时​跑​——​持有者​自己​的​ pass ​才​计入​，​否则​每个​心跳​都​会​重复​计数​）。​整个​函数​永不​抛​异常​：​策展​人​是​ best-effort ​的​背景​维护​，​故障​只能​降级​为​日志​。​调度​状态​持久​在​ ~/.hermes/skills/.curator_state（load_state/save_state，​行​ 30-53：last_run_at、paused、run_count ​等​，​原子​写​）。

docs.title: 自动​迁移​：​证据​锚点​与​保护​名单
docs.text:
# agent/curator.py:209-221
def apply_automatic_transitions(now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Move every curator-managed skill between active/stale/archived based on its latest real activity; pinned skills are
    never touched. Built-ins are seeded with a baseline record on first sight so their inactivity clock starts NOW, not at epoch.
    Returns a counter dict."""
    from tools import skill_usage as _u

    now = now or datetime.now(UTC)
    stale_cutoff = now - timedelta(days=get_stale_after_days())
    archive_cutoff = now - timedelta(days=get_archive_after_days())
    # Cron-referenced skills are in use by definition (usage only bumps when a
    # job fires, so paused/rare jobs would age them out). Treat as pinned.
    protected = _cron_referenced_skills()

apply_automatic_transitions（​行​ 209-263）​是​确定性​的​不​活动​行走​，​几个​判定​细节​全是​真实​故障​的​伤疤​：

  • ​锚点取​「​最后​真实​活动​」​或​ created_at——​从未​活跃​的​技能​锚​在​创建​时刻​，​不许​按​ epoch ​起算​自灭​。
  • use_count == 0 ​是​证据​缺失​，​不是​陈旧​：​比​ stale_after_days（​默认​ 14 ​天​）​年轻​的​从未​使用​技能​永不​归档​。
  • ​内置​技能​首见​时​播种​基线​记录​（seed_record_if_missing / reanchor_clock）——​时钟​从​「​策展​人​第一次​看见​」​起​算​，​不​从​ 1970 ​年​起算​。
  • ​保护​名单​：pinned ​技能​、​被​ cron ​任务​ skills/skill ​字​段​引用​的​技能​（​遥测​只​在​任务​真的​点火​时​ +1，​暂停​/​低频​任务​会​冤枉​老化​它们​——​按​ pinned ​对待​）、​锁定​技能​，​全部​跳过​。

docs.title: 触碰​边界​：​只​碰​ created_by: "agent"
docs.text:
# tools/skill_usage.py:1-6（docstring ​节选​）
"""Skill usage telemetry + provenance for the Curator: a sidecar ``~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`` keyed by
skill name (never frontmatter — keeps telemetry out of user-authored SKILL.md and off bundled/hub skills).
Counter bumps are best-effort (DEBUG-logged failures never break the tool call); writes are atomic under a
cross-process lock. Curator management is an explicit ``created_by: agent`` marker written by skill_manage —
never inferred from location. Lifecycle: active -> stale -> archived (moved to .archive/); ``pinned`` opts
out of auto transitions, orthogonal to state."""

​策展​人​的​最大​铁律​是​触​碰​范围​：​只​碰​ created_by: "agent" ​的​技能​——​这是​一个​由​ skill_manage ​显式​写入​的​标记​，​绝不​从​位置​推断​（bundled ​与​ hub ​安装​的​技能​天然​越界​；skills.disabled ​名单​里​的​技能​ skill_view ​都​拒绝​）。curator.prune_builtins ​允许​确定性​不​活动​行走​归档​内置​技能​，​但​它们​永不​进入​ LLM pass ​的​候选​名单​——fork ​出​的​ agent ​必须​只​被​提供​它​有权​读写​的​技能​。​第二条​铁律​是​永不​删除​：archive ​是​上限​（​进​ ~/.hermes/skills/.archive/，​可​恢复​）；skill_manage(action="delete") ​拒绝​ pinned ​技能​，​但​ patch/edit/write_file/remove_file ​仍然​可用​——agent ​可以​继续​改进​它​，​只是​不能​除名​。

docs.title: LLM ​整合​：opt-in ​的​ fork
docs.text:
# agent/curator.py:268-276
CURATOR_DRY_RUN_BANNER = (
    "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n"
    "DRY-RUN — REPORT ONLY. DO NOT MUTATE THE SKILL LIBRARY.\n"
    "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n"
    "\n"
    "This is a PREVIEW pass. Follow every instruction below EXCEPT:\n"
    "\n"
    "  • DO NOT call skill_manage with action=patch, create, delete, "
    "write_file, or remove_file.\n"
    ...

LLM fork ​默认​关闭​（DEFAULT_CONSOLIDATE = False，​行​ 30）：​确定性​迁移​总是​跑​（​只要​策展​人​启用​），LLM ​整合​（pin/archive/consolidate/patch ​建议​）​必须​显式​打开​。fork ​走​ auxiliary ​客户端​（_run_llm_review，​行​ 1087），​绝不​触​碰主会​话​的​ prompt cache——​这​正是​根​ AGENTS.md「​提示​词​缓存​神圣​」​不​变量​在​后台任务​上​的​投影​。dry-run ​模式​在​ prompt ​顶部​立​起​横幅​：​这是​预览​ pass，​你​的​输出​就是​交付​物​，​描述​你​会​做​什么​；​评审​者​读完​报告​再​决定​是否​ hermes curator run（​无​旗标​）​真跑​。

docs.title: 备份​与​回滚​：​可​撤销​的​撤销
docs.text:
# agent/curator_backup.py:1-4
"""Curator snapshot + rollback. Before any mutating curator pass, ``~/.hermes/skills/`` is tar.gz'd under
``~/.hermes/skills/.curator_backups/<utc-iso>/`` with a ``manifest.json``. Rollback first snapshots the CURRENT tree (so it is
itself undoable), then extracts the chosen snapshot into place. ...
Each snapshot also copies ``~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json`` as
``cron-jobs.json``: the consolidation pass rewrites cron ``skills``/``skill`` references in place, so rollback restores those two
fields (only) — the rest is live state."""

​每次​变更​ pass ​前​整树​快照​（​排除​ .curator_backups/、.hub/、.git/；​包含​ .usage.json、.archive/、.curator_state——​回滚​连​「​上次​运行​时间​」​一起​恢复​，​策展​人​不会​立刻​重新​开火​）。​回滚​先​给​当前​树拍​快照​——​回滚​本身​也​可​撤销​。​快照​顺带​抄​走​ cron/jobs.json：​整合​ pass ​会​原地​改写​ cron ​任务​的​ skills/skill ​引用​，​回滚​只​恢复​这​两个​字​段​、​其余​维持​现势​——​跨​文件​的​引用​一致性​被​显式​建模​。

docs.title: 核心​类​/​函数

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• agent/ ​技能​运行​时​：​策展​人​消费​ skill_view/skills_list ​的​遥测​；​运行​时​视角​见​ tutorial/03_agent/skills_runtime.md。
  • cron/：cron ​任务​的​ skills/skill ​字段​把​技能​拉​进​保护​名单​；​整合​ pass ​改写​引用​ → ​备份​抄​走​ jobs.json。
  • auxiliary ​客户端​（agent/AGENTS.md）：LLM fork ​的​模型​调用​通道​，​与​主会话​ prompt cache ​隔离​。
  • skills hub（tools/skills_hub*）：.hub/ ​目录​被​备份​排除​（hub ​自​管​）；created_by ​标记​绝不​从​位置​推断​。
  • config.yaml：curator: ​节​——enabled, interval_hours, min_idle_hours, stale_after_days, archive_after_days, backup.*。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​策展​人​的​设计​可以​压缩成​三个​「​绝不​」：​绝不​从​位置​推断​管辖权​（​只​碰​显式​ created_by: "agent"）、​绝不​删除​（archive ​是​上限​、​回滚​可​撤销​）、​绝不​在​主会话​上花​一个​ token（fork ​走​ auxiliary、LLM pass ​默认​关​）。​生命周期​只有​一个​信号​——​真实​使用​的​不​活动​——​但​每个​边界​情况​（​从未​使用​、​内置​首见​、cron ​引用​、pinned、​锁定​）​都​有​显式​的​锚点​或​保护​规则​，​因为​每一处​都​是​一次​真实​的​误​归档​。

docs.title: 技能​格式​与​加载​机器​ —— SKILL.md、​编写​标准​与​渐进​披露
文件​概览
docs.text: ​本篇​讲​技能​的​格式​契约​（frontmatter ​字​段​、​目录​布局​）​与​加载​机器​（tools/skills_tool.py ​的​发现​缓存​、agent/skill_commands.py ​的​ slash ​注册​、agent/skill_preprocessing.py ​的​预处理​），​以及​ CI ​强制​的​编写​硬​标准​。​一个​技能​ = ​一个​目录​，​里面​必有​ SKILL.md（YAML frontmatter + Markdown ​指令​），​可​选​ references/（​参考​文档​）、templates/（​模板​）、assets/（​资源​）、scripts/（helper ​脚本​）。

docs.title: frontmatter ​实例​与​字​段表
docs.text:
# skills/software-development/github/SKILL.md:1-11
---
name: github
description: "GitHub via gh CLI: PRs, issues, reviews, repos, auth."
version: 2.0.0
author: Ben Barclay (benbarclay), Hermes Agent
license: MIT
platforms: [linux, macos, windows]
metadata:
  hermes:
    tags: [github, gh, git, pull-requests, issues, code-review, repos, auth, ci]
    category: software-development
    related_skills: [codebase-inspection, requesting-code-review]
---
​字​段​ ​必需​ ​语义​ name ​是​ ​加载​名​；skill_view(name) ​接受​ frontmatter ​名​（​也​接受​目录名​，​递归​兼容​） description ​强制​ ≤60 ​字符​、​一句​话​、​以​句号​结尾​；​技能​索引​只​显示​到​这里​ version / author / license ​否​ ​人类​作者​优先​（「Hermes Agent」​排​第二​） platforms ​否​ OS ​门​：[macos]、[linux, macos]…；​编写​标准​要求​它​与​脚本​实际​ import ​对账​ metadata.hermes.tags / category / related_skills ​否​ ​索引​展示​与​关联​；​顶层​ tags:/category: ​被​加载​器​镜像​接受​ metadata.hermes.config ​否​ ​技能​需要​的​ config.yaml ​设置​：setup ​时​提示​、​加载​时​注入​，​存于​ skills.config.<key> prerequisites.commands ​否​ ​前置​命令​检查​（setup note）

docs.title: 发现​：​签名​ + TTL ​的​每会话​缓存
docs.text:
# tools/skills_tool.py:33-40
# Per-session discovery cache: {cache_key: (signature, timestamp, skills_list)}. Signature =
# every catalog directory's mtime and child-dir names, walked like the catalog itself (an install
# under an existing category such as ``mlops/training/`` moves only that dir's mtime) + the disabled
# set (config-only change, no mtime) + platform; the TTL bounds staleness from in-place SKILL.md
# edits, which no directory signature can see.
_SKILLS_CACHE: dict = {}
_SKILLS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 30.0
# Deepest directory the signature descends to below a root (a skill sits at <cat>/<sub>/<skill>/).
_SIGNATURE_MAX_DEPTH = 6

​扫描​本身​很​便宜​（_dir_tree_signature ​约​ 1ms/170 ​目录​），​但​「​目录​签名​」​有​一个​盲区​：​原地​编辑​ SKILL.md ​不​动​ mtime ​目录​——TTL ​就是​给​这个​盲区​兜底​的​。​缓存​键分​ filtered/with_disabled（​配置​ UI ​需要​看​禁用​项​）​与​ include_hidden；​命中​时​返回​浅​拷贝​——​调用者​会​改写​返回​的​ dict（web_server ​注注​ enabled/usage），​把​缓存​对象​递出去​会​毒化​缓存​。​缓存​的​签名​在​扫描​前​计算​：​一个​与​扫描​竞争​的​写入​改变​签名​，​下​一次​调用​重新​扫而​不是​端​出​撕裂​结果​。

docs.title: 渐进​披露​的​两个​工具
docs.text:
# tools/skills_tool.py:753-755
registry.register(
    name="skills_list", toolset="skills", schema=SKILLS_LIST_SCHEMA,
    handler=lambda args, **kw: skills_list(category=args.get("category"), task_id=kw.get("task_id")),
)

skills_list ​的​ schema ​描述​就是​教学​文案​：「List available skills (name + description). Use skill_view(name) to load full content.」——​模型​读完​列表​自然​会调​ skill_view。skill_view ​的​ handler ​是​ _skill_view_with_bump（​行​ 758）：​成功​视图​顺手​把​ use_count/view_count ​遥测​ +1（best-effort），​重复​视图​经​ dedup_skill_view ​去​重​——​一个​ stub ​防止​同一​文件​被​反复​全量​注入​。​技能​列表​工具​上​禁用​ offset/limit ​分页​（skills/AGENTS.md）：agent ​必须​完整​读​一个​技能​。

docs.title: 每个​技能​一个​ slash ​命令
docs.text:
# agent/skill_commands.py:15-23
# Multi-slot skill-command cache keyed by the full resolved identity
# (_resolve_skill_commands_platform(), _resolve_skill_commands_home(),
# _resolve_skill_commands_project()). The previous single-slot memo held ONE
# (platform, home, project) triple; a Desktop serve process whose identity
# flaps across requests (profile-home overrides, per-session project roots)
# missed on every poll and rescanned the whole skills dir ~3x/5s, re-logging
# the collision warnings each time (#104849). Each distinct identity is
# scanned once and memoized; reload_skills() clears every slot.
_skill_commands_by_key: dict[tuple, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}

​旧​的​单槽​ memo ​只记​一个​ (platform, home, project) ​三元组​，Desktop serve ​进程​的​身份​在​请求​间​抖动​时​每次​轮询​都​ miss、​每​ 5 ​秒​重扫​三遍​技能​目录​。​多槽​缓存​按​完整​身份​分键​。​技能​名转​命令​名​的​清洗​也​值得注意​：\w ​保留​ Unicode ​字母​（CJK、​西里尔​），name: ​小说​拆条​ ​的​技能​注册​成​ /​小说​拆条​ ​而​不是​被​ slug ​成​空串​丢弃​（#12351）；Telegram ​的​ [a-z0-9_] ​菜单​限制​由​平台​层​另管​。/skill turn ​会​被​展开​成​嵌入​技能​全文​的​模型​消息​，​所以​有成​对​的​脚手架​标记​（_SKILL_INVOCATION_PREFIX ​等​）​让​ extract_user_instruction_from_skill_message ​能​把​「​用户​到底​问​了​什么​」​从​消息​里​还原​出来​——​否则​记忆​提供者​会​把​技能​正文​当成​用户​发言​存档​。

docs.title: 预处理​：​模板​令牌​与​内联​ shell
docs.text:
# agent/skill_preprocessing.py:15-21
# ${HERMES_SKILL_DIR} / ${HERMES_SESSION_ID} tokens. Unresolvable ones (e.g. no
# session) are left as-is so the author can spot them.
_SKILL_TEMPLATE_RE = re.compile(r"\$\{(HERMES_SKILL_DIR|HERMES_SESSION_ID)\}")
# Inline shell snippets like !`date +%Y-%m-%d` — single-line only.
_INLINE_SHELL_RE = re.compile(r"!`([^`\n]+)`")
# Cap inline-shell output so a runaway command can't blow out the context.
_INLINE_SHELL_MAX_OUTPUT = 4000

​两个​令牌​族​：${HERMES_SKILL_DIR}/${HERMES_SESSION_ID}（​解析​不了​的​原样​保留​，​作者​看得见​）；!cmd`（​单行​、​输出​封顶​ 4000 ​字符​、​失败​返回​[inline-shell ...]​标记​而​不​抛​异常​——​一个​坏​片段​不许​毁掉​整条​技能​消息​）。​内联​ shell ​默认​**​关闭​**（cfg.get("inline_shell", False)`），​开启​时​还有​一道​信任​闸​：

# agent/skill_preprocessing.py:154-155
    if cfg.get("inline_shell", False) and not _is_community_hub_skill(skill_dir):
        content = expand_inline_shell(content, skill_dir, int(cfg.get("inline_shell_timeout", 10) or 10))

_is_community_hub_skill（​行​ 99-139）​查​ hub ​的​ .hub/lock.json：--force ​装进来​的​ community ​信任​级​技能​不许​在​「​查看​」​时​自动​执行​ shell——​那​正是​安装​门​当初​拒绝​的​东西​（#63307）；​锁读​不​出来​时​对​它​树下​的​技能​失败​关闭​。

docs.title: 编写​硬​标准​（CI ​强制​）
docs.text: tests/skills/test_authoring_standards.py ​强制​全部​新​/​现代化​技能​（​内置​、​可​选​、​贡献​）​满足​：description ≤60 ​字符​一句​（​禁​营销​词​、​不​复述​名字​/​类别​）；prose ​引用​原生​ Hermes ​工具​或​ MCP ​时用​反​引号​，​且​不许​点名​ agent ​已​包装​的​ shell ​工具​（grep→search_files、cat→read_file、sed/awk→patch）；platforms: ​门​与​脚本​实际​ import ​对账​（POSIX-only ​原语​必须​先试​着​跨平台​化​）；author ​人类​在​前​；​现代​章节​顺序​（When to Use / Prerequisites / How to Run / Quick Reference / Procedure / Pitfalls / Verification，​复杂​技能​ ~200 ​行​）；helper ​逻辑​进​ scripts/ ​而​不是​让​模型​每次​现写​解析器​；​测试​在​ tests/skills/test_<skill>_skill.py（stdlib + pytest + mock，​无​真实​网络​）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• tools/registry.py：​两​工具​注册​进​ skills ​工具集​（​可​按​平台​启停​）。
  • cron/：​任务​的​ skills ​字段​在​运行​时​按同​一套​根​解析​。
  • curator（​下​一篇​）：​消费​ skill_usage ​遥测​；skills.disabled ​名单​由​ skill_view ​拒绝​。
  • hermes_cli/：hermes skills install/list/remove ​走​ hub ​家族​；slash ​分发​见​ tutorial/06_cli/。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​格式​契约​的​每​一个​细节​都​指向​同一个​目标​——​让​「​描述​」​成为​机器​可​依赖​的​触发​面​：60 ​字符​上限​让​索引​不​膨胀​、​编写​标准​让​ prose ​不​说谎​、​平台​门​与​ import ​对账​让​ OS ​门​不​装样子​。​加载​机器​则​用​「​签名​ + TTL + ​浅​拷贝​」​三件套​把​廉价​扫描​做成​正确​缓存​，​用​渐进​披露​把​ 185 ​份​技能​文档​的​上下文​成本​压​到​「​列表​一次​、​全文​按​需​」。

docs.title: hermes_platform/ —— ​机器​事实​与​资源​解析​的​统一​层
文件​概览
docs.text:
hermes_platform/ ​是​全​仓库​机器​事实​与​可​执行​资源​解析​的​唯一​权威​。​包​ docstring ​一句​话定​纲​：

Machine facts and resource resolution for every Hermes surface. Host facts describe the machine running this interpreter; resolution has no side effects.

​两个​子层​、​两条​纪律​。host/（facts.py、darwin_pci.py、gpu_adapters.py、products.py、runtime.py、summary.py）​回答​「​这台​机器​是​什么​」：OS、​架构​（​仿真​下​也​报​原生​架构​）、CPU、​内存​、GPU。​读取​来源​只有​ registry/sysctl/IOKit/procfs/sysfs——​绝不​环境变量​、​绝不​ subprocess、​绝不​ GPU ​驱动​库​。resolver/（core.py、app.py、availability.py、base.py、known_dirs.py）​回答​「​某个​工具​/app ​在​哪​、​什么​状态​」：​被动​、​无副作用​——locate_command ​只读​文件​元​数据​。declaration.py ​是​顶层​声明​模块​（​应用​需求​的​注册​与​查询​）。​根​ AGENTS.md ​的​铁律​「​机器​事实​与​可​执行​查找​走​ hermes_platform」​就是指​这里​。

docs.title: 架构​：​仿真​之下​报​真身
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/host/facts.py:1-5
"""Cached OS, architecture, CPU, memory and GPU facts for the current machine.

Native architecture remains accurate when the Python process is emulated. Facts read the registry,
sysctl, IOKit, procfs or sysfs: never the environment, a subprocess or a GPU driver library."""

​四个​架构​函数​各司其职​：normalize_arch()（​行​ 29）​把​ x86_64/aarch64/i686 ​等​别名​收拢​成​规范名​；process_arch()（​行​ 41）​报​这个​ Python ​进程​的​架构​；native_arch()（​行​ 80）​报​机器​的​架构​——​即使​在​ Rosetta/WOW64 ​仿真​下​：

# hermes_platform/host/facts.py:79-90
@functools.cache
def native_arch() -> str:
    """Return the machine architecture even when this process is emulated."""
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            wow64 = _wow64_native_machine()
        except (OSError, AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
            wow64 = None
        return windows_native_arch(wow64_native=wow64, machine=platform.machine())
    if sys.platform == "darwin" and process_arch() == "amd64" and _darwin_translated():
        return "arm64"
    return process_arch()

Windows ​走​ IsWow64Process2（_wow64_native_machine()，​行​ 53-71——ctypes ​直接​调​ kernel32，GetCurrentProcess.restype ​必须​重​定义​为​ HANDLE，​否则​伪​句柄​被​截断​成​ c_int）；macOS ​走​ sysctl.proc_translated（Rosetta）。​为什么​较真​：​一个​ x64 Python ​跑​在​ arm64 Windows ​上​会​选错​下载​ target、​装错​ artifact——pm/store.py::_native_machine ​与​工具​解析​全都​消费​这里​的​答案​。windows_native_arch()（​行​ 48-50）​是​纯​函数​：IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE ​常量​映射​ + ​回退​，​方便​数据​化​测试​。

docs.title: CPU/​内存​/GPU：​每个​平台​一条​只读​通道
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/host/facts.py:162-169
@functools.cache
def cpu_model() -> str:
    """Return the CPU model, or an empty string when unavailable."""
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        return _winreg_str(_CPU_KEY, "ProcessorNameString")
    if sys.platform == "darwin":
        return _sysctl_str(b"machdep.cpu.brand_string")
    return parse_cpuinfo(_read_text("/proc/cpuinfo"), device_tree_model=_read_text("/proc/device-tree/model", 512))

​模式​固定​：Windows ​读​注册表​（HARDWARE\DESCRIPTION\System\CentralProcessor\0）、macOS ​读​ sysctl、Linux ​读​ procfs/sysfs（CPU ​型号​还​能​回退​到​设备​树​ model——​树莓​派​这类​ ARM ​板​）。​全部​ functools.cache：​事实​是​缓存​的​机器​快照​，​进程​内​不变​。GPU ​的​解析​分​两级​：classify_gpu_vendors()（​行​ 254）​按​ PCI vendor id ​分类​（10de=nvidia、1002=amd、8086=intel，​独显​优先​）；​数据​来源​ Windows ​读​显示​类​注册表​键​（_windows_display_adapters，​行​ 297）、Linux ​读​ /sys/class/drm/card*/device/vendor、macOS ​走​ darwin_pci.py ​的​ IOKit registry（Apple silicon ​没有​ PCI ​显示​控制器​，Intel Mac ​才​有​名字​）。gpu_adapters.py ​是​ Windows ​专用​的​ DXGI ​视角​：Task Manager ​显示​的​「GPU ​内存​」= DXGI ​专用​显存​ + ​共享​系统​内存​之​和​——​核显​几乎​没有​专用​显存​，​共享​配额​才​是​真实​池子​（31.5GB ​机器​上​的​ Intel Arc B390 ​拿到​ 18GB）。​读法​是​ ctypes ​手​扒​ vtable（_RELEASE, _ENUM_ADAPTERS1, _GET_DESC1 = 2, 12, 10），​同样​无​ env、​无​ subprocess。

docs.title: resolver：​三级​努力​模型
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/resolver/base.py:10-20
class Effort(Enum):
    """What `probe` may do. `NETWORK` never implies subprocess; `DIAGNOSTIC` alone may spawn."""

    LOCAL = "local"
    NETWORK = "network"
    DIAGNOSTIC = "diagnostic"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Inspection:
    version: Observation[str]

resolver ​的​核心​词汇​是​ Observation[T] + CheckState（core.py:29-47）：​消费者​只​分支​于​ state（NOT_CHECKED/PRESENT/ABSENT/UNAVAILABLE/ERROR），detail ​是​给​人​看​的​、​永不​被​解析​。​努力​分​三级​：locate ​只读​文件​元​数据​；inspect ​可以​开​文件​、​进程​内​调​ OS API；probe ​每次​新鲜​、​永不​缓存​，​是​唯一​可以​开​ socket ​或​ spawn ​的​层级​——​且​ NETWORK ​绝不​暗含​ subprocess。locate_command()（core.py:116-140）​按​「​显式​路径​ → PATH → known_dirs」​顺序​记录​每个​候选​（Candidate ​带​ present ​标记​），​相对路径​显式​拒绝​（​会​解析​到​环境​ cwd）；Windows ​下​ known dir ​里​的​裸名​按​ PATHEXT ​枚举​变体​。

docs.title: known_dirs：​目录​字面​量​的​棘轮
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/resolver/known_dirs.py:1-6
"""Directories where tools install outside PATH, grouped by the ecosystem that owns them.

Every table in Hermes lives here. A directory literal outside this module fails the ratchet in
`tests/test_managed_runtime_resolution.py`. Each table is empty on an OS where the ecosystem
does not install there, so callers compose tables without OS branches."""

「​工具​装在​ PATH ​之外​的​规范​目录​」​全部​收拢​于​此​，​按​生态​分组​：homebrew_dirs()（/opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin）、user_local_bin()、rust_tool_dirs()（~/.cargo/bin）​等​。​棘轮​测试​ tests/test_managed_runtime_resolution.py ​会​让​任何​出现​在​本​模块​之外​的​目录​字面​量​测试​失败​——​这​是​把​「​散落​的​硬​编码​路径​」​变成​「​一张​表​」​的​机械化​手段​。​每张​表在​不​存在​该​生态​的​ OS ​上​为​空​，​调用者​组合​表时​不​需要​ OS ​分支​。

docs.title: app ​解析​与​可用性
docs.text: resolver/app.py ​是​桌面​应用​解析器​：locate ​按​声明​顺序​ stat ​每个​位置​（​固定​路径​、PATH、​卸载​注册表​项​、flatpak/snap/Applications ​目录​），* ​路径​段​展开​目录​列表​，​第一个​存在​的​胜出​；inspect ​进程​内读​版本​源​（plist/​可执行文件​元​数据​）；probe ​每次​重读​厂商​的​运行​时​文件​——​其中​的​ bearer token ​永不​离开​本​模块​。resolver/availability.py ​把​ app/requires ​声明​块​折算​成​目录​条目​能否​在​此​主机​提供​的​七态​：available / installed_not_running / missing_app / version_too_old / unsupported_os / unsupported_gpu / no_requirements。​它​只​跑​ locate、inspect ​与​缓存​的​ GPU fact——​不​ probe、​不​ spawn、​不​ connect、​自己​无​缓存​（​需要​ TTL ​的​调用​方​——​工具​注册表​——​已经​有​ TTL）。declaration.py ​提供​ AppSpec/RequiresSpec ​的​解析​与​注册表​（MCP ​清单​与​技能​ offer ​时门​共享​同​一套​声明​语义​）。

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• pm/store.py：native_arch() ​决定​下载​ target；PM ​独立​引导​缺此​包时​才​降级​自行​探测​（​同​一套​ IsWow64/sysctl ​逻辑​）。
  • tools/：​工具​可用性​检查​（check_fn）​消费​ locate_command ​与​ availability；​工具​注册表​的​ TTL ​缓存​包住​无​缓存​的​ availability。
  • agent/ ​浏览器​与​ computer-use：​桌面​ app ​解析​（AppDef）​服务​ browser_exec ​的​应用​目标​。
  • apps/desktop：​首启​ onboarding ​消费​ host/summary.py。
  • ​根​ AGENTS.md：「​机器​事实​与​可​执行​查找​走​ hermes_platform」​是​全​仓库​级​铁律​；~/.hermes ​硬​编码​禁令​的​对应​面​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​这个​包​的​纪律​可以​用​两句​否定句​概括​：​事实​不问​环境变量​、​解析​不​产生​副作用​。​前者​的​理由​是​环境变量​描述​的​是​「​会话​」​而​事实​描述​的​是​「​机器​」（HOME/LANG ​会​骗人​，​注册表​/sysctl/procfs ​不会​）；​后者​的​理由​是​解析​结果​要​被​工具​注册表​、MCP ​目录​、​技能​门​共享​——​有​副作用​的​解析​会​把​「​探测​」​变成​「​安装​」。​三级​努力​模型​（locate/inspect/probe）​把​「​能​做​什么​」​编码​进​类型​，​让​每个​消费者​按​需​选择​、​让​棘轮​测试​守住​目录​字面​量​的​天花板​。

docs.title: host facts ​与​ resolver ​族​深读​ —— ​从​ procfs ​到​ AppDef
文件​概览
docs.text: ​本篇​把​ hermes_platform ​的​两个​子层​拆开​细读​：host/ ​的​每个​事实​函数​（​读​哪里​、​为什么​绝不​读​ env），​与​ resolver/ ​的​完整​解析​链​（Observation ​词汇​ → locate_command → AppResolver → availability ​七态​）。​全部​ 15 ​个​文件​在​文末​清单​中​逐行​归档​。

docs.title: host/facts.py：​一条​事实​、​三个​平台​、​一个​回退​链
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/host/facts.py:204-244（​节选​）
def parse_meminfo_total(text: str) -> int | None:
    """Return ``MemTotal`` from ``/proc/meminfo`` text, in bytes."""
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("MemTotal:"):
            fields = line.split()
            if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[1].isdigit():
                return int(fields[1]) * 1024
    return None


@functools.cache
def ram_total_bytes() -> int | None:
    """Return the physical memory visible to this OS, or ``None`` when unavailable."""
    try:
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            return _windows_ram_total()
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            return _sysctl_u64(b"hw.memsize") or None
    except (AttributeError, OSError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return parse_meminfo_total(_read_text("/proc/meminfo", 4096))

​代码​组织​是​「​解析器​纯​函数​ + ​平台​读取器​ + ​缓存​门面​」​三层​：parse_meminfo_total(text) ​是​纯​函数​（​对​文本​负责​，​数据​化​测试​友好​），_windows_ram_total()/_sysctl_u64() ​是​平台​读取器​（ctypes/procfs），ram_total_bytes() ​是​缓存​门面​。CPU vendor ​也​有​同等​结构​：parse_cpuinfo_vendor()（​行​ 179-188）​先认​ x86 ​的​ vendor_id，​再认​ arm64 Linux ​的​ CPU implementer ​十六进制​码​（0x41=ARM、0x61=Apple、0x4E=NVIDIA…）。​注释​里​的​一个​细节​值得​记住​：Windows ​报​的​是​ SoC vendor（N1X ​机器​上​就是​ NVIDIA），arm64 Linux ​报​的​是​核心​设计者​——​两者​语义​不同​但​都​是​「​这台​机器​的​芯片​是​谁家​的​」。

docs.title: GPU：​注册表​行到​ vendor ​分类
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/host/facts.py:280-293
def parse_windows_display_adapters(rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]]) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """``(vendor id, device id, description)`` per adapter from ``(subkey, MatchingDeviceId, DriverDesc)`` rows.

    Virtual adapters (no ``VEN_`` id, such as the remote-display driver) are skipped; an
    adapter subkey without a readable id keeps empty ids so it counts as unreadable."""
    adapters = []
    for subkey, matching_id, description in rows:
        upper = matching_id.upper()
        if "VEN_" in upper:
            adapters.append((_hex_after(upper, "VEN_"), _hex_after(upper, "DEV_"), description))
        elif subkey.isdigit() and not matching_id:
            adapters.append(("", "", description))
    return adapters

Windows ​的​显示​适配器​住​在​注册表​显示​类键​（{4d36e968-…}）​下​；​解析器​区分​三种​情况​：​有​ VEN_ ​的​物理​卡​（​提出​ vendor/device id）、​无​ id ​的​子键​（​保留​空​ id、​计入​「​不可​读​」——​分类​结果​是​ unknown ​而​不是​ none，​行​ 259-262）、​无​ VEN_ ​的​虚拟​适配器​（​远程​显示​驱动​，​跳过​）。​分类器​ _GPU_PRIORITY = ("nvidia", "amd", "intel") ​让​独显​在​混合​机器​上​赢​过​核显​。​数据流​：​注册表​行​ → parse_windows_display_adapters（​纯​）→ _windows_display_adapters（​缓存​）→ classify_gpu_vendors（​纯​）。

docs.title: macOS ​两条​ ctypes ​长廊
docs.text:
host/darwin_pci.py ​读​ IOKit registry ​的​ PCI ​显示​控制器​（kCFStringEncodingUTF8、base class 0x03、​上限​ 256 ​设备​）——Intel Mac ​从​这里​拿到​ GPU vendor，Apple silicon ​没有​ PCI ​显示​控制器​（​这是​事实​，​不是​缺陷​）。host/gpu_adapters.py ​走​ DXGI：

# hermes_platform/host/gpu_adapters.py:1-8
"""Windows graphics adapters as DXGI reports them.

Task Manager's "GPU memory" for an adapter is DXGI's dedicated video memory plus shared system
memory, and that sum is what Windows lets the adapter allocate. An integrated GPU has almost no
dedicated memory, so its shared allowance is its real pool: an Intel Arc B390 on a 31.5 GB machine
gets 18 GB. Read through ctypes without environment-variable input or subprocesses."""

ctypes ​手​扒​ COM vtable（_RELEASE, _ENUM_ADAPTERS1, _GET_DESC1 = 2, 12, 10——IUnknown::Release、IDXGIFactory1::EnumAdapters1、IDXGIAdapter1::GetDesc1 ​的​槽​位​号​），_SOFTWARE_FLAG = 0x2 ​排除​ Microsoft Basic Render Driver ​这种​软件​适配器​。​返回​的​ Adapter ​记录​ dedicated_video_memory ​与​ shared_system_memory ​两个​字​段​——「​能​分配​多少​」​是​两者​之​和​，​这​正是​ Task Manager ​显示​的​数字​。

docs.title: summary.py：​账户​事实​的​来源​边界
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/host/summary.py:1-7
"""One summary of this machine and its OS account, for the desktop first-run onboarding.

Hardware facts come from ``hermes_platform.host``. Account facts (full name, locale) come from OS
user records through ``pwd`` or Win32/CoreFoundation calls, never from environment variables such
as HOME or LANG, and never from a subprocess or the network. They describe the machine that runs
the Hermes backend; when the desktop app drives a remote backend, that is not the user's laptop."""

​账户​摘要​（​全名​、locale）​有​三条​来源​禁令​：​绝不​ HOME/LANG ​等​环境变量​、​绝不​ subprocess、​绝不​网络​。​理由​写​在​最后​一句​：​桌面​ app ​可能​驱动​一台​远程​后​端​——HOME ​说​的​是​ shell ​会话​，pwd/Win32/CoreFoundation ​说​的​才​是​「​跑​后​端的​这台​机器​上​的​账户​」。_NON_NAMES（admin/guest/root/user…）​把​泛化​账户​名​从​「​人​名​候选​」​里​剔除​，_HANDLE_CHARS（​数字​、​下划线​、@、​路径​分隔​）​识别​出​ handle ​形态​的​名字​。

docs.title: resolver/core.py：ABSENT、None、"" ​的​三态
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/resolver/core.py:57-67
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LookupContext:
    """`path`: ABSENT = caller did not say (ambient), None = ambient, "" = search nothing."""

    path: str | None | _Absent = ABSENT
    pathext: str | None = None

    def effective_path(self) -> str | None:
        if isinstance(self.path, str):
            return self.path
        return None

LookupContext.path ​的​三种​「​没​给​」​值​语义​不同​：ABSENT（​哨兵​单例​，​行​ 19-26）= ​调用者​没​表态​（​用​环境​ PATH）；None = ​明确​要​用​环境​ PATH；"" = ​什么​都​不​搜​（_which ​行​ 95-96 ​直接​短路​）。pathext ​显式​传入​时​（Windows）​不​读​ os.environ ​的​ PATHEXT ​而是​不​改变​环境​地​尊重​调用者​的​值​。​这套​三态​让​「​测试​注入​ PATH」​与​「​生产​用​环境​ PATH」​是​同一个​代码​路径​，​而​不是​两套​分支​。

docs.title: app.py → availability.py：​从​ AppDef ​到​七态
docs.text:
# hermes_platform/resolver/app.py:1-7
"""Desktop-application resolver over an `AppDef` (parsed from an MCP manifest's `app:` block).

`locate` stats every declared location in order (fixed paths, PATH, uninstall entries, the flatpak,
snap and Applications directories) and lists directories for a `*` path segment; the first present
one wins. `inspect` reads the version source in-process.
`probe` re-reads the vendor's runtime file on every call; the bearer token in it never
leaves this module."""

AppDef ​来自​ MCP ​清单​的​ app: ​块​——​位置​列表​是​声明​式​的​：​固定​路径​、PATH、​卸载​注册表​项​、flatpak/snap/Applications ​目录​，* ​段​做​目录​展开​，​按序​ stat、​第一个​存在​的​胜出​。​三级​努力​各守​各​的​边界​：inspect ​只​在​进程​内开​文件​；probe ​每次​重读​厂商​运行​时​文件​且​ bearer token ​永不​离开​本​模块​（​安全​边界​编码​在​模块​边界​上​）。availability.py ​把​声明​块​折算​成七态​：

# hermes_platform/resolver/availability.py:20-29
AvailabilityState = Literal[
    "available",
    "installed_not_running",
    "missing_app",
    "version_too_old",
    "unsupported_os",
    "unsupported_gpu",
    "no_requirements",
]

​它​跑​的​只有​ locate、inspect ​和​缓存​的​ GPU fact，​永不​ probe、​永不​ spawn、​永不​ connect、​自己​无​缓存​——​需要​ TTL ​的​调用​方​（​工具​注册表​）​已经​有​ TTL，​两层​缓存​是​重复​计费​。​这个​模块​的​存在​让​ MCP ​目录​与​技能​ offer ​门​可以​共享​同一个​「​这台​机器​能​不能​提供​该​条目​」​的​答案​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: ​两个​子层​共享​一条​实现​哲学​：「​读取​」​与​「​判断​」​分离​。​每个​事实​函数​都​是​「​纯​解析器​（​可​数据​化​测试​）+ ​平台​读取器​（ctypes/procfs/registry）+ ​缓存​门面​」​的​三明治​；​每个​解析器​都​输出​ Observation（​分支​于​ state、detail ​不​被​解析​），​把​「​机器​说​了​什么​」​与​「​代码​怎么​决策​」​切开​。​这样​，​平台​差异​被​压缩​进​读取器​的​几行​ ctypes，​决策​逻辑​成为​跨平台​纯​函数​——​这​正是​它​能​作为​全​仓库​唯一​权威​而​不​膨胀​的​原因​。

docs.title: acp_adapter/ —— ​把​ Hermes ​暴露​给​编辑器​的​ ACP ​适配器
文件​概览
docs.text: ACP（Agent Client Protocol）​是​ Zed ​等​编辑器​与​编码​代理​通话​的​协议​；Hermes ​经​ acp/agent-client-protocol Python ​包​实现​它​，acp_adapter/ ​把​ Hermes ​暴露​为​一个​ ACP agent——​于是​你​可以​在​编辑器​里​直接​跟​ Hermes ​对话​。​入口​是​ entry.py（python -m acp_adapter.entry、hermes acp ​或​ hermes-acp ​命令​），​进程​内​服务​在​ server.py（HermesACPAgent，​自​建​ AIAgent ​的​执行​路径​），​网关​投影​在​ gateway_server.py（GatewayACPAgent——「profile ​网关​的​ ACP ​投影​；​永不​构建​执行​ owner」）。​共​ 22 ​个​文件​：​协议​骨架​（entry/server/gateway_server/modes/events/auth）+ ​会话​与​目录​（session/catalog/model_catalog/provenance）+ ​桥接​件​（content/tools/commands/permissions/edit_approval/elicitation）+ ​网关​面​（gateway_commands/gateway_media/gateway_reply/gateway_session_meta）。

docs.title: entry.py：stdout ​是​协议​，stderr ​是​日志
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/entry.py:1-9
"""CLI entry point for the hermes-agent ACP adapter.

Loads ``~/.hermes/.env``, routes logging to stderr (stdout is reserved for ACP
JSON-RPC), and starts the ACP agent server.

Usage::

    python -m acp_adapter.entry   # or: hermes acp / hermes-acp
"""

stdio ​传输​下​ stdout ​是​ JSON-RPC ​专线​——​一条​混进​ stdout ​的​日志​就​会​破坏​协议​帧​，​所以​ _setup_logging()（​行​ 65-78）​把​ root logger ​全部​改道​ stderr（​且经​ RedactingFormatter ​脱敏​），httpx/httpcore/openai ​降噪​到​ WARNING。​启动​顺序​上​有​三道​保险​：

# acp_adapter/entry.py:13-28
try:
    import hermes_bootstrap
except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
    # Partial ``hermes update`` (git-reset landed, ``uv pip install -e .`` did not).
    if exc.name != "hermes_bootstrap" and not "hermes_bootstrap".startswith(f"{exc.name}."):
        raise  # the bootstrap exists but cannot load: skipping it would skip PM activation
else:
    # Stop a ``utils/``/``proxy/``/``ui/`` package in the launch cwd from shadowing Hermes modules.
    hermes_bootstrap.harden_import_path()

# `hermes-acp` runs without hermes_cli.main: repair a `hermes update` killed mid-pull here, before
# importing anything else from the checkout (a no-op under `hermes acp`, which already did).
from hermes_cli import _early_recovery

if _early_recovery.restore_interrupted_pull():
    _early_recovery.relaunch_after_restore()

hermes_bootstrap ​必须​是​第一个​ import（Windows ​上​的​ UTF-8 stdio）；​导入​失败​时​只有​「bootstrap ​本身​存在​但装​不​上​」​才​重​抛​——​跳过​它​等于​跳过​ PM ​激活​。hermes-acp ​不​经过​ hermes_cli.main，​所以​被​半路​杀死​的​ hermes update ​的​恢复​（restore_interrupted_pull → ​可能​ re-launch）​在​这里​补做​。​良性​探针​过滤​（​行​ 39-62）：ping/health/healthcheck ​不​在​ ACP schema ​里​，​路由器​正确​回​ JSON-RPC -32601（​客户端​当​「agent ​活着​」），​但​派发​ supervisor ​会为​每次​探针​打​一条​「Background task failed」​堆栈​——​过滤器​只​吞​这个​噪声​，​其余​ method_not_found ​依旧​可见​。​进程​主​循环​里​还有​两处​值得注意​：Windows ​上​先​在​主线​程​预热​ memory provider + numpy ​的​ import（​首次​原生​扩展​ import ​与​另​一线​程​的​ import ​链​竞争​曾​在​ create_module ​死锁​、session/new ​永不​响应​，#58083）；MCP ​发现​与​执行​属于​网关​守护​进程​——「​这个​进程​是​一个​查看​者​」。

docs.title: server.py vs gateway_server.py：​两条​执行​路径
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/server.py:273
class HermesACPAgent(SlashCommandsMixin, acp.Agent):

# acp_adapter/gateway_server.py:1
"""ACP projection of the profile gateway; never constructs an execution owner."""

server.py（1,155 ​行​）​是​进程​内​ agent server：​自己​构造​ AIAgent（​线程​池​ _executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4, thread_name_prefix="acp-agent") ​把​同步​ agent ​挪出​事件​循环​），​自己​管理​ sessions/models/modes/usage ​更新​（​经​ acp.schema ​类型​）。gateway_server.py（1,238 ​行​）​是​另​一条​路​：​投影​——​经​ hermes_cli.gateway_client.connect_gateway ​把​每个​ ACP ​请求​转​成​网关​动词​，​本​进程​不建​任何​执行​ owner。 slash ​识别​（_slash_command，​行​ 17-33）​只认​注册​命令​或​别名​：/etc/hosts is wrong ​是​ prompt ​文本​不是​命令​；​注册​命令​绝不​降级​为​ prompt——​要么​被​网关​动词​应答​，​要么​按名​拒绝​。--safe-mode/--ignore-user-config ​启动​的​会​话​必须​在​ session/new ​时​冻结​显式​路由​（_bypass_route，​行​ 36-51）：​只​给​模型​不​给​ provider ​的话​，​第一轮​ turn ​就​无法​构建​ agent——​所以​在​会​话​创建​时​就​拒绝​。

docs.title: modes.py：​一张​ 19 ​行​的​表
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/modes.py:1-18
"""ACP's edit modes, one table for the in-process server and the gateway path.

mode id -> (edit approval policy, display name, description). On the gateway path the policy is the
session's own on the owner (``session.mutate edit_policy``), enforced where the edit runs
(``gateway/session_local_editor.py``); sensitive paths always ask."""

DEFAULT_MODE = "default"
DEFAULT_EDIT_APPROVAL_POLICY = "ask"
EDIT_APPROVAL_POLICY_CONFIG_ID = "edit_approval_policy"
MODES: dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]] = {
    "default": ("ask", "Default", "Ask before edits."),
    "accept_edits": ("workspace_session", "Accept Edits",
                     "Auto-allow workspace and temp-dir edits; still asks for sensitive paths."),
    "dont_ask": ("session", "Don't Ask", "Auto-allow file edits for this session except sensitive paths."),
}
MODE_TO_EDIT_APPROVAL_POLICY = {mode: spec[0] for mode, spec in MODES.items()}
EDIT_APPROVAL_POLICY_TO_MODE = {spec[0]: mode for mode, spec in MODES.items()}

​三个​编辑​模式​映射​到​ Hermes ​的​编辑​审批​政策​：default→ask（​每笔​编辑​都​问​）、accept_edits→workspace_session（​工作​区​+​临时​目录​自动​放行​，​敏感​路径​仍​问​）、dont_ask→session（​本会话​文件​编辑​自动​放行​，​敏感​路径​例外​）。​敏感​路径​永远​要​问​——​模式​再​宽松​也​不​越过​安全​下限​。​表​驱动​：​进程​内​路径​直接​查表​构造​审批​回调​（permissions.py ​的​ make_approval_callback），​网关​路径​把​它​写​进​ owner ​的​ session.mutate edit_policy、​在​编辑​真正​执行​的​地方​（gateway/session_local_editor.py）​强制​。edit_approval.py ​是​预​执行​审批​助手​：​把​审批​请求者​绑进​ ContextVar，​只​在​一次​ ACP agent ​运行​期间​有效​；CLI/​网关​等会话​不设​它​、​天然​绕过​——「​隔离​于​通用​工具​注册表​」​是​刻意​的​。

docs.title: events.py：​线程​到​事件​循环​的​桥
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/events.py:1-7
"""Callback factories for bridging AIAgent events to ACP notifications.

Each factory returns a callable with the signature AIAgent expects for its
callbacks. AIAgent runs in a worker thread while the event loop lives on the
main thread, so updates are pushed via ``conn.session_update()`` scheduled
thread-safely onto the loop."""

AIAgent ​在​ worker ​线程​跑​、​事件​循环​在​主线​程​——​每个​回调​工厂​（make_message_cb、make_step_cb、make_thinking_cb、make_tool_progress_cb）​都​返回​ AIAgent ​期待​的​签名​，​内部​用​ conn.session_update() ​线程​安全​地排​进​循环​。AssistantMessageIdAllocator ​分配​消息​ id；flush_open_tool_calls ​保证​流​中断​时未​闭合​的​ tool-call ​气泡​被​正确​关闭​；_build_plan_update_from_todo_result ​把​ Hermes ​的​ todo ​结果​折算​成​ ACP ​的​计划​更新​。content.py ​做​反向​翻译​：ACP prompt ​内容​块​（​文本​/​图片​/​资源​/audio）⇄ OpenAI user content；tools.py ​把​ Hermes ​工具​映射​到​ ACP ToolKind ​并用​ agent.display.build_tool_preview ​造​预览​。

docs.text:
# acp_adapter/auth.py:1-8
"""ACP auth helpers — detect and advertise Hermes authentication methods."""

TERMINAL_SETUP_AUTH_METHOD_ID = "hermes-setup"


def detect_provider() -> Optional[str]:
    """Resolve the active Hermes runtime provider, or None if unavailable.

    A callable ``api_key`` (Azure Foundry Entra ID bearer-token provider, see
    :mod:`agent.azure_identity_adapter`) counts as a valid credential; otherwise
    Entra-configured Foundry deployments would default to ``"openrouter"`` and ...

hermes-setup ​认证​方法​把​「​在​终端​里​跑​ hermes acp --setup」​通告​给​编辑器​——​编辑器​发起​认证​时​，​适配器​指引​它​走​ Hermes ​自己​的​ provider/model ​设置​流​。detect_provider ​的​细节​：​可​调用​的​ api_key（Entra bearer token ​提供者​）​也​算​有效​凭据​，​否则​ Entra ​配置​的​ Foundry ​部署​会​被​误判​为​默认​ openrouter。catalog.py ​是​历史​会话​目录​：​从​ hermes_state.SessionDB ​只读​投影​（​不​做​存储​初始化​、​不建​执行​ owner）；provenance.py ​从​既有​压缩​链​（sessions ​表​的​ parent_session_id/end_reason）​派生​ _meta.hermes ​出处​元​数据​——​压缩​轮换​内部​ head ​时​，​编辑器​侧​的​ session_id ​仍​是​稳定​公共​句柄​，​出处​元​数据​暴露​前​/​当前​内部​ id ​与​谱系​根​。elicitation.py：​声明​了​ elicitation.form ​能力​的​客户端​拿到​ elicitation/create ​表单​；​其他​客户端​拿到​「​选项​ + Skip」​的​权限​卡​——​所有​ ACP ​客户端​都​会​渲染​的​那种​交互​。

  • tools/approval_context：set_hermes_interactive_context ​让​ ACP ​会话​获得​交互式​审批​语义​。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text: acp_adapter ​的​全部​复杂度​都​服务​于​一条​原则​：「​查看​者​而​非​ owner」。​进程​内​路径​（server.py）​为​没有​网关​的​轻量​场景​自​建​ agent；​网关​路径​（gateway_server.py）​把​每个​ ACP ​概念​投影​成​既有​网关​动词​，​永不​构建​第二个​执行​ owner——​执行​、MCP、​会话​生命周期​都​归​ daemon，​编辑器​只是​一个​渲染器​。​协议​适配​的​技术​底座​是​三条​纪律​：stdout ​只​走​协议​帧​（​日志​全​改道​ stderr）、​跨​线程​事件​线程​安全​地排​进​循环​、​编辑​审批​的​安全​下限​（​敏感​路径​必问​）​写​在​模式​表​之外​、​不可​协商​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: ​本篇​按​「​一个​进程​如何​变成​一个​ ACP agent」​的​顺序​走读​协议​接入​的​五个​支点​：entry.py（​进程​外壳​与​ stdio ​纪律​）、server.py（​进程​内​ agent ​的​会​话​生命周期​）、gateway_server.py（​网关​投影​与​回复​分组​）、modes.py + permissions.py + edit_approval.py（​编辑​审批​的​三层​）、events.py（​事件​桥​）。​全部​ 22 ​个​文件​的​清单​在​ index.md，​此处​不​重复​。

docs.title: 进程​外壳​：​三层​启动​保险​ + ​一个​会话​生命周期​的​所有权
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/entry.py:197-226（​节选​）
    import acp
    from .server import HermesACPAgent

    # Windows: import the configured memory provider (and numpy) on the main thread before
    # the ACP stdin-reader thread starts. A first-time native-extension import racing another
    # thread's import chain deadlocked in create_module and session/new never answered (#58083).
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        _warm_memory_provider_import(logger)

    # MCP discovery and execution belong to the gateway daemon; this process is a viewer.
    agent = HermesACPAgent()

    async def serve():
        # MCP and execution belong to the daemon. Close only this viewer, while
        # its event loop is still alive, including on protocol/transport errors.
        try:
            await acp.run_agent(agent, use_unstable_protocol=True)
        finally:
            await agent.aclose()

    try:
        asyncio.run(serve())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logger.info("Shutting down (KeyboardInterrupt)")

​三个​启动​细节​：Windows ​主线​程先​预热​ memory provider ​的​ import（#58083 ​的​死锁​修复​）；HermesACPAgent() ​构造​旁​的​注释​宣告​了​进程​身份​——「MCP ​发现​与​执行​属于​网关​守护​进程​；​这个​进程​是​一个​查看​者​」；serve() ​的​ finally ​只关​这个​查看​者​，​且​在​事件​循环​还​活着​的​时候​关​（​协议​/​传输​错误​也​一样​）——​没有​任何​ ended_at ​时间​戳​：​会话​是​ daemon ​拥有​的​，​可能​还有​别的​查看​者​或​排队​的​工作​；owner ​在​最后​一个​查看​者​以​空闲​ FIFO ​脱离​时​、​或​在​网关​停止​时才​结束​ ACP ​会话​（gateway/session_acp_lifecycle.py，#118216）。​这​就是​「​查看​者​而​非​ owner」​在​进程​生命周期​上​的​具体​形状​。

docs.title: 进程​内​ server：​历史​恢复​与​压缩​协作
docs.text: HermesACPAgent（server.py:273）​把​ ACP ​会话​映射​到​ AIAgent：session.py::SessionManager ​持有​会话表​，​每个​会话​持久​化进​共享​ hermes_state.SessionDB——​重启​后​ load_session/resume_session ​从​ state.db ​全量​恢复​历史​，​编辑​器重​连​不​丢​上下文​。​压缩​链是​编辑器​特有​的​难点​：​压缩​轮换​内部​ head ​时​，​编辑器​握​着​的​ session_id ​必须​保持稳定​——provenance.py ​从​ sessions ​表​的​ parent_session_id/end_reason ​派生​ _meta.hermes ​出处​（​前​/​当前​内部​ id、​谱系​根​），​不​新增​任何​持久​状态​。​模型​选择器​（model_catalog.py）​把​ Hermes ​库存​ + ​命名​端点​去​重成​ provider:model ​行​（​每​ provider ​上限​ ACP_MAX_MODELS_PER_PROVIDER = 200，​客户端​在​一个​下拉框​里​渲染​全部​ availableModels；​当前​模型​经​ fallback ​插入​永远​保留​）。

docs.title: 网关​投影​：​回复​分组​与​恰好​一次​终稿
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/gateway_reply.py:1-4
"""How a gateway turn's reply reaches the editor: ``messageId`` grouping, exactly-once final text, tool and
permission bubbles closed as the in-process agent closed them. Mixed into ``GatewayACPAgent``, whose state
(``_conn``, ``_streamed``, ``_segments``, ``_tool_args``, ``_message_ids``, ``_cut``) it reads and updates."""

​网关​路径​的​难点​不​在​请求​（prompt.submit ​直白​），​而​在​流式​回复​的​语义​对齐​：​网关​的​流式​事件​要​折算​成​ ACP ​的​ session_update，messageId ​把​同​一轮​的​片段​分组​，​终稿​文本​恰好​出现​一次​（​流式​增量​ + ​最终​完整​文本​不能​重复​呈现​），​工具​气泡​与​权限​气泡​的​打开​/​关闭​时机​对齐​进程​内​ agent ​的​行为​——​同一个​编辑器​客户端​不应​因后​端​是​网关​还是​进程​内​ agent ​而​看到​不同​的​ UI ​生命周期​。gateway_media.py ​把​编辑器​发来​的​内容​块​转成​ prompt.submit ​文本​ + ​暂存​图片附件​（​远程​图片​ URL ​拉取​失败​不​致命​）；gateway_session_meta.py ​的​每个​数字​都​来自​ owner ​的​既有​读数​（session.info ​快照​、session.stats、message.complete ​的​ usage、​或​ state.db）——​投影​层​自己​不​算账​。

slash ​命令​在​网关​路径​上​各有​归宿​（gateway_commands.py docstring）：​报告​类​是​ owner ​的​ slash.exec ​读数​；/model、/compress、/reset ​是​保留​的​ session.mutate ​控制​；/steer ​是​ owner ​的​ session.steer；/queue ​与​空闲​的​ /steer ​变成​下​一个​ prompt（​会话​ FIFO ​在​在​途​ turn ​之后​执行​）；/title ​是​ rename、/undo//retry ​是​ rewind；​其余​注册​命令​原样​送​ slash.exec——​拒绝​也​要​以​「​点名​命令​的​回复​」​到达​编辑器​，​绝不能​变成​一次​失败​的​ prompt。

docs.title: 编辑​审批​的​三层
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/permissions.py:9-12
"""ACP permission bridging for Hermes dangerous-command approvals."""
# ACP permission option id -> Hermes approval result. Ids are stable across the
# ``allow_permanent=True`` and ``False`` paths even though the option list differs.

​第一层​是​ permissions.py：Hermes ​的​危险​命令​审批​被​翻译成​ ACP ​权限​请求​（PermissionOption/AllowedOutcome），​选项​ id ​在​「​允许​记住​」​与​「​只​允许​一次​」​两条​路径​上​保持稳定​（​选项​列表​不同​、id ​语义​不变​）；FutureTimeout ​与​递增​计数器​处理​「​编辑器​没​人​应答​」​的​路径​。​第二层​是​ edit_approval.py：​把​编辑​审批​请求者​绑进​ ContextVar、​只​覆盖​一次​ ACP agent ​运行​——CLI/​网关​等会话​不设​它​、​自然​绕过​；​刻意​不进​通用​工具​注册表​，​因为​这​不是​工具​行为​而是​会话​行为​。​第三层​是​ modes.py ​的​模式​表​（​见​ index.md）：ACP ​的​三档​编辑​模式​映射​到​ Hermes ​审批​政策​，​网关​路径​把​政策​写​进​ owner ​的​ session.mutate edit_policy、​在​编辑​真正​执行​处​强制​——​适配器​只​声明​意图​，​不​执行​放行​。

docs.title: 事件​桥​的​细节
docs.text:
# acp_adapter/events.py:9-11
Each factory returns a callable with the signature AIAgent expects for its
callbacks. AIAgent runs in a worker thread while the event loop lives on the
main thread, so updates are pushed via ``conn.session_update()`` scheduled
thread-safely onto the loop.

​四个​工厂​（message/step/thinking/tool_progress）+ ​两个​助手​：AssistantMessageIdAllocator（​消息​ id ​分配​——​流式​增量​要​挂​同一个​ id ​下​）、flush_open_tool_calls（​流​被​截断​时​，​把​还​开​着​的​ tool-call ​气泡​按​ ACP ​语义​闭合​——​否则​编辑器​留下​永远​转圈​的​气泡​）。_build_plan_update_from_todo_result ​是​语义​折算​的​样例​：Hermes ​的​ todo ​工具​结果​ → ACP ​的​ AgentPlanUpdate（PlanEntry ​列表​），​让​编辑器​原生​渲染​任务​清单​。
